### [1] [STATERA: Hidden Mass Estimation via Zero-Shot Sim-to-Real Kinematics using Frozen Temporal Tubelets](https://arxiv.org/abs/2610.00003)
*Animesh Varma*

Main category: cs.CV

TL;DR: 该论文研究从单目短视频中估计不透明非对称刚体质心（CoM）的问题，提出STATERA模型，通过冻结V-JEPA骨干网络并配合轻量时序tubelet混合器预测逐帧CoM热力图与轨迹，并构建HiddenMass基准（5万条MuJoCo轨迹+63段真实测试序列）。仿真中归一化CoM误差由41.7%降至25.2%；零样本仿真到现实迁移中揭示监督信号的根本权衡，相敏目标可实现41.0%的物理捕获率。


<details>
  <summary>Details</summary>
Motivation: 预训练视觉模型多针对帧级外观，难以从运动中推断隐藏物理属性。在自遮挡条件下，表面线索与点跟踪均不可靠，因此需要研究从单目短视频中估计刚体质心这一隐藏参数。

Method: 提出STATERA：在预训练视频骨干V-JEPA上以大部分冻结权重进行适配，加入轻量时序tubelet混合器，输出逐帧CoM热力图与轨迹。同时构建HiddenMass基准，包含5万条MuJoCo轨迹和63段带物理标定CoM真值的真实世界测试序列。

Result: 仿真中STATERA-50K-Sigma将归一化CoM误差从DINOv2的41.7%降至25.2%。零样本仿真到现实迁移中观察到监督信号的根本权衡：相敏目标易导致双峰预测，相无关目标易坍缩至统计安全的质心。相敏的STATERA-50K-Crescent是唯一持续朝真实隐藏偏移移动的方法，虽带来单目向量过冲、绝对欧氏误差略增，但物理捕获率从2.6%提升至41.0%。

Conclusion: 结果表明，冻结的时序表征能更好地将惯性动力学与视觉几何分离，从而利于隐藏参数估计。

Abstract: Vision models pretrained for frame-level appearance often struggle to infer hidden physical properties from motion. We study center-of-mass (CoM) localization for opaque, asymmetric rigid bodies from short monocular videos, where surface cues and point tracking are unreliable under self-occlusion. We propose STATERA, which adapts a pretrained video backbone (V-JEPA) with mostly frozen weights and a lightweight temporal tubelet mixer to predict per-frame CoM heatmaps and trajectories. To support this task, we introduce the HiddenMass Benchmark, comprising 50K MuJoCo trajectories and a 63-sequence real-world test set with physically calibrated CoM ground truth. In simulation, STATERA-50K-Sigma improves normalized CoM error from 41.7% (DINOv2) to 25.2%. In zero-shot sim-to-real transfer, we observe a fundamental trade-off in supervision: phase-aware targets can induce bimodal predictions, while phase-agnostic targets can collapse toward statistically safe centroids. Nevertheless, our phase-aware STATERA-50K-Crescent is the only evaluated method that demonstrates consistent movement toward the true hidden offset. While this leads to a monocular vector overshoot artifact that marginally increases absolute Euclidean error compared to a static geometric centroid, it improves physics capture from 2.6% to 41.0%. These results suggest that frozen temporal representations can better separate inertial dynamics from visual geometry for hidden-parameter estimation.

</details>


### [2] [Emergent Object Binding Has a Finite Spatial Horizon](https://arxiv.org/abs/2610.00006)
*Mayank Singal*

Main category: cs.CV

TL;DR: 预训练ViT的冻结patch嵌入中可解码出"同一物体"信号，但该信号并非全局均质，而是呈有限长度的指数空间衰减（局部绑定），这一局域性可解释大物体绑定减弱、同类物体分离困难等聚合指标掩盖的现象。


<details>
  <summary>Details</summary>
Motivation: 已有工作发现预训练视觉Transformer（ViT）的冻结patch嵌入可高准确率解码出"两patch是否属于同一物体"（IsSameObject）信号，暗示物体绑定（object binding）可仅由自监督预训练涌现。但单一准确率数值掩盖了该信号的空间结构，作者希望揭示绑定的内在组织方式，并解释聚合分数无法说明的一系列行为。

Method: 将绑定建模为具有有限作用范围的局部空间相干性；在不同物体尺寸、三种探针（probe）家族、ADE20K与COCO两个数据集、以及DINO与CLIP骨干上测量"同一物体两patch被判为绑定"的概率随patch间距离的变化，并拟合指数衰减曲线（含长度尺度与地板值）；在控制混淆因素的前提下逐一刻画各行为；另在DINOv2与DINOv3中比较该范围与地板值所对应的层深组织。

Result: 绑定概率随两patch距离单调下降，并在非零地板处趋于平稳，衰减可由有限长度尺度的指数函数良好描述；该衰减在物体尺寸、三类探针、ADE20K与COCO、DINO与CLIP骨干间均稳定，说明其为表征属性而非解码器属性。以"有限范围的局部空间相干性"解读绑定，可解释聚合分数所忽视的行为：大物体上绑定减弱、同类不同物体比不同类物体更难区分、物体部分与整体被归为一组；而在控制物体尺寸后，绑定不受遮挡影响。DINOv2与DINOv3中衰减范围与地板处于不同深度，但作者因探针层数少、两模型间存在混淆而仅作为提示性观察报告。

Conclusion: IsSameObject信号的本质是具有有限空间作用范围的局部绑定：其距离衰减遵循带非零地板的指数规律，是预训练表征的内在属性，跨数据集、探针与骨干一致。该局域性框架统一解释了大物体绑定弱化、同类物体难以分离、部分-整体聚合等行为，并将物体绑定与分层深度组织联系起来，为理解ViT中物体表征的涌现结构提供了更细粒度的刻画。

Abstract: Pretrained Vision Transformers encode whether two image patches belong to the same object. This IsSameObject signal is decodable from frozen patch embeddings at high accuracy, which suggests that object binding emerges from self-supervised pretraining alone. We show that this single accuracy number hides the structure of the signal. Binding is local: the probability that two patches of the same object are decoded as bound falls off monotonically with the distance between them and levels off at a nonzero floor, a falloff well described by an exponential with a finite length scale. This decay holds across object sizes, across three families of probe, on both ADE20K and COCO, and across DINO and CLIP backbones, which indicates that it is a property of the representation rather than of the decoder. Reading binding as local spatial coherence with a finite range accounts for a set of behaviors that the aggregate score leaves unexplained: binding weakens on large objects, separates distinct objects of the same class less reliably than objects of different classes, and groups object parts with their wholes. It is, by contrast, unaffected by occlusion once object size is controlled. We map each behavior with confounds controlled. As a preliminary observation, the horizon and its floor are organized at different depths in DINOv2 and DINOv3, which we report as suggestive given the small number of layers probed and the confound between the two models.

</details>


### [3] [Spatial Lifting for Dense Prediction](https://arxiv.org/abs/2610.00017)
*Mingzhi Xu,Tao Zhou,Yong Li,Yizhe Zhang*

Main category: cs.CV

TL;DR: 提出空间提升(SL)方法：将2D图像升维到高维空间，用3D U-Net等网络处理，在密集预测任务中以更少参数和更低推理成本取得良好性能，并实现自一致性的质量与不确定性估计。


<details>
  <summary>Details</summary>
Motivation: 传统密集预测方法（如2D网络）在性能、推理成本和模型参数量之间难以兼顾。作者希望探索一种反直觉的建模策略，通过升维输入来提升效率与可靠性。

Method: SL将标准2D输入提升到更高维空间，然后使用为该高维设计的网络（如3D U-Net）进行处理。该框架在提升维度上产生内在结构化输出，支持训练时的密集监督，并在测试时通过单次前向传播实现基于自一致性的质量与不确定性估计。

Result: 在基准任务上，SL相比传统方法取得良好性能，同时降低推理成本并大幅减少模型参数量，还能产生结构化输出用于训练监督和测试时的不确定性估计。

Conclusion: 空间提升提供了一种简单通用的建模策略，为视觉密集预测任务中更高效、准确、可靠的深度网络指明了有前景的方向。

Abstract: We present Spatial Lifting (SL), a novel methodology for dense prediction tasks. SL operates by lifting standard inputs, such as 2D images, into a higher-dimensional space and subsequently processing them using networks designed for that higher dimension, such as a 3D U-Net. Counterintuitively, this dimensionality lifting allows us to achieve good performance on benchmark tasks compared to conventional approaches, while reducing inference costs and \textbf{drastically lowering the number of model parameters}. The SL framework produces intrinsically structured outputs along the lifted dimension. This emergent structure facilitates dense supervision during training and enables single-forward-pass self-consistency-based quality and uncertainty estimation at test time. Spatial Lifting introduces a simple and general modeling strategy that offers a promising path toward more efficient, accurate, and reliable deep networks for dense prediction tasks in vision.

</details>


### [4] [Encoded but Disconnected: Decomposing Vision-Language Model Failures under a Patching Null](https://arxiv.org/abs/2610.00024)
*Genpei Zhang*

Main category: cs.CV

TL;DR: 在三种视觉语言模型（LLaVA-1.5-7B、Qwen2.5-VL-7B、InternVL3-8B）上，中层普遍能编码正确答案但该信号不具因果作用；错误可分三类且可学习判别，但缓解效果仅在oracle标签下呈现。


<details>
  <summary>Details</summary>
Motivation: 探究中层表征的"可解释性"是否具备因果作用：尽管中层编码了正确答案，但这一信号是否真正驱动最终预测尚不清楚，作者希望系统检验中层可解释性与因果性之间的断裂。

Method: 在POPE基准（三模型共有的评测集）上，采用残差流patching（层级别与头级别）进行因果干预；分析错误样本中中层编码真值答案的比例；识别唯一例外头（InternVL3 layer-20 head-2，非词表、自注意力头）；并将错误操作化分为三类失败模式进行可学习性验证。

Result: 中层在68-91%的错误中编码了真值答案，但残差流patching在三种架构的层级干预均为0%非平凡翻转；头级别在两个模型上也为0%（Qwen：0/12,600 patched forwards）；唯一例外InternVL3 layer-20 head-2的效果局限于该头（p < 1e-4）。三类失败模式（Perception Failure、Encoded-but-Disconnected、Prior-Override）在三架构上均可学习判别，准确率超60%，且架构先验方向可预测两种干预中哪一种引发类别特异响应。

Conclusion: 中层编码的信号对最终预测不具因果活性，构成跨架构的普遍性否定发现；但错误可在操作层面分离为三类机制上真实的失败模式。缓解效果仅作为类别机制真实性的证据，而非可部署方法。

Abstract: Across three vision-language model architectures (LLaVA-1.5-7B, Qwen2.5-VL-7B, InternVL3-8B), we report a universal negative finding for mid-layer interpretability. On POPE -- the benchmark common to all three -- the mid layers encode the ground-truth answer in 68-91% of errors, yet this signal is not causally active for the final prediction: residual-stream patching yields 0% non-trivial flip at the layer level on all three architectures, and on two of three at the per-head level (Qwen: 0/12,600 patched forwards). The lone exception, InternVL3 layer-20 head-2, is a non-vocab, self-attending head whose effect is localized to that specific head (p < 1e-4). Despite the null, the errors separate operationally into three failure modes -- Perception Failure, Encoded-but-Disconnected, Prior-Override -- learnable above 60% on all three architectures, and the architecture's prior direction predicts which of two interventions elicits a category-specific response. We report these mitigation effects under oracle labels as evidence the categories are mechanistically real, not as a deployable method.

</details>


### [5] [Domain generalization and synthetic data in object detection: the enabler, the probe, and the gap](https://arxiv.org/abs/2610.00030)
*Elfi I. S. Hofmeijer,Ella P. Fokkinga,Friso G. Heslinga,Klamer Schutte,Jörgen M. Karlholm*

Main category: cs.CV

TL;DR: 本文综述了面向目标检测的域泛化（DG）研究，并从合成数据作为“使能器”“探针”以及“合成-真实鸿沟”三个视角，分析其在提升分布偏移下检测鲁棒性中的作用，指出未来需发展显式处理定位与分类的表示感知方法。


<details>
  <summary>Details</summary>
Motivation: 目标检测模型在部署中常因天气、运行环境或目标外观变化等分布偏移而性能下降。域泛化旨在让模型在未见域上保持稳健，但聚焦目标检测的DG研究稀缺，且检测还面临定位与多尺度表示的额外挑战；同时合成数据虽被视为支持DG的有力工具，其作用与局限缺乏系统梳理。

Method: 采用以目标检测为核心的DG综述方法，从三个互补视角审视合成数据的角色：一是作为DG的使能器，通过多样化与对齐策略提升对分布偏移的鲁棒性；二是作为探针，支持受控实验以识别和理解失败模式；三是讨论合成-真实鸿沟这一特殊且困难的域偏移形式，即基于合成图像训练的模型部署到真实数据时产生的偏差。

Result: 通过系统梳理上述三个视角，归纳了现有DG方法在目标检测任务中的局限性，特别是在定位与分类两方面应对域偏移时的不足，并明确了合成数据在dg研究与失败模式分析中的价值与边界。

Conclusion: 面向目标检测的未来DG研究需要发展表示感知（representation-aware）的方法，能够显式地在域偏移下同时处理定位与分类问题。

Abstract: Object detection models often experience performance degradation when deployed under distribution shifts, caused by for example changes in weather type, operational environment, or object appearance. Domain Generalization (DG) aims to develop models that remain robust under such shifts and generalize well to unseen domains. DG research specifically focused on object detection models is scarce, although these models face additional challenges around localization and multi-scale representations. Synthetic data is a promising tool to support in DG, by enabling large-scale generation of diverse new samples. In this paper, we present an object detection-centric review of DG and examine the role of synthetic data from three complementary perspectives. First, synthetic data acts as an enabler of DG through diversification and alignment strategies that aim to improve robustness to distribution shifts. Second, it serves as a probe that enables controlled experimentation to identify and understand failure modes. Third, we discuss the synthetic-to-real gap, a particularly challenging form of domain shift that arises when models trained on synthetic imagery are deployed on real-world data. Through reviewing these perspectives, we identify limitations of current DG approaches for object detection and argue that future research requires representation-aware methods that explicitly address both localization and classification under domain shift.

</details>


### [6] [Seeing the City or Recognizing the Place? What Street-View Imagery Adds Beyond Existing Urban Data in VLM Urban Sensing](https://arxiv.org/abs/2610.00031)
*Kaizhen Tan*

Main category: cs.CV

TL;DR: 论文比较街景图像预测与既有城市数据在七项城市属性上的信息价值,指出图像价值取决于视觉可辨识性与局部数据覆盖度,并受与最近标注建筑距离及建筑高度调节。


<details>
  <summary>Details</summary>
Motivation: 街景图像被广泛用于推断城市属性,但仅凭预测精度无法判断图像相比同一地点的既有数据提供了多少额外信息。作者希望量化图像的增量价值,并为图像采集策略与派生城市地图的数据来源溯源提供依据。

Method: 对同一批城市单元,分别使用图像、任务上下文、邻近观测和公共记录进行预测比较;覆盖5个公共资源中的7项属性和3个视觉语言模型。通过图像替换与冲突记录测试模型对数据源的依赖。此外分析图像优势随到最近标注建筑距离、建筑高度的变化,并检验OpenFACADES楼层标注(由OpenStreetMap楼层值生成)与纯图像重跑之间误差模式的方向差异。

Result: 在道路损坏、路缘坡道和房价上,既有城市数据与图像模型持平或更优;邻近官方统计在人口上几乎追平最佳图像结果。图像在建筑类型、建筑功能和低层楼层数上更具信息量。楼层数方面,到最近标注建筑的距离每翻一倍,图像优势增加5.7个百分点,而对屋顶线常超出画面的高层建筑优势下降。模型在记录冲突时往往跟随冲突记录。OpenFACADES楼层标注呈现与纯图像重跑相反的随高度变化的误差模式。

Conclusion: 街景图像的价值并非普遍更高,而取决于视觉可辨识性与局部数据覆盖度。将图像与既有城市数据对比,可指导图像采集并厘清派生城市地图的数据来源。

Abstract: Street-view imagery is increasingly used to infer urban attributes, but predictive accuracy alone does not reveal how much a photograph contributes beyond data already available for the same place. We compare image-based predictions with existing urban data across seven attributes from five public resources and three VLMs. The same urban units are evaluated using images, task context, nearby observations, and public records, while image replacements and conflicting records test source reliance. Existing urban data matched or exceeded image-only models for road damage, curb ramps, and house price, while neighbouring official statistics nearly matched the best image result for population. Images were more informative for building type, building function, and low-rise floor count. For floor count, image advantage increased by 5.7 percentage points per doubling of distance to the nearest labelled building and declined for tall buildings whose rooflines often fell outside the frame. Models frequently followed conflicting records. OpenFACADES floor annotations were generated with OpenStreetMap floor values and showed the opposite height-dependent error pattern from image-only reruns. Street-view image value therefore depends on visual legibility and local data coverage. Comparing images with existing urban data can guide image collection and clarify the provenance of derived urban maps.

</details>


### [7] [DSSR-3D: Decoupled Reasoning for View-Dependent Referring in 3D Gaussians](https://arxiv.org/abs/2610.00040)
*Thanh-Khoi Nguyen,Thien-Phuc Tran,Minh-Triet Tran*

Main category: cs.CV

TL;DR: 提出DSSR-3D，一个无需重训练的推理期框架，在连续3D高斯场上实现视角相关的指代分割，并构建ViewRef-GS基准。


<details>
  <summary>Details</summary>
Motivation: 现有指代3D场将语言特征嵌入全局视角不变空间，无法解决依赖相机位姿的观察者中心空间关系（如"在……左侧"）。

Method: 形式化为两个接口：位姿不变的语义定位与位姿条件的空间推理，任意满足约束的函数对均可实例化。以温度锐化softmax定位机制与基于投影的方向评分函数实现两接口，并通过轻量、免训练步骤融合；同时提出ViewRef-GS基准并联合增强版Ref-LERF评估。

Result: 较现有基于3DGS的指代方法取得一致性提升，且除基础语义场外无需额外训练；两接口可零样本迁移至结构不同的语义场。

Conclusion: 以接口化形式统一视角相关指代分割，摆脱全局视角不变嵌入与离散几何代理（如边界框）的依赖，为视角相关空间定位提供通用且免训练的方案与测试床。

Abstract: Recent advances in 3D Gaussian Splatting have enabled open-vocabulary and referring segmentation by distilling semantic knowledge from 2D foundation models into 3D representations. However, existing referring fields embed language features in a globally view-invariant space, making them fundamentally unable to resolve observer-centric spatial relations (e.g., "to the left of") that depend on camera pose. We propose DSSR-3D, an inference-time framework for view-dependent referring segmentation on continuous 3D Gaussian fields, formalized as two interfaces - pose-invariant semantic localization and pose-conditioned spatial reasoning - such that any pair of functions satisfying these constraints yields a valid instantiation, requiring no retraining of the underlying semantic field and no reliance on discrete geometric proxies such as bounding boxes. We instantiate the two interfaces with a temperature-sharpened softmax localization mechanism and a projection-based directional scoring function, fused via a lightweight, training-free step, and show they transfer zero-shot to structurally distinct semantic fields without adaptation. We further propose ViewRef-GS, a benchmark isolating view-dependent segmentation on 3D Gaussian fields, evaluated jointly with an augmented Ref-LERF to provide a comprehensive testbed for viewpoint-dependent spatial grounding. Experiments show consistent gains over existing 3DGS-based referring methods, with no additional training beyond the base semantic field

</details>


### [8] [Reachability Is Not Generalization: Understanding Verb--Noun Decomposition in Assembly Action Recognition](https://arxiv.org/abs/2610.00064)
*Changyi Li,Yu Xiao*

Main category: cs.CV

TL;DR: 该论文系统分析了装配动作识别中动-名分解在组合泛化上的局限：分解虽能突破原子分类的概率上限，但其泛化收益主要来自训练共现结构密集区域内的插值，而非自由重组。


<details>
  <summary>Details</summary>
Motivation: 装配动作具有组合性（操作+部件/工具），部署中系统常遇到熟悉组件的新组合，而原子动作分类器对任何未见组合在构造上赋予零概率。动-名分解被广泛采用以预测组件再重组，但其在组合偏移下的泛化机制尚不清楚。

Abstract: Assembly actions are compositional: they combine a manipulation with a part or tool. We further show that shared-encoder training introduces component entanglement, encouraging reliance on co-occurrence patterns that transfer poorly to unseen compositions and trailing independent recombination by up to $6.0\times$ in harmonic mean. Taken together, these findings explain why decomposition achieves only partial compositional generalization in practice. By identifying primitive support, vocabulary asymmetry, and component entanglement as connected sources of error, we provide a portable diagnostic framework for studying compositional recognition beyond aggregate accuracy. *Rasul Khanbayov,Hasan Kurban*

Main category: cs.CV

TL;DR: 本文质疑图像侧反事实探针（编辑图像使真值翻转、保持推理链不变）测量多模态判断器视觉 grounding 的有效性，提出 Verdict Grounding Score 并证明其解释存在偏差：分数受编辑可感知性上限约束，且误差单侧——只会让判断器显得比实际更不 grounded，导致把可用的监督者误判为不合格（假警报）。在给定假设下，作者证明该缺失量可由同一审计协议已收集的三个量识别，使假警报率可直接测量。九个判断器的审计结果验证了预测的排序，典型判断器仅对约一半其本可分辨属性的编辑作出反应；保守拒绝阈值下若干单元被直接认证为假警报。


<details>
  <summary>Details</summary>
Motivation: 模型判断器已被大规模用于多模态系统的训练数据过滤、输出选择与奖励供给，因此必须验证其是否真正使用了视觉证据。现有做法是用反事实探针（编辑图像翻转真值）来检验视觉 grounding，但这种检验本身值得审视：作者怀疑该分数并不能按其惯常方式被解读，可能产生系统性误判。

Method: 提出 Verdict Grounding Score 的形式化定义，并分析其可解释性：论证判断结论只对触达其决策相关读数的编辑作出响应，因此分数被编辑可感知性所限；除非编辑使属性更易读，否则误差是单侧的。随后在明确假设下，证明这一缺失量不仅可被界定，而且可由审计协议已收集的三个量识别出来，使假警报率可测量。最后对九个判断器开展实证审计，并施加保守拒绝阈值进行假警报认证。

Result: 在九个判断器上，预测的排序在整个主池中严格成立；典型判断器仅对约一半其本可分辨属性的编辑有所反应。施加保守拒绝阈值后，若干单元被直接认证为假警报，最明显的是一个几乎每次都能检出注入错误的判断器，其得分却显示它似乎完全未使用图像。

Conclusion: 图像侧反事实分数不应单独报告：在未编辑图像上做检测探针可为其提供上界、认证其假警报，且不增加额外成本。核心结论是把审计从"分数即证据"转为"分数加检测上界"的联合报告，以避免因假警报丢弃可用的监督者。

Abstract: Model judges now supervise multimodal systems at scale, filtering training data, selecting outputs, and supplying the reward that shapes multimodal reasoning models. Trusting one means first checking that it uses its evidence, and that check is itself worth scrutinizing, so we ask whether a counterfactual probe of visual grounding measures what it claims to. The probe edits the image so the ground truth flips, holds the reasoning trace fixed, and asks whether the verdict follows. We formalize it as the Verdict Grounding Score and show it cannot be read the way such scores are read. A verdict responds only to an edit that reaches the judge's decision-relevant reading, so the score is capped by how perceptible the edit is, and unless editing makes the attribute easier to read, the error is one-sided: the score can only make a judge look less grounded than it is. The practical failure is therefore a false alarm, an auditor discarding a usable overseer. Under assumptions we state, we show this missing quantity is not merely bounded but identified from three quantities the same audit protocol already collects, which makes the false-alarm rate directly measurable rather than merely a concern. Auditing nine judges, we find the predicted ordering holds strictly across our entire primary pool, and the typical judge there acts on only about half of the edits whose attribute it can otherwise resolve. Applying a conservative rejection threshold certifies several cells as false alarms outright, the clearest being a judge that detects the injected error essentially every time while still scoring as if it had not used the image at all. The rule that follows is that an image-side counterfactual score should never be reported alone: a detection probe on the unedited image upper-bounds it, certifies its false alarms, and costs nothing extra to run.

</details>

This work presents the first severity-controlled fog benchmark for this task: synthetic fog at ten severity levels is applied to the RGB modality of the Anti-UAV300 dataset, comparing a clear-trained YOLOv5m baseline to a fog-aware model trained on both clear and foggy images. Detection performance drops sharply and non-linearly: degradation is front-loaded across light-to-moderate fog (beta approximately 0.05-0.10), with a 96% reduction in mAP@0.5:0.95 from clear to thickest fog, mainly due to lost recall and confidence. On the comparable metric (mAP@0.5), this collapse exceeds the most extreme rain degradation reported in the closest prior benchmark. Fog-aware training boosts detection across all severities (up to +0.320 mAP@0.5:0.95) with only a 9.1% drop in clear-sky accuracy, raising the threshold for reliable detection while not preventing collapse under extreme fog. Abstract: Multimodal large language models (MLLMs) have shown strong potential for video understanding and caption generation, but their performance may decline in specialized medical imaging domains such as echocardiography. The target is constructed by converting structured video annotations into qualitative attributes, generating a fixed-format reference caption, and mapping it into the language-model embedding space. Results show improved caption similarity and content alignment after applying the proposed correction. Furthermore, GPEC adds less than 0.05 s of inference-time overhead per video in the evaluated setting. ### [15] [Query Independent Variable Rate Visual Token Coding](https://arxiv.org/abs/2610.00204)
*Hongbo Zhang,Zihao Yang,Liuyang Song,Daqian Yang,Haoyang Yao,Yan Wen,Zhengtao Yao*

Main category: cs.CV

TL;DR: 该文提出用变换编码的"变率"思路替代视觉token剪枝的"选择"范式：保留全部token、逐token分配比特率，在比特预算约束下做整数率失真优化，得到与问题无关、一次压缩多次使用的视觉表示。


<details>
  <summary>Details</summary>
Motivation: 现有视觉token压缩几乎被定义为选择问题（按语言模型注意力排序后丢弃低分token），而注意力排序依赖所提问题。这在单轮基准中不可见，但当压缩表示被写入一次、多次读取（如跨对话轮次缓存、设备与服务器之间传输）时，其问题依赖性就成为致命缺陷。

Method: 借鉴经典变换编码工具包的另一半：不做选择而做变率编码，保留每个token并调节其码率。对每个token测量其率失真曲线，在固定比特预算下对这些曲线做精确的整数率失真优化，将预算分配给各token。整条流水线不引入任何文本信息，因此一次压缩表示可服务任意查询。

Result: 在相同比特预算下，于两个数据集和两种模型容量上，该方法比均匀码率编码、闭式注水算法和按失真排序剪枝更好地保持了模型的输出分布与答案；在与剪枝调优所针对的同一问题上，与注意力排序剪枝持平；而当同一张压缩图像需要回答关于该图像的另一问题时，则反超注意力排序剪枝。

Conclusion: 将视觉token压缩从"选择保留哪些token"重构为"为所有token分配码率"，可得到问题无关的压缩表示，在多次读取、跨查询复用的场景下优于依赖注意力排序的剪枝方法。

Abstract: Visual-token compression for vision--language models is posed almost entirely as a selection problem: decide which tokens to keep and discard the rest. The criteria that work best rank tokens by the attention the language model pays them, which makes the ranking a function of the question being asked. That is invisible in a single-turn benchmark and decisive whenever a compressed representation is written once and read many times, as when it is cached across the turns of a conversation or transmitted between a device and a server. We take the other half of the classical transform-coding toolkit instead: keep every token and vary its rate. A transform code exposes each token's measured distortion--rate curve, and a fixed bit budget is distributed across tokens by exact integer rate--distortion optimisation on those curves. No text enters the pipeline, so one compressed representation serves any query. At equal bit budgets, on two datasets and two capacities, it preserves the model's output distribution and its answers better than uniform-rate coding, the closed-form water-fill and distortion-ranked pruning. It matches attention-ranked pruning on the question pruning was tuned for, and overtakes it once the compressed image must answer a different question about the same image.

</details>

*Eirini Cholopoulou,Dimitrios E. Diamantis,Dimitris K. Iakovidis*

Main category: cs.CV

TL;DR: 提出MRFFU-Net，通过在编码器-解码器各层级引入多分辨率特征融合模块，并结合注意力机制与跳跃连接，提升MRI解剖结构分割精度。


<details>
  <summary>Details</summary>
Motivation: MRI分割对临床诊断和疾病监测至关重要，但现有U-Net类深度学习架构难以同时保留细粒度细节与全局上下文信息，而MRI解剖结构存在边界不规则及形状、对比度、尺度变化大的问题。

Method: 设计可即插即用于任意U-Net类架构的多分辨率特征融合模块MRFF，将其集成于编码器-解码器结构的每一层级，配合注意力机制与跳跃连接，实现多分辨率特征提取，兼顾细粒度细节与全局上下文。

Result: 在两个公开MRI基准数据集（脊柱MR扫描的脑脊液分割、MSD挑战赛的左心房心脏分割）上，MRFFU-Net在多项评价指标上优于现有最优模型。

Conclusion: MRFFU-Net能有效提升MRI分割性能，验证了多分辨率特征融合策略在MRI解剖结构分割中的有效性。

Abstract: The segmentation of anatomical structures in medical images and particularly in MRI scans, is essential for clinical diagnosis and monitoring disease progression. While Deep Learning (DL) architectures, such as U-Net and its extensions are very effective in medical image segmentation tasks, they often struggle with preserving fine-grained details and global contextual information. This is especially challenging for MRI data segmentation, where anatomical structures are characterized by irregular boundaries and variations in shape, contrast, and scale. To address this challenge, we propose a novel DL architecture for MRI segmentation across different anatomical structures. Specifically, the architecture introduces a module, named Multi-Resolution Feature Fusion (MRFF), that can be easily integrated into any U-Net-like architecture. The MRFF is integrated in all levels of an encode-decoder structure, along with attention mechanisms and skip connections to extract features at multiple resolutions, enabling the model to capture both fine-grained details and global contextual information. We evaluate the MRFFU-Net on two publicly available benchmark MRI datasets of different anatomical targets; one for Cerebrospinal Fluid (CSF) segmentation in spinal MR scans, and one for left atrium cardiac segmentation, from the Medical Segmentation Decathlon (MSD) challenge. Experimental results indicate that MRFFU-Net outperforms state-of-the-art models across multiple evaluation metrics, demonstrating its effectiveness in MRI segmentation.

</details>


### [17] [LENS-GRF: Permutation-Invariant Lesion Evidence Network with Gated Residual Fusion for Acne Severity Grading and Multi-Rater Clinical Oracle Analysis](https://arxiv.org/abs/2610.00294)
*Muhammad Muhtasim Shahriar,M. F. Mridha*

Main category: cs.CV

TL;DR: 提出LENS-GRF可解释多阶段痤疮分级框架，融合全局ViT先验与置换不变病灶Set Transformer，在ACNE04上达80.82%（自动）/95.89%（真值病灶），并在PLSBRACNE01零样本评估中揭示域偏移问题。


<details>
  <summary>Details</summary>
Motivation: 自动痤疮严重度分级既需全脸上下文，也需细粒度病灶证据；现有方法难以兼顾二者，且公开数据集存在数据完整性与跨标准一致性问题，缺乏可靠的可解释分级方案。

Method: LENS-GRF由三部分组成：自适应面部皮肤分割、全局Vision Transformer先验、置换不变的病灶Set Transformer（编码局部病灶patch及空间几何）；并通过门控残差融合（Gated Residual Fusion）自适应控制局部残差贡献，门控为零时退化为全局预测。

Conclusion: 病灶级证据能显著提升分级性能，但自动检测器的域偏移、标注变异性及跨分级标准不匹配制约了真实场景的泛化；同时数据集存在重复与标签冲突问题，需谨慎解读benchmark结果。

Abstract: Automated acne severity grading requires both whole-face context and fine-grained lesion evidence. We propose LENS-GRF (Lesion Evidence Network with Set-Transformer and Gated Residual Fusion), an interpretable multi-stage framework for four-class acne severity grading. The method combines Adaptive Facial Skin Segmentation and a global Vision Transformer prior with a permutation-invariant Lesion Set Transformer that encodes localized lesion patches and spatial geometry. Gated Residual Fusion adaptively controls the local residual contribution and reduces to the global prediction when the gate is zero. On ACNE04, fully automated LENS-GRF with YOLOv11s achieved 80.82% accuracy; with ground-truth lesion annotations, it achieved 95.89% +/- 0.59% accuracy and a Quadratic Weighted Kappa of 0.9753. A data-integrity audit identified 15 cross-split duplicate image pairs, including five with conflicting severity labels. In locked zero-shot evaluation on the full PLSBRACNE01 cohort (200 subjects, 600 views), automated LENS-GRF achieved 35.00% accuracy versus 42.50% for the global baseline. On the 148-subject common cohort used for three-dermatologist oracle analysis, ground-truth lesion inputs increased the best oracle accuracy to 47.97%, while the highest oracle QWK was 0.5799. Pairwise oracle agreement ranged from 49.32% to 66.22%, highlighting detector domain shift, annotation variability, and cross-criterion mismatch.

</details>


### [18] [Decoding the Disaster: Multi-Task Geospatial Reasoning with Vision-Language Models and Crowdsourced Imagery for Disaster Mapping](https://arxiv.org/abs/2610.00302)
*Wenping Yin,Fabian Desuer,Ziqi Liu,Naixia Mou,Weijia Li,Pedram Ghamisi,Xiao Xiang Zhu,Hao Li*

Main category: cs.CV

TL;DR: 本文提出GRDisaster——一个多任务地理空间推理灾害制图框架，基于PhotoMappers新构建的基准数据集（26,340张图像，含VGI、街景与遥感跨视图三元组，覆盖2018-2024年多起灾害事件），系统探索视觉语言模型（VLMs）在众包灾害图像理解、地理定位与推理中的潜力。


<details>
  <summary>Details</summary>
Motivation: 众包图像可提供及时、精细的街景级观测，弥补应急响应中传统遥感影像（RSI）的不足；但此类图像结构松散、空间模糊、缺乏可靠地理元数据，人工地理定位与解译成本高、难以规模化。因此需探索VLM驱动的空间推理能否将其转化为可行动的地理空间人工智能（GeoAI）。

Method: 构建基于PhotoMappers的新基准数据集，包含26,340张图像，组织为经人工验证的VGI、街景影像（SVI）与RSI跨视图三元组，覆盖2018-2024年多起灾害事件；提出多任务框架GRDisaster，结合确定性（deterministic）与概率性（probabilistic）跨视图地理定位及多视图融合，将VGI图像与带地理参考的SVI、RSI关联；引入两组空间推理指标，分别用于跨视图地理定位验证与灾害损伤评估，指标利用结构、环境与全局场景线索，并与专家验证标注对照以评估灾害严重程度，从而增强VLM输出的可解释性。

Result: 据作者所知，本研究首次系统性地调查并建立了统一评估框架，验证了基于VLM的空间推理如何通过跨视图地理定位验证、可解释空间推理与损伤感知的严重程度评估，将众包灾害图像转化为可行动的GeoAI；框架通过指标化的线索验证提升了VLM输出的可解释性。

Conclusion: GRDisaster为众包灾害图像的地理定位、空间推理与损伤评估提供了首个系统性研究与统一评估范式，展示了VLM在跨视图地理定位验证与可解释灾害严重程度评估方面的应用价值，推动众包影像向可行动GeoAI转化。

Abstract: Crowdsourced imagery provides timely, fine-grained, street-level observations for disaster mapping, complementing conventional remote sensing imagery (RSI) during emergency response. However, such imagery is often unstructured, spatially ambiguous, and lacks reliable geographic metadata, making manual geolocalization and interpretation labor-intensive and difficult to scale. This work proposes a multi-task Geospatial Reasoning Disaster mapping framework, namely GRDisaster, to examine the potential of vision-language models (VLMs) in understanding, geolocalizing, and reasoning over crowdsourced disaster imagery. GRDisaster is built on a newly curated benchmark dataset derived from PhotoMappers, comprising 26,340 images organized into human-validated volunteered geographic information (VGI), street-view imagery (SVI), RSI cross-view triplets covering multiple disaster events from 2018 to 2024. The framework combines deterministic and probabilistic cross-view geolocalization with multi-view fusion to associate VGI images with georeferenced SVI and RSI. It introduces two sets of spatial reasoning indicators for cross-view geolocalization validation and disaster damage assessment. These indicators use structural, environmental, and global-scene cues to validate cross-view correspondences and visually observable damage evidence with expert-verified annotations to assess disaster severity, improving the interpretability of VLM outputs. To our knowledge, this study provides the first systematic investigation and unified evaluation framework for examining how VLM-based spatial reasoning can transform crowdsourced disaster imagery into actionable geospatial artificial intelligence (GeoAI) through cross-view geolocalization validation, interpretable spatial reasoning, and damage-aware severity assessment.

</details>

Main category: cs.CV

<details>
  <summary>Details</summary>
Motivation: 满洲文历史文档具有重要的语言与文化价值，但其数字化受限于严重退化和配准训练数据稀缺。现有文档修复方法主要优化像素级重建，虽能生成视觉上合理的图像，却无法保持满洲文字形的结构身份，因此需要超越像素层面的字形级结构建模。

Method: 提出检索引导的字形感知修复框架：在修复过程中检索相关字形范例，为重建提供字形级结构指导，并将该结构信息融入重建流程，从而在低资源条件下改善退化字符结构的恢复。

Result: 在满洲文历史文档上的大量实验表明，所提方法在图像修复质量和字形级保真度两方面均优于现有修复方法。

Conclusion: 面向低资源历史文档的可靠修复，引入字符感知的结构先验至关重要，字形级结构知识可有效弥补纯像素重建的不足。

Abstract: Historical Manchu documents preserve invaluable linguistic and cultural heritage, yet their digitization is hindered by severe degradations and the scarcity of paired training data. Existing document restoration methods primarily optimize pixel-level reconstruction, which can produce visually plausible results while failing to preserve the structural identity of Manchu glyphs. To address this limitation, we propose a retrieval-guided glyph-aware restoration framework that goes beyond pixel reconstruction by explicitly incorporating glyph-level structural knowledge. Our method retrieves relevant glyph exemplars to provide structural guidance during restoration and integrates this information into the reconstruction process, improving the recovery of degraded character structures under low-resource conditions. Extensive experiments on Manchu historical documents demonstrate that the proposed approach improves both image restoration quality and glyph-level fidelity compared with existing restoration methods. These results highlight the importance of incorporating character-aware structural priors for reliable restoration of low-resource historical documents.

</details>


### [20] [EgoRefine: Ego-Referenced Predictive Alignment and Trajectory-Conditioned Reliability-Aware Fusion for Asynchronous Collaborative Perception](https://arxiv.org/abs/2610.00319)
*Lingzhao Kong,Yongsheng Zang,Yu Kang,Kailun Yang,Jie Fu,Yukun Zuo,Zhiyong Li*

Main category: cs.CV

TL;DR: EgoRefine：以自车特征为参考的异步协同感知对齐与可靠性融合框架，在V2V4Real和DAIR-V2X-Seq上优于TraF-Align。


<details>
  <summary>Details</summary>
Motivation: 异步通信下协同特征存在时间延迟，现有基于预测的方法主要依赖发送方自身历史进行补偿，与自车当前观测仍存在残余错位；且后续融合常忽略对齐质量的空间差异。

Method: 提出Ego-refined Predictive Alignment模块，用当前自车特征引导协同轨迹场预测，并沿自车参考轨迹方向细化采样偏移；提出Trajectory-conditioned Reliability-aware Fusion模块，以自车与协同流的轨迹差异及方向细化幅度作为对齐线索，据此调节对齐特征间关系并在卷积融合前自适应重加权两路特征。

Result: 在V2V4Real和DAIR-V2X-Seq上，AP@0.5和AP@0.7平均分别超过TraF-Align 1.6和2.9个点。

Conclusion: EgoRefine通过自车参考的预测对齐与可靠性感知融合，有效缓解异步协同感知中的时空错位，提升3D目标检测性能。

Abstract: Collaborative perception enables connected agents to share complementary observations for 3D object detection, extending sensing range and mitigating occlusion. Under asynchronous communication, however, cooperative features arrive with temporal delay. Existing prediction-based methods compensate for these features mainly from the transmitting agent's own history, leaving residual misalignment with the ego agent's current observation; subsequent fusion also often overlooks spatial variations in alignment quality. We propose EgoRefine, an ego-referenced predictive alignment and reliability-aware fusion framework for asynchronous collaborative perception. Its Ego-referenced Predictive Alignment module uses the current ego feature to guide cooperative trajectory-field prediction and refines the sampling offsets along an ego-referenced trajectory direction. Its Trajectory-conditioned Reliability-aware Fusion module treats the trajectory discrepancy between the ego and cooperative streams and the directional refinement magnitude as alignment cues, using them to condition the relation between aligned features and adaptively reweight the two streams before convolutional fusion. Experiments on V2V4Real and DAIR-V2X-Seq show that EgoRefine outperforms TraF-Align by 1.6 and 2.9 points on average in AP@0.5 and AP@0.7, respectively. The source code will be made publicly available at https://github.com/godk0509/EgoRefine.

</details>


### [21] [LEGO-OPD: Factorized Teacher Composition for Multimodal On-Policy Distillation](https://arxiv.org/abs/2610.00333)
*Jaeyun Shin,Hangeol Chang,Jong Chul Ye*

Main category: cs.CV

TL;DR: 提出 LEGO-OPD，通过贝叶斯因式分解将一个语言专家（先验）与一个接地专家（似然）选择性组合成单一教师分布，并配合自适应校准实现多模态在线策略蒸馏，从而独立控制语言推理与视觉接地。


<details>
  <summary>Details</summary>
Motivation: 多模态在线策略蒸馏（OPD）希望提升视觉接地能力的同时保留语言模型强大的推理能力。现有做法：多教师方法用 LLM 与 VLM 教师提供互补监督。但存在两个问题：（1）直接使用 VLM 的完整预测分布会将其视觉接地信号与自身语言先验纠缠在一起，接地信息无法被独立迁移；（2）加强视觉监督强度虽能改善感知，却可能过度强调视觉证据而损害语言推理。因此需要解决视觉接地与语言推理之间的权衡。

Method: 提出 LEGO-OPD。在广义贝叶斯框架下，将 Language Expert 与 Grounding expert 的因子选择性组合为一个教师分布：语言专家提供候选 token 上的先验，接地专家提供视觉似然对该先验进行更新，而非迁移其完整预测分布，从而让语言推理与视觉接地可被独立控制。此外引入自适应校准，在每个解码前缀处决定视觉似然更新语言先验的强度：以接地专家由图像引起的预测偏移（image-induced prediction shift）作为前缀相关的参考，避免视觉监督不足或过度。

Result: 基于 Qwen3 模型的实验表明，LEGO-OPD 在多模态与纯文本推理任务上均稳定优于所评估的单教师与多教师 OPD 基线；同时提升了初始学生的视觉感知能力，并保持了纯文本推理能力。

Conclusion: 通过因子化组合语言先验与视觉似然并自适应校准视觉监督强度，可在多模态 OPD 中解耦语言推理与视觉接地，实现两者的独立可控，并同时取得多模态与文本推理上的性能提升。

Abstract: Multimodal on-policy distillation (OPD) aims to improve visual grounding while preserving the strong reasoning capabilities of language models. Recent multi-teacher approaches combine LLM and VLM teachers to provide complementary supervision. However, directly using a VLM's full predictive distribution entangles its visual grounding signal with its own language prior, preventing the grounding information from being transferred independently. Conversely, increasing the strength of visual supervision can improve perception but may overemphasize visual evidence and degrade language reasoning. To address this trade-off, we introduce LEGO-OPD, which selectively composes factors from a Language Expert and a Grounding expert into One teacher distribution for multimodal OPD. Under a generalized Bayesian formulation, the language expert provides a prior over candidate tokens, while the grounding expert contributes a visual likelihood that updates this prior, rather than transferring its complete predictive distribution. This factorized composition allows language reasoning and visual grounding to be controlled independently. We further introduce adaptive calibration to determine how strongly the visual likelihood should update the language prior at each decoding prefix. Specifically, LEGO-OPD uses the grounding expert's image-induced prediction shift as a prefix-dependent reference, preventing both insufficient and excessive visual supervision. Experiments with Qwen3 models show that LEGO-OPD consistently outperforms the evaluated single- and multi-teacher OPD baselines on both multimodal and text-only reasoning tasks. Moreover, it improves the initial student's visual perception while preserving text-only reasoning.

</details>


### [22] [Vmem-$\varphi$: Low-Compute Out-of-Distribution Detection in Spiking Neural Networks from Membrane-Potential Statistics](https://arxiv.org/abs/2610.00350)
*Arul Rana,Agrim Tripathi,Shoaib Ahmed Dipu,Md. Shaown Miah,Syed Ishtiaque Ahmed,Sayeed Shafayet Chowdhury*

Main category: cs.CV

TL;DR: 提出利用脉冲神经网络亚阈值膜电位动态进行OOD检测，并构建Gen1-C损坏基准与MDD方法，在多数损坏下AUROC超0.88。


<details>
  <summary>Details</summary>
Motivation: 事件相机数据处理的SNN虽节能，但其OOD检测仍具挑战；现有方法依赖检测SNN中不可得的模型输出或计算组件，不适合低算力部署，因此需寻找新的内部信号。

Method: 利用亚阈值膜电位V_mem(t)作为内部信号，从中提取简单的逐通道统计量；构建Gen1-C基准（基于Prophesee Gen1汽车检测数据集，含6种传感器相关的直方图级压力测试、5个严重等级）；并提出对损坏不可知的Multi-Descriptor Deviation (MDD)方法，基于膜电位统计在64帧有界窗口内运作。

Result: 在最高损坏等级下，MDD在6种损坏中的5种上AUROC超过0.88；唯一未达标的一种损坏也是对底层检测器影响最小的。

Conclusion: 膜电位的时间动态可为SNN事件感知的OOD检测提供有效且低成本的信号。

Abstract: Spiking Neural Networks (SNNs) offer an energy-efficient approach to processing event-camera data, yet out-of-distribution (OOD) detection remains challenging in this setting. Existing OOD detection methods often depend on model outputs or computational components that are unavailable in object detection SNNs or are poorly suited to low-compute deployment. To that effect, we show that the subthreshold membrane potential \(V_{\mathrm{mem}}(t)\) provides a useful internal signal for detecting distribution shifts. Simple per-channel statistics derived from these membrane dynamics enable OOD detection. To evaluate this approach, we introduce Gen1-C, an event-camera corruption benchmark developed upon the Prophesee Gen1 automotive detection dataset, containing six sensor-motivated histogram-level stress tests at five severity levels. We further propose the Multi-Descriptor Deviation (MDD), a corruption-blind method that operates on membrane-potential statistics. At the highest corruption severity, MDD achieves an AUROC of more than 0.88 on five of the six corruptions using only a bounded 64-frame observation window. Notably, the remaining corruption is also the one that has the smallest effect on the underlying detector. Abstract: Automated classification of brain tumors from MRI is a heavily published application of deep learning in medical imaging, with reported accuracies on public benchmarks routinely exceeding 98%. Abstract: Human motion, environmental contacts, and interaction forces are governed by common physical laws, yet existing approaches typically separate visual pose reconstruction from contact and force estimation. Our approach augments a human reconstruction foundation model with learnable contact-force tokens and a temporal transformer that integrates visual features with world-space motion. In pixel-space diffusion, SAM2, Depth Anything v2, and Metric3D v2 each outperform the DINOv2-only GenEval baseline, with the two geometric teachers leading the segmentation teacher. A flat sum of all four teachers, however, lands below the best single geometric teacher, as semantic and geometric gradients compete for one denoiser projection. We introduce PixelDense, which routes DINOv2 and SAM2 through a semantic projection stream, routes Depth Anything v2 and Metric3D v2 through a geometric projection stream, and adds a weight-space orthogonality penalty that keeps the two streams in disjoint subspaces. In partial-noise reconstruction, independent panoptic, depth, and surface-normal probes show up to 53.1% PQ gain and 36.0% depth AbsRel reduction at $τ=0.5$ across COCO and Flickr30K. From random initialization, PixelDense also reaches the baseline's peak GenEval 1.23x faster. ### [27] [Memorizon: Training World Models Beyond Their Context Window](https://arxiv.org/abs/2610.00544)
*Tingting Liao,Xuezhi Liang,Hao Li,Guangyi Liu*

Main category: cs.CV

TL;DR: Memorizon 解耦了长跨度监督与注意力计算：训练样本可覆盖任意长跨度，但只对最后 k 个 chunk 计分，各计分 chunk 通过相机共视检索 top-K latent 组成有界共享 bank，使长跨度训练成本几乎不随跨度增长。


<details>
  <summary>Details</summary>
Motivation: 流式世界模型需要在重复访问同一地点时保持一致渲染，而直接监督这种重访需要同时包含两次访问、常跨越数分钟的训练样本。对完整跨度做稠密注意力会带来二次复杂度，使长跨度监督代价高昂。作者希望打破"长跨度监督必然要求长跨度注意力"这一耦合。

Method: 训练样本覆盖任意长度跨度，但仅在最后 k 个 chunk 上计算损失。每个计分 chunk 不将之前的历史全部 tokenize，而是依据相机共视关系检索各自的 top-K latent，各 chunk 请求的并集构成一个共享 latent bank。bank 规模上界为 kK，因此无论跨度多长，序列长度保持有界；最短跨度时该方案即退化为常规训练。额外开销仅为一次性引入 bank。

Result: 相比滑动窗口基线，检索在全部数据划分上提升重访一致性；当跨度长到足以覆盖每次返回的首次访问时，一致性再提升 24%–30%，但图像质量有所下降，且超过该跨度后继续加长不再有益。将 bank 用另一 episode 填充会使重访相关性下降 83%，说明模型确实利用了检索到的内容。跨度从 100 s 增至 400 s，单步时间仅增加 12%。

Conclusion: 长跨度是监督所需但不必然为注意力所需；通过相机共视检索与有界共享 bank，可在近似恒定的计算成本下实现长跨度重访监督，显著提升流式世界模型的重访一致性，且模型对检索内容存在因果依赖。

Abstract: Streaming world models should render a place consistently across repeated visits. Directly supervising such revisits requires training samples that capture both visits, often spanning minutes. Yet dense attention over the full span incurs quadratic costs, making long-span supervision expensive. Memorizon breaks this coupling: long spans are needed for supervision, but not for attention, since the two visits can share a forward pass without including every intervening frame. A training sample covers a span of any length but is scored only on its last $k$ chunks. Instead of tokenizing the history before them, each scored chunk retrieves its own top-$K$ latents by camera co-visibility, and the union of these requests forms a shared bank. The bank is bounded by $kK$, so the sequence stays bounded however long the span; at the shortest span the recipe is exactly conventional training. Adding the bank raises the cost of a step once; beyond that, a longer span costs little, and going from 100 to 400 s adds 12% to the step time. Against a sliding-window baseline, retrieval raises revisit consistency on every split, and a span long enough to reach the first visit of each return adds a further 24% to 30%, at some cost in image quality; beyond that span, more length no longer helps. Filling the bank from another episode lowers revisit correlation by 83%, so the model uses what it retrieves. Project page: https://tingtingliao.github.io/memorizon

</details>

Conclusion: 该工作通过闭环、多层次的评测范式为VLM物理智能提供了更全面的诊断工具，并指向更具原则性的、物理根基扎实的多模态智能设计方向。

Abstract: Vision-Language Models (VLMs) have shown strong multimodal reasoning capabilities, yet whether they truly capture the physical consistency underlying real-world dynamics remains unclear. Existing benchmark paradigms often suffer from fragmented evaluation, focusing on isolated cognitive stages while overlooking the inherent synergy between perception, reasoning, and physical judgment. The lack of a holistic perspective limits the ability to diagnose whether VLMs can reliably evaluate the physical authenticity of emerging generative models. To address these issues, we introduce PhysVista, a benchmark designed to evaluate physical intelligence in VLMs through a closed cognitive loop framework inspired by the human seeing-reasoning-assessment process. PhysVista restores this loop by jointly evaluating physical state perception, physical dynamics reasoning, and physical plausibility assessment. It further distinguishes event-level reasoning and scale-level reasoning to enable fine-grained analysis of physical understanding. In addition, PhysVista incorporates both real-world and AI-generated videos, allowing evaluation across diverse domains and emerging generative scenarios. Extensive experiments across a diverse set of VLMs reveal substantial limitations in physical reasoning and plausibility assessment, highlighting a persistent gap between visual recognition and genuine physical understanding, and pointing toward more principled designs for physically grounded multimodal intelligence.

</details>


### [29] [FORTE: Adaptive Scoring and Exact Keyframe Selection for Long-Video Question Answering](https://arxiv.org/abs/2610.00573)
*Haifeng Huang,Biyin Xu,Chunsheng Xin,Yang Li*

Main category: cs.CV

TL;DR: FORTE：一种免训练的两阶段查询感知关键帧选择框架，通过自适应相关性评分与全局关键帧优化，突破固定候选池限制，提升长视频问答精度。


<details>
  <summary>Details</summary>
Motivation: 现有基于评分的MLLM长视频关键帧选择方法通常在固定的均匀采样候选池内搜索，池外证据无法被选中；在有限评分预算下，如何自适应地评估有潜力的帧，同时持续探索时间上欠采样的区域，是核心挑战。

Method: 提出免训练框架FORTE，包含两阶段：1）自适应相关性评分：从稀疏均匀观测出发，用高效高斯过程相关性预测器估计未评分帧的相关性，利用时间局部性与近似带状核结构，将核心计算从立方复杂度降为线性；评分阶段以预测相关性与时间覆盖度的平衡来选择下一批评分帧。2）全局关键帧优化：最大化同时刻画实测相关性与时间覆盖度的目标函数，利用对数覆盖结构推导出精确算法，在固定最终帧预算下以线性时间求解最优子集。

Conclusion: FORTE通过自适应评分与全局优化的协同，兼顾相关性与时间覆盖度，为长视频问答中的关键帧选择提供了免训练、线性复杂度且性能优异的解决方案。

Abstract: Query-aware keyframe selection enables multimodal large language models (MLLMs) to process long videos using only a small set of question-relevant frames. Existing score-based methods, however, typically search within a fixed, uniformly sampled candidate pool, preventing evidence outside this pool from ever being selected. Given a limited relevance-scoring budget, the key challenge is to allocate evaluations adaptively to promising frames while continuing to explore underrepresented temporal regions. We introduce FORTE, a training-free framework that addresses this challenge through two stages: adaptive relevance scoring and global keyframe optimization. Starting from sparse, uniformly distributed observations, our efficient Gaussian-process relevance predictor estimates relevance for unscored frames, exploiting temporal locality and the approximately banded kernel structure to reduce the core computation from cubic to linear time in the number of frames for fixed bandwidth. The scoring stage then selects which frames to score next by balancing predicted relevance with temporal coverage, prioritizing promising regions while also exploring less-represented parts of the video. The optimization stage selects the final keyframes by maximizing an objective that jointly captures measured relevance and temporal coverage. We derive an exact algorithm that leverages the logarithmic coverage structure to identify the optimal subset of the scored candidate pool in time linear in the pool size, for a fixed final-frame budget. Experiments on four long-video question-answering benchmarks show that FORTE achieves the highest observed mean accuracy among the compared selectors under every tested scoring budget. Further evaluations demonstrate its consistent effectiveness across different relevance scorers and downstream MLLMs.

</details>

*Zequn Yang,Yu Miao,Haotian Ni,Ziheng Chen,Chengxiang Huang,Dongzhan Zhou,Kai Chen,Qi Zhang,Ji-Rong Wen,Yake Wei,Di Hu*

Main category: cs.CV

TL;DR: 该论文提出Gestalt，一种以多模态交互为核心的大型多模态模型新范式，通过"多模态交互金字塔"组织建模与训练，在图像生成、多模态理解及纯文本任务上均取得强劲表现。


<details>
  <summary>Details</summary>
Motivation: 现有大型多模态模型主要致力于容纳更多模态，却忽视了各模态自身的独特特征及其相互关系，导致发展遭遇瓶颈。作者受人类多感官感知的多阶段特性启发，试图以交互为核心重构多模态建模方式。

Method: 提出"多模态交互金字塔"，将多模态建模组织为从模态特定处理、跨模态对齐到更深层多模态整合的递进过程。基于该金字塔，Gestalt采用统一的离散扩散框架与交互分区（interplay-partitioned）架构，并引入可学习的交互token来中介跨模态交换与整合；该金字塔同时指导数据组织与训练策略。

Result: 在图像生成、多模态理解以及纯文本评测中均表现出强劲性能，显著提升了跨模态整合能力，同时保留了各模态特定信息。

Conclusion: Gestalt有效融合了基于扩散的多模态模型优势，为通向统一多模态智能提供了一条有前景的路径。

Abstract: In this paper, we propose Gestalt, a new paradigm of large multimodal model built around multimodal interplay. Despite rapid advances, large multimodal models are reaching a bottleneck: existing approaches focus primarily on accommodating additional modalities while overlooking the distinct characteristics of each modality and the relations among them. Motivated by the multistage property of human multisensory perception, we propose a multimodal interplay pyramid that organizes multimodal modeling as a progression from modality-specific processing, through cross-modal alignment, to deeper multimodal integration. Guided by this pyramid, Gestalt adopts a unified discrete diffusion framework and an interplay-partitioned architecture, with learnable interplay tokens mediating cross-modal exchange and integration. The pyramid also structures its data organization and training strategy. Strong performance across image generation, multimodal understanding, and text-only evaluation shows that Gestalt significantly improves cross-modal integration while preserving modality-specific information, effectively harnessing the strengths of diffusion-based multimodal models and offering a promising path toward unified multimodal intelligence.

</details>


### [31] [Discrete Annotation, Continuous Preference: Rethinking Supervision for Accurate and Generalizable Aesthetic Image Cropping](https://arxiv.org/abs/2610.00582)
*Ziqing Zhang,Xiao Liu,Kai Liu,Jianze Li,Weihang Zhang,Linghe Kong,Yulun Zhang*

Main category: cs.CV

TL;DR: 该论文提出将人类裁剪偏好建模为裁剪空间上的连续偏好场（CPF），并据此训练VLM裁剪模型CPIC、重构基准CPICD，解决标注主观性与离散网格局限问题。


<details>
  <summary>Details</summary>
Motivation: 现有美学图像裁剪数据集存在两大长期问题：(1) 人类标注的主观性；(2) 受限于固定采样网格的刚性离散性。这些有缺陷的标注不仅降低模型的准确性与泛化能力，还严重扭曲了公平评测。

Method: 将人类裁剪偏好建模为裁剪空间上多峰、连续且尖锐的偏好场。提出连续偏好场（CPF），通过峰值聚类、离格细化、负向塑形、场组装四步从离散标注中恢复稠密偏好景观；据此训练基于VLM的裁剪模型CPIC，使用GRPO以CPF奖励进行优化。

Result: CPIC克服了模板坍塌问题，取得state-of-the-art性能与优异的域外泛化能力；CPICD利用CPF修正主流基准中的网格约束伪影，重构现有真值框。大量实验与用户研究验证了CPF、CPIC、CPICD的优越性。

Conclusion: 通过连续偏好场建模，本文统一解决了标注质量、模型训练与基准评测三个环节的问题，为未来裁剪研究建立了严谨可靠的基础。

Abstract: Aesthetic image cropping aims to identify the optimal crop of an image in terms of aesthetics and composition. While supervision based on annotated data is fundamental, the field has been hindered by a long-standing problem: existing datasets suffer from (1) human subjectivity and (2) rigid discreteness confined to fixed sampling grids. These flawed annotations not only limit the accuracy and generalization of trained models but also severely distort fair evaluation. To overcome this, we propose to model human cropping preference as a multi-peaked, continuous, and sharp field over the crop space. We introduce the Continuous Preference Field (CPF), which recovers a dense preference landscape from discrete annotations through (1) peak clustering, (2) off-lattice refinement, (3) negative shaping, and (4) field assembly. Based on this, we train CPIC, a VLM-based cropping model optimized via GRPO with the CPF reward, which overcomes template collapse, achieving state-of-the-art performance and exceptional out-of-domain generalization. Finally, to resolve the long-standing benchmark evaluation crisis, we introduce CPICD, a comprehensive recalibration of existing ground-truth boxes. By leveraging the CPF to correct grid-bound artifacts across mainstream benchmarks, CPICD establishes a rigorous and reliable foundation for future cropping research. Extensive experiments and user studies demonstrate the superiority of our CPF, CPIC, and CPICD. Code, model, and data are available at https://github.com/zzqingz/CPIC.

</details>


### [32] [Just Align $\bm{x}$: Aligning Predictions, Not Representations](https://arxiv.org/abs/2610.00600)
*Yuyao Zhang,Yuwei Hu,Ziyang Mai,Yu-Wing Tai*

Main category: cs.CV

TL;DR: JAx 提出以预测空间对齐替代表征对齐：通过马尔可夫退化耦合更干净与更噪声的观测，对齐干净图像预测，在保持 JiT 总体目标不变的前提下降低训练目标方差，在 ImageNet 256×256 上一致提升 FID 并加速收敛。


<details>
  <summary>Details</summary>
Motivation: 表征对齐虽能加速扩散训练，但其收益难以可靠迁移到像素空间的干净图像预测任务。作者在 JiT 中发现，辅助特征对齐在提升语义特征可及性的同时，会削弱对干净图像预测所需的图像变化信息的获取，导致辅助目标与去噪任务之间出现错配，因此需要一种不引入独立表征目标、而是直接改进预测目标本身的辅助监督原则。

Method: JAx（Just Align x）是一种预测监督方法，在不同噪声水平之间对齐干净图像预测。它通过保持原始 JiT 输入分布的马尔可夫退化，将更噪声的学生观测与更干净的观测耦合；在该耦合下，来自更干净状态的 oracle 预测与最优 JiT 目标具有相同的条件均值，且条件目标协方差不更大，因此 oracle 预测对齐在常数意义下保持总体 JiT 目标不变，同时提供更低方差的训练目标。为在存在不完美 EMA 教师时落地，JAx 结合真值监督与基于预测风险选择邻近教师状态的可靠性门控耦合带。

Result: 在 ImageNet 256×256 上，JAx 在 JiT-B/16、L/16 和 H/16 上一致提升 FID 并加速收敛，且无需外部编码器，也不改动架构或采样流程。梯度诊断显示小批量梯度方差降低；消融实验表明收益无法仅由时间重加权解释。

Conclusion: 预测空间监督为像素空间生成模型提供了一种简单且具原理性的表征对齐替代方案。

Abstract: Representation alignment has become an effective way to accelerate diffusion training, but its benefits do not transfer reliably to pixel-space clean-image prediction. In JiT, we find that auxiliary feature alignment can improve access to semantic features while reducing access to image variation needed for clean-image prediction, creating a mismatch between the auxiliary objective and the denoising task. This suggests a different principle: auxiliary supervision should improve the prediction target itself rather than impose a separate representation target. We introduce JAx (Just Align x), a prediction-supervision method that aligns clean-image predictions across noise levels. JAx couples a noisier student observation with a cleaner observation through a Markov degradation that preserves the original JiT input distribution. Under this coupling, the oracle prediction from the cleaner state has the same conditional mean as the optimal JiT target, while its conditional target covariance is no greater. Thus, oracle prediction alignment preserves the population JiT objective up to a constant while providing a lower-variance training target. To make this construction practical with an imperfect EMA teacher, JAx combines ground-truth supervision with a reliability-gated coupling band that selects nearby teacher states based on prediction risk. On ImageNet 256x256, JAx consistently improves FID and accelerates convergence across JiT-B/16, L/16, and H/16, without an external encoder or changes to the architecture or sampling procedure. Gradient diagnostics further show reduced minibatch gradient variance, while ablations demonstrate that the gains cannot be explained by time reweighting alone. These results show that prediction-space supervision provides a simple and principled alternative to representation alignment for pixel-space generative models.

</details>


### [33] [HAWK: Rethinking Multimodal Drafting for Speculative Decoding](https://arxiv.org/abs/2610.00623)
*Wenhan Yang,Anirudh Rao,Ashwin Chandra*

Main category: cs.CV

TL;DR: 提出HAWK，通过表征相似度选择并融合目标模型中间层隐状态、直接向浅层drafter提供压缩后的视觉隐状态，并训练drafter建模自身proposal后目标预测的变化，从而提升LVLM投机解码的接受长度与加速比。


<details>
  <summary>Details</summary>
Motivation: 投机解码在LLM上已实现无损加速，但在大型视觉语言模型（LVLM）上效果有限：一是轻量drafter难以利用丰富的多模态信息；二是标准蒸馏仅沿原始训练轨迹监督drafter，未建模drafter提出自身proposal后目标预测的偏移，导致偏离轨迹后drafter与目标分歧增大、后续步骤接受率下降。

Method: HAWK包含三部分：（1）利用表征相似度选择信息量高的目标层，并学习如何组合其隐状态；（2）在视觉方面，不向drafter提供原始视觉token，而是直接提供目标模型的压缩视觉隐状态，使浅层drafter更易利用；（3）训练drafter捕捉其自身proposal之后目标预测的变化，提升多步起草中与目标的一致性。

Result: 在SmolVLM-256M、十个多模态基准上，相比EAGLE-3：贪心解码下平均接受长度由3.32提升至4.08，加速比由2.19x提升至2.60x；采样解码下接受长度由2.89提升至3.41，加速比由1.92x提升至2.19x。

Conclusion: HAWK针对LVLM投机解码中多模态信息利用不足与训练轨迹偏差两个瓶颈，通过目标层隐状态选择融合、压缩视觉隐状态输入及建模proposal后预测偏移，显著提升drafter接受率与推理加速效果。

Abstract: Speculative decoding has achieved substantial lossless speedups for LLMs, but remains less effective for large vision-language models (LVLMs), where lightweight drafters struggle to use rich multimodal information. A second limitation is that standard distillation supervises the drafter only along the original training trajectory, without modeling how target predictions shift after the drafter's own proposals. As drafting moves away from this trajectory, the drafter can increasingly disagree with the target, reducing acceptance in later steps. We propose HAWK to address both limitations. HAWK uses representation similarity to select informative target layers and learns how to combine their hidden states. For visual information, it directly provides the drafter with compressed visual hidden states from the target model instead of raw visual tokens, making the visual information easier for a shallow drafter to use. HAWK also trains the drafter to capture how target predictions change after its own proposals, improving its agreement with the target during multi-step drafting. On SmolVLM-256M across ten multimodal benchmarks, HAWK raises average acceptance length from 3.32 to 4.08 and speedup from 2.19x to 2.60x over EAGLE-3 under greedy decoding, and from 2.89 to 3.41 and 1.92x to 2.19x under sampling.

</details>


### [34] [VisionQ: VLM-as-a-Judge Taxonomy, Dataset and Benchmark for Qualitative Analysis in Computer Vision](https://arxiv.org/abs/2610.00666)
*Vu Dinh Xuan,Duc-Hai Nguyen,Minh-Dung Dao,Vu Quynh Giao,Quang Hong Nguyen,Binh-Son Hua,Barry O'Sullivan,David Murphy,Hoang D. Nguyen*

Main category: cs.CV

TL;DR: VisionQ是首个基于同行评审CV论文比较图、以命名视觉准则为条件来评测VLM判断能力的基准，最强模型仅达63.1%准确率（随机32.2%）。


<details>
  <summary>Details</summary>
Motivation: 现有基准仅评标量质量或整体偏好，导致评判模型可能因错误的视觉理由而选中被偏好图像并获得奖励，即缺乏对判断依据的显式监督与归因。

Method: 提出准则条件化视觉判别任务，构建包含1,409篇CVPR/ICCV论文、1,800+已验证比较图、3,911条人工标注数据点的语料；建立六轴51叶的视觉准则分类体系；设计隐藏方法名、图注与论文身份的准则条件化评测协议；并训练DPO微调的Gemma-4-E4B评判器VisionQ-Judge（基于对称证据对）。

Result: VisionQ-Judge将末选项预测降低7.0个百分点，在留出测试集上准确率提升2.5个百分点；评测20个开源与闭源VLM评判器，最强仅63.1%（随机基线32.2%），且在不同准则间可靠性差异显著。

Conclusion: 以准则为条件的评测揭示了现有VLM在比较图判断上仍远未可靠，且性能随视觉准则剧烈波动，VisionQ为细粒度、可归因的评判评测提供了基准与协议。

Abstract: Qualitative comparison figures are central evidence in computer vision papers, and vision-language models (VLMs) are increasingly used to judge them. Yet existing benchmarks score only scalar quality or overall preference, so a judge can be rewarded for picking the preferred image for the wrong visual reason. We introduce VisionQ, the first benchmark built from peer-reviewed CV comparison figures that grounds every judgment in a named visual criterion: each question states the criterion, and a judge is credited only when it selects the output the authors identify as best on that criterion. We call this task criterion-conditioned visual discrimination. VisionQ comprises (1) a corpus of 1,409 CVPR and ICCV papers with 1,800+ validated comparison figures and 3,911 hand-annotated data points linking method crops to author-stated visual claims; (2) a six-axis, 51-leaf taxonomy of the visual criteria behind qualitative judgment; (3) a criterion-conditioned evaluation protocol that hides method names, captions, and paper identity and reports accuracy per criterion; and (4) VisionQ-Judge, a DPO-tuned Gemma-4-E4B judge trained on symmetric evidence pairs, which reduces last-option predictions by 7.0pp and improves accuracy by 2.5pp on a held-out test set. Evaluating 20 open- and closed-source VLM judges, we find that the strongest reach only 63.1% accuracy (chance 32.2%) and that reliability varies sharply across criteria. Code: https://github.com/ReML-AI/visionq. Data: https://huggingface.co/datasets/visionq-anon-2026/VisionQ-1k.

</details>


### [35] [Harnessing Vision-Language Models for Perceptual Quality Assessment and Autonomous Content Adjustment in Augmented Reality](https://arxiv.org/abs/2610.00677)
*Elias Rotondo,Lin Duan,Yanming Xiu,Sangjun Eom,Conrad Li,Maria Gorlatova*

Main category: cs.CV

TL;DR: 该论文提出基于视觉语言模型（VLM）的自动化AR内容评估与优化框架，构建RateAR基准并验证VLM预测与人类主观评分高度相关，进而搭建自动AR内容调整系统，用户研究中超90%参与者认为系统改善了虚拟内容的放置与尺寸一致性。


<details>
  <summary>Details</summary>
Motivation: AR头戴显示受限于场景几何约束、空间抖动和时间不稳定性，难以优化终端用户的沉浸感与舒适度；传统用户研究是AR视觉质量评估的标准方法，但成本高、可扩展性递减且缺乏灵活性，成为迭代式应用设计的瓶颈。因此需要自动化的评估与细化手段来替代或补充昂贵的人工评测。

Method: 1) 构建RateAR基准，涵盖多样场景与环境条件下的AR图像与视频，在物体放置、尺度、阴影一致性等感知因子上具有良好至优秀的评分者信度（ICC(2,5) >= .90）；2) 在该基准上评测11个商业VLM，并进行提示策略消融研究，比较上下文提示与其他提示方式；3) 基于上述发现构建自动化AR内容调整系统，并开展21名参与者的用户研究。

Result: VLM质量预测与人类主观判断强相关，Spearman秩相关最高达0.8695；消融研究表明上下文提示在与人评分对齐方面优于其他提示策略，同时平衡了所引入的复杂度线索；21人用户研究中，超过90%的参与者认为系统改善了虚拟内容的放置与尺寸一致性。

Conclusion: VLM可作为AR视觉保真度评估的有效代理，减少对高成本用户研究的依赖，并支持自动化内容调整；该框架为AR内容的迭代设计与质量优化提供了可扩展的路径。

Abstract: Advancements in augmented reality (AR) continue to foster innovative solutions, facilitating novel methodologies within educational systems, healthcare delivery, and risk-mitigation protocols. However, optimizing for end-user immersion and comfort remains challenging, as AR head-mounted displays contend with constrained scene geometry, spatial jitter, and temporal instability. User studies are the standard AR evaluation method for visual quality, but their cost, diminishing scalability, and inflexibility pose bottlenecks during iterative application design. To address this problem, we present an automated framework for AR content evaluation and refinement, built on vision-language models (VLMs), to evaluate and predict the visual fidelity of AR scenes as perceived by users. First, we introduce RateAR, a benchmark of AR images and videos collected across diverse scenes and environmental conditions, with good-to-excellent reliability (ICC(2,5) >= .90) across perceptual factors, including object placement, scale, and shadow consistency. Subsequently, we evaluate eleven commercial VLMs on the crafted benchmark. Results support that VLM-based quality predictions strongly correlate with human subjective judgments, achieving Spearman's rank-order correlations of up to 0.8695. An ablation study further suggests that, compared to other prompting strategies, our contextual prompting yields better alignment with human ratings while balancing introduced complexity cues. Building on these findings, we construct an automated AR content adjustment system and conduct a 21-participant user study. More than 90% of participants found that the system improved placement and size coherence of virtual content.

</details>


### [36] [SemanTok: Predictable Semantic Tokens for Efficient Autoregressive Video Generation](https://arxiv.org/abs/2610.00686)
*Mikhail Dereviannykh,Vikram Voleti,Simon Donne,Mallikarjun Byrasandra Ramalinga Reddy,Shimon Vainer,Mark Boss*

Main category: cs.CV

TL;DR: SemanTok是一种灵活长度视频分词器，通过从每个token前缀重建冻结的DINO特征，在自回归世界模型中同时提升语义对齐与视频保真度。


<details>
  <summary>Details</summary>
Motivation: 现有灵活分词器仅在早期解码器隐藏状态上施加表征对齐（REPA）损失，而解码器可部分从带噪输入满足该目标，导致语义监督不足。

Method: 将冻结的DINO特征输入编码器，并添加轻量级预测头，使其仅从每个保留的token前缀即可重建这些特征，从而在任意前缀长度上施加前缀独立的语义对齐监督。

Result: 在每个AR模型规模下均实现高语义对齐与视频保真度：201M的SemanTok AR模型匹配或超越3.4倍规模的VideoFlexTok AR模型；在分布外类别上保持语义对齐；在每个噪声水平（含纯噪声）下解码器语义对齐更高；重建与生成均表现良好。

Conclusion: 短token前缀更易预测且生成保真度更好，像素细节被推迟到后续token，说明前缀级语义监督对灵活视频分词器有效。

Abstract: Recent video-based world models pair the scalability of autoregressive (AR) prediction with the visual quality of diffusion models. The choice of scene tokenizer is paramount for the optimal performance of each of these, both in terms of fidelity and semantics. Flexible-length, coarse-to-fine tokenizers yield exactly that: the first coarse tokens carry the clip's global semantics while later tokens further specify details. Existing flexible tokenizers only apply a representation-alignment (REPA) loss on early decoder hidden states, a target the decoder can partly meet from its noised input instead. We introduce SemanTok, a flexible video tokenizer that feeds frozen DINO features into its encoder and adds lightweight heads that reconstruct them from each retained token prefix alone. SemanTok achieves high semantic alignment and video fidelity at every AR model size: a 201M SemanTok AR model matches or beats a VideoFlexTok AR model $3.4\times$ its size, and larger SemanTok AR models further improve fidelity. It keeps semantic alignment on out-of-distribution classes and gives the decoder higher semantic alignment at every noise level, including pure noise. It performs well in both reconstruction and generation, and its short token prefixes are cheaper to predict and give better generation fidelity, with pixel detail deferred to later tokens.

</details>


### [37] [Soundwich: Video Generation with Layered and Controllable Audio](https://arxiv.org/abs/2610.00691)
*Zhuo Ning,AmirHossein Naghi Razlighi,Sagi Polaczek,Daniel Cohen-Or,Ali Mahdavi-Amiri*

Main category: cs.CV

TL;DR: Soundwich：一种免训练框架，将冻结的联合音视频流匹配模型改造为可生成多个与共享视频同步、可独立编辑的音源轨（stem）的生成器。


<details>
  <summary>Details</summary>
Motivation: 现有联合音视频生成模型虽能合成音画同步的真实视频，但通常只生成单一混合音轨，缺乏音源级控制，与实际工作流中语音、音乐、音效、环境声分轨可编辑的需求不符。

Method: 免训练地将冻结的联合音视频流匹配模型转化为多音源轨生成器；生成各音源轨并可显式控制其时间活动；引入共享场景表示传递全局音视频上下文以保持分轨间一致性，同时维持音源级分离；进一步路由每个音源轨与其对应视觉源之间的跨模态交互以提升音画一致性。

Result: 实验与人工评测表明，在时间控制、音源分离和自然度方面均有提升，并支持在连贯音视频生成中的灵活音源级编辑。音源轨与视频保持同步，可独立重定时、静音、替换或重混。

Abstract: Long-video question answering is limited by the high cost of visual tokens and by the fixed context width of current VLMs. A long-video question may require broad temporal coverage, but the answer is often supported by only a compact set of moments. We implement this idea with an inference pipeline: the Video Preview provides cheap global coverage, Video Evidence Indexing constructs the Evidence Set, and Answer Generation combines both inputs for final VQA. To address missing frame-level supervision, we adopt privileged self-distillation, where an answer-aware teacher guides the normal test-time policy on student-generated indexing traces. Main category: cs.CV

TL;DR: 提出VTV-FM，一种二阶流匹配框架，通过最小化加速度能量为静态数据推导缺失的终端速度，给出闭式闭合解，并统一用于OT配对代价与加速度监督目标。


<details>
  <summary>Details</summary>
Motivation: 现有流匹配多采用一阶桥：源-目标配对后路径为恒速直线，即使结合最优传输（OT）改进了配对，桥本身仍为线性，难以建模曲线运动、加速度与方向变化。自然方案是引入二阶相空间动力学，但学习该桥需要静态数据集不提供的目标侧终端速度信息。

Result: 在低维数据集、PDE支配的物理场以及CIFAR-10上的实验表明，VTV-FM在传输几何与生成质量上优于一阶及高阶流匹配基线。

Conclusion: 通过最小加速度变分将二阶流匹配的终端速度闭合、OT配对与加速度监督统一到一个框架中，无需额外终端速度标注即可获得更优的传输几何与生成性能。

Abstract: Flow matching (FM) learns generative transport by fitting continuous-time motion from a simple source distribution to the data distribution. Most existing methods use first-order bridges: once a source and a target sample are paired, the path is a straight motion with constant velocity. FM with optimal transport (OT) improves the pairing, but the bridge itself remains linear, limiting its ability to model curved motion, acceleration, and changing directions. A natural remedy is to use second-order phase-space dynamics; however, learning the bridge requires target-side terminal-velocity information that static datasets do not provide. We propose Variational Terminal-Velocity Flow Matching (VTV-FM), a second-order FM framework that derives the missing velocity by minimizing acceleration energy, yielding a closed-form closure for static data. </details>

TL;DR: 该文系统评估短视频VLM标注中的降本启发式，在情感与主题分类两个计算社会科学任务上，从分类准确率、下游推断有效性、单视频token成本三轴对比，发现三者并非一致，并给出成本感知标注指南。


<details>
  <summary>Details</summary>
Motivation: VLM可规模化标注视频，但成本高：典型60秒短视频以1帧/秒采样需数百万token。研究者常用抽帧、图像网格压缩、单模态等启发式降本，但不清楚哪些启发式真正省钱，以及是否会破坏标注所支撑的下游结论。文献通常将准确率、下游推断与成本分离讨论，缺乏统一评估。

Result: 1）准确率与有效性出现分离：最高准确率配置可能产生错误的下游结论。2）模态价值不保证：仅文本即可获得强表现，说明增加模态可能只增加成本而不增加信号。3）成本可与视频长度解耦：通过简单镜头切换检测构建的单个2×8图像网格，其与全视频理解的一致性κ在.05以内，token成本约为后者的15%。

Conclusion: 基于上述发现推导出一套指南，用于在计算社会科学中实现成本感知的VLM视频标注：应同时报告准确率、下游推断有效性与token成本，避免仅以准确率选择配置，优先验证单模态是否足够，并在短格式视频上采用镜头切换检测生成的2×8图像网格以显著降低成本。

Abstract: Vision-Language Models (VLMs) enable video annotation at scale, but costs accumulate quickly: processing a typical 60-second short-form video at one frame per second requires millions of tokens. To reduce costs, researchers rely on heuristics such as sampling a subset of frames, compressing videos into image grids, or using only a single modality. However, it remains unclear which heuristics save cost, and whether they preserve the downstream conclusions these annotations enable. To address this gap, we conduct a systematic evaluation of these heuristics using short-form videos, on two computational social science (CSS) tasks: sentiment and topic classification. We evaluate each configuration along three axes the literature typically treats separately: classification accuracy, validity of downstream inference, and per-video token cost. First, we find that accuracy and validity diverge: the highest-accuracy configuration can produce wrong conclusions. Second, modality value is not guaranteed: text alone can yield strong performance, indicating that adding modalities can add cost without adding signal. Finally, we find that cost can be decoupled from video length when annotating short-form videos: a single $2\times8$ image grid built via simple shot-transition detection approaches full-video understanding ($κ$ within~.05), at $\sim 15\%$ of the token cost. </details>

*Chaoyu Li,Xiaoyi Gu,Yogesh Kulkarni,Eun Woo Im,Mohammadmahdi Honarmand,Zeyu Wang,Juntong Song,Fei Du,Xilin Jiang,Kexin Zheng,Tianzhi Li,Fei Tao,Pooyan Fazli*

TL;DR: 本文是首篇系统综述视频生成模型后训练与对齐工作的文章，提出统一框架，区分隐式与显式对齐，并将方法归纳为四类。

Conclusion: 该综述为可控、可靠的视频生成模型提供了结构化概念基础与实践指导，是视频生成后训练与对齐领域的首个系统性回顾。

Abstract: Video generation has rapidly progressed from short, low-quality clips to high-resolution, long-duration sequences with complex spatiotemporal dynamics. Despite strong generative priors learned through large-scale pretraining, pretrained video models often fail to reliably follow human intent, maintain temporal coherence, or satisfy physical and safety constraints. Compared with image and text generation, alignment in video generation presents unique challenges, including error accumulation over time, motion-appearance coupling, multi-objective trade-offs, and limited supervision for temporal properties. These challenges motivate systematic post-training strategies that adapt pretrained models without retraining them from scratch. In this survey, we present the first comprehensive review of post-training and alignment in video generation models. We frame post-training as a unifying framework and distinguish between implicit alignment and explicit alignment based on how alignment signals are enforced. From this perspective, we organize existing approaches into four broad categories: supervised fine-tuning methods, self-training and distillation methods, preference- and reward-based methods, and inference-time methods. This taxonomy provides a coherent view of how alignment signals shape model behavior across both training and deployment. Beyond methodological advances, we review commonly used datasets, benchmarks, and evaluation practices, and discuss open challenges such as scalable reward design, long-horizon temporal consistency, stability-expressiveness trade-offs, and safety-aware generation. This survey aims to provide a structured conceptual foundation and practical guidance for advancing controllable and reliable video generation models.

Abstract: Open Set Recognition (OSR) aims to enable models to accurately classify known classes while rejecting samples from unseen classes. A key challenge in OSR lies in the inability to model the unbounded distribution of unknown classes during training, often leading to the misclassification of samples from these classes. Rather than modeling unknowns, recent work shapes the feature space so that known classes are compact and well separated, and spherical representation learning methods have achieved strong results this way. Label smoothing has been identified as one of the key drivers of this success, yet it applies the same coefficient to every training sample, regardless of how well each sample is already embedded. We show that the spherical representation learning objectives used in OSR share a single alignment--uniformity structure in which labels enter only through the alignment term. Label smoothing therefore acts as an alignment dial, and a fixed coefficient sets this dial to the same value for every sample. We propose a plug-in, SmoothOperator (SmoothOP), which sets the smoothing coefficient of each sample from its \textbf{prominence}, an embedding-space signal measuring how clearly the sample's own class stands out against its strongest competing class. Our method integrates into four existing spherical representation learning methods at minimal training overhead. SmoothOP assigns strong smoothing to samples with high prominence, which reduces their alignment and relaxes their pull. Abstract: Accurate 3D semantic perception is critical for safe autonomous navigation. However, supervised LiDAR segmentation remains tied to closed taxonomies and to the cost of point-wise manual annotation. Open-vocabulary methods avoid that cost by projecting the output of 2D vision-language models onto LiDAR and distilling it into a 3D network. These methods rely almost exclusively on voxel-based sparse convolutions, and point transformers have so far been limited to indoor environments, where 3D data is dense and bounded. *Chensheng Peng,Wenhao Ding,Ran Tian,Zewei Zhou,Jef Packer,Maximilian Igl,Peter Karkus,Yan Wang,Masayoshi Tomizuka,Boris Ivanovic,Marco Pavone,Yuxiao Chen*

  <summary>Details</summary>

Conclusion: 通过模拟器中的扰动动作—加噪视觉配对、扭曲噪声调度与多智能体动作接口，CtrlWAM 实现了更可控的世界动作模型。项目主页：https://ctrl-wam.github.io/

Abstract: World action models (WAMs) jointly predict actions (intent) and visual future (foresight). Standard training adds noise to recorded actions and video simultaneously, but such training paradigms introduce a mismatch: perturbed actions imply counterfactual future visual, while the noised video remains tied to the GT recording. In low-noise regime, the scene geometry and even the dynamic behavior remain clearly visible from the noisy future frames despite the added noise. Abstract: Sign language machine translation has progressed substantially over the past decade, evolving from isolated sign recognition to end-to-end translation systems. Abstract: Gaze estimation under natural head-eye motion underpins applications from driver monitoring to human-computer interaction. Because differencing is translation-invariant in gaze space, this token carries subject-invariant motion rather than personal gaze offsets. Abstract: Video-to-speech synthesis aims to generate natural-sounding speech from silent talking-face videos while ensuring phonetic accuracy. A fundamental challenge in this task is the inherent one-to-many mapping problem, where visual dynamics often lack sufficient information to uniquely determine the corresponding utterance. To address this, we propose Watch Your Speech (WYS), a video-to-speech synthesis framework that incorporates textual conditioning as an explicit linguistic cue to mitigate visual ambiguity. Our framework features an attention-based embedding fusion module that synergistically integrates textual context with video sequences, coupled with a conditional flow matching objective for high-fidelity speech generation. Extensive experiments on the LRS2 and LRS3 datasets demonstrate that WYS achieves superior performance, establishing new state-of-the-art results in audio-visual synchronization (LSE-C/D) while maintaining highly competitive textual accuracy (WER). Subjective evaluations further confirm that our model generates speech with near-human naturalness, validating the effectiveness of textual conditioning in content-controlled video-to-speech synthesis.
