Result: 在ImageNet 256x256上的大量实验表明，相比标准FM，CoFlow在少步推理（如20步）下显著降低FID，且不增加额外训练开销。代码已开源：https://github.com/HKUST-LongGroup/CoFlow

Conclusion: CoFlow将轨迹交叉问题重新定义为速度场局部Lipschitz常数过大导致的拟合与积分困难，并通过SDE中注入排斥漂移项、结合等价随机插值表述，实现对中间轨迹的显式调控。方法在少步生成中提升FID且无额外训练成本，验证了从网络学习视角解决轨迹交叉的有效性。

Abstract: Trajectory crossing remains a critical bottleneck in Flow Matching (FM), and previous works typically view these crossings from a theoretical optimization perspective causing velocity averaging. They attempt to address it indirectly by post-hoc distillation or endpoint coupling, without explicitly regulating the intermediate trajectories. In this paper, we introduce a new network learning perspective: crossing points inherently induce large local Lipschitz constants in the target velocity field, leading to two drawbacks. First, high Lipschitz constants correspond to high-frequency signals in the velocity field that neural networks struggle to fit due to spectral bias. Second, they also imply drastic velocity variations, leading to severe numerical integration errors in few-step inference. To alleviate this, we propose CoFlow, a framework that introduces the contrastive learning paradigm into FM to explicitly repel trajectories during training, thereby lowering the local Lipschitz constants of the velocity field. Specifically, we formulate CoFlow from a Stochastic Differential Equation (SDE) perspective by injecting a repulsive drift term. This drift actively guides the forward process of positive samples away from negative trajectories, effectively reducing the local Lipschitz constant. Furthermore, we derive an equivalent stochastic interpolant formulation from this SDE, providing a simple and tractable design space to control the influence of negative samples. Extensive experiments on ImageNet 256x256 demonstrate that CoFlow significantly reduces FID compared to standard FM in few-step inference (e.g., 20 steps), with no added training overhead. The code can be accessed at: https://github.com/HKUST-LongGroup/CoFlow

</details>


### [96] [Localisation-Aware Uncertainty for Pretrained Object Detection](https://arxiv.org/abs/2610.01409)
*Charmaine Barker,Daniel Bethell,Simos Gerasimou*

Main category: cs.CV

TL;DR: 提出一种轻量级事后证据元模型GRACE，在冻结检测器的前提下估计每个预测框的不确定性，要求无需重训练或修改架构。


<details>
  <summary>Details</summary>
Motivation: 目标检测器在分布/协变量偏移与对抗攻击下的可靠不确定性估计对部署至关重要；现有方法多需重训练、改架构或重复推理，代价高甚至不可行。

Method: 冻结基检测器，训练事后证据元模型；自动识别与定位相关特征，用显著性引导修改构建递进式难度的课程；以定位误差、修改程度、预测不稳定性合成的检测级目标指导元模型输出每个预测框的不确定性；不改变检测器、保留原始定位输出。

Result: 在多种对抗攻击及不同强度下，GRACE相较最强对比方法将TP-FP AUROC最多提升22%，同时保持分布内检测性能。

Conclusion: GRACE验证了事后、无需改动检测器的不确定性估计可行性，兼顾鲁棒性与原性能，为检测器部署提供低成本方案。

Abstract: Reliable uncertainty estimation is essential for deploying object detectors when distribution/covariate shift and adversarial attacks may occur. Existing approaches often require detector retraining, architectural modification, or repeated inference, which may be infeasible or incur significant overheads. We introduce a lightweight post-hoc evidential meta-model that learns when object localisations should be considered uncertain while keeping the base detector frozen. Our approach automatically identifies localisation-relevant features and uses saliency-guided modification to construct an increasingly challenging curriculum. Detection-level targets combine localisation error, modification level, and prediction instability to guide an evidential meta-model to estimate uncertainty for each predicted bounding box. Our approach requires no changes to the detector and preserves its original localisation outputs. Across adversarial attacks and evaluated strengths, GRACE improves TP-FP AUROC by 22% relative to the strongest comparator in some cases while maintaining in-distribution detection performance.

</details>


### [97] [MWOP: Modality-aware Width-wise Operation Pruning for Efficient MLLMs](https://arxiv.org/abs/2610.01434)
*Xudong Wang,Hao Wu,Haozhe Hu,Peiran Yin,Xinghao Chen,Yunpu Ma,Wei Zhang,Xiaoyu Shen*

Main category: cs.CV

TL;DR: 提出MWOP方法，在多模态大模型中按模态对注意力路径和FFN通道进行细粒度剪枝，配合专用Triton内核实现显著推理加速且几乎不损性能。


<details>
  <summary>Details</summary>
Motivation: 多模态大模型处理长视觉-文本序列时推理成本高。现有算子压缩方法仅利用模态级冗余，将注意力头和共享FFN通道视为统一单元，忽略了更细粒度的冗余。作者观察到同一注意力头内不同模态交互路径之间、以及同一FFN通道在视觉与文本执行之间的冗余存在差异。

Method: 提出模式感知宽度方向算子剪枝（MWOP）：在每层内独立剪枝V2V、T2V、T2T注意力路径，并对视觉和文本输入分别选择FFN通道。采用一阶泰勒准则指导剪枝，在注意力剪枝后重新评估FFN重要性，并进行基于LoRA的恢复训练。开发路径稀疏Triton注意力内核与紧凑视觉侧FFN执行以将稀疏性转化为实际加速。

Result: 在LLaVA-OneVision-7B上，MWOP单独实现1.6倍预填充加速，12个基准平均性能保留99.7%。与两种代表性token压缩方法结合后，预填充加速比分别从2.0倍和1.9倍提升至2.9倍和2.7倍。在Qwen2.5-VL-7B上进一步验证了跨架构适用性。

Conclusion: MWOP保留token序列而减少注意力与FFN计算，与token压缩互补，可同时降低序列长度与每token计算量，实现细粒度稀疏到实际加速的转化。

Abstract: Multimodal large language models (MLLMs) incur substantial inference costs when processing long visual-textual sequences. While existing operation compression methods exploit modality-level redundancy, they largely treat computation within attention heads and shared feed-forward network (FFN) channels as unified units, leaving finer-grained redundancy underexplored. We find that redundancy varies both across modality-interaction paths within the same attention head and across visual and textual executions of the same FFN channel. Based on these findings, we propose Modality-aware Width-wise Operation Pruning (MWOP), which independently prunes visual-to-visual (V2V), text-to-visual (T2V), and text-to-text (T2T) attention paths within each layer, and separately selects FFN channels for visual and textual inputs. A first-order Taylor criterion guides the pruning process, with FFN importance re-evaluated after attention pruning and LoRA-based recovery training. To translate the resulting fine-grained sparsity into practical acceleration, we further develop path-sparse Triton attention kernels and compact visual-side FFN execution. MWOP preserves the token sequence while reducing attention and FFN computation, making it complementary to token compression and enabling simultaneous reduction of sequence length and per-token computation. On LLaVA-OneVision-7B, MWOP alone achieves a $1.6\times$ prefill speedup with 99.7\% average performance retention across 12 benchmarks. Combined with two representative token compression methods, it further increases their prefill speedups from $2.0\times$ and $1.9\times$ to $2.9\times$ and $2.7\times$, respectively. Results on Qwen2.5-VL-7B further demonstrate its applicability across architectures. The code is available at https://github.com/EIT-NLP/MWOP.

</details>


### [98] [The Impact of Processing Parameters on High-Accuracy Measurements in UAV Photogrammetry](https://arxiv.org/abs/2610.01438)
*Paweł Ćwiąkała,Edyta Puniach,Elżbieta Pastucha,Wojciech Gruszczyński*

Main category: cs.CV

TL;DR: 对768种无人机摄影测量处理方案进行全因子评估，系统揭示光束法平差参数设置对三维精度及形变指标的影响。


<details>
  <summary>Details</summary>
Motivation: 滑坡、采矿与微地形变化监测对无人机摄影测量精度要求高，采集策略研究较多，但处理流程（尤其光束法平差参数设置）影响尚未充分探讨。

Method: 基于1.5年、220 ha研究区采集的10个无人机数据集，设计全因子实验，评估768种处理变体，分析8个关键参数，并考察其对位移、倾斜变化与水平应变精度的影响。

Result: 三维精度差异显著，最优RMSE为16 mm，最差达303 mm；最主要影响因子为地面控制点数量、附加相机检校改正及PPK-GNSS确定投影中心坐标；随机位移误差稳定（RMSE约6-7 mm），系统误差各轴降低过半，垂直中位绝对误差由14 mm降至7 mm。

Conclusion: 首次开展大规模、面向实践的处理参数影响评估，为构建稳健、可重复的高精度无人机摄影测量监测流程提供可操作指导。

Abstract: Unmanned aerial vehicle (UAV) photogrammetry is increasingly used in applications requiring high accuracy, such as determining ground surface changes caused by landslides, mining, or microrelief transformation. While acquisition strategies have been widely studied, the influence of the processing workflow-particularly Bundle Block Adjustment parameter settings-remains insufficiently explored. This study addresses this gap through a systematic, full-factorial evaluation of 768 processing variants applied to ten UAV datasets collected over 1.5 years in a 220 ha study area. Eight key parameters were analysed. The results show substantial variability in final 3D accuracy: the best performing variant achieved a root mean square error (RMSE) of 16 mm, whereas the weakest reached 303 mm. The most influential factors were the number of ground control points, the application of additional camera calibration corrections, and the use of the Post-Processing Kinematic GNSS method for determining camera projection center coordinates. The study also evaluates how workflow optimization affects the accuracy of displacement, tilt changes, and horizontal strain determination. While random displacement errors remained stable (RMSE of ~6-7 mm), systematic errors were significantly reduced by over half in all axes, with vertical median absolute error decreasing from 14 mm to 7 mm in the optimized configuration compared to the baseline previously used by the authors. This study provides the first large-scale, practice-oriented assessment of how processing parameter selection shapes the accuracy of both photogrammetric products and deformation indices determination. The results offer actionable guidance for developing more robust and repeatable UAV photogrammetry workflows tailored to high-precision monitoring.

</details>


### [99] [Uncertainty-Guided Handshake: Efficient Human-in-the-Loop Refinement for Surgical-Grade Glioma Segmentation](https://arxiv.org/abs/2610.01452)
*Samuel Hart,Ahmad Yahya,Ahmed Karam Eldaly*

Main category: cs.CV

TL;DR: 本文提出一种面向胶质瘤分割的混合结构-随机不确定性人机回环框架，通过逐体素TTA不确定性与分层拓扑过滤主动定位高风险结构异常，在OOD临床压力测试队列上以约11.3%的中位交互工作量显著提升WT与TC的Dice并降低HD95。


<details>
  <summary>Details</summary>
Motivation: 现有医学图像分割模型虽平均性能高，但在神经肿瘤等领域存在局部灾难性失败，难以安全临床部署；传统交互式分割需医生手动查找错误，带来难以承受的认知与时间负担。因此需要一种能自动定位高风险错误、仅需少量人工干预的高效人机回环方案，以弥合自动化基线与手术级精度之间的差距。

Method: 提出混合结构-随机不确定性的人机回环（Human-in-the-Loop）框架：提取逐体素测试时增强（TTA）不确定性，并施加分层拓扑过滤，主动隔离高风险结构异常，为结构性失败提供安全网路由；在模拟Human Oracle下于分布外临床压力测试队列（N=362）上评估。

Result: 在N=362的OOD临床压力测试队列上，框架将全肿瘤（WT）Dice从0.891提升至0.914，HD95从5.82 mm降至4.76 mm；在肿瘤核心（TC）上挽救严重边界失败，平均HD95从17.96 mm降至14.83 mm，绝对TC Dice提升至0.356；同时中位交互工作量仅为目标体积的11.3%。

Conclusion: 该框架在模拟上限条件下实现了高帕累托效率的临床AI安全部署路径，能够以极低的人工交互成本显著提升分割精度与安全性；但作者指出模拟Human Oracle缺乏真实认知摩擦，结果应视为上界，需进一步真实验证。

Abstract: While state-of-the-art automated models for medical image segmentation achieve high mean performance, they frequently suffer from localized, catastrophic failures that preclude safe clinical deployment, particularly in neuro-oncology. Interactive segmentation frameworks mitigate this by incorporating human oversight, but traditionally impose prohibitive cognitive and temporal workloads by requiring clinicians to manually search for errors. In this project, we present an efficient, Hybrid Structural-Aleatoric Human-in-the-Loop framework for glioma segmentation that bridges the gap between automated baseline performance and surgical-grade precision, achieving sub-2.0 mm HD95 on curated benchmarks while providing safety-net routing for structural failures across real-world clinical data. By extracting voxel-wise Test-Time Augmentation (TTA) uncertainty and applying hierarchical topological filtering, our method proactively isolates high-risk structural anomalies. We comprehensively evaluated our approach on a challenging out-of-distribution clinical stress-test cohort (N = 362). Operating under a simulated Human Oracle, the framework improved the Whole Tumor (WT) Dice score from 0.891 to 0.914 and reduced the 95th percentile Hausdorff Distance (HD95) from 5.82 mm to 4.76 mm. Critically for surgical safety, the system rescued severe boundary failures in the Tumor Core, reducing mean HD95 from 17.96 mm to 14.83 mm (improving absolute TC Dice to 0.356). These spatial rescues were achieved while demanding a median interactive workload of just 11.3% of the target volume. Acknowledging this as a simulated upper bound lacking real-world cognitive friction, the framework nevertheless demonstrates a highly Pareto-efficient pathway for safely deploying clinical AI.

</details>


### [100] [FiVOS: A Fish Segmentation Algorithm Based on Interactive Video Object Segmentation and Filter Enhancement](https://arxiv.org/abs/2610.01480)
*Yuqing Duan,Song Zhang,Shili Zhao,Daoliang Li,Ran Zhao*

Main category: cs.CV

TL;DR: 本文提出改进的交互式视频目标分割方法FiVOS，并构建两个鱼类专用数据集，实现鱼类视频分割的SOTA性能。


<details>
  <summary>Details</summary>
Motivation: 水产养殖规模扩大对鱼类行为精准监测需求增强；现有基于深度学习的视频分割方法忽视帧间动态关联；IVOS交互-传播范式可高效高精度分割但受限于数据稀缺，且因类内高相似性导致长序列传播中误差累积与掩码丢失。

Method: 提出FiVOS方法：采用掩码块滤波器（mask block filter）实现错误传播掩码块的早期检测与校正，通过基于规则的阈值策略提升滤波准确度；并串联噪声滤波器（serialized noise filters）进一步消除错误掩码噪声以增强鲁棒性；同时构建两个鱼类专用数据集。

Result: FiVOS在鱼类视频分割任务中取得SOTA性能。

Conclusion: FiVOS为鱼类行为研究提供稳健的技术支撑，验证了交互式视频目标分割在水产养殖场景的可行性与有效性。

Abstract: With the continuous expansion of aquaculture, precise and efficient monitoring of fish behavior has become increasingly critical for improving farming efficiency and reducing economic losses. In particular, with the ongoing enhancement of computational capabilities in deep learning models, vision-based fish segmentation methods are garnering growing attention. By analyzing video segmentation results, fish behavior can be effectively tracked, thereby providing reliable data support for the precise regulation of aquaculture environments. However, existing deep learning-based video segmentation methods for aquaculture scenarios often overlook the dynamic correlations between video frames. In contrast, Interactive Video Object Segmentation (IVOS) employs an interaction-propagation scheme to achieve high-precision segmentation while minimizing user effort, thereby enhancing monitoring efficiency. Yet, IVOS applications in aquaculture remain limited due to data scarcity, and are susceptible to error accumulation and mask loss over long sequence propagation due to high intra-class similarity. In response, this paper proposes an improved interactive video object segmentation method (FiVOS) and constructs two fish-specific datasets. FiVOS utilizes a mask block filter to enable early detection and correction of erroneous propagated mask blocks, enhancing filtering accuracy through a rule-based thresholding approach. Additionally, it serializes noise filters to further eliminate erroneous mask noise, thereby improving model robustness. Experimental results demonstrate that FiVOS achieves state-of-the-art (SOTA) performance in fish video segmentation tasks, providing robust technical support for fish behavior research.

</details>


### [101] [SALD: Self-Referenced Advantage Learning for Diffusion Models](https://arxiv.org/abs/2610.01496)
*Aryan Das,Surjo Dey,Koushik Biswas,Swalpa Kumar Roy,Moloud Abdar,Arnab Bhattacharya,Vinay Kumar Verma*

Main category: cs.CV

TL;DR: 提出 SALD 自参考训练框架，让扩散模型在同一模型的两个噪声水平路径间构造相对误差信号，无需外部示范或教师网络即可提升生成质量。


<details>
  <summary>Details</summary>
Motivation: 现有语言模型自适应工作表明，模型能在示范或反馈增强的上下文中评估自身行为以获得训练信号，但通常依赖由学生参数驱动的教师网络。本文受"内部参考"原理启发，探索扩散模型能否在没有外部示范与教师网络的情况下，自行识别自参考的训练信号。

Method: SALD 对每个图文对在两个噪声水平上、用同一模型进行评估：较低噪声的易路径不追踪梯度，仅提供参考；较高噪声的难路径提供训练梯度。它不直接蒸馏易路径预测，而是利用两条路径误差之差来调整难路径目标。包含三个组件：AGD（Advantage-Guided Diffusion）将相对误差转为可微的样本级权重；TAM（Temporal Advantage Memory）累积训练中的相对难度并自适应调整未来两个噪声水平间的间隔；SAD（Spectral Advantage Decomposition）比较两路径残差功率谱，构造可微的、源自频域的隐元素权重。所有组件共享同一套模型参数。

Result: 在多种架构与数据集上的实验表明，生成质量获得一致提升；组件消融实验量化了各所提组件的贡献。

Conclusion: SALD 无需外部教师网络，也不引入额外可训练参数，训练与推理阶段均不改变推理流程，即可通过自参考的相对误差信号有效提升扩散模型的生成质量。

Abstract: Recent work on language-model adaptation has shown that single models can obtain informative training signals by evaluating their behavior in demonstrationor feedback-augmented contexts, with the help of a teacher network, which is driven by the student's learned parameters. Inspired by this internal-reference principle, we investigate how diffusion models can identify self-referenced training signals without external demonstrations or teacher networks. We introduce SALD, a self-referenced training framework that evaluates each image-caption pair at two noise levels using the same model. The easier, lower-noise path is evaluated without gradient tracking to provide a reference, while the harder, higher-noise path provides the training gradient. Rather than directly distilling the easy-path prediction, SALD uses the difference between two path errors to adapt the hardpath objective. The proposed Advantage-Guided Diffusion (AGD) converts this relative error into a differentiable sample-level weight. Temporal Advantage Memory (TAM) accumulates relative difficulty across training and adapts the future gap between the two noise levels. Spectral Advantage Decomposition (SAD) further compares the residual power spectra of the two paths and constructs a differentiable, frequency-derived latent-element weight. All components share a single set of model parameters, requiring neither an external teacher network nor additional trainable parameters during training or inference, and no modification to the inference procedure. Experiments across multiple architectures and datasets demonstrate consistent improvements in generation quality, while component-wise ablations quantify the contributions of the proposed components.

</details>


### [102] [VTR-Bench: A Systematic Benchmark for Evaluating Visual Text Rendering in Video Generation](https://arxiv.org/abs/2610.01499)
*Yu Huang,Jungang Li,Zhiyuan Wang,Yonghua Hei,Song Dai,Jiayu Yang,Deyuan Liu,Xiang Zheng,Xiaoshuang Shi,Hao Cheng,Kaidi Xu*

Main category: cs.CV

TL;DR: 论文提出VTR-Bench基准，系统评估视频生成模型的视觉文本渲染能力，并给出Keyframe-Guided Agentic Framework改进框架。


<details>
  <summary>Details</summary>
Motivation: 现有视频生成评测基准主要关注视觉质量、美学和物理合理性，忽视场景内文本渲染这一日常信息传递的重要媒介；模型可生成视觉逼真视频但文本渲染错误。

Method: 构建VTR-Bench，将文本置于广告、科学视频等五类具体应用场景，含300个精心构造的提示词；设计自动化评测流水线并与人工对齐，通过载体特定转录评估文本保真度，通过提示词特定的查询链评估场景与运动需求；提出Keyframe-Guided Agentic Framework，由Director智能体协调图像与视频生成及视觉评估，借助视觉反馈迭代优化与候选选择。

Result: 在11个最先进模型上实验，普遍存在场景文本渲染困难，最佳模型整体词错误率（WER）为0.250；进一步分析文本渲染失败案例以刻画当前模型面临的挑战。

Conclusion: 视觉文本渲染是视频生成的关键挑战，本文基准与框架揭示了这一被忽视维度并展示了切实可行的改进路径。

Abstract: Recent video generation models can produce highly realistic videos from natural language instructions, with visual quality approaching cinematic standards. Existing evaluation benchmarks, however, predominantly assess visual quality, aesthetic appeal and physical plausibility, while paying limited attention to text, an essential medium for conveying information in everyday scenes. A generated video may appear visually compelling and feature lifelike subjects, yet still render the text within the scene incorrectly. To address this overlooked dimension, we introduce \textbf{VTR-Bench}, a systematic benchmark for evaluating the \textbf{V}isual \textbf{T}ext \textbf{R}endering capabilities of video generation models. VTR-Bench situates text within concrete application scenarios, such as advertisements and scientific videos, with 300 carefully constructed prompts spanning five scenario categories. We develop an automated evaluation pipeline with human alignments that separately assesses text fidelity through carrier-specific transcription and scene and motion requirements through a prompt-specific chain of query. Beyond evaluation, we introduce a \textbf{Keyframe-Guided Agentic Framework} in which a Director agent coordinates image and video generation with visual evaluation, guiding iterative refinement and candidate selection through visual feedback. Experiments on 11 state-of-the-art models reveal widespread difficulties in accurately rendering scene text, with the best-performing model recording an overall word error rate (WER) of 0.250. We further analyze text rendering failures to characterize the challenges faced by current video generation models. These findings highlight visual text rendering as a key challenge for video generation and demonstrate a practical path toward improvement. Code is available at https://github.com/hardenyu21/VTR-Bench.

</details>


### [103] [FedCKA: Representation-Guided Layer Personalization for Federated 3D Perception Across Driving Domains](https://arxiv.org/abs/2610.01510)
*Jolle Verhoog,Ali Burak Ünal,Holger Caesar*

Main category: cs.CV

TL;DR: 提出FedCKA，基于CKA动态平衡联邦3D检测中的个性化与全局化，在nuScenes多域基准上NDS较最强基线提升7个百分点。


<details>
  <summary>Details</summary>
Motivation: 智能车辆需在时间、地点、天气等域偏移下保持可靠的3D目标检测，但部分环境因标注昂贵、偏移样本稀少而缺少足够数据训练独立检测器。联邦学习可在保护隐私前提下协作训练，但传统单一全局共识模型难以适应异构本地分布；现有基于预定义层划分或固定个性化比例的方法灵活性不足。

Method: FedCKA利用中心核对齐（CKA）计算训练中本地客户端模型与全局共识模型之间的逐层特征相似度，将逐层相似度分数转换为客户端特定的聚合掩码，从而有选择地共享表征一致的层，动态处理个性化-全局化权衡。

Result: 在基于nuScenes构建的统一多域基准上，FedCKA优于FedBN、FedRep、FedSelect等联邦基线，平均NDS较最强基线提升7个百分点。

Conclusion: 该工作提供了跨地点、天气和光照偏移下鲁棒联邦3D感知的对比基准与有前景的方向，代码已开源。

Abstract: Robust perception in intelligent vehicles demands 3D object detectors that remain dependable under domain shifts, such as changes in time of day, location, or weather. However, due to costly annotation and rare shifts, some environments lack sufficient data to train a standalone detector. Federated learning offers a privacy-preserving framework for collaborative model training, enabling clients to benefit from shared learning across diverse environments. Yet, this framework traditionally relies on a single global consensus model, which struggles to perform across heterogeneous local data distributions. Local conditions are better captured by adapting a subset of the model, but many personalization approaches rely on predefined layer partitions or fixed personalization ratios, thereby limiting adaptation to client-specific divergence. To reduce this rigidity, we propose FedCKA, a Centered Kernel Alignment (CKA)-based strategy that dynamically handles the personalization-globalization trade-off. Specifically, FedCKA computes layer-wise feature similarities between local client models and the global consensus model during training. By converting layer-wise similarity scores into client-specific aggregation masks, FedCKA selectively shares representation-consistent layers. Evaluation on a unified multi-domain benchmark based on nuScenes shows that FedCKA outperforms established federated baselines, including FedBN, FedRep, and FedSelect, improving average NDS by 7 percentage points over the strongest baseline. The findings offer both a comparative benchmark and a promising direction for robust federated 3D perception across shifts in location, weather, and illumination. Code is available at https://github.com/j-verhoog/FedCKA.

</details>


### [104] [VoxelSynth3D: Interpretable Volumetric Image-Domain Metal Artifact Reduction with a Paired Synthetic CLINIC-Metal Benchmark](https://arxiv.org/abs/2610.01512)
*Amritesh Banerjee,Abdul Basit,Renil Renji Joseph,Nouhaila Innan,Muhammad Shafique*

Main category: cs.CV

TL;DR: VoxelSynth3D：一种无需训练的3D图像域金属伪影校正框架，在合成配对数据上将组织RMSE从801.48降至786.18 HU，逐例改善并优于3D高斯平滑器。


<details>
  <summary>Details</summary>
Motivation: 术后肌肉骨骼CT中的金属伪影会遮蔽骨-植入物界面及邻近软组织界面，影响评估。现有金属伪影校正（MAR）方法多依赖难以获取的原始投影数据，或依赖可能随扫描仪和植入物类型发生迁移的学习模型，限制了临床通用性。因此需要一种仅作用于重建CT图像、无需训练与原始数据的实用方案。

Method: 提出VoxelSynth3D，一种训练无关（training-free）的3D图像域框架，作用于已重建CT。其流程包含：支持掩膜（support masking）、归一化组织合成（normalized tissue synthesis）、偏差门控（deviation gating）与受限边缘细化（restricted edge refinement）。检测到的植入物体素在输出中予以保留，校正目标限定为金属周围组织中的金属诱导伪影。同时构建合成配对评测资源Synthetic CLINIC-Metal：基于无金属的CTPelvic1K体数据生成，配备干净目标、金属/伪影掩膜、固定随机种子与患者级数据划分。75例非配对真实金属病例仅做定性/无参考评估。工作点固定在近乎平坦的验证盆地内。

Result: 在精确掩膜oracle定位下，所有方法共享去除金属后的组织ROI。在40例留出病例上，VoxelSynth3D将RMSE从801.48降至786.18 HU（配对增益15.30 HU，95% CI 11.68–19.23），每一例均有改善，并比所评估的3D高斯平滑器优出13.58 HU。近距离金属处干净边缘一致性下降，但在距金属5 mm以外优于输入。间距感知（spacing-aware）敏感性分析保持了大范围区域的总体改善，并识别出近金属定标为后续改进目标。

Conclusion: VoxelSynth3D在无需训练、无需原始投影的条件下，实现了逐例一致的分布内组织误差降低，代价是局部化的结构权衡（近金属边缘一致性略有下降），为图像域金属伪影校正提供了一条可复现的合成配对评测路径。

Abstract: Metal artifacts in postoperative musculoskeletal CT obscure bone-implant and adjacent soft-tissue interfaces. Many metal artifact reduction (MAR) methods require unavailable raw projections or learned models that may shift across scanners and implants. We present VoxelSynth3D, a training-free 3D image-domain framework for reconstructed CT. The framework combines support masking, normalized tissue synthesis, deviation gating, and restricted edge refinement. Detected implant voxels are preserved in the output, while correction targets metal-induced artifacts in the surrounding tissue. We also construct Synthetic CLINIC-Metal, a controlled paired synthetic evaluation resource, from no-metal CTPelvic1K volumes with clean targets, metal/artifact masks, fixed seeds, and patient-level splits; 75 unpaired real metal cases receive qualitative/no-reference evaluation only. The operating point was fixed in a near-flat validation basin. With exact-mask oracle localization, all methods share a metal-excluded tissue ROI. On 40 held-out cases, VoxelSynth3D reduced RMSE from 801.48 to 786.18 HU (paired gain 15.30 HU, 95% CI 11.68-19.23), improving every case and exceeding the evaluated 3D Gaussian smoother by 13.58 HU. Clean-edge agreement decreased next to metal but exceeded input beyond 5 mm. Thus, VoxelSynth3D provides case-consistent within-distribution tissue-error reduction with a localized structural tradeoff. Spacing-aware sensitivity retained aggregate broad-region improvement and identified near-metal calibration as a target.

</details>


### [105] [SuperMotion: Source-Preserving Denoising for Text-Driven Human Motion Editing](https://arxiv.org/abs/2610.01517)
*Fa-Ting Hong,Peter Wonka*

Main category: cs.CV

TL;DR: 提出 SuperMotion 框架，在每个反向去噪步骤显式复用源动作，实现文本驱动的人体动作编辑，在保持时序细节的同时提升编辑精度。


<details>
  <summary>Details</summary>
Motivation: 现有基于扩散的编辑器主要依赖学习到的条件信息来保留未编辑部分，但随去噪推进，输出容易丢失时序细节（temporal detail），导致源内容保持不足。作者希望显式地重用源动作而非仅靠条件约束。

Method: 提出 Source-Preserving Denoising 框架（SuperMotion）。1）将源动作对齐到输出时间线，并预测一个 preservation gate，在帧和特征维度上控制复用程度；2）clean-space source anchor 利用该 gate 将预测的干净动作与对齐的源动作混合，并把校正后的估计直接送入采样后验；3）由于对齐源是已实现的动作而非回归输出，anchor 注入了被重建训练的降噪器平滑掉的样本级时序细节；4）用编辑目标监督 anchor 估计，并通过时序高频损失匹配其二阶时间差分。该方法无需显式编辑掩码。

Result: 在 MotionFix 上达到 33.20% full-pool R@1，编辑精度提升，同时减轻时序细节衰减并更好保持动作动态。消融实验证实性能增益来自学习到的 preservation gate，且该 gate 确实通过复用源来正确保留未编辑内容。

Conclusion: 显式复用源动作的 source-preserving 去噪策略能有效保留未编辑内容及其时序细节，优于纯条件式的扩散编辑方法，且无需编辑掩码。

Abstract: Text-driven human motion editing aims to realize a requested change while preserving compatible source content. Existing diffusion editors rely largely on learned conditioning for preservation of the unedited part, yet their outputs can lose temporal detail as denoising proceeds. We propose the \textbf{Source-Preserving Denoising framework (SuperMotion)}, which explicitly reuses the source at each reverse step for source preservation. We first align the source motion to the output timeline and predict a preservation gate that controls reuse across frames and feature dimensions. A clean-space source anchor then utilizes the learned preservation gate to blend the predicted clean motion with the aligned source and passes the corrected estimate directly to the sampling posterior. Because the aligned source is a realized motion rather than a regression output, the anchor injects sample-level temporal detail that a reconstruction-trained denoiser tends to smooth away. To learn effective source reuse, we supervise the anchored estimate against the editing target and match its second temporal differences through a temporal high-frequency loss. These objectives require no explicit edit masks. Extensive experiments show that SuperMotion improves editing accuracy, reaching 33.20\% full-pool R@1 on MotionFix, while reducing temporal-detail attenuation and preserving motion dynamics as it realizes the requested changes. Ablations confirm that the learned preservation gate is responsible for the gain and that it reuses the source to retain the unedited content properly.

</details>


### [106] [Synthetic training for long-tail haemorrhagic lesion segmentation in data-scarce settings](https://arxiv.org/abs/2610.01542)
*Yuan Cao,Sumeet Dash,Antonia Zachariadis,Stefanie Schreiber,Katja Neumann,Jose Bernal*

Main category: cs.CV

TL;DR: 提出一种无需真实病灶标注的合成训练框架，用于长尾出血性病灶（cSS与CMB）的自动分割，性能优于经典滤波基线。


<details>
  <summary>Details</summary>
Motivation: 脑微出血（CMB）与皮层表面铁沉积（cSS）是脑小血管病的影像标志物，但其自动分割受限于阳性样本稀缺与体素级标注匮乏，属于典型长尾问题。

Method: 以解剖脑区划分（parcellation）为起点，经空间增强与体素重采样，依据病灶位置与形态的临床先验以程序化方式插入cSS与CMB标签，并通过随机强度赋值、模糊与Rician噪声模拟合成图像；基于动态生成的图像-标签对训练模型，利用放射学描述而非真实标注。

Result: 在10例cSS与13例CMB病例上以人工勾画为参考评估：cSS方面，低信号约束模型AUPRC 0.284、AUROC 0.907，优于Frangi滤波（0.083、0.731）；CMB方面，显式合成血管作为类病灶干扰项使AUPRC达0.538、AUROC达0.999，优于经典基线（0.004、0.968）。

Conclusion: 该合成训练策略在数据稀缺条件下具有可行性，为长尾出血性病灶分割提供了无需真实标注的解决思路。

Abstract: Cerebral microbleeds (CMBs) and cortical superficial siderosis (cSS) are imaging markers of cerebral small vessel disease, but their automated segmentation is limited by the scarcity of positive cases and voxel-level annotations. We propose a synthetic training framework for long-tail haemorrhagic lesion segmentation that requires no real lesion annotations for training and leverages radiological description of the lesions. Starting from anatomical brain parcellations, the framework applies spatial augmentation and voxel resampling, procedurally inserts cSS and CMB labels using clinical priors on lesion location and morphology, and synthesises images through randomised intensity assignment, blurring, and Rician noise simulation. Models were trained on dynamically generated image-label pairs and evaluated against manual delineations in 10 cSS cases and 13 CMB cases. The proposed configurations outperformed classical filter baselines. For cSS, the hypointensity constrained model achieved higher AUPRC and AUROC than the Frangi filter (AUPRC: 0.284 vs 0.083; AUROC: 0.907 vs 0.731). For CMBs, explicit synthesis of blood vessels as lesion mimics improved performance over the classical baseline (AUPRC: 0.538 vs 0.004; AUROC: 0.999 vs 0.968). These results support our proposal as a feasible strategy for data-scarce haemorrhagic lesion segmentation.

</details>


### [107] [Revisiting Cross-Reconstruction for Generalizable Deepfake Detection](https://arxiv.org/abs/2610.01544)
*Bingjian Yang,Shilei Zhao,Zheng Wang*

Main category: cs.CV

TL;DR: 本文提出面向伪影的解耦框架，通过保留伪影多样性并引入伪影感知的跨生成器重建，提升图像伪造检测的泛化能力。


<details>
  <summary>Details</summary>
Motivation: 现有图像伪造检测器泛化性差，难以捕捉可迁移的取证线索；近期基于跨重建的方法虽尝试语义-伪影解耦，但对异构伪影强行对齐并在重建中排除伪影表示，忽视了篡改伪影的固有多样性与视觉线索。

Method: 重新审视跨重建范式，提出artifact-oriented解耦框架：主张伪影多样性是互补取证线索而非域变化，不强制对齐伪影，而通过语义对齐的跨生成器重建保留多样化伪影特征；将伪影表示纳入重建过程，并引入掩码频率感知重建策略，突出篡改相关残差、抑制语义干扰。

Result: 在多个基准数据集上，跨数据集与跨生成器评测设置下均取得性能提升；进一步分析与消融实验验证了伪影多样性保留与伪影感知跨重建的有效性。

Conclusion: 保留并利用伪影多样性、将伪影表示融入跨生成器重建，可学习到更具可迁移性的取证表示，从而显著增强图像伪造检测的泛化性能。

Abstract: Existing image forgery detectors often suffer from generalization to unseen manipulation methods due to the limited ability to capture transferable forensic cues. Recent cross-reconstruction based methods attempt to improve generalization through semantic-artifact disentanglement, but typically align heterogeneous artifacts across generators and exclude artifact representations during reconstruction, which may overlook the inherent diversity and visual cues of manipulation artifacts. In this work, we revisit cross-reconstruction and introduce an artifact-oriented disentanglement framework for robust image forgery detection. We argue that \textbf{artifact diversity}, i.e., the intrinsic variations of manipulation artifacts introduced by different generation processes, contains complementary forensic cues rather than undesirable domain variations. Instead of enforcing explicit artifact alignment, our framework preserves diverse artifact characteristics through semantically aligned cross-generator reconstruction. Furthermore, we incorporate artifact representations into the reconstruction process and introduce a masked frequency-aware reconstruction strategy to emphasize manipulation-related residuals while reducing semantic interference. This design enables the model to learn transferable forensic representations from diverse artifacts. Extensive experiments on multiple benchmark datasets demonstrate improvements under both cross-dataset and cross-generator evaluation settings. Further analysis and ablation studies validate the effectiveness of artifact diversity preservation and artifact-aware cross-reconstruction.

</details>


### [108] [PAGER: Partial-to-global Alignment via Geometric and Relational Distillation](https://arxiv.org/abs/2610.01589)
*Akira-Miranda Adeyomi Adeniran-Lowe,Binod Singh,Lars Arnold Dethlefsen,Lazaros Nalpantidis,Theodora Kontogianni*

Main category: cs.CV

TL;DR: 本文指出预训练3D编码器在全局重建场景上学得，但具身系统需从相机坐标系下的部分观测推理，导致严重的表征错配；提出无标签适配方法PAGER，将部分视图特征对齐到冻结的全局3D语义空间，在Sonata与Concerto上超越有监督PEFT，并在零样本跨数据集迁移中优于全微调。


<details>
  <summary>Details</summary>
Motivation: 现有预训练3D编码器（如Sonata、Concerto）通常基于统一世界坐标系下的全局重建场景训练，而具身智能系统必须在相机坐标系下、从局部且依赖视角的观测中进行推理。这种从全局学习到的3D特征空间到真实部分观测的转变，暴露出严重的表征错配问题，且仅靠坐标规范化无法完全解决，因此需要一种能弥合该跨坐标系差异的适配方法。

Method: 提出PAGER，一种无标签适配方法，仅利用配对的部分/全局几何，将部分视图特征对齐到冻结的全局3D语义空间。它训练轻量适配模块，保持预训练编码器与全局分割探针冻结：通过匹配点特征对齐将部分特征锚定到对应全局特征，并用关系监督保持其相对于全局表征的相似性结构。全局几何仅在训练时提供监督，推理时直接作用于部分观测。

Result: 冻结的Sonata编码器加全局线性探针在完整ScanNet场景上达72.47 mIoU，在单帧相机坐标输入上仅2.57 mIoU；免训练的引力对齐可恢复至41.64 mIoU，说明坐标框架错配是主要退化来源但无法仅靠规范化完全解决。PAGER在无部分视图标签下，于Sonata和Concerto上均优于有标签监督的PEFT；在零样本ScanNet→ScanNet++迁移中超越全微调Sonata（53.93 vs. 48.09 mIoU）。

Conclusion: 从全局统一坐标系到相机坐标系部分观测的转变会导致严重表征错配，是当前3D编码器在具身应用中性能骤降的主因，且坐标规范化只能部分缓解。PAGER表明，通过无标签适配对齐部分视图特征并保持冻结的全局表征，不仅能超越有监督参数高效微调，还能提升跨数据集迁移能力，凸显保留冻结全局表征的价值。

Abstract: Pretrained 3D encoders are typically developed on globally reconstructed scenes expressed in a consistent world coordinate frame, whereas embodied systems must reason from partial, viewpoint-dependent observations in camera coordinates. We show that this shift from globally learned 3D feature spaces to realistic partial observations exposes a severe representation mismatch, which we find consistently across representative state-of-the-art encoders, including Sonata and Concerto. A frozen Sonata encoder with a global linear probe achieves 72.47 mIoU on full ScanNet scenes, but 2.57 mIoU on single-frame camera-coordinate inputs. Training-free gravity alignment recovers performance to 41.64 mIoU, showing that coordinate-frame mismatch is a dominant source of degradation but cannot be fully resolved through canonicalization alone. We introduce PAGER, a label-free adaptation method that aligns partial-view features with a frozen global 3D semantic space using only paired partial/global geometry. It learns lightweight adaptation modules while keeping the pretrained encoder and global segmentation probe frozen. Matched-point feature alignment anchors partial features to their global counterparts, while relational supervision preserves their similarity structure with respect to the global representation. Global geometry provides supervision only during training. Inference operates directly on the partial observation. Without partial-view labels, PAGER outperforms label-supervised PEFT on both Sonata and Concerto, and in zero-shot ScanNet$\rightarrow$ScanNet++ transfer surpasses fully fine-tuned Sonata ($53.93$ vs.\ $48.09$ mIoU), suggesting that preserving the frozen global representation can improve cross-dataset transfer.

</details>


### [109] [Before It Fades: Reinforcing Temporal Representations at Inference Time in VideoLLMs](https://arxiv.org/abs/2610.01595)
*Youngwoo Shin,Yusung Ro,Minseo Kim,Junmo Kim*

Main category: cs.CV

TL;DR: 本文研究VideoLLM时序推理失败的根源，提出时序发散向量τ_l并发现其中间层达峰、向输出层逐渐衰减的规律，据此提出免训练方法Temporal Activation Injection (TAI)，将峰值处的τ_l按测量衰减轨迹重注入后续层，在3个模型、4个基准上稳定提升时序推理且几乎不影响非时序任务。


<details>
  <summary>Details</summary>
Motivation: VideoLLM按顺序接收帧并应理解视觉内容的时间演化，但时序推理持续薄弱：反转视频帧序（本应反转时序答案）往往不改变最终预测。作者希望定位这一失败的来源，即模型在何处获取时序信息、又为何未能保持到输出。

Method: 定义时序发散向量τ_l，即反转时间顺序引起的逐层表征差异；追踪其跨层幅值以刻画时序发散剖面。发现发散在中间层达峰、向输出层递减，并验证该峰值对时序推理具有特异性且对预测功能关键。基于此提出TAI：对每个输入在剖面峰值处提取τ_l，并依照测得的衰减规律将其重注入后续层，无需训练。

Result: 时序发散剖面在中间层出现一致峰值，且该峰值具有时序特异性并对预测功能关键，表明VideoLLM在中间层获得时序信息但未能保持到输出。TAI在3个VideoLLM和4个基准上稳定提升时序推理性能，对非时序任务影响可忽略。

Conclusion: VideoLLM的时序失败源于中间层获得的时序信息在向输出传播过程中逐步衰减；通过在峰值处捕获并按衰减规律重注入时序激活（TAI），可在免训练条件下有效缓解该问题，为时序推理改进提供了表征层面的解释与可插拔方案。

Abstract: Video Large Language Models (VideoLLMs) receive frames in sequential order and interpret how visual content evolves along the temporal axis, yet temporal reasoning remains a persistent weakness across architectures. Reversing the frame order of a video, a transformation that should invert temporal answers, often leaves the final prediction unchanged. We investigate where this failure originates by defining the temporal divergence vector $τ_l$, the layer-wise representational difference induced by reversing temporal order. Tracking its magnitude across layers reveals a consistent temporal divergence profile where the divergence peaks at intermediate layers and progressively diminishes toward the output. We confirm this peak is specific to temporal reasoning and functionally critical for predictions, establishing that VideoLLMs acquire temporal information at intermediate layers but fail to maintain it to the output. This progressive fading motivates our method, Temporal Activation Injection (TAI), which extracts $τ_l$ at the peak of the profile for each input and reinjects it into subsequent layers following the measured decay. TAI requires no training and consistently improves temporal reasoning across three VideoLLMs and four benchmarks with negligible impact on non-temporal tasks. Code is available at https://github.com/Youngwoo-git/Before-It-Fades.

</details>


### [110] [Hob-VL: A Benchmark for Visually Grounded Boolean Reasoning](https://arxiv.org/abs/2610.01605)
*Yuzhou Wang,Emile Anand,Ijay Narang*

Main category: cs.CV

TL;DR: Hob-VL：面向视觉 grounding 的布尔推理基准，含规则验证与对象识别两任务，模型准确率仅约 48.5%–50.6%，识别最高 43.0%。


<details>
  <summary>Details</summary>
Motivation: 可靠视觉推理需组合多个视觉观测并对逻辑等价问题给出统一答案；现有模型在布尔组合与嵌套逻辑下表现薄弱，且缺少可执行参考答案与匹配评测的基准。

Method: 构建 Hob-VL：两任务（判断图像中布尔规则是否成立、识别满足布尔描述的唯一对象）；含 6000 条人工核验的平衡 Yes/No 问题，每题由 10 条视觉语句的布尔组合定义，覆盖 1000 个生成场景与 46 类多样标注照片；另含同一照片上的 1000 个对象识别问题。问题族刻意通过误导性局部线索与嵌套逻辑操作制造挑战，并提供符号化与结构化自然语言两种呈现。

Result: 八个模型配置在禁用或最小化 thinking 下，布尔准确率 48.52%–50.57%；识别准确率最高 43.0%。启用 thinking 的 GLM 配置增益不均衡，仍保留大量错误与不一致。

Conclusion: Hob-VL 通过可执行参考答案与匹配评测暴露现有模型在视觉布尔推理上的系统性失败。

Abstract: Reliable visual reasoning requires composing multiple visual observations and returning consistent answers to logically equivalent questions. We introduce Hob-VL, a benchmark for visually grounded Boolean reasoning. Hob-VL comprises two tasks: (1) evaluating whether a Boolean rule holds in an image, and (2) identifying the (unique) object satisfying a Boolean description. Hob-VL contains 6,000 human-verified balanced Yes/No questions, each defined by a Boolean combination of ten visual statements, across 1,000 generated scenes and 46 diverse labeled photographs, along with 1,000 object-identification questions over the same photographs. Our question families are deliberately constructed to challenge reasoning through misleading local cues and nested logical operations, and include symbolic and structured natural-language presentations. Across eight model configurations with thinking disabled or minimized, Boolean accuracy ranges from 48.52% to 50.57%, while the identification accuracy reaches at most 43.0%. A thinking-enabled GLM configuration achieves uneven gains while retaining substantial errors and inconsistencies. Hob-VL exposes these failures through executable reference answers and matched evaluations.

</details>


### [111] [Oneira: From Open-Ended Generation to Open-World Interaction in Video World Models](https://arxiv.org/abs/2610.01614)
*Xindi Yang,Baolu Li,Liam Lee,Zhenfei Yin,Songxin Zhang,Zhuoyang Song,Xu Jia,Jianfei Cai,Tien-Tsin Wong,Bingyi Jing,Mengyue Yang*

Main category: cs.CV

TL;DR: Oneira是一种交互式视频世界模型，通过由编码智能体管理的外部可扩展世界状态表，闭合生成与交互之间的循环，实现开放的交互性与持久状态。


<details>
  <summary>Details</summary>
Motivation: 现有生成式视频世界模型虽能合成开放式环境，但开放式生成不等于完整交互：新生成内容未纳入可操作范围，交互结果也未持久化，仅是瞬时视觉效应。论文将这两个需求概括为"开放世界交互性"与"持久状态"，并试图解决之。

Method: 提出Oneira，以显式、可扩展的世界状态表为核心：给定当前观测与动作或高层目标，编码智能体读取世界状态、定位相关实体、规划交互并将结果写回状态表；探索中发现的新物体由生成观测中纳入状态，使交互空间随世界扩展；先前状态变化跨视频片段传递。更新后的状态沿相机轨迹渲染为粗条件视频，再由视频生成器补全外观、运动与交互细节。

Result: 实验表明，Oneira能够对新生成物体进行直接且一致的交互，同时在长时程上保持先前交互的效果。

Conclusion: 通过编码智能体维护的显式世界状态实现生成与交互的闭环，是赋予视频世界模型开放交互性与持久状态的有效途径。

Abstract: Generative video world models can now synthesize open-ended environments that agents can navigate and interact with in simple ways. Yet open-ended generation does not imply full interaction: as a generated world expands, newly created content through navigation should expand what the agent can act upon, and as the agent changes the world, those changes should become persistent parts of the environment rather than transient visual effects. We characterize these two requirements as Open-World Interactivity, where newly generated or encountered entities are incorporated into the actionable world, and Persistent State, where interaction outcomes are committed to the world state and continue to influence subsequent observations and interactions. We present Oneira, an interactive video world model that closes the loop between generation and interaction through an explicit, extensible world state managed by a coding agent. Given the current observation and an action or high-level goal, the agent reads the world state, grounds the relevant entities, plans the interaction, and writes its outcome back into a world state table. When exploration reveals new objects, the agent incorporates them from generated observations, allowing the interaction space to expand with the generated world. Meanwhile, previously induced state changes are carried across video segments, making the consequences of interaction persistent parts of subsequent world evolution. The updated world state is rendered along the camera action trajectory into a coarse conditioning video, from which a video generator fills in the appearance, motion, and interaction details not represented in the state. Experiments show that Oneira enables direct and consistent interaction with newly generated objects, while preserving the effects of prior interactions over long horizons. Project page: https://madaoer.github.io/projects/oneira

</details>


### [112] [Beyond Domain-Level Adaptation: Margin-Oriented Semantic-Appearance Interaction Correction for Personalized Federated Vision-Language Models](https://arxiv.org/abs/2610.01625)
*Wentao Yue,Qingyu Mao,Tianyou Lai,Ahmed M. Abdelmoniem,Qilei Li*

Main category: cs.CV

TL;DR: 提出MOSAIC方法，通过建模细粒度类别-域交互并定位损害决策边界的残差，提升联邦参数高效微调在域异构下的个性化性能。


<details>
  <summary>Details</summary>
Motivation: 联邦参数高效微调可在不共享原始数据、不更新完整骨干的前提下适配预训练视觉-语言模型，但受客户端间域异构限制。现有个性化方法将全局共享知识与客户端特有风格分离，却大多把每个域视为类别无关的变换，这一抽象不足：固定域对应的跨域位移随语义类别变化，且仅部分类别-域残差会损害图文决策边界。

Method: MOSAIC首先构造决策感知的有害性评分，衡量由训练得到的类别-域残差是否使竞争文本原型优于真实类别。随后用低秩残差适配器建模细粒度类别-域交互，其中类别因子与残差基全局共享，域因子保持客户端私有。再用图像条件门控控制候选修正，并通过有害对感知重加权在本地优化中优先处理与决策相关的残差。

Result: 在Office31、OfficeHome和DomainNet100上的大量实验表明，MOSAIC在全部评估的域偏移与联合域-标签偏移设置下均持续提升宏客户端top-1准确率。

Conclusion: 将域视为类别无关变换的假设不足；显式建模类别-域交互并聚焦损害决策边界的残差，是提升联邦个性化参数高效微调有效性的关键方向。

Abstract: Federated parameter-efficient fine-tuning enables distributed clients to adapt pretrained vision-language models without sharing raw data or updating the full backbone. Its effectiveness, however, is limited by domain heterogeneity across clients. Existing personalized methods separate globally shared knowledge from client-specific style, but they largely treat each domain as a class-agnostic transformation. We show that this abstraction is insufficient: the cross-domain displacement associated with a fixed domain varies across semantic classes, and only a subset of these class-domain residuals damages the image-text decision margin. We therefore propose Margin-Oriented Semantic-Appearance Interaction Correction (MOSAIC), which first constructs a decision-aware harmfulness score that measures whether a training-derived class-domain residual favors a competing text prototype over the true class. It then models fine-grained class-domain interactions with a low-rank residual adapter whose class factors and residual basis are globally shared while domain factors remain client-private. An image-conditioned gate further controls candidate-wise correction, and harmful-pair-aware reweighting prioritizes decision-relevant residuals during local optimization. Extensive experiments on Office31, OfficeHome, and DomainNet100 demonstrate that MOSAIC consistently improves macro-client top-1 accuracy across all evaluated domain-shift and joint domain-label-shift settings.

</details>


### [113] [Fusing Visual and Textual Representations via Multi-layer Fusing Transformers for Vietnamese Visual Question Answering](https://arxiv.org/abs/2610.01637)
*Cong Phu Nguyen,Huy Tien Nguyen,Tung Le*

Main category: cs.CV

TL;DR: 本文提出一种多层融合Transformer模型，通过跨注意力模块聚合图像与文本不同层级的特征，用于越南语视觉问答，并在ViVQA数据集上取得优于基线模型的结果。


<details>
  <summary>Details</summary>
Motivation: 近年来人工智能在图像理解与交互方面进展显著，视觉问答（VQA）是其中的重要应用。然而，现有VQA研究主要集中于英语，针对越南语等其他语言的研究极少，这一空白既带来挑战也带来机遇。发展越南语VQA不仅可丰富人工智能研究的多样性，还能推动教育、医疗、娱乐等领域的实际应用，服务全球越南语人群。

Method: 提出一种多层融合Transformer（Multi-layer Fusing Transformer）模型，采用跨注意力（cross attention）模块，将图像与文本在不同层级的多种模态特征进行聚合表示，从而能够从低层级到高层级提取信息。

Result: 通过详细实验与消融研究，该模型在越南语ViVQA数据集上相比竞争性基线取得了有前景的结果。

Conclusion: 越南语VQA系统的探索与开发在计算机视觉与自然语言处理的交叉领域具有巨大潜力，能够同时推动学术研究与实际应用。

Abstract: In recent decades, artificial intelligence has made significant progress in understanding and interacting with images. One of the important applications of this technology is Visual Question Answering (VQA), a research field that requires computers to understand and answer questions about images in a natural manner. Despite extensive research and development in VQA for English, there have been very few similar efforts made for other languages, especially Vietnamese. This gap presents a significant challenge and opportunity for the advancement of VQA technology in the Vietnamese language context. By bridging this gap, the field of Vietnamese VQA not only enriches the diversity of research in artificial intelligence but also enables practical applications in various domains, such as education, healthcare, and entertainment, catering to Vietnamese-speaking populations worldwide. Thus, the exploration and development of Vietnamese VQA systems hold immense potential for advancing both research and practical applications in the intersection of computer vision and natural language processing. In this paper, we propose a Multi-layer Fusing Transformer model utilizing a cross attention module to combine multiple modality features of images and texts from different layers in an aggregated representation. Our architecture allows us extract information from low level to high level. Through detailed experiments and ablation studies, our model achieves promising results against the competitive baselines in ViVQA dataset for Vietnamese language.

</details>


### [114] [Not All Error Yields to Scale: Where Scaling Stops in Vision-Language Inference](https://arxiv.org/abs/2610.01640)
*Xinye Zhao,Yunkai Dang,Yunchen Wu,Wenbin Li*

Main category: cs.CV

TL;DR: 提出"可分离定律"，刻画VLM性能随语言骨干规模与视觉token数的变化，并据此在固定预算下给出骨干与视觉token的算力分配闭式规则。


<details>
  <summary>Details</summary>
Motivation: VLM在固定算力预算下存在"增加视觉信息以提升细粒度感知"与"扩大语言骨干以增强推理"的权衡，但现有研究未说明在高分辨率部署时应如何组合骨干规模与输入分辨率。

Method: 在26个InternVL和QwenVL模型上拟合该定律，骨干规模1B–72B，评测覆盖4个高分辨率基准、图像尺寸224像素至8K；并结合成本定律推导算力分配的闭式规则。

Result: 可扩展性问题可由其所需技能预测，但相当一部分问题完全不随规模改善；两个模型家族从更大骨干获得的收益相似，而从更多视觉token获得的收益差异显著。

Conclusion: 在受限于可用配置的部署场景中，该定律能识别出同预算下接近最优的模型与图像尺寸，为高分辨率下"该看多少、依据需推理什么"提供原则性决策方法。

Abstract: Vision-language models (VLMs) face a fixed-budget trade-off between processing more visual information for fine-grained perception and using a larger language backbone for complex reasoning. Existing studies do not tell us which combination of backbone size and input resolution to deploy, especially in high-resolution deployments. To address this gap, we propose the Separable Law that describes how VLM performance changes with language backbone size and visual token count. We fit the law to measurements from 26 InternVL and QwenVL models, with language backbone sizes from 1B to 72B, on four high-resolution benchmarks with image sizes from 224 pixels to 8K. We find that the questions responding to scaling can be predicted from the skill they require, while a substantial fraction never responds at all. We also find that the two model families gain similarly from a larger backbone, while their gains from more visual tokens differ sharply. Combined with a cost law, the Separable Law gives a closed-form rule for allocating compute between backbone size and visual tokens. When deployment is limited to available configurations, the law identifies model and image sizes that perform close to the best feasible choice under the same budget. We hope our work offers a principled way to decide how much a model should be allowed to see at high resolution, given what it must reason about.

</details>


### [115] [DiVid: Diagnosing Dimension-Specific Diversity Collapse in Video Generation Models](https://arxiv.org/abs/2610.01661)
*Huanran Hu,Zihui Ren,Dingyi Yang,Zhinan Song,Guozheng Wu,Tiezheng Ge,Qin Jin*

Main category: cs.CV

TL;DR: DiVid：将视频生成多样性分解为语义、风格、主体、场景、运动、镜头六个维度，用可复现CV流程量化，并结合质量与指令忠实度诊断多样性在时空中的崩溃位置与原因。


<details>
  <summary>Details</summary>
Motivation: 视频生成模型对同一提示重复采样时输出高度相似，限制创意探索；现有多样性评估依赖全局标量指标，掩盖了多样性在视频时空空间中崩塌的具体位置，无法定位是哪个因素、在何时失效。

Method: 提出DiVid维度级诊断框架：(1) 将多样性分解为语义、风格、主体、场景、运动、镜头六个可解释维度；(2) 每个维度通过可复现的计算机视觉流水线测量；(3) 将各维度多样性得分与质量、指令忠实度联合分析以考察权衡；(4) 在代表性模型上系统评测，并通过过滤不忠实生成、控制提示词干预（开放提示 vs. 显式多样性请求）来识别瓶颈。

Result: 多样性高度维度特异：全局多样性得分高的模型在特定因素上仍显著崩塌，尤其运动与镜头；过滤不忠实生成后排名依然保持，说明是真实能力差异而非离题输出；识别出两类瓶颈——默认模式收敛（开放提示下回落到主导模式）与实现鸿沟（无法忠实实现显式请求的多样替代，时间类因素尤甚）；时间因素的忠实度损失更大，表明仅靠文本控制运动与镜头变化困难。

Conclusion: DiVid把多样性研究从“是否存在”转向“在哪里、为什么崩塌”，为维度感知的训练目标与控制信号提供可操作方向，并开源框架以推动多样且可控的视频生成研究。

Abstract: Despite remarkable progress, video generation models often produce highly similar outputs when repeatedly sampled from the same prompt, limiting their usefulness for creative exploration. Existing diversity evaluations primarily rely on global scalar metrics, which obscure where diversity collapses in the spatiotemporal space of videos. We introduce DiVid, a dimension-level diagnostic framework that decomposes video generation diversity into six interpretable dimensions: Semantic, Style, Subject, Scene, Motion, and Camera. Each dimension is measured through a reproducible computer-vision pipeline and analyzed alongside quality and instruction faithfulness to examine potential trade-offs. Systematic evaluation of representative video generation models reveals that diversity is highly dimension-specific: models with strong global diversity scores still collapse on specific factors, particularly Motion and Camera. These rankings persist after filtering unfaithful generations, indicating genuine capability differences rather than off-prompt outputs. Beyond measurement, controlled prompt interventions identify two fundamental bottlenecks: default mode convergence, where models fall back to dominant patterns under open-ended prompts; and realization gaps, where models fail to faithfully realize diverse, explicitly requested alternatives, particularly for temporal factors. The larger faithfulness losses for temporal factors highlight the difficulty of controlling motion and camera variation through text alone. DiVid thus shifts the study of diversity from measuring whether it exists to diagnosing where and why it collapses, and provides actionable directions for dimension-aware training objectives and control signals. The framework will be released to facilitate future research on diverse and controllable video generation.

</details>


### [116] [Do MLLM Judges Judge the Edit? Auditing Bias in Image Editing Evaluation with Verified Quality Preservation](https://arxiv.org/abs/2610.01670)
*Yuan Huang,Zirui Song,Xiuying Chen*

Main category: cs.CV

TL;DR: 本文提出 EditJudgeBias，一个经质量保持验证的反事实基准（1,196 个真实编辑样本、4 个评估位点、13 类线索），用噪声底线（而非零）审计五个 MLLM 评判者的偏差，发现质量保持线索均将各评判者推离自身噪声范围，且鲁棒性无法用单一指标刻画。


<details>
  <summary>Details</summary>
Motivation: MLLM 被广泛用作指令式图像编辑的自动评判者与训练奖励信号，但其是否受与编辑质量无关的线索影响尚缺乏系统审计。核心困难在于视觉干预本身可能改变被评估的质量，只有当干预被验证保持原编辑质量时，判断偏移才能归因于偏差；此外偏移应对照评判者自身的噪声底线而非零进行比较。

Method: 构建 EditJudgeBias 反事实基准：1,196 个真实编辑样本、4 个评估位点注入 13 类线索；用校准的多模态验证器、对照与人工检查确认质量保持。随后从三个维度审计五个 MLLM 评判者：对质量保持线索的不变性、与人类判断的一致性、成对偏好的稳定性；并将观测偏移与各自的零剂量与重复查询噪声底线对比。

Result: 质量保持线索使每个评判者都超出自身噪声范围；伪造的多数意见提高评分；无关视觉元素造成的偏移大于整图操纵；交换候选顺序可逆转高达 60.9% 的成对决策；编辑区域线索倾向于降低与人类的一致性；三种度量对评判者的刻画各不相同。

Conclusion: MLLM 评判者对与编辑质量无关的线索普遍敏感，其判断偏移超出自身噪声底线，说明现有自动评判与奖励信号存在系统性偏差风险；鲁棒性是多维属性，不能由单一指标捕捉，需结合不变性、人类一致性与偏好稳定性综合评估。

Abstract: Multimodal large language models (MLLMs) are increasingly used as automated judges for instruction-based image editing and as reward signals for model training. However, systematically auditing whether these judges are influenced by cues irrelevant to editing quality is challenging because visual interventions may themselves alter the quality being evaluated. A judgment shift can therefore be attributed to bias only when the intervention is verified to preserve the underlying editing quality. To address this challenge, we introduce EditJudgeBias, a counterfactual benchmark with verified quality preservation, comprising 1,196 real editing samples and 13 cues injected across four evaluation sites. We verify quality preservation for the requested edit using calibrated multimodal validators, controls, and human inspection. We then audit five MLLM judges along three complementary dimensions: invariance to quality-preserving cues, agreement with human judgments, and stability of pairwise preferences. Importantly, observed shifts are evaluated against each judge's own zero-dose and re-query noise floors rather than against zero. Experiments show that quality-preserving cues move every judge beyond its own noise. Fabricated majority opinions increase ratings, irrelevant visual elements cause larger shifts than whole-image manipulations, and swapping candidate order reverses up to 60.9% of pairwise decisions. Edit-region cues also tend to reduce human agreement. The three measures characterize judges differently, showing that robustness cannot be captured by a single metric.

</details>


### [117] [When Text-to-Image Helps Editing: The Effects of Conditioning During Denoising](https://arxiv.org/abs/2610.01681)
*Lidia Troeshestova,Alexander Ustyuzhanin,Sergey Kastryulin*

Main category: cs.CV

TL;DR: 该研究提出"任务切换"策略：在统一图像编辑模型中，于去噪过程的有界区间内切换到T2I生成模式（放弃源图像条件），可在保持感知保真度接近纯编辑的同时提升编辑质量；切换时机决定质量与保持之间的平衡。


<details>
  <summary>Details</summary>
Motivation: 统一模型同时支持指令式图像编辑与文本到图像（T2I）生成，但标准编辑流程在整个去噪过程中始终保留源图像条件，未利用模型的T2I能力。作者希望探究条件作用如何随编辑类型和去噪阶段变化，以及编辑能否从T2I生成中获益。

Method: 观察到在纯编辑模式下，某些编辑的源注意力（source attention）会随采样轨迹下降，据此提出"任务切换"（task switching）：在去噪的有界区间内改为T2I任务，使模型调用其T2I能力。在三种统一编辑模型、四个基准上进行验证。

Result: 在三个统一编辑器和四个基准上，于有界区间切换到T2I任务均可提升编辑质量，且三个模型的平均感知保真度（perceptual preservation）与纯编辑相近。

Conclusion: 统一编辑模型能够同时受益于其所训练的双重条件模式；切换的时机决定了编辑质量与源图像保持之间的权衡。

Abstract: Unified models are trained for both instruction-based image editing and text-to-image (T2I) generation, but standard editing pipelines keep source-image conditioning throughout denoising. We ask whether editing can benefit from T2I, and study how the effects of conditioning vary across edits and denoising stages. In pure editing, source attention declines for some edits over the sampling trajectory. This observation led us to task switching, which lets the model draw on its T2I capabilities. Across three unified editors and four benchmarks, switching to the T2I task for bounded intervals improves edit quality, while mean perceptual preservation remains close to pure editing across all three models. Unified editors therefore benefit from using both conditioning modes they are trained for, and the timing of the switch sets the balance between quality and preservation.

</details>


### [118] [Architectural Sampling: Test-Time Scaling via Computational Diversity in Frozen Vision-Language Models](https://arxiv.org/abs/2610.01687)
*Akshit Singh,Shyam Marjit,Wei Lin,Leonid Karlinsky,M. Jehanzeb Mirza*

Main category: cs.CV

TL;DR: 提出免训练的"架构采样"(architectural sampling)，通过复用解码器层块生成不同前向计算路径的候选答案，在同等预算下显著提升pass@9，并利于无标签测试时强化学习。


<details>
  <summary>Details</summary>
Motivation: 传统温度采样在测试时扩展中让所有候选沿同一固定计算路径生成，候选多样性受限于采样随机性，难以充分覆盖答案空间。作者希望在冻结模型、不更新权重、不增加参数的条件下获得计算层面的多样性。

Method: 免训练方法：通过复用解码器中选定的层块（block）来构造不同前向计算路径，即变化层块的位置与重复次数，从而在不改动模型权重、不引入辅助参数的情况下生成多样候选。

Result: 在5个Qwen检查点和12个多模态基准上，相同9候选预算下pass@9较标准路径温度采样平均提升6.58个百分点；复用浅层收益最大；即使贪婪解码下候选覆盖率提升仍存在；候选词面重叠更低，并作为rollouts提升无标签测试时强化学习的准确率。

Conclusion: 架构采样将测试时扩展的收益从候选覆盖扩展到更有效的自输出学习，表明计算路径多样性是提升推理与测试时学习的重要维度。

Abstract: Test-time scaling often seeks better answers by sampling multiple responses from a frozen model, yet conventional temperature sampling generates every candidate along the same fixed computation path. We introduce architectural sampling, a training-free method that generates candidates through distinct forward computations by reusing selected blocks of decoder layers. Varying the block location and repetition count introduces computational diversity without updating model weights or adding auxiliary parameters. Across five Qwen checkpoints and twelve multimodal benchmarks, architectural sampling improves pass@9 over standard-path temperature sampling by 6.58 percentage points on average at the same nine-candidate budget. Reusing early layers yields the strongest gains, and the improvement in candidate coverage persists even under greedy decoding. The resulting candidates show lower lexical overlap and improve accuracy when used as rollouts for label-free test-time reinforcement learning. These findings extend the benefits of our architectural sampling beyond candidate coverage, demonstrating more effective learning from a model's own outputs.

</details>


### [119] [MEGA: Object-Level Mesh Extraction from 3D Gaussian Splatting via Spatial Visual Distillation](https://arxiv.org/abs/2610.01707)
*Liwei Liao,Yingkui Zhang,Qianqian Tong,Ronggang Wang*

Main category: cs.CV

TL;DR: MEGA是一个"先分割后网格化"框架，可从未经处理的3D高斯泼溅（3DGS）场景中提取物体级、水密（watertight）网格，通过空间视觉蒸馏与掩码引导的神经表面重建实现，达到SOTA的物体级三维占据精度。


<details>
  <summary>Details</summary>
Motivation: 现有3DGS网格提取方法主要面向场景级（scene-level），无法表示物体级占据（object-level occupancy），且常产生非水密表面，限制了其在几何精度与物理交互上的应用。

Method: 提出MEGA（Mesh Extraction from Gaussians），一种"segment-then-mesh"（先分割后网格化）框架。核心包含两部分：(1) 空间视觉蒸馏（Spatial Visual Distillation, SVD）：将3DGS模型作为教师，采样多样相机位姿并渲染每个已分割物体的对应视图；(2) 掩码引导的神经表面重建模块，利用上述观测通过光度监督训练网格重建模型。

Result: 在多个广泛使用的基准上实验表明，MEGA在恢复准确的物体级三维占据方面达到state-of-the-art性能；同时结合高质量物体级网格（几何占据）与3DGS表示（照片级渲染），可实现复杂的物理交互。

Conclusion: MEGA有效突破了3DGS网格提取在物体级与拓扑封闭性上的局限，为高质量物体级几何重建与可交互的3DGS场景应用提供了可行方案。

Abstract: Mesh extraction from 3D Gaussian Splatting (3DGS) aims to endow 3D Gaussians with accurate geometric structures, enabling explicit and precise 3D occupancy. However, existing methods primarily focus on scene-level mesh extraction, making them unable to represent object-level occupancy and often resulting in non-watertight surfaces. To overcome these limitations, we propose \textbf{MEGA} (\underline{M}esh \underline{E}xtraction from \underline{GA}ussians), a ``segment-then-mesh'' framework for extracting object-level, watertight meshes from complex 3DGS scenes. At the core of MEGA are \textbf{Spatial Visual Distillation (SVD)} and a mask-guided neural surface reconstruction module. SVD treats the 3DGS model as a teacher, sampling diverse camera poses and rendering the corresponding views of each segmented object. These observations are then used to train a mesh reconstruction model through photometric supervision. Extensive experiments on several widely used benchmarks demonstrate that MEGA achieves state-of-the-art performance in recovering accurate object-level 3D occupancy. Moreover, MEGA enables complex physical interactions by combining high-quality object-level meshes for geometric occupancy with 3DGS representations for photorealistic rendering.

</details>


### [120] [Rethinking Memorization Mitigation in Diffusion Models: Reinforcing Text Conditioning](https://arxiv.org/abs/2610.01723)
*Hyungjun Joo,Sehwan Kim,Hyeonggeun Han,Sangwoo Hong,Jungwoo Lee*

Main category: cs.CV

TL;DR: 该论文提出一种无需训练的文本到图像扩散模型去记忆方法，通过高斯平滑重分配交叉注意力、强化内容token并削弱padding贡献，在降低训练图像相似度的同时保持提示对齐与图像偏好。


<details>
  <summary>Details</summary>
Motivation: 文本到图像扩散模型虽合成能力出色，但会记忆并复现训练样本。现有缓解方法需在减少记忆的同时保留有效提示信息，以引导生成替代性描绘。

Method: 提出免训练方法：在强化内容token贡献、衰减padding贡献之前，使用高斯平滑重分配交叉注意力，且不增加额外的去噪器评估。局部分析表明，强化在保持共享value信息的同时，重分配降低了局部注意力质量。

Result: 在Stable Diffusion v1.4与v2.0上，所有评估的平滑宽度均位于训练图像相似度对提示对齐及图像偏好的经验帕累托前沿上；在SD上选定的配置在未进一步调参的情况下减少了DeepFloyd IF中的模板复现。

Conclusion: 结果表明，联合控制条件分配与强度可生成与提示一致的替代性图像，为缓解记忆提供了有效途径。

Abstract: Text-to-image diffusion models have achieved remarkable progress in image synthesis, yet can exhibit memorization by closely reproducing individual training examples. Effective mitigation must preserve useful prompt information to guide alternative depictions. We introduce a training-free method that redistributes cross-attention with Gaussian smoothing before reinforcing content-token contributions and attenuating padding contributions, without additional denoiser evaluations. With this intervention, stronger content conditioning can improve prompt alignment at comparable training-image similarity. A local analysis identifies when reinforcement preserves shared value information while redistribution reduces localized attention mass. On Stable Diffusion v1.4 and v2.0, all evaluated smoothing widths lie on the empirical Pareto frontiers for training-image similarity versus both prompt alignment and image preference. A configuration selected on Stable Diffusion reduces template reproduction in DeepFloyd IF without further tuning. These findings support jointly controlling conditioning allocation and strength to generate prompt-consistent alternatives.

</details>


### [121] [ATI-VLA: Action-Centric Predictive Vision-Language-Action Models via Actionable Alignment Then Adaptive Injection](https://arxiv.org/abs/2610.01741)
*Yijie Zhu,Rui Shao,Jie He,Wei Li,Bo Zhao,Yelin Wang,Xiaochen Yuan,Tao Tan,Miao Zhang,Xiaojiang Peng,Zitong Yu*

Main category: cs.CV

TL;DR: 提出ATI-VLA框架，通过"可操作性对齐—自适应注入"两步设计解决预测式VLA模型中的模态失配与联合优化冲突问题，在仿真与真实机器人任务上取得SOTA性能并加快收敛。


<details>
  <summary>Details</summary>
Motivation: 预测式视觉-语言-动作（VLA）模型旨在通过预测未来观测或世界动态来提升机器人操作性能，但现有方法往往未能实现这一潜力，甚至不如直接动作预测模型。作者认为其根本原因在于：观测与动作之间存在模态失配，以及联合优化冲突使学习偏离以动作为中心的优化目标。

Method: ATI-VLA采用两步设计：(1) 基于共享码本的可操作表征对齐——通过统一码本将预测观测与动作表征映射到共享离散隐空间，使预测观测隐变量可直接用于动作生成，缓解模态失配；(2) 以动作为中心的自适应预测隐变量注入——在(1)的基础上，通过轻量级自适应侧通路将预测观测隐变量作为显式预测先验注入动作解码过程，在单一以动作为中心的目标下实现自适应预测引导。

Result: 在仿真和真实世界机器人任务上的大量实验表明，ATI-VLA达到最先进（state-of-the-art）性能，并具有更快的收敛速度。

Conclusion: 通过共享码本对齐观测与动作表征、并以自适应侧通路注入预测隐变量，可在单一动作中心目标下有效利用预测信息，缓解模态失配与优化冲突，从而优于现有预测式VLA及直接动作预测方法。

Abstract: Predictive Vision-Language-Action (VLA) models aim to improve robotic manipulation via future observation or world dynamics forecasting. However, existing approaches often fail to realize this potential and underperform direct action prediction models. We argue that these limitations stem from modality misalignment between observations and actions, together with joint optimization conflicts that drive learning away from an action-centric objective. To this end, we introduce ATI-VLA, an Action-Centric Predictive Vision-Language-Action framework via Actionable Alignment Then Adaptive Injection. Specifically, it follows a two-step design: 1) Actionable Representation Alignment via a Shared Codebook. It aligns predictive observation and action representations by mapping both modalities into a shared discrete latent space via a unified codebook, making predictive observation latents readily usable for action generation and mitigating modality misalignment. 2) Action-Centric Adaptive Injection of Predictive Latents. Building upon this, it then injects predictive observation latents into action decoding as explicit predictive priors via a lightweight adaptive side-path, enabling adaptive predictive guidance under a single action-centric objective. Extensive experiments on both simulation and real-world robotic tasks demonstrate that ATI-VLA achieves state-of-the-art performance with faster convergence.

</details>


### [122] [3DROID: A Renderable 3D Gaussian Dataset with Measured Per-Scene Reliability](https://arxiv.org/abs/2610.01744)
*Wonguen Cho,Junhoo Lee,Nojun Kwak*

Main category: cs.CV

TL;DR: 本文研究外参可靠性与位姿条件对前馈3DGS的影响，提出标定感知流程将重建场景锚定到机器人度量工作空间，并发布可渲染的度量位姿锚定数据集3DROID。


<details>
  <summary>Details</summary>
Motivation: 机器人操作模型主要在2D观测下推理却在3D物理世界中动作，现有工作用深度、点云、3D轨迹等几何先验弥补这一差距，而可渲染的3D高斯表示提供了另一类3D监督。但3DGS主要为光度保真设计，在外参不可靠时可能无法保持真实世界度量尺度，因此需要研究外参可靠性与位姿条件的影响。

Method: 研究外参可靠性和位姿条件对前馈3DGS的影响，提出一种标定感知（calibration-aware）流程，将重建场景锚定到机器人的度量工作空间。

Result: 实验表明位姿条件提升了新视角保真度，但其几何收益取决于注入外参的可靠性；基于该流程构建了带有场景级可靠性信息的可渲染、度量位姿锚定数据集。

Conclusion: 面向机器人操作研究，作者发布了可渲染、度量位姿锚定的数据集，并提供场景级可靠性信息，数据集地址为 https://huggingface.co/datasets/wonguen/3DROID。

Abstract: Robot manipulation models primarily reason from 2D observations while acting in the 3D physical world. To bridge this gap, recent work has augmented robot data with geometric priors such as depth, point clouds, and 3D trajectories, while renderable 3D Gaussian representations provide another promising form of 3D supervision. However, 3DGS representation is designed mainly for photometric fidelity and may not preserve real-world metric scale, particularly when the supplied camera extrinsics are unreliable. We study the effect of extrinsic reliability and pose conditioning on feed-forward 3DGS, and propose a calibration-aware pipeline that anchors reconstructed scenes to the robot's metric workspace. Our experiments show that pose conditioning improves novel-view fidelity, while its geometric benefit depends on the reliability of the injected extrinsics. Using this pipeline, we present a renderable, metric-pose-anchored dataset with scene-level reliability information for robot manipulation research. Our dataset is available at https://huggingface.co/datasets/wonguen/3DROID

</details>


### [123] [FFBL-Coop: Association-Decoupled Cooperative 3D Multi-Object Tracking](https://arxiv.org/abs/2610.01750)
*Haoxin Wu,Xiaokai Bai*

Main category: cs.CV

TL;DR: 提出 FFBL-Coop 框架，将实例准入与身份管理解耦，先融合后绑定，实现协同 3D 跟踪。


<details>
  <summary>Details</summary>
Motivation: 协同 3D 跟踪需跨智能体与时序整合互补观测并保持身份一致。当证据融合与身份继承共用同一匹配决策时，跨视角外观差异与空间错位会同时破坏特征融合与轨迹连续性。

Method: FFBL-Coop 采用"先融合、后绑定"结构：CSA 依据置信度与空间邻近性将协同查询分配到可用 ego 槽位；URA 以协同语义特征与对齐锚点引导 ego 特征检索，在共享 Transformer 解码器中精炼增强查询库；随后 CPIA 结合学习关联与持久映射，跨帧建立被接受的身份分配；共享码本降低传输负载。

Result: 在 V2X-Seq 上 AMOTA/AP 达 0.611/0.548，在 Griffin-25M 上达 0.688/0.653；共享码本在降低传输数据量的同时，AP 与 AMOTA 接近未压缩版本。

Conclusion: 通过解耦实例准入与身份管理，FFBL-Coop 有效缓解跨视角外观差异与空间错位带来的融合与关联误差，在协同 3D 跟踪精度与通信效率间取得良好平衡。代码将开源。

Abstract: Cooperative 3D tracking must integrate complementary observations across agents and time while maintaining consistent identities. When evidence integration and identity inheritance share a matching decision, errors arising from cross-view appearance differences and spatial misalignment can compromise both feature fusion and track continuity. We propose FFBL-Coop, a fuse first, bind later framework that separates instance admission from identity management. Confidence-ranked Slot Admission (CSA) allocates cooperative queries to available ego slots using confidence and spatial proximity. Unified Representation Aggregation (URA) uses cooperative semantic features and aligned anchors to guide ego-feature retrieval, refining the augmented query bank within a shared transformer decoder. After refinement, Cooperative-Priority Identity Anchoring (CPIA) combines learned association with persistent mappings to establish accepted identity assignments across frames. A shared codebook reduces transmitted payload while retaining AP and AMOTA close to the uncompressed variant. FFBL-Coop achieves AMOTA/AP of 0.611/0.548 on V2X-Seq and 0.688/0.653 on Griffin-25M. Code will be released.

</details>


### [124] [Cog-VADU: A Training-Free Cognitive Reasoning Framework for Video Anomaly Detection and Understanding](https://arxiv.org/abs/2610.01754)
*Mohd Ubaid Wani,Sara Atito,Josef Kittler,Muhammad Awais*

Main category: cs.CV

TL;DR: 提出完全免训练框架 Cog-VADU，将视频异常检测重构为顺序认知推理任务，通过链式提示与跨模态重排序实现零样本检测。


<details>
  <summary>Details</summary>
Motivation: 现有 VAD 方法多依赖数据集专属训练与人工标注，难以在开放场景中泛化；近期基于大型视觉语言模型（LVLM）的零样本方法虽缓解了该依赖，但普遍缺乏时间连续性与结构化推理能力。

Method: Cog-VADU 将 VAD 重构为顺序认知推理任务，包含两个核心组件：(1) Chain-of-Anomaly Detection Thought Prompting (CoADTP)，将 LVLM 展开为跨视频片段的循环推理链，通过随时间传播结构化推理依据维持隐式时间记忆，以区分复杂异常与高运动正常活动；(2) 跨模态重排序阶段，将文本推理依据与视觉嵌入对齐，强化语义一致性与时间连贯性，获得精炼稳定的预测。

Result: 在多个公开 VAD 基准上的大量实验表明，Cog-VADU 取得了有竞争力的零样本性能；跨模型评估显示 CoADTP 以模型无关的方式持续提升基于推理的异常检测效果。

Conclusion: Cog-VADU 为真实应用提供了可解释、可泛化的异常理解能力，验证了推理链式提示在零样本视频异常检测中的有效性与通用性。

Abstract: Video Anomaly Detection (VAD) aims to temporally localize abnormal events in videos. Most existing approaches rely on dataset-specific training and curated annotations, limiting generalization in open-set scenarios. Recent zero-shot methods based on Large Vision- Language Models (LVLMs) alleviate this dependency but often lack temporal continuity and structured reasoning. We propose Cog-VADU, a fully training-free framework that reformulates VAD as a sequential cognitive reasoning task. Cog-VADU introduces Chain-of- Anomaly Detection Thought Prompting (CoADTP), which unrolls an LVLM into a recurrent reasoning chain across video segments. By propagating structured rationales over time, the model maintains implicit temporal memory, enabling robust discrimination between com- plex anomalies and high-motion normal activities. To improve reliability, we further design a cross-modal re-ranking stage that aligns textual rationales with visual embeddings, enforcing semantic consistency and temporal coherence for refined and stable predictions. Extensive experiments on multiple public VAD benchmarks demonstrate that Cog-VADU achieves competitive zero-shot performance. Moreover, cross-model evaluations show that CoADTP consistently enhances reasoning-based anomaly detection in a model-agnostic manner, pro- viding interpretable and generalizable anomaly understanding for real-world applications.

</details>


### [125] [GenCOPE: Syn2Real Generalized Category-Level Object Pose Estimation for Robotic Picking](https://arxiv.org/abs/2610.01758)
*Jian Liu,Wei Sun,Zhenqi Dai,Hui Yang,Jian Xiao,Nicu Sebe,Na Zhao*

Main category: cs.CV

TL;DR: 该论文提出GenCOPE，实现仅用合成数据训练、直接泛化到真实场景的类别级物体位姿估计（Syn2Real COPE）。通过2D/3D语义一致性约束学习域不变表示，并采用基于全局特征的轻量端到端回归框架完成2D-3D交叉一致性学习。在REAL275、Wild6D及真实机器人操作场景上展现出优越的泛化性能。


<details>
  <summary>Details</summary>
Motivation: 现有类别级物体位姿估计（COPE）方法在面对新物体类别时，仍需耗费大量人力重新采集真实训练数据，可扩展性受限。本文希望实现合成到真实的泛化：模型仅在渲染的合成数据上训练，即可直接部署到真实世界。其核心挑战在于合成数据与真实数据之间存在显著的域间隙，尤其体现在纹理外观上。

Method: 1) 通过域泛化学习域不变表示，捕捉同类别物体间的语义共性；2) 引入2D与3D语义一致性约束，降低特征编码器对域特有特征的敏感性；3) 提出端到端位姿回归框架，进行2D-3D交叉一致性学习，利用密集跨模态融合进一步精炼位姿估计；4) 模型仅使用全局特征，结构轻量高效，便于真实机器人部署。

Result: 在REAL275和Wild6D基准以及真实机器人操作场景上的大量实验表明，该范式具有更优的Syn2Real泛化性能。代码与演示已发布于 https://paperreview99.github.io/GenCOPE/。

Conclusion: 本文证明了仅依赖合成数据训练即可实现泛化的类别级物体位姿估计，通过语义一致性约束与跨模态一致性学习有效缓解合成-真实域间隙，且轻量架构适合实际机器人部署，为可扩展的COPE提供了新范式。

Abstract: Category-level object pose estimation (COPE), capable of generalizing to intra-class unknown objects, has become a core technique for robotic 3D scene understanding. However, existing COPE methods still require labor-intensive recollection of real-world training data for novel object categories, which limits their scalability in practical applications. This paper aims to achieve synthetic-to-real (Syn2Real) generalized COPE, where a model is trained solely on rendered synthetic data and directly generalized to real-world deployments. The central challenge lies in the significant domain gap between synthetic and real-world data, particularly in texture appearance. To address this, we aim to enhance domain generalization by learning domain-invariant representations that capture semantic commonalities among objects within the same category. We introduce 2D and 3D semantic consistency constraints to reduce the sensitivity of feature encoders to domain-specific features. In addition, we propose an end-to-end pose regression framework that performs 2D-3D cross consistency learning, leveraging dense cross-modality fusion to further refine pose estimation. Since simplicity and effectiveness are essential for real-world robotic deployment, our model operates exclusively on global features, yielding a highly lightweight and efficient architecture. Extensive experiments on the REAL275 and Wild6D benchmarks, as well as real-world robotic manipulation scenes, show superior Syn2Real generalization performance of our paradigm. Code and demos are released at https://paperreview99.github.io/GenCOPE/.

</details>


### [126] [PhysDEM: Physics-Defined Energy-Matching Diffusion for Spatiotemporal Field Generation under Scarce Measurements](https://arxiv.org/abs/2610.01759)
*Zhenyu Liang,Yining Huang,Yubo Zhao,Jack C. P. Cheng*

Main category: cs.CV

TL;DR: PhysDEM 提出一种物理定义的扩散框架，通过将偏微分方程残差能量融入以稀疏观测为条件的高斯参考分布构建 Gibbs 目标，并推导条件均值恒等式与物理位移概率流，实现无需全字段数据集、无需重训练的可摊销时空场生成与推断。


<details>
  <summary>Details</summary>
Motivation: 从稀缺测量中生成和预测时空物理场十分困难：观测不足以刻画完整场的分布，导致依赖全字段数据集的传统数据驱动扩散模型难以适用。作者希望在不预先采集完整场数据的前提下，结合物理方程与稀疏观测生成多个合理的场。

Method: 1) 构建 Gibbs 目标：用 PDE 残差能量对以测量为条件的高斯参考分布进行重加权；2) 推导精确的条件均值恒等式，将去噪过程约化为对标准化能量诱导均值修正的监督学习；3) 引入物理位移概率流，抵消高斯参考项，并借助高斯条件化在测量变化时实现可摊销采样、无需重训练。

Result: 在合成 PDE 系统与真实场景启发的应用中，PhysDEM 支持连贯的场恢复与高效采样，并在所测试的噪声水平下保持稳定的诊断性能，体现出其在场评估中的实用价值。据作者所知，PhysDEM 是首个无需预组装全字段数据集即可实现可摊销时空场推断的物理定义扩散模型。

Conclusion: PhysDEM 通过将控制方程与稀疏观测耦合进扩散生成框架，绕开了对全字段训练数据的依赖，并支持随测量变化而免重训练的可摊销推断，为稀缺测量下的时空物理场生成与评估提供了新范式。

Abstract: Generating and predicting spatiotemporal physical fields from scarce measurements is challenging, as observations are insufficient to characterize a distribution over complete fields. This limits conventional data-driven diffusion models that rely on full-field datasets. We introduce PhysDEM, a physics-defined diffusion framework that combines governing equations with spatially sparse observations to generate multiple plausible fields. First, we construct a Gibbs target by reweighting a measurement-conditioned Gaussian reference with PDE residual energy. Second, we derive an exact conditional-mean identity that reduces denoising to supervised learning of the standardized energy-induced mean correction. Third, a physics-displacement probability flow cancels Gaussian reference terms and enables amortized sampling with changing measurements through Gaussian conditioning, without retraining. Experiments on synthetic PDE systems and real-world-informed applications demonstrate that PhysDEM supports coherent field recovery and efficient sampling while maintaining stable diagnostics under tested noise levels, illustrating its practical value for field assessment. To our knowledge, PhysDEM is the first physics-defined diffusion model enabling amortized spatiotemporal field inference without preassembled full-field datasets.

</details>


### [127] [OneStreamer: Unifying Perception, Memory, and Proactive Response in Streaming Video Interaction](https://arxiv.org/abs/2610.01762)
*Xiangyu Zeng,Yuandong Yang,Zhiqiu Zhang,Yuhan Zhu,Xinhao Li,Qingyi Si,Dingyu Yao,Changlian Ma,Haoran Chen,Xinyu Chen,Yansong Shi,Junhao Zhou,Yifei Li,Jun Zhang,Chuanyu Qin,Chenxu Yang,Xinlei Yu,Kun Ouyang,Yuchen Shao,Qianshan Wei,Changhai Zhou,Jun Gao,Jiaqi Wang,Limin Wang*

Main category: cs.CV

TL;DR: 提出 OneStreamer，通过共享的主动生成过程，联合学习查询无关的证据记录与任务响应，构建可复用的事实记忆而不损害实时感知，在八个流媒体视频理解基准上取得最优结果。


<details>
  <summary>Details</summary>
Motivation: 流媒体视频 LLM 需要在证据与未来任务的相关性尚未明确时先保留证据，并在证据充分时及时响应。核心挑战在于：如何在不牺牲实时感知的前提下，形成可复用的事实记忆。

Method: 1) 主动分层字幕记忆（PHCM）：生成带时间锚定的局部细节字幕与已完成事件的摘要，训练时以流式字幕目标监督对已观测视频前缀的解读；推理时用模型生成的记录补充近期视觉窗口，避免重访历史视觉特征。2) 主动状态转移学习（PSTL）：在所有输出锚点保留监督，并选取代表性的状态变化与状态持续 token，缓解重复等待状态的主导问题。3) 流式数据合成流水线：使输出内容与时序与可用证据对齐，结合流式字幕、QA 及清洗后的开源数据，构建 OneStreamer-1M 数据集（超百万条、覆盖多样任务）。

Result: 4B 模型在所有八个评测的流媒体视频理解基准上优于所对比方法。消融实验表明：保留生成字幕可提升历史 QA 且不降低实时感知；PSTL 仅监督 27.5% 的标注状态 token，效果仍优于稠密状态监督。

Conclusion: 结果表明，主动生成可作为共享学习接口，将感知、记忆形成与及时响应连接起来，支撑流媒体视频交互。

Abstract: Streaming video LLMs must retain evidence before its relevance to future tasks is known and respond when sufficient evidence becomes available. The challenge is to form reusable factual memory without compromising real-time perception. We introduce OneStreamer, which jointly learns query-independent evidence recording and task response through a shared proactive generation process. Its Proactive Hierarchical Caption Memory (PHCM) produces time-grounded local-detail captions and summaries of completed events. Streaming caption targets supervise the interpretation of observed video prefixes during training. At inference, model-generated records complement a recent visual window, providing reusable factual context without revisiting historical visual features. Proactive State Transition Learning (PSTL) reduces the dominance of repeated waiting states by preserving supervision at all output anchors and selecting representative state-change and state-persistence tokens. We further develop a streaming data synthesis pipeline that aligns output content and timing with available evidence. Combining the resulting streaming captions and QA with cleaned open-source data yields OneStreamer-1M, a broad-coverage streaming video interaction dataset with over one million records spanning diverse tasks. Our 4B model achieves the best results among the compared methods across all eight evaluated streaming video understanding benchmarks. Ablations show that retaining generated captions improves historical QA without degrading real-time perception. PSTL also outperforms dense state supervision while supervising only 27.5% of annotated state tokens. Together, these results support proactive generation as a shared learning interface connecting perception, memory formation, and timely response in streaming video interaction.

</details>


### [128] [GIFTBench: Diagnosing Generalization in Image Forgery Localization and Informing Model Design](https://arxiv.org/abs/2610.01778)
*Baoke Dou,Ziye Wang,Hao Wang,Guoqing Cai,Wende Tan,Chenyang Si,Liucheng Guo,Yueming Lyu*

Main category: cs.CV

TL;DR: 本文提出GIFTBench——一个包含115,013张篡改图像、像素级标注的多轴图像伪造定位基准，涵盖篡改来源、语义目标、编辑操作与合成复杂度四个维度；并基于其诊断发现开发了ForenScope框架。


<details>
  <summary>Details</summary>
Motivation: 现有图像伪造定位（IFL）基准覆盖的篡改条件有限，或在跨数据集评估中混淆多个因素，导致聚合性能无法完整反映定位泛化能力，因此亟需多轴、解耦的评估基准。

Method: 构建GIFTBench多轴基准，支持单轴迁移分析与12个外部数据集评估，并进行诊断研究；利用其大规模多样性作为训练资源；基于诊断发现设计ForenScope框架，融合分类适配表征、多深度多尺度空间特征、学习式层级融合与选择性粗尺度条件化。

Result: 诊断研究揭示跨来源迁移的非对称性、以召回为主导的失败模式，以及语义、操作与合成变化下的异质退化；在GIFTBench上训练的定位器对外部数据集的聚合迁移性能持续提升；ForenScope在保持图像级检测能力的同时改善了跨数据集定位性能。

Conclusion: GIFTBench既是评估工具也是有效的跨域训练资源，其诊断结论可指导新方法设计，ForenScope验证了这一范式在跨数据集定位上的有效性。

Abstract: Reliable evaluation of image forgery localization (IFL) requires assessing models under diverse distribution changes, yet existing benchmarks often cover limited manipulation conditions or entangle multiple factors in cross-dataset evaluation. Consequently, aggregate performance provides an incomplete view of localization generalization. We introduce GIFTBench, a multi-axis benchmark of 115,013 manipulated images with pixel-level annotations spanning manipulation source, semantic target, editing operation, and composition complexity. GIFTBench supports axis-specific transfer analysis and evaluation on twelve external datasets. Its diagnostic studies reveal asymmetric cross-source transfer, recall-dominated failures, and heterogeneous degradation across semantic, operational, and compositional changes. Beyond diagnosis, the scale and diversity of GIFTBench provide a substantially broader training distribution than conventional IFL datasets.
