# cs.SD [[Back]](#toc)

### [286] [High-Value Synthetic Supervision for Parameter-Efficient Adaptation of a Compact Japanese Speech Model](https://arxiv.org/abs/2610.00026)
*Sidi Chang,Peiying Zhu*

Main category: cs.SD

TL;DR: 该研究提出一条可审计的合成数据流水线，将日語护理交接语音直接映射为六字段结构化笔记，并在182段合成语音上对1.47B音频模型进行全量微调与rank-16 LoRA适配。在39段场景种子互斥的合成测试集上，未适配模型的事实召回模型评分为0.0500，全量微调为0.8664，LoRA为0.8461；LoRA以约12.4M可训练参数（约0.85%）达到全量微调聚合指标的97.7%。


<details>
  <summary>Details</summary>
Motivation: 私有领域语音难以采集与再分发，而紧凑模型又需要任务特定监督。研究动机在于探索能否通过可审计的合成流水线，以少量溯源关联的合成样本让紧凑音频模型获得狭窄的"音频到结构化文本"转换能力，从而规避真实隐私语音的使用障碍。

Method: 构建可审计的合成流水线，将日语护理交接语音直接映射为六字段结构化笔记；使用182段合成训练与开发音频片段，对1.47B音频模型分别进行全量微调和rank-16 LoRA适配；在39段场景-种子互斥的合成测试集上评估，采用模型-judge的事实性召回评分作为指标，并记录可训练参数量等工程遥测数据。

Result: 未适配模型的事实召回模型评分为0.0500，全量微调为0.8664，LoRA为0.8461；LoRA以描述性比率达到全量微调聚合指标的97.7%，可训练参数约12.4M，约占骨干网络的0.85%。两种适配相对同一基线均显示较大配对增益；全量微调与LoRA的置信区间跨越零，且优化设置不同，故无法主张二者等价。论文未测量延迟、内存、能耗与实时因子，因此这是参数高效的能力获取结果，而非设备性能结果。所有评估语音与目标均为合成，参考为模型生成，评判器未校准。

Conclusion: 证据表明紧凑模型可从数百条溯源关联的合成样本中习得狭窄的音频到结构化转换能力，但该结论不构成临床有效性、真实语音迁移能力或优于洁净云端系统的证明。合成数据、模型生成的参考与未校准评判器等限制意味着结果应被谨慎解读，后续需在真实语音与临床场景中进一步验证。

Abstract: Private domain speech is difficult to collect and redistribute, while compact models need task-specific supervision. We study an auditable synthetic pipeline that maps Japanese care handoffs directly to six-field structured notes. Using 182 synthetic training and development clips, we adapt a 1.47B audio model by full fine-tuning and rank-16 LoRA. On a 39-clip scenario-seed-disjoint synthetic test, an unadapted model obtains a model-judged factuality-recall score of 0.0500, full tuning 0.8664, and LoRA 0.8461. LoRA reaches 97.7% of the full-tuning aggregate as a descriptive ratio while project telemetry reports 12.4M trainable parameters, about 0.85% of the backbone. Both adaptations show large paired gains over the same base; the full-versus-LoRA interval crosses zero, and differing optimization settings preclude an equivalence claim. This is a parameter-efficient capability-acquisition result, not a device-performance result: latency, memory, energy, and real-time factor were not measured. All evaluation speech and targets are synthetic, references are model-proposed, and the judge is uncalibrated. The evidence shows that a compact model can acquire a narrow audio-to-structure transformation from a few hundred provenance-linked synthetic examples; it does not establish clinical validity, real-speech transfer, or superiority to a clean cloud system.

</details>


### [287] [How Robust Are Neural Audio Codecs for African Speech? A Multi-Task Benchmark and the Limits of Perceptual Quality](https://arxiv.org/abs/2610.00154)
*Chibuzor Okocha,Christan Earl Grant*

Main category: cs.SD

TL;DR: 该论文对七种开源神经音频编解码器在三种非洲语音数据集上进行基准评测，从信号级质量与ASR/ASV下游任务两方面分析其鲁棒性，并提出四项发现。


<details>
  <summary>Details</summary>
Motivation: 神经音频编解码器已能实现低码率语音压缩与token化，但其在带口音及多语言语音上的鲁棒性仍缺乏系统评估，尤其是面向非洲语言等低资源场景的包容性部署需求。

Method: 选取DAC、EnCodec、FocalCodec、LanguageCodec、SemantiCodec、UniCodec、WavTokenizer七种开源编解码器，在afrinames、afrispeech dialog、afrispeech multilingual三个非洲语音数据集上评测；信号级指标包括NISQA、UTMOS、ViSQOL、STOI、F0-RMSE，同时评估ASR与ASV两项下游任务；并采用LoRA进行参数高效编解码器适配（约1–3%参数，约35小时非洲语音）。

Result: 四项发现：①基于参考的结构/可懂度指标（ViSQOL、STOI）与韵律误差（F0-RMSE）比神经MOS预测器（NISQA、UTMOS）更能可靠反映ASR/ASV退化；②可懂度与说话人身份保持在不同架构间差异显著，身份排序本身依赖ASV后端；③退化强烈依赖领域，在对话式语音中最大；④退化部分可恢复，LoRA适配可缩小压缩导致的词错误率差距，使识别性能接近未压缩基线。

Conclusion: 结果说明语音编解码器的评测应面向任务、具有领域代表性并考虑适配性，这是实现包容性部署的前提。

Abstract: Neural audio codecs enable low-bitrate speech compression and tokenization, yet their robustness on accented and multilingual speech remains under-evaluated. We benchmark seven open-source neural codecs (DAC, EnCodec, FocalCodec, LanguageCodec, SemantiCodec, UniCodec, WavTokenizer) on three African speech datasets afrinames, afrispeech dialog, afrispeech multilingual, reporting signal-level quality (NISQA, UTMOS, ViSQOL, STOI, F0-RMSE) alongside two downstream tasks: automatic speech recognition (ASR) and speaker verification (ASV). Our analysis yields four findings. First, signal metrics differ sharply in downstream validity: reference-based structural/intelligibility measures (ViSQOL, STOI) and prosodic error (F0-RMSE) track ASR and ASV degradation far more reliably than neural mean-opinion-score predictors (NISQA, UTMOS). Second, intelligibility and speaker-identity preservation diverge sharply across architectures, and the apparent identity ranking itself depends on the ASV backend. Third, degradation is strongly domain-dependent and largest for conversational dialog. Fourth, the resulting degradation is partly recoverable: parameter-efficient \emph{codec} adaptation (LoRA, $\sim$1--3\% of parameters) on roughly 35 hours of African speech reduces the compression-induced word-error-rate gap, recovering recognition toward the uncompressed baseline (developed in companion work). These results motivate task-aware, domain-representative, and adaptation-aware evaluation of speech codecs as a prerequisite for inclusive deployment.

</details>


### [288] [Q-SPT: Learnable Query-Based Compression for Low-Frame-Rate Speech Tokenization](https://arxiv.org/abs/2610.01492)
*Jeeyoung Yun,Seohwan Yun,Sungwoong Kim*

Main category: cs.SD

TL;DR: Q-SPT是一种低帧率双流语音分词器，通过可学习的查询式压缩器分别对语义和声学表示进行上下文感知压缩，在相同帧率下取得最优重建效果，并在下游SLM中提升语音识别准确率和TTS感知质量。


<details>
  <summary>Details</summary>
Motivation: 神经语音编解码器正成为语音语言模型（SLM）的分词器。降低帧率可减少SLM的计算与内存开销，但难以同时保留语言信息和声学细节。现有方法依赖规则化压缩：平均池化会丢弃语言信息，而基于相似度的合并使用相邻帧相似度的固定阈值，并将所得边界直接应用于声学流，缺乏灵活性与针对性。

Method: 提出Q-SPT，一种低帧率双流语音分词器，为语义和声学表示分别配备独立的、上下文感知的、可学习的查询式压缩器。固定速率的查询分别作为独立的键值源对语义流和声学流进行注意力聚合，通过两个分别学习的压缩器实现流特定的上下文感知聚合；同时引入自回归文本损失，显式监督语义压缩器以保留语言信息。

Result: 在相同帧率下，Q-SPT在所评估的编解码器中取得最佳重建效果。在下游SLM中，取得最佳语音识别准确率和文本到语音（TTS）感知质量，并具有具竞争力的可懂度。

Conclusion: Q-SPT通过可学习的查询式双流压缩替代规则化压缩，在低帧率下兼顾语言信息与声学细节，验证了流特定、上下文感知压缩在语音分词与下游SLM任务中的有效性。

Abstract: Neural speech codecs increasingly serve as tokenizers for speech language models (SLMs). Lowering the frame rate reduces the computational and memory costs of SLMs, but makes it difficult to preserve both linguistic information and acoustic detail. Existing approaches rely on rule-based compression: average pooling can discard linguistic information, whereas similarity-based merging uses a fixed threshold on adjacent-frame similarity and applies the resulting boundaries to the acoustic stream. We propose Q-SPT, a low-frame-rate dual-stream speech tokenizer with separate, context-aware, learnable query-based compressors specialized for semantic and acoustic representations. In particular, queries at a fixed rate independently attend to the semantic and acoustic streams as separate key-value sources, enabling stream-specific, context-aware aggregation through two separately learned compressors. In addition, an autoregressive text loss explicitly supervises the semantic compressor to preserve linguistic information. Experimental results show that Q-SPT achieves the best reconstruction among the evaluated codecs at the same frame rate. In downstream SLMs, it yields the best speech recognition accuracy and text-to-speech perceptual quality with competitive intelligibility.

</details>


### [289] [Beyond Decodability: Do Acoustic Factors Drive Predictions in Speech-Based Alzheimer's Assessment?](https://arxiv.org/abs/2610.01846)
*Serli Kopar,Alkis Koudounas,Roshan P. Rane,Sam Gijsen,Paula A. Perez-Toro,Kerstin Ritter*

Main category: cs.SD

TL;DR: 该研究通过受控噪声与混响干预，证明自监督语音表征中的录音因素不仅被编码，还会系统性地改变阿尔茨海默病预测，且预测性能高或因组间无显著差异并不能保证鲁棒性。


<details>
  <summary>Details</summary>
Motivation: 基于语音的阿尔茨海默病（AD）评估日益依赖自监督学习（SSL）模型直接从原始音频学习声学表征，这使模型暴露于录音因素。作者希望厘清这些录音因素究竟只是被编码在SSL表征中，还是能够系统性地改变AD预测，从而评估临床语音模型的可靠性。

Method: 使用ADReSSo数据集和三个大型SSL骨干网络，对仅参与者语音、非语音及完整录音施加受控噪声与混响干预；结合逐层线性解码、输入空间与表征空间干预，以及几何对齐分析，区分声学可解码性与对AD预测的实际影响。

Result: 受控声学干预在三个SSL骨干网络上均改变了AD预测；噪声在原始数据中虽无显著诊断组间差异，却产生最强的干预效应；这些效应相对分类器决策方向呈现系统性结构，在留出测试集上可复现，且在反转表征空间干预方向时随之反转。

Conclusion: 高预测性能以及某一实测声学因素缺乏显著诊断组间差异，都不足以保证鲁棒性；作者主张将基于干预的鲁棒性测试作为可信临床语音模型的标准流程。

Abstract: Speech-based Alzheimer's disease (AD) assessments increasingly rely on pretrained self-supervised learning (SSL) models that learn acoustic representations directly from raw audio, exposing the model to recording factors. We ask whether such factors are merely encoded in SSL representations or can systematically alter predictions. Using ADReSSo and three large SSL backbones, we apply controlled noise and reverberation interventions to participant-speech-only, non-speech, and full-recording audio. We combine layer-wise linear decoding, input- and representation-space interventions, and geometric alignment analysis to distinguish acoustic decodability from influence on AD prediction. Our results show that controlled acoustic interventions alter AD predictions across all three SSL backbones. Noise, despite showing no significant diagnostic-group difference in the original data, produces the strongest intervention effects. Importantly, these effects are systematically structured relative to the classifier's decision direction, replicate on the held-out test set and reverse when the representation-space intervention direction is reversed. Together, these findings show that high predictive performance and the absence of a significant diagnostic-group difference in a measured acoustic factor are not sufficient for robustness. We argue that intervention-based robustness tests should become standard for trustworthy clinical speech models.

</details>


### [290] [PLACE: Positional Latent Adaptation via Conditioned Embeddings for Binaural Audio Generation](https://arxiv.org/abs/2610.00630)
*Tiernon Riesenmy,You Zhang,Gautam Bhattacharya,Andrea Fanelli*

Main category: cs.SD

TL;DR: PLACE 通过在 AudioX 上引入感知编码器特征、文本-视频空间对齐及条件低秩变换，实现任意组合提示的双耳音频生成。


<details>
  <summary>Details</summary>
Motivation: 现有 any-to-audio 模型（如 AudioX）在多模态条件生成中缺乏对双耳空间线索的建模能力，难以生成具有空间一致性的音频。

Method: 在预训练 AudioX 上扩展：用 Perception Encoder Core 特征增强视频条件；对齐文本与视频表示以提取空间线索；对生成 latent 施加条件依赖的低秩变换；并通过解码音频的 ILD/ITD 目标监督适配器；在 MRSAudio 上训练。

Result: 在 FAIR-Play 上多数指标优于 ViSAGe；在 BEWO-1M Single Static 测试集上 SpatialCLAP 优于 SpatialSonic；听测在 video-to-audio 与 OOD text-to-audio 上更受偏好。

Conclusion: PLACE 实现了灵活的多模态控制与更优的空间一致性，可用于任意文本、视频及可选音频组合的双耳音频生成。

Abstract: We present PLACE, a method that extends the pretrained any-to-audio model AudioX for binaural generation from arbitrary combinations of text, video, and optional audio prompts. PLACE augments video conditioning with Perception Encoder Core features, aligns text and video representations to derive spatial cues, and applies a conditioning-dependent low-rank transformation to the generated latent. The adapter is supervised via decoded-audio interaural level and time difference objectives. Trained on MRSAudio, PLACE improves most metrics over ViSAGe on FAIR-Play and achieves an improved SpatialCLAP score over SpatialSonic on the BEWO-1M Single Static test split. Listener evaluations favor PLACE for video-to-audio and out-of-distribution text-to-audio generation, demonstrating flexible multimodal control and improved spatial consistency.

</details>


### [291] [ProxyMOS: Label-Free Speech Quality Assessment by Multi-Teacher Distillation with Adaptive Routing](https://arxiv.org/abs/2610.00419)
*Maxim Trokunov,Kirill Borodin,Nikita Vasiliev,Grach Mkrtchian*

Main category: cs.SD

TL;DR: ProxyMOS 无需新人工标注，将多个公开 MOS 预测器通过子集搜索与自适应路由集成为更强模型，并蒸馏到 wav2vec 2.0 学生模型，在 URGENT 和新建俄语 TTS 基准 mos260 上均超越最佳教师。


<details>
  <summary>Details</summary>
Motivation: 人工 MOS 标注成本高昂，而非侵入式 MOS 预测器在训练域外性能急剧下降，因此需要在不新增人工标签的前提下提升 MOS 预测的鲁棒性与精度。

Method: 以 8 个公开 MOS 预测器为对象，对照人工评分进行基准测试，选取信息量最高的 5 个进入子集搜索，比较均匀、相关性加权、误差加权、MSE 优化及逐话语自适应路由五种集成规则；用最佳的四模型路由集成对 807k 无标注话语打标签，训练 wav2vec 2.0 学生模型。

Result: URGENT 上学生模型 Spearman ρ=0.802，优于最佳教师的 0.773；在包含 38 种合成条件、4,600 条话语的俄语 TTS 基准 mos260 上，逐话语 ρ=0.636（教师 0.613），逐条件 ρ=0.95，单次前向即可匹敌自身路由集成；自适应路由是唯一在加入弱预测器时不退化的规则。

Conclusion: ProxyMOS 证明可用无标注数据与多预测器路由集成蒸馏出强学生模型，避免人工标注成本；模型、ONNX 导出与 mos260 基准均已开源。

Abstract: Human mean opinion scores (MOS) are costly to collect, and non-intrusive MOS predictors degrade sharply outside their training domain. ProxyMOS turns a pool of public MOS predictors into a single stronger model without new human labels. Eight predictors are benchmarked against human ratings; the five most informative enter a subset search under uniform, correlation-weighted, error-weighted, MSE-optimised and adaptive per-utterance routing; and the best routed four-model ensemble labels 807k unlabeled utterances that train a wav2vec 2.0 student. On URGENT the student reaches Spearman $ρ=0.802$ against $0.773$ for the best teacher. On mos260, a new Russian TTS benchmark of 4,600 utterances from 38 synthesis conditions, it reaches $ρ=0.636$ against $0.613$ per utterance and $0.95$ per condition, matching its own routed ensemble in one forward pass. Adaptive routing is the only rule that does not degrade when weak predictors are added. Model, ONNX exports and mos260 are released. It's about 950 characters; arXiv's limit is 1,920. I kept $ρ$ because arXiv renders it on the abstract page. If you'd rather avoid math, replace $ρ=0.802$ with rho = 0.802 and do the same for the other $...$ values.

</details>


### [292] [Collapse, Not Invariance: Diagnosing Auxiliary Objectives in Speech Anti-Spoofing](https://arxiv.org/abs/2610.00539)
*Ksenia Lysikova,Kirill Borodin,Maxim Maslov,Grach Mkrtchian*

Main category: cs.SD

TL;DR: 系统比较七种辅助目标与交叉熵在语音反欺骗任务中的效果，发现没有一种辅助目标能在不同架构、语料和随机种子下稳定优于交叉熵。


<details>
  <summary>Details</summary>
Motivation: 语音反欺骗系统在生成器、编解码器或信道变化时性能下降，常用辅助目标来塑造嵌入空间以提升泛化性。但辅助目标是否真正有效无法通过EER（纯排序指标）体现，因此需要直接测量嵌入空间结构来评估这些目标的真实作用。

Method: 在5个语料库上进行了113次运行，对比七种辅助目标与交叉熵；使用AASIST3的3个随机种子及4个预训练检测器；直接测量24个AASIST3运行的嵌入空间结构，并以空间散布进行归一化分析。

Result: 原始增强位移使余弦一致性看似有效，但增益来自更小的空间而非更稳定的空间；归一化后没有配置能持续优于交叉熵。所有训练空间的表征都被单一决策轴主导，其训练集结构无法迁移；4次运行坍缩为近似恒定输出，该现象被位移指标奖励但被EER报告为低准确率。

Conclusion: 没有任何辅助目标能在不同架构、语料库和随机种子下保持相对于交叉熵的优势，辅助目标塑造嵌入空间的常见补救思路缺乏实证支持。

Abstract: Speech anti-spoofing countermeasures degrade when the generator, codec or channel changes, and a common remedy is an auxiliary objective that shapes the embedding space; whether it does is invisible to EER, a pure ranking metric. We compare seven such objectives with cross-entropy over 113 runs on five corpora, AASIST3 at three seeds plus four pre-trained detectors, and measure the embedding space of the 24 AASIST3 runs directly. Raw augmentation displacement makes cosine consistency look effective, but the gain is a smaller space, not a more stable one: normalised by the spread, no configuration consistently improves on cross-entropy. Every trained space is dominated by the single decision axis expected for two classes, whose training-set structure does not transfer, and four runs collapse to a near-constant output that displacement rewards and EER reports as poor accuracy. No auxiliary objective keeps an advantage over cross-entropy across architectures, corpora and seeds.

</details>


### [293] [On Evaluating Quantum Kernel Robustness for Low-Resource Cross-Corpus Audio Deepfake Detection](https://arxiv.org/abs/2610.00649)
*Lisan Al Amin,Lei Zhang,Vandana P. Janeja*

Main category: cs.SD

TL;DR: 该研究在严格低资源（200条训练样本）与四维PCA降维条件下，对量子支持向量机（QSVM）、经典SVM与MLP在跨语料合成语音检测中的表现进行比较，发现QSVM在严重域偏移下更稳健，但优势并不一致。


<details>
  <summary>Details</summary>
Motivation: 合成语音检测对音频安全至关重要，但在标注数据稀缺、且评测条件与训练条件存在差异时性能会显著下降。作者希望考察在低资源与跨语料场景下，量子核方法与轻量神经网络是否具备可用的检测能力。

Method: 以冻结的wav2vec 2.0嵌入为特征，使用PCA将嵌入降至四维以匹配近期量子硬件的量子比特预算；在200条训练样本的严格预算下，统一使用相同降维特征训练QSVM、经典SVM和MLP，并在ASVspoof 2019、ASVspoof 5、ADD 2023与In-the-Wild数据集上进行跨语料评测。

Result: 在ASVspoof 2019→ADD 2023的严重域偏移下，MLP退化至接近随机水平（AUC约50%，EER 50.0%），而QSVM保持有意义的判别能力（AUC 76.0%，EER 27.0%）。但该优势并非在所有迁移方向上一致：以ADD 2023为训练集时，QSVM在三项迁移中的两项低于随机水平，MLP反而更好。

Conclusion: 量子核方法在严重跨语料偏移与严格低资源约束下可能具有竞争力，但在近域迁移中并未表现出一致优势。作者将结果解释为对分布偏移下量子核归纳偏置的经验性刻画，而非量子优势的证据，因为四量子比特核可在经典硬件上精确模拟。

Abstract: Synthetic speech detection is critical for audio security, but performance can degrade when labeled data are scarce and evaluation conditions differ from training. This study examines quantum kernel methods and lightweight neural models for cross-corpus audio deepfake detection under limited training data. We compare a Quantum Support Vector Machine (QSVM), a classical support vector machine (SVM), and a multilayer perceptron (MLP), all trained on frozen wav2vec 2.0 embeddings using a strict budget of 200 training samples. To match the qubit budget of near-term quantum hardware, embeddings are reduced to four dimensions using principal component analysis, and all models use the same reduced features. Experiments on ASVspoof 2019, ASVspoof 5, the ADD 2023 Challenge, and the In-the-Wild dataset show that under severe domain shift from ASVspoof 2019 to ADD 2023, the MLP degrades to near-random performance, with an area under the curve of approximately 50% and an equal error rate of 50.0%. In contrast, the QSVM maintains meaningful discrimination, achieving an area under the curve of 76.0% and an equal error rate of 27.0%. This advantage is not consistent across transfer directions. When trained on ADD 2023, the QSVM falls below chance on two of three transfers, while the MLP performs better. These results suggest that quantum kernel methods can be competitive under severe cross-corpus shifts and strict low-resource constraints, but do not provide a consistent advantage under near-domain transfer. We interpret these findings as an empirical characterization of quantum kernel inductive bias under distribution shift, rather than evidence of quantum advantage, since the four-qubit kernel can be simulated exactly on classical hardware.

</details>


### [294] [Balalaika-Longform: A Russian Speech Corpus for Continuous Long-Form Text-to-Speech](https://arxiv.org/abs/2610.00658)
*Nikita Vasiliev,Kirill Borodin,Vasilii Kudryavtsev,Maxim Maslov,Grach Mkrtchian*

Main category: cs.SD

TL;DR: 本文提出Balalaika-Longform——一个189小时的开放俄语长文本语音语料库，包含30秒至15分钟的连续语音单元及匹配的短窗视图，用于在相同源录音上比较微调策略；在50个未见音色的文本-音色对上评估四种TTS模型的连续合成能力，发现长目标微调显著降低长文本合成的词错误率。


<details>
  <summary>Details</summary>
Motivation: 长文本语音合成必须在长时生成中保留全部请求的词汇，但句级训练与评估会掩盖漏词和提前停止等问题，导致模型在长文本场景下的缺陷被隐藏。作者希望建立一个能在固定连续生成协议下、隔离训练序列长度影响的评估框架，因此构建了长单元与短窗匹配的俄语语料库。

Method: 作者构建了Balalaika-Longform俄语语料库，共189小时，以30秒至15分钟的连续单元组织，并提供与长单元匹配的短窗视图，使微调对比基于同一批源录音；评估过程保留每一次合成尝试。随后在两种视图上分别微调CosyVoice3、Qwen3-TTS、VoxCPM2与F5-TTS，并在50个微调中未见音色的文本-音色对上做连续合成测试，文本长度约为75、300和1,200词。

Result: 在1,200词条件下，CosyVoice3的词错误率从短窗微调后的99.9%降至长目标微调的47.3%，在使用带标点、格式匹配的转录文本后进一步降至16.6%；配对区间显示长目标对Qwen3-TTS和VoxCPM2更有利，对F5-TTS也有小幅优势，但后者绝对WER仍高于90%。

Conclusion: 结果在固定的连续生成协议下清晰分离出训练序列长度的影响，说明长单元训练目标对长文本语音合成的词汇保留能力至关重要，同时转录文本的标点与格式匹配也能大幅提升性能；该语料库与评估协议为长文本TTS的可复现研究提供了基准。

Abstract: Long-form text-to-speech must retain requested words over extended generations, yet sentence-level training and evaluation can hide omissions and early stops. We introduce Balalaika-Longform, an open Russian corpus of 189 hours in continuous units of 30 seconds to 15 minutes. Long units and matched short windows support fine-tuning comparisons on the same source recordings, and the accompanying evaluation retains every synthesis attempt. We fine-tune CosyVoice3, Qwen3-TTS, VoxCPM2 and F5-TTS on either view and test continuous synthesis on 50 text-voice pairs with voices unseen in fine-tuning, at about 75, 300 and 1,200 words. At 1,200 words, CosyVoice3 WER falls from 99.9% after short-window fine-tuning to 47.3% with long targets, and to 16.6% with punctuated, format-matched transcripts; paired intervals favor long targets for Qwen3-TTS and VoxCPM2, and by a small margin for F5-TTS, whose absolute WER stays above 90%. The results isolate the effect of training sequence length under a fixed continuous-generation protocol.

</details>


### [295] [AnchorPrompt: Self-Distilled Soft Prompts for Robust Audio-Language Models](https://arxiv.org/abs/2610.00706)
*Pooneh Mousavi,Amir Ivry,Mirco Ravanelli,Cem Subakan*

Main category: cs.SD

TL;DR: 提出 AnchorPrompt：冻结 LALM 主体，仅在解码器输入端音频与问题嵌入之间插入一组可学习提示向量，通过面向多种音频与文本扰动的自蒸馏训练，提升答案一致性与抗幻觉能力，且推理时扰动不可知、可零样本迁移到未见失真。


<details>
  <summary>Details</summary>
Motivation: 大型音频语言模型（LALMs）对输入扰动敏感，如噪声、波形损坏与对抗注入，导致答案不一致与幻觉，需要一种低成本、无需识别扰动类型的适应方法。

Method: 冻结模型参数，学习单个提示向量块并插入解码器输入、位于音频与问题嵌入之间；采用自蒸馏在多样化音频与文本扰动上训练：可答输入以干净录音的预测为目标，音频证据不足时以拒答为目标；推理阶段扰动不可知，无需预先检测扰动。

Result: 在 3 个 LALM、3 个基准上评估：多数测试条件下答案一致性提升；9 组“模型-基准”配对中 6 组干净精度提升，其余影响最大仅 1.2%；严重音频损坏下幻觉减少，干净音频上的误拒答率低；一致性收益可迁移至未见扰动，如选项排列与混响。

Conclusion: AnchorPrompt 以极小参数开销（单块提示向量）实现扰动鲁棒的 LALM 适配，兼顾干净精度、拒答校准与零样本泛化，为提升音频语言模型鲁棒性提供了高效方案。

Abstract: Large audio-language models (LALMs) are sensitive to input perturbations, such as noise, waveform corruption, and adversarial injections. We propose AnchorPrompt, an efficient adaptation method that keeps the model frozen and learns a single block of prompt vectors inserted at the decoder input, between the audio and question embeddings. We train these vectors through self-distillation over diverse audio and text perturbations. To improve answer consistency and mitigate hallucination, we use the model's prediction on the clean recording as the target for answerable inputs, and assign a refusal target when the audio lacks sufficient evidence to answer. Furthermore, AnchorPrompt is perturbation-agnostic at inference, requiring no prior detection of perturbations and enabling zero-shot transfer to unseen distortions. We evaluate three LALMs across three benchmarks and show that AnchorPrompt improves answer consistency in most tested conditions. Clean accuracy improves in six of nine model-benchmark pairs, with minimal impact on the remainder of 1.2% at most. Crucially, AnchorPrompt reduces hallucinations under severe audio corruption while keeping false refusals on clean audio rare. Finally, these consistency gains transfer to unseen perturbations, such as choice permutations and reverberation.

</details>


### [296] [Where the Body Keeps the Beat: Structured Motion Conditioning and Music Dynamics Supervision for Dance-to-Music Generation](https://arxiv.org/abs/2610.00726)
*Changchang Sun,Lu Cheng,Yan Yan*

Main category: cs.SD

TL;DR: 本文提出 Dyna2Music，一种潜空间流匹配框架，通过结构化运动条件与音乐潜变量动态的显式监督，提升舞蹈到音乐生成的节奏对齐与音频质量。


<details>
  <summary>Details</summary>
Motivation: 现有舞蹈到音乐（D2M）方法未显式区分不同身体部位与频段的运动线索，且标准流匹配缺乏针对局部音乐潜变量动态的专门监督目标，导致节奏对齐不足。

Method: 基于 AIST++ 的实证分析量化空间划分与频率分离对音乐-运动节拍对齐及运动参考密度的影响；据此将关节速度分解为慢、快分量，并将部位级运动能量与预训练关节特征分层融合以构成条件；同时提出潜变量动态一致性（LDC）辅助目标，在单步干净潜变量估计与配对参考之间匹配相邻帧变化幅度，不增加可训练参数与推理开销；框架支持可变长度音乐生成。

Result: 在 AIST++ 与 TikTok 数据集上，相较代表性 D2M 基线，Dyna2Music 在节奏对齐与音频质量方面均有提升。

Conclusion: 结构化运动条件与潜变量动态显式监督相结合，可有效改善 D2M 生成的节奏对齐与音质，且 LDC 以零额外参数与推理成本实现。

Abstract: Dance-to-music (D2M) generation aims to synthesize musically plausible soundtracks whose temporal structure aligns with a given dance performance. Representative D2M methods do not explicitly distinguish motion cues across body parts and frequency bands, while standard flow matching lacks a dedicated objective for supervising local music-latent dynamics. To address these issues, we propose Dyna2Music, a latent flow-matching framework that combines structured motion conditioning with explicit supervision of music-latent dynamics. An empirical analysis on AIST++ quantifies how spatial partitioning and frequency separation affect raw music-to-kinematic beat alignment and motion-reference density, informing the conditioning design. Accordingly, Dyna2Music decomposes joint velocities into slow and fast components and hierarchically fuses the resulting part-wise motion energy with pretrained joint features to condition music generation. To complement this representation, we introduce latent dynamics consistency (LDC), an auxiliary objective that matches adjacent-frame change magnitudes between a single-step clean-latent estimate and the paired reference. LDC makes local music-latent variation an explicit training target without adding trainable parameters or inference computation. Dyna2Music supports variable-length music generation, and experiments on AIST++ and TikTok demonstrate improved rhythmic alignment and audio quality over representative D2M baselines.

</details>


### [297] [RMS-AQA: A Two-Stage Spatial Audio Question Answering Benchmark for Real-World Domestic Environments](https://arxiv.org/abs/2610.00935)
*Peihao Chen,Qing Wang,Lichun Fan,Yufeng Hao,Zhifeng Kong,Mengyao Zhu,Hengyi Hong,Hang Chen,Hang Su,Yujie Jian,Chao-Han Huck Yang,Shichao Hu,Jun Du,Jian Luan,Ke Li*

Main category: cs.SD

TL;DR: 提出 RMS-AQA，一个面向真实家庭环境的空间音频问答（SAQA）基准，采用两阶段 QA 形式评估音频语言模型的声事件定位与时空推理能力，并结合真实 FOA 录音与基于实测 RIR 的高保真合成数据，同时提供轻量空间插件。


<details>
  <summary>Details</summary>
Motivation: 家庭环境中的具身助手需要推断"发生了什么、在哪里、何时发生以及如何响应"，这要求模型具备空间音频理解与时空推理能力；但现有基准在真实感、任务综合性和评测维度上存在不足。

Method: 构建 RMS-AQA 基准：1）设计两阶段 QA 格式，先进行可听声事件定位（grounding），再基于定位结果进行复杂时空推理；2）数据由真实世界一阶 Ambisonics（FOA）录音与基于实测房间脉冲响应（RIR）生成的高保真合成数据混合而成，以最大化声学真实性；3）提供轻量级空间插件，将 FOA 格式数据注入冻结的音频语言骨干网络。

Result: 实验表明，主要挑战来自并发声源（concurrent sources）、远距离（far distance）以及 RIR 合成数据与真实录音之间的仿真—真实域差距（sim-to-real domain gap）。

Conclusion: RMS-AQA 为真实家庭场景下的空间音频问答提供了综合性评测平台，揭示当前音频语言模型在复杂声学条件下的局限，并为空间音频理解与具身助手研究指明改进方向。

Abstract: Embodied assistants in domestic environments must infer what happened, where and when it occurred, and how to respond. To address this, we introduce RMS-AQA, a spatial audio question answering (SAQA) benchmark for real-world domestic environments. The benchmark features a two-stage question-answering (QA) format to comprehensively assess the ability of audio-language models (ALMs) to first ground audible sound events and subsequently perform complex spatio-temporal reasoning based on that grounding. To maximize acoustic realism, our dataset combines authentic real-world first-order Ambisonics (FOA) recordings with high-fidelity synthetic data generated using measured room impulse responses (RIRs). Furthermore, we provide a lightweight spatial plug-in that injects FOA-format data into frozen audio-language backbones. Experimental results reveal that the primary challenges stem from concurrent sources, far distance, and sim-to-real domain gap between RIR-synthesized and authentic recordings.

</details>


### [298] [Toward Elastic Speech Inference: Training-Free Wake-Word Detection from Pretrained ASR](https://arxiv.org/abs/2610.01182)
*Hwayeon Kim,Youngwon Choi,Hyeonyu Kim*

Main category: cs.SD

TL;DR: 探索用共享预训练ASR主干、免梯度微调地进行唤醒词检测，并用SliceGPT的PCA结构化剪枝提取紧凑编码器；在Parakeet-TDT-0.6B-v3与Moonshine-base上，编码器通道维减半后WuW检测性能基本稳定。


<details>
  <summary>Details</summary>
Motivation: ASR发展日益强调跨领域与多样声学条件的泛化能力。现有方法通常需要额外训练或将任务专用模块接入预训练ASR模型来适配前端功能（如唤醒词检测），成本较高。本文希望验证：是否可直接复用共享的预训练ASR主干完成WuW检测，且无需梯度微调。

Method: 以预训练ASR模型为共享主干，不做梯度式微调，直接用于唤醒词（WuW）检测；并采用SliceGPT的基于PCA的结构化剪枝方法，尝试从主干中抽取紧凑编码器，考察编码器通道维压缩的可行性。

Result: 在Parakeet-TDT-0.6B-v3与Moonshine-base上，当编码器通道维度缩减50%时，WuW检测性能保持相对稳定。

Conclusion: 结果表明，无需微调即可从预训练ASR模型中导出与任务相关的紧凑编码器，为前端任务复用ASR主干提供了可行路径。

Abstract: Recent ASR development has placed growing emphasis on generalization across diverse domains and acoustic conditions. Existing approaches typically adapt pretrained ASR models to front-end functions such as wake-up word (WuW) detection through additional training or task-specific modules. In this work, we explore the use of a shared pretrained ASR backbone for WuW detection without gradient-based fine-tuning and examine whether a compact encoder can be extracted using the PCA-based structured pruning approach of SliceGPT. Experiments with Parakeet-TDT-0.6B-v3 and Moonshine-base show that WuW detection performance remains relatively stable when the encoder channel dimension is reduced by 50%. These results suggest that task-relevant compact encoders can be derived from pretrained ASR models without fine-tuning.

</details>


### [299] [AudioJev: Direct Audio Decisions with Order-Calibrated Probabilities](https://arxiv.org/abs/2610.01293)
*Sihan Lv,Zhen Li,Zhiqi Cao,Jinshan Zhang,Ying Li,Meng Xi,Jianwei Yin*

Main category: cs.SD

TL;DR: AudioJev 将音频波形、问题与候选选项直接映射为候选分布，通过随机乱序 SKL 训练实现顺序校准，在保持单次前向推理的同时提升音频问答准确率与概率稳定性。


<details>
  <summary>Details</summary>
Motivation: 音频决策常依赖转录文本无法保留的证据，且概率估计易受选项排列顺序影响，因此需要一个直接作用于音频、且对选项顺序稳健的建模与校准方法。

Method: 提出 AudioJev：用单一全参数共享模型将波形、问题、候选选项直接映射为候选分布；定义顺序校准为在语义保持的选项置换下保持答案概率；采用随机错位（random-derangement）SKL 训练，对每个问题构造每个选项均改变位置的重排视图，监督两个视图的答案并在应用对称 KL 惩罚前对齐两个分布；推理保持单次候选打分前向，无需校准头或顺序集成。

Result: 在三个训练种子上，AudioJev 在完整 MMAU/MMAR 上达到 68.88%/55.33% 平均准确率，并将随机顺序 SKL 相对单视图移除消融分别降低 43.8%/60.5%；同一模型可处理意图、环境声、音符属性、语音活动与对话转换等任务。

Conclusion: 配对移除消融与多顺序评估同时衡量预测准确率和概率稳定性，表明校准目标作用于候选语义而非展示位置，从而建立起直接的音频接口。

Abstract: Audio decisions often depend on evidence that a transcript does not preserve, while their probability estimates can depend on how answer options are ordered. AudioJev maps a waveform, question and supplied alternatives directly to a candidate distribution through one shared full-parameter model. We define order calibration as preserving an answer's probability under meaning-preserving option permutations. Random-derangement SKL training pairs each question with a reordered view in which every alternative changes position, supervises both answers, and aligns the two distributions before applying a symmetric KL penalty. Inference retains a single candidate-scoring forward, with no calibration head or order ensemble. Across three training seeds, AudioJev reaches 68.88%/55.33% mean accuracy on complete MMAU/MMAR and reduces random-order SKL by 43.8%/60.5% relative to the single-view removal ablation. The same model handles intent, environmental sound, note properties, speech activity and conversational transitions. Paired removal ablations and multi-order evaluation measure predictive accuracy and probability stability together, establishing a direct audio interface whose calibration objective acts on candidate meaning rather than presentation position. Inference code and model weights are available at https://github.com/SihanLv/AudioJev-Inference and https://huggingface.co/shlv/AudioJev.

</details>


### [300] [Multi-Party Backchannel Prediction: a Diagnosis, a Benchmark, and a Ceiling](https://arxiv.org/abs/2610.01488)
*Mohammed Hafsati,Ahmed Loughzali*

Main category: cs.SD

TL;DR: 本文提出基于 AMI 语料库的多方会话 backchannel 预测基准，发现现有 dyadic 模型零样本迁移到会议音频时仅达随机水平（AUROC 0.499），但冻结声学特征经线性探针可达 0.704、重训后达 0.751；同时揭示 listener 条件化对未见听众迁移失败的问题，并分析其与说话人身份信息纠缠的关系。


<details>
  <summary>Details</summary>
Motivation: 现有 backchannel 预测研究几乎完全局限于双人（dyadic）对话，缺乏多方会议场景的基准与评估工具，难以检验模型在多人、多听众条件下的泛化能力。因此作者构建多方基准，系统评估 dyadic 模型的零样本迁移与 listener 泛化表现，并探究其失败原因。

Method: 基于 AMI 语料库构建多方 backchannel 预测基准，包含来自 171 场会议、190 位说话人、18,697 个 backchannel 事件的 682 个 masked-listener 视图，并采用 person-disjoint 的留出划分。评估 dyadic SOTA 模型的零样本迁移、冻结特征线性探针与重训表现；通过容量缩减、listener 对抗训练、逐听众自适应、oracle 词汇条件化等手段分析 listener 条件化泛化；并用同一模型内的 turn-onset 预测作为对照，分析身份信息与 backchannel 线索的纠缠。

Result: dyadic 模型零样本迁移 AUROC 仅 0.499（随机水平），冻结特征线性探针达 0.704，重训后达 0.751。重训后 listener 条件化仅对训练中见过的听众有效，对未见听众无效，且该差距在容量缩减、listener 对抗训练、逐听众自适应和 oracle 词汇条件化下依然存在。对抗训练只能移除部分说话人身份信息，更强移除则损害预测，表明身份与 backchannel 有用线索纠缠。对照显示：相同特征与数据划分下，turn-onset 预测可迁移到未见听众，而 backchannel 预测不能；backchannel 率跨个体变异约为 turn-onset 率的两倍。由于 backchannel 仅占约 1% 帧，帧级 F1 受基率影响强烈，故同时报告 AUROC 与 listener-active 区域上的 event-F1。

Conclusion: 多方会话中的 backchannel 预测对未见听众的泛化仍是未解难题，listener 条件化收益无法迁移，且与说话人身份信息存在纠缠；相比之下 turn-onset 预测可正常迁移。研究提示需谨慎使用帧级 F1，并建议以 AUROC 配合 event-F1 评估。作者公开了基准与评估工具以供后续研究。

Abstract: Backchannel prediction has been studied almost entirely in dyadic conversation. We introduce a multi-party benchmark based on the AMI corpus, comprising 682 masked-listener views from 171 meetings, 190 speakers, and 18,697 backchannel events, with a person-disjoint held-out split. A state-of-the-art dyadic model applied zero-shot to meeting audio performs at chance (AUROC 0.499); nevertheless, its frozen acoustic features remain informative: a linear probe reaches 0.704, and retraining the predictor raises performance to 0.751. Retraining reveals a second limitation. Listener conditioning improves prediction for listeners seen during training but not for unseen listeners, and the gap remains under capacity reduction, listener-adversarial training, per-listener adaptation, and oracle lexical conditioning. Adversarial training removes only part of the speaker-identity information, while stronger removal hurts prediction, suggesting that identity is entangled with cues that are useful for backchanneling. A within-model control helps explain this pattern: with the same features and data splits, turn-onset prediction transfers to unseen listeners, while backchannel prediction does not. Backchannel rates also vary about twice as much across individuals as turn-onset rates. Since backchannels occupy only about 1% of frames, frame-level F1 is strongly affected by the base rate. We therefore report AUROC alongside event-F1 on listener-active regions. We release the benchmark and evaluation tools at https://github.com/HafsatiMohammed/bc_multiparty_release.

</details>


### [301] [From Isolated Feature to Orbits: Discovering Music Concepts via Multi-SAE Alignment](https://arxiv.org/abs/2610.01864)
*Liwei Lin,Gus Xia*

Main category: cs.SD

TL;DR: 本文提出从"特征识别"转向"结构分析"的音乐基础模型可解释性框架，利用音高移调作为归纳偏置，通过多视角SAE对齐诱导有序轨道，从而发现和弦、调性等结构化概念。


<details>
  <summary>Details</summary>
Motivation: 现有可解释性方法（如探针和稀疏自编码器SAE）侧重以最小结构假设识别孤立特征，但音乐中的许多概念（如和弦、调）本质上是有组织的结构化关系（音高与时间空间中的结构集合），而非孤立特征，因此需要新的分析视角。

Method: 提出一个以音高移调作为归纳偏置的框架，通过多视角SAE对齐来诱导有序轨道：生成音高移调的输入对，对齐其SAE表示，从而发现音高相关特征的结构化分组。

Result: 在两个最先进的音乐基础模型上，该方法成功恢复了对应和弦、调性和旋律模式的轨道结构，且仅需极少锚点示例即可解释整个概念族。

Conclusion: 研究表明音乐基础模型的内部表示可以组织为结构化的特征轨道，结构分析为音乐模型可解释性提供了优于孤立特征识别的有效范式。

Abstract: How can we understand what a music foundation model has learned \textit{internally}? Most interpretability approaches, such as probing and Sparse Autoencoders (SAEs), focus on identifying individual features with minimal structural assumptions. We argue that many concepts are better understood as \textit{structured relations} rather than isolated features. This is especially prominent in music, where tonal structures are organized in the space of pitch and time. For example, concepts such as chords or keys are naturally expressed as structured sets (e.g., the 12 transpositions of a chord or the diatonic system within a key), rather than isolated features. In this study, \textbf{we shift from feature identification to structure-based analysis}, asking whether the learned inner representations of music foundation model emerge as organized structures over features. To this end, we introduce a framework that uses pitch transposition as an inductive bias to induce ordered orbits via multi-view SAE alignment. Concretely, we generate pitch-shifted input pairs and align their SAE representations to discover structured groups of pitch-related features. Experimental results show that this approach recovers orbit structures corresponding to chords, keys, and melodic patterns across two state-of-the-art music foundation models, while requiring only minimal grounding (e.g., a few anchor examples) to interpret entire concept families.

</details>


### [302] [LAST: Looped Audio Spectrogram Transformer](https://arxiv.org/abs/2610.01926)
*Haider Al-Tahan,Sean O'Brien,Anastasia Razdaibiedina,N. Apurva Ratan Murty*

Main category: cs.SD

TL;DR: LAST（Looped Audio Spectrogram Transformer）通过复用同一组Transformer块、仅对class token进行多次精炼，在AudioSet上以更少参数和计算量取得优于十二层顺序Transformer的性能，并提升鲁棒性与泛化能力。


<details>
  <summary>Details</summary>
Motivation: 增加Transformer深度虽能提升识别性能，但每增加一层都会带来更多参数，导致计算效率低下。作者希望探索是否能让额外处理聚焦于对已计算特征的整合，而非引入全新层。

Method: LAST先对全部token进行一次处理，随后复用相同的Transformer块，在固定的音频特征上仅对class token进行反复精炼，使后续迭代计算代价很低；同时在不同pass数（2至10）下训练模型。

Result: 在AudioSet上，十次pass的LAST达到0.345 mAP，相比十二层顺序Transformer相对提升2.1%，同时参数量减少49.4%，MAC减少42%，实测吞吐提升9.8%。pass数由2增至10时精度提升而计算量仅增1.2%。对时间掩蔽及其他听觉增强更鲁棒，在音乐、环境声和事件声分类任务上泛化更好。

Conclusion: 重复精炼class token的循环结构可在显著降低参数与计算开销的同时提升音频识别性能，为深度扩展提供了高效替代方案。

Abstract: Increasing depth of transformer models improves recognition, but it comes at a substantial cost. Each additional layer requires more parameters, which makes the process computationally inefficient. We ask whether additional processing can focus on integrating features already computed. Looped Audio Spectrogram Transformer (LAST) first processes all tokens, then reuses the same blocks to refine only the class token over fixed audio features, thereby making later passes inexpensive. On AudioSet, ten-pass LAST achieves 0.345 mean average precision, exceeding a twelve-layer sequential transformer by 2.1% relative with 49.4% fewer parameters, 42% fewer multiply-accumulate operations, and 9.8% higher measured throughput. Across separately trained models, increasing the pass count from two to ten improves accuracy while adding only 1.2% computation. Further evaluations show improved robustness to temporal masking and various other auditory augmentations, with better generalization on classification tasks with music, environmental, and event sounds.

</details>


<div id='stat.ML'></div>

# stat.ML [[Back]](#toc)

### [303] [Weighted Data Selection: Sharp Upper-Half and Five-Dimensional Laws](https://arxiv.org/abs/2610.00101)
*Zhongxuan Liu,Hongzhi Wang*

Main category: stat.ML

TL;DR: 本文研究加权最小二乘在最小范数学习器下，小型重加权训练支持集保留的风险大小，刻画了中间预算区间上的精确风险律 $\Gamma_d(n)=3-n/d$，并给出匹配下界与 Lean 4 形式化验证。


<details>
  <summary>Details</summary>
Motivation: 量化小规模重加权训练支持所保留的风险，是理解有限样本下加权最小二乘与最小范数学习器行为的关键。已有结论多集中于极端预算，中间预算区间缺乏精确风险刻画，本文旨在填补该空白并给出可形式化验证的严格保证。

Method: 对最小范数学习器下的有限加权最小二乘，在 $\lceil 3d/2\rceil\le n\le 2d-1$ 区间证明精确风险律 $\Gamma_d(n)=3-n/d$。技术上使用平衡单纯形锚点降维、正权提升与独立直线压缩来封闭风险界，并以平移坐标对构造紧下界；同时借助电路覆盖、比较二阶矩、电路-平面概率及极面几何处理共享的三维电路，并通过单纯形块前沿将这些律统一到中间预算选择问题中。

Result: 证明了完整预算区间内的精确风险律 $\Gamma_d(n)=3-n/d$，覆盖所有观测特征秩且选择保持完整特征张成；证明平移坐标对达到匹配下界。在较小预算 $(d,n)=(5,6)$ 处证明 $\Gamma_5(6)=11/5$，与 $5=3+2$ 的单纯形块预测一致；得到锐利超额 $6/5$。数据集级上界与紧性构造均在 Lean 4 中验证。

Conclusion: 小规模重加权支持的风险在中间预算下遵循精确的 $\Gamma_d(n)=3-n/d$ 律，且该律由单纯形块前沿统一描述，兼具紧下界与机器验证的严格性。

Abstract: How much risk does a small reweighted training support retain? For finite weighted least squares with the minimum-norm learner, we prove the exact law $Γ_d(n)=3-n/d$ throughout $\lceil3d/2\rceil\leq n\leq2d-1$. The guarantee covers every observed feature rank and uses selections that preserve the full feature span. Balanced simplex anchors reduce dimension; positive-weight lifting and independent-line compression close the risk bound. Shifted coordinate pairs attain the matching lower bound. The complete dataset-level upper bound and sharpness construction are verified in Lean 4. At the smaller budget $(d,n)=(5,6)$, we also prove $Γ_5(6)=11/5$, matching the simplex-block prediction from $5=3+2$ over arbitrary interacting configurations. Circuit covers, comparison second moments, and circuit-plane probabilities give the sharp excess $6/5$, while polar-face geometry resolves shared rank-three circuits. The general simplex-block frontier connects these laws within the intermediate-budget selection problem.

</details>


### [304] [Transferable Graph Metanetworks](https://arxiv.org/abs/2610.00420)
*Yuxin Ma,Adir Dayan,Yam Eitan,Haggai Maron,Soledad Villar*

Main category: stat.ML

TL;DR: 该论文提出可迁移图元网络（Transferable Graph Metanetworks），通过对图元网络范式进行若干修改，使权重空间网络的性能能够在不同宽度（width）的输入网络之间迁移，从而实现尺寸泛化（size generalization）。


<details>
  <summary>Details</summary>
Motivation: 现有权重空间网络（元网络）大多在一种或少数固定尺寸的输入网络上训练，并在分布内评估；少数尝试分布外尺寸泛化的研究范围有限且效果一般。因此，"在小网络上训练、在远大于它的网络上评估"所带来的潜在效率收益基本未能实现。论文旨在解决输入网络宽度差异导致的尺寸泛化问题。

Method: 提出 Transferable Graph Metanetworks，在图元网络（graph metanetwork）范式上引入一组修改，遵循两条原则：其一，对不同宽度网络表示同一函数的方式保持不变性（invariance）；其二，保证连续性（continuity），即表示相似函数的权重应获得相似的预测。此外，研究输入网络从随机初始化独立训练时尺寸泛化的可行性。

Result: 在论文考虑的所有任务上，所提出的修改都显著改善了尺寸泛化。在按最大更新参数化（μP）训练的输入网络上表现最佳，且在训练宽度的最高 42 倍范围内仍保持稳健。理论方面，作者用无限宽度极限理论解释了这些现象：证明了模型在 μP 训练输入上的尺寸泛化保证，并解释了在其他参数化下可能失效的原因。

Conclusion: 通过不变性与连续性驱动的范式修改，图元网络可实现跨宽度的尺寸泛化，其中 μP 参数化条件下效果最为稳健；无限宽度极限理论为该方法提供了理论支撑，并说明了其他参数化下泛化失败的原因。

Abstract: A weight space network (or metanetwork) takes the weights of another neural network as input and predicts properties of it. Most prior work trains such models on input networks of one or a few fixed sizes and evaluates them in-distribution. The few attempts at out-of-distribution size generalization remain limited in scope and have achieved only modest success. Consequently, the potential efficiency gains of training on small networks and evaluating on much larger ones remain largely unrealized. We propose Transferable Graph Metanetworks, which extend the graph metanetwork paradigm with a set of modifications that make performance transferable across input networks of different widths. The modifications follow two principles: invariance to the ways in which networks of different widths represent the same function, and continuity, such that weights representing similar functions receive similar predictions. We further study whether size generalization is possible for input networks trained independently from random initialization. Empirically, our modifications significantly improve size generalization on every task we consider. Performance is strongest on input networks trained under the maximal-update parameterization ($μ$P), where it remains robust up to $42\times$ the training width. Theoretically, we explain these observations with infinite-width limit theory: we prove size-generalization guarantees for our model on $μ$P-trained inputs, and explain why it can fail under other parameterizations.

</details>


### [305] [Learning to Cover Locally: Graph Neural Combinatorial Optimization under a Hard Information Horizon](https://arxiv.org/abs/2610.00422)
*Johannes F. Loevenich,Thies Moehlenhof,Laurin Holz,Maxime Schwarzer,Tobias Huerten,Roberto Rigolin F. Lopes*

Main category: stat.ML

TL;DR: 该论文研究"硬信息视界"下的组合优化，形式化为局部集合覆盖，并在OLSRv2的MPR选择上实例化：证明决策视界不可由模型容量弥补，深度与宽度足够的GNN可复现RFC 7181贪心及其加权版本并继承近似比，实验表明3层GATv2显著逼近最优，而将视界限制为一跳则性能崩溃。


<details>
  <summary>Details</summary>
Motivation: 主流神经组合优化假设存在可读取整个实例的集中式求解器，忽略了现实中每个节点只能看到局部信息、且局部决策必须拼合成全局可行解的情形。OLSRv2路由协议中的MPR选择正是此类问题：其信息视界由协议（RFC 7181）强制规定而非建模者自选，因此需要研究视界对可解性与近似质量的根本约束。

Method: 将问题形式化为局部集合覆盖，并实例化到加权MPR选择（NP-hard的2跳覆盖问题）。理论上刻画确定性选择器与图神经网络（GNN）的视界：L层GNN在读出于决策节点处恰为L跳选择器；在协议给定视界下，深度O(Δ)的GNN可复现RFC 7181覆盖贪心，宽度O(c_max·Δ)时可复现其度量感知的加权版本。实验上以CP-SAT最优解为示范，行为克隆训练带覆盖补全解码器的3层GATv2，并与贪心、限制为一跳的同一学习器对比，另做两项真实网络迁移验证。

Result: 理论上证明：任何视界差一跳的确定性选择器要么覆盖失败，要么偏离最优达Δ倍，故模型容量无法换回半径。反之，在协议视界下，深度O(Δ)的GNN复现覆盖贪心、宽度O(c_max·Δ)时复现加权贪心，二者均继承(1+lnΔ₂)近似比。实验上，3层GATv2在100%覆盖下达到cost/opt=1.030±0.001，优于贪心的1.138，弥补79.1%的差距；同一学习器若限制为一跳（解码器与示范相同）则退化到1.344，远劣于贪心。迁移检验中，OLSRv2原始选择代码在200/200单位成本实例上与基数贪心一致；在40,308个真实营级移动性实例上，冻结模型在全覆盖下弥补48%的差距。

Conclusion: 在硬信息视界下的组合优化中，决定性能的关键变量是信息视界而非模型容量：视界不足会造成本质性不可逾越的近似下界，而在协议允许的视界内，适当深度与宽度的GNN可精确对齐并继承经典贪心的近似保证，实证上也显著优于贪心并逼近最优。

Abstract: Neural combinatorial optimization typically assumes a centralized solver that reads the whole instance. We study the opposite: combinatorial optimization under a hard information horizon, where every node commits to its share of a global solution seeing only its $k$-hop neighborhood, and those commitments must compose into a globally feasible solution. We formalize this as local set cover and instantiate it on weighted multipoint relay (MPR) selection, the NP-hard 2-hop covering problem of the Optimized Link State Routing Protocol version 2 (OLSRv2) routing protocol (RFC~7181), whose horizon is imposed by the protocol, not chosen by the modeler. We prove two results. Any deterministic selector whose horizon is one hop short must either fail coverage or land a factor $Δ$ from optimal, and an $L$-layer graph neural network (GNN) read out at the deciding node is exactly an $L$-hop selector, so capacity cannot buy back radius. Conversely, at the horizon a \ac{GNN} of depth $O(Δ)$ reproduces the RFC~7181 covering greedy, and at width $O(c_{\max}Δ)$ its metric-aware weighted analogue, inheriting the $(1+\lnΔ_2)$-approximation in both cases. Empirically, a 3-layer \ac{GATv2} with a coverage-completing decoder, behavior-cloned from the CP-SAT optimum, reaches $\text{cost}/\text{opt}=1.030\pm0.001$ against greedy's $1.138$, closing $79.1\%$ of the gap at $100\%$ coverage. Restricting the same learner to one hop, on identical instances with the same decoder and demonstrations, collapses it to $1.344$, far worse than greedy. Two transfer checks target real-world networks. OLSRv2's unmodified selection code matches our cardinality greedy on $200/200$ unit-cost instances, and on $40{,}308$ instances of real battalion mobility the frozen model closes $48\%$ of the gap at full coverage. The information horizon, not the model capacity, is the most significant variable.

</details>


### [306] [Target-Dependent Limits of Causal Repair: A Leading-Log Frontier in a Gaussian Model](https://arxiv.org/abs/2610.00424)
*Qinchuan Cheng,Jiaqi Liu,Ruixuan Xie*

Main category: stat.ML

TL;DR: 该文在一个标量高斯因果实验框架下，量化了"因果预测器的潜在改进量"与"实际学到的修复增益"之间的评估鸿沟，给出了评估误差指数的尖锐前沿。


<details>
  <summary>Details</summary>
Motivation: 即使能估计因果预测器的潜在改进上限（oracle potential），也未必能揭示实际训练出的修复（repair）所带来的真实增益；两者之间存在评估缺口，需要刻画这一缺口的信息需求与可达到的速率。

Method: 设定标量高斯因果实验，干预几何已知：辅助数据将有界污染下的效应幅值识别出来，诊断量识别方向。目标量为"实际训练修复相对于拟合参照的平方损失增益"。在统一学习MSE η 下联合优化学习器与评估器，避免"不做修复"的平凡解。分析 1/k 学习尺度下的评估下界，推导幅值充裕区间的对数前沿指数 min{ℓ_k, 2kη_k/U}，并提出诊断弃权（diagnostic-abstention）规则；通过精确高斯模拟将前沿迁移到自适应采样，并用有限网格实验区分符号尾部抑制与总MSE。

Result: 在常规 1/k 学习尺度下，任何可行学习器都承受 k^{-2} 的评估下界，即便 oracle potential 能以更快速率被估计。在幅值充裕区间得到尖锐的前导对数前沿：评估指数在一阶相对意义下为 min{ℓ_k, 2kη_k/U}，其中 ℓ_k = log(1/(k²E_k))，E_k 为辅助精度。诊断弃权规则在未知冗余参数情形下达到该指数，并给出临界容差窗口的界。

Conclusion: 该结果刻画了在这一具体实验中评估目标如何改变信息需求，而非一般性的因果可识别性主张。

Abstract: Knowing how much a causal predictor could improve need not reveal the gain of the repair actually learned. We quantify this gap in a scalar Gaussian causal experiment with known intervention geometry: auxiliary data identify effect magnitude up to bounded contamination, while diagnostics identify direction. The target is the squared-loss gain of the realized trained repair relative to a fitted reference. Jointly optimizing the learner and assessor under uniform learning MSE $η$ avoids the trivial solution of making no repair. At the usual $1/k$ learning scale, every feasible learner incurs a $k^{-2}$ assessment floor, even when oracle potential is estimable at a faster rate. In the magnitude-rich regime, we characterize a sharp leading-log frontier: the assessment exponent is $\min{\ell_k,2kη_k/U}$ to first relative order, where $\ell_k=\log(1/(k^2E_k))$ and $E_k$ is auxiliary precision. A diagnostic-abstention rule attains this exponent with unknown nuisance parameters. We also bound the critical allowance window and transfer the frontier to adaptive sampling by exact Gaussian simulation. Finite-grid experiments distinguish sign-tail suppression from total MSE and expose conservative finite-budget behavior. The result isolates how the assessment target changes information requirements in this experiment; it is not a general causal identifiability claim.

</details>


### [307] [ChainLoRA: Geometry-Preserving Task Vector Merging for Continual Learning in LLMs](https://arxiv.org/abs/2610.00431)
*Hang Yin,Haozhe Wang,Yuhua Luo,Zhangqi Pan,Xiaoxing Wang,Junchi Yan*

Main category: stat.ML

TL;DR: ChainLoRA：一种免回放的持续参数高效微调框架，基于链式更新的任务向量几何，结合链式训练与自适应SVD合并，在参数预算受限下平衡知识保持与新任务适应。


<details>
  <summary>Details</summary>
Motivation: 大语言模型的持续参数高效微调需在旧知识保持、新任务适应和严格参数预算之间取得平衡；现有方法（如基于回放的方法）存在存储历史数据或状态开销随任务流增长的问题。

Method: 从参数合并视角提出任务更新间可度量的几何交互，将遗忘分解为方向重叠与系数耦合；ChainLoRA由两部分组成：（1）链式更新训练，初始化和单边正交代理仅使用最近一个carrier，使历史状态占用与正则开销随任务流增长保持恒定；（2）合并阶段的自适应SVD，提取共享carrier并通过Procrustes适配对齐到最新任务，另加有效秩惩罚促进任务子空间的高效利用。

Result: 理论分析表明Procrustes适配可实现共享与任务特定成分的几何近似分离，单边代理可约束任务间干扰；实验中在Large和SuperNI基准上取得所评估的免回放方法中最优性能，在Standard CL上具竞争力，三项基准平均分接近所评估的基于回放方法。

Conclusion: ChainLoRA以恒定的历史开销实现免回放持续合并，在参数预算约束下兼顾知识保持与任务适应，性能优于所评估的免回放方法并接近回放方法。

Abstract: Continual parameter-efficient fine-tuning for large language models (LLMs) must balance retention of previously acquired knowledge, adaptation to new tasks, and strict parameter budgets. We present \textbf{ChainLoRA}, a replay-free continual merging framework built on chain-updated task-vector geometry. From a parameter-merging perspective, we formulate a geometric view of forgetting through a measurable interaction between task updates, separating directional overlap from coefficient coupling. Building on this view, ChainLoRA combines chain-updated training with post-stream adaptive SVD merging. During training, initialization and a one-sided orthogonality proxy use only the last carrier, keeping their historical-state footprint and regularization overhead constant as the task stream grows. At merging time, Adaptive SVD extracts a shared carrier and aligns it to the latest task through Procrustes adaptation. Our theoretical analysis shows that Procrustes adaptation facilitates geometric approximate separation of shared and task-specific components. The one-sided proxy further bounds inter-task interference. An effective-rank penalty additionally promotes efficient utilization of the task subspace during continual learning. Experiments show that ChainLoRA achieves state-of-the-art performance among the evaluated replay-free methods on the Large and SuperNI benchmarks, while remaining competitive on Standard CL and attaining almost the closest average scores to the evaluated replay-based method across all three benchmarks.

</details>


### [308] [Fractional Laplace Neural Operators: Exact Architectures, an Expressivity Frontier at Criticality, and Certified Stability for Memory-Driven Network Dynamics](https://arxiv.org/abs/2610.00515)
*Mauricio Herrera-Marín*

Main category: stat.ML

TL;DR: 该论文提出分数阶拉普拉斯神经算子（fLNO），将Volterra型遗传动力学结构嵌入学习映射，实现精确线性记忆算子表示与稳定性保证，并在近临界场景中展现参数效率优势。


<details>
  <summary>Details</summary>
Motivation: 神经算子可学习函数空间之间的映射，而遗传网络动力学由具有非有理拉普拉斯符号的Volterra预解式描述。现有有理近似难以刻画非整数临界渐近行为，且缺乏显式稳定性保证与物理坐标的一致性，因此需要一种能同时保持精确记忆结构、物理意义与稳定性的算子学习架构。

Method: 针对可交换的激励—拉普拉斯对，fLNO通过单个块图谱层精确表示完整线性Volterra解算子。作者建立有限有理实现的表达力边界理论：在紧频率窗口上几何逼近分数阶记忆，但无法复现分支点产生的非整数临界渐近，且半直线上最优有理收敛率为根指数级。基于同一理论给出按构造满足预设稳定裕度的可训练参数化，并证明图极限（graphon）迁移定理以区分真正的算子一致性与参数共享。

Result: 在共同数据基准上，正有理算子在有限时域可达到或超过fLNO精度；但在受控近临界实验中，fLNO以远少参数更忠实地恢复分支坐标。无约束有理拟合会跨越稳定边界，而认证参数化不会。四参数谱律无需重训练即可从规模48的图迁移到192的图，相对误差0.51%–0.62%。在智利余震序列及智利与21个意大利地区的更新模型上展示了带显式不确定性的结构化推断。

Conclusion: 该工作贡献了一种算子学习架构，使精确记忆结构、物理坐标与稳定性保证能够与有竞争力的精度共存，为遗传动力学与分数阶记忆系统的学习提供了理论支撑和实用参数化方案。

Abstract: Neural operators learn maps between function spaces, while hereditary network dynamics are described by Volterra resolvents with non-rational Laplace symbols. We introduce a fractional Laplace neural operator (fLNO) that embeds this structure in the learned map. For commuting excitation--Laplacian pairs, one block graph-spectral layer represents the full linear Volterra solution operator exactly. We establish an expressivity frontier for finite rational realizations: they approximate fractional memory geometrically on compact frequency windows, but cannot reproduce the non-integer critical asymptotics generated by a branch point, and on the half-line the best rational rate is root-exponential. The same theory yields trainable parametrizations that enforce a prescribed stability margin by construction, and a graphon-transfer theorem separates genuine operator consistency from parameter sharing. In a common-data benchmark, positive rational operators can match or exceed fLNO accuracy on finite horizons, whereas in controlled near-critical experiments fLNO recovers the branching coordinate more faithfully with far fewer parameters; unconstrained rational fits can cross the stability boundary, while certified parametrizations cannot. A four-parameter spectral law transfers without retraining from graphs of size 48 to 192 with 0.51--0.62% relative error. Applications to Chilean aftershock sequences and to renewal models for Chile and 21 Italian regions illustrate structured inference with explicit uncertainty. The contribution is an operator-learning architecture in which exact memory structure, physical coordinates and stability guarantees coexist with competitive accuracy.

</details>


### [309] [Adaptive Conformal Prediction for Image Regression Models with Application to an Inertial Confinement Fusion Emulator](https://arxiv.org/abs/2610.00535)
*Carrie J. Lei-Cramer,Michael S. Jones,Laura J. Wendelberger*

Main category: stat.ML

TL;DR: 提出ACPNN——一种基于最近邻的输入自适应保形预测框架，用于图像回归，在扩散模型模拟惯性约束聚变(ICF)任务上实现可靠且自适应的不确定性量化，且计算成本低。


<details>
  <summary>Details</summary>
Motivation: 科学机器学习中，基于图像的黑箱模型日益用于高风险场景，其输出影响昂贵决策，但多数方法仅给出点估计，缺乏预测不确定性量化。同时模型内部不可访问、可解释性差，难以评估输入空间不同区域的可靠性，因此亟需能够提供输入相关（输入自适应）不确定性估计的方法，以指导模型开发与下游实验。

Method: 提出ACPNN（Adaptive Conformal Prediction using Nearest Neighbors），一种面向图像回归的输入自适应保形框架。该方法利用邻近样本信息生成局部自适应的不确定性估计，保持较低计算成本。邻域结构通过一个尺度化距离度量来定义，该度量由带自动相关性判定(ARD)核的高斯过程学习得到。

Result: 在用于模拟惯性约束聚变(ICF)的扩散模型上进行验证，结果表明ACPNN能够实现可靠且自适应的不确定性量化。

Conclusion: ACPNN为图像回归提供了一种输入自适应、计算高效的不确定性量化方案，适用于科学机器学习中的高风险黑箱模型场景，可指导模型开发与下游实验。

Abstract: Uncertainty quantification is critical in scientific machine learning, where black-box, image-based models are increasingly deployed in high-stakes settings. In many such applications, model outputs inform costly decisions, yet most methods provide only point estimates without quantifying predictive uncertainty. This challenge is compounded by the limited accessibility and interpretability of model internals, making it difficult to assess reliability across different regions of the input space. As a result, there is a growing need for methods that can provide input-dependent uncertainty estimates to guide both model development and downstream experimentation. To address this need, we propose Adaptive Conformal Prediction using Nearest Neighbors (ACPNN), an input-adaptive conformal framework for image regression. ACPNN leverages information from neighboring samples to produce locally adaptive uncertainty estimates while maintaining low computational cost. The neighborhood structure is defined using a scaled distance metric learned via a Gaussian Process with an automatic relevance determination (ARD) kernel. We demonstrate the effectiveness of ACPNN on a diffusion model for emulating inertial confinement fusion (ICF) simulations, showing that it achieves reliable and adaptive uncertainty quantification.

</details>


### [310] [Learning to Price Electricity for Optimal Demand Response](https://arxiv.org/abs/2610.00755)
*Jing Shang,Mohammad Mehrabi,Xinyang Zhou,Mahmoud Saleh,Andrey Bernstein,Stefan Wager*

Main category: stat.ML

TL;DR: 提出一种基于神经网络的上下文能源定价算法，将定价建模为Stackelberg博弈并利用平均场解表示，学习从上下文特征到可行价格信号的受约束映射，仿真验证显示引入上下文信息可显著提升需求响应价值。


<details>
  <summary>Details</summary>
Motivation: 利用时变电价塑造消费者需求响应、使能源需求与可再生能源发电更好匹配具有重要价值。但最优价格通常随时间变化，需响应天气预报、日出日落时间、星期模式等复杂信号，而现有方法无法有效利用这类丰富上下文信息。

Method: 提出基于神经网络的上下文能源定价算法：将定价问题建模为Stackelberg博弈，并借助Mehrabi et al. (2024)的平均场解表示，学习从上下文特征到可行价格信号的受约束映射。在美国多个城市对电网进行仿真验证。

Result: 在美国若干城市的电网仿真中，纳入上下文信息能够显著提升需求响应项目的价值。

Conclusion: 通过神经网络学习受约束的上下文到价格信号映射，并结合Stackelberg博弈与平均场表示，可有效利用丰富上下文信息改进时变电价设计，提升需求响应效益。

Abstract: There is considerable interest in using time-varying electricity prices to shape consumer demand response, and better align energy demand with renewable production. However, optimal prices generally vary over time in response to complex signals such as weather forecasts, sunrise/sunset times, and day-of-week patterns; and existing methods are not able to make efficient use of such rich contextual information. Here, we propose a neural-network-based algorithm for contextual energy pricing, modeling pricing as a Stackelberg game and leveraging a mean-field solution representation from Mehrabi et al.~(2024). The approach learns constrained mappings from contextual features to feasible price signals. We validate our approach by simulating the energy grid in several US cities, and show that incorporating contextual information can considerably increase the value of the demand response programs.

</details>


### [311] [Inference for stochastic differential equations driven by weighted sub-fractional Brownian motion using neural networks and the Euler approximation](https://arxiv.org/abs/2610.00793)
*J. H. Ramirez-Gonzalez*

Main category: stat.ML

TL;DR: 本文研究加权次分数布朗运动驱动的随机微分方程在离散观测下的漂移、扩散和噪声协方差估计问题，提出基于Euler近似与轨迹似然、结合神经网络与径向基表示、并利用似然 profile 估计协方差指数与扩散尺度的估计方法，并与两种神经替代方法在二十种系数设置下进行模拟比较。


<details>
  <summary>Details</summary>
Motivation: 针对由加权次分数布朗族（含协方差指数β与时间权重f）驱动的SDE，从离散观测中联合估计漂移a、扩散σ与噪声协方差结构具有实际需求，但驱动过程非标准布朗且协方差结构复杂，现有方法难以直接处理，故需构建适配该驱动族的估计框架。

Method: 采用Euler近似重构高斯驱动增量，利用其联合密度构造轨迹似然；用神经网络与径向基表示建模漂移、扩散及归一化时间权重，并通过似然profile估计协方差指数β与扩散尺度。

Result: 在相同模拟轨迹的二十种系数设置下，将所提方法与两种神经替代方法进行比较，验证估计效果。

Conclusion: 提出的似然驱动、神经与径向基混合表示的方法可用于加权次分数布朗驱动SDE的系数与协方差估计，并在多种系数设置下与神经替代方法进行对比评估。

Abstract: We consider the estimation of drift, diffusion, and noise covariance from discrete observations of stochastic differential equations driven by Gaussian processes. For a fixed observation horizon $T>0$ and a known initial state $x_0\in\mathbb R$, we study \begin{equation*}
  dX_t=a(X_t)\,dt+σ(X_t)\,dZ_t^{β,f},
  \qquad X_0=x_0,\quad 0\leq t\leq T. \end{equation*} \smallskip\noindent Here $a:\mathbb R\to\mathbb R$ is the drift coefficient, $σ:\mathbb R\to(0,\infty)$ is the diffusion coefficient, and $Z^{β,f}$ is a centered Gaussian process from the weighted sub-fractional Brownian family, with covariance \begin{equation*}
  \operatorname{Cov}(Z_s^{β,f},Z_t^{β,f})
  =\int_0^{s\wedge t} f(r)q_β(s-r,t-r)\,dr,
  \qquad 0\leq s,t\leq T. \end{equation*} \smallskip\noindent Here $s\wedge t=\min\{s,t\}$. The temporal weight $f:[0,T]\to[0,\infty)$ is measurable, bounded, and positive almost everywhere, and $β\in(0,2)$ is the covariance exponent. For $u,v\geq0$, the kernel is $q_β(u,v)=[u^β+v^β-(u+v)^β]/(1-β)$ when $β\ne1$. Its continuous extension at $β=1$ is $q_1(u,v)=(u+v)\log(u+v)-u\log u-v\log v$, with $0\log0=0$.
  Using the Euler approximation, we reconstruct the Gaussian driving increments from observed transitions and use their joint density to obtain a trajectory likelihood. Neural and radial-basis representations model the drift, diffusion, and normalized temporal weight, while a likelihood profile estimates the covariance exponent and diffusion scale. We compare the method with two neural alternatives on the same simulated trajectories in twenty coefficient settings.

</details>


### [312] [Block Optimism for Nonstationary Bandits with Latent Linear Dynamics](https://arxiv.org/abs/2610.00911)
*Taehyun Hwang,Hyunjun Choi,Heesang Ann,Min-hwan Oh*

Main category: stat.ML

TL;DR: 本文研究内生非平稳随机赌博机问题，其中动作同时影响即时奖励与隐藏线性动态状态的演化，奖励关于动作与隐藏状态双线性。作者提出基于分块乐观的自适应算法，通过循环近似将无限记忆奖励过程截断并优化有限记忆分块代理，证明遗憾上界为 Õ(√T)，显著优于已有 Õ(T^{2/3})。


<details>
  <summary>Details</summary>
Motivation: 已有 explore-then-commit 方法需均匀探索以估计潜在动态，再固定开环动作序列，仅达到 Õ(T^{2/3}) 遗憾。作者希望利用自适应分块乐观突破该瓶颈，在相同模型下取得更优遗憾率。

Method: 关键步骤为循环近似：在稳定动态下，将无限记忆奖励过程截断，并用有限记忆的分块级代理近似开环基准。基于该归约，提出基于 UCB 的分块算法，维护截断动态参数的置信集，并乐观地选择动作块。

Result: 证明遗憾上界为 Õ(√T)，显著优于此前同模型的 Õ(T^{2/3}) 保证；据作者所知，这是潜在线性动态赌博机（双线性奖励观测、开环动作序列基准）的首个 Õ(√T) 遗憾保证。

Conclusion: 通过分块级乐观与循环近似，可在内生非平稳随机赌博机中实现 Õ(√T) 遗憾，验证了自适应乐观相对 explore-then-commit 的显著优势，并为该类潜在动态问题建立了新的理论基准。

Abstract: We study an endogenous nonstationary stochastic bandit problem with latent linear dynamics, where actions affect both immediate rewards and the future evolution of an unobserved latent state. Rewards are bilinear in the current action and latent state, inducing history-dependent rewards and a nontrivial long-horizon planning problem. The existing explore-then-commit approach achieves $\tilde{O}(T^{2/3})$ regret by uniformly exploring to estimate the latent dynamics and then committing to an optimized open-loop action sequence. We show that this rate can be improved via adaptive block-level optimism. Our key step is a cyclic approximation: under stable dynamics, the infinite-memory reward process can be truncated, and the open-loop benchmark can be approximated by optimizing a finite-memory block-level proxy. Building on this reduction, we propose a UCB-based block algorithm that maintains confidence sets for the truncated dynamics parameters and selects blocks optimistically. We prove a regret bound of order $\tilde{O}(\sqrt T)$, significantly improving over the previous $\tilde{O}(T^{2/3})$ guarantee for the same model. To the best of our knowledge, this is the first $\tilde{O}(\sqrt T)$ regret guarantee for latent linear-dynamics bandits with bilinear reward observations and an open-loop action-sequence benchmark.

</details>


### [313] [The Price of Correlated Tests: How Strict Should a Model Release Gate Be?](https://arxiv.org/abs/2610.00993)
*Marco Pollanen*

Main category: stat.ML

TL;DR: 将模型发布门控视为设计问题：在满足给定可靠性目标的前提下，选择所需通过的测试数量以保留尽可能多的优质模型。基于二类潜因子模型，证明在潜在相关性相同的情形下更严格门控必然提升可靠性；给出达标门控的验证流程。


<details>
  <summary>Details</summary>
Motivation: 现有做法要求模型通过全部自动化测试，看似安全，但会错误拒绝大量本可服务用户的模型，且未说明通过模型的真实可信度。因此需要把发布门控设计为一个权衡问题。

Method: 提出二类潜因子模型，显式刻画两类代价，并将每次计算化简为一维积分。在两类共享相同潜在相关性的条件下，证明更严格门控必然提高可靠性，故满足目标的最宽松门控即保留优质模型最多的门控。另给出基于精确二项界（exact binomial bounds）的验证流程，可在门控从固定短名单中选出的情况下，用带标签数据认证门控。

Result: 在“通过全部测试”门控下，任何非完美的可靠性目标在模型内均可达成，但随着测试套件增大，保留的优质模型比例趋于零。测试间相关性决定代价：某配置下，99% 目标需 8 个独立测试，潜在相关性 0.3 时需 74 个，0.5 时需 5,182 个，且此时门控保留的优质模型不足十分之一。

Conclusion: 发布门控应作为显式设计问题处理：通过调节必过测试数量在可靠性目标与优质模型保留率之间权衡，测试间相关性是主要成本来源；所给验证流程可对短名单内选定门控提供统计认证。

Abstract: Before a machine learning model ships, it often has to pass a suite of automated tests. Requiring every test to pass looks safe, yet it can reject many models that would have served users well, and it does not say how trustworthy a passing model actually is. We treat the release gate as a design problem: choose how many tests a model must pass so that cleared models meet a stated reliability target, while keeping as many good models as possible. A two-class latent-factor model makes both costs explicit and reduces each calculation to a one-dimensional integral. We prove that when both classes share the same latent correlation, a stricter gate always raises reliability, so the gate that keeps the most good models is the most lenient one that still meets the target. Under pass-all gating, any reliability target short of perfection is attainable within the model, but the share of good models kept tends to zero as the suite grows. Correlation between tests sets the price. In one configuration, a 99 percent target needs 8 independent tests, but 74 tests at a latent correlation of 0.3 and 5,182 at 0.5, where the gate keeps fewer than one good model in ten. We also give a validation procedure, built on exact binomial bounds, that certifies a gate from labelled data even when the gate is chosen from a fixed shortlist.

</details>


### [314] [Tolerance-Based Fairness Auditing: Violation Certification and Sensitivity Screening](https://arxiv.org/abs/2610.01005)
*Jie Tang,Chuanlong Xie,Lixing Zhu*

Main category: stat.ML

TL;DR: 本文提出统一的基于容忍度的公平性审计框架，面向违规认证与敏感度筛查两类目标，分别开发约束经验似然检验与分裂经验似然检验，实现误差控制与敏感度的权衡。


<details>
  <summary>Details</summary>
Motivation: AI部署日益广泛，算法不公平引发关注，要求进行透明的公平性审计。实际中可容忍的不公平程度依赖具体法律、伦理或应用情境，因此需要给定预设容忍阈值后，判断群体差异是否超过允许容忍度。

Method: 构建统一的基于容忍度的公平性审计框架，针对两类目标：1）违规认证，优先控制错误违规声明，采用约束经验似然检验，使用最不利点校准，并可结合假阳性率控制进行同时子群审计；2）敏感度筛查，优先减少漏检，采用分裂经验似然检验和调整分裂经验似然检验，基于自适应边界代理原则用于预警场景。

Result: 数值实验显示这些程序在误差控制与敏感度之间存在明显不同的权衡。COMPAS案例分析展示了该框架在预测公平性审计中的应用。

Conclusion: 该框架为容忍度导向的公平性审计提供了统一方法论，兼顾违规认证的严格误差控制与筛查的高敏感度，适用于不同审计目标与实际场景。

Abstract: As artificial intelligence is increasingly deployed, algorithmic unfairness has raised growing concerns and intensified demands for transparent fairness auditing. In practice, the tolerable degree of algorithmic unfairness depends on the specific legal, ethical, or application context. Given a prespecified tolerance threshold, an important statistical question is how to determine whether a group disparity exceeds the allowable tolerance across different auditing objectives. To address this problem, we develop a unified tolerance-based fairness auditing framework for two complementary auditing objectives: violation certification, which prioritizes control of false violation declarations, and sensitivity screening, which prioritizes reducing missed violations. For the first objective, we develop a constrained empirical likelihood test for formal settings that uses least-favorable-point calibration and can be combined with false flagging rate control for simultaneous subgroup auditing. For the second objective, we develop split empirical likelihood and adjusted split empirical likelihood tests using an adaptive boundary-proxy principle for early-warning settings. Numerical experiments show the distinct error-control--sensitivity trade-offs of these procedures. A COMPAS analysis illustrates the framework in predictive fairness auditing.

</details>


### [315] [Posterior sampling by source-space MCMC via prior-based few-step transport maps](https://arxiv.org/abs/2610.01034)
*Hoang Phuc Hau Luu,Marcelo Hartmann,Zhongjian Wang*

Main category: stat.ML

TL;DR: 提出源空间广义贝叶斯推断框架，用少步改进MeanFlow(iMF)映射表示隐式先验，在高斯源空间采样，并给出Wasserstein误差界。


<details>
  <summary>Details</summary>
Motivation: 隐式先验(历史集合、模拟器输出、预训练生成模型)仅能以样本形式表示，难以直接进行贝叶斯推断；同时在测试时引导(广义贝叶斯)中，显式正权重(如指数化奖励)会倾斜隐式先验，形成同一计算难题。

Method: 用一/少步iMF映射表示先验，在其高斯源空间做后验采样；建立精确后验与学习后验间的Wasserstein误差界，并分解为训练次优性与模型类近似误差；源空间采用并行回火+预处理Crank-Nicolson更新，并提出融合分裂哈密顿蒙特卡洛的混合变体以提升效率。

Result: 合成实验表明该框架能准确、高效地近似后验分布；CLIP引导的ImageNet实验表明其可将预训练iMF图像先验导向文本指定偏好。

Conclusion: 将少步iMF传输与后验稳定性保证相结合，为隐式先验下的广义贝叶斯推断提供了兼具理论误差界与高效采样的统一框架。

Abstract: Bayesian inference increasingly uses informative but implicit priors represented only by samples, such as historical ensembles, simulator outputs, and pretrained generative models. The same computational problem appears in the test-time guidance task (generalized Bayes), where an explicit positive weight, e.g., an exponentiated reward, tilts an implicit prior. We develop a framework for source-space generalized Bayesian inference that combines inexpensive few-step prior transports with posterior stability guarantees. Specifically, we represent the prior using a one- or few-step improved MeanFlow (iMF) map and perform posterior sampling in its Gaussian source space. We establish Wasserstein error bounds between the exact and learned posteriors in terms of the joint population iMF and auxiliary-velocity loss, decomposed into training suboptimality and model-class approximation error. In the iMF source space, we adopt parallel tempering with preconditioned Crank-Nicolson updates and introduce a hybrid variant that incorporates split Hamiltonian Monte Carlo to improve sampling efficiency. Synthetic experiments show that the proposed framework can approximate posterior distributions accurately and efficiently, while CLIP-guided ImageNet experiments demonstrate its ability to steer a pretrained iMF image prior toward text-specified preferences.

</details>


### [316] [Optimal Transport Meets Reinforcement Learning: A Survey](https://arxiv.org/abs/2610.01413)
*Yujie Zhu,Charles A. Hepburn,Matthew Thorpe,Giovanni Montana*

Main category: stat.ML

TL;DR: 这是一篇关于最优传输（OT）在强化学习（RL）中应用的综述，梳理了OT在RL目标与算法中的角色、所比较的分布、所用OT形式及时间结构的处理方式，并讨论了动机、实践考量与开放问题。


<details>
  <summary>Details</summary>
Motivation: 常用散度在分布弱重叠时（模仿学习、离线RL、分布偏移部署中常见）会失效，需要一种基于"移动概率质量"的度量，最优传输（OT）因引入任务几何的ground cost而成为替代方案。

Method: 综述性方法：对每类使用OT的RL方法，识别其OT扮演的角色、比较的分布（状态访问分布、动作分布、转移分布等）、所用OT形式，以及对时间结构的处理；并分析不同OT选择背后的动机与成本设计、计算挑战等实践问题。

Result: 给出OT用于RL目标与算法的系统分类框架，涵盖状态访问分布、动作分布、转移分布等多类比较对象，并总结成本设计与计算方面的实践要点。

Conclusion: OT为弱重叠分布下的RL提供了有效度量工具；未来开放问题包括可扩展的轨迹级传输、质量不匹配的原则化处理，以及OT正则化RL的理论分析。

Abstract: Reinforcement learning (RL) algorithms frequently compare probability distributions, such as state visitation distributions induced by policies and experts, action distributions from learned policies and offline datasets, or transition distributions from learned models and environments. However, commonly used divergences may become ineffective when these distributions overlap weakly, which is frequently encountered in imitation learning, offline RL, and deployment under distribution shift. Optimal transport (OT) offers an alternative by measuring the cost of \emph{moving} probability mass from one distribution to another under a ground cost that encodes task geometry. This survey covers how OT is used inside RL objectives and algorithms. For each method, we identify: the role OT plays, the distributions compared, the OT formulation used, and the treatment of temporal structure. Beyond categorising existing methods, we discuss the motivations behind different OT choices, practical considerations such as cost design and computational challenges, and highlight open problems including scalable trajectory-level transport, principled handling of mass mismatch, and theoretical analysis for OT-regularised RL.

</details>


### [317] [Zero Flux: Flow-Based Comparison of High-Dimensional Discrete Distributions](https://arxiv.org/abs/2610.01472)
*Leyang Wang,Yakun Wang,Song Liu,Taiji Suzuki*

Main category: stat.ML

TL;DR: 本文将连续域中基于流匹配的向量场判据推广到离散分布，提出 Zero Flux 准则：在独立耦合下，中点处所有局部概率通量消失当且仅当两分布相同；该差异度量可分解为局部贡献并可由样本高效估计，具有有限样本误差界，在合成与真实分类数据上验证了其有效性。


<details>
  <summary>Details</summary>
Motivation: 高维离散分布比较因状态空间指数增长、交互变化复杂而困难。已有工作用流匹配训练连续分布间的向量场，其中点向量场为零当且仅当两分布相同，但该流式判据无法自然适用于离散分布，因此需要将这一原理扩展到离散域。

Method: 提出 Zero Flux 准则，一种基于局部概率通量的差异度量。在独立耦合假设下，证明中点处所有局部概率通量消失当且仅当两分布相同；该差异将联合分布差异分解为更小的局部贡献，并可由样本高效估计；同时建立估计量的有限样本误差界。

Result: 理论上给出了中点零通量的等价性证明及估计量的有限样本误差界；实验上在合成与真实分类数据上实现了稀疏依赖信号的可靠恢复，并在高维情形下稳定追踪分布漂移。

Conclusion: Zero Flux 为高维离散分布比较提供了可分解、可估计且具理论保证的差异度量，扩展了流匹配式判据到离散域，在稀疏依赖检测与高维分布漂移追踪方面表现可靠。

Abstract: Comparing two high-dimensional discrete distributions has always been a challenging task due to the exponentially growing state space and complex changes in interactions. A recent work suggests comparing distributions through a vector field trained using flow matching between two continuous distributions. The resulting vector field at mid-point vanishes if and only if two distributions identical. However, such a flow-based criterion does not naturally apply to discrete distributions. We extend this principle to the discrete domain and introduce the \emph{Zero Flux} criterion, a discrepancy based on local probability fluxes. Under independent coupling, we show that all local probability fluxes vanish at the midpoint if and only if two distributions are the same. This discrepancy decomposes the joint distributional difference into smaller, local contributions and can be efficiently estimated from samples. We establish finite sample error bounds for our estimator. Experiments on synthetic and real categorical data demonstrate reliable recovery of sparse dependence signals and stable tracking of distribution shifts in high dimensions.

</details>


### [318] [The hidden advantage of mask resampling: a theory of masked autoencoders](https://arxiv.org/abs/2610.01578)
*Jorge Medina Moreira,Lorenzo Bardone,Lenka Zdeborová*

Main category: stat.ML

TL;DR: 本文从高维理论模型出发，证明掩码线性重构能在无掩码重构（等价于PCA）失败的情形下以线性样本复杂度恢复潜在特征，并量化掩码重采样与掩码多样性的统计优势，进而在图像与语言任务中验证动态掩码的优势。


<details>
  <summary>Details</summary>
Motivation: 解释为何掩码预测（masked prediction）能学到无掩码重构所缺失的有用表征，并区分掩码预测目标本身与掩码多样性带来的收益。

Method: 在具有共享潜在结构与异质噪声的高维数据上建立掩码自编码器（MAE）模型：证明掩码线性重构可恢复潜在特征，分析每样本固定K个掩码（mask resampling）对特征恢复与下游性能的影响；并在CNN自编码器、ViT上做图像实验（随机裁剪、翻转会遮蔽重采样优势），另做BERT试点实验。

Result: 掩码线性重构在无掩码线性重构（PCA）失败的区间仍能以线性样本复杂度恢复潜在特征；掩码多样性越大，样本复杂度越低；标准图像训练中的随机裁剪与翻转即使在patch mask固定时也会更新预测任务，从而掩盖掩码重采样优势，去除后CNN自编码器与ViT显现出动态掩码相对静态掩码的下游优势；BERT试点显示更大掩码多样性对下游语言任务有益。

Conclusion: 区分了掩码预测目标本身与掩码多样性各自的收益，并表明可处理的理论能指导实验，揭示被标准训练实践所掩盖的优势。

Abstract: Why can masked prediction learn useful representations that unmasked reconstruction misses? We study this question in a high-dimensional model of a masked autoencoder (MAE) trained on data with shared latent structure and heterogeneous noise. We prove that masked linear reconstruction can recover the latent feature at linear sample complexity in regimes where unmasked linear reconstruction, equivalent to PCA, fails. The analysis also quantifies the statistical advantage of mask resampling, an established ingredient of masked pretraining. By introducing a fixed collection of $K$ masks per sample, we characterize its effect on feature recovery and downstream performance, identifying regimes where greater mask diversity lowers sample complexity. Guided by this prediction, we find that random cropping and flipping in standard image-training pipelines can obscure the advantage of mask resampling by renewing the prediction task even when the patch mask is fixed. Removing these transformations reveals a downstream advantage for dynamic over static masking in CNN autoencoders and vision transformers. A complementary BERT pilot finds benefits from greater mask diversity on downstream language tasks. Our results separate the benefit of the masked prediction objective from that of mask diversity, and show how a tractable theory can guide experiments that uncover advantages hidden by standard training practices.

</details>


### [319] [Error-Corrected Inference-Time Scaling for Imperfect Diffusion Models](https://arxiv.org/abs/2610.01933)
*Zuokai Wen,Louis Grenioux,Weinan E,Jiequn Han*

Main category: stat.ML

TL;DR: 提出EBFKC框架，在能量扩散模型中在线修正模型误差，实现精确路径跟踪与端点匹配，实验验证优于标准推理时缩放基线。


<details>
  <summary>Details</summary>
Motivation: 现有推理时缩放方法依赖蒙特卡洛采样增加粒子数，但前提是预训练模型精确。实际中数据和训练限制使模型不完美，该方法继承了误差；增加粒子只能降低蒙特卡洛误差，无法消除端点与目标分布的不匹配及沿指定概率路径跟踪的误差。

Method: 针对能量基扩散模型提出EBFKC。首先推导Feynman-Kac动力学，在连续时间群体极限下即使模型不完美也能精确跟踪指定路径；再用序贯蒙特卡洛配合方差控制引导近似该动力学。为消除端点不匹配，将预训练能量作为扩散路径上的代理，并逐步引入学习终端能量与目标终端能量之间的差异。

Result: 在高斯混合模型、粒子系统、丙氨酸二肽和丙氨酸四肽上实验表明，方法在退火和奖励倾斜下能紧密匹配目标分布与分子自由能曲线，而标准推理时缩放基线仍保留显著采样误差。

Conclusion: EBFKC通过在推理阶段在线修正模型与路径误差，克服了现有推理时缩放对精确预训练模型的依赖，在复杂分布与分子自由能估计上取得更准确的采样结果。

Abstract: Inference-time scaling adapts pretrained diffusion models to new sampling tasks without additional training. Existing methods rely primarily on Monte Carlo sampling with more particles, yet are premised on the pretrained model being exact. In practice, data and training limitations make the model imperfect, and these methods inherit its error. More particles reduce Monte Carlo error but cannot remove the mismatch between the endpoint and the desired target or the error in tracking the prescribed probability path. We introduce the Energy-based Feynman-Kac Corrector (EBFKC), a framework for energy-based diffusion models that corrects these errors on the fly given a reference energy. We first derive Feynman-Kac dynamics that track a prescribed path exactly in the continuous-time population limit even when the model is imperfect, and approximate these dynamics using sequential Monte Carlo with variance-controlling guidance. To remove the endpoint mismatch, we use the pretrained energy as a surrogate along the diffusion path and progressively incorporate the discrepancy between the learned and target terminal energies. Experiments on Gaussian mixture models, particle systems, alanine dipeptide, and alanine tetrapeptide show that our method closely matches target distributions and molecular free-energy profiles under annealing and reward tilting, whereas standard inference-time scaling baselines retain substantial sampling errors.

</details>


### [320] [Wasserstein Gradient Flows and Forward-Only Diffusion Are Not Enough for Multimodal Sampling](https://arxiv.org/abs/2610.02081)
*Daniel McBride,Pratik Khandagale,Cristina Garcia-Cardona,Yen Ting Lin*

Main category: stat.ML

TL;DR: 本文质疑WGF/FODP采样"指数快速收敛即能高效采样多模态分布"的解读，证明其在分离良好的多模态下存在指数级混合时间这一结构性瓶颈。


<details>
  <summary>Details</summary>
Motivation: 已有大量基于Wasserstein梯度流（WGF）与前向扩散过程（FODP）的采样算法宣称具有指数快速收敛保证，并常被解读为可高效采样复杂多模态分布，且有实证支持。作者认为这一解读具误导性，需澄清其收敛保证的真实含义与适用边界。

Method: 借助Jordan-Kinderlehrer-Otto（JKO）格式与Otto演算证明：典型WGF采样动力学与过阻尼前向扩散具有相同的密度演化，从而继承非平衡统计物理中的亚稳态与慢混合现象。采用谱分析与平均首次通过时间（MFPT）分析两种互补工具刻画该采样族，并针对常用的对数-线性退火策略考察引入中间分布后的输运时间标度。

Result: 分离良好的多模态会诱导指数级长的混合时间，表现为小谱隙与罕见的模态间跃迁；在所用对数-线性退火下，引入中间分布并不能消除总输运时间的指数标度。

Conclusion: 该局限是结构性的而非实现细节：纯局部、梯度驱动的输运机制跨越分离良好的模态所需时间可能为指数级。这构成标准形式WGF/FODP采样的根本限制，并激励未来发展本质非局部的机制以实现高效多模态采样。

Abstract: There has been a proliferation of sampling algorithms based on Wasserstein gradient flows (WGF) and forward-only diffusion processes (FODP), often accompanied by theoretical guarantees of exponentially fast convergence to the target distribution. These guarantees are frequently interpreted as evidence that such methods can efficiently sample complex multimodal distributions, often supported by empirical results. In this work, we argue that this interpretation is fundamentally misleading. By invoking the Jordan-Kinderlehrer-Otto (JKO) scheme and Otto calculus, we establish that the canonical WGF sampling dynamics and overdamped forward diffusion share the same density evolution and therefore inherit the same metastability and slow-mixing phenomena long understood in nonequilibrium statistical physics. We analyze this family of samplers using two complementary tools -- spectral analysis and mean first-passage time (MFPT) analysis -- and show that well-separated multimodality can induce exponentially long mixing times associated with small spectral gaps and rare inter-mode transitions. For the commonly adopted log-linear annealing schedule studied here, we find that introducing intermediate distributions does not remove the exponential scaling of the total transport time. The limitation is structural rather than implementation-specific: purely local, gradient-driven transport mechanisms can require exponentially long times to transport probability mass across well-separated modes. We argue that this represents a fundamental limitation of WGF- and FODP-based sampling in their standard forms, and motivates future development of fundamentally nonlocal mechanisms for efficient multimodal sampling.

</details>


<div id='cs.IR'></div>

### [321] [Ask a Language Model for Lottery Numbers: Concentration in Repeated Six-of-49 Outputs](https://arxiv.org/abs/2610.00052)
*Dmitrij Żatuchin*

Main category: cs.IR

TL;DR: 该研究评估了六种语言模型配置在随机选号任务中的表现：在1-49中随机选取6个整数。1,200次调用中1,184次返回有效号码，其号码频率有效多样性（9.9–18.0）远低于独立均匀抽样下模拟的第五百分位阈值（46.6–46.7）。系统仅产生8–93个不同的无序号码组合，众数组合占比达22.5–68.0%。与两个波兰Lotto实体彩票样本（有效多样性41.1和41.4）相比，模型输出表现出明显的集中化，但研究未揭示其机制或验证其他设置下的表现。


<details>
  <summary>Details</summary>
Motivation: 探究语言模型在执行"随机性"任务（如彩票选号）时是否真正产生均匀分布的输出，以及其输出是否可能存在统计上可检测的集中化偏差，从而评估模型在实际部署场景中作为随机数生成器的可靠性。

Method: 在1-49范围内要求六种语言模型配置完成随机选取6个整数的任务，使用四种英文提示变体，共进行1,200次调用。统计有效响应数量（1,184）、号码频率的有效多样性、不同无序号码组合数量及众数组合占比，并以独立均匀六选四十九抽样在相应样本量下模拟的第五百分位阈值作为基准。此外引入两个归档波兰Lotto实体彩票样本作为对照，计算其有效多样性。

Result: 1,200次尝试中1,184次产生有效号码；有效多样性仅9.9–18.0，远低于模拟第五百分位阈值46.6–46.7；各系统仅产生8–93种不同无序组合；众数组合占有效响应的22.5–68.0%。两个波兰Lotto样本的有效多样性为41.1和41.4（样本量更小），接近均匀分布预期。

Conclusion: 在测试的部署设置下，语言模型的随机选号输出表现出显著的集中化（缺乏均匀性），与实体彩票的分布形成鲜明对比。但该研究未识别造成集中化的机制，也无法推断模型在其他提示、温度参数或工具配置下的表现，结论仅限于所测条件。

Abstract: We evaluate six language-model configurations on requests for six distinct random integers from 1-49. Across 1,200 attempted calls using four English prompt variants, 1,184 responses yielded valid tickets. Effective diversity of number frequencies ranged from 9.9 to 18.0, compared with simulated fifth-percentile thresholds of 46.6-46.7 under independent uniform six-of-49 sampling at the corresponding sample sizes. Systems produced 8-93 distinct unordered tickets, and their modal tickets accounted for 22.5-68.0% of valid responses. Two archived Polish Lotto samples provided a physical-lottery comparison, with effective diversities of 41.1 and 41.4 at smaller sample sizes. These results demonstrate substantial concentration under the tested deployment settings. They do not identify its mechanism or establish performance under other prompts, temperatures, or tool configurations.

</details>


### [322] [On-Device Commercial Intent Retrieval Under Size, Latency, and Privacy Constraints: A 3 MiB Retrieval System with Typed Egress Boundaries](https://arxiv.org/abs/2610.00170)
*Hyojung Han*
