Main category: cs.IR

TL;DR: 本文在“下载包<3 MiB、Tier-0 p95<20 ms、无原始文本/向量/稳定标识离设备”三重约束下，构建了基于6,020叶商业分类法的端侧检索式商业意图推断系统；核心发现是精度损失主要由“查询是否含某叶名子串”这一锚点变量决定，且在无锚点场景下缺口源于编码器容量而非任务适配。


<details>
  <summary>Details</summary>
Motivation: 商业意图推断具有隐私敏感性，实际部署要求完全端侧运行，且受下载体积、延迟与隐私三类硬约束限制；作者希望在约束冻结的设定下量化“约束究竟在哪里损失精度”，并识别该损失是否可通过任务适配弥补。

Method: 基于6,020叶节点商业分类法构建检索路径：将韩语句向量模型蒸馏为静态嵌入表并量化至4 bit，无推理运行时。在22,900条AI-Hub购物评论（第三方标注）上评估中类目top-5准确率；以“查询是否包含某叶名为子串”为锚点变量做分层分析；对比196.6倍大的通用教师模型、以及在学生自身对比学习对上微调的同一教师（0.8586）；用秩分边际检测低置信样本并可端侧拒答最不确定的五分之一；对厂商型号编码轴做源类目固定效应检验；实测包体与Tier-0 p95延迟。

Result: 中类目top-5为75.0%，置换基线18.4%；含叶名锚点查询83.5%，无锚点45.2%。通用大教师整体看似填补缺口（无锚点+20.1 pp，有锚点+0.1 pp），实为两效应抵消：在学生的对比对上微调后达0.8586，较纯编码器学生有锚点+10.6 pp、无锚点+20.9 pp。拒答最低置信五分之一后其余升至0.8296。厂商型号编码轴经源类目固定效应后不显著（-4.0 pp，p=0.51），锚点显著（+13.0 pp）。包体2,942,652字节；Tier-0 p95在iPhone A14/A16为4.431/3.670 ms，Snapdragon 695平板为5.080 ms，均慢于同代码的三款服务器CPU。分类法监督多为合成韩语话语。

Conclusion: 硬约束下的精度代价并非均匀分布，而是集中于“无锚点”查询；该处通用教师的任务适配无法带来增益，因此缺口是受限编码器容量不足，而非适配不足——需靠容量或架构改进而非微调解决。代价虽非均匀但处处存在；昂贵的无锚点区域可端侧通过秩分边际检测并拒答以缓解。厂商型号编码轴在控制源类目后不成立，唯有锚点效应稳健。

Abstract: We study commercial intent inference that runs entirely on the user's device, under three constraints frozen before the work began: the downloaded payload under 3 MiB, Tier-0 inference under 20 ms at p95, and no raw text, content embedding, or stable identifier leaving the device. Under them we build a retrieval path over a 6,020-leaf commercial taxonomy: a static embedding table distilled from a Korean sentence transformer, quantized to 4 bits, no inference runtime.
  Our main result is where that constraint costs accuracy. On real Korean commerce text labelled by others (22,900 AI-Hub shopping reviews), mid-category top-5 on real product names is 75.0% against an 18.4% permutation baseline, but splits on one observable: a query containing some leaf name as a substring scores 83.5%, one containing none 45.2%. A generic 196.6x larger teacher seemed to localize the gap (+20.1 pp without an anchor, +0.1 with). That null was two effects cancelling: the same teacher fine-tuned on the student's own contrastive pairs reaches 0.8586 and beats the pure-encoder student by +10.6 pp with an anchor and +20.9 pp without. The cost is not uniform, but it is not free anywhere; where the anchor is absent, task adaptation buys the teacher nothing, so what the constrained encoder lacks there is capacity. The expensive regime is detectable on-device from the ranker's own score margin: declining the least confident fifth lifts the rest to 0.8296.
  A second axis we first reported, a manufacturer model code, does not survive source-category fixed effects (-4.0 pp, p=0.51); the anchor does (+13.0 pp).
  Payload is 2,942,652 bytes, all three library links measured. Tier-0 p95 is 4.431 and 3.670 ms on two iPhones (A14, A16) and 5.080 ms on a budget Android tablet (Snapdragon 695), all slower than three server CPUs on the same code. Taxonomy supervision is mostly synthetic Korean utterances.

</details>


### [323] [System Attribution in LLM Brand Recommendations: Single Responses Identify the System, Aggregated Brand Profiles Do Not Transfer](https://arxiv.org/abs/2610.00253)
*Dmitrij Żatuchin*

Main category: cs.IR

TL;DR: 该研究检验"AI可见性审计"中按系统汇总的品牌画像是否真正刻画了模型本身。基于6,475条（可分析6,324条）多端点响应，字符n-gram分类器可将单条回答归属到具体模型（97.84%），但聚合后的品牌行为特征跨域失效，说明表层形式可携带系统身份，而聚合品牌画像不能。


<details>
  <summary>Details</summary>
Motivation: 审计实践通常把语言模型的品牌推荐汇总为"每系统画像"，但缺乏证据表明该画像描述的是系统本身，还是混杂了语料、查询域与采集工具（harness）的影响。作者因此检验此类画像的可迁移性与可分离性。

Method: 采集2025年12月至2026年2月间五个部署端点（GPT-5.2、Gemini 3 Flash、Gemini 3 Flash with search、Grok、Perplexity sonar-pro）共6,475条响应（6,324条可分析），覆盖礼品推荐、企业声誉、品类归属三类查询。将所有回答截取前800字符后，用字符n-gram分类器按提示属性做交叉验证；并设置长度基线、格式统计、品牌与首字母大写token掩蔽、留出查询条件、检索增强的harness等对照。随后将响应聚合为50个"模型×域×条件"单元，用12个行为特征做分组交叉验证，并与标签置换零分布比较。

Result: 单条响应归属准确率97.84%（5,028条、383个提示、多数类31.5%、30个划分种子）；仅用长度降至多数类水平，24个格式统计达95.79%，掩蔽品牌与首字母大写token仍为97.72%。留出查询条件加权97.43%、未加权88.0%；检索增强条件下Grok回答无一被归为Grok（0/120）。聚合层面：12个行为特征分组交叉验证仅66.53%，零分布均值33.71%、95分位46.0%；跨域失败明显，用品类归属单元训练的森林把全部22个礼品单元判错系统，与品牌数量反转一致（礼品8.41对0.94，品类归属3.01对3.91），而单条响应迁移的平衡准确率为89.92%。

Conclusion: 答案的表层形式在测试的查询域间可稳定携带系统身份，但聚合后的品牌行为画像不具备跨域可迁移性；当前未做交叉的设计无法将系统效应与查询域效应及采集harness效应分离。

Abstract: Audits of AI visibility summarise the brand recommendations of deployed language models into per-system profiles. We test whether such a profile describes the system on one corpus of 6,475 stored responses (6,324 analysable) collected between December 2025 and February 2026 from five deployed endpoints across gift-recommendation, corporate-reputation and category-ownership queries. The collection harness cut many answers short: 83.1% of Gemini 3 Flash answers in category ownership end mid-sentence under a 1,024-token output cap. With every answer cut to its first 800 characters, a character n-gram classifier cross-validated by prompt attributes one response to GPT-5.2, Gemini 3 Flash, Gemini 3 Flash with search, Grok or Perplexity sonar-pro with 97.84% accuracy (5,028 responses, 383 prompts, majority class 31.5%, 30 split seeds). Length alone falls to the majority rate, 24 formatting statistics reach 95.79%, and masking brand names and capitalised tokens leaves 97.72%. Held-out query conditions keep 97.43% weighted by size and 88.0% unweighted; in a retrieval-grounded arm that changes the harness, no Grok answer is attributed to Grok (0/120). Aggregated into 50 model-by-domain-by-condition units, twelve behavioural features separate four systems at 66.53% under grouped cross-validation, against a label-permutation null with mean 33.71% and 95th percentile 46.0%. Across domains the aggregate profile fails: a forest trained on category-ownership units assigns all 22 gift units to the wrong system, consistent with a reversal in brand volume (8.41 against 0.94 brands per response in gifts, 3.01 against 3.91 in category ownership), while single responses transfer at 89.92% balanced accuracy. The surface form of an answer carries the system across the query domains tested; aggregated brand behaviour does not, and the uncrossed design cannot separate the system from the domain or the harness.

</details>


### [324] [A Shared Taste for Model-Written Text: The Generator-by-Selector Matrices of "AI-AI Bias" Show No Detectable Own-Model Premium](https://arxiv.org/abs/2610.00369)
*Dmitrij Żatuchin*

Main category: cs.IR

TL;DR: 重新分析 Laurito 等 (PNAS 2025) 的 5×5 生成器×选择器矩阵数据，检验选择器是否偏好自身模型生成的文本（自模型溢价 γ），结果在三个数据集上均不显著，说明模型间共享的"偏好模型文本"效应存在，但不存在自我识别式偏好。


<details>
  <summary>Details</summary>
Motivation: Laurito 等的原始研究关注"模型偏好模型撰写的文本"，但其交叉设计（5 生成器×5 选择器）蕴含一个未被强调的问题：选择器是否对来自自己模型的文本存在超出生成器与选择器主效应的额外偏好（即自模型识别）。本文旨在回答这一"自偏好"是否存在。

Method: 从作者公开仓库重建三个 5×5 矩阵（21,828 有效试次，逐格与论文一致），拟合含自模型项 γ 的双向固定效应模型；用对选择器 120 种重标记的精确置换检验进行显著性检验；控制位置偏差（单格移动至多 0.42 百分点）并剔除顺序驱动项后复核；计算检验功效与最小可检测效应；并用 Tan 等 (ACL 2024) 的 4×4 矩阵作对照。

Result: 自模型溢价 γ：产品 +0.013 (单侧精确 p = 0.24)、论文摘要 -0.010 (p = 0.74)、电影 +0.054 (p = 0.07)、合并 +0.019 (p = 0.14；95% 区间 -0.008 至 0.046)。GPT-3.5/GPT-4 同厂商项在三个数据集中均为负。设计对 0.05 溢价的功效为产品 82%、论文 88%、电影 42%、合并 97%；80% 功效下合并最小可检测效应为 0.034。Tan 等的 4×4 矩阵给出 γ = +0.148（其 24 种重标记下的最小 p），同族项大小相当。

Conclusion: Laurito 等的主要结论成立：模型普遍偏好模型撰写的文本（GPT-4 描述在产品上被每个选择器以 77%–95% 选择）。但这些数据不显示模型能识别并偏好自身撰写的文本；该"无效应"结论在约 0.04 个百分点以上是可推断的，低于此则无信息。

Abstract: Laurito et al. (PNAS 2025) showed that large language models choosing between two descriptions of the same product, paper or film prefer the description written by a language model over the one written by a person, by a wide margin over what human judges do. Their design crosses five generators with the same five models as selectors, which permits a second question the paper does not headline: does a selector prefer text from its own model beyond what the generator and selector main effects predict? We rebuild the three 5x5 matrices from the per-item counts in the authors' public repository (21,828 valid trials; every cell matches the published value) and fit a two-way fixed-effects model with an own-model term gamma, tested by the exact permutation test over the 120 relabellings of the selectors. The premium is +0.013 on products (exact one-sided p = 0.24), -0.010 on paper abstracts (p = 0.74), +0.054 on films (p = 0.07) and +0.019 pooled (p = 0.14; 95% interval -0.008 to 0.046). The same-vendor term for the GPT-3.5 and GPT-4 pair is negative in all three datasets. Position bias moves single cells by up to 0.42 share points in either direction, and the own-model contrast is unchanged once order-driven items are removed. The design would have detected a premium of 0.05 with 82% (products), 88% (papers), 42% (films) and 97% (pooled) power; the minimum detectable effect at 80% power is 0.034 pooled. The absence is informative down to about 0.04 share points and silent below that. The 4x4 matrix of Tan et al. (ACL 2024) gives gamma = +0.148 at the smallest p its 24 relabellings allow, with a same-family term of the same size. The main result of Laurito et al. stands: models share a taste for model-written text, with GPT-4's descriptions chosen 77% to 95% of the time by every selector on products. What these data do not show is a model recognising and favouring its own prose.

</details>


### [325] [Comparison of Common Crawl News & GDELT](https://arxiv.org/abs/2610.00587)
*Ameir El Ouadi,David Beskow*

Main category: cs.IR

TL;DR: 本文比较了GDELT与Common Crawl News两个全球新闻数据集，分析其内容与覆盖范围，发现两者在新闻来源地域上存在显著差异。


<details>
  <summary>Details</summary>
Motivation: 全球新闻语料对自然语言处理、知识图谱及大语言模型等技术研究至关重要，同时也有助于理解每日互动的人物、地点、组织与事件。因此有必要厘清现有主流新闻数据集的特点与局限。

Method: 对比分析GDELT与Common Crawl News两个数据集，从内容构成与覆盖范围两方面剖析各自的数据来源特征。GDELT依赖全球广播电视、印刷媒体及网络新闻，而Common Crawl则侧重通过网页爬取获取全球新闻站点内容。

Result: 分析显示两个数据集在新闻来源的采集地理分布上存在相当大的差异。

Conclusion: 研究揭示了两个数据集各自的优势与局限，为相关任务中数据集选择的适用性提供了参考依据。

Abstract: The corpus of worldwide news is important for natural language processing, knowledge graphs, large language models, and other technical efforts. Additionally, this corpus is important for understanding the people, places, organizations, and events that interact in real-time every day. This paper compares two news datasets used for these tasks today, namely the Global Database of Events, Language, and Tone (GDELT) and Common Crawl News. Our research highlights the strengths and limitations of each dataset, analyzing their content and coverage. Notably, while GDELT relies on broadcasts, prints, and web news from across the globe, Common Crawl focuses on news sites from around the world gathered through web crawling. Our analysis revealed considerable differences in where the two datasets gather their news sources.

</details>


### [326] [CANOPY: Adaptive-Granularity Evidence Compression for Multimodal RAG](https://arxiv.org/abs/2610.00923)
*Hyojeong Yun,Jueun Kim,Wook-Shin Han*

Main category: cs.IR

TL;DR: CANOPY是一个自适应粒度的检索后证据压缩框架，将多模态检索项表示为层级结构并逐区域决定保留范围。


<details>
  <summary>Details</summary>
Motivation: 多模态RAG中，检索粒度选择无法决定每个条目内应保留多少上下文：粗粒度会引入无关内容，统一细粒度则会删除解读证据所需的上下文。现有压缩方法依赖模态特定机制，缺乏跨异构条目逐区域自适应保留范围的通用流程。

Method: CANOPY在微调节点编码器（基于金标准证据）对查询相关的区域打分；通过父节点相对精细化比较分数，在不同粒度上选择多个区域，且节点级剪枝无需调用LLM。此外引入critic：当判断累积证据不足时发起定向补检索，新检索条目先压缩再加入。

Result: 在覆盖3300万条异构语料的5个QA基准上，CANOPY平均答案准确率优于所评估的检索基线；消融显示多跳QA的主要准确率增益来自额外检索。在未路由的Qwen3-VL-8B-Instruct设置下，相比同迭代流程无压缩版本，压缩使阅读器输入证据token减少14.2-27.7%，准确率相当。

Conclusion: CANOPY提供了跨模态统一的自适应粒度证据压缩流程，在保持准确率的同时显著压缩阅读器输入，并通过critic驱动的补检索缓解压缩无法恢复未检索证据的问题。

Abstract: Multimodal RAG retrieves text, tables, images, and videos, but choosing a retrieval granularity does not determine how much context to retain within each item. Coarse units include irrelevant content, while uniformly fine selection can remove context needed to interpret the evidence. Existing compressors address this trade-off with modality-specific mechanisms, leaving open a shared procedure for adapting the retained extent region by region across heterogeneous items. We introduce CANOPY (Canonical Projection over Hierarchy), a framework for adaptive-granularity post-retrieval evidence compression. CANOPY represents retrieved items as hierarchies and uses a node encoder fine-tuned on gold evidence to score regions against the query. Parent-relative refinement compares these scores to select multiple regions at different granularities without LLM calls for node-level pruning. Because compression cannot recover evidence that was never retrieved, a critic requests targeted follow-up retrieval when it judges the accumulated evidence insufficient; newly retrieved items are compressed before being added. Across five QA benchmarks over a 33M-item heterogeneous corpus, CANOPY achieves higher average answer accuracy than the evaluated retrieval baselines. Ablations indicate that additional retrieval drives the main accuracy gains on multi-hop QA. In the unrouted Qwen3-VL-8B-Instruct setting, compression reduces reader-input evidence tokens by 14.2-27.7% relative to the same iterative pipeline without compression, with comparable answer accuracy.

</details>


### [327] [RPTune: Learned Context Curation for LLM Catalog Search](https://arxiv.org/abs/2610.00964)
*Chuxuan Hu,Hejie Cui,Norman Huang,Shubham Kumar Bharti,Wang-Chiew Tan,Sercan Ö. Arık*

Main category: cs.IR

TL;DR: 提出RPTune框架，将“商品目录整理”与“LLM后训练”耦合，用于小商家的全目录上下文检索，在7个真实商家上显著提升搜索准确率。


<details>
  <summary>Details</summary>
Motivation: 小型商家（SMB）的商品目录可整体放入长上下文LLM，因此全目录提示可替代为大型市场设计的多阶段检索。但仅把全目录塞进上下文窗口并不能保证模型有效利用，因为LLM对长上下文的利用并不均匀。因此需研究两个问题：(1) 如何整理和呈现目录给LLM；(2) 如何在整理后的上下文上让LLM适配商品选择。

Method: RPTune为端到端框架，将可学习的目录整理与LLM后训练结合，并使用自动生成的、基于目录的监督信号。其curator采用encoder-reorganizer结构，依据下游LLM反馈对商品进行排序与剪枝；由此得到的整理后目录又反过来以“上下文相对奖励”（context-relative reward）提升LLM后训练的效果。

Result: 在覆盖不同零售垂直领域的7个真实商家上评估，每家使用100条复杂对话式查询。RPTune在专有与开源权重LLM上均持续提升搜索准确率：上下文整理带来最高31.4个百分点的增益，后训练平均再增加10.3个百分点。

Conclusion: 对于目录可放入长上下文的SMB场景，全目录上下文搜索是可行路线，但关键在于“如何整理上下文”与“如何针对整理后上下文做适配”。RPTune通过整理与后训练的相互促进，验证了该路线的有效性并取得显著性能提升。

Abstract: For small merchant businesses (SMBs) whose catalogs fit within a long-context LLM, full-catalog prompting offers a compelling alternative to multi-stage retrieval designed primarily for large marketplaces with millions of items. However, fitting the full catalog into the context window does not ensure that the model can use it effectively, since LLMs do not exploit long contexts uniformly. We therefore study in-context catalog search through two complementary questions: (1) how to curate and present catalogs to the LLM, and (2) how to adapt the LLM for product selection on curated contexts.
  We propose RPTune, an end-to-end framework that couples learned catalog curation with LLM post-training using automatically generated, catalog-grounded supervision. An encoder-reorganizer curator orders and prunes products guided by downstream LLM feedback, while the resulting curated catalogs in turn improve the effectiveness of LLM post-training with a context-relative reward. We evaluate RPTune on 7 real merchants spanning distinct retail verticals, using 100 complex conversational queries per merchant. RPTune consistently improves search accuracy across both proprietary and open-weight LLMs, with context curation yielding gains of up to 31.4 percentage points and post-training adding a further 10.3 points on average.

</details>


### [328] [Do Multilingual Encoders Produce Language-Consistent Semantic IDs?](https://arxiv.org/abs/2610.01139)
*Abhinav Bohra,Anuj Bohra*

Main category: cs.IR

TL;DR: 该论文检验多语言编码器能否为同一商品的不同语言表示生成语言一致的语义ID（SID）。实验表明：翻译与英文原文的嵌入距离明显，且量化器对"翻译方向"并无特异性放大；平衡量化器拟合反而降低跨语言SID一致性。因此，多语言暴露与码本均衡使用本身不足以保证语言一致的SID。


<details>
  <summary>Details</summary>
Motivation: 生成式检索中，SID 由商品嵌入经离散化（残差量化）得到；若同一商品的不同语言版本被映射到差异很大的SID，则跨语言检索与商品对齐会失效。作者由此提出核心问题：多语言编码器是否足以让同一商品的不同语言渲染获得语言一致的SID，并进一步排查问题出在编码器距离、量化器敏感性，还是量化器拟合方式。

Method: 使用 Amazon ESCI 商品条目及其英语、西班牙语、日语三种语言渲染。检验三点：(1) 翻译嵌入是否仍接近英文源；(2) 残差量化是否对翻译引起的位移异常敏感；(3) 多语言或语言均衡的量化器拟合能否提升SID一致性。对照设置包括英文改写（衡量同语言位移基线）与"距离匹配的商品导向对照"（控制嵌入位移幅度，以判断量化器是否选择性放大语言方向）。比较指标为跨语言前缀/首码一致率及码本使用均匀度。

Result: 多语言E5使翻译与源文存在可测距离：在英文占优的拟合下，日语翻译仅7.7%保留其英文对应项的首个SID码，而英文改写为89.0%。距离匹配的商品导向对照产生的全SID不匹配率与翻译几乎相同，说明没有证据表明量化器会选择性放大语言方向。对拟合混合做均衡虽使码本使用更均匀，却进一步降低跨语言前缀一致率：西班牙语首码一致率由28.3%降至6.6%，而纯英文拟合仍能对67.6%的西班牙语翻译保持一致性。

Conclusion: 多语言预训练暴露与码本均衡使用并不能保证语言一致的SID；SID的跨语言不稳定性主要源于编码器对语言变化的位移被量化过程如实反映（而非量化器对语言方向的偏置）。单纯调整拟合语料配比或提升码本利用率不是有效解法，需在目标层面显式对齐跨语言SID（如语言不变表示约束、对齐式量化目标等）。

Abstract: Semantic IDs (SIDs) compress item embeddings into discrete code sequences used in generative retrieval. We ask whether a multilingual encoder is sufficient for different-language renderings of the same product to receive language-consistent SIDs. Using Amazon ESCI listings rendered in English, Spanish, and Japanese, we test whether translations remain close to their English source, whether residual quantization is unusually sensitive to translation-induced movement, and whether multilingual or language-balanced quantizer fitting improves SID agreement. Multilingual E5 places translations measurably apart: under an English-heavy fit, a Japanese translation preserves the first SID code of its English counterpart in only 7.7% of cases, compared with 89.0% for an English rewording. Distance-matched product-directed controls produce nearly the same full-SID mismatch as translation, providing no evidence that the quantizer selectively amplifies language directions. Balancing the fitting mixture makes codebook use more uniform but further reduces cross-lingual prefix agreement: Spanish first-code consistency falls from 28.3% to 6.6%, while an English-only fit preserves it for 67.6% of Spanish translations. These results show that multilingual exposure and balanced codebook use alone do not guarantee language-consistent SIDs.

</details>


### [329] [Learning to structure data from user-generated thematic corpora](https://arxiv.org/abs/2610.01463)
*Elishay Avram,Oren Glickman,Elad Yom-Tov*

Main category: cs.IR

TL;DR: 本文提出一个全自动、迭代式框架，利用LLM从主题语料中无预定义本体地发现并抽取领域特定属性模式，并在5个健康相关Reddit社区上验证其有效性。


<details>
  <summary>Details</summary>
Motivation: 社交媒体等主题语料包含大量非结构化文本，其中的个人属性、行为与经历可被结构化。但相关属性往往隐式、依赖领域且事先未知，导致结构化数据抽取困难，且缺乏预定义本体。

Method: 提出全自动迭代框架：使用LLM归纳候选属性，顺序合并语义重叠属性，并赋予结构类型；据此构建本体并从语料中填充属性值。框架还支持用较小LLM进行值抽取，并评估相对大模型的精度损失。

Result: 在5个健康相关Reddit社区上评估：发现属性与人工识别属性一致率达61%，接近独立标注者间的62%；多数情况下算法在少于10次迭代内收敛到稳定属性集；结构类型分配准确率82%；值抽取F1为0.8。四个LLM家族中，较小指令微调模型随规模增大抽取性能显著提升。

Conclusion: 可自动发现与人类识别相当的高质量属性，经济且大规模地构建结构化数据集；无需预定义本体的迭代模型驱动模式归纳为主题语料挖掘提供了实用可扩展的基础。

Abstract: Thematic corpora, such as social media communities, contain unstructured text describing data that could be made structured. These include, for example, personal attributes, behaviors, and experiences mentioned in social media data. Extracting structured data is challenging as relevant attributes are often implicit, domain-dependent, and unknown in advance. We propose a fully automated, iterative framework for discovering and extracting domain-specific attribute schemas without a predefined ontology. Using large language models (LLMs), the framework induces candidate attributes, sequentially consolidates semantically overlapping attributes, and assigns a structural type. These enable creating an ontology and populating it with values from the corpus. The framework also enables the use of smaller LLMs for value extraction with estimable accuracy loss compared to large LLMs. We evaluate the framework on 5 health-related Reddit communities. Discovered attributes achieved 61% agreement with human-identified attributes, close to the 62% agreement between independent annotators. In most cases, the algorithm converges to a stable attribute set in fewer than 10 iterations. Structural type assignment achieves 82% accuracy, and value extraction reaches an F1 score of 0.8 compared to human annotations. Across four LLM families, smaller instruction-tuned models show statistically significant improvements in extraction performance with model scale when evaluated against a high-capacity reference LLM, supporting informed accuracy-cost trade-offs. These results show that attributes comparable to those identified by humans can be discovered automatically, enabling the creation of high-quality structured datasets economically and at scale. By removing the need for predefined ontologies, iterative model-driven schema induction offers a practical and scalable foundation for mining thematic corpora.

</details>


### [330] [From Rules to Neural Graphs: Scalable Structured Prediction for Patent Prior Art Search](https://arxiv.org/abs/2610.01553)
*Nikolai Zenovkin,Sebastian Björkqvist*

Main category: cs.IR

TL;DR: 提出神经解析器，用局部双仿射注意力直接从专利文本预测发明图谱，复杂度从O(n²)降至O(n·w)，可在超长文档上部署并提升检索召回。


<details>
  <summary>Details</summary>
Motivation: 专利检索需处理超长文档（常超数万token），主流神经检索对输入截断导致效果受限；基于图谱的检索以结构化发明图谱表示专利，但图谱构建依赖脆弱的规则解析器。

Method: 将依存句法分析中的双仿射注意力迁移用于直接从专利文本预测发明图谱；采用局部双仿射注意力，把成对打分限制在滑动窗口内，复杂度由O(n²)降为O(n·w)；局部与全局打分共享同一组权重，因而可在短序列上训练、在超4万token文档上直接部署而无需重训；并以100万份规则解析文档进行蒸馏。

Result: 以3倍更低的推理成本超越其教师模型；在下游Graph Transformer检索系统中，神经图谱使短查询的引用召回提升0.5%，完整文档提升1.1%。

Conclusion: 神经解析器可高效构建专利发明图谱，突破超长输入限制，并优于规则解析的教师模型，验证了其在长文档专利检索中的实用价值。

Abstract: Patent search requires processing documents routinely exceeding tens of thousands of tokens. Most neural retrieval approaches operate on truncated inputs, limiting their effectiveness. Graph-based retrieval addresses this by representing each patent as a structured invention graph, but constructing these graphs relies on brittle rule-based parsers. We present the neural parser, which adapts biaffine attention from dependency parsing to predict invention graphs directly from patent text. Our local biaffine attention restricts pairwise scoring to a sliding window, reducing complexity from $O(n^2)$ to $O(n \cdot w)$. Since local and global scoring share the same weights, the model trains on short sequences and deploys on documents exceeding 40,000 tokens without retraining. Distilled from 1 million rule-parsed documents, it surpasses its teacher at 3$\times$ lower inference cost: neural graphs improve citation recall by 0.5% on short queries and 1.1% on full documents in a downstream Graph Transformer retrieval system.

</details>


### [331] [AgentWebRec: Compact Evidence Fusion over the Agent Web for Personalized Recommendation](https://arxiv.org/abs/2610.01705)
*Haoran Qiang,Guannan Liu,Liang Zhang,Junjie Wu*

Main category: cs.IR

TL;DR: 该文提出 AgentWebRec，将基于 LLM 智能体的推荐重构为有限证据预算下的“任务时证据获取与融合”问题，在保持各智能体记忆本地化的前提下，逐步获取并融合分布式证据以支撑每次用户—物品决策。


<details>
  <summary>Details</summary>
Motivation: LLM 个人智能体正成为用户语义的持久载体及用户与推荐平台之间的中介，本地掌握更丰富的用户知识。随着智能体之间相互交互，传统的“用户—平台”关系演变为“用户—智能体网络—平台”的信息通路，使用户侧分布式信息得以补充物品侧信息。但该新通路对传统推荐构成挑战：证据分散在彼此不透明的智能体中，仅能通过受限查询触及；其中仅小部分与当前推荐决策相关；且不同智能体返回的响应语义异构。因此需要新的推荐范式而非依赖聚合数据学习。

Method: 将智能体网络上的推荐重新表述为有限证据预算下的任务时证据获取与融合问题，核心是决定“问什么”和“保留什么”。提出 AgentWebRec——面向用户—智能体的框架，为每个用户—物品决策逐步获取并融合分布式证据，同时保持底层智能体记忆的本地性。具体地，以平台提供的物品语义与目标用户智能体私有记忆中任务相关的证据作为决策基础，当本地证据不足时，有条件地向邻近用户智能体查询互补的偏好模式。

Result: 在四个 InstructRec 数据集上的实验表明，AgentWebRec 持续优于基线推荐器；消融实验验证各证据层带来互补增益。

Conclusion: 面向智能体网络的推荐可从传统的集中式数据学习转向任务时的分布式证据获取与融合，在证据预算受限与智能体记忆本地化的约束下仍能有效提升推荐表现，且多层证据具有互补作用。

Abstract: LLM-based personal agents are emerging as persistent carriers of user semantics and intermediaries between users and recommendation platforms, maintaining richer user knowledge locally. As agents interact with one another, the conventional \textit{User--Platform} relation evolves into a \textit{User--Agent Web--Platform} information pathway, enabling distributed user-side information to complement item-side information. This new pathway, however, defies conventional recommendation: evidence is scattered across mutually opaque agents and reachable only through bounded queries, only a small portion of it is relevant to the current recommendation decision, and the responses returned by different agents are semantically heterogeneous. We therefore recast recommendation over the agent web as a \emph{task-time evidence acquisition and fusion} problem under a finite evidence budget by deciding what to ask and what to keep, rather than learning from aggregated data. We propose AgentWebRec, a user-agent-oriented framework that progressively acquires and fuses distributed evidence for each user-item decision while keeping underlying agent memories local. It grounds each decision in platform-provided item semantics and task-relevant evidence from the target user agent's private memory, and conditionally queries neighboring user agents for complementary preference patterns when local evidence is insufficient. Experiments on four InstructRec datasets show that AgentWebRec consistently outperforms baseline recommenders, and ablations verify that the evidence layers contribute complementary gains.

</details>


### [332] [Optimizing Effective Training Time for Large-Scale Recommendation Systems](https://arxiv.org/abs/2610.02057)
*Mingming Ding,Ruilin Chen,Yuzhen Huang,Hang Qi,Menglu Yu,San Tan,Damian Reeves,Boris Sarana,Kevin Tang,Satendra Gera,Gagan Jain,Sahil Shah,Vishwa Karia,Fuzail Khan,Yashasvi Makin,Edward Z. Yang,Oguz Ulgen,Jia Chen Ren,Laith Sakka,Mayank Garg,Meet Vadakkanchery,Aici Lin,Wei Sun,Mengjiao Zhou,Shuai Yang,Junqing Zhou,Max Leung,Apoorv Purwar,Musharaf Sultan,John Bocharov,Zhenyu Tang,Vivek Trehan*

Main category: cs.IR

TL;DR: 本文针对大规模推荐模型训练集群中"生命周期开销"（lifecycle overhead）导致的加速器算力浪费问题展开系统性研究，提出以有效训练时间占比（ETT%）为运营框架来量化与定位损失时间，并给出贯穿训练全栈的一系列优化措施。


<details>
  <summary>Details</summary>
Motivation: 在日均处理数百亿训练样本、运行于数千块GPU之上的最大推荐训练负载中，端到端墙钟时间仅有50-60%真正用于在新数据上推进训练，其余时间被生命周期开销静默消耗。这些开销分散在多个独立负责的基础设施组件中，且存在跨作业重启的重复工作，难以被传统的单一环节监控所发现和归因。

Method: 以ETT%（Effective Training Time）作为运营框架对损失时间进行打点度量和归因，将其本地化到各独立拥有的基础设施组件，并暴露作业重启中重复的工作；据此设计覆盖全训练栈的优化，包括训练器初始化阶段的通信消除与流水线重叠、动态形状处理、autotuning剪枝、可复用的PyTorch 2编译缓存、异步checkpointing、独立模型发布（standalone model publishing）以及恢复（recovery）成本降低。

Result: 在代表性模型上评估这些优化，并在实际训练集群中测量其影响：所有基准上ETT%均有提升，平均提升15.5%，在最大的工作负载上达到85%；部署后全集群ETT%从约80%上升至90%以上。

Conclusion: 生命周期开销是可被系统性量化、归因和优化的可观算力损失来源；通过以ETT%为统一运营指标并实施全栈协同优化，可显著提升大规模推荐训练集群的有效训练时间占比，从而提升整体加速器利用率。

Abstract: Lifecycle overhead silently consumes accelerator capacity across large-scale recommendation training fleets. Our largest recommendation workloads process tens of billions train- ing examples per day on thousands of GPUs. Before this work, only 50-60% of their end-to-end wall time advanced training on new data. We present a fleet-scale study of this lifecycle overhead and a set of optimizations spanning the full training stack. We use Effective Training Time (ETT%) as an operational framework to instrument lost time, localize it to independently owned infrastructure components, and expose work repeated across job restarts. This analysis guides optimizations like communication elimination and pipeline overlap during trainer initialization; dynamic-shape handling, autotuning pruning, and reusable Py- Torch 2 compilation caches; asynchronous checkpointing; stan- dalone model publishing; and reductions in recovery cost. We evaluate the optimizations on representative models and measure their impacts in our training fleet. ETT% improves on every benchmark, by 15.5% on average, and reaches 85% on our largest workload. Fleet-wide ETT% rose from about 80% to above 90% after deployment.

</details>


<div id='cs.MM'></div>

# cs.MM [[Back]](#toc)

### [333] [Supporting Perspective Acquisition and Opinion Formation on Societal Issues Through AI-Generated Japanese Rap Battle Debates](https://arxiv.org/abs/2610.01179)
*Ryota Mibayashi,Toru Urakawa,Dai Takanashi,Tomoya Morohoshi,Kanata Yamagishi,Ryuho Sekikawa,Yasuhiko Nishimura,Yuta Takeuchi,Hideaki Tamori,Takehiro Yamamoto,Hidenari Kiyomitsu,Hiroaki Ohshima*

Main category: cs.MM

TL;DR: 研究表明，约1.5分钟的AI生成说唱对决式辩论（GPT-5.4-mini生成、配合成语音）能将近乎翻倍参与者识别出的观点与论点数量，并在52.5%的评估案例中促使参与者重新考量或改变立场。


<details>
  <summary>Details</summary>
Motivation: 获取多元视角并就社会议题形成有依据的观点，是批判性思维与明智决策的基础。观察对立观点间的辩论虽有助于视角获取，但传统辩论耗费大量时间与人力，可及性受限。因此作者探索一种低成本、短时长的替代形式。

Method: 采用说唱对决（rap battle）这一以押韵唱词表达对立观点、同时保留论证对话结构的辩论表演形式。使用GPT-5.4-mini自动生成说唱对决式辩论文本，并通过合成语音与网页浏览界面呈现。以全日本初高中辩论锦标赛使用过的社会议题为题，生成40段辩论，开展6名参与者的用户研究进行评估。

Result: 观看约1.5分钟的说唱对决式辩论后，参与者识别出的意见与讨论要点数量近乎翻倍；在受评估案例中，52.5%的情况下参与者重新考虑或改变了原有立场。

Conclusion: 即便时长极短的AI生成说唱对决式辩论，也能有效支持社会议题上的视角获取与观点形成。

Abstract: Acquiring diverse perspectives and forming informed opinions on societal issues are essential for critical thinking and informed decision-making. Although observing debates between opposing viewpoints can promote perspective acquisition, conventional debates require substantial time and human resources, limiting their accessibility. This study investigates whether brief AI-generated rap battle-style debates can support perspective acquisition and opinion formation on societal issues. Rap battles are debate-style performances in which opposing viewpoints are expressed through rhymed verses, making them engaging while preserving the structure of argumentative dialogue. To conduct this investigation, we automatically generated rap battle-style debates using GPT-5.4-mini and presented them to participants with synthesized audio through a web-based viewing interface. We evaluated the educational effectiveness of this approach through a user study involving six participants who viewed 40 debates generated from topics on societal issues used in the All Japan Junior and Senior High School Debate Championships. The results showed that watching approximately 1.5 minute rap battle-style debates nearly doubled the number of opinions and discussion points identified by participants. Furthermore, participants reconsidered or changed their stances in 52.5% of the evaluated cases. These findings demonstrate that even brief AI-generated rap battle-style debates can effectively support perspective acquisition and opinion formation on societal issues.

</details>


<div id='cs.NE'></div>

# cs.NE [[Back]](#toc)

### [334] [Multi-Behavioral Evolved Substrates Through Neuromodulation and Activation Selection](https://arxiv.org/abs/2610.00148)
*Romain Claret,Michael O'Neill,Paul Cotofrei,Kilian Stoffel*

Main category: cs.NE

TL;DR: 研究通过超过10,000次CPPN间接编码进化实验发现，仅靠神经调质无法突破奇偶校验任务的进化搜索壁垒（单调激活函数下成功率上限75%），需将激活函数选择本身作为可进化性状与神经调质结合，才能实现100%多任务成功。


<details>
  <summary>Details</summary>
Motivation: 开放式人工生命系统需从单一进化基因型中获得多种能力。生物大脑结合了神经调质（在不改变连接的情况下重构回路）与匹配特定计算角色的多样神经元类型，本文探究人工进化能否在间接编码基质中实现类似机制。

Method: 使用CPPN进化间接编码基质，进行超过10,000次实验；先测试仅含神经调质的方案，再引入逐任务激活函数选择（振荡原语匹配奇偶校验任务、单调函数匹配阈值任务），并与Adam梯度下降作对照，同时检验向高阶与非对称任务的泛化性及多层深度的替代路径。

Result: 仅神经调质时，单调激活函数在奇偶校验任务上存在75%成功率上限，且不随容量、拓扑或种群规模改变；该壁垒属进化搜索而非表征限制，因Adam梯度下降在相同架构上可达100%。结合神经调质与激活函数选择后，30个种子全部实现100%同时5任务成功（中位14代）。该结论在所有4种振荡激活函数上均成立（各30个种子）。壁垒延伸至高阶与非对称任务，多层深度可提供替代路径。

Conclusion: 对开放式进化而言，计算原语本身应作为可进化性状；两种机制单独均不充分。推理阶段，单一进化基因型可表达多种行为。

Abstract: Open-ended artificial life systems must acquire diverse competencies from a single evolving genotype. Biological brains combine neuromodulation, which reconfigures circuits without changing connections, with diverse neuron types matched to specific computational roles. Can artificial evolution achieve something analogous in indirectly encoded substrates?
  Using indirectly encoded substrates evolved via CPPNs, we show through more than 10,000 experiments that neuromodulation alone is insufficient: under evolutionary search, monotonic activation functions impose a 75% ceiling on parity tasks that persists regardless of capacity, topology, or population size. This is an evolutionary search barrier, not a representational limit, since Adam gradient descent achieves 100% on the identical architecture.
  We combine neuromodulation with per-task activation function selection, matching oscillatory primitives to parity tasks and monotonic to threshold tasks, producing multi-behavioral evolved substrates. The result: 100% simultaneous 5-task success across all 30 seeds (median 14 generations). This generalizes across the oscillatory activation class: all four functions reach 100% (30 seeds each). Neither mechanism suffices alone.
  The barrier extends to higher-arity and asymmetric tasks, while multi-layer depth provides an alternative path. For open-ended evolution, the computational primitive should itself be an evolvable trait. At inference, one evolved genotype expresses many behaviors.

</details>


### [335] [Per-Node Activation Function Evolution in Indirectly Encoded Substrates: Solvability, Limits, and Emergent Diversity](https://arxiv.org/abs/2610.00149)
*Romain Claret,Michael O'Neill,Paul Cotofrei,Kilian Stoffel*

Main category: cs.NE

TL;DR: 生物神经元具备多种特化类型，而人工网络通常对所有节点施加统一激活函数。本文通过间接编码演化，为每个节点从18种函数库中分配激活函数，跨越4500余次实验发现：在稀疏演化基底上，单调函数无法解决除XOR外的更高阶奇偶问题，而单个振荡单元即可在所有测试规模下胜任。该鸿沟源于搜索与稀疏性而非表征能力，且可被递归结构或梯度下降消除。


<details>
  <summary>Details</summary>
Motivation: 生物神经元通过类型特化（强直、爆发、适应、快速放电等）实现计算多样性，而人工神经网络对所有节点统一使用单一激活函数，限制了其表征能力。作者希望探究这种"激活函数均匀性"对演化搜索施加的硬性限制，并检验异质激活函数分配是否能拓展演化可解问题的边界。

Method: 在间接编码框架下，为每个节点从包含18种函数的函数库中演化分配激活函数；在超过4500次实验运行中覆盖布尔逻辑、回归与空间分类任务。单独测试18种函数在Parity-4上的表现，并对比递归结构与梯度下降两种条件下的结果。

Result: 在Parity-4上呈现三层可解性结构：振荡函数达100%，中间函数6.7%–80%，全部9种单调函数均为0%。在稀疏演化基底上，单调函数无法解决XOR以外的最小实例，而单个振荡单元在所有测试规模下均足够。该分界并非普遍存在：递归结构可使其崩塌，梯度下降则完全反转该结论。单调网络本身可用适量隐藏单元表征奇偶，梯度下降能恢复该解。

Conclusion: 网络可用何种激活函数，与其拓扑和权重一样，决定了演化搜索能够解决何种问题。该障碍特异地存在于稀疏基底的演化搜索中，而非表征能力不足。间接编码能够发现手工难以选择的异质逐节点激活函数分配，凸显了激活函数多样性对演化计算的重要意义。

Abstract: Biological neurons achieve computational diversity through specialized types: tonic, bursting, adapting, and fast-spiking cells coexist within the same circuit. Artificial neural networks, by contrast, apply a single activation function uniformly to all nodes, which limits what they can represent. We show that this uniformity creates hard limits for evolutionary search: across sparse evolved substrates, monotonic functions fail to solve parity beyond its smallest instance, XOR, while a single oscillatory unit suffices at all tested scales. The gap is one of search and sparsity, not representation: monotonic networks can represent parity with a modest number of hidden units, and gradient descent recovers that solution. We evolve, to our knowledge for the first time in indirect encoding, per-node activation function assignments from an 18-function palette across more than 4,500 experimental runs spanning Boolean logic, regression, and spatial classification.
  Testing each of the 18 functions individually on Parity-4 reveals a three-tier solvability structure: oscillatory functions achieve 100%, intermediate functions 6.7-80%, and all 9 monotonic functions 0%. This divide is not universal. Recurrence collapses it, and gradient descent inverts it entirely, showing that the barrier is specific to evolutionary search in sparse substrates. What activation functions a network can use, beyond its topology and weights, determines what evolutionary search can solve. Indirect encoding discovers heterogeneous per-node activation assignments unlikely to be chosen by hand.

</details>


### [336] [Neuromorphic Pseudo-Random Number Generators with a Low Power Hardware Implementation](https://arxiv.org/abs/2610.00719)
*Jafar Shamsi,Navid Akbari,Sonia Sennik,Aaron Gruber,Wilten Nicola*

Main category: cs.NE

TL;DR: 该研究构建了基于兴奋-抑制平衡的脉冲神经网络混沌动力学模型，并在低功耗FPGA上实现神经形态伪随机数发生器（NPRNG），以3.24 mW功耗实现120 kbps生成速率，输出通过标准随机性检验。


<details>
  <summary>Details</summary>
Motivation: 传统伪随机数生成需在质量、功耗与带宽之间权衡。大脑能通过高维状态中的复杂网络动力学高效产生不可预测输出，该状态被假设为混沌，并依赖兴奋与抑制的平衡。作者由此设想：若用计算模型复现这种混沌平衡态，或可为低功耗硬件提供高质量的伪随机源。

Method: 建立由漏电积分-发放（LIF）神经元组成的平衡脉冲神经网络模型，使网络处于兴奋-抑制平衡的混沌状态；将该模型适配为易于在低功耗FPGA上部署的实现，构建神经形态伪随机数发生器（NPRNG）原型，并与软件实例对照，采用标准RNG质量指标评估随机性。

Result: 硬件NPRNG原型运行时功耗为3.24 mW，伪随机数生成速率为120 kbps；在硬件与软件实现中，NPRNG均能产出高质量随机数，并通过标准随机数发生器质量测试指标验证。

Conclusion: 混沌平衡脉冲神经网络可作为低功耗神经形态伪随机数发生器的有效计算基础，在功耗、带宽与随机性质量之间提供可行折中，具备硬件落地潜力。

Abstract: Pseudo-random number generation often requires trade-offs among quality, power consumption, and bandwidth to produce unpredictable sequences of numbers. The brain, on the other hand, efficiently generates unpredictable output complex network dynamics occurring in a high-dimensional state. This state, which is hypothesized to be chaotic, relies on the balance between excitation and inhibition. Here, we investigated if computational models of these chaotic balanced states can be harnessed for Neuromorphic Pseudo-Random Number Generators (NPRNGs) in low power hardware. We successfully constructed a balanced spiking neural network model consisting of leaky-integrate-and-fire neurons that could be readily implemented in low power FPGAs and used as a NPRNG. The prototyped NPRNG consumed 3.24 mW during operation and produced pseudo-random numbers at 120kbps. In both hardware and software instantiations, NPRNGs produce high-quality random numbers as validated by standard metrics for testing RNG quality.

</details>


### [337] [Inherited Learning in an Artificial Ecology: How Controls and Update Allocation Shape Benefits](https://arxiv.org/abs/2610.01232)
*Xuening Wu,Lei Li,Shan Yu*

Main category: cs.NE

TL;DR: 在资源受限的人工生态中，通过结构化随机对照与遗传更新分配干预，区分"继承偏好"的真实收益与对照设计及更新分配带来的假象。


<details>
  <summary>Details</summary>
Motivation: 个体死亡后被替换会导致群体丢失已学到的经验，继承学习偏好可跨代保留有用行为。但继承不仅改变后代行为，还改变存活、繁殖及后续遗传更新机会，因此等更新幅度的随机对照若改变不同状态或受不同稳定性约束，会产生误导性比较。论文旨在回答：继承何时提升集体表现，以及如何公平度量其收益。

Method: 构建资源受限的人工生态；采用保持状态结构的结构化随机对照；对新生个体偏好与遗传更新分配进行干预；并设置偏好擦除、加速学习补偿、事件配额、共同时间截断等条件；在更新次数与累积幅度匹配下检验分阶段释放的效果。

Result: 保持随机更新的状态结构后，表观继承优势大幅缩小，仅残留条件性的"建立速度"收益；偏好擦除与加速学习补偿支持"减少后代重学习"这一贡献来源；更新分配方式（事件配额、共同时间截断）可逆转排序，但同时也改变了实际更新量；在更新次数与累积幅度匹配时，分阶段释放提升占据率，但未达到预设的建立标准。

Conclusion: 继承偏好的价值必须与控制设计和更新分配效应相分离；本文提出的框架有助于在人工群体中更公平地评估"继承学习"，并为相关实验与指标设计提供规范。

Abstract: Learning can improve an individual's behavior, yet a population risks losing that experience whenever individuals die and are replaced. Inheriting learned preferences offers a way to preserve useful behavior across generations, raising a question for artificial populations: when does inheritance improve collective performance, and how can its benefits be measured fairly? The challenge is that inheritance changes not only offspring behavior but also survival, reproduction, and opportunities for further hereditary updates. Random controls with equal update magnitudes may therefore yield misleading comparisons if they alter different states or obey different stability constraints. We investigate this problem in a resource-limited artificial ecology, combining structured random controls with interventions on newborn preferences and the allocation of hereditary updates. Preserving the state structure of random updates substantially narrows the apparent inheritance advantage, while a conditional establishment-speed benefit remains. Preference erasure and faster-learning compensation support a contribution from reduced offspring relearning. Update allocation also changes the comparison: event quotas and common time cutoffs can reverse rankings, although they also change realized update amounts. With update count and cumulative magnitudes matched, staged release improves occupancy but does not achieve the prespecified establishment criterion. These findings provide a framework for distinguishing the value of inherited preferences from the effects of control design and update allocation, clarifying how inherited learning should be evaluated in artificial populations.

</details>


### [338] [LESS: Lightweight Evolutionary Supernet Search in Minutes](https://arxiv.org/abs/2610.01468)
*Aviral Gandhi,Jinglue Xu,Jialong Li,Hitoshi Iba*

Main category: cs.NE

TL;DR: 提出LESS（轻量级进化超网搜索），通过短时公平硬路径预热与单一CMA-ES分布下的离散搜索结合，在极低搜索成本下实现有竞争力的NAS性能。


<details>
  <summary>Details</summary>
Motivation: 低成本NAS需同时高效探索高性能架构并可靠识别它们，但降低评估成本往往削弱候选比较的保真度；免训练方法用初始化时的代理信号替代任务反馈，虽降低评估成本却牺牲了比较的可靠性。

Method: LESS将短暂的、公平的硬路径预训练与单一CMA-ES分布下的离散搜索相结合。每个候选方案以其解码后的硬基因型进行评估，评估前先进行六次候选条件化的超网更新，从而在轻量更新与真实任务反馈之间取得平衡。

Result: 在NAS-Bench-201上，LESS达到93.189±0.467%的CIFAR-10测试精度，仅耗时409.1秒，与FairNAS相差0.04个百分点但搜索时间约为其1/24。对照实验显示校准使选中的验证精度提升0.577个百分点，而最优访问精度仅变化0.054点，说明主要作用是降低选择遗憾。冻结配置无需调参迁移至CIFAR-100和ImageNet16-120，精度分别为69.615±1.139%和43.720±1.697%。在更大的DARTS空间上无需调参即达到CIFAR-10 96.95±0.14%、CIFAR-100 82.43±0.80%，单GPU每次搜索约43.5分钟。

Conclusion: 短时、平衡、数据依赖的更新使NAS能够在数分钟内跨数据集与搜索空间取得有竞争力的结果，证明轻量校准能有效降低选择遗憾而非提升探索上限。

Abstract: Low-cost NAS must both explore high-performing architectures and identify them reliably, yet reducing evaluation cost often weakens the fidelity of candidate comparisons. Training-free methods reduce evaluation cost by replacing learned task feedback with proxy signals measured at initialization. We introduce LESS (Lightweight Evolutionary Supernet Search), a data-driven method that combines a brief fair hard-path warm-up with discrete search under a single CMA-ES distribution. Each proposal is evaluated as its decoded hard genotype after six candidate-conditioned supernet updates. On NAS-Bench-201, LESS achieves \(93.189\pm0.467\%\) CIFAR-10 test accuracy in 409.1 seconds, coming within 0.04 percentage points of FairNAS using approximately \(1/24\) of its source-reported search time. Matched controls show that calibration improves selected validation accuracy by \(0.577\) percentage points while changing best-visited accuracy by only \(0.054\) points, indicating that its primary effect is to reduce selection regret. The frozen configuration transfers without tuning to CIFAR-100 and ImageNet16-120 with \(69.615\pm1.139\%\) and \(43.720\pm1.697\%\) accuracy. Applied without tuning to the larger DARTS space, LESS achieves \(96.95\pm0.14\%\) on CIFAR-10 and \(82.43\pm0.80\%\) on CIFAR-100, with each search completing in approximately 43.5 minutes on a single GPU. Together, these results show that short, balanced, data-dependent updates enable competitive neural architecture search across datasets and search spaces within minutes.

</details>


### [339] [Controllable Stochastic Quantization Encoding for Adversarially Robust Spiking Neural Networks](https://arxiv.org/abs/2610.01558)
*Yujia Liu,Peiyu Liu,Yajing Zheng,Tiejun Huang*

Main category: cs.NE

TL;DR: 本文提出一种随机量化编码方法，通过在输入编码阶段引入可调控的随机性，提升脉冲神经网络（SNN）的对抗鲁棒性。


<details>
  <summary>Details</summary>
Motivation: SNN虽在图像分类中表现良好，但易受对抗攻击。现有防御方法多集中于训练策略，而输入编码的作用尚未被充分探索。作者观察到Poisson编码相较直接编码的鲁棒性优势可能源于其固有随机性，据此提出改进思路。

Method: 提出随机量化编码方法，通过量化尺度调节引入可控随机性来编码输入图像；并证明该方法是通用框架，在不同量化尺度选择下可退化为Poisson编码和直接编码。由于作用于输入编码阶段，可与现有基于训练的防御方法结合使用。

Result: 在CIFAR-10和CIFAR-100上的实验结果验证了所提随机量化编码方法的有效性。

Conclusion: 该工作强调了输入编码对SNN对抗鲁棒性的重要性，为理解和提升SNN鲁棒性提供了新视角。

Abstract: Spiking Neural Networks (SNNs) have attracted increasing attention due to their impressive temporal dynamics, energy efficiency, and brain-inspired mechanisms. Although SNNs have demonstrated promising performance in image classification tasks, recent studies have shown that they remain vulnerable to adversarial attacks, where imperceptible perturbations are added to input images to mislead model predictions. Existing defense methods mainly focus on training strategies, while the role of input encoding remains less explored. An observation is that the robustness advantage of Poisson encoding over direct encoding may benefit from its inherent randomness. Motivated by this, we propose a stochastic quantization encoding method that encodes the input image with controllable randomness adjusted by the quantization scale, thereby improving the adversarial robustness of SNNs. We further show that this method constitutes a general framework that reduces to both Poisson encoding and direct encoding under different choices of the quantization scale. Since it enhances robustness at the input encoding stage, it can be combined with existing training-based defenses for further gains. Experimental results on CIFAR-10 and CIFAR-100 demonstrate the effectiveness of the proposed stochastic quantization encoding method. To sum up, this work highlights the importance of input encoding for the adversarial robustness of SNNs, providing a new perspective for understanding and improving it.

</details>


### [340] [Continual Reinforcement Learning with Neuroevolution](https://arxiv.org/abs/2610.01583)
*Eleni Nisioti,Andrea Cossu,Kathrin Korte,Sebastian Risi*

Main category: cs.NE

TL;DR: 该研究通过神经进化（NE）替代传统强化学习（RL）优化范式，系统比较进化策略（ES）与遗传算法（GA）同最先进连续RL方法在多环境任务变化下的表现，发现ES在稳定性-可塑性权衡上表现最佳，GA可塑性最强但遗忘更多，并用权重空间的回报景观与邻域重叠解释该现象。


<details>
  <summary>Details</summary>
Motivation: 连续任务变化下的强化学习存在可塑性损失问题，且现有RL方法难以在适应性与遗忘之间取得稳定平衡，因此作者转向神经进化这一直接搜索权重空间的替代优化范式，探索其是否能更好地应对连续学习中的稳定性-可塑性权衡。

Method: 在多种环境和环境变化下，涵盖从数百参数到百万参数网络的策略，将进化策略（ES）和遗传算法（GA）与最先进的连续RL变体及基于群体的RL进行对比；并分析各方法解周围的回报景观，测量扰动后仍能求解任务的权重空间邻域宽度，以及连续任务邻域之间的重叠大小；此外，通过新颖性搜索在GA中奖励行为多样性。

Result: ES最稳定地实现了良好的稳定性-可塑性权衡；GA可塑性最强但遗忘比ES更多；ES找到最宽的邻域，连续任务邻域重叠的大小与方法稳定性-可塑性权衡相关；新颖性搜索使GA群体更具可塑性但代价是遗忘增加；RL中常见的可塑性损失症状并未迁移到NE。

Conclusion: 神经进化是连续任务变化下RL的有竞争力替代方案，权重空间扰动下的训练可能是一种更广泛适用于连续学习的机制。

Abstract: Despite many studies about causes and remedies of plasticity loss in Reinforcement Learning (RL) under continual task changes, no RL method has yet consistently achieved a good balance between adaptation and forgetting. Here we turn to an alternative optimization paradigm, neuroevolution (NE): algorithms that search directly in weight space through mutation and selection over a population of neural networks. Across a wide array of environments and environmental changes, with policies ranging from a few hundred parameters to million-parameter networks, we compare evolution strategies (ES) and genetic algorithms (GAs) against state-of-the-art continual RL variants and population-based RL. ES most consistently achieves a good stability-plasticity trade-off, while the GA is the most plastic method but forgets more than ES. To explain this, we study the return landscape around each method's solutions. ES finds the widest neighborhoods, i.e.\ regions of weight space in which perturbed policies still solve the task, and the size of the overlap between the neighborhoods of consecutive tasks correlates with a method's stability-plasticity trade-off. Rewarding behavioral diversity in a GA through novelty search makes the population even more plastic, at the cost of forgetting. Finally, symptoms of plasticity loss commonly reported in RL do not transfer to NE. Overall, these results establish NE as a competitive alternative to RL under continual task changes, and suggest that training under perturbations in weight space may be a useful mechanism for continual learning more broadly.

</details>


### [341] [TRACE: Tackling Real-World Resource Assignment Problems via Agentic Heuristic Design](https://arxiv.org/abs/2610.01887)
*Jose A. Ayala-Romero,Andres Garcia-Saavedra,Xavier Costa-Perez*

Main category: cs.NE

TL;DR: 提出TRACE框架，将进化式自动启发式设计（AHD）与智能体知识抽取流程耦合，利用系统日志中的过程信息（而非仅标量适应度）指导启发式生成，在合成云基准与5G vRAN场景中的资源分配问题上超越现有AHD方法，开销低于2%。


<details>
  <summary>Details</summary>
Motivation: 动态资源分配是计算基础设施的核心，工业界仍依赖人工编写规则，因其可读、可审计且满足严苛时延。基于LLM的自动启发式设计（AHD）可自动化这一过程，但现有方法面向"完全指定"的组合问题，仅从标量适应度学习。实际系统中决定启发式优劣的因素（如处理器速度、功耗）先验未知，分数只说明"哪个更好"而不解释"为何更好"。这一缺失信息记录在每次评估产生的系统日志中，但日志体量庞大、噪声多，相关信号依目标而异，格式跨软硬件栈变化，无法直接投喂LLM或用固定解析器处理。

Method: TRACE将进化式AHD循环与智能体知识抽取工作流耦合。其中Reasoner智能体结合目标分析日志schema并提出关于系统动态的假设；Coder智能体编写并执行针对该schema的代码来验证假设，产出洞见或可供进化启发式直接使用的可执行工具。由此把原始日志转化为结构化、可迁移的知识以指导启发式演化。

Result: 在合成云基准和基于工业测试台测量与运营流量轨迹构建的5G vRAN场景上进行评估。TRACE在资源分配问题上持续优于现有最优AHD方法，并产出可审计性更强的启发式，额外开销低于2%。

Conclusion: TRACE表明，将日志等过程性信息通过智能体化的知识抽取纳入AHD循环，可在不牺牲时延预算的前提下提升启发式质量与可审计性，为工业级动态资源分配的自动规则设计提供了可行路径。

Abstract: Dynamic resource assignment, the real-time allocation of task streams to heterogeneous processing nodes, is the backbone of modern computing infrastructure. While learning-based schedulers excel in research, industrial deployments still rely on hand-written rules that operators can read, audit, and execute within tight latency budgets. LLM-based Automatic Heuristic Design (AHD) promises to automate writing such rules. However, existing AHD frameworks were developed for combinatorial problems fully specified to the LLM, and they learn only from a scalar fitness score. In real systems, the behaviour that determines a good heuristic, such as processor speeds or power consumption, is unknown a priori: the score reveals which heuristic performs better, but not why. This missing information is recorded in the system logs that every evaluation produces. Exploiting it is non-trivial: logs are massive and noisy, the relevant signals depend on the objective, and their content and format vary across hardware and software stacks, so they can neither be fed to an LLM as is nor processed by a fixed parser. We propose TRACE, which couples an evolutionary AHD loop with an agentic knowledge-extraction workflow. A Reasoner agent analyzes the log schema in light of the objective and formulates hypotheses about the system dynamics; a Coder agent writes and executes schema-specific code to test them, producing insights or executable tools for the evolved heuristics. We evaluate TRACE on a synthetic cloud benchmark and a 5G vRAN scenario built from industrial testbed measurements and operational traffic traces. TRACE consistently outperforms state-of-the-art AHD methods in resource assignment problems and yields more auditable heuristics at under 2% overhead.

</details>


<div id='cs.LG'></div>

# cs.LG [[Back]](#toc)

### [342] [Uncertainty-Aware RL-Controlled Adaptive 3D Mapping](https://arxiv.org/abs/2610.00188)
*Alpay Ozkan,Tunc Ozan Aydin,Marc Pollefeys,Jelena Trisovic,Daniel Barath*

Main category: cs.LG

TL;DR: 提出基于语义熵、几何曲率和纹理丰富度的自适应体素细分框架，并用强化学习智能体在用户指定内存预算下学习细分策略，实现多分辨率TSDF，精度、语义一致性和内存-精度权衡均优于MAP-ADAPT与固定分辨率基线。


<details>
  <summary>Details</summary>
Motivation: 体素体积建图是3D重建的基础，但固定分辨率网格效率低：均匀区域浪费内存，复杂区域丢失细节。现有自适应方法（如MAP-ADAPT）依赖几何与用户定义的语义类别列表，需专家调参、缺乏对未见物体的泛化能力，且无显式内存控制机制。

Method: 以语义熵（捕捉标签不确定性）结合几何曲率和纹理丰富度作为场景复杂度线索，指导体素细分，摆脱对语义分类体系的依赖；进一步引入强化学习智能体，在用户指定目标内存预算下学习体素细分策略，以单一直观控制参数替代手工调参阈值。

Result: 在合成与真实数据集上，所生成的多分辨率TSDF相比MAP-ADAPT和固定分辨率基线取得了更高的几何精度、更好的语义一致性以及更优的内存-精度权衡。

Conclusion: 通过语义熵等场景复杂度线索与强化学习的显式内存预算控制，实现了原理化、用户可控的自适应体素分辨率分配，克服了启发式方法的调参与泛化局限。代码与模型已开源。

Abstract: Voxel-based volumetric mapping is fundamental to 3D reconstruction, yet fixed-resolution grids remain inherently inefficient - wasting memory in uniform regions and losing detail in complex ones. Existing adaptive methods, such as MAP-ADAPT, partially address this by varying resolution based on geometry and user-defined semantic class lists, but these heuristics require expert tuning, lack generalization to unseen objects, and provide no explicit mechanism to control memory usage. We propose an adaptive framework that refines voxels based on semantic entropy, which captures label uncertainty, together with geometric curvature and texture richness as scene complexity cues, yielding principled resolution allocation without reliance on semantic taxonomies. To make the accuracy-memory trade-off explicit and user-controlled, we further introduce a reinforcement learning agent that learns voxel subdivision policies under a user-specified target memory budget, replacing hand-tuned thresholds with a single intuitive control parameter. The resulting multi-resolution TSDF achieves higher geometric accuracy, better semantic consistency, and improved memory-accuracy trade-offs compared to MAP-ADAPT and fixed-resolution baselines on both synthetic and real-world datasets. Our code and models are available at https://github.com/alpayozkan/UnRL.

</details>


### [343] [Manifold-Constrained Initial Noise Optimization for Efficient Generative Model Alignment](https://arxiv.org/abs/2610.00365)
*Jinho Chang,Jong Chul Ye*

Main category: cs.LG

TL;DR: 本文提出ZeNOVA，一种无梯度的初始噪声对齐方法，通过退火软价值引导、流形约束超球Langevin动力学和Metropolis-Hastings跳跃，在黑盒奖励场景下稳定高效地优化高斯初始噪声，实验证明其在图像和视频生成模型上优于所有零阶基线。


<details>
  <summary>Details</summary>
Motivation: 蒸馏与流映射模型实现了确定性的一步或少步高质量生成，催生了直接优化高斯初始噪声的奖励对齐新方向。但现有初始噪声优化方法多依赖一阶梯度信息，在黑盒奖励场景下要么不适用，要么存在不稳定和低效的问题。

Method: 提出ZeNOVA，一种无梯度的稳定高效初始噪声对齐方法。针对黑盒场景下现有算法的核心挑战，采用三项关键技术：退火软价值引导（annealed soft-value guidance）、流形约束的超球面Langevin动力学（manifold-constrained hyperspherical Langevin dynamics）以及Metropolis-Hastings跳跃（Metropolis-Hastings jumping）。

Result: 在图像和视频生成模型上的大量实验表明，ZeNOVA在将初始噪声优化至更高奖励方面，比所有评估的零阶基线更稳定，同时充分利用了高斯先验的几何结构，性能全面超越这些基线。

Conclusion: ZeNOVA展示了其在各类黑盒奖励对齐任务中的实际适用性，为无梯度初始噪声优化提供了稳定高效的解决方案。

Abstract: Recent advances in distillation and flow-map models have enabled deterministic one- or few-step generation for high-quality data, facilitating a new branch of reward alignment approaches that directly optimize the initial noise from a Gaussian distribution. However, most existing initial-noise optimization methods rely on first-order gradient information, which is either inapplicable or suffers from instability and inefficiency in black-box reward scenarios. Here, we introduce ZeNOVA, a stable and efficient initial noise alignment method in a gradient-free manner. Specifically, we address existing algorithms' major challenge in black-box scenarios through annealed soft-value guidance, manifold-constrained hyperspherical Langevin dynamics, and Metropolis-Hastings jumping. Extensive experiments on image and video generative models show that ZeNOVA outperforms all evaluated zeroth-order baselines by optimizing the initial noise toward higher rewards substantially more stably while exploiting the geometry of the Gaussian prior, demonstrating its practical applicability to various black-box reward alignment.

</details>


### [344] [Right In-Place (RiP) Convolution: A Simple, General, and Near-Optimal Strategy for Memory-Efficient CNN Inference](https://arxiv.org/abs/2610.00586)
*Opegbemi Matthias Busoye,Tolulope Matthew Busoye,Eghonghon-aye Eigbe*

Main category: cs.LG

TL;DR: 本文修正了Gural与Murmann提出的就地卷积闭式解中的两个缺陷，并将其推广至任意步幅、膨胀、填充与矩形卷积核；进而提出RiP卷积，以O(1)断点求值给出最小安全间隙、保持行主序访问，在TinyEngine部署后显著降低峰值激活内存且比特完全一致。


<details>
  <summary>Details</summary>
Motivation: CNN在微控制器等受限硬件上推理时，瓶颈是激活内存而非算力。直接就地卷积可消除双缓冲开销，但现有内存最优闭式解仅适用于有效填充、单位步幅、单位膨胀和奇数方核，且需非顺序遍历，带来2倍推理时间开销。作者发现该闭式解存在两个失效情形：欠分配(k-1)C_in mod (C_out-C_in)个标量导致对仍存活输入的静默破坏，以及在关键边离开输出网格后产生高达2432倍的无界高估。

Method: 修正上述两个缺陷并推广到任意步幅、膨胀、填充和矩形核；提出Right In-Place (RiP)卷积：每层在共享工作区中右对齐读取输入、从索引0左对齐写出输出，保持比特一致。由于占用债务对输出像素索引分段仿射，只需O(1)求值断点即可得到最小安全间隙，无需枚举输出网格，同时保持行主序访问。

Result: 在10000个随机层上RiP未出现破坏；在来自25种架构的84个卷积层中，58个与herringbone工作区完全一致，81个在5%以内，平均比双缓冲少用24.8%内存。写入TinyEngine内核并部署到Raspberry Pi Pico 1和Pico 2后，在11个MCUNet模型上峰值激活内存降低12.5%至33.3%，周期数不变且输出比特一致，使Pico 1的256 KB SRAM可容纳模型数从6个升至9个。

Conclusion: RiP卷积在不牺牲比特一致性与推理速度的前提下，修正并推广了就地卷积的内存最优解，显著降低嵌入式CNN推理的峰值激活内存，提升了受限硬件可部署模型的数量。

Abstract: Activation memory, not compute, limits CNN inference on constrained hardware such as microcontrollers. Direct in-place convolution removes the dual-buffer cost, but the memory-optimal formulation of Gural and Murmann assumes valid padding, unit stride, unit dilation, and odd square kernels, and needs a non-sequential traversal costing $2\times$ inference time in transposes. We identify two regimes in which their published closed form does not hold: (1) an under-allocation of exactly $(k-1)C_{in} \bmod (C_{out}-C_{in})$ scalars, active on every convolutional layer of their own deployed network and manifesting as a silent corruption of still-live input; (2) an unbounded overestimate, up to $2{,}432\times$, once the critical leg leaves the output grid. We correct both and generalize to arbitrary stride, dilation, padding, and rectangular kernels. We then propose Right In-Place (RiP) convolution, a bit-identical operation in which every layer reads its input right-aligned in a shared workspace and writes its output left-aligned from index zero. The debt is piecewise affine in the output pixel index, so evaluating its breakpoints in $O(1)$ yields the minimum safe gap without enumerating the output grid, with row-major access preserved. Across $10{,}000$ random layers RiP produced no corruption, and across 84 convolutional layers from 25 architectures it matches the herringbone workspace exactly on 58 and within 5% on 81, using 24.8% less memory than dual buffering on average. Written into TinyEngine's kernels and deployed to a Raspberry Pi Pico 1 and Pico 2, it cuts peak activation memory across eleven MCUNet models by 12.5 to 33.3% at unchanged cycle counts and bit-identical outputs, raising the number of models that fit the Pico 1's 256 KB SRAM from six to nine.

</details>


### [345] [Curvature Under Attack in hZACH-ViT: Gauge Symmetry, Boundary Saturation, and Adversarial Failure](https://arxiv.org/abs/2610.00680)
*Athanasios Angelakis,Marta Gomez-Barrero*

Main category: cs.LG

TL;DR: 在 hZACH-ViT 上研究曲率与坐标尺度、logit 温度、数值保护的交互：固定 c=1 时 Poincare 头对抗攻击成功率最低但干净 MacroF1 也最低；将曲率降到 c=0.1 提升干净性能并消除硬边界截断，却在 OrganAMNIST 上使强攻击成功率从 89.7% 升至 99.3%。结论不主张内在双曲鲁棒性，而是识别出一个受实现影响的、由曲率—尺度—边界邻近度共同组织的机制。


<details>
  <summary>Details</summary>
Motivation: 曲率常被视为表示的内在属性，但其经验效应实际还取决于坐标尺度、学习到的 logit 温度与数值保护措施；作者希望厘清双曲/球面原型头中"曲率—鲁棒性"关系究竟有多少来自内在几何、多少来自实现细节（尺度、边界截断等）。

Method: 构建紧凑 ViT（hZACH-ViT），配备欧氏、Poincare 与球面三种原型头；在 3 个 MedMNIST 数据集、5 个随机种子上严格匹配骨干结构、种子初始化、每类 50 样本训练子集与优化流程。开展两类实验：固定对比曲率 c=1 的跨数据集—预算对比（含 PGD 与更强 CE+DLR 多重启攻击、干净 MacroF1）；以及端到端曲率干预（将 Poincare 曲率由 c=1 降至 c=0.1），并分析硬边界截断比例、径向 Jacobian、无量纲攻击轨迹长度，同时以球面头作为曲率改变等价于精确尺度规范变换的对照。

Result: 固定 c=1 时 Poincare 在全部 12 个数据集—预算单元中类宏平均 PGD 攻击成功率最低，在三个数据集的更强 CE+DLR 多重启攻击下亦然，但干净 MacroF1 最低。降至 c=0.1 后，15 组配对种子—数据集比较中干净 MacroF1 全部提升且硬边界截断消失；然而 OrganAMNIST 上强攻击成功率由 89.7% 升至 99.3%（配对差 +9.57 点，95% 层次自助 CI [+5.52,+14.03]）。c=1 时 40–47% 的干净 Poincare 特征被硬截断，继承映射的径向 Jacobian 近乎为零，攻击轨迹异常长且低效。球面头的曲率变化在浮点精度内是精确尺度规范，攻击差异小得多。

Conclusion: 结果不支持"内在双曲鲁棒性"的解释；本文识别出一个实现敏感区间，其中曲率、尺度与 Poincare 边界邻近度共同组织干净识别性能与对抗表示运动。曲率对鲁棒性的表面收益在很大程度上是坐标尺度与数值保护（边界截断、径向 Jacobian 退化）的耦合产物，因此相关结论必须结合实现细节解读。

Abstract: Curvature is often treated as an intrinsic property of a representation, although its empirical effect also depends on coordinate scale, learned logit temperature, and numerical safeguards. We study this interaction in hZACH-ViT, a compact Vision Transformer with Euclidean, Poincare, and spherical prototype heads. The backbone architecture, seed-specific initialization, 50-per-class training subset, and optimization protocol are matched across three MedMNIST datasets and five seeds. At the fixed comparison curvature $c=1$, Poincare has the lowest class-macro PGD attack-success rate in all 12 dataset-budget cells and under a stronger CE+DLR multi-restart attack on all three datasets, but it also has the lowest clean MacroF1. An end-to-end curvature intervention changes the interpretation. Reducing Poincare curvature to $c=0.1$ improves clean MacroF1 in every one of the 15 paired seed-dataset comparisons and removes hard boundary clipping, yet on OrganAMNIST it increases strong attack success from $89.7\%$ to $99.3\%$ (paired difference $+9.57$ points; 95\% hierarchical bootstrap CI $[+5.52,+14.03]$). At $c=1$, $40$-$47\%$ of clean Poincare features are hard-clipped, the radial Jacobian of the inherited map is nearly zero, and dimensionless attack trajectories are unusually long and inefficient. The spherical head provides a control: its curvature change is an exact scale gauge to floating-point precision and produces much smaller attack differences. These results do not establish intrinsic hyperbolic robustness. They identify an implementation-sensitive regime in which curvature, scale, and proximity to the Poincare boundary jointly organize clean recognition and adversarial representation motion.

</details>


### [346] [Signal-Noise Factorization Isolates Nuisance Variation into Removable Subspaces](https://arxiv.org/abs/2610.00751)
*Sakin Kirti,Joel Zylberberg*

Main category: cs.LG

TL;DR: 本文提出强化表征几何（signal-noise factorization, SNF；signal-signal factorization, SSF）的正则化器，在CIFAR-100与BloodMNIST上验证：SNF正则化提升性能（尤其是存在分布外失真时），SSF正则化无此效果，且SNF显式分离噪声子空间使方向可估计并投影剔除。


<details>
  <summary>Details</summary>
Motivation: 近期理论工作指出表征几何的两个基本属性影响深度网络推理能力：SNF（把信号从噪声中分离）与SSF（把任务相关与任务无关信号分离）。作者希望验证：通过训练期正则化强化这两种属性，会如何重塑表征几何、并影响实际视觉任务性能，特别是具有生物医学意义的、推理时含分布外图像失真的场景。

Method: 构建分别强化SNF与SSF的正则化器；在CIFAR-100分类任务上与L2正则化基线网络对比；进一步在经MedMNIST-C五种严重程度腐蚀处理的BloodMNIST数据集上评估；随后分析不同正则化方案下的nuisance子空间，在留出数据上估计由腐蚀主导的方向，并将其从表征中投影剔除。

Result: 强化SNF提升模型性能，而强化SSF并未提升。在BloodMNIST（MedMNIST-C腐蚀，五级严重度）上，SNF正则化带来更大性能增益。机制上，SNF正则化模型将噪声表征在独立于类别相关信号的子空间中；该几何显式可分，故可在留出数据上估计腐蚀主导方向并投影剔除，带来显著准确率提升。

Conclusion: 强制SNF的正则化器可显著改善含推理期分布外图像失真的计算机视觉任务；同时说明表征塑造对性能的影响：将nuisance变量与类别变量隔离，比维持类别变量之间的因子化表征更重要。

Abstract: Recent theoretical work identified fundamental properties of representation geometry that shape inference ability of deep neural networks. These include signal-noise factorization (SNF), the ability to segregate signal from noise, and signal-signal factorization (SSF), the ability to segregate task-specific and task-irrelevant signals. Here, we built regularizers that reinforce these two properties during training. We compared networks trained with these regularizers to $L_2$-regularized baseline networks on the CIFAR-100 classification task to understand how our regularizers shape representation geometry and impact performance on a well-known computer vision baseline. Enhancing SNF via regularization improved model performance but enhancing SSF did not. Motivated by biomedical applications, we investigated how our regularizers affected performance on the BloodMNIST dataset treated with MedMNIST-C corruptions at five severity levels, and found even larger performance gains using the SNF regularizer. To understand the mechanism by which SNF-regularization produces improved performance, we analyzed the nuisance subspaces across regularization regimes, finding that the SNF-regularized models represent noise in distinct subspaces, separate from class-relevant signal. Because this geometry is explicit, the dominant corruption-induced directions can be estimated on held-out data and projected out of the representations. This manipulation led to a substantial gain in accuracy. These results show that regularizers that enforce signal-noise factorization can produce substantial improvements on computer vision tasks that contain out-of-distribution image distortions at inference time. They also highlight how shaping representations affects model performance: isolating nuisance variables from categorical ones is more important than maintaining factorized representations of categorical variables.

</details>


### [347] [Increasing Width Allows Greedy Layer-wise Training to Rival End-to-End Backpropagation in Self-Supervised Learning](https://arxiv.org/abs/2610.00753)
*Syon Mansur,Joel Zylberberg*

Main category: cs.LG

TL;DR: 该论文在自监督学习情境下研究网络宽度与深度如何影响逐层贪心训练与端到端反向传播的效果，发现宽网络中端到端训练的优势会缩小，甚至被贪心逐层训练反超，并将表征几何差异识别为潜在机制。


<details>
  <summary>Details</summary>
Motivation: 端到端反向传播是深度学习训练的主导方式，已有研究显示某些更简单的局部训练机制有时能达到相近性能，但在何种网络结构条件下局部优化网络能学到与端到端训练相当的表征仍不明确。作者希望在自监督学习这一大规模预训练框架下回答该问题。

Method: 在卷积网络的自监督训练中，系统比较贪心逐层训练与端到端反向传播的效果，并考察网络宽度和深度这两个结构变量的影响，同时对两种训练方式所形成的表征进行几何分析。

Result: 网络越宽，端到端反向传播相对贪心逐层训练的性能优势越小；在相对较浅且非常宽的网络中，贪心逐层训练甚至取得更高性能。表征分析显示，非常宽的贪心训练网络比端到端反向传播网络具有更有利的表征几何。

Conclusion: 网络宽度可以补偿受限的信用分配，表征几何的差异是贪心训练性能提升的潜在机制。

Abstract: End-to-end backpropagation has been the dominant mode of training in deep learning, allowing for the coordination of parameter updates across layers of a neural network. Prior studies have explored alternative -- and, in some cases, simpler -- training mechanisms, showing that they can sometimes achieve performance similar to backpropagation. However, the architectural conditions under which locally optimized networks, which avoid end-to-end backpropagation of error, can learn representations comparable to those learned through end-to-end training remain unclear. We aim to answer this question in the context of self-supervised learning, an important framework for large-scale pretraining in artificial intelligence. Here, we investigate how network width and depth affect the efficacy of greedy layer-wise and end-to-end self-supervised training in convolutional networks. We find that in wider networks, the benefits of end-to-end backpropagation over greedy layer-wise training shrink: in relatively shallow and very wide networks, we even observed higher performance in models trained with greedy layer-wise training. Subsequent analysis of the representations formed by these networks shows that very wide greedy-trained networks exhibit more favorable representational geometry than do networks trained end-to-end with backpropagation. This work shows that width can compensate for restricted credit assignment and identifies differences in representational geometry as a potential mechanism for their improved performance.

</details>


### [348] [Don't Waste the Noise: Importance-Guided Perturbation Allocation under Joint Global and Local Constraints](https://arxiv.org/abs/2610.00861)
*Melika Shirian,Kianoosh Vadaei*

Main category: cs.LG

TL;DR: 提出重要性引导的扰动分配机制，在共享ℓ1预算与局部幅度约束下优化扰动位置分配，于十个配置上提升攻击成功率2.52–17.70个百分点且不增加全局ℓ1消耗。


<details>
  <summary>Details</summary>
Motivation: 共享ℓ1预算的对抗优化不仅要决定扰动大小，还需决定有限预算的投放位置；当各输入坐标存在局部幅度约束时，扰动难以集中于少数位置，分配问题尤为关键。

Method: 利用固定的干净梯度先验构造重要性引导的分配机制，将扰动导向模型敏感区域，同时保持可行扰动集不变；采用中心化分配目标，鼓励在高于平均重要性的位置施加扰动、抑制其他位置的无效开销，从而在不扩大预算的前提下重新分配预算。

Result: 在统一的容量受限威胁设定下，十个鲁棒模型—数据集配置中攻击成功率较匹配的APGD与PMA基线提升2.52至17.70个百分点；分配分析显示高重要性区域扰动质量显著增加而全局ℓ1消耗未上升；机制消融表明中心化非均匀再分配贡献部分增益，模型导出的重要性带来额外提升。

Conclusion: 扰动分配是共享预算、局部约束威胁模型下对抗优化的一个独立且具实用价值的维度。

Abstract: Adversarial optimization under a shared $\ell_1$ budget requires deciding not only how much perturbation to use, but also where that limited budget should be spent. This allocation problem becomes particularly important when individual input coordinates are subject to local magnitude constraints, which restrict the extent to which perturbation can be concentrated on a small number of locations. We introduce an importance-guided allocation mechanism that uses a fixed clean-gradient prior to steer perturbation toward model-sensitive regions while leaving the feasible perturbation set unchanged. A centered allocation objective encourages perturbation at above-average importance locations and discourages unnecessary expenditure elsewhere, thereby redistributing rather than enlarging the available budget. Across ten robust model--dataset configurations under a common capacity-limited threat setting, the proposed method improves attack success over matched APGD- and PMA-based baselines by $2.52$ to $17.70$ percentage points. Allocation analysis shows that these gains are accompanied by substantially greater perturbation mass in high-importance regions without increased global $\ell_1$ consumption. Mechanism ablations further show that centered non-uniform redistribution provides part of the benefit, while model-derived importance yields an additional improvement. These results identify perturbation allocation as a distinct and practically relevant dimension of adversarial optimization under shared-budget, locally constrained threat models.

</details>


### [349] [Towards Fast and Disentangled Counterfactuals for Visual Foundation Models](https://arxiv.org/abs/2610.00895)
*Sidney Bender,Benedikt Kunz,Ahmed Zeid,Shinichi Nakajima,Klaus-Robert Müller,Marco Morik*

Main category: cs.LG

TL;DR: 提出 DiDAE，用冻结基础模型+条件扩散解码器，通过解耦字典的闭式编辑生成反事实，无需梯度且比 SOTA 快 2000 倍，可修复下游分类器。


<details>
  <summary>Details</summary>
Motivation: 基础模型仍受虚假相关和"Clever Hans"策略困扰，而现有可解释机器学习方法（用于无元数据分类器的策略发现与移除）无法直接应用于基础模型。

Method: DiDAE 将冻结的基础模型包裹在条件扩散解码器中。反事实即在解耦字典某一方向上的闭式编辑再解码；字典可监督（Procrustes）或无监督（SVD、稀疏自编码器）获得。无需梯度。另有 CFKD（反事实知识蒸馏）修复下游分类器。

Result: 在 6 个数据集（2 合成、4 真实）上评估，其中 3 个的愿望清单基准显示反事实与 SOTA 相当或更优，并通过 CFKD 修复下游分类器，优于基于元数据的修正；方法还能量化预训练字典对分类器的排序，返回分类器实际依赖的少数方向，每个方向经反事实因果验证。

Conclusion: DiDAE 为基础模型提供即插即用的无梯度反事实解释与修复方案，配套开源 Peal 库；有了公开字典与预训练解码器，仅需廉价的分类器线性蒸馏及其自身的微调。

Abstract: Foundation models remain vulnerable to spurious correlations and ``Clever Hans'' strategies. Explainable machine learning can find and remove such strategies for classifiers without metadata. For foundation models, no such option exists yet. We propose Disentangled Diffusion Autoencoders (DiDAE). DiDAE wraps a frozen foundation model in a conditional diffusion decoder. A counterfactual is one closed-form edit along a direction of a disentangled dictionary, followed by decoding. The dictionary can be supervised (Procrustes) or unsupervised (Singular Value Decomposition, Sparse Autoencoders). No gradients are needed, so DiDAE is up to 2000 times faster than the state of the art. We evaluate on six datasets, two synthetic and four real-world. In a desiderata-driven benchmark on three of them, its counterfactuals are on par with or better than the state of the art, and they repair downstream classifiers through Counterfactual Knowledge Distillation (CFKD), where they beat metadata-based correction. The same machinery can rank a pretrained dictionary against a trained classifier. It returns the few directions the classifier actually reads, each causally verified by a counterfactual that flips the decision, and repairs the classifier along those a teacher marks spurious. The workflow is plug-and-play in our open-source Peal library we publish alongside the paper. With a public dictionary and a pretrained decoder, all that remains is a cheap linear distillation of the classifier and its own fine-tuning.

</details>


### [350] [Platonic Task Arithmetic](https://arxiv.org/abs/2610.00929)
*Junghwan Park,Woojin Cho*

Main category: cs.LG

TL;DR: 本文提出"柏拉图任务向量"假设，用与架构无关的"通用任务描述符"（UTD）实现跨异构模型的权重空间任务知识迁移与组合。


<details>
  <summary>Details</summary>
Motivation: 针对同一任务训练的专用模型虽行为相似，但其参数更新不共享坐标系，导致权重空间的任务算术被限制在单一模型内，无法跨架构迁移。作者借柏拉图洞穴寓言，假设这些模型特定更新是同一共享、与模型无关对象（柏拉图任务向量）的"影子"。

Method: 引入通用任务描述符（UTD）：形状与架构及嵌入维度无关的矩阵，记录任务的功能效果，支持矩阵加法和取反运算。将描述符迁移到目标模型时，在任务的无标签探针图像和类名提示上编辑目标使其复现该描述符，无需逐图像标签。两种实现：(1) 描述符分解为图像嵌入上的位移场，一次最小二乘求解得到线性算子，作为权重编辑折叠进目标末层；由线性性，一组算子可按任意强度以带符号求和实现任意组合；(2) 在相同目标上训练低秩适配器，可触及所有层并联合拟合组合，代价是每次编辑需一次优化。

Result: 异构模型仅部分共享该对象，模型特定残差范数与共享分量相当，但跨模型迁移仍保留目标自身描述符增益的74-80%。在六个模型家族、八个分类任务及一个音频-文本设置中，任务知识在两种实现下均能跨异构模型迁移与组合。

Conclusion: 任务知识可在异构模型间迁移与组合，验证了柏拉图任务向量作为共享、模型无关对象的假设具有一定的可操作性，为跨架构的权重空间任务算术提供了新途径。

Abstract: Models specialized for the same task converge to similar behavior, yet the parameter updates that produce it share no common coordinate system, so weight-space task arithmetic stays confined to a single model and cannot cross architectures without a structural correspondence. Drawing on Plato's allegory of the cave, we hypothesize that these model-specific updates are shadows of one shared, model-agnostic object, which we call the platonic task vector. To make it operational for models that pair an image or audio encoder with a text encoder, we introduce Universal Task Descriptors: matrices whose shape is independent of architecture and embedding dimension, which record a task's functional effect and support addition and negation as matrix operations. Transferring a descriptor into a target means editing the target until it reproduces the descriptor on the task's unlabeled probe images and class-name prompts, requiring no per-image labels. We realize this edit in two ways. First, the descriptor factorizes into a shift field on image embeddings, so a single least-squares solve yields a linear operator that folds into the target's last layer as a weight edit; by linearity, a bank of such operators admits any composition at any strength as a signed sum. Second, a low-rank adapter trained on the same objective reaches every layer and fits compositions jointly, at the cost of one optimization per edit. Heterogeneous models share this object only partially, with a model-specific residual comparable in norm to the shared component, yet cross-model transfer still retains 74-80 percent of the gain of the target's own descriptors. Experiments across six model families, eight classification tasks, and an audio-text setting show that task knowledge transfers and composes across heterogeneous models under both realizations.

</details>


### [351] [Dataset Identity, Not Novelty: The Source of an Inflated OOD Detection Gain](https://arxiv.org/abs/2610.01096)
*Donghoon Lee,Shinjin Kang*

Main category: cs.LG

TL;DR: 事后OOD检测器在拟合OOD数据时报告的性能增益大多是"数据集身份"而非真正的"新颖性"信息，作者将这种因hold-out整个OOD数据集而非样本所暴露的差距称为"膨胀"（inflation），并给出闭式公式以便从业者预判哪些拟合会膨胀。


<details>
  <summary>Details</summary>
Motivation: 现有后处理OOD检测基准在校验检测器拟合时，仅在同一OOD数据集内部做样本级hold-out，只能排除对单张图像的记忆，无法排除检测器学会"识别这是哪个OOD数据集"而非识别"新颖性"。而实际部署时检测器面对的是未参与拟合的OOD来源，因此这一差距决定了所报告增益的真实价值。

Method: 采用"整体hold-out整个OOD数据集"而非样本级hold-out的评估协议，将该差距定义为inflation；在ImageNet与CIFAR-100骨干网络上，对多种combiner（常数调优、特征空间方向拟合、灵活组合器）测量该膨胀；设计两个仅改变"输入是否暴露类别身份"这一属性的对照实验；并推导闭式公式，直接从拟合行计算出膨胀值。

Result: 多数常规协议报告的增益实为数据集身份而非新颖性；膨胀大小与拟合规模无关，故不是普通过拟合；膨胀比例取决于输入是否暴露类别身份，两个对照在两种基准的每个骨干上都能区分出膨胀；闭式公式可从拟合行预测哪些拟合会膨胀；唯一幸存的是领域已在指定验证集上选定的单一常数，任何高于它的拟合所报告的增益在整集hold-out协议下都不复现；在某一基准上，真实幸存增益下降而报告值却上升。

Conclusion: 当前OOD检测基准中基于同一OOD数据集拟合所报告的增益被系统性高估，其本质是数据集身份识别而非新颖性检测；应采用整体hold-out整个OOD数据集的评估协议，或使用本文闭式公式预判拟合的可迁移性；实践中应仅保留在指定验证集上选取的单一常数阈值。

Abstract: A post-hoc out-of-distribution (OOD) detector reads the activations of a trained classifier and returns a score. It fits that score on in-distribution data, and the benchmarks that evaluate it supply a second piece of OOD data for the fitting itself. Some detectors tune a constant on it. Others fit a direction in feature space or train a flexible combiner and report the number that it reaches as the gain that is still available. Every such fit is validated on held-out samples of the same OOD dataset. That check rules out memorizing individual images. It says nothing about a fit that has instead learned which dataset it is looking at, and a direction that recognizes one OOD dataset rather than novelty passes it perfectly. The detector that a practitioner installs meets OOD data from a source that nobody fitted it on, so the difference decides what the reported number is worth. We measure it by holding out the whole OOD dataset rather than a sample of it, and we call that gap the inflation. We read it across a range of combiners on ImageNet and CIFAR-100 backbones. Most of the gain that the usual protocol reports turns out to be dataset identity rather than novelty. The size of the fit does not move what survives, so the effect is not ordinary overfitting. The share depends instead on whether the input exposes class identity, and two controls that vary that property alone separate the inflation on every backbone of both benchmarks. A closed form accounts for the effect and computes it from the fitting rows, so a practitioner can tell which fits will inflate without running the hold-out protocol. One of these fits survives, namely the single constant that the field already picks on a designated validation dataset. Anything above it reports a gain that the hold-out protocol does not return, and on one benchmark what survives falls while what is reported climbs.

</details>


### [352] [Two Routes to the Middle: Placement Search and Brain Readouts Converge on Where Continual Learners Should Specialize](https://arxiv.org/abs/2610.01590)
*Yuan Huang,Zihan Chen,Runbin Zhang,Hongwei Ding,Changzeng Fu,Shiqi Zhao*

Main category: cs.LG

TL;DR: 本文研究持续学习中任务特定Adapter在预训练ViT中的放置位置问题，提出基于人脑fMRI编码模型的LS-B方法，通过观察初始任务自动确定中间层放置位置，在多个骨干网络上实现稳定且高效的分配。


<details>
  <summary>Details</summary>
Motivation: 在持续学习中，为预训练视觉Transformer每个模块保留任务特定Adapter会导致存储随任务数线性增长；仅在少数模块放置Adapter可抑制增长，但如何确定放置位置尚不明确，且缺乏无需搜索的指导准则。

Method: 从算法与神经科学两个角度研究放置问题：算法上训练所有连续四模块配置并分析精度变化，考察基于权重谱和激活统计的廉价准则。借鉴视觉皮层层级组织与中期可塑性，提出LS-B方法：用冻结的十二个人类视觉区fMRI编码模型观察首批任务，将任务特定容量一次性分配给跨任务读数变化最大而结构稳定的模块。

Result: 连续四模块配置的最终精度呈倒U形，在中间深度达到峰值，波动可达3.5个百分点，而廉价准则偏好最深层。LS-B在三个ViT-B/16骨干上产生稳定且骨干特定的分配；在AugReg和iBOT上所选模块与搜索得到的中间深度区域重叠；在相同存储与观察预算下优于最浅和最深的四模块配置。在Split ImageNet-R上，LS-B使用60%的full-BiLoRA Adapter存储，最终精度相差在1.5个百分点以内。分配无需标签或反向传播，运行时增加不足0.6%。

Conclusion: LS-B将外部神经科学测量作为层特化信号，无需放置搜索即可确定任务特定Adapter位置，实现高效存储利用并展现骨干特定的皮层特征，为持续学习中的参数分配提供了新思路。

Abstract: Continual learners that keep a task-specific adapter in every block of a pre-trained vision transformer accumulate storage linearly with the number of tasks; keeping task-specific adapters in only a few blocks curbs this growth but raises the question of where to place them. We investigate this question from two perspectives. Algorithmically, training all contiguous four-block placements yields an inverted U: final accuracy peaks at intermediate depth and varies by up to 3.5 percentage points (pp), while inexpensive criteria based on weight spectra or activation statistics favor the deepest blocks. From neuroscience, the hierarchical organization and intermediate-stage plasticity of the visual cortex motivate us to ask whether a measurement taken outside the learner can guide layer specialization without placement search. LS-B observes the first tasks through a frozen fMRI encoding model of twelve human visual areas and commits task-specific capacity once to the blocks whose readouts vary most across tasks relative to their stable structure. Across three ViT-B/16 backbones, LS-B yields stable, backbone-specific allocations. On the two backbones with placement search, AugReg and iBOT, the selected blocks overlap the intermediate-depth region identified by search. Under matched storage and observation budgets, the selected blocks outperform the shallowest and deepest four-block configurations. On Split ImageNet-R, LS-B uses 60% of full-BiLoRA adapter storage while remaining within 1.5 pp of its final accuracy. The allocation requires no labels or backpropagation, adds under 0.6% runtime, and exhibits backbone-specific cortical signatures.

</details>


### [353] [SIEVE: Selective attention-value Suppression for Vision-Language Models Unlearning](https://arxiv.org/abs/2610.01962)
*Si Qi Goh,Cap Dang Xuan Kiet,Tat-Jen Cham,Kwok-Yan Lam*

Main category: cs.LG

TL;DR: 本文提出SIEVE框架，用于视觉语言模型（VLM）的选择性遗忘，通过正则化注意力值表示并结合序列级遗忘/保留监督，在删除个人身份信息的同时保留允许知识。


<details>
  <summary>Details</summary>
Motivation: VLMs能够将视觉身份与个人简历信息关联，因此需要选择性遗忘个人可识别信息（PII），同时保留关于同一人物的允许知识。该任务困难在于敏感信息与保留信息往往共享相同的视觉输入和中间表示，难以区分处理。

Method: SIEVE是一个简单有效的选择性VLM遗忘框架。它直接正则化注意力值（attention-value）表示，同时控制模型输出：对遗忘样本的注意力值抑制至常数零，而对保留样本则通过匹配冻结参考模型来保持其表示；并联合使用序列级的遗忘与保留监督。

Result: 大量实验表明，SIEVE在多种模型-模态设置下取得最先进的遗忘性能，同时保持有竞争力的保留效用。消融研究表明，值抑制与负交叉熵提供互补的遗忘信号，而基于参考的值匹配显著降低效用退化。

Conclusion: 当敏感知识与保留知识密切相关时，注意力值为选择性多模态遗忘提供了有效的干预点。

Abstract: The ability of vision-language models (VLMs) to associate visual identities with biographical information creates a need for selective unlearning of personally identifiable information (PII) while preserving permitted knowledge about the same individual. This setting is challenging because both sensitive and retained information can share the same visual inputs and intermediate representations. We introduce SIEVE, a simple and effective framework for selective VLM unlearning. SIEVE directly regularizes attention-value representations while also controlling model outputs. SIEVE suppresses attention values for forget examples toward a constant zero, while preserving retain-example representations by matching them to a frozen reference model. These objectives are combined with sequence-level forget and retain supervision, enabling targeted forgetting without largely affecting retained knowledge. Extensive experiments show that SIEVE achieves state-of-the-art performance on unlearning with multiple model-modality settings, while maintaining competitive retained utility. Ablation studies further show that value suppression and negative cross-entropy contribute complementary forgetting signals, while reference-based value matching substantially reduces utility degradation. These results demonstrate that attention values provide an effective intervention point for selective multimodal unlearning when sensitive and retained knowledge are closely related.

</details>


### [354] [Not All Is Lost: Repairing Lossy User Preference States of Personalization Encoders](https://arxiv.org/abs/2610.01270)
*Parthiv Chatterjee,Dhiraj Golhar,Ummesalma Diwan,Sourish Dasgupta,Manjunath Joshi,Tanmoy Chakraborty*

Main category: cs.LG

TL;DR: 论文提出REPAIR，通过在紧凑学习坐标空间中对比缓存表示与当前偏好状态，选择性地聚合校正证据并加到偏好状态上，在不重训编码器和任务头的前提下显著提升推荐与个性化生成性能。


<details>
  <summary>Details</summary>
