Motivation: 个性化编码器将演化的交互历史压缩为偏好状态，但仅作用于该状态的任务头会遗漏冻结编码器缓存表示中仍存在的有用证据。论文关注这种"可恢复性差距"，即偏好证据仍然可用却未被下游充分利用的问题。

Method: 提出REPAIR：在紧凑学习坐标空间中将缓存表示与当前偏好状态进行比较，在长历史、近期交互和局部爆发三种范围内解析校正证据；随后选择哪些时间步的哪些模式参与贡献，并在任务头之前将聚合校正加入偏好状态。编码器宿主式修复复用现有前向计算中的表示，无需重新编码历史。全过程仅训练REPAIR，编码器和任务头保持冻结。

Result: 在MovieLens、PENS、MIND和Amazon Reviews 2023上，仅训练REPAIR使十二个代表性推荐宿主的MRR和nDCG@10全面提升；对同样宿主仅微调任务头增益更小，例如MovieLens上Mamba4Rec获得3.96 MRR点提升，而仅微调任务头仅0.19。排序与时间诊断支持紧凑且依赖宿主的校正结构。在个性化生成中，IMPerSumm将两个加权PerSEval变体（衡量对用户偏好的响应性）提升最多25.23%。

Conclusion: 结果支持压缩后状态校正这一思路，并区分了偏好证据的"可用性"与其"下游使用"两个层面，说明性能瓶颈可能在于证据利用而非证据缺失。

Abstract: Personalization encoders compress evolving interaction histories into preference states used to rank items or condition text generation. A task head operating only on this state can miss useful evidence that remains in the frozen encoder's cached representations for individual timesteps. We study this recoverability gap and propose REPAIR, which compares cached representations with the current preference state in a compact learned coordinate space. It resolves corrective evidence over extended history, recent interactions, and localized bursts. It then selects which patterns at which timesteps contribute and adds their aggregate correction to the state before the task head. Encoder-host repair reuses representations from the existing forward computation without re-encoding the history. Across MovieLens, PENS, MIND, and Amazon Reviews 2023, training only REPAIR improves MRR and nDCG@10 for all twelve representative recommendation hosts while both encoder and task head remain frozen. Head-only finetuning of the same hosts yields smaller gains. For example, Mamba4Rec on MovieLens gains 3.96 MRR points, compared with 0.19 from head-only finetuning. Rank and temporal diagnostics support a compact, host-dependent corrective structure. In personalized generation, IMPerSumm improves the two reported weighted PerSEval variants, which assess responsiveness to user preference, by up to 25.23%. These results support post-compression state correction and distinguish the availability of preference evidence from its downstream use.

</details>


### [355] [FourierQK: Filter Shape, Admissibility and the Leakage-Coverage Law](https://arxiv.org/abs/2610.00009)
*Athanasios Zeris*

Main category: cs.LG

TL;DR: 该研究通过受控消融实验，系统检验了频率坍缩注意力（FourierQK）中带通滤波器形状的五个假设，确立了振荡性带通结构（抑制DC/Nyquist）对性能的必要性，并界定了其在双向注意力场景下的适用边界。


<details>
  <summary>Details</summary>
Motivation: FourierQK用可学习频率的带通滤波内积替代标准Q/K点积并取得显著增益，但滤波器形状的最优选择及其机理尚不明确，需要回答"哪种滤波器形状最好、为什么"这一后续问题。

Method: 在字符级语言建模（TinyShakespeare，6层GPT）上进行受控消融，围绕滤波器五个属性（DC抑制、Nyquist抑制、带宽、中心频率、多尺度覆盖）检验五项假设；对比可容许滤波器（零均值、Mexican Hat DOG m=2）与非可容许高斯滤波器，并考察双边FFT泄漏与谱覆盖的关系；另测试因果时域Morlet。

Result: （1）DC与Nyquist分量有害（val≈2.0，相当于相位随机化），确认振荡带通结构必不可少；（2）最优单尺度带宽σ≈2 bins、中心在段落尺度（约70 tokens），较BASE-DOT获得Δ=+1.15 nats的净增益；（3）可容许DOG滤波器在同尺度下优于非可容许高斯，并能部分抵御双边FFT泄漏；（4）双边FFT泄漏随谱覆盖单调增长，窄带（gap>+4）干净、宽带（gap<+2）泄漏；（5）字符尺度因果时域Morlet无法超越BASE-DOT（K=128抽头仅覆盖T=256上下文的50%）。

Conclusion: FourierQK在双向注意力（编码器式，如BERT）中有效，因为训练和推理时均可获得全序列上下文；自回归生成则需因果谱变体（如MorletQK，解码器式，如GPT）。五项发现共同刻画了该方法的适用条件与滤波器设计准则。

Abstract: Frequency-collapse attention [Zeris, 2026e] achieves large gains over standard dot-product attention by replacing the Q/K dot product with a bandpass-filtered inner product at a learned frequency. A natural follow-up question is: which filter shape works best, and why? We test five hypotheses about filter properties -- DC suppression, Nyquist suppression, bandwidth, centre frequency, and multi-scale coverage -- using a controlled ablation on character-level language modelling (TinyShakespeare, 6-layer GPT). Our main findings are: (1) DC and Nyquist components are actively harmful (val ~= 2.0, equivalent to phase randomisation), confirming that oscillatory bandpass structure is essential, not just any low-dimensional spectral summary; (2) the optimal single-scale bandwidth is sigma ~= 2 bins centred at paragraph scale (~70 tokens), giving a clean gain of Delta = +1.15 nats over BASE-DOT; (3) admissible filters (zero-mean, Mexican Hat DOG m = 2) outperform non-admissible Gaussians at the same scale and provide partial protection against bilateral FFT leakage; (4) bilateral FFT leakage scales monotonically with spectral coverage -- narrowband filters (gap > +4) are clean, wideband filters (gap < +2) are leaky; and (5) causal time-domain Morlet at character scale cannot beat BASE-DOT (K=128 taps covers 50% of T=256 context), motivating word-level experiments in the companion MorletQK paper [Zeris, 2026f]. Together, findings (1)-(5) characterise FourierQK as effective in bidirectional attention settings (encoder-style, e.g. BERT), where full-sequence context is available at both training and inference time; autoregressive generation requires a causal spectral variant such as MorletQK [Zeris, 2026f] (decoder-style, e.g. GPT). Code available at: https://github.com/AthanasiosZeris/energy-gated-attention

</details>


### [356] [Integrating Fairness and Explainability in a Multiple Instance Reinforcement Learning System](https://arxiv.org/abs/2610.00035)
*Bente Hinkenhuis,Seyed Sahand Mohammadi Ziabari,Ali Mohammed Mansoor Alsahag*

Main category: cs.LG

TL;DR: 该研究构建了结合RL-MIL、对抗去偏与偏好条件超网络的多目标学生风险预测框架，但发现超网络扩展出现模式坍塌，偏好标量无法有效控制公平性-性能权衡。


<details>
  <summary>Details</summary>
Motivation: 学生成绩预测需兼顾准确性与透明性以支持有效干预，同时人口统计信息带来不公平预测风险，因此需要可解释且可控制公平性-性能权衡的模型。

Method: 采用基于强化学习的多实例学习（RL-MIL）将学生建模为弱标注交互实例包，RL智能体选择信息量大的实例用于下游分类；结合对抗去偏与偏好条件超网络，评价两种超网络变体，检验用户定义的偏好标量能否连续控制预测性能与Equalized Odds之间的权衡。

Result: RL-MIL基线分类性能强，但两种超网络扩展均出现模式坍塌：改变偏好权重几乎不产生沿预期公平性-性能前沿的系统性移动。失败原因与目标主导、条件机制梯度传播弱及动态生成参数间交互有关。

Conclusion: 公平目标可嵌入可解释的RL-MIL流程，但仅靠偏好条件化无法保证可控的多目标行为；稳健的公平RL-MIL需显式机制实现梯度平衡、目标分离与稳定性分析。

Abstract: Predicting student performance from educational interaction data requires models that are both accurate and sufficiently transparent to support meaningful intervention, while demographic information introduces an additional risk of unfair predictions. This study investigates a multi-objective framework that combines reinforcement learning-based multiple instance learning (RL-MIL), adversarial debiasing, and preference-conditioned hypernetworks for student-at-risk prediction. MIL represents each student as a bag of weakly labeled interactions, while an RL agent selects informative instances for downstream classification. Two hypernetwork variants are evaluated to determine whether a user-defined preference scalar can continuously control the trade-off between predictive performance and Equalized Odds. The underlying RL-MIL baseline achieves strong classification performance, but both hypernetwork extensions exhibit mode collapse: changing the preference weight produces little systematic movement along the intended fairness-performance frontier. The failure is associated with objective dominance, weak gradient propagation through the conditioning mechanism, and interactions between dynamically generated parameters. The results show that fairness objectives can be incorporated into an interpretable RL-MIL pipeline, but preference conditioning alone does not guarantee controllable multi-objective behavior. Robust fair RL-MIL therefore requires explicit mechanisms for gradient balancing, objective separation, and stability analysis.

</details>


### [357] [When Do Attention-Head Ablations Support Causal Claims? Projection-Level Confounds, Floor Effects, and Matched Controls](https://arxiv.org/abs/2610.00373)
*Juli Huang*

Main category: cs.LG

TL;DR: 该论文论证：单头消融本身不足以支撑因果结论，必须以正确的干预位置（pre-projection）、非饱和连续指标（gold-token log-prob）和匹配的留出对照（matched controls）为前提；在 GPT-2 small 上，post-projection 与 pre-projection 消融几乎不相关（r=0.057）且 top-5 头完全不相交。


<details>
  <summary>Details</summary>
Motivation: 注意力头消融（将一个头置零并测量任务性能变化）被广泛用于推断语言模型哪些组件对某行为具有因果责任。但作者指出，这种推断可能非常脆弱：若干预语义、评估指标与对照组设计未经验证，结论便不可靠。现有实践常直接采用 post-projection 置零并以二元准确率评估，可能产生误导性甚至相互矛盾的"重要头"结论。

Method: 以 GPT-2 small 为对象：对比 post-projection 置零与修正后的 pre-projection 消融两种干预语义（相关性与 top-5 头集合一致性）；比较二元准确率与 gold-token log-probability 两类评估指标在行为地板/天花板附近的敏感性；采用 discovery/held-out 划分，并进行 1000 次匹配的随机头与层级匹配头对照抽样，用 Spearman rho、Monte Carlo p 值检验排名稳定性与显著性；在 DistilGPT2 上做复现验证，并考察任务特异性证据。

Result: post-projection 置零与修正的 pre-projection 消融几乎不相关（Pearson r = 0.057），且选出的 top-5 重要头完全不相交；二元准确率在地板与天花板处会掩盖效应，而 gold-token log-probability 保持梯度性；在 discovery/held-out 划分下，修正后的 per-head 效应排名高度稳定（Spearman rho = 0.974），top-5 头显著超过随机头与层级匹配头两种对照分布（Monte Carlo p = 0.001）；但任务特异性证据在 GPT-2 上不稳健；DistilGPT2 复现了干预语义与匹配对照的主要发现。

Conclusion: 单头消融不能仅凭结果本身构成因果主张。可辩护的解释需同时满足三点：正确的干预位置、非饱和的连续评估指标、匹配的留出对照。研究还提示任务特异性结论在 GPT-2 上需谨慎对待，需跨模型与更严格设计进一步验证。

Abstract: Attention-head ablation, zeroing a head and measuring the resulting change in task performance, is a common method for inferring which components of a language model are causally responsible for a behavior. We show using GPT-2 small that this inference can be fragile unless the intervention semantics, evaluation metric, and controls are carefully validated. A natural post-projection implementation of "zeroing a head" is nearly uncorrelated with a corrected pre-projection ablation (Pearson r = 0.057) and selects a completely disjoint top-5 set of important heads. We also show that binary accuracy can hide effects at behavioral floors and near ceilings, whereas gold-token log-probability remains graded. Using a discovery/held-out split and 1,000 matched random-head and layer-matched-head control draws, the corrected per-head effect ranking is highly stable across splits (Spearman rho = 0.974), and the top-5 selected heads significantly exceed both control distributions (Monte Carlo p = 0.001). However, evidence for task specificity is not robust on GPT-2. Replication on DistilGPT2 preserves the intervention-semantic and matched-control findings. These results show that single-head ablation does not by itself justify a causal claim; defensible interpretation requires correct intervention placement, a non-saturated continuous metric, and matched held-out controls.

</details>


### [358] [FAER: Auditable Utility-Aligned Trajectory Replay for Language Model Post-Training](https://arxiv.org/abs/2610.00385)
*Miaobo Hu,Shuhao Hu,Xiaobo Guo,Xin Wang,Bokun Wang,Tianshu Fu,Daren Zha,Jun Xiao*

Main category: cs.LG

TL;DR: 论文形式化"选择—学习"落差，提出可审计的全轨迹回放框架FAER：其免训练固定选择器为协议基线，FAER-UTILITY为学习者感知选择器（在分离校准块上拟合）；审计契约在拼接评测标签前冻结观测字段与回放轨迹。GSM8K（Qwen2.5-1.5B-Instruct，128次更新）上，固定选择器质量0.6329，优于均匀0.5482与格式反馈0.6037；仅元数据交叉拟合校准达0.6476±0.0139（8个种子，中位数0.6481，配对95%区间[+0.079,+0.122]），目标运行63,276 tokens；FAER-UTILITY达0.6624。格式反馈所选记录正确率0.6953远高于固定选择器0.3594，但下游排序不同，印证两个目标并不一致。


<details>
  <summary>Details</summary>
Motivation: 回放选择器常按格式反馈、置信度、新鲜度或响应长度对缓存轨迹排序，但缓存层面的正确性与下游学习者效用是两类不同目标，二者之间的"选择—学习"落差此前缺乏形式化刻画与可审计评估。

Method: 提出FAER可审计全轨迹回放框架：设置免训练固定选择器作为协议基线；FAER-UTILITY为学习者感知选择器，在分离校准块上拟合；以归一化梯度对齐作为基线，并通过一次性、优化器感知的虚拟更新构造幅度感知的效用面；审计契约在拼接评测标签前冻结观测字段与回放轨迹。以仅元数据、交叉拟合的校准方式评估。

Result: GSM8K + Qwen2.5-1.5B-Instruct，128次更新下：固定选择器质量0.6329，均匀0.5482，格式反馈0.6037。仅元数据交叉拟合校准达0.6476±0.0139（8个种子，中位数0.6481，配对95%区间[+0.079,+0.122]），目标运行63,276 tokens，含校准的完整成本189,642 tokens、3.48 GPU小时。完整FAER-UTILITY行达0.6624，目标运行62,844 tokens、4.26 GPU小时。格式反馈所选记录正确率0.6953，远高于固定选择器0.3594，但下游排序相反。

Conclusion: 缓存级正确性与下游学习者效用确为不同目标，学习者感知选择器可显著优于固定选择器与格式反馈基线；完整对比进一步给出学习者感知消融、同种子差距、策略优化行与严格零样本迁移结果。

Abstract: Replay selectors often rank cached trajectories by format feedback, confidence, freshness, or response length, although cache-level correctness and downstream learner utility are distinct objectives. We formalize this selection-to-learning gap and introduce FAER as an auditable full-trajectory replay framework. Its training-free fixed selector is a protocol baseline; FAER-UTILITY is the learner-aware selector fitted on disjoint calibration blocks. The normalized gradient alignment is reported as a baseline, while a disposable optimizer-aware virtual update supplies a magnitude-aware utility surface. The audit contract freezes observed fields and replay traces before evaluation labels are joined. On GSM8K with Qwen2.5-1.5B-Instruct, the matched learner study reports quality 0.6329 for the fixed selector, compared with 0.5482 for uniform and 0.6037 for format-feedback under 128 updates. Metadata-only cross-fitted calibration reaches $0.6476\!\pm\!0.0139$ over eight seeds (median 0.6481; paired 95% interval $[+0.079,+0.122]$) at 63,276 target-run tokens; its recorded full cost is 189,642 tokens and 3.48 GPU-hours including calibration. The completed FAER-UTILITY row reaches 0.6624 at 62,844 target-run tokens and 4.26 GPU-hours. Format-feedback selects records with correctness 0.6953, compared with 0.3594 for the fixed selector, despite the different downstream ranking. The completed comparison surfaces report the learner-aware ablation, same-seed gap, policy-optimization rows, and strict zero-shot transfer.

</details>


### [359] [Make Sparse Rewards Count: Density-Aware Reward Aggregation for Multi-Reward RL](https://arxiv.org/abs/2610.00574)
*Tong Zheng,Skylar Zhai,Zhan Cheng,TianMing Sha,Youling Huang,Shuo Zhou,Shaotong Qi,Jingcheng Liang,Xuwei Ding,Pengcheng Xu*

Main category: cs.LG

TL;DR: 提出DARA方法，通过逆平方根密度校正缓解多奖励强化学习中的批次级信号不平衡，在工具调用和数学推理任务上加速行为习得。


<details>
  <summary>Details</summary>
Motivation: 多奖励强化学习需同时满足多个行为目标，GDPO中的奖励归一化虽保留了组内相对信息，但不同目标的学习进度不均，存在残留的批次级信号不平衡，需要校准各奖励贡献。

Method: 提出优势能量（奖励在批次上平方优势之和）概念，在理想化GDPO归一化下证明其正比于活跃组密度（提供非零相对优势的rollout组比例）。据此设计DARA，采用逆平方根密度校正，对活跃频率低的奖励赋予更大权重，权重由每个rollout批次计算得出，动态适应训练中奖励活跃度变化，且不改变底层策略优化目标。

Result: 在工具调用任务上，达到高格式合规性的训练步数减少最多26%；在数学推理任务上，达到近饱和长度合规性的步数减少最多65%，且最终性能保持竞争力。

Conclusion: DARA通过批次级的密度感知奖励聚合有效缓解多目标学习不平衡，在不修改策略优化目标的前提下加速目标行为学习，同时保持最终性能。

Abstract: Multi-reward reinforcement learning trains large language models to satisfy multiple behavioral objectives simultaneously. Reward-wise normalization, as used in GDPO, preserves reward-specific relative information within rollout groups, but different objectives can still exhibit uneven learning progress. We study this behavior through advantage energy, the sum of a reward's squared advantages over a batch. Under idealized GDPO normalization, we show that this energy is proportional to active-group density: the fraction of rollout groups in which the reward provides nonzero relative advantages. This reveals a residual batch-level signal imbalance and provides a basis for calibrating reward contributions. Based on this relation, we propose Density-Aware Reward Aggregation (DARA). We derive an inverse-square-root density correction that gives greater weight to signals from less frequently active rewards. DARA computes its weights from each rollout batch, adapting to changes in reward activity throughout training without modifying the underlying policy optimization objective. Experiments on tool calling and mathematical reasoning show that DARA learns the targeted behaviors faster than GDPO, reaching high format compliance in up to 26% fewer training steps on tool calling and near-saturated length compliance in up to 65% fewer steps on mathematical reasoning, while remaining competitive in final performance. Our code is available at https://github.com/zhaihaotian/DARA.

</details>


### [360] [Initialization Improves LLM-Driven Discovery](https://arxiv.org/abs/2610.00707)
*Mansi Sakarvadia,Marco Ciccone,Colin Raffel*

Main category: cs.LG

TL;DR: 本文研究LLM驱动发现中"历史迭代群体"与发现成功率的关系，提出模块化工具箱Modular（12种harness），在5类任务上发现发现过程脆弱、易发生模式坍缩，且早期发现性能可预测最终成功，据此提出"并行探索初始化"干预，在多种harness与任务上取得稳定增益。


<details>
  <summary>Details</summary>
Motivation: LLM已被用于算法、定理、药物等发现任务，通常依赖harness提示模型迭代优化目标。然而，历史迭代群体（population of previous iterates）与最终发现成功之间的关系尚不清晰，缺乏对harness设计的系统刻画，也缺乏通用有效的改进手段。

Method: 1) 将以往harness设计工作进行泛化，构建包含12种harness的"Modular"套件；2) 在5类多样化发现任务上评测其性能，分析发现成功对harness设计的敏感性；3) 识别模式坍缩（迭代多样性骤降）这一常见失败模式，并检验SOTA harness及多样性诱导干预的效果；4) 基于"早期发现性能可预测最终成功"的观察，提出通用干预：先进行并行探索以初始化后续迭代优化。

Result: 发现成功具有脆弱性且高度依赖harness设计；模式坍缩是普遍失败模式；流行SOTA harness与旨在延缓解坍缩的多样性干预带来的增益不稳定；早期发现的性能对最终成功具有预测性；所提出的并行探索初始化方法在多种harness和目标应用上均带来一致增益。

Conclusion: 初始化在LLM驱动发现中至关重要；通过并行探索进行初始化是一种通用且稳定的改进策略，优于单纯依赖多样性诱导干预，为harness设计提供了新方向。

Abstract: Large Language Models (LLMs) have been used for novel discovery of algorithms, theorems, drugs, and other tasks through the use of harnesses that prompt an LLM to iteratively optimize an objective. In this work, we study the relationship between the population of previous iterates and eventual discovery success. We generalize past work on harness design to develop a suite of 12 harnesses called 'Modular' and characterize their performance across 5 diverse discovery tasks, finding that discovery success is brittle and sensitive to harness design. We uncover mode collapse, characterized by a dramatic drop in the diversity of iterates, as a common failure mode. We find that popular state-of-the-art harnesses and diversity-inducing harness interventions, which aim to prolong this collapse, yield inconsistent gains. Our results instead uncover that the performance of early discoveries is predictive of eventual success. We therefore propose a universally applicable intervention that performs an initial stage of parallel exploration in order to initialize subsequent iterative optimization. Our method provides consistent gains across many harnesses and target applications, confirming the importance of initialization in LLM-driven discovery.

</details>


### [361] [Pre-training interventions, ex post facto: Grafting model beliefs across checkpoints](https://arxiv.org/abs/2610.00767)
*Peter Nutter,Dani Roytburg,Clément Dumas,Jinghua Ou,Shi Feng*

Main category: cs.LG

TL;DR: 论文提出"移植"(grafting)方法：在预训练检查点上训练SDF适配器，再将其权重更新加到已后训练模型上，从而在无需重新后训练的情况下近似实现忠实的训练中期干预，显著减少现实漂移与偏好一致性损失，并支持在任意后续检查点上复用同一适配器。


<details>
  <summary>Details</summary>
Motivation: 预训练阶段形成的信念决定模型后续泛化方式，因此对预训练的干预是对齐研究的关键。合成文档微调(SDF)旨在改变模型信念，理想上应作用于预训练或训练中期，但任何对预训练语料的修改都必须重新跑完整后训练才能评估效果，迭代慢且昂贵。实践中常将SDF直接施加于已后训练的模型，这会留下伪影、削弱能力，并导致"现实漂移"——模型把与文档无关的虚构实体当作真实存在。

Method: 提出grafting：在预训练检查点上训练SDF适配器，然后将学习到的权重更新加到后训练模型上，从而近似忠实做法并复用已有的后训练过程。在多达284B参数的多个模型家族上验证，任务包括植入虚假事实、训练失准模型有机体以及应用宪制性训练中期干预。

Result: Grafting植入目标信念的强度与直接对后训练模型施加SDF相当，同时把现实漂移和偏好一致性损失平均降低一半以上，并且更接近忠实的训练中期运行结果。

Conclusion: 由于grafting无需后训练，同一适配器可应用于任何后续检查点，使研究者能以单次微调的成本快速迭代预训练干预，兼顾忠实性与效率。

Abstract: Pre-training interventions are critical to alignment research, since beliefs formed during pre-training shape how a model generalizes from later training. One recently popular technique for such interventions is synthetic document fine-tuning (SDF), which aims to alter what the model believes. Ideally, synthetic documents would be mixed into pre- or mid-training, but every change to a pre-training corpus must be followed by a full post-training run before its effect can be measured, making iteration slow and expensive. Common practice instead applies SDF to an already post-trained model. This is known to leave artifacts and degrade capabilities, and, as we show, it makes the model treat fabricated entities unrelated to the documents as real, a failure we call reality drift. We propose grafting: train the SDF adapter on the pre-trained checkpoint, then add the learned weight update to the post-trained model, which approximates the faithful approach while reusing the existing post-training. We demonstrate this by installing false facts, training misaligned model organisms and applying a constitutional mid-training intervention, across model families up to 284B parameters. Grafting installs the target belief as strongly as SDF on the post-trained model while reducing both reality drift and the loss of preference coherence by more than half on average, and it stays closer to a faithful mid-training run. Because grafting requires no post-training, the same adapter can be applied to any later checkpoint, enabling researchers to iterate quickly on pre-training interventions at the cost of a single fine-tuning run.

</details>


### [362] [Persistent Depth Ordering amid Shifting Block-Bypass Responses in Language Model Pretraining](https://arxiv.org/abs/2610.01165)
*Shengye Tao,Yinzhu Cheng,Haihua Xie*

Main category: cs.LG

TL;DR: 该研究通过跨5个发布训练轨迹、11个模型-领域组合的单块 identity bypass 干预，发现层间敏感性随预训练具有"结构但非静态"的演化特征。


<details>
  <summary>Details</summary>
Motivation: 现有层干预分析多基于单一训练检查点，而模型表示与计算在预训练中持续演化，因此无法区分哪些深度依赖的干预响应反映持久组织、哪些只是训练的瞬态产物。

Method: 对固定 teacher-forced 上下文施加 single-block identity bypass，跨5个公开训练轨迹与11个模型-领域组合进行纵向比较；考察检查点间秩对应、变化集中位置及其跨域迁移性，并设计控制实验检验自然 bypass 效应变化能否归结为单一下游敏感性。

Result: block-bypass 响应保留可识别的深度顺序，但幅度发生重分布：近邻检查点秩对应更强，大幅变化集中于跨文本样本复现且跨评估域迁移的位置。控制实验显示变化无法归结为单一下游敏感性：复现的 Pythia 运行中局部缺失更新幅度增大而池化匹配下游响应下降，OLMo-2 7B 呈现不同平衡；匹配响应还依赖扰动强度与方向，未发现定向补偿。

Conclusion: 纵向层敏感性具有结构但非静态，单检查点干预响应需在扰动通路的训练演化背景下解读。

Abstract: Layer interventions are widely used to probe the internal organization of language models, yet most analyses examine a single training checkpoint even though model representations and computations evolve throughout pretraining. This leaves open which depth-dependent intervention responses reflect persistent organization and which are transient consequences of training. We study this question using single-block identity bypass on fixed teacher-forced contexts across five released trajectories and 11 model-domain combinations. We find that block-bypass responses retain recognizable depth ordering while their magnitudes redistribute: nearby checkpoints preserve stronger rank correspondence than distant ones, and large changes concentrate at positions that recur across text samples and transfer across evaluation domains. Controlled experiments further show that changes in the natural bypass effect cannot be reduced to a single downstream sensitivity: in replicated Pythia runs, local missing-update magnitude grows while the pooled matched downstream response decreases, whereas OLMo-2 7B exhibits a different balance. These matched responses also depend on perturbation strength and direction, without identifying targeted compensation. Together, our results show that longitudinal layer sensitivity is structured but not static, and that single-checkpoint intervention responses should be interpreted in the context of how the underlying perturbation pathway evolves during training.

</details>


### [363] [QK-Wanda: Coupling Queries and Keys for Unstructured Pruning](https://arxiv.org/abs/2610.01554)
*Ivan Ilin,Peter Richtárik*

Main category: cs.LG

TL;DR: 提出 QK-Wanda，用未掩码 pre-RoPE 重构目标联合打分 Q/K 权重，共享剪枝预算；重构误差显著降低，下游效果因模型而异。


<details>
  <summary>Details</summary>
Motivation: Wanda 在每条线性投影内独立评分权重，忽略了 query 与 key 通过点积相互作用的事实，因此其评分准则未能刻画 Q/K 的耦合关系，可能造成次优剪枝。

Method: QK-Wanda 以未掩码的 pre-RoPE 重构目标下的单个删除代价为 query 与 key 权重打分，并引入对侧投影信息（为 query 权重引入 key、为 key 权重引入 query）增强 Wanda 分数，使两条投影共享同一剪枝预算；分数为闭式解，无需梯度或权重更新。

Result: 在 TinyLlama、Llama 2、Llama 3、Qwen2.5 共 15 个模型（0.5B–72B）上评估 QK-only 剪枝：相比 Wanda，50% 稀疏度下 QK 重构误差平均降低 60%，80% 下降低 45%；Llama 2 70B 在 80% 稀疏度下 WikiText-2 与 C4 困惑度分别下降 20.3% 和 13.5%，零样本平均准确率提升 5.94 个百分点；Qwen2.5-72B 亦有提升，但 Llama-3.1-70B 尽管重构误差更低，困惑度却显著更高。开销方面，主实验校准下全流程剪枝耗时在 A100 上比 Wanda 多 1.3%，H200 上多 3.1%。

Conclusion: 结果表明耦合式剪枝准则具有潜力，同时揭示局部重构误差作为模型质量预测指标存在局限——更低的 QK 重构误差并不必然带来更好的下游表现。

Abstract: Wanda (Sun et al., 2024) prunes large language models by scoring weights independently within each linear projection, although queries and keys interact through dot products. We introduce QK-Wanda, which scores query and key weights by their individual deletion costs under an unmasked pre-RoPE reconstruction objective. It augments Wanda scores with information from the opposite projection (keys for query weights, and queries for key weights), allowing both projections to share a pruning budget. Its closed-form scores require no gradients or weight updates; full pruning takes 1.3% longer than Wanda on A100 and 3.1% longer on H200 with the calibration used in our main experiments. We evaluate QK-only pruning across 15 models from TinyLlama, Llama 2, Llama 3, and Qwen2.5, spanning 0.5B-72B parameters. Relative to Wanda, QK-Wanda reduces QK reconstruction error by an average of 60% at 50% sparsity and 45% at 80%. Downstream gains depend on the model. At 80% sparsity on Llama 2 70B, WikiText-2 and C4 perplexity decrease by 20.3% and 13.5%, while mean zero-shot accuracy rises by 5.94 percentage points. Qwen2.5-72B also improves, but Llama-3.1-70B has substantially higher perplexity despite lower reconstruction error. These results show both the promise of coupled pruning criteria and the limits of local reconstruction as a predictor of model quality.

</details>


### [364] [A Safe Prototype Is Not a Safety Direction: Reference Dependence and Prompt Confounds in Response-Safety Embeddings](https://arxiv.org/abs/2610.01801)
*Sahil Kadadekar*

Main category: cs.LG

TL;DR: 论文审核了"用已知安全响应均值嵌入的余弦相似度打分"这一sleeper-agent检测器规则，发现原始正质心规则无法确定安全方向，显式安全减不安全参考在多个语料上表现显著更优。


<details>
  <summary>Details</summary>
Motivation: 近期一个sleeper-agent检测器提出用"对已知安全响应均值嵌入的余弦相似度"来给响应安全性打分，但该原始正质心规则缺乏识别性：正样本只能确定安全类相对于编码器原点的位置，无法确定区分安全与不安全响应的方向。作者因此对其进行审计。

Method: 在两个提示受控、人工标注的语料及一个辅助的陪审团标注源控制集上审计该规则；使用四个冻结编码器和按提示分组的划分。对比安全原型（正质心）与显式的"安全减不安全"参考方向，并在验证集校准的5%误安全阈值下评估，同时进行完全无标注留出参考与仅用5%不安全样本、以及80-634条标注不安全响应的消融。

Result: 在人工标注语料上安全原型ROC-AUC仅0.457-0.545（两格显著低于随机、一格高于随机），而显式安全减不安全参考在同一嵌入上达0.588-0.738；在陪审团控制集上原型反向（0.358-0.405），参考达0.754-0.793。5%误安全阈值下，参考在PKU-SafeRLHF（0.153-0.263 vs 0.039-0.061）和Aegis（0.189-0.291 vs 0.004-0.045）接受更多安全响应，但在BeaverTails上不稳定。无标注留出参考能恢复部分排序，不安全样本仅占5%时恢复更少，而80-634条标注不安全响应可恢复大部分。

Conclusion: 类均值是一个位置，未必是安全方向；声明式参考只有在具备足够不安全样本量时才能确定方向。该结论限于原始正质心方法，不涉及所有单类方法或安全专用防护模型。提示标签构成的消融表明其会抬高不受控评估结果。

Abstract: Can response safety be scored by cosine similarity to the mean embedding of known-safe responses? A recent sleeper-agent detector proposes exactly this score, yet the raw positive-centroid rule is not identified: positive observations locate the safe class relative to an encoder origin, but do not determine which direction separates safe from unsafe responses. We audit the rule on two prompt-controlled, human-labeled corpora and one auxiliary jury-labeled source control, using four frozen encoders and prompt-grouped splits. On the human-labeled corpora the safe prototype reaches ROC-AUC 0.457-0.545, with two cells significantly below chance and one above, while an explicit safe-minus-unsafe reference reaches 0.588-0.738 on the same embeddings; on the jury control the prototype is inverted (0.358-0.405) and the reference reaches 0.754-0.793. At validation-calibrated 5% false-safe thresholds, the reference accepts more safe responses on PKU-SafeRLHF (0.153-0.263 versus 0.039-0.061 across encoders) and Aegis (0.189-0.291 versus 0.004-0.045), but not reliably on BeaverTails. A fully unlabeled held-out reference recovers part to most of the referenced ranking, much less when only 5% of the pool is unsafe, whereas 80-634 labeled unsafe responses recover most of it. Prompt-only ablations show that prompt-label composition can inflate uncontrolled evaluations. This is a bounded result about a raw positive centroid, not all one-class methods or safety-specialized guards. A class mean is a location, not necessarily a safety direction; a declared reference with enough unsafe mass identifies orientation.

</details>


### [365] [Beyond Linear Concepts: Discovering and Aligning Non-Linear Concept Manifolds in Large Language Models](https://arxiv.org/abs/2610.01821)
*Tido Specht,Elias Benedict Krey,Nils Neukirch,Nils Strodthoff*

Main category: cs.LG

TL;DR: 该论文将非线性多维概念发现(NLMCD)引入LLM token级激活分析，把概念建模为低维流形，并提出概念对齐(CBA)分数，揭示跨层/跨模型的几何结构。


<details>
  <summary>Details</summary>
Motivation: 现有机理可解释性方法多假设线性概念表示，但非线性特征流形的证据使该假设受限，需突破线性概念以刻画内部token表示的几何组织。

Method: 将视觉领域的NLMCD迁移至token级激活，建模低维概念流形；提出CBA分数（广义Rand指数），在无需显式特征匹配下度量流形几何接近度。

Result: 得到六项发现：(i)CBA灵敏度高于PCA/CKA线性基线；(ii)层间对齐矩阵显示中后层存在两个块结构；(iii)概念组成多为句法主导，后层转向句法-语义混合并增强输出导向；(iv)英汉多语概念共享依训练而定；(v)同家族模型对齐强，跨家族弱；(vi)训练阶段相邻对齐最高，base到SFT变化最大，DPO/RLVR对早期层影响小，RLVR基本保留DPO晚期概念。

Conclusion: 非线性流形建模与CBA提供了比线性方法更敏感的跨层/跨模型概念对齐分析工具，揭示LLM内部表示的结构化组织及训练依赖的概念演化规律。

Abstract: Understanding information processing in large language models (LLMs) requires dissecting the geometric organization of their internal token representations. While existing mechanistic interpretability (MI) methods seek to extract concepts, they are constrained by a strong linearity assumption challenged by evidence of non-linear feature manifolds. We move beyond linear concepts by adapting Non-Linear Multi-Dimensional Concept Discovery (NLMCD) from computer vision to token-level LLM activations, modeling concepts as low-dimensional manifolds. To compare concept manifolds across layers and models, we introduce a concept-based alignment (CBA) score, a generalized Rand index that measures geometric proximity without explicit feature matching. Our analysis yields six key findings: (i) a neighboring-layer sanity check shows CBA is more sensitive than PCA- or CKA-based linear baselines; (ii) layer-by-layer alignment matrices reveal two block structures in intermediate and late layers, consistent across models and obscured by linear metrics; (iii) concept composition remains syntax-dominated through most of the network before giving way to increasingly mixed syntactic-semantic concepts in later layers, with increasing output-orientation toward the final layers; (iv) multilingual concept sharing between English and Mandarin is training-dependent rather than universal, strongest in Qwen, weaker in Llama, and absent in GPT-2; (v) inter-model alignment mirrors this structure, with strong correspondence between same-family Qwen models of different scale but weak alignment across model families; and (vi) across Tulu-3 training stages, alignment is highest between adjacent stages, with the largest shift between the base model and SFT, while subsequent preference-alignment stages (DPO, RLVR) leave early layers largely unchanged and RLVR mostly preserves DPO's concepts in late layers.

</details>


### [366] [Stochastic Rounding in Low-Precision Transformer Inference: A Variable-Precision Emulation Study of a Small GPT-2](https://arxiv.org/abs/2610.01889)
*Yohan Chatelain,Pablo de Oliveira Castro*

Main category: cs.LG

TL;DR: 本文研究了低精度Transformer推理中随机舍入(SR)与就近舍入(RN)的取舍问题，发现最优舍入规则依赖于网络中具体的位置。作者将PRISM库扩展到任意虚拟精度，通过前向误差界与二阶损失分解两种分析，揭示了MLP投影层适合SR、语言模型头适合RN的机制，并在DistilGPT-2上验证了该结论。


<details>
  <summary>Details</summary>
Motivation: 低精度Transformer推理中SR与RN的优劣缺乏系统性认识，现有做法未明确区分舍入规则在不同计算位置的影响。作者希望固定数值格式、仅变化各操作位置的舍入规则，从而隔离并量化"位置级"的舍入策略差异。

Method: 1) 将PRISM向量化舍入库通过可变精度随机舍入(VPSR)算法扩展到任意虚拟精度，并证明舍入决策可在硬件浮点中精确评估；2) 推导线性投影的前向误差概率界，显示SR误差包络为O(√n·u)、RN为O(n·u)；3) 对输出softmax处期望交叉熵损失变化做二阶分解，拆分为带符号漂移、漂移曲率与Fisher加权方差惩罚。

Result: 在DistilGPT-2、t=6位有效数字下，观测与理论一致：MLP中使用SR使困惑度升至全精度参考的1.15倍，而RN为2.21倍；在语言模型头处顺序反转，因SR引入非均匀方差而RN无方差。混合精度配置(MLP输出t=6)中将SR分配给MLP、RN分配给头，困惑度可控制在全精度参考的1.10倍以内，相比同位数RN降低28%。

Conclusion: 舍入规则的选择是位置依赖的：MLP长降投影的噪声近似为softmax不变的均匀logit偏移，SR的方差被大幅折减，故SR占优；语言模型头的噪声在全词表上非均匀，RN更优。按位置分配SR/RN的混合策略可在匹配位宽下显著提升低精度Transformer推理质量。

Abstract: Should low-precision transformer inference use stochastic rounding (SR) or round-to-nearest (RN)? The answer depends on where in the network you look. We isolate this effect by holding the numerical format fixed and varying only the rounding rule at individual operation sites. To enable experiments at freely chosen precisions, we extend the PRISM vectorized rounding library to arbitrary virtual precision via a variable-precision stochastic rounding (VPSR) algorithm, proving that the rounding decision is evaluated exactly in hardware floating point.
  We develop two analyses providing complementary insight into this site-level trade-off. First, a probabilistic forward-error bound for linear projections shows that SR's error envelope grows as $O(\sqrt{n} u)$ in reduction length $n$, versus $O(n u)$ for RN, a gap that widens rapidly at low precision and is most pronounced in the long multilayer perceptron (MLP) down-projection. Second, a second-order decomposition of expected cross-entropy loss change at the output softmax into signed drift, drift curvature, and a Fisher-weighted variance penalty reveals why the two sites behave oppositely: MLP noise is predominantly a uniform logit shift to which softmax is invariant, so SR's variance is largely discounted; head noise is non-uniform across the vocabulary and is not.
  On DistilGPT-2 at $t=6$ significand bits, observations match theory: SR in the MLP raises perplexity to 1.15x the full-precision reference, versus 2.21x for RN. At the language-model head, the ordering reverses because SR introduces non-uniform variance, whereas deterministic RN carries none. In a mixed-precision configuration (MLP output at $t=6$), assigning SR to the MLP and RN to the head brings perplexity within 1.10x of the full-precision reference, a 28% reduction over matched-bit RN.

</details>


### [367] [Latent JEPA: Abstract Future Prediction for Latent Reasoning in Chemistry](https://arxiv.org/abs/2610.01947)
*Xinjian Zhao,Yaoyao Xu,Xuemin Chen,Xiaozhuang Song,Tianshu Yu*

Main category: cs.LG

TL;DR: 本文提出 Latent JEPA 框架，将自回归学习与联合嵌入预测结合，使连续隐式思维能够预测未来解的有信息量方面，从而提升化学推理能力。


<details>
  <summary>Details</summary>
Motivation: 大语言模型为化学推理提供了潜力，而化学直觉能在细节求解前给出合理预期。受此启发，作者希望探究连续隐式思维如何在不逐字表述每个中间步骤的情况下，预测未来解的有信息方面。

Method: 提出 Latent JEPA 框架，将自回归学习与对一个或多个未来视图的联合嵌入预测相结合；针对化学推理设计了文本与分子预测目标，把隐式思维与后续推理及分子结果相连接。

Result: 在 ChemCoTBench 上取得分子优化方面的提升，并在多项编辑与反应指标上有所改进；表征分析显示未来预测使隐式思维对分子结果更具信息量，并增强其与化学结构的对应关系。

Conclusion: 抽象的未来预测可作为一种学习原则，将连续隐式推理与科学结果相连接。

Abstract: Large language models offer a promising foundation for chemical reasoning, bringing together chemical knowledge and multistep problem solving. Chemical intuition can provide an initial sense of plausible outcomes before the details of a solution are fully worked out. Inspired by how such expectations complement explicit analysis, we study how continuous latent thoughts can be trained to anticipate informative aspects of future solutions without verbalizing every intermediate step. We introduce Latent JEPA, a framework that combines autoregressive learning with joint-embedding prediction of one or more future views. For chemical reasoning, we develop textual and molecular prediction objectives that connect latent thoughts to both subsequent reasoning and molecular outcomes. Experiments on ChemCoTBench show gains in molecular optimization and on several editing and reaction metrics. Representation analyses show that future prediction makes latent thoughts more informative about molecular outcomes and strengthens their correspondence with chemical structure. These findings support abstract future prediction as a learning principle for connecting continuous latent reasoning with scientific outcomes.

</details>


### [368] [CARM: Cancellation-Aware Response Masking for LLM Reinforcement Learning](https://arxiv.org/abs/2610.02039)
*Yafei Zhang,Songshuo Lu,Sicong Liao,Zhi Chen,Yaohua Tang*

Main category: cs.LG

TL;DR: 该论文提出CARM（Cancellation-Aware Response Masking），通过先取每个token对数概率比的绝对值再平均，避免符号相消，从而更有效地进行序列级off-policy掩码，在数学推理和代码生成上均优于几何平均掩码。


<details>
  <summary>Details</summary>
Motivation: 在大语言模型后训练的强化学习中，策略更新及rollout引擎与训练引擎的差异会导致采样响应变为off-policy。常用的序列级掩码规则使用采样token概率比的长度归一化几何平均，但其带符号对数比会在不同位置相互抵消，掩盖了显著的b双向策略漂移问题。

Method: 提出CARM序列级掩码：对每个token的对数概率比先取绝对值，再进行平均，防止相反方向的概率变化相互抵消。同时从理论上证明，被接受的响应满足联合界约束，即采样token比值超出规定区间的比例及其超出边界后的平均对数距离均受到控制。

Result: 在数学推理和代码生成任务上，CARM相比几何平均掩码在AIME 2024/2025/2026与BeyondAIME上平均mean@16最高提升3.13个百分点；在四个代码基准上平均pass@1相比最强基线提升2.88个百分点。

Conclusion: CARM是一种有理论支撑且有效的响应级off-policy控制方法，适用于大语言模型强化学习，能显著提升数学推理与代码生成性能。

Abstract: Recent years have witnessed the rapid adoption of reinforcement learning (RL) in large language model (LLM) post-training, with substantial gains in mathematical reasoning and code generation. In practical systems, however, policy updates and differences between rollout and training engines can make sampled responses off-policy. Sequence-level masking addresses this mismatch by deciding whether an entire response should contribute to optimization. A common masking rule uses the length-normalized geometric mean of sampled token probability ratios. Its signed log-ratios can cancel across positions, concealing substantial bidirectional policy drift. We propose \emph{Cancellation-Aware Response Masking} (CARM), a sequence-level mask that takes the absolute value of each token log-ratio before averaging, preventing opposing probability changes from canceling. We prove that accepted responses satisfy a joint bound on the fraction of sampled-token ratios outside a prescribed band and their mean log-distance beyond its boundaries. Experiments on mathematical reasoning and code generation show that CARM improves mean@16 averaged over AIME 2024/2025/2026 and BeyondAIME by up to $3.13$ percentage points over geometric-mean masking, and increases average pass@1 across four code benchmarks by $2.88$ points over the strongest evaluated baseline. These findings support CARM as a theoretically grounded and effective method for response-level off-policy control in LLM reinforcement learning.

</details>


### [369] [Finetuning with Sampling: SFT Learns Better Than You Think](https://arxiv.org/abs/2610.02140)
*Aayush Karan,Sitan Chen,Yilun Du*

Main category: cs.LG

TL;DR: 本文提出一种MCMC采样算法，将off-policy轨迹逐步转化为更接近on-policy的分布，使SFT能够媲美甚至优于主流后训练方法，兼具更好泛化与更少遗忘。


<details>
  <summary>Details</summary>
Motivation: 后训练中，RL擅长泛化且不易遗忘但依赖on-policy采样，SFT能利用off-policy专家数据却泛化弱且易灾难性遗忘。作者希望兼取二者优势：既利用off-policy数据中的特权信息，又保留on-policy学习的泛化能力。

Method: 不修改学习目标以适配数据，而是调整数据分布以适应学习器。作者引入一种MCMC采样算法，以参考模型为条件，逐步将off-policy轨迹转换为更on-policy的轨迹，再用于微调。

Result: 在科学技能习得、数学推理和开放式专业知识等任务上，该采样算法使SFT能够与主流后训练技术相媲美，通常比强on-policy基线泛化更好、遗忘更少；微调后的模型展现出较强的分布性表现，能够在仅锐化基座模型分布之外进行学习。

Conclusion: 该方法将采样视为一种模型原生算子，用于塑造数据的可学习性，可作为后训练流程中的通用基础原语，具有更广泛的适用性。

Abstract: Introducing new capabilities to frontier models has long been the goal of posttraining, which predominantly employs supervised finetuning (SFT) and reinforcement learning (RL) to this end. Conventional wisdom dictates that RL enables strong generalization on new tasks without losing existing capabilities, while SFT is prone to weak generalization and catastrophic forgetting. At the same time, SFT can learn from off-policy expert data, whereas RL must rely on a model's ability to find successful trajectories with repeated sampling. In our work, we seek to leverage the strength of on-policy learning while utilizing the privileged information contained in off-policy data. However, rather than modifying the learning objective to accommodate this data, we instead tailor the data distribution to better suit the learner. We introduce a Markov chain Monte Carlo (MCMC) sampling algorithm that progressively transforms off-policy traces to be more on-policy given a reference model for finetuning. Across tasks like scientific skill acquisition, mathematical reasoning, and open-ended expertise, our sampling algorithm enables SFT to rival prevailing posttraining techniques, often generalizing better and forgetting less than strong on-policy baselines. In addition, the resulting finetuned models exhibit strong distributional performance and are capable of learning beyond sharpening the base model distribution. At a higher level, our approach presents sampling as a model-native operator that shapes data for learnability, offering broader utility as a general-purpose primitive throughout the posttraining stack.

</details>


### [370] [Every Ablation Is a Dose: Counterweights and the Semblance of Self-Repair](https://arxiv.org/abs/2610.02173)
*Areeb Ahmad,Pratinav Seth,Vinay Kumar Sankarapu*

Main category: cs.LG

TL;DR: 该论文提出并验证"自修复"现象存在单一机理解释：消融前已存在的增益，可用仿射定律 E_r(λ)=own_r+γ_rλ 统一刻画，斜率 γ_r 表征单元对消融信号的抵消或强化作用。


<details>
  <summary>Details</summary>
Motivation: 语言模型被消融某组件后，其他组件常出现补偿调整，称为自修复，但机制不明。此前最系统的研究认为自修复是噪声性现象，难以用单一解释。本文主张自修复有唯一解释：一种在消融前就已存在的增益。

Method: 将任何对因果重要组件的干预视为反事实对比强度坐标轴 λ 上的点，指出传统消融方法只是未校准的点。由此推导细粒度单元 r 的因果修复响应服从仿射定律 E_r(λ)=own_r+γ_rλ，斜率 γ_r 为固定系数，其符号决定单元是抵消还是强化被移除信号。并在事实判定任务（Gemma、Qwen、LLaMA、Mistral 四个模型家族）与 GPT-2 Small 的 IOI 电路上进行实证验证。

Result: 在事实判定任务中，识别出 MLP 神经元、OV 神经元及奇异方向等组件遵循该仿射定律，81 个下游方向中有 68 个符合。可从固定权重预测 γ_r 的量级。在 GPT-2 Small 的 IOI 电路上，干预可触及的 10 个头中有 7 个遵循该定律，且这 7 个均为反权重。

Conclusion: 所谓自修复，本质是反权重（counterweight）在核心处出现对比信号时执行其常规操作，而非噪声性或需多解释的现象。

Abstract: Ablate a component of a language model, and other components often appear to adjust and compensate. This phenomenon, termed self-repair, has been observed repeatedly, but its mechanism remains unclear. The most systematic study to date concluded that self-repair is noisy and unlikely to have a single explanation. We argue that it has one: a gain already present before any ablation. Any intervention on a causally important component can be viewed as a point on a coordinate axis $λ$, the signed strength of a counterfactual contrast. Hence, conventional ablation methods are uncalibrated points on this axis. We show that the causal repair response for a fine-grained unit $r$ is governed by an affine law, $E_r(λ)=\mathrm{own}_r+γ_rλ$. The slope $γ_r$ is a fixed coefficient that consistently influences the model, with or without ablation, and its sign determines whether the unit counteracts or reinforces the removed signal. On a factual-verdict task across four models from distinct families (Gemma, Qwen, LLaMA, and Mistral), we identify components including MLP neurons, OV neurons, and singular directions that follow this affine law, 68 of 81 downstream directions in all. Moreover, we can anticipate the magnitude of $γ_r$ from the fixed weights. On the IOI circuit of GPT-2 Small, seven of the ten heads the intervention can reach follow the law, and all seven are counterweights. From this perspective, what may appear as self-repair is a counterweight performing its usual operation when the contrastive signal emerges at the core.

</details>


### [371] [MIKASA-Robo-VLA: Benchmarking Memory in VLA Models for Long-Horizon Manipulation](https://arxiv.org/abs/2610.00604)
*Egor Cherepanov,Nikita Kachaev,Aleksandr I. Panov,Alexey K. Kovalev*

Main category: cs.LG

TL;DR: MIKASA-Robo-VLA是一个包含90个语言条件操作任务的基准，其中80个任务隐藏了动作所依赖的线索（10个为反应式对照），用于评估VLA策略对任务中消失信息的记忆与利用能力。


<details>
  <summary>Details</summary>
Motivation: 现有视觉-语言-动作（VLA）策略通常只观测最近的一帧或少数几帧，难以评估其如何利用任务过程中消失的信息，因此缺乏针对记忆依赖型操作的系统性评测基准。

Method: 重建并扩展MIKASA-Robo套件：原套件含32个任务且仅在代表性VLA子集中使用语言；新基准的90个任务中每个都提供指令，80个隐藏任务相关线索、10个为保留线索可见的反应式对照；对70个任务通过环境阶段时序定义"信息间隙"，其中28个间隙超过所调研最宽固定上下文VLA的16帧窗口；间隙仅统计线索可证明缺失的区间，故所有记忆依赖任务在构造上均需要记忆。发布10类记忆类型共22,500条oracle轨迹（RLDS与LeRobotDataset v3格式）。

Result: 以π₀.₅为参考基线（仅用当前图像与本体感受，无观测历史或显式记忆模块），在14个任务上微调，平均任务成功率为0.211 ± 0.044；其在Long-split评估任务上的较低成功率受开环分块（open-loop chunking）与该子集所含记忆类型的混淆影响。

Conclusion: 该基准通过隐藏任务关键线索的构造方式，确保记忆依赖任务必须依赖记忆，为VLA记忆能力提供可控评测；参考基线表现偏低，表明现有无历史、无显式记忆的策略在记忆依赖操作上存在明显不足。

Abstract: Vision-language-action policies often see only one or a few recent frames, which makes it difficult to evaluate how they use information that disappears during a task. We introduce MIKASA-Robo-VLA, a benchmark of 90 language-conditioned manipulation tasks. All but 10 hide the cue an action depends on. Those 10 are reactive controls. MIKASA-Robo, the suite it rebuilds, has 32 tasks and uses language only in a representative VLA subset. Here every task provides an instruction, while memory-dependent tasks hide a task-relevant cue and reactive controls keep it available. For 70 tasks, environment phase timings specify an information gap, and for 28 of them the gap exceeds the 16-frame window of the widest fixed-context VLA we survey. The gap counts only the interval the cue is provably absent, not the full duration a policy must retain it, so every memory-dependent task still requires memory by construction, including the ones whose measured gap is short. We release 22,500 oracle trajectories across 10 memory types in RLDS and LeRobotDataset v3. A reference $π_{0.5}$ baseline with current images and proprioception, but no observation history or explicit memory module, is fine-tuned on 14 tasks and achieves 0.211 $\pm$ 0.044 mean task success. Its lower success on the evaluated Long-split tasks is confounded by open-loop chunking and the memory types represented in that subset. Project page: https://mikasarobo.github.io/

</details>


### [372] [Learning Transferable Skills using Goal-Conditioned Bisimulation](https://arxiv.org/abs/2610.00676)
*Mohammad Amin Abbasfar,Farbod Azimmohseni,Mohammad Hossein Rohban*

Main category: cs.LG

TL;DR: 本文提出面向无监督技能发现的“动作感知时序表示”学习目标，满足功能等变性并保留局部时序结构；基于此嵌入，进一步提出基于双模拟（bisimulation）的无监督技能发现方法，使技能行为仅依赖直接影响其执行的状态特征子集，从而在不同布局间保持行为不变、实现可迁移技能，并在多种环境布局的下游任务中展现出强分布外泛化能力。


<details>
  <summary>Details</summary>
Motivation: 无监督技能发现可利用无奖励数据集预训练通用策略，但现有方法要么依赖专家数据，要么泛化能力有限，难以迁移到未见过的布局。核心挑战在于：所学表示需同时捕捉环境的时序结构，并对跨布局的变化保持鲁棒。

Method: 1）提出一个学习动作感知时序表示的目标，使表示满足功能等变性（functional equivariance），同时保留环境的局部时序结构。2）在该嵌入基础上，提出基于双模拟（bisimulation）的无监督技能发现，将技能行为仅以其执行直接相关的状态特征子集为条件，从而在不同布局间强制行为不变，实现技能迁移。

Result: 通过全面的实证评估表明：在某一环境中学习到的技能可有效应用于不同环境布局下的下游任务，表现出较强的分布外（out-of-distribution）泛化能力。

Conclusion: 动作感知时序表示与双模拟技能发现的结合，能够在不依赖专家数据的情况下学习跨布局可迁移的技能，为解决无监督技能发现的泛化瓶颈提供了有效途径。

Abstract: Unsupervised skill discovery has emerged as a promising approach for leveraging reward-free datasets to pretrain general-purpose policies. However, current skill discovery methods either require access to expert data or exhibit limited generalization, failing to transfer effectively to previously unseen layouts. A key challenge is to learn representations that capture the temporal structure of the environment while remaining robust to variations across layouts. To address this issue, we present an objective for learning action-aware temporal representations that satisfy the functional equivariance property while preserving the local temporal structure of the environment. Building upon this embedding, we further propose unsupervised skill discovery using bisimulation, which learns transferable skills by conditioning the behavior of skills exclusively on the subset of state features that directly affect their execution. This enforces invariant behavior across different layouts, enabling skills to transfer effectively to other configurations. Finally, through comprehensive empirical evaluations, we show that skills learned in a given environment can be effectively applied to solve downstream tasks in various environment layouts, demonstrating strong out-of-distribution generalization.

</details>


### [373] [Reward as Observation: Learning Reward-Based Policies for Rapid Adaptation](https://arxiv.org/abs/2610.00729)
*Morgan Byrd,Maks Sorokin,Robert Wright,Sehoon Ha*

Main category: cs.LG

TL;DR: 本文提出一种仅以奖励和动作为条件的"奖励基策略"（reward-based policy），实现观测空间完全不同的源环境与目标环境之间的零样本迁移。


<details>
  <summary>Details</summary>
Motivation: 深度神经网络策略通常难以适应新环境，且成功迁移需要大量样本；而人类具备出色的适应能力。作者希望摆脱对观测（observation）的依赖，从而在观测空间完全不同的目标环境中实现零样本迁移。

Method: 提出一种新颖的、仅以历史奖励和动作为输入的奖励基策略，使其不依赖任何观测信息；论文分析了该策略面临的挑战与可行性，并据此设计了一个可在实际中训练的算法。

Result: 在Pointmass、Cartpole、2D Car Racing三个环境中训练该奖励基策略，并以零样本方式迁移到完全不同的观测（如不同配色、3D渲染或Habitat-Sim中的Stretch机器人导航）；同时表明该奖励基策略还能进一步指导目标环境中基于观测的策略的训练。

Conclusion: 仅条件于奖励与动作的策略能够在观测空间完全不同的环境间实现零样本迁移，并可作为辅助信号引导目标环境中基于观测的策略学习。

Abstract: This paper explores a reward-based policy to achieve zero-shot transfer between source and target environments with completely different observation spaces. While humans can demonstrate impressive adaptation capabilities, deep neural network policies often struggle to adapt to a new environment and require a considerable amount of samples for successful transfer. Instead, we propose a novel reward-based policy only conditioned on rewards and actions, enabling zero-shot adaptation to new environments with completely different observations. We discuss the challenges and feasibility of a reward-based policy and then propose a practical algorithm for training. We demonstrate that a reward policy can be trained within three different environments, Pointmass, Cartpole, and 2D Car Racing, and transferred to completely different observations, such as different color palettes or 3D rendering, or Stretch robot navigation in Habitat-Sim, in a zero-shot manner. We also demonstrate that a reward-based policy can further guide the training of an observation-based policy in the target environment.

</details>


### [374] [In CEM, a World Model Is Also a Proposal Mechanism](https://arxiv.org/abs/2610.00921)
*Oliver Obst,Frieder Stolzenburg*

Main category: cs.LG

TL;DR: 该论文将CEM中预测模型的作用拆分为"当前决策"和"后续候选分布"两个角色分别评估，发现跨模型与跨候选池的评分变异主要源于评分器而非候选池本身，且用环境排名替换首次模型排名更新可降低最终实际代价。


<details>
  <summary>Details</summary>
Motivation: CEM用世界模型评分来选择动作序列，并据此拟合下一次迭代采样的分布，因此一次评分错误会同时影响当下决策和之后考虑的候选。作者希望厘清评分在"决策"与"提议分布更新"中的两种作用是否可分离、其误差来源何在。

Method: 用四类预测模型生成CEM轨迹，并让每个模型对所有已保存的候选池重新评分。同时在真实环境中执行相同候选以获得参照精英集与提议更新。在Walker和Cheetah上各用十二个独立训练的任务-种子单元，考察提议分布距离、提议宽度收缩、均值分离、成对排名一致性与精英集一致性。基于原始六个单元选出"Random nonlinear"进行一次更新干预（不看干预结果），将首次模型排名更新替换为环境排名更新，并在六个留出单元上验证。

Result: 十二个单元中，预设的提议分布距离均从首次到末次CEM迭代下降；提议宽度收缩，拟合均值相对剩余搜索宽度出现分离。成对排名一致性在Walker上接近随机水平、在Cheetah上下降；精英集一致性未改善。在Cheetah上评分器之间的变异大于候选池来源之间的变异，Walker上两者及其配对均存在变异。干预实验显示，环境排名更新在原始六个单元及六个留出单元上均降低了最终实际选序代价。

Conclusion: CEM的评分误差主要来自评分器而非候选池，且评分对提议分布更新的作用是关键错误通道：即使排名接近随机、精英集一致性未改善，提议分布仍在收缩。仅替换首次更新为环境排名即可在留出单元上降低最终实际代价，说明"评分-提议"耦合是可控且具实际影响的改进点。

Abstract: The cross-entropy method (CEM) uses world-model scores to select action sequences and fit the distribution sampled in its next iteration. A scoring error can therefore change both the present decision and the candidates considered later. We evaluate these two roles separately. Four types of predictive model generate CEM traces, and every model rescores every saved candidate pool. Executing the same candidates in the environment provides a reference elite set and proposal update.
  Across twelve independently trained task-seed units on Walker and Cheetah, the pre-specified proposal distance falls from the first to the final CEM iteration in every unit. Proposal widths contract and fitted means separate relative to the remaining search width. Pairwise ranking agreement stays near chance on Walker and declines on Cheetah; elite-set agreement does not improve. This comparison shows greater variation between scorers than between pool sources on Cheetah; Walker has variation in both and in their pairings. We use the original six units to select Random nonlinear for a one-update intervention, without inspecting intervention outcomes. Replacing its first model-ranked update with an environment-ranked update lowers final realised selected-sequence cost in those six units and in six further units held out from the selection.

</details>


### [375] [Supervise What Decides Success: Criterion-Aligned Auxiliary Losses for Latent World-Model Planning](https://arxiv.org/abs/2610.01224)
*Takumi Hara,Kanata Suzuki*

Main category: cs.LG

TL;DR: 提出一种辅助损失：将成功判定量（如末端执行器位置）作为训练目标对编码器/预测器输出做线性回归，回归误差加入训练损失，训练后丢弃该头，模型测试成本与输入不变；在PushT与cube任务上成功率绝对提升3.5%与3.4%且统计显著。


<details>
  <summary>Details</summary>
Motivation: 潜在世界模型通过潜在空间距离对候选动作序列打分，但任务成功由物理量（成功判定量）决定。作者考察的四个潜在世界模型中，末端执行器位置的编码误差均超过成功判定所允许的阈值，导致潜在状态无法区分成功与失败的候选序列。因此需要让潜在状态显式保留成功判定量所需信息。

Method: 在现有以成功判定量为输入的潜在世界模型上，额外引入辅助损失：在训练阶段，于编码器与预测器输出之上加一个线性头，回归成功判定量，并将回归误差加入训练损失；训练结束后丢弃该线性头。因此测试时的模型结构、计算代价与输入均保持不变。

Result: 仅使用该辅助损失，PushT任务成功率绝对提升3.5%，cube任务绝对提升3.4%，两项提升均具有统计显著性。

Conclusion: 成功判定量实际上规定了世界模型潜在状态必须保留的信息；本文表明它不仅可以作为模型输入，还能直接作为训练目标，从而提升规划成功率。

Abstract: Latent world models plan by scoring candidate action sequences with distances in latent space. However, task success is judged by physical quantities, which we call the success-criterion quantities. In all four latent world models we examine, the end-effector position is encoded in the latent state with an error larger than the success criterion allows. Such a latent state cannot separate successful candidates from failing ones. We propose an auxiliary loss that uses success-criterion quantities as training targets, whereas existing latent world models take them only as inputs. During training, a linear head on the encoder and predictor outputs regresses the success-criterion quantities, and the regression error is added to the training loss. The head is discarded after training, so the model, its cost, and its inputs at test time are unchanged. This loss alone improves the success rate on PushT and cube by 3.5% and 3.4% (absolute), respectively, and both improvements are statistically significant. A success criterion thus specifies what a world model must retain in its latent state, and we show that it can serve directly as a training target.

</details>


### [376] [FERPO: Forward Entropy-Regularized Policy Optimization](https://arxiv.org/abs/2610.02198)
*Sebastian Sanokowski,Alireza Sarmadi,Majid Khadiv*

Main category: cs.LG

TL;DR: 提出FERPO——一种on-policy最大熵RL算法，利用critic值而非其对动作的梯度进行策略改进，通过前向KL拟合由熵与KL正则化的最优目标动作分布。


<details>
  <summary>Details</summary>
Motivation: 现有连续控制在线RL方法多依赖学习到的critic的动作梯度改进策略，但critic通常以预测回报为目标训练，准确的价值预测并不保证准确的动作导数，可能导致不可靠的策略更新。

Method: FERPO从带熵与KL散度正则的策略改进目标推导最优目标动作分布；用自归一化重要性采样（SNIS）以rollout策略采样的动作估计前向KL目标并拟合actor。KL正则限制目标分布偏离rollout策略，使重要性权重保持良好性质；相对reverse-KL，前向KL鼓励覆盖多个高价值模态从而促进探索。

Result: 在MuJoCo Playground与ManiSkill上的实验与消融显示具竞争力的性能与样本效率提升；计算基准显示actor更新快于REPPO。

Conclusion: 通过规避critic对动作的微分并采用前向KL正则化目标分布拟合，FERPO实现了更可靠且高效的策略改进，兼顾探索与计算效率。

Abstract: Several state-of-the-art methods for online reinforcement learning in continuous control improve policies using action gradients of a learned critic. However, critics are typically trained to predict returns, and accurate value predictions do not necessarily yield accurate action derivatives, potentially leading to unreliable policy updates. We propose Forward Entropy-Regularized Policy Optimization (FERPO), an on-policy maximum entropy reinforcement learning algorithm that performs policy improvement using critic values without differentiating the critic with respect to actions. FERPO derives an optimal target action distribution from a policy-improvement objective regularized by entropy and Kullback-Leibler (KL) divergence. We then fit the actor to this target by minimizing a forward-KL objective, estimated using self-normalized importance sampling (SNIS) with actions drawn from the rollout policy. By limiting the target distribution's deviation from the rollout policy, the KL regularization helps keep these importance weights well behaved. In contrast to reverse-KL objectives, which can favor a subset of the target distribution's modes, the forward-KL objective encourages coverage of multiple high-value modes and thereby promotes exploration. Experiments and ablations on MuJoCo Playground and ManiSkill show competitive performance and sample-efficiency gains. Computational benchmarks also demonstrate faster actor updates than Relative Entropy Pathwise Policy Optimization (REPPO).

</details>


### [377] [Exposing the Cost of Deep Learning Audio Development](https://arxiv.org/abs/2610.01619)
*Constance Douwes,Paul Magron,Romain Serizel*

Main category: cs.LG

TL;DR: 现有研究多关注深度学习模型训练与推理的能耗,忽视开发阶段的能耗。本文基于Grid5000平台活动日志,提出估算开发阶段能耗的方法,并以Multispeech团队音频项目为案例,发现开发阶段能耗是训练最优模型能耗的3至256倍,呼吁系统报告全生命周期能耗。


<details>
  <summary>Details</summary>
Motivation: 过去十年深度学习的环境影响受到关注,但现有研究主要聚焦训练与推理阶段的能耗与碳排放,忽略了整个开发阶段。而开发阶段包含架构原型设计与大量实验,能耗需求极高,因此需要量化这一被忽视的开销。

Method: 基于LORIA实验室使用的Grid5000共享计算平台的活动日志,提出一种估算开发阶段能耗的方法。以Multispeech研究团队开发的音频项目为案例,评估四个项目的整体能耗,并将其与训练所报告模型的能耗进行对比。

Result: 开发阶段所需能耗是训练单个最佳性能模型所需能耗的3至256倍。

Conclusion: 结果倡导对深度学习音频项目全生命周期的能耗进行更系统化的报告,以更全面评估其环境影响。

Abstract: The environmental impact of deep learning has attracted increasing attention over the past decade. Existing studies mainly focus on the energy and carbon emissions of model training and inference, while the whole development phase is often overlooked. Yet, architecture prototyping and intensive experiments are conducted during this stage, which is highly energy-demanding. In this article, we propose a methodology to estimate these costs, based on activity logs from the Grid5000 shared computing platform used by the LORIA laboratory. As a case-study, we focus on audio projects developed in the Multispeech research team. We evaluate the overall energy cost of four projects, and we compare them to those of training the reported models. Our results show that the energy required for the development phase is 3 to 256 times greater than that required to train the best-performing model alone. These results advocate for a more systematic reporting of energy consumption across the entire life cycle of deep learning-based audio projects.

</details>


### [378] [Partial AUC Maximization from Positive-unlabeled Data](https://arxiv.org/abs/2610.00284)
*Atsutoshi Kumagai,Tomoharu Iwata,Taishi Nishiyama,Hiroshi Takahashi,Kazuki Adachi,Yasuhiro Fujiwara*

Main category: cs.LG

TL;DR: 本文提出一种仅利用正例与无标签数据（PU数据）最大化部分AUC（pAUC）的方法，无需负例标签。作者在经验风险最小化框架下证明pAUC（含FPR相关阈值）可仅用正类与边缘密度表示，并推导出PU经验估计器，通过最大化平滑后的经验pAUC训练分类器，在十个真实数据集上验证了有效性。


<details>
  <summary>Details</summary>
Motivation: pAUC关注特定假正率（FPR）范围内的真正率，是二分类在网络安全、医疗、广告等场景中的重要指标。现有pAUC最大化方法通常需要同时具备有标签的正例与负例数据，但负例标签常因隐私问题或标注成本高而难以获取。

Method: 在经验风险最小化框架下，将pAUC（包括其依赖FPR的阈值）用正类密度与边缘密度重新表示，从而摆脱对负类条件密度的依赖；据此从PU数据推导出经验估计器，并对估计器进行平滑处理，通过最大化该平滑经验pAUC估计器来训练分类器。

Result: 在十个真实世界数据集上进行了实验，结果表明所提方法能有效实现pAUC最大化，验证了仅用PU数据训练高性能pAUC分类器的可行性。

Conclusion: pAUC可仅通过正类与边缘密度表达，因此无需负例标签即可从PU数据估计并优化；所提PU经验pAUC最大化方法在多个真实数据集上有效，为缺乏负例标注场景下的pAUC优化提供了可行途径。

Abstract: The partial area under the receiver operating characteristic curve (pAUC) is an important performance metric for binary classification that summarizes true positive rates within a specific range of false positive rates (FPRs). Classifiers that achieve high pAUC need to be obtained in many real-world applications such as cybersecurity, medical care, and advertising. Although many methods for maximizing the pAUC have been proposed, they typically require both labeled positive and negative data for training. However, in practice, labeled negative data are often difficult to collect due to privacy concerns or the need for high expertise to annotate them. In this paper, we propose a method for maximizing the pAUC from positive and unlabeled (PU) data without negative data. Within an empirical risk minimization framework, we show that the pAUC, including its FPR-dependent thresholds, can be represented using only the positive and marginal densities, and derive an empirical estimator from PU data. A classifier is then trained by maximizing the derived smoothed empirical pAUC estimator. We experimentally demonstrate the effectiveness of the proposed method with ten real-world datasets.

</details>


### [379] [M$^2$Weather: A Benchmark for Joint Multi-Station and Multi-Variable Weather Forecasting](https://arxiv.org/abs/2610.00370)
*Rongwen Li,Xiao Wang,Mingyang Wang,Hongwu Liu,Changjian Chen,Zhuo Tang,Kenli Li*

Main category: cs.LG

TL;DR: 本文提出 $M^2$Weather 基准，用于联合多站点与多变量的天气预报，并设计轻量即插即用适配器验证站点-变量关系建模的增益。


<details>
  <summary>Details</summary>
Motivation: 现有研究通常将站点间空间依赖与变量间物理耦合分开处理，且使用不同数据集与实验设置，难以系统评估二者各自的贡献与联合贡献。

Method: 通过多准则质量控制与站点分层，采集法国、欧洲、全球三个空间尺度下 2,809 个高质量站点及 5 个物理耦合气象变量；建立统一训练与评估协议以公平比较不同建模范式；并设计轻量即插即用适配器，在已训练模型上引入缺失的站点或变量关系而无需重训练。

Result: 对 16 个代表性模型的系统评估表明，联合建模站点与变量关系具有收益；补全缺失关系后，所有适配模型在三个数据集上 MSE 均进一步降低。

Conclusion: 站点与变量间的互补信息是提升站点天气预报的重要资源，联合建模多站点与多变量关系具有显著价值。

Abstract: Station weather forecasting is fundamentally shaped by both complex spatial dependencies across stations and strong physical coupling among weather variables. However, existing studies often consider these relationships separately and use different datasets and experimental settings, hindering systematic assessment of their individual and joint contributions. In this paper, we introduce $M^2$Weather, a benchmark for joint multi-station and multi-variable weather forecasting. Through multi-criteria quality control and station stratification, we collect 2,809 high-quality stations with 5 physically coupled weather variables across three spatial scales: France, Europe, and Global. This multi-scale design lets us examine whether conclusions persist from national to global station networks. We also introduce unified training and evaluation protocols to enable fair comparison of different station-variable modeling paradigms. To further examine the benefits of modeling station-variable relationships, we design a lightweight, plug-and-play adapter. With a trained weather forecasting model, this adapter can introduce missing station or variable relationships without retraining the model. This enables fair and efficient investigation of station-variable relationships. Systematic evaluation of 16 representative models shows the benefits of jointly modeling station and variable relationships. Completing missing relationships further reduces MSE for all adapted models on all three datasets. Together, these results identify the complementary information across stations and variables as an important resource for improving station weather forecasting. Our code can be obtained at https://github.com/hnu-vis/M2-Weather.

</details>


### [380] [STCFormer: Adaptive Spatio-Temporal Modeling with Dynamic Cluster Transformer for Station-based Weather Forecasting](https://arxiv.org/abs/2610.00377)
*Rongwen Li,Haixin Xie,Mingyang Wang,Hongwu Liu,Kun Fang,Changjian Chen,Zhuo Tang,Kenli Li*

Main category: cs.LG

TL;DR: 提出STCFormer自适应时空Transformer，通过时间片段内动态聚类与簇内局部-全局注意力结合，在8项天气预测任务上取得最优精度，并从Lipschitz上界角度论证选择性交互的鲁棒性优势。


<details>
  <summary>Details</summary>
Motivation: 站点天气预测需建模站点间复杂空间依赖。现有聚类式选择性建模存在两点不足：一是跨观测窗口共享的分组会掩盖站点关系的局部变化，二是仅簇内交互会丢失重要全局上下文；同时，选择性交互相对稠密连接的理论优势尚缺乏充分解释。

Method: 提出STCFormer自适应时空Transformer，在每个时间片段内依据站点局部演化动态分组。其Cluster-Guided Attention Block将簇内细粒度局部注意力与基于区域状态摘要的全局注意力结合，使站点可获取簇外信息。理论上推导出簇条件局部注意力的Lipschitz上界不大于全连接对应形式，据此设计InfoLoss。

Result: 在三个真实天气数据集、八项温度与风速预测任务上，STCFormer在全部8项任务中取得最低的24小时MSE，并在48项指标与预测时长的比较中位列第一或第二达47次。消融实验与案例研究证实了局部自适应分组及局部-全局互补交互的有效性。

Conclusion: 动态、局部自适应分组结合局部-全局注意力可有效替代稠密站点交互，在提升预测精度的同时具备理论上的鲁棒性优势，为聚类式选择性时空建模提供了新方案。

Abstract: Station-based weather forecasting supports daily life and economic activity, yet accurate forecasts require modeling complex spatial dependencies among stations. Recent clustering-based selective modeling offers a promising alternative to dense inter-station interactions. However, a grouping shared across an observation window may obscure local changes in station relationships, while intra-cluster interactions alone may miss important global context. The theoretical advantages of selective interactions over dense connectivity also remain insufficiently understood. We therefore propose STCFormer, an adaptive spatio-temporal Transformer that dynamically groups stations according to their local evolution within each temporal patch. Its Cluster-Guided Attention Block combines fine-grained local attention within clusters and global attention over regional state summaries, allowing each station to access information beyond its own cluster. We further show that a derived Lipschitz upper bound for cluster-conditioned local attention is no larger than its fully connected counterpart, explaining a potential robustness benefit and motivating the design of InfoLoss. Experiments on three real-world weather datasets spanning eight temperature and wind forecasting tasks show that STCFormer achieves the lowest 24-hour mean squared error on all eight tasks and ranks first or second in 47 of 48 comparisons across metrics and forecasting horizons. Ablations and case studies further confirm the benefits of locally adaptive grouping and complementary local-global interactions. Our code can be obtained at https://github.com/hnu-vis/STCFormer.

</details>


### [381] [MatrixReward: Reward from Rubric Matrix for Open-Ended Generation](https://arxiv.org/abs/2610.00389)
*Zihan Shen,Qi Liu,Zixuan Yang,Yiqun Chen,Chenglong Zhao,Xiaozhao Wang,Lei He*

Main category: cs.LG

TL;DR: 提出MatrixReward，利用rollout×rubric胜率矩阵构建数据依赖的评分权重，通过正负理想剖面计算相对质量奖励，在开放式生成RL中优于最强基线约2.0%。


<details>
  <summary>Details</summary>
Motivation: 开放式查询生成缺乏标准答案，需要有效的奖励机制。逐点评分式评分标准（pointwise scoring rubrics）只能提供有限信息：其一，无法反映同一prompt下不同样本答案之间的相对质量；其二，将多个rubric判断合并为单一分数可能掩盖样本间的差异。

Method: 构建rollout×rubric胜率矩阵，对每个rubric下所有成对采样回答进行比较得到胜率。矩阵列的离散程度（spread）反映该rubric对当前rollout的区分能力，列间相关性揭示rubric重复程度，二者共同导出数据依赖的rubric权重，并与rubric先验权重结合。经列归一化与加权后，以观测到的每个rubric的最大值与最小值定义正、负理想剖面（ideal profiles），每个rollout到这两个理想的距离决定其相对贴近度质量奖励。

Result: 在Qwen3-8B上、四个开放式问答基准评测中，MatrixReward平均得分63.02，超过最强基线约2.0%。

Conclusion: 结果表明，基于相对比较所导出的矩阵可用于为开放式生成强化学习更合理地构建奖励。

Abstract: Open-ended query generation lacks standard answers, thus necessitating an effective reward mechanism. Pointwise scoring rubrics provide limited information about the relative quality of sample answers under the same prompt; merging multiple rubric judgments into a single score may also mask the differences between these answers. We propose MatrixReward, which constructs rewards from a rollout-by-rubric win-rate matrix obtained by comparing every pair of sampled responses under each rubric. The spread of each matrix column captures how strongly that rubric distinguishes the current rollouts, while correlations between columns reveal rubric repetition; together, these statistics yield data-dependent rubric weights. We combine these weights with the prior weights of rubrics. After column normalization and weighting, the observed per-rubric maxima and minima define positive and negative ideal profiles. Each rollout's distances to these two ideals determine its relative-closeness quality reward. Evaluated using Qwen3-8B on four open-ended query-answering benchmarks, MatrixReward achieves an average score of 63.02, outperforming the strongest baseline by approximately 2.0%. These results support the idea that matrices derived from relative comparisons can be used to construct rewards more reasonably for open-ended generative reinforcement learning.

</details>


### [382] [RACE: Residual-Aware Test-Time Adaptation for Neighbor-Rich Time-Series Foundation Model Forecasting](https://arxiv.org/abs/2610.00405)
*Hao-Nan Shi,Tong Wu,Chen-Cong Sun,Yuan Jiang,Han-Jia Ye,De-Chuan Zhan*

Main category: cs.LG

TL;DR: 论文提出"测试时邻域缩放"设定，并设计RACE两阶段框架，在不修改时序基础模型（TSFM）的前提下利用同域邻居证据修正预测误差；方法在4个TSFM、2个领域上改善全部聚合指标，Gate可跨骨干迁移。


<details>
  <summary>Details</summary>
Motivation: TSFM逐序列推理难以适配"邻居丰富"的预测场景（如CGM、Web/云负载），此类场景中查询序列存在相关但非相同的邻居历史。现有方法或对TSFM逐域微调（成本高、跨骨干迁移差），或直接拼接检索序列而不验证其是否支持当前预测。核心难点在于邻居残差证据可能相互冲突，且残差模式随TSFM与任务变化。

Method: 将问题形式化为测试时邻域缩放，在不改动骨干模型的前提下利用同域邻居证据。提出RACE（Residual-Aware Correction of Forecasting Errors）两阶段框架：先检索与查询兼容的邻居，将其残差对齐到查询尺度，聚合一致证据得到免训练的RACE-TF修正；完整RACE进一步用轻量、域特定的Gate判断何时应用修正有益，并提供可跨TSFM骨干复用的训练流程。

Result: 在4个TSFM上，RACE在两个主要领域的三个域聚合指标上均获提升，且在高误差查询上增益最大；同一领域内，在一个TSFM上训练的Gate无需适配即可迁移至其他骨干，所得流程在72项跨骨干指标比较中全部优于对应的冻结基线。

Conclusion: 利用同域邻居的残差证据可在不改动骨干的前提下有效修正TSFM预测，且通过轻量Gate实现选择性应用与跨骨干迁移，为邻居丰富场景提供了一种训练成本可控、复用性强的测试时增强范式。

Abstract: Time-series foundation models (TSFMs) perform strongly across forecasting tasks, but their per-series inference is ill-suited to neighbor-rich forecasting, where each query has access to related but nonidentical historical series. Continuous glucose monitoring (CGM) and Web/cloud workloads exemplify this setting: CGM trajectories share physiological patterns but vary across individuals, devices, and conditions, while Web/cloud workloads combine common operating regimes with non-stationarity, heavy tails, and bursts. These histories share useful structure, yet neighbors are not equally relevant. Existing methods either fine-tune TSFMs for each target domain, incurring additional costs and offering limited transferability across backbones, or append retrieved series without verifying whether they support the current forecast. The key challenges are conflicting residual evidence from neighboring series and residual patterns that vary across TSFMs and forecasting tasks. We formulate test-time neighborhood scaling: using same-domain neighbor evidence without modifying the backbone. We propose RACE (Residual-Aware Correction of Forecasting Errors), a two-stage framework for using historical neighbors. We first retrieve query-compatible neighbors, align their residuals to the query scale, and aggregate coherent evidence into the training-free RACE-TF correction. Full RACE then uses a lightweight, domain-specific Gate to determine when applying the correction is beneficial, with a reusable training workflow across TSFM backbones. Across four TSFMs, RACE improves all three domain-aggregate metrics on both primary domains, with the largest gains on high-error queries. Within each domain, a Gate trained on one TSFM transfers to other backbones without adaptation, and the resulting pipeline improves all 72 cross-backbone metric comparisons over the matched frozen targets.

</details>


### [383] [VANDAM: Viewing a nucleotide sequence with DNA molecular priors](https://arxiv.org/abs/2610.00411)
*Jeremy Levy,Ariel Larey,Yury Nahshan,Raizy Kellerman,Elay Dahan,Amit Bleiweiss,Guy Leib,Omri Nayshool,Dan Ofer,Tal Zinger,Dan Dominissini,Gideon Rechavi,Marissa Wirth,Simon Lee,Dung Hoang,Noam D. Beckmann,Shane O'Connell,Nicole Bussola,Alexander W. Charney,Yoli Shavit,Nati Daniel*

Main category: cs.LG

TL;DR: VANDAM通过在基因组基础模型的自监督训练中显式引入DNA分子先验（预测区域分子属性并注入局部特征），在四类架构、九项下游任务上持续提升性能。


<details>
  <summary>Details</summary>
Motivation: 现有基因组基础模型采用"DNA即字符串"的范式，仅依赖掩码token预测目标进行预训练，未能显式建模生化、结构与物理属性，而这些属性对生物功能至关重要。由于许多分子属性可由序列通过既有生物物理模型估计，其价值不在于提供独立模态，而在于引入训练目标可显式利用的先验。

Method: 提出VANDAM框架，在基因组基础模型训练中扩展DNA分子先验：在自监督训练阶段，从池化表示中预测区域级分子属性；当存在功能标签且该标签可奖励对分子先验的保留时，额外在输入端注入局部特征。

Result: 在四个架构家族和九项留出基因组任务上，VANDAM通过与基于token的目标互补，持续提升下游性能；探测实验进一步表明分子先验的使用可泛化到其他未见的分子属性。

Conclusion: 将可估计的分子属性作为显式先验融入训练目标，能有效补足纯token级预训练目标，且具备跨架构、跨任务的通用性与泛化能力。

Abstract: Contemporary Genomic Foundation Models (GFMs) rely on a DNA-as-a-string paradigm that employs masked token prediction objectives for pretraining. However, this abstraction does not explicitly model the biochemical, structural, and physical properties essential to biological function. Many molecular properties can be estimated from sequence using established biophysical models, so their utility lies not in providing an independent modality, but in introducing priors that training objectives can explicitly exploit. We introduce VANDAM, a framework that extends the training of GFMs with DNA molecular priors. In self-supervised training, VANDAM predicts regional molecular properties from pooled representations. When functional labels are available and can reward retaining molecular priors, local features are additionally injected at the input. VANDAM consistently improves downstream performance across four architecture families and nine held-out genomic tasks by complementing token-based objectives. Probing experiments further demonstrate that the use of molecular priors generalizes to other unseen molecular properties.

</details>


### [384] [IrekoGPT: Turning Structured Pruning into Post-Hoc Slimmable LLMs](https://arxiv.org/abs/2610.00426)
*Pietro Moriello,Pietro Buzzega,Angelo Porrello,Simone Calderara*

Main category: cs.LG

TL;DR: IrekoGPT是一种事后方法，可将预训练LLM转换为宽度可在推理时调整的slimmable模型；基于SliceGPT保留投影矩阵，通过多层压缩比校准和岭回归校正线性层，在Llama与Qwen上优于朴素PCA瘦身，高压缩下增益最大。


<details>
  <summary>Details</summary>
Motivation: 使单一预训练LLM在推理时能按需调整宽度，从而在单一模型内暴露不同宽度的嵌套子网络，避免为不同宽度分别训练或存储模型；同时提升现有SliceGPT类压缩方法的鲁棒性。

Method: 基于SliceGPT的事后转换框架，保留其投影矩阵而不进行剪枝，使一个模型暴露不同宽度的嵌套子网络；对每一层在多个压缩比下进行校准以提升鲁棒性；并用无梯度的岭回归（ridge regression）对下游线性层进行校正。

Result: 在Llama和Qwen系列模型上，初步结果显示该方法优于基于PCA的朴素瘦身（naive PCA-based slimming），且在高压缩率下增益最大。

Conclusion: IrekoGPT提供了一种无需梯度、事后且支持推理时宽度调节的LLM瘦身方案，验证了多压缩比校准与岭回归校正在提升压缩鲁棒性方面的有效性。代码已开源于https://github.com/aimagelab/IrekoGPT。

Abstract: We introduce IrekoGPT, a post-hoc method for converting pretrained LLMs into slimmable models whose width can be adjusted at inference time. Building on SliceGPT, we retain its projection matrices without pruning them, allowing a single model to expose nested subnetworks at different widths. We improve robustness by calibrating each layer across multiple compression ratios, and correct downstream linear layers through gradient-free ridge regression. Across Llama and Qwen models, preliminary results show improvements over naive PCA-based slimming, with the largest gains at high compression. Code is available at https://github.com/aimagelab/IrekoGPT

</details>


### [385] [Exact information accounting for SGD methods](https://arxiv.org/abs/2610.00446)
*Akshay Balsubramani*

Main category: cs.LG

TL;DR: 本文用信息论方法精确分析SGD及其变体，证明预条件SGD步是高斯贝叶斯模型的后验均值更新，其单步遗憾可分解为"内在时间成本"与"比较器信息变化"两项，并将凸收敛、鞍点逃逸、平坦性与泛化关系、学习率调度、自适应优化器等统一为该恒等式的特例。


<details>
  <summary>Details</summary>
Motivation: 标准几何分析难以统一解释SGD各类变体与学习率调度、平坦性-泛化联系等现象。作者希望提供一个精确的、基于信息论的统一分析框架，替代或补充传统几何视角。

Method: 将预条件SGD步解释为高斯贝叶斯模型的后验均值更新；推导单步遗憾分解为内在时间成本项与比较器信息变化项，并将该分解扩展为目标函数本身的恒等式；在合成数据与真实训练运行上测量各分解项。

Result: 凸收敛、严格鞍点逃逸、平坦性-泛化联系、标准学习率调度、自适应优化器，以及带噪、动量、重尾、无梯度等SGD变体，均对应恒等式中的某一项或特例。真实网络上，该分解把经典收敛界的松弛归因于推导中丢弃的项，并能区分达到相同训练损失的优化器；其分离由步数与步长一致性决定，而谁泛化更好因网络而异。无梯度SGD中，该恒等式决定了曲率预条件子如何进入更新。

Conclusion: 该信息论恒等式为SGD及其变体提供了统一、精确的刻画；但由此得到的基于锐度的泛化证书，在数据无关的各向同性先验下，除非全部参数的曲率谱近乎平坦，否则在网络规模上是空洞无意义的。

Abstract: As an alternative to the standard geometric analyses, we give an exact, information-theoretic analysis of stochastic gradient descent (SGD) and its variants. We show that a preconditioned SGD step is the posterior-mean update of a Gaussian Bayes model, and that its one-step regret splits into an intrinsic-time cost and a change in comparator information. The split extends to an identity for the objective itself. Convex convergence, strict-saddle-point escape, the link between flatness and generalization, the standard learning-rate schedules, adaptive optimizers, and the noisy, momentum, heavy-tailed, and gradient-free variants of SGD each correspond to a term or a special case of this identity. We measure its terms on synthetic and real training runs. On real networks it attributes the slack of classical convergence bounds to the terms their derivations drop and separates optimizers that reach the same training loss. That separation follows the number and consistency of their steps. Its relation to which of them generalizes better differs between networks. For gradient-free SGD the identity determines how a curvature preconditioner should enter the update. The sharpness-based generalization certificate it yields, with a data-independent isotropic prior, is vacuous at network scale unless the curvature spectrum is nearly flat across all parameters.

</details>


### [386] [Grand Canonical Generators](https://arxiv.org/abs/2610.00683)
*Andreas Burger,Malte Franke,Luka Mucko,Kjell Jorner,Alan Aspuru-Guzik*

Main category: cs.LG

TL;DR: 本文提出大正则生成器（GCG），将玻尔兹曼生成器推广到大正则系综，用于联合采样粒子数与构型。


<details>
  <summary>Details</summary>
Motivation: 传统玻尔兹曼生成器局限于正则系综（固定粒子数），无法处理粒子数可变的开放系统（如吸附、流体相平衡）。需要将生成式采样推广到大正则系综，以在化学势驱动下采样粒子数与构型的联合分布。

Method: 提出两种设计：①以化学势为条件、对可变规模生成模型进行条件化，联合采样粒子数与构型；②将大正则分布因子化为粒子数分布与相应正则玻尔兹曼密度，正则部分可复用任意已有玻尔兹曼生成器，化学势的线性依赖被解析地编码，得到可处理似然，并支持自归一化重要性采样（SNIS）。

Result: 在Lennard-Jones流体与沸石中甲烷吸附两个体系上，GCG能准确复现大正则观测量，展现跨化学势的泛化能力，并可经SNIS与大正则蒙特卡洛进行校正。

Conclusion: GCG有效将玻尔兹曼生成器扩展至大正则系综，因子化设计兼顾灵活性与可处理似然，结合SNIS与大正则蒙特卡洛可实现精确采样与校正。

Abstract: We introduce Grand Canonical Generators (GCG), a generative framework that extends Boltzmann generators to the grand canonical ensemble. We present two designs. The first conditions a variable-size generative model on the chemical potential, sampling particle number and configuration jointly. The second factorizes the grand canonical distribution into a particle-number distribution and the corresponding canonical Boltzmann density. This factorized formulation can use any existing Boltzmann generator for the canonical component, encodes the known linear chemical-potential dependence analytically, and yields a tractable likelihood that supports self-normalized importance sampling (SNIS). Empirically, GCG accurately reproduces grand canonical observables on a Lennard--Jones fluid and methane adsorption in a zeolite, demonstrating generalization across chemical potentials and correction via SNIS and grand canonical Monte Carlo.

</details>


### [387] [Scalable Multi-Task Inverse Reinforcement Learning](https://arxiv.org/abs/2610.00758)
*Allen Tran,Jia Wan,Nathan Kallus,Aurélien Bibaut*

Main category: cs.LG

TL;DR: 提出一种多任务逆强化学习方法，在低秩假设下跨多个同环境不同奖励的智能体数据池化，缓解覆盖要求并实现可扩展评估，附带有限样本保证。


<details>
  <summary>Details</summary>
Motivation: 逆强化学习通过可迁移奖励实现反事实评估，但目标环境会改变状态占用分布，因此对覆盖有严格要求。单任务方法在多任务场景下数据覆盖不足且规划计算随任务数增长。

Method: 在低秩假设下，将同一环境中具有不同奖励的多个智能体的数据进行池化，进行多任务逆强化学习。利用低秩结构，使各任务无需访问全部状态（只要其他任务覆盖即可），并使规划计算复杂度随秩而非任务数增长。

Result: 提供奖励恢复与新环境下策略学习的有限样本保证。实验表明方法对有限覆盖鲁棒，能恢复各任务支持集内外的奖励，迁移到目标环境时 regret 低于基线，且相对逐任务方法的计算优势随任务数增加而扩大。

Conclusion: 低秩多任务 IRL 通过数据池化有效降低覆盖要求并提升多任务新环境评估的可扩展性，在理论与实验上均优于逐任务基线。

Abstract: By learning transferable rewards, inverse reinforcement learning (IRL) enables counterfactual evaluation of agents under modified environments. Such transfer places strict requirements on coverage since target environments affect agents' state occupancy. We propose a multi-task IRL method that pools data across multiple agents with different rewards in the same environment under a low-rank assumption. In addition to alleviating coverage requirements, so each task need not visit every state as long as others do, the method offers scalable evaluation of multiple tasks under new environments as computationally intensive planning scales with rank rather than the number of tasks. We provide finite sample guarantees on reward recovery and on policy learning in new environments. Experiments show our method is robust to limited coverage, recovers rewards on and off of each task's support, transfers to target environments at lower regret than baselines, with its computational advantage over per-task methods widening as tasks grow.

</details>


### [388] [Counterfactual Generation via Flow Matching: Coupling-Sensitive End-to-End Rates](https://arxiv.org/abs/2610.01193)
*Yunrui Guan,Krishnakumar Balasubramanian,Shiva Prasad Kasiviswanathan*

Main category: cs.LG

TL;DR: 本文提出一种结合样本分割双重稳健训练目标与学习式源-目标耦合的流匹配方法用于反事实生成，并基于高斯平滑插值的分数校正随机采样器实现有限步生成；理论上给出耦合敏感的常步Euler离散化KL界及端到端有限样本保证，实验验证了耦合依赖理论与随机采样器在有限步预算下的优势。


<details>
  <summary>Details</summary>
Motivation: 反事实生成需要在事实分配机制下收集的观测数据中，对假设干预或决策下的结果进行采样。既有方法往往依赖全局一致性/正则性假设，误差控制不够精细，且缺乏从数据估计条件结果模型与耦合时的有限样本端到端理论保证。

Method: 方法上采用流匹配框架，结合样本分割的双重稳健训练目标，并学习观测源结果与由拟合条件结果模型得到的目标结果之间的耦合。为实现有限步生成，使用基于高斯平滑插值的分数校正随机采样器。

Result: 理论结果包括：耦合敏感的常步Euler离散化KL界，误差由所选耦合下源-目标位移的矩控制而非速度场的全局一致正则性，且对维度近线性依赖；并在条件结果模型与源-目标耦合均由数据估计时，给出学习到的速度场与分数场的有限样本非参数保证，将近似误差、耦合替换误差、 nuisance 估计误差、泛化误差与蒙特卡洛误差分离。结合采样器分析得到反事实生成的端到端保证。合成与半合成图像基准实验支持耦合依赖理论，并显示在有限离散化预算下随机采样器可优于对应确定性ODE采样器。

Conclusion: 该工作为反事实生成提供了兼具精细理论刻画与实用采样效率的流匹配方案：通过耦合敏感误差分析与分数校正随机采样，实现有限步、近线性维度依赖以及端到端有限样本保证，并在实验中验证了理论预测与随机采样器的实际优势。

Abstract: Counterfactual generation seeks to sample outcomes under a hypothetical intervention or decision using observational data collected under the factual assignment mechanism. We develop a flow-matching approach that combines a sample-split, doubly robust training objective with a learned coupling between observed source outcomes and target outcomes drawn from a fitted conditional outcome model. To enable finite-step generation, we leverage a score-corrected stochastic sampler based on a Gaussian-smoothed interpolation. Our main theoretical contribution is a coupling-sensitive KL bound for constant-step Euler discretization: the error is controlled by moments of the source--target displacement under the chosen coupling, rather than by global uniform regularity of the velocity field, and has near-linear dependence on the ambient dimension. We also establish finite-sample non-parametric guarantees for the learned velocity and score fields when both the conditional outcome model and the source-target coupling are estimated from data.
