These bounds separate approximation, coupling-replacement, nuisance-estimation, generalization, and Monte Carlo errors and, combined with the sampler analysis, yield an end-to-end guarantee for counterfactual generation. Experiments on synthetic and semi-synthetic image benchmarks support the coupling-dependent theory and show that, at finite discretization budgets, the stochastic sampler can outperform the corresponding deterministic ODE sampler.

</details>


### [389] [IQS-BO: In-Context Query Selection for Bayesian Optimisation](https://arxiv.org/abs/2610.01269)
*Luca Geminiani,Nadja Klein*

Main category: cs.LG

TL;DR: IQS-BO：一种基于PFN的监督式上下文内贝叶斯优化方法，单次前向即可预测各候选点为最优解的后验概率，兼顾全上下文与替代模型辅助两种模式。


<details>
  <summary>Details</summary>
Motivation: 贝叶斯优化（BO）通常每一步都需重拟合替代模型并数值最大化采集函数，计算开销大。现有PFN类上下文方法虽有改进，但仍存在局限：PFNs4BO仍需数值优化采集函数；FIBO完全上下文但决策规则被固定且无替代模型；学习式采集函数因缺乏查询标签，只能依赖强化学习，样本效率与监督信号不足。

Method: 提出IQS-BO——一个通过合成先验监督学习查询决策的PFN。模型单次前向预测每个候选点成为集合内最优解的概率，并证明其目标函数的最小化子即为该事件的后验概率。该模型可无替代模型地预训练以支持完全上下文BO，也可将固定概率替代模型的预测作为额外输入，仅摊销决策步骤。此外设计混合先验用于预训练：将高斯过程样本与具有扭曲输入、孤立窄峰或平台结构的函数相结合，以弥补平稳核建模能力的不足。

Result: 所提查询成本仅为基于采集函数方法的一小部分，在合成与真实基准上匹配或超越标准高斯过程BO及现有上下文方法；采用混合先验预训练可进一步提升优化性能。

Conclusion: 通过将查询决策转化为监督学习问题，IQS-BO在保持低推理开销的同时达到或优于主流BO性能，且混合先验设计有效增强了对非平稳、病态景观的建模与优化能力。

Abstract: Bayesian Optimisation (BO) is a powerful framework for the optimisation of expensive black-box functions, but typically requires refitting a surrogate and maximising an acquisition function at every evaluation step. In-context approaches based on Prior-data Fitted Networks (PFNs) amortise part of this cost by pre-training transformers on functions drawn from synthetic priors. PFNs4BO amortises the surrogate but still relies on a numerically maximised acquisition function, while FIBO performs BO fully in-context by sampling optimiser locations from a learned density, which fixes the decision rule and admits no surrogate. Learned acquisition functions score a finite candidate set with a trained network, but, lacking a label for the query, learn the score by reinforcement learning on previously solved tasks. We propose IQS-BO, a PFN that learns the query decision by supervised learning on synthetic priors. In a single forward pass, IQS-BO predicts the probability that each candidate maximises the objective over the set, and we show that the minimiser of its objective is the posterior probability of this event. The model can be pre-trained without a surrogate for fully in-context BO, or take the predictions of a fixed probabilistic surrogate as additional input, amortising only the decision step. Our method proposes queries at a fraction of the cost of acquisition-based methods, while either matching or outperforming standard BO with Gaussian processes (GPs) and available in-context methods on synthetic and real-world benchmarks. Finally, we propose a mixture prior for pre-training PFNs which combines samples from GPs with functions exhibiting warped inputs, isolated narrow optima, or plateaus that are poorly modeled by stationary kernels common in GP surrogates. We show that pre-training on this prior can lead to improved optimisation performance.

</details>


### [390] [Clifford Sheaf Neural Networks](https://arxiv.org/abs/2610.01322)
*Kotaro Kamiya,Joel Nicholls*

Main category: cs.LG

TL;DR: 提出Clifford层神经网络（CSNN）：在胞腔层的每个茎上放置Clifford代数，沿边传输多重向量特征；放弃代数同态约束改用K项夹心（K-term sandwich）构造限制映射，天然半正定、无需versor约束且能混合grade。


<details>
  <summary>Details</summary>
Motivation: 几何图的等变层神经网络中，代数值茎上的限制映射若要求代数同态并满足等变性，最自然选择是versor共轭，但其表达能力过弱，需要一种更具表达力且保持结构良好性质的限制映射。

Method: 在胞腔层各茎配置Clifford代数，沿边传输多重向量特征。放弃代数同态要求，采用K项夹心构造限制映射，得到的层Laplacian按构造半正定、无需versor约束。沿三条轴刻画限制映射族：耦合哪些grade、可达自同态空间的比例、条件数。CSNN对应reversion成员，是一阶模型与grade混合角落。

Result: K项夹心可张成一半的自同态空间；在Cl(3,0,0)中对应于与中心伪标量对易的映射。项数控制表达能力。所构造的层Laplacian半正定且混合grade。

Conclusion: CSNN作为该限制映射族的reversion成员，是面向图层级等变回归的、一阶且grade混合的层构造，为几何图等变建模提供了新的表达力与结构保证。

Abstract: We introduce the Clifford Sheaf Neural Network (CSNN), an equivariant sheaf neural network for geometric graphs that places a Clifford algebra on each stalk of a cellular sheaf and transports multivector features along edges. The canonical choice of restriction map for sheaves with algebra-valued stalks is algebra homomorphism. Adding the constraint of equivariance, the naive choice becomes versor conjugation. However, versor conjugation is expressively weak, so we drop algebra homomorphism and arrive at the K-term sandwich. The resulting sheaf Laplacian is positive semidefinite by construction, needs no versor constraint, and still mixes grades. Our main contribution characterizes the resulting family of restriction maps along three axes: which grades a map couples, how much of the endomorphism space it reaches, and how well it is conditioned. The K-term sandwich spans half of the endomorphism space, and in Cl(3, 0, 0) it corresponds to the maps that commute with the central pseudoscalar. The number of terms controls expressivity. CSNN is the reversion member, a first-order model by construction and the grade-mixing corner of this family, developed as a sheaf construction for graph-level equivariant regression.

</details>


### [391] [Tight Transition Time Bounds for Separable Logistic Regression at the Edge of Stability](https://arxiv.org/abs/2610.01459)
*Haodong Wen,Kaiyue Wen,Jiaye Teng*

Main category: cs.LG

TL;DR: 本文研究大步长梯度下降下线性可分数据的逻辑回归，否证了"过渡时间与 η 无关"的猜想，证明最坏过渡时间为 Θ((log η)^{min{n-2,d-2}})。


<details>
  <summary>Details</summary>
Motivation: 已有工作仅给出 d=2 时过渡时间的紧 Θ(1) 界，并猜想任意维 d≥2 下该界与步长 η 无关；本文旨在检验并否证这一猜想。

Method: 通过按维度与样本量进行归纳，控制"对梯度贡献最大的样本在迭代中反复切换"这一核心困难，并构造匹配的困难实例以给出下界。

Result: 对任意固定样本量 n≥2 与充分小的间隔 γ，最坏情形过渡时间为 Θ((log η)^{min{n-2,d-2}})，且对所有 d≥2 一致成立。

Conclusion: 过渡时间在任意维度下实际依赖于 η，从而否证了原猜想，揭示了高维大步长下 Edge of Stability 过渡行为的更精细结构。

Abstract: We study logistic regression on linearly separable data under gradient descent with a large constant stepsize $η$. Such dynamics may exhibit a characteristic Edge of Stability phenomenon, in which the loss initially oscillates before transitioning to a stable phase of monotone decrease. Existing work provides a tight $Θ(1)$ bound in dimension $d=2$ as $η\to \infty$ and conjectures a bound independent of $η$ in arbitrary dimensions $d\geq 2$. In this paper, we disprove this conjecture by showing that, for every fixed sample size $n\geq 2$ and sufficiently small margin $γ$, the worst-case transition time is $$Θ\!\left((\logη)^{\min\{n-2,d-2\}}\right)$$ uniformly over $d\geq2$. The key challenge in establishing a tight bound is that the sample contributing most strongly to the gradient can change repeatedly across iterations. To address this issue, we control such changes by induction on dimension and sample size, and construct matching hard instances.

</details>


### [392] [Langevin-Informed Transfer Learning: Replacing Target Samples by Black-Box Feedback](https://arxiv.org/abs/2610.01522)
*Vladimir R. Kostic,Karim Lounici,Hélène Halconruy,Timothée Devergne,Michele Parrinello,Massimiliano Pontil*

Main category: cs.LG

TL;DR: LITL框架通过Dirichlet表示学习，仅利用黑盒反馈即可从有偏源样本中恢复目标Langevin动力学的谱结构与投影漂移，并在分子模拟、生成模型与神经网络潜在空间操控中验证有效。


<details>
  <summary>Details</summary>
Motivation: 科学和机器学习系统（如分子动力学、扩散模型）常由具有低维结构、慢时间尺度的随机动力学支配，但用于识别与解释这些动力学的目标轨迹往往不可获得，仅有探索潜在流形的有偏样本或静态样本。因此需要一种在分布偏移下从有偏源样本恢复目标动力学的方法。

Method: 提出Langevin-Informed Transfer Learning（LITL），仅依赖黑盒反馈：通过Dirichlet表示学习目标无穷小生成元的领先谱结构和投影漂移，实现谱形式的动力学重构与慢流形梯度场估计；并引入球面变体以引导归一化潜在表示。理论上给出Sobolev范数下特征值、特征函数与投影漂移估计的有限样本保证。

Result: 实验上，LITL从有偏分子模拟中恢复物理跃迁时间尺度，从生成模型的静态样本中构建动力学结构，重建物理系统的球面对称性，并在黑盒反馈下实现训练后神经网络的潜在操控。

Conclusion: 结果表明谱算子学习是在分布偏移下恢复随机动力学的实用框架，可在机器学习与物理科学中广泛应用。

Abstract: Many scientific and machine learning systems, from molecular dynamics to diffusion models and beyond, are governed by stochastic dynamics with low-dimensional structure, evolving on slow timescales. However, target trajectories, used to identify and interpret such dynamics, are often inaccessible: only biased or static samples that explore the underlying manifold are available. We introduce Langevin-Informed Transfer Learning (LITL), a framework for recovering target Langevin dynamics from biased source samples using only black-box feedback. LITL learns the leading spectral structure of the target infinitesimal generator and the projected drift through Dirichlet representation learning, enabling kinetic reconstruction in spectral form and slow-manifold gradient field estimation. We further introduce a spherical variant well suited to steering normalized latent representations commonly used in learning systems toward desired objectives. We establish finite-sample guarantees for eigenvalue, eigenfunction, and projected drift estimation in Sobolev norms, thereby ensuring generalization of these quantities and their first-order derivatives. Empirically, LITL recovers physical transition timescales from biased molecular simulations, builds kinetic structure from static samples of generative models, reconstructs spherical symmetries of physical systems, and enables post-hoc latent steering of trained neural networks under black-box feedback. Together, these results position spectral operator learning as a practical framework for recovering stochastic dynamics under distribution shift and unlock applications across machine learning and the physical sciences.

</details>


### [393] [Exact Distinguishability in Non-Markovian Decision Processes](https://arxiv.org/abs/2610.01527)
*Kabir Murjani,Nisarg Patel*

Main category: cs.LG

TL;DR: 该论文研究非马尔可夫环境建模为RDP时，固定行为策略下数据能否区分两个候选RDP。作者证明观测等价候选的后验几率在任意样本量下都等于先验几率（即使策略访问所有自动机状态），并在Lean 4中形式化验证；随后精确刻画该等价关系，提出PEC算法在线性时间内判定，实验表明先前工作的可区分性假设在四个测试环境中三个失效，而PEC识别的实验可恢复该假设。


<details>
  <summary>Details</summary>
Motivation: 现有RDP离线保证依赖行为策略的可区分性假设，但无法验证该假设；一旦违反，不同模型可能同样好地解释数据，导致学习与评估失效。因此需要判定固定行为策略收集的数据能否区分候选RDP。

Method: 将非马尔可夫环境建模为RDP；分析固定行为策略下观测等价候选的后验几率与先验几率关系；在Lean 4中形式化验证关键结论；精确刻画观测等价关系；基于乘积自动机提出PEC算法，以线性时间判定等价。

Result: 证明观测等价候选的后验几率在每一样本量下恒等于先验几率，即使策略访问每个自动机状态；形式化验证成功；给出等价关系的精确刻画；PEC可在乘积自动机规模线性时间内判定；在四个测试环境中，先前可区分性假设有三个失效，PEC识别的实验在每个失效情形中均恢复该假设。

Conclusion: 固定行为策略下RDP的可区分性不能仅靠数据或访问所有状态保证，存在观测等价导致的不可辨识性；PEC提供了可验证、高效的判定工具，并能指导设计恢复可区分性的实验，从而弥补现有离线保证中不可验证假设的缺陷。

Abstract: Non-Markovian environments are often modeled as Regular Decision Processes (RDPs), where dynamics depend on the interaction history through a finite automaton. Existing offline guarantees for RDPs rely on a distinguishability assumption on the behaviour policy but provide no means of verifying it. When the assumption is violated, distinct models may explain the data equally well. We study when data collected under a fixed behaviour policy can distinguish two candidate RDPs. We prove that the posterior odds between observationally equivalent candidates remain equal to the prior odds at every sample size, even when the policy visits every automaton state, and verify both results formally in Lean 4. We then characterize this equivalence exactly and derive PEC, an algorithm that decides it in time linear in the size of the product automaton. The distinguishability assumption of prior work fails on three of our four test environments, and the experiment identified by PEC restores it in each case.

</details>


### [394] [In-context Learning of Single-index Targets: Comparing Kernel and Feature Learners](https://arxiv.org/abs/2610.01712)
*Haotian Gu,Yizhou Xu,Lenka Zdeborová*

Main category: cs.LG

TL;DR: 本文研究非线性单指标任务下的上下文学习（ICL），比较两种单层注意力架构（核学习器与特征学习器）的记忆与泛化误差，用replica方法推导预测并给出相图。


<details>
  <summary>Details</summary>
Motivation: 现有ICL理论多聚焦线性目标函数，缺乏对非线性情形的理解；需要澄清架构选择如何与数据集交互并决定非线性ICL的表现。

Method: 在同一族单指标任务上比较两种单层注意力架构：核学习器先用固定非线性特征映射再线性注意力，特征学习器直接对原输入做注意力再接可学习非线性读出。采用replica方法推导记忆与泛化误差预测，保留预训练规模、任务池多样性与训练/推理上下文长度的影响。

Result: 理论预测在广泛区间内与数值实验高度吻合；得到相图刻画不同预训练数据量、任务多样性与上下文长度下各架构的优势区域；并识别出两类学习器在上下文长度标度上的定性差异。

Conclusion: 结果阐明了架构选择如何与数据集相互作用并支配非线性上下文学习的行为。

Abstract: In-context learning (ICL) enables a pretrained model to infer a task from demonstrations without updating its parameters. While much of the existing theory focuses on linear target functions, in this paper we study nonlinear cases by comparing two one-layer attention architectures on the same family of single-index tasks. A kernel learner first maps inputs through a fixed nonlinear feature map and then applies linear attention, whereas a feature learner applies attention to the original input, followed by a learned nonlinear readout. We derive predictions for their memorization and generalization errors using the replica method, retaining the effects of pretraining size, task-pool diversity, and training and inference context lengths. The resulting predictions closely match numerical experiments across a broad range of regimes. Our analysis yields phase diagrams that characterize when each architecture is advantageous as the amount of pretraining data, task diversity, and context lengths vary. We further identify qualitatively different context-length scalings for the two learners. Together, these results clarify how architectural choices interact with the dataset and govern nonlinear in-context learning.

</details>


### [395] [Inferring Multi-Timescale Neural Dynamics with Switching Linear Dynamical Systems](https://arxiv.org/abs/2610.01786)
*Lulu Gong,Yongxu Zhang,Shreya Saxena*

Main category: cs.LG

TL;DR: 本文提出多时间尺度切换线性动力系统（MTS-SLDS），用于从连续或脉冲神经观测中识别随状态/任务变化的潜在时间尺度，结合多滞后矩初始化与制度条件化 Laplace-EM 推断，通过潜转移矩阵特征值直接提取特征时间尺度，在合成与神经数据上准确恢复时间尺度及切换结构。


<details>
  <summary>Details</summary>
Motivation: 神经活动常表现出多个时间尺度，且会随行为状态和任务条件变化，识别这些时间尺度有助于理解神经计算与功能。但基于自相关拟合的传统方法难以扩展到高维群体记录，且在神经动态随行为变化时可靠性下降；状态空间模型虽能建模高维神经群体活动，但标准形式与推断方法未显式考虑多时间尺度，无法保证准确恢复潜在时间结构。

Method: 提出 MTS-SLDS 框架：结合多滞后矩初始化（跨多个观测滞后捕捉时间结构）与制度条件化 Laplace-EM 推断（减少不确定制度间动态统计的混淆）；特征时间尺度由学习到的潜转移矩阵特征值直接提取。适用于高斯和泊松脉冲观测。

Result: 在高斯与泊松脉冲观测的合成及神经实验中，MTS-SLDS 在多个数据集上准确恢复了时间尺度与切换结构。

Conclusion: MTS-SLDS 为从高维神经记录中识别制度特异性潜在时间尺度提供了有效框架，克服了传统自相关拟合与标准状态空间模型在多时间尺度建模上的局限。

Abstract: Neural activity often exhibits multiple timescales that can vary with behavioral states and task conditions. Identifying these timescales from neural recordings is important for better understanding neural computation and function. However, traditional approaches based on autocorrelation fitting are difficult to scale to high-dimensional population recordings and can become unreliable when neural dynamics change with behavior. State-space models have been a powerful framework for modeling high-dimensional neural population activity through latent dynamical systems, but standard formulations and inference methods do not explicitly account for multiple timescales and therefore do not guarantee accurate recovery of the underlying temporal structure. Motivated by these questions, we introduce the Multi-Timescale Switching Linear Dynamical System (MTS-SLDS), a framework for identifying regime-specific latent timescales from continuous or spiking neural observations. MTS-SLDS combines a multi-lag moment initialization, which captures temporal structure across multiple observation lags, with \textit{regime-conditioned} Laplace-EM inference, which reduces mixing of dynamical statistics across uncertain regimes. Characteristic timescales can then be extracted directly from the eigenvalues of the learned latent transition matrices. In synthetic and neural experiments with Gaussian and Poisson spike observations, MTS-SLDS accurately recovers timescales and switching structure over multiple datasets.

</details>


### [396] [Sharp Non-Asymptotic Analysis of the Penalized Challenger in $β$-EB-TCI for Bernoulli Bandits](https://arxiv.org/abs/2610.01951)
*Nam Nguyen,Tuan Quang Dam*

Main category: cs.LG

TL;DR: 本文研究Bernoulli臂的固定置信度最优臂识别中top-two算法的非渐近行为，针对β-EB-TCI算法证明停止时间约为T_β^*(μ)log(1/δ)，并给出高概率界与期望样本复杂度结果。


<details>
  <summary>Details</summary>
Motivation: top-two算法虽简单有效，但其尖锐的非渐近行为尚不清楚，尤其缺乏对停止时间精确刻画及期望样本复杂度的严格分析。

Method: 针对Jourdan等人的β-EB-TCI（基于Bernoulli运输成本与对数计数惩罚选择挑战者的经验最优top-two规则），分析经验领导者成为真实最优臂且采样比例临近β后的停止时间与各挑战者线性采样性质；结合有限均值充分探索条件及贡献O(√(Kt))的温和强制探索规则进行理论推导。

Result: 在经验领导者永久正确且采样分数接近β的机制下，停止时间达到T_β^*(μ)log(1/δ)（忽略低阶集中项），且每个挑战者被线性采样；对唯一最优臂的所有Bernoulli实例给出非渐近高概率界；在充分探索条件下得到尖锐期望样本复杂度，包括臂均值两两不同时的无保护Bernoulli规则；加入温和强制探索后得到任意臂数下的自包含期望样本复杂度定理，并指出现有通过单一指标比较处理相等次优均值的证明策略的局限。

Conclusion: β-EB-TCI在经验领导者永久正确后具有接近最优的停止时间与线性挑战者采样；配合充分探索或温和强制探索可获得尖锐期望样本复杂度；单一指标比较策略无法处理相等次优均值情形。

Abstract: Top-two algorithms are simple and effective for fixed-confidence best-arm identification, but their sharp non-asymptotic behavior is still not well understood. We study this problem for Bernoulli bandits through $β$-EB-TCI, the empirical-best top-two rule of Jourdan et al., whose challenger is chosen using a Bernoulli transportation cost with a logarithmic count penalty. We prove that, after the empirical leader has become the true best arm and its sampling fraction stays close to $β$, the stopping time is $T_β^{\star}(μ)\log(1/δ)$ up to lower-order concentration terms. We also show that, in this regime, every challenger is sampled linearly often. Thus, for the original algorithm without forced exploration, the main remaining difficulty is to control when the empirical leader becomes permanently correct. These results imply a non-asymptotic high-probability bound for all Bernoulli instances with a unique best arm. If the algorithm satisfies a finite-mean sufficient-exploration condition, the bound further yields the sharp expected sample complexity. In particular, this gives the sharp expectation result for the unguarded Bernoulli rule when all arm means are pairwise distinct, using the sufficient-exploration result of Jourdan et al. Finally, if we add a mild forced-exploration rule that contributes only $O(\sqrt{Kt})$ pulls up to time $t$, we obtain a self-contained expected sample-complexity theorem for any number of arms under the unique-best-arm assumption. We also identify a limitation of proof strategies that try to handle equal suboptimal means through a single index-comparison argument.

</details>


### [397] [The Curvature of Regret in Contextual Linear Optimization](https://arxiv.org/abs/2610.01980)
*Konstantinos Ziliaskopoulos,Alexander Vinel,Alice E. Smith*

Main category: cs.LG

TL;DR: 该论文研究线性优化中决策聚焦学习的非光滑性问题，证明逐点不连续的目标在数据分布平均后局部表现为二次曲率，并给出闭式表达与可计算近似。


<details>
  <summary>Details</summary>
Motivation: 线性优化中的优化器具有不连续性：成本的微小误差可能不改变决策，也可能使决策跳到另一个顶点，这使决策聚焦学习（decision-focused learning）的梯度与训练变得困难。作者希望刻画这种不连续性在总体分布层面上的平均行为，从而获得可用于学习的平滑结构。

Method: 作者从理论上分析逐点非光滑目标在数据分布下的平均，证明其局部呈二次行为，并推导曲率的闭式解：一个支撑在正规扇（normal fan）墙上的矩阵值测度。该测度仅依赖可行集，数据分布仅作为权重进入。随后提出一种仅需一次投影到可行集的曲率近似方法，并证明该近似弱收敛到真实总体曲率。最后将结论应用于期望成本线性优化的决策感知场景生成方法。

Result: 理论上给出了平均后二次曲率的闭式矩阵值测度表达，并证明所提近似弱收敛到真实总体曲率。实验验证了二次律与弱收敛律，并在电池套利任务上相比均匀分配取得30.8%的后悔值（regret）改进。

Conclusion: 研究表明，线性优化优化器的逐点不连续性在分布平均后转化为局部二次曲率，且曲率可由仅依赖可行集的矩阵值测度刻画。基于一次投影的近似在理论上弱收敛，并在决策感知场景生成中带来显著后悔值改善。

Abstract: Decision-focused learning for linear optimization is complicated by the discontinuity of the optimizer, where small cost errors may leave the decision unchanged or move it to a different vertex. We show that this non-smooth pointwise behavior becomes locally quadratic after averaging over the data distribution, and we derive the curvature in closed form, specifically, a matrix-valued measure supported on the walls of the normal fan. This measure depends only on the feasible set, with the data distribution entering only as a weight. We then offer a tractable approximation for this curvature, computable with just one projection to the feasible set. We prove that the approximation weakly converges to the true population curvature. We offer one application of our findings, a decision-aware scenario generation method for expected-cost linear optimization. Our experiments test the quadratic and weak convergence laws and show a 30.8% regret improvement over uniform allocation on battery arbitrage.

</details>


### [398] [Muon meets Tamed Langevin: Momentum Preconditioning beyond Convex and gradient-Lipschitz Potentials](https://arxiv.org/abs/2610.02158)
*Nikolaos Makras,Sotirios Sabanis*

Main category: cs.LG

TL;DR: 该论文研究非凸、非全局梯度Lipschitz势能下矩阵空间Gibbs分布的采样问题，提出一类非二次动能驱动的惯性Langevin系统与动量预条件方法，证明了动力学保持目标测度不变、加权全变差距离下指数收敛，并给出Euler-Maruyama离散的时间一致矩界。


<details>
  <summary>Details</summary>
Motivation: 现有采样方法通常要求势能凸或全局梯度Lipschitz，而矩阵空间上许多实际Gibbs分布不满足这些条件；因此需要放宽假设，设计能在非凸、非全局Lipschitz势能下稳定且收敛的采样动力学。

Method: 引入一族非二次动能，构造带动量预条件的欠阻尼Langevin系统，其中动能梯度充当对动量的光滑谱变换（spectral taming）；在该松弛势能假设下分析连续动力学的不变性与收敛性，并研究相应的Euler-Maruyama离散格式的稳定性。

Result: 证明所得动力学保持目标Gibbs测度不变，并在加权全变差距离下以指数速率收敛到平衡态；同时证明Euler-Maruyama离散在不对势能梯度作任何修正的情况下具有时间一致矩界，从而保证采样算法的稳定性。

Conclusion: 非二次动能与动量预条件机制可在弱化假设下实现矩阵空间Gibbs分布的有效采样，兼顾连续时间指数收敛与离散时间数值稳定性。

Abstract: We consider the problem of sampling from Gibbs distributions on matrix spaces whose potential energies are neither convex nor globally gradient-Lipschitz. We introduce a family of non-quadratic kinetic energies that lead to a new underdamped Langevin system with momentum preconditioning, in which the gradient of the kinetic energy acts as a smooth spectral taming of the momentum. We prove that, under these relaxed assumptions on the potential, the resulting dynamics leaves the target Gibbs measure invariant, and we establish exponential convergence to equilibrium in a weighted total variation distance. Finally, we show that the corresponding Euler-Maruyama discretization admits moment bounds that are uniform in time, without any modification of the potential gradient, which ensures the stability of the resulting sampling algorithm.

</details>


### [399] [Reverse Item Response Theory for Sparsity-Robust Ranking in Fragmented Cancer Drug-Response Matrices](https://arxiv.org/abs/2610.00002)
*Jung Min Kang*

Main category: cs.LG

TL;DR: 该研究将反向项目反应理论（reverse IRT）引入药物基因组学药物反应分析，把癌症类型视为具有"耐药能力"的潜在被试、药物视为具有"规避难度"的项目。基于GDSC2的242,036条药物敏感性测量，模型在共享潜在尺度上同时估计癌症类型层面的体外耐药性与药物层面的广谱活性，并通过缺失机制模拟、留出预测和PRISM跨平台复制进行验证。


<details>
  <summary>Details</summary>
Motivation: 药物反应数据普遍存在严重缺失（稀疏性），且缺失并非随机，可能由癌症类型或药物属性驱动。简单的平均法在此类碎片化评价下难以稳健地恢复真实的潜在排序，因此需要一种能显式建模缺失结构、并同时刻画癌症与药物双端潜在属性的统计框架。

Method: 将癌症类型定义为潜在"被试"（resistance ability）、药物定义为"项目"（evasion difficulty），采用反向IRT建模药物敏感性数据。数据来源为GDSC2数据库的242,036条测量。在四种缺失机制下（MCAR、癌症偏倚、药物偏倚等）进行验证，与简单平均法比较对全数据潜在排序的恢复能力；采用留出预测评估Brier分数；用Bootstrap置信区间判断分类稳定性；并在PRISM平台上做跨平台复制检验方向一致性与秩相关。

Result: 在60%缺失率下，MCAR、癌症偏倚和药物偏倚稀疏条件下，reverse IRT相对简单平均法的排序恢复优势为Δrho = +0.089至+0.095。留出预测中，IRT在五种评估方法中取得最优Brier分数。Bootstrap结果显示28种癌症类型中有19种具有稳定的耐药/敏感分类。跨平台PRISM复制显示方向一致性达82%，但秩相关较弱（rho = 0.25）。

Conclusion: reverse IRT为碎片化评价下的药物反应分析提供了方法学稳健性，而非一个普适的临床耐药排行榜。其在缺失数据下恢复潜在排序和预测表现方面优于简单平均法，但跨平台秩相关较弱，说明该贡献主要体现在统计建模的稳健性上，而非可直接推广的临床耐药性排序。

Abstract: We introduce reverse Item Response Theory (IRT) to pharmacogenomic drug-response analysis by treating cancer types as latent "subjects" with resistance ability and drugs as "items" with evasion difficulty. Applied to 242,036 drug sensitivity measurements from the Genomics of Drug Sensitivity in Cancer (GDSC2) database, the model estimates cancer-type-level in-vitro resistance and drug-level broad activity on a shared latent scale. Validation across four missingness regimes demonstrates that reverse IRT better recovers the full-data latent ranking than simple averaging, with advantages of Delta-rho = +0.089 to +0.095 at 60% missingness under MCAR, cancer-biased, and drug-biased sparsity. Held-out prediction confirms IRT achieves the best Brier score among five evaluated methods. Bootstrap confidence intervals show 19 of 28 cancer types have stable resistant/sensitive classifications. Cross-platform PRISM replication shows 82% directional agreement but weak rank-order correlation (rho = 0.25), indicating the contribution is methodological robustness under fragmented evaluation, not a universal clinical resistance leaderboard.

</details>


### [400] [How Far is Adam from Natural Gradient Descent?](https://arxiv.org/abs/2610.00004)
*Vihaan Paka-Hegde*

Main category: cs.LG

TL;DR: 本文将 Adam 的完整更新规则（含动量）建模为对角经验 Fisher 近似，并受对角截断、经验标签替换与时间滞后三重影响；用尺度不变的 γ(Δθ) 度量其真实 NGD 的几何偏差。实验表明偏差高度依赖情境：良态下很小，病态下显著上升，神经网络中错位可达约 10³；几何漂移越大初期优化越慢，但最终损失不退化。iEF 轨迹比 EF 更稳定。


<details>
  <summary>Details</summary>
Motivation: Adam 是深度学习标准优化器，但其与自然梯度下降（NGD）之间的几何关系仍有未解问题。作者希望厘清 Adam 究竟在多大程度上、以及在何种损失景观下近似真实 NGD，从而解释其实际优化能力的来源。

Method: 将 Adam 的完整更新规则（包含动量）解释为一种对角经验 Fisher 近似，该近似叠加了三项偏差：对角截断、经验标签替换、时间滞后。采用尺度不变的 γ(Δθ) 度量，在四类损失景观上量化 Adam 与真实 NGD 的几何偏差：良态线性回归、病态线性回归、逻辑回归，以及一个非凸小型神经网络；并对比改进经验 Fisher（iEF）与标准经验 Fisher（EF）的轨迹稳定性。

Result: Adam 的几何轨迹具有情境依赖性：良态设定下偏差保持较低，病态条件下显著上升，在神经网络中错位达到约 10³。较高的几何漂移与初期优化变慢相关，但不会损害最终目标最小化——Adam 始终能达到较低损失。此外，iEF 比标准 EF 追踪更稳定的路径，后者常出现振荡或发散。

Conclusion: Adam 的实际优化能力可能源于结构性近似误差与动量平滑之间的平衡，而非对自然梯度路径的紧密追踪。

Abstract: Adam is the standard optimizer in deep learning, yet its geometric relationship to natural gradient descent (NGD) contains unresolved questions. We study Adam's full update rule, including momentum, as a diagonal empirical Fisher approximation subject to diagonal truncation, empirical label substitution, and temporal lag. Using the scale-invariant $γ(Δθ)$ metric, we measure Adam's geometric deviation from true NGD across four loss landscapes: well-conditioned linear regression, ill-conditioned linear regression, logistic regression, and a non-convex small neural network. Adam's geometric trajectory is context-dependent. Deviation remains low in well-conditioned settings but rises significantly under ill-conditioning, reaching misalignments of $\approx 10^3$ in the neural network. Higher geometric drift correlates with slower initial optimization but does not degrade final objective minimization; Adam consistently reaches low loss. Furthermore, the improved empirical Fisher (iEF) tracks more stable paths than the standard empirical Fisher (EF), which frequently oscillates or diverges. Our results suggest Adam's practical optimization power may stem from a balance of structural approximation errors and momentum smoothing rather than close tracking of the natural gradient path.

</details>


### [401] [Fast Polynomial Transcendentals for LLMs](https://arxiv.org/abs/2610.00049)
*Robert Hu*

Main category: cs.LG

TL;DR: 该论文测试用短多项式程序替代LLM中SFU非线性函数，在Blackwell GB200上通过打包FMA/目标格式舍入/解析对称性实现加速，并评估其训练吞吐与损失影响。


<details>
  <summary>Details</summary>
Motivation: GPU不同代际对矩阵、特殊功能单元（SFU）和内存管线的扩展速率不同，导致内核瓶颈随硬件演进发生转移；FlashAttention-4已暴露Blackwell上注意力内部的这种不平衡，因此作者希望检验短多项式程序能否加速LLM中其他SFU操作。

Method: 先在隔离的FP16扫描中比较原生PyTorch与打包FMA程序，覆盖L2驻留和HBM驻留工作集；随后在四个GB200集成任务中用3次或4次BF16多项式替换原生sigmoid、tanh和SiLU，包括dense SiLU、tanh-softcapped attention、sigmoid attention和routed-expert SwiGLU，程序结合解析对称、目标格式舍入和消费内核内的打包算术。

Result: 隔离路径在L2提升1.19–2.19倍，在HBM提升1.00–1.70倍；dense-SiLU、tanh-softcapped-attention、routed-expert替换分别提升完整训练步吞吐2.7%、2.9%、8.0%；sigmoid-attention替换提升完整注意力前向7.4%和完整GPU步0.3%；约1000亿token常见horizon下，四个任务最终平滑训练损失差异（polynomial minus native）为-0.107至+0.079。

Conclusion: 短多项式程序可有效加速多类SFU非线性操作，并在若干LLM集成任务中带来训练吞吐提升；在相近预训练horizon下训练损失差异较小，说明该替换在性能收益与模型行为之间具有可行性。

Abstract: Graphics processing unit (GPU) generations scale matrix, special-function, and memory pipelines at different rates, so kernel bottlenecks move as hardware evolves. FlashAttention-4 exposed this imbalance inside attention on NVIDIA Blackwell. We test whether short polynomial programs can accelerate other special-function-unit (SFU) operations in large language models (LLMs). We first compare native PyTorch evaluation with packed fused multiply--add (FMA) programs in an isolated IEEE binary16 (FP16) sweep spanning L2-resident and high-bandwidth-memory (HBM)-resident working sets. We then replace native sigmoid, tanh, and sigmoid linear unit (SiLU) with degree-3 or degree-4 bfloat16 (BF16) programs in four GB200 integration tasks: dense SiLU, tanh-softcapped attention, sigmoid attention, and routed-expert Swish-gated linear unit (SwiGLU). The programs combine analytical symmetry, target-format rounding, and packed arithmetic inside consuming kernels. The isolated paths improve by 1.19--2.19x in L2 and 1.00--1.70x in HBM. The dense-SiLU, tanh-softcapped-attention, and routed-expert substitutions improve complete training-step throughput by 2.7\%, 2.9\%, and 8.0\%, respectively. The sigmoid-attention substitution improves complete-attention forward by 7.4\% and the complete GPU step by 0.3\%. Same-checkpoint open-weight ablations and one paired pre-training comparison per task extend the evaluation to model behavior. At common horizons near 100 billion tokens, the final smoothed training-loss differences (polynomial minus native) range from $-0.107$ to $+0.079$ across the four tasks.

</details>


### [402] [SW-KAN: Kolmogorov-Arnold Networks with Stieltjes-Wigert q-Orthogonal Polynomials](https://arxiv.org/abs/2610.00050)
*Amirhosein Azarpour,Seyyed Moein Kazemi*

Main category: cs.LG

TL;DR: 本文提出SW-KAN，用定义在半无限域上的Stieltjes-Wigert q-正交多项式替代KAN中的样条基，配合指数-of-tanh映射与三项递推，实现高精度、低参数的高效函数逼近与分类。


<details>
  <summary>Details</summary>
Motivation: 多项式型KAN变体虽缓解了B-spline的计算开销，但存在无界实数输入与正交多项式有界/半无限支撑之间的域不匹配问题，该问题尚未被充分研究。作者旨在通过引入适配半无限域的正交多项式基来解决这一根本性限制。

Method: 提出Stieltjes-Wigert Kolmogorov-Arnold Network（SW-KAN）：(1) 采用定义在(0, ∞)上的Stieltjes-Wigert q-正交多项式作为可学习单变量函数基；(2) 设计平滑的exponential-of-tanh映射，稳定桥接域间隙并保持良态梯度；(3) 利用数值稳定的三项递推，以O(N)复杂度计算多项式展开，无需调用特殊函数；其对数正态权重结构与可学习q参数构成独特归纳偏置。

Result: 在图像分类与连续函数逼近实验中，SW-KAN在多种任务上取得更优的精度-效率权衡；在资源受限条件（降低特征维度、有限训练数据）下表现稳健；在标准基准上优于现有多项式KAN基线；能以极少参数逼近复杂多元函数，展现强表示能力。

Conclusion: SW-KAN通过半无限域正交多项式基与稳定递推设计，有效解决了多项式KAN的域不匹配问题，在精度、参数效率与资源受限鲁棒性方面均具优势，是高效函数逼近与分类的有力替代方案。

Abstract: Kolmogorov-Arnold Networks (KANs) represent a paradigmatic shift in deep learning by replacing fixed node activations with learnable univariate functions on edges, offering enhanced interpretability and parameter efficiency. While recent polynomial-based KAN variants have addressed the computational overhead of original B-spline implementations, they introduce a fundamental yet underexplored challenge: the domain mismatch between unbounded real-valued inputs and the bounded or semi-infinite support of orthogonal polynomial bases. To address this limitation, we propose the Stieltjes-Wigert Kolmogorov-Arnold Network (SW-KAN), a novel architecture that employs Stieltjes-Wigert q-orthogonal polynomials defined on the semi-infinite domain (0, infinity). We introduce a smooth exponential-of-tanh mapping that stably bridges the domain gap while preserving well-conditioned gradients, and leverage a numerically stable three-term recurrence that evaluates polynomial expansions in O(N) operations without special-function calls. Through comprehensive experiments spanning image classification and continuous function approximation, we demonstrate that SW-KAN achieves superior accuracy-efficiency trade-offs across diverse tasks. The log-normal weight structure and learnable q-parameter of Stieltjes-Wigert polynomials provide a distinct inductive bias that enables robust performance under resource-constrained conditions, including reduced feature dimensionality and limited training data. The proposed architecture not only outperforms established polynomial KAN baselines on standard benchmarks but also exhibits strong representational capacity for approximating complex multivariate functions with remarkably few parameters, making it a compelling alternative for efficient function approximation and classification in resource-constrained settings.

</details>


### [403] [Format-Aware Fusion for Fast FP4 Pretraining](https://arxiv.org/abs/2610.00053)
*Robert Hu*

Main category: cs.LG

TL;DR: 本文提出"格式感知融合"方法，将量化生产端与其尺度域、消费者布局协同设计，在Llama-3系列8B预训练中使FP4 Tensor Core达到37.9K tokens/s/GPU，并分析不同尺度契约对训练损失与下游排名的影响。


<details>
  <summary>Details</summary>
Motivation: FP4 Tensor Core虽可加速矩阵乘法，但尺度计算、操作数打包、布局构建及反向状态保存会抵消其收益。作者希望通过对量化生产端、尺度域与消费者布局的协同设计，消除这些额外开销，从而在真实预训练中实现净加速。

Method: 提出format-aware fusion（格式感知融合），为native mxfp4、global nvfp4、cooperative-thread-array-local nvfp4分别协同设计量化生产者与尺度域及消费者布局；采用bfloat16输出投影与编译交叉熵，对Llama-3系列8B进行1600亿token预训练；并引入行梯度随机舍入、固定符号32值Hadamard权重梯度预条件等技术。

Result: 同加速器对比中，bfloat16与Transformer Engine nvfp4分别达18.8K和27.6K tokens/s/GPU，最快定制方案达37.9K；mxfp4结合行梯度随机舍入与Hadamard预条件达37.2K（86.3% bfloat16模型FLOP利用率），训练损失终点仅高于bfloat16原始终点2.11%；TE方案加四个最终bfloat16块在27.1K下达0.87%差距。下游任务排名与训练损失排名不一致。

Conclusion: FP4训练效果取决于尺度契约、操作数与执行路径的联合设计；格式感知融合可显著降低量化开销并接近bfloat16训练质量，但训练损失与下游排名的解耦表明需以更全面的指标评估低精度训练方案。

Abstract: Four-bit floating-point (FP4) Tensor Cores accelerate matrix multiplication, but scale computation, operand packing, layout construction, and saved backward state can erase the gain. We present \emph{format-aware fusion}, which co-designs each quantization producer with its scale domain and consumer layout for native \mxfp{}, global \nvfp{}, and cooperative-thread-array-local \nvfp{}. We evaluate Llama-3-family 8B pretraining through 160 billion tokens using bfloat16 output projections and compiled cross entropy. In matched same-accelerator probes, bfloat16 and Transformer Engine \nvfp{} reach 18.8K and 27.6K tokens/s/GPU, while our fastest custom route reaches 37.9K. \mxfp{} with row-gradient stochastic rounding and fixed-sign 32-value Hadamard weight-gradient preconditioning reaches 37.2K tokens/s/GPU (86.3\% bfloat16 model FLOP utilization) and ends 2.11\% above the raw bfloat16 training-loss endpoint. A Transformer Engine recipe with four final bfloat16 blocks ends 0.87\% above bfloat16 at 27.1K tokens/s/GPU. Downstream rankings differ from training-loss rankings, showing that FP4 outcomes depend jointly on scale contract, operand, and execution path.

</details>


### [404] ["very likely" Means "uncertain"? How LLMs Diverge from Humans in Linguistic Uncertainty Quantification](https://arxiv.org/abs/2610.00083)
*Jinhao Duan,Zicheng Liu,Zijie Liu,Kaidi Xu,Tianlong Chen*

Main category: cs.LG

TL;DR: 本文研究LLM与人类在言语不确定性量化上的差异，并提出METHODNAME算法，直接从LLM输出中学习不确定性标记的最优概率映射。


<details>
  <summary>Details</summary>
Motivation: 人类通过"可能""很可能"等标记表达不确定性，体现元认知监控；但现有LLM不确定性量化多依赖似然或一致性信号，忽略了言语标记这一认知维度。因此需探究LLM与人类的差异，以及言语标记能否可靠量化LLM不确定性。

Method: 从心理学与决策科学文献中整理人类不确定性标记语料库，对LLM进行基准测试；提出基于优化的算法METHODNAME，直接从LLM输出中学习标记-不确定性映射，通过拟合该映射以最优解释经验正确性，从而确定每个言语标记应承载的概率质量，无需重复采样。

Result: LLM编码的言语不确定性数值水平与人类存在显著差异；METHODNAME实现了标记层面的置信语义对比，能够分离错配并揭示言语表达中的系统性置信差异。

Conclusion: 言语标记可作为可靠的LLM不确定性量化信号；METHODNAME为人类与LLM在置信语义上的直接比较提供了新工具。

Abstract: Humans express uncertainty verbally via markers (e.g., "possible," "likely"), yet most LLM uncertainty quantification (UQ) relies on costing likelihood- or consistency-based signals. From a cognitive perspective, accurate verbal uncertainty reflects metacognitive monitoring, representing knowledge boundaries ("knowing that you don't know") to support regulation and information seeking. In this paper, we investigate how LLMs diverge from humans in verbal uncertainty quantification and whether verbal markers can reliably quantify LLM uncertainty. We curate a corpus of human uncertainty markers from psychology and decision-science literature and benchmark LLMs against it. We observe that LLMs encode verbal uncertainty with numerical levels that differ substantially from those of humans. We then introduce METHODNAME, a novel optimization-based algorithm that learns an optimal uncertainty profile over uncertainty markers directly from LLM outputs. By fitting a marker-uncertainty mapping to best explain empirical correctness, METHODNAME discovers how much probability mass each verbal marker should convey, rather than estimating uncertainty via repeated sampling. METHODNAME enables a direct, marker-level comparison of confidence semantics between humans and LLMs, disentangling mismatch and revealing systematic confidence disparities in verbal expressions.

</details>


### [405] [Nous: Learning and Certifying Memory Decisions Before Source Calibration](https://arxiv.org/abs/2610.00094)
*Pranav Singh*

Main category: cs.LG

TL;DR: 该论文从统计学习角度研究"基于信念的智能体记忆"中的决策可靠性问题，区分了学习、校准与修订认证三个任务，证明决策学习与认证的样本复杂度可显著低于源可靠性校准，并给出无需纯类锚点的有限样本认证方法与鲁棒性扩展，在MiniGrid环境中进行了实证验证。


<details>
  <summary>Details</summary>
Motivation: 基于信念的记忆系统其证据可能存在噪声、复制或过时，因此需要关于当前状态的可靠决策。核心疑问是：记忆是否必须先校准其证据来源，才能改进决策？论文试图厘清"决策学习/认证"与"源校准"在统计上是否可解耦，从而回答在何种条件下记忆决策可被学习并证明其改进，而不必先恢复源可靠性。

Method: 论文将问题形式化为学习、校准与修订认证三个分离的统计任务。在一个四模型隐马尔可夫族上给出样本复杂度刻画：学习未知贝叶斯决策需 Theta(l^-2) 条记录，认证其相对一个信息量充足的既有策略的改进需 O(l^-2) 条来自同一观测律的新鲜记录，而固定精度的源估计需要 Theta(l^-4)（随持久性 l 趋于零）。在未知"身份加背景"报告信道下，刻画策略改进的尖锐可识别区间，并利用可观测见证区域构造有限样本认证，无需纯类锚点。进一步给出容忍有界历史依赖误设与条件复制的鲁棒性扩展，并证明分训练见证方法在显式功效条件下适用于任意历史空间。实验上将策略界收据与 Nous Dimensions 结合，在 45,000 条留出的可变状态历史与 9,000 个回合上，于三个外部 MiniGrid 记忆环境（引入噪声报告接口）中测试。

Result: 理论上，决策的学习与认证在新样本上可比重放源校准少用二次方量级的记录，且在更广模型类中保持该决策率与源下界。实证上，新认证在 MiniGrid 中接受 9/9 个相对常数既有策略的改进、4/9 个相对 last-write-wins 的改进，而先前认证均未接受任何改进。强基线推理方法仍具竞争力或更优。

Conclusion: 论文给出了一个统计层面的论断：在何种情况下记忆决策可被学习并证明其合理性，而无需恢复源可靠性；它并非一个普遍更优的记忆算法。学习、认证与源校准在样本复杂度上可分离，且所提认证方法在噪声报告与鲁棒性设定下有效，但同时承认强推理基线在某些情形下仍具竞争力。

Abstract: Belief-based agent memory needs reliable decisions about current state, yet its evidence may be noisy, copied, or stale. Must a memory calibrate its sources before it can improve its decisions? We separate learning, calibration, and revision certification. On one four-model hidden Markov family, learning an unknown Bayes decision requires Theta(l^-2) records and certifying its improvement over an informative incumbent takes O(l^-2) fresh records from the same observation law, while fixed-precision source estimation requires Theta(l^-4) as persistence l vanishes. Thus learning and certifying useful decisions can require quadratically fewer records than source calibration. A broader model class retains the decision rate and source lower bound. Under an unknown identity-plus-background report channel, we characterize the sharp identified interval for policy improvement and derive a finite-sample certificate using observable witness regions, without pure-class anchors. A robustness extension tolerates bounded history-dependent misspecification and conditional copying; split-trained witnesses apply to arbitrary history spaces with explicit power conditions. We integrate policy-bound receipts with Nous Dimensions and test 45,000 held-out mutable-state histories and 9,000 episodes in three external MiniGrid memory environments with an introduced noisy-report interface. The new certificate accepts 9/9 improvements over a constant incumbent and 4/9 over last-write-wins, versus none for the earlier certificate in MiniGrid. Strong established inference baselines remain competitive or better. The result is a statistical account of when memory decisions can be learned and justified without recovering source reliability, not a universally superior memory algorithm.

</details>


### [406] [One Mastery Threshold Does Not Fit All Knowledge Tracing Models](https://arxiv.org/abs/2610.00095)
*Xianghui Meng,Yujing Zhang,Jionghao Lin*

Main category: cs.LG

TL;DR: 本文在4个公开教育数据集上比较6种知识追踪（KT）模型，评估0.50–0.99共12个掌握阈值对学业表现、进阶覆盖率、练习负担及群体差异的影响，发现阈值效应高度依赖于KT模型与教学优先级，需重新校准。


<details>
  <summary>Details</summary>
Motivation: 掌握阈值常被视为固定数值，但当底层KT模型变化时，同一阈值会产生截然不同的教学决策（是否停止练习、是否进阶），因此需要系统考察阈值与KT模型的交互效应及其对公平性与练习负担的影响。

Method: 在4个公开教育数据集上使用6种KT模型，评估12个阈值（0.50–0.99），指标包括进阶后表现、进阶覆盖率、练习负担以及不同先前表现群体间的差异；并在30种预设教学情境下识别兼顾表现、额外练习与进阶的平衡阈值。同时从模型输出语义上分析差异来源（潜在掌握概率 vs. 下一次作答正确概率）。

Result: BKT对阈值变化相对不敏感，神经模型随阈值升高显著更具选择性；这种差异部分源于两类模型输出含义不同，同一cutoff并不代表同等掌握水平。最佳平衡阈值在不同模型与情境间差异很大；在一半的测试情境中，神经模型与BKT所选阈值相差超过0.10，但当更重视减少额外练习、允许更多学生进阶时该差距缩小。更严格的阈值并未可靠缩小表现差距，反而可能不成比例地限制进阶，先前表现较强的学生进阶频率最高可达较弱学生的3.26倍。

Conclusion: 掌握阈值不应视为通用常量：当KT模型或教学优先级改变时应重新校准，并从表现、练习、进阶与可及性（access）四个维度综合评估其后果，以避免因阈值迁移带来的不公平与低效。

Abstract: Tutoring systems use mastery thresholds to decide when students can stop practicing and advance, but the same numerical threshold can lead to very different decisions when the underlying knowledge tracing (KT) model changes. We examine six KT models across four public educational datasets and evaluate 12 thresholds from 0.50 to 0.99 using post-advancement performance, advancement coverage, practice burden, and disparities across prior-performance groups. We also identify thresholds that balance performance, extra practice, and advancement under 30 predefined instructional settings. Bayesian Knowledge Tracing (BKT) is relatively insensitive to threshold changes, while neural models become much more selective as thresholds increase. This partly reflects different model outputs: BKT estimates latent mastery probability, whereas neural models estimate the probability of a correct next response, so the same cutoff does not represent the same level of mastery. The best-balanced threshold varied substantially across models and settings. In half of the tested settings, neural models and BKT differed by more than 0.10 in their selected thresholds, although this gap became smaller when greater priority was placed on reducing extra practice and allowing more students to advance. Stricter thresholds also did not reliably reduce performance gaps and could disproportionately restrict advancement, with stronger-prior students advancing up to 3.26 times as often as weaker-prior students. These results show that mastery thresholds should be recalibrated when the KT model or instructional priorities change and evaluated by their effects on performance, practice, advancement, and access.

</details>


### [407] [Uncertainty-Aware Learning from Multi-Expert Interval Targets](https://arxiv.org/abs/2610.00102)
*Samira Alkaee Taleghan,Younghyun Koo,Andrew P. Barrett,Farnoush Banaei-Kashani*

Main category: cs.LG

TL;DR: 该论文针对多专家提供区间标签时存在的两类不确定性（标签内不精确性与专家间差异），提出保留个体专家区间、分离并验证预测不确定性成分的方法。


<details>
  <summary>Details</summary>
Motivation: 机器学习应用依赖专家标注，但不同专家对同一观测可能给出不同但合理的解释，这种差异反映真实分歧或模糊性而非标注错误。当专家还提供区间而非精确值时，监督信号包含两种不同的标签不确定性：标签内不精确性和专家间差异。现有方法分别处理这两类不确定性：多专家方法将标签塌缩为共识，区间目标方法通常只给出单一预测，预测不确定性方法很少用观测到的专家分歧来验证其不确定性估计。因此需要一个能同时保留并分离这两类不确定性并进行验证的方法。

Method: 1）将异构标签词表统一到共同的概率标签空间，把编码差异与专家判断分离开；2）保留个体标签区间，用Beta混合分布建模，并使用适当的Cramér距离目标函数训练，保留各专家报告的独特标签；3）将预测不确定性分解为组内成分、组间成分和模型不确定性，并评估这些成分是否分别对应标签内不确定性、标签间不确定性和模型误差；4）由于这种对应关系无法保证，引入分解匹配（decomposition matching）将预测成分对齐到其预期的标签侧来源。

Result: 在海冰浓度数据集上，该模型相比硬标签将MAE降低31%，并优于聚合、区间分布和区间回归等基线方法。

Conclusion: 通过在统一概率标签空间中保留个体专家区间、用Beta混合建模并分解预测不确定性，再通过分解匹配对齐标签侧来源，该方法能够有效分离并验证标签内不精确性与专家间差异，在海冰浓度任务上显著优于现有基线。

Abstract: Many machine learning (ML) applications rely on expert labels, and qualified experts may provide different but plausible interpretations of the same observation. Such variation across expert labels may reflect genuine disagreement or ambiguity rather than annotation error. When individual experts additionally report intervals rather than exact values, the supervision contains two distinct sources of label uncertainty: within-label imprecision and between-expert variation. Existing methods treat these forms separately: multi-expert approaches collapse labels to a consensus, interval-target methods often yield a single prediction, and predictive-uncertainty methods rarely validate their uncertainty estimates against observed expert disagreement. To address this problem, we propose an approach that preserves individual expert intervals, separates within-label imprecision from between-expert variation, and validates the corresponding predictive uncertainty components. First, heterogeneous label vocabularies are harmonized into a common probabilistic label space, separating encoding differences from expert judgement. Second, individual label intervals are retained and modeled with a mixture of Beta distributions trained using a proper Cramér-distance objective, preserving distinct expert-reported labels. Third, we decompose predictive uncertainty into within-component, between-component, and model uncertainty, and evaluate whether these components correspond to within-label uncertainty, between-label uncertainty, and model error, respectively. Because this correspondence is not guaranteed, we introduce decomposition matching, which aligns the predictive components to their intended label-side sources. On sea-ice concentration the model reduces MAE by 31\% over hard labels and outperforms aggregation, interval-distribution, and interval-regression baselines.

</details>


### [408] [The Hidden Costs of 99% Accuracy: A Trustworthiness Audit of the Telco Customer Churn Benchmark](https://arxiv.org/abs/2610.00118)
*Soumyadeep Roy*

Main category: cs.LG

TL;DR: 对IBM Telco客户流失基准（n=7,043）进行可信度审计，发现四项被准确率/F1导向报告所掩盖的失效：预划分SMOTE泄漏、TotalCharges冗余字段、校准缺陷与阈值选择偏差，并给出四组件报告清单及可复现实现。


<details>
  <summary>Details</summary>
Motivation: 该基准上普遍报告超过95%的测试准确率（最高被引研究达99.01%），但以准确率和F1为中心的评价体系无法揭示数据泄漏、特征冗余、概率校准与决策阈值等可信度问题，可能导致模型性能被高估且SHAP解释与业务决策被误导。

Method: （1）跨10个分类器、15个随机种子对比预划分SMOTE与类权重流程，并用Wilcoxon检验验证F1膨胀；通过最近邻分析量化合成点与测试集的插值重叠。（2）对TotalCharges做R2诊断（tenure×MonthlyCharges，R2=0.999），并以TreeSHAP归因排名与移除该特征后的准确率变化做对照。（3）15种子校准审计，比较isotonic regression与temperature scaling。（4）以50美元挽留成本与24个月CLV代理计算成本最优阈值，与F1最优阈值对比；并在Iranian Telecom Churn（同域）与Bank Customer Churn（跨域）上复现F1/F2。

Result: 预划分SMOTE使流失类F1平均膨胀13.1个百分点（每个分类器Wilcoxon p<10^-4），约36%合成训练点为测试集实例的最近邻插值；改用类权重后膨胀消失。移除TotalCharges后准确率变化<0.2个百分点，但TreeSHAP仍将其排在第9位平均绝对归因，提出R2>0.95的建模前诊断。校准中isotonic回归最优，temperature scaling在类加权树集成（预测概率双峰）上失效。成本最优阈值比F1最优阈值低约5-10倍，每1,000名客户节省约77,000美元。F1在同域与跨域均可泛化，F2仅在电信域内泛化。

Conclusion: 基于四项发现提出四组件报告清单——流程披露、冗余诊断、校准审计与成本敏感阈值，并发布可复现实现，以提升流失预测研究的可信度与业务可用性。

Abstract: Customer churn prediction on the IBM Telco Customer Churn benchmark (n = 7,043) routinely reports test accuracies above 95%, with the most cited published study reporting 99.01%. We audit this benchmark for four trustworthiness failures invisible to the accuracy- and F1-centred reporting that dominates the literature. First, pre-split SMOTE inflates churn-class F1 by 13.1 percentage points across ten classifiers and fifteen seeds (Wilcoxon p < 10^-4 per classifier); the same leaky pipeline ordering paired with class weighting yields no inflation, isolating the effect to SMOTE's geometric construction. We measure the mechanism directly: approximately 36% of synthetic training points are nearest-neighbour interpolations of test-set instances. Second, the TotalCharges field is approximately determined by tenure multiplied by MonthlyCharges (R2 = 0.999); removing it changes accuracy by less than 0.2 percentage points, yet TreeSHAP ranks it ninth in mean absolute attribution - a pattern that materially corrupts SHAP-based interpretation. We propose an R2 > 0.95 pre-modelling diagnostic. Third, in a 15-seed calibration audit, isotonic regression is the strongest default; temperature scaling fails on class-weighted tree ensembles whose predicted-probability distribution is bimodal. Fourth, the cost-optimal decision threshold (under a 50 USD retention offer and 24-month CLV proxy) is approximately 5-10 times lower than the F1-optimal threshold, saving approximately 77,000 USD per 1,000 customers. We replicate F1 and F2 on Iranian Telecom Churn (within domain) and Bank Customer Churn (across domain): F1 generalises; F2 generalises only within telecom. We synthesise these findings into a four-component reporting checklist - pipeline disclosure, redundancy diagnostic, calibration audit, and cost-sensitive thresholds - and release a reproducible implementation.

</details>


### [409] [Generalized Biomedicine Discovery](https://arxiv.org/abs/2610.00120)
*Luyao Tang,Yingkai Yang,Hanqi Chen,Jiewei Zheng,Chaoqi Chen,Cheng Chen*

Main category: cs.LG

TL;DR: 该文提出广义生物医学发现（GBD）任务与统一基准，并设计受认知启发的方法SCAN，通过预测抑制、惊讶诱发显著性与互补适应三步，在长尾、异常与层级分类的开放世界医学图像中发现新概念，同时尽量保持已有临床知识。


<details>
  <summary>Details</summary>
Motivation: 真实临床医学图像存在开放世界偏移：长尾罕见病、被正常解剖结构主导的细微病灶、层级分类体系；而多数开放世界范式假设标签空间平坦且类别均衡，无法满足生物医学需求。

Method: 关键洞察是主导性已知模式构成视觉流形并掩盖细微新异性。受专家诊断启发提出SCAN（惊讶诱发互补适应），遵循认知启发的感知进程：先用预测抑制过滤预期常态，再以惊讶诱发显著性突出意外偏差，最后通过互补适应将这些偏移整合进全局表示。

Result: 大量实验表明，SCAN在提升新概念发现能力的同时总体上保持既有临床知识，并可插入现有架构以更好地权衡医学图像中的已知-未知取舍。

Conclusion: SCAN为医学图像开放世界发现提供了统一基准与通用模块，能兼顾新概念发现与既有知识保持，代码已开源。

Abstract: In real-world clinical practice, medical images face open-world shifts: (i) long-tailed rare diseases, (ii) subtle lesions dominated by normal anatomy, and (iii) hierarchical taxonomies. Yet most open-world paradigms assume flat, balanced label spaces, leaving these biomedical demands unresolved. We introduce Generalized Biomedicine Discovery (GBD) and a unified benchmark spanning long-tail, anomaly, and taxonomy-aware discovery. Our key insight is that dominant known patterns form a visual manifold that masks subtle novelty. Inspired by expert diagnosis, we propose SCAN (Surprise-evoked Complementary AccommodatioN), which follows a cognition-inspired perceptual progression: it applies predictive suppression to filter expected norms, triggers surprise-evoked salience to highlight unexpected deviations, and performs complementary accommodation to integrate these shifts into global representations. Extensive experiments show that SCAN improves novel concept discovery while generally preserving established clinical knowledge, and it plugs into existing architectures to better navigate the known-unknown trade-off in medical imaging. Code is available at https://github.com/lytang63/generalized-biomedicine-discovery.

</details>


### [410] [Classification Based on Association Rules Algorithm for Breast Cancer](https://arxiv.org/abs/2610.00174)
*Ali Alsalama,Ahmed Kubba,Ghaith Jamjoum,Zaher Al Aghbari*

Main category: cs.LG

TL;DR: 本文提出一种基于加权分类的关联规则数据挖掘方法用于乳腺癌分类，包含规则生成、规则剪枝与规则预测三个核心算法，并在测试样本上验证了该方法的可行性与性能。


<details>
  <summary>Details</summary>
Motivation: 乳腺癌是导致女性死亡的重要原因，发病率居各类癌症前列，早期检测需求迫切。关联规则挖掘具有结果易被医学专业人员理解的优点，因此成为研究者青睐的分类方法，但现有方法在分类精度与规则利用上仍有改进空间，本文据此提出加权分类的关联规则方法。

Method: 提出一种基于加权分类（weighted classification）的关联规则数据挖掘技术，实现包含三个核心算法：1）规则生成（Rule Generation）——识别频繁项集并生成关联规则；2）规则剪枝（Rule Pruning）——依据特定准则剔除规则，并根据其对训练数据的影响力将规则划分为主要规则组与次要规则组；3）规则预测（Rule Prediction）——利用剪枝后的规则对测试数据进行分类。

Result: 最终预测算法在多个测试样本上进行了测试，结果展示了该方法的可行性与性能表现。

Conclusion: 基于加权分类的关联规则方法可用于乳腺癌分类，其规则生成—剪枝—预测的流程具备可行性，且关联规则形式便于医学专业人员理解，具有一定的应用价值。

Abstract: Breast cancer is a significant contributor to female mortality across the world, displaying one of the highest oc currence rates among the various cancer types. In response to the need for early breast cancer detection, researchers have increasingly turned to association rule-based classification as a favored method. Association Rule mining is a data mining approach which offers the benefit of yielding results that are readily understandable for medical professionals. This paper introduces a novel association rule-based data mining technique for breast cancer classification based on a weighted classification approach. This implementation employs three core algorithms: Rule Generation, Rule Pruning, and Rule Prediction. Rule Generation identifies frequent itemsets and creates association rules. Rule Pruning eliminates rules using specific criteria and separates them into major and minor groups based on their influence on training data. Rule Prediction applies the pruned rules to classify test data. The final prediction algorithm was tested on several testing samples to show the feasibility and performance of the approach.

</details>


### [411] [Four Ways to Grow a Classifier and Why One of Them Cannot Learn](https://arxiv.org/abs/2610.00180)
*Cagri Temel*

Main category: cs.LG

TL;DR: 本文在统一协议下实证评估树结构与构造式模型中四种"生长决策"的收益，并给出其中"无效生长"（叶节点门化加深）的精确诊断与修复方案。


<details>
  <summary>Details</summary>
Motivation: 构造式分类器在训练中动态增加结构（树层、隐藏单元、叶分裂），但缺乏统一协议来衡量每种生长决策究竟带来什么收益，尤其需要诊断并修复那些实际无收益的生长方式。

Method: 在固定的树结构与构造式模型协议下，对四种生长决策进行对比（三组随机种子、五折交叉验证）。诊断部分：将软决策树的每个叶节点变为门、两个子节点继承父节点的类分布使函数不变，通过梯度分析证明新门梯度恒为零，且门为1/2时两子节点梯度相同。修复方法为对子节点施加小幅随机扰动。同时在测试中加入断言：新增参数后其梯度必须非零。

Result: 无效构建在Iris、Wine、Digits上分别损失19.6、19.1、55.6个准确率点（相比同深度从头训练）；小幅随机扰动即可修复，扰动幅度影响很小。其余三种决策：拟合残差的新隐藏单元可获得更小网络但准确率无提升，Digits上显著下降；最大期望误差叶分裂带来稀疏性（0.885，3.7次分裂 vs 完整六层树63次），但困难问题上损失4.3点；要求统计显著性后再分裂无收益，树更大且更不准确。

Conclusion: 四种生长决策中三种各有一项收益（更小网络、稀疏性），一种（门化加深）不带来任何收益且梯度消失；实用规则是新增参数后断言其梯度非零。所有数值均由测量脚本插入，保证可复现。

Abstract: Constructive classifiers add structure while they train: a level to a tree, a unit to a hidden layer, a split at a leaf. This paper asks what each of four such growth decisions actually buys, measured under one fixed protocol in tree-structured and constructive models, and gives an exact diagnosis and a fix for the one that buys nothing.
  The diagnosis concerns the most natural way to deepen a soft decision tree: turn every leaf into a gate whose two children inherit the parent's class distribution, so that the function is unchanged. I prove that this leaves the gradient of every new gate identically zero and, with the gate at 1/2, gives the two children identical gradients, so the added level can never learn. Unlike the symmetry that Net2Net breaks with noise or the saddle point that splitting steepest descent escapes with second-order information, first-order information here is not weak but absent. Over three seeds of five-fold cross-validation the construction loses 19.6 accuracy points on Iris, 19.1 on Wine and 55.6 on Digits against the same depth trained from scratch. The fix is a small random perturbation of the children, whose size barely matters. The practical rule is one line in a test: after adding parameters, assert that their gradient is nonzero.
  The other three decisions each buy one thing. Fitting a new hidden unit to the residual error before installing it buys a smaller network on every dataset, though not a more accurate one, and on Digits it costs accuracy significantly. Splitting the leaf with the largest expected error buys sparsity, reaching 0.885 with 3.7 splits where a complete depth-six tree uses 63, but loses 4.3 points on a harder problem. Requiring statistical significance before a node receives a more expressive split buys nothing: the tree gets larger and less accurate.
  Every number in the paper is inserted from the measurement script.

</details>


### [412] [Energy Time-Series Imputation with Differentially Private Diffusion Models via Clipping-Aware Objective Conditioning](https://arxiv.org/abs/2610.00209)
*Huizhen Huang,Yu Li,Tao Huang,Chen Hou*

Main category: cs.LG

TL;DR: 提出面向差分隐私扩散模型的"目标-裁剪相互作用"优化框架，用v-预测与噪声日程感知动态加权抑制低信噪比后期时间步的裁剪前梯度膨胀，在5个真实能源时间序列数据集上稳定提升缺失填补效用。


<details>
  <summary>Details</summary>
Motivation: 能源时间序列的细粒度测量含敏感时间信息，需在隐私保护下可靠填补缺失值。DP-SGD训练的扩散模型是有前景的框架，但在余弦扩散日程下，后期时间步对应低信噪比（SNR），标准ε-预测会放大裁剪前梯度，使其更易被固定阈值裁剪，导致保留的优化信号减少、填补效用下降。

Method: 将目标函数与梯度裁剪的相互作用形式化为固定阈值DP-SGD下的目标优化问题，并提出时间步感知的目标条件化：1）采用v-预测缓解后期时间步的梯度放大；2）使用静态损失加权作为统一缩放对照；3）引入扩散日程感知的动态加权，在裁剪前施加更强衰减。

Result: 在5个真实能源时间序列数据集上，覆盖随机点缺失、连续块缺失、持续中断及多种缺失严重程度。相同DP-SGD设置下，所提方法在填补效用上持续优于ε-预测基线。梯度诊断显示裁剪前梯度范数上尾更低、裁剪比例下降、后期低SNR时间步衰减更强。

Conclusion: 验证了裁剪感知的目标条件化对隐私保护能源时间序列填补的有效性，v-预测结合日程感知动态加权可作为缓解DP-SGD梯度裁剪信息损失的有效方案。

Abstract: Reliable recovery of missing measurements is important for monitoring and analysis in energy time-series systems, where fine-grained measurements may contain sensitive temporal information. Diffusion models trained with differentially private stochastic gradient descent (DP-SGD) provide a promising framework for privacy-sensitive energy time-series imputation. Under cosine diffusion schedules, late timesteps correspond to low signal-to-noise ratio (SNR) conditions, where standard $\varepsilon$-prediction can induce large pre-clipping gradients. Such gradients are more likely to be clipped, reducing the retained optimization signal. The artificial intelligence (AI) contribution lies in formulating this objective--clipping interaction as an objective optimization problem under fixed-threshold DP-SGD and developing timestep-aware objective conditioning for diffusion-based energy time-series imputation. The method adopts $v$-prediction to mitigate late-timestep gradient amplification, uses static loss weighting as a uniform-scaling control, and introduces diffusion-schedule-aware dynamic weighting for stronger attenuation before clipping. For the engineering application, we evaluate the method on five real-world energy time-series datasets across random point missingness, contiguous block missingness, persistent outages, and multiple missing-data severities. Under matched DP-SGD settings, the proposed method consistently improves imputation utility over the $\varepsilon$-prediction baseline. Gradient diagnostics reveal lower upper-tail pre-clipping gradient norms, reduced clipping fractions, and stronger attenuation at late low-SNR timesteps, supporting the effectiveness of clipping-aware objective conditioning for energy time-series imputation.

</details>


### [413] [Useful to Whom? Sample Value Is Defined Only Relative to the Learner](https://arxiv.org/abs/2610.00221)
*Yangze Liu,Xiao-Long Yin,Zhongyi Han*

Main category: cs.LG

TL;DR: 该论文提出核心集选择中的"交叉边界"（易样本优先 vs. 几何覆盖）并非由数据固定，而是依赖于目标学习器的容量与结构；通过冻结子集、只改变学习器的受控实验证实了学习器依赖性。


<details>
  <summary>Details</summary>
Motivation: 核心集选择研究"在预算约束下保留对训练最有用的样本"，其中易样本优先（easy-first）与几何覆盖（geometric coverage）两类准则在不同预算区间各有优势，二者由交叉边界分隔。作者质疑该边界是否由数据固定，还是随目标学习器变化——若随学习器变化，则选择策略的评估必须针对具体学习器。

Method: 采用冻结子集干预：固定所选样本子集不变，仅操纵训练学习器。在低分辨率 ImageNet-100 上改变 ResNet-18 宽度；进行输入网格与容量交互的扫掠；通过 stride 控制在不改变输入网格的情况下再现与逆转网格效应；在原生 224px ImageNet-1k 协议下检验宽度效应（LFrac、EL2N 探针）；并将卷积学习系统替换为 ViT 进行对比。

Result: 低分辨率 ImageNet-100 上，ResNet-18 宽度翻倍使交叉点从 57 移至 85 样本/类，说明学习器改变了相同样本的相对价值。输入网格与容量存在交互：在同一图像信息下增大网格使边界左移，且该左移随宽度增大而减弱；仅移除最后一个下采样 stride 即可恢复左移，stride 控制可再现并逆转网格效应。原生 224px ImageNet-1k 上宽度效应较小且依赖探针：LFrac 近乎平缓，EL2N 略微右移。将卷积学习系统换成 ViT 后，在全部测量范围内覆盖准则均胜出，即使易样本子集来自卷积代理。

Conclusion: 结果通过冻结子集干预确立了边界的"学习器依赖性"，并识别出可移动该边界的网络结构（宽度、输入网格、stride、架构类型），但未给出普适的缩放律。实践含义明确：选择策略所偏好的预算区间必须针对目标学习器进行评估。

Abstract: What kind of data does a model need in order to learn? Coreset selection makes this question concrete: under a budget, keep the samples most useful for training. Easy-first and geometric coverage criteria can win in different budget regimes, separated by a crossover boundary. We ask whether this boundary is fixed by the data or changes with the target learner. Controlled experiments freeze the selected subsets and manipulate only the training learner. On low-resolution ImageNet-100, doubling ResNet-18's width moves the crossover from 57 to 85 samples per class: the learner changes the relative value of the same samples. A wider sweep reveals an interaction between input grid and capacity. Enlarging the grid while retaining the same image information shifts the boundary left, and this shift weakens as width increases. Stride controls reproduce and reverse the grid effect without changing the input grid; removing only the last downsampling stride is sufficient to recover the leftward shift. Under the native-224px ImageNet-1k protocol, width effects are smaller and depend on the probe: LFrac remains nearly flat, while EL2N shifts modestly right. Swapping the convolutional learning system for a ViT makes coverage win throughout the measured range, even when the easy subsets come from the convolutional proxy. These results establish learner dependence through frozen-subset interventions and identify network structure that can move the boundary. They do not yield a universal scaling law. Their practical implication is direct: a selection strategy's preferred budget regime must be evaluated with respect to the target learner.

</details>


### [414] [Constant-Memory Recall: Learned Associations in a Fixed Matrix State](https://arxiv.org/abs/2610.00232)
*Samuel Larson*

Main category: cs.LG

TL;DR: 固定规模循环记忆的DeltaNet变体在32 KiB状态下实现32对键值精准召回（99.95%），但参数匹配的向量与Transformer基线均接近随机水平，导致无法比较记忆效率。


<details>
  <summary>Details</summary>
Motivation: 固定规模循环记忆限制推理时存储增长，但成功召回取决于任务与训练方式，需验证其在特定召回任务上的能力及与基线方法的可比性。

Method: 研究带固定token特定键偏置的小型DeltaNet变体，训练其每序列记忆32个新键值对；使用32 KiB循环矩阵状态，进行三训练种子测试；并用填充延长查询前上下文至1,798 token；将首个记忆块置零进行消融；开展48对探索性测试；与参数匹配的向量和Transformer基线对比。

Result: 32 KiB状态下三训练种子平均准确率99.95%；填充延长至1,798 token仍近完美；置零首个记忆块后召回消失；48对探索测试在主要训练预算四分之一后仍近随机，未定位容量上限；参数匹配的向量与Transformer基线近随机，额外训练搜索后仍如此。

Conclusion: 该DeltaNet变体在特定键值召回任务上表现优异且对填充鲁棒，但基线持续失败阻碍了记忆效率比较，容量上限仍未被定位。

Abstract: Fixed-size recurrent memory limits storage growth during inference, but successful recall depends on the task and training. We study a small DeltaNet variant with fixed token-specific key biases, trained to remember 32 new key-value pairings per sequence. With 32 KiB of recurrent matrix state, it achieves 99.95% mean accuracy across three training seeds when choosing among the sequence's values. Recall remains near perfect when filler extends the pre-query context to 1,798 tokens without adding pairings. Zeroing the first memory block removes this recall. An exploratory 48-pair test remains near chance after one quarter of the primary training budget and does not locate a capacity limit. Parameter-matched vector and Transformer baselines remain near chance, including the Transformer after additional training searches. This unresolved baseline failure prevents a memory-efficiency comparison.

</details>


### [415] [How Many Categories Are Enough? Distribution-Free Certification Limits for Few-Shot Anomaly Thresholds](https://arxiv.org/abs/2610.00236)
*Gia Huy Thai,Nguyen Thai Anh*

Main category: cs.LG

TL;DR: 本文研究少样本异常检测中可迁移报警阈值的可认证性问题：目标域自身的留一图像校准受分辨率限制且在分布偏移下脆弱，而类别层面的分布无关置信上界需要至少14/29/59个独立同分布类别样本，远多于实际可得，因此提出CRESS协议以明确源证据支持可靠性声明的作用边界。


<details>
  <summary>Details</summary>
Motivation: 少样本异常检测的评价通常依赖排序类指标（如AUROC），但实际部署需要设定具有可控误报率（FAR）的报警阈值。核心问题是：对于未见类别，需要多少"正常证据"（无论以图像为单位还是以类别为单位）才能对该阈值进行可靠性认证。现有目标域自身校准方法受分辨率和分布偏移限制，缺乏对可认证性边界的定量分析。

Method: 采用冻结的DINOv2主成分分析（PCA）残差排序器，在15个MVTec和12个VisA类别、四种损坏类型下进行实验。首先分析目标域留一图像（LOIO）校准：由于秩值无法低于1/(k+1)，其可达显著性水平受限，在k=4、α=0.20时可达到的最优水平下，高斯损坏MVTec的经验FAR达0.341。随后推导类别计数可行性演算：即使假设全零类别损失且不计多重性，任何确定性、一致有效、分布无关的95%置信上界（UCB）在α=0.20/0.10/0.05下分别至少需要14/29/59个独立同分布类别抽样。最后提出CRESS协议，将源类别划分为参考、提议和认证三种互斥角色。

Result: LOIO校准在高斯损坏MVTec、k=4、α=0.20时经验FAR达0.341，为标称水平的1.7倍，显示其分辨率受限且对偏移脆弱。类别计数演算给出α=0.20/0.10/0.05下分别至少需14/29/59个iid类别抽样（必要非充分）。CRESS在仅有3或4个认证类别时，全部960个冻结配置均返回失效关闭阈值τ*=0，最小类别级UCB为0.950。对同一档案的图像单元分析在36.7%至60.3%的目标单元中选择正阈值，但这些界仅对所选源混合成立，不适用于新类别抽样的边际风险。

Conclusion: 本文的贡献在于给出了一个定量的可行性边界，以及一个可识别估计量（estimand-aware）的协议，明确规定了源证据何时能够、何时不能支持可迁移的可靠性声明。类别层面的可靠认证在当前少样本设定下几乎不可行，图像层面的界也存在适用性限制。

Abstract: Few-shot anomaly detectors are judged by ranking metrics, yet deployment requires an alarm threshold with a controlled false-alarm rate (FAR). We ask how much normal evidence, in images or category units, is needed to certify such a threshold for an unseen category. Using a frozen DINOv2 principal component analysis (PCA) residual ranker on 15 MVTec and 12 VisA categories under four corruption types, we show that target-only leave-one-image-out (LOIO) calibration is resolution-limited and shift-fragile: rank values cannot fall below $1/(k+1)$, and at the attainable level $α=0.20$, empirical FAR reaches 0.341 on Gaussian-corrupted MVTec at $k=4$, 1.7 times the nominal level. A category-count feasibility calculus is then derived: even with all-zero category losses and no multiplicity charged, any deterministic, uniformly valid, distribution-free 95% upper confidence bound (UCB) requires at least 14, 29, and 59 independent and identically distributed (iid) category draws at $α=0.20$, $0.10$, and $0.05$; these counts are necessary but not sufficient. The Cross-category Reliability Estimation with Source Support (CRESS) protocol splits source categories into disjoint reference, proposal, and certification roles. With only three or four certification categories, all 960 frozen configurations return the fail-closed threshold $τ^\star=0$, and the smallest category-level UCB is 0.950. Image-unit analyses of the same archive select positive thresholds in 36.7% to 60.3% of target cells; these bounds hold for the selected source mixture, not for the marginal risk of a new-category draw. The contribution is a quantitative feasibility boundary and an estimand-aware protocol specifying when source evidence can, and cannot, support a transferable reliability claim.

</details>


### [416] [Contingent Exposure Routing for Financial AI: Outage Risk and the Cost of Indivisible Decisions](https://arxiv.org/abs/2610.00239)
*Shivam Gupta*

Main category: cs.LG

TL;DR: 论文将“故障切换（failover）路由”建模为网元级局部市场冲击响应矩阵下的组合优化问题，研究预期平方价格位移，提出平衡回退路由与不可分决策下的精确二阶矩及舍入/交换算法，并通过合成网络与API回放验证风险下降。


<details>
  <summary>Details</summary>
Motivation: 故障切换虽恢复可用性，却改变了哪些金融机构共享同一决策误差，从而可能造成风险集中；作者希望量化这种“错误相关性”在路由重构后的价格冲击，并给出可审计的压力测试方法，而非估计真实市场崩盘概率。

Method: 1) 以outage-contingent routing为对象，构造局部市场冲击响应矩阵，目标为expected squared price displacement；2) 对称构造分析共享备份导致的order-one concentration floor，并证明balanced fallback risk随存活端点数量反比下降；3) 对indivisible decisions推导独立随机路由的精确二阶矩与effective-exposure granularity，刻画其相对fractional allocation的差距；4) 使用conditional-expectation rounding给出有限智能体界，并设计保持端点数量的swap procedure，用对偶下界评估。

Result: 在60个合成组合网络、11,340次情景评估中，中心反馈设置且误差独立时，swap procedure在单端点与双端点移除下分别降低风险6.57%与10.53%；在1,024条记录API响应的再平衡任务回放中，留出集风险降低较小，为3.30%（配对bootstrap区间2.07%–4.57%）。强对齐误差、劣质端点与不可分性会限制分散化收益。

Conclusion: 共享备份可造成集中风险下限，平衡回退可随存活端点数增加而降低风险；不可分路由需借助精确二阶矩、舍入与交换算法优化。该工作提供可审计的路由压力测试与实现分析，不用于估计真实市场崩盘概率。

Abstract: Model failover restores availability, but changes which financial institutions share decision errors. We formulate outage-contingent routing through a local market-impact response matrix and study expected squared price displacement. A symmetric construction shows that a shared backup can leave an order-one concentration floor as the number of primary endpoints grows, while balanced fallback risk decreases inversely with the surviving endpoint count. For indivisible decisions, we derive the exact second moment of independent randomized routing and an effective-exposure granularity that determines its gap from fractional allocation. Conditional-expectation rounding gives a finite-agent bound without coupled quotas; a separate swap procedure preserves endpoint counts and is assessed against dual lower bounds. Across 60 synthetic portfolio networks and 11,340 scenario evaluations, the latter reduces risk by 6.57% and 10.53% for single and double endpoint removals at the central feedback setting with independent errors. A replay of 1,024 recorded API responses on constructed rebalancing tasks gives a smaller held-out reduction of 3.30% (paired bootstrap interval 2.07--4.57%). Strongly aligned errors, inferior endpoints, and indivisibility limit diversification. The contribution is an auditable routing stress test and implementation analysis, not an estimate of real-market crash probabilities.

</details>


### [417] [The Null Is the Hard Part: Exact Tests for Memorization in Generative Models](https://arxiv.org/abs/2610.00251)
*Sushovan Majhi,Pramita Bagchi*

Main category: cs.LG

TL;DR: 本文指出生成模型记忆化审计普遍缺乏零假设分布，导致结论可能失效；为此提出基于置换检验（整体模型）与匹配对照校准（单图）的两类零假设，并在MemBench上验证。


<details>
  <summary>Details</summary>
Motivation: 现有记忆化审计直接将相似度分数与阈值比较，未构造零假设分布，缺乏假发现率控制，因而得到的"记忆化"结论可能错误。作者认为零假设的构造才是记忆化问题的难点。

Method: 对整体模型：利用训练图与留出图在给定样本条件下可交换性，重新标注做置换检验，留出图为随机划分时对任意统计量精确。对单图：构造匹配对照校准，指出排序式与独立生成重采样式零假设分别导致假发现与零假设过窄。推荐使用Intersection Euler Characteristic Profile的小尺度质量作为尺度受限统计量。

Result: 在MemBench规则下缓解措施约减半Stable Diffusion记忆化；加入假发现控制后，随机提示扰动下2/3认证图像不再被检测，注意力缩放5/6，嵌入优化全部消失；数据复制检验在自身零假设下误标24个生成器中的10个。置换检验下最近邻偏好仍命中7/24，尺度受限统计命中0（McNemar p=0.016）。单图排序法在2365个对照中产生596个假发现，重采样零假设过窄三倍；校准后以5%FDR认证61张中的36张，对照在0.01%划分中被认证，每图两次生成即可恢复该计数；校准最大值认证46张。

Conclusion: 记忆化审计必须显式构造并校准零假设，否则结论不可靠；本文提供的置换检验与匹配对照校准两类零假设，以及尺度受限的Intersection Euler Characteristic Profile统计量，可给出具有假发现率保证的记忆化认证，并能计数被复制的不同图像及检验两模型是否复制相同图像。

Abstract: Memorization audits of generative models read similarity scores against thresholds, with no null distribution, and the conclusions they support can be wrong. By MemBench's rule, the benchmark's mitigations roughly halve Stable Diffusion's memorization; audited with false-discovery control, two thirds of the certified images are no longer detected under random prompt perturbations, five sixths under attention rescaling, and all of them under embedding optimization. The field's data-copying test, read against its own null, flags ten of twenty-four generators that reproduce nothing. We argue that for memorization the null is the hard part, and supply two. For a whole model, training and held-out images are exchangeable given its samples, and relabelling them is a permutation test, exact for any statistic when the held-out images are a random split; under it, a nearest-neighbour preference still fires on seven of those twenty-four, and a count restricted to the near-duplicate scale on none (McNemar p=0.016). For single images, the natural nulls fail twice, measurably: ranking an image among random images yields 596 false discoveries among 2,365 controls, and resampling independent generations makes the null three times too narrow. Calibrated against matched controls, the audit certifies 36 of 61 MemBench images at 5% false-discovery rate, held-out controls are certified in 0.01% of calibration splits, and on this benchmark two generations per image recover that count. A calibrated maximum, which reads occasional rather than typical copying, certifies 46. As the scale-restricted statistic we recommend the small-scale mass of the Intersection Euler Characteristic Profile, which also counts distinct images copied and tests whether two models copy the same ones.

</details>


### [418] [Sharp Oracle-Regret Tradeoffs for Projection-Free Online Convex Optimization](https://arxiv.org/abs/2610.00254)
*Vaneet Aggarwal*

Main category: cs.LG

TL;DR: 本文刻画了在线凸优化中，当可行集访问仅限精确线性优化预言机时的极小极大期望遗憾，给出维度无关的紧界 Θ(GD max{√T, T/(1+min{Q,BT})^{1/4}})。


<details>
  <summary>Details</summary>
Motivation: 研究在每轮预言机调用次数受限（总预算 Q、每轮上限 B）且必须始终可行这一约束下，在线凸优化的最优可达成遗憾尚不明确，需要建立匹配的上下界。

Method: 通过下界与上界两侧论证：下界先利用通用可行性证明每步动作必须落在给定球与前序预言机回复的凸包内，再构造固定体实例，将新相位方向耦合到共享单纯形，使有用回复反复高成本；上界采用带交错块的计数近似梯度方法以匹配该速率。

Result: 对 G-Lipschitz 凸损失、直径至多 D，维度无关极小极大期望遗憾为 Θ(GD max{√T, T/(1+min{Q,BT})^{1/4}})，下界对任意随机化学习器成立；总预算与严格每轮保证为特例，包括每轮一次调用的 T^{3/4} 速率与实现 √T 遗憾所需的二次总预算；对给定光滑度 β，解析构造给出曲率相关下界并确定通用刻画保持尖锐的阈值。

Conclusion: 该工作完整刻画了受限线性优化预言机下在线凸优化的遗憾极限，明确了预算与每轮调用限制对最优速率的影响，并给出相应最优算法与更精细的光滑情形分析。

Abstract: We characterize the regret attainable in online convex optimization when access to the feasible set is limited to an exact linear optimization oracle. The learner is given an inscribed ball and a diameter bound and must remain feasible on every consistent instance. For convex $G$-Lipschitz losses, diameter at most $D$, a total allowance of $Q$ oracle calls, and a strict limit of $B$ calls per round, the dimension-free minimax expected regret is $Θ(GD\max\{\sqrt T,T/(1+\min\{Q,BT\})^{1/4}\})$. The lower bound applies to arbitrary randomized learners. Universal feasibility first forces each action into the hull of the supplied ball and the preceding oracle replies. A fixed-body construction then couples fresh phase directions to a shared simplex, making useful replies costly repeatedly even though all losses have a common minimizer. A counted approximate-gradient method with interleaved blocks attains the matching rate. Total-budget and strict per-round guarantees follow as special cases, including the $T^{3/4}$ rate with one call per round and the quadratic total budget needed for $\sqrt T$ regret. For prescribed smoothness $β$, an analytic construction yields a curvature-dependent lower bound and identifies the threshold above which the general characterization remains sharp.

</details>


### [419] [Verification Pulses and the Cost of Escaping Wrong Consensus](https://arxiv.org/abs/2610.00256)
*Shivam Gupta*

Main category: cs.LG

TL;DR: 研究固定验证预算的时机与投放方式如何影响异步二元寄存器中错误共识的恢复，给出跨分盆边界的最小"燃料"、有限种群脉冲后错误共识概率、临界预算窗口渐近结果，并开展13,392条语言模型响应实验与分布审计。


<details>
  <summary>Details</summary>
Motivation: 外部验证可修正个体输出，但若放任自强化群体动态，种群仍可能滞留于错误共识盆地。因此需明确在固定验证预算下，何时验证、验证谁，才能有效恢复正确共识。

Method: 在异步二元寄存器模型中，针对一般非线性响应推导峰值验证约束下跨越分盆边界所需的最小燃料；对有限种群用精确生灭过程计算脉冲后再次形成错误共识的概率；通过渐近分析刻画临界预算窗口；并在语言模型上开展前瞻性实验（13,392条响应、含校准与108条留出轨迹），进行调度比较与分布审计。

Result: 主渐近结果给出临界预算窗口：主导项为 N log(x0/b)，修正项为 √N 阶，方差分别来自重复验证目标与验证停止后的自主放大。实例中16个多数更新槽、14个初始错误时，9次随机检查即越过平均场预算阈值，而精确模型中需23次才能达到95%最终恢复。实验中校准产生不同拟合响应区制，但四个调整后调度比较区间均包含零；分布审计发现较小的均值预测误差可能掩盖对终端共识占据率的严重低估。

Conclusion: 结果支持在明确更新契约下采用风险校准的重置调度，并强调应将其与异目标检查和无限制证据广播明确区分。

Abstract: External verification can correct individual outputs while leaving a self-reinforcing population in the basin of a wrong consensus. We study how the timing and addressing of a fixed verification budget affect recovery in an asynchronous binary register. For a general nonlinear response, we derive the minimum fuel required to cross a basin boundary under a peak verification constraint. For a finite population, an exact birth--death calculation gives the probability of subsequent wrong consensus after a pulse. Our main asymptotic result identifies the critical budget window: a leading term $N\log(x_0/b)$ and a correction of order $\sqrt N$, with separate variance contributions from repeated verification targets and autonomous amplification after verification stops. The distinction is substantial: with 16 majority-updated slots and 14 initially wrong, 9 random checks cross the mean-field budget threshold, whereas 23 are required for 95% eventual recovery in the exact model. A prospectively specified experiment records 13,392 language-model responses, including calibration and 108 held-out trajectories. Calibration produces different fitted response regimes, but all four adjusted schedule-comparison intervals include zero. A distributional audit also finds that modest mean-prediction error can conceal a large underestimate of terminal consensus occupancy. The results support risk-calibrated reset scheduling under a specified update contract, while explicitly separating it from distinct-target checking and unrestricted evidence broadcast.

</details>


### [420] [Attention Manifolds: Steering or Blocking Language Models by Editing Learned B-Spline Surfaces](https://arxiv.org/abs/2610.00257)
*Naveen Mysore*

Main category: cs.LG

TL;DR: 标准注意力中源 token 向所有接收者发送相同 value，query 只决定"关注多少"而非"提取什么"。本文提出"注意力流形"（attention manifolds）：用可学习的二维 B 样条曲面 S_d(q_d, k_d) 依据 query-key 交互调制每个 value 维度。曲面为张量积三次 B 样条且初值为零，保持预训练行为。在 LLaMA 3.2-1B/3B-Instruct 上，WikiText-2 验证困惑度下降 2–2.5，参数开销仅 0.3%。112 条提示中，约 69%（1B）至 83%（3B）的贪心解码输出发生改变，歧义/多义词输入变化率最高（94–100%），且输出质量提升（纠正事实错误、提高精确性、增加具体性）。曲面可机械编辑：反转某层系数可改变 9/10 提示的输出（KL≈0.010），提供几何化的模型引导机制；将系数设为 −1 形成"注意力墙"阻断特定维度的 value 流动，初步实验显示可引导某类敏感提示从具体指令转向一般性教育内容，指向面向安全的流形塑形路径。


<details>
  <summary>Details</summary>
Motivation: 标准 transformer 注意力存在结构性局限：源 token 向每个接收者发送同一个 value 向量，query 仅控制注意力权重（how much），而无法控制从 value 中提取什么内容（what）。作者希望赋予注意力机制按 query-key 交互对 value 各维度进行细粒度调制的能力，并保持对预训练模型的兼容性。

Method: 提出注意力流形：为每个 value 维度学习一张二维 B 样条曲面 S_d(q_d, k_d)，以 query-key 交互为自变量对 value 维度进行调制。每张曲面为张量积三次 B 样条，初始化恒为零，从而在初始时严格保持预训练行为、不破坏原有输出。同时研究曲面的机械可编辑性，包括反转层系数与将系数置为 −1 构造"注意力墙"以阻断特定维度的 value 流动。

Result: 在 LLaMA 3.2-1B-Instruct 与 3B-Instruct 上微调：WikiText-2 验证困惑度降低 2–2.5 点，参数增量仅 0.3%。112 条多样化提示中，曲面改变贪心解码输出的比例为 69%（1B）到 83%（3B），歧义与多义输入上变化率最高（94–100%）。输出质量提升，表现为纠正事实错误、提高表述精确性、增加具体性与归因。曲面可编辑：反转某层系数使 9/10 提示输出改变（KL≈0.010）；将曲面系数设为 −1 形成"注意力墙"，初步实验显示层范围内可对特定敏感提示产生引导效果。

Conclusion: 注意力流形以极小的参数开销（0.3%）显著改善语言模型性能，并广泛改变生成行为，尤其在歧义输入上效果最强。其曲面具备机械可解释与可编辑特性，既可作为几何化的模型引导机制，也为面向安全的流形塑形提供了初步可行性证据。整体表明在不破坏预训练能力的前提下，对注意力 value 提取过程进行几何化调制是一条有效且可操控的路径。

Abstract: In standard transformer attention, a source token sends the same value vector to every receiver. The query determines \emph{how much} to attend but not \emph{what} to extract. This work introduces \textbf{attention manifolds}: learned 2D B-spline surfaces $S_d(q_d, k_d)$ that modulate each value dimension based on the query-key interaction. Each surface is a tensor-product cubic B-spline initialized to zero, preserving pretrained behavior. Applied to LLaMA 3.2-1B-Instruct and 3B-Instruct, attention manifolds reduce WikiText-2 validation perplexity by 2--2.5 points with 0.3\% parameter overhead. Across 112 diverse prompts, surfaces change greedy-decoded output for 69\% (1B) to 83\% (3B) of cases, with the strongest effects on ambiguous and polysemous inputs (94--100\% change rate). The surfaces improve output quality: correcting factual errors (\emph{``the CAP theorem has three main components''} $\to$ \emph{``it is impossible to guarantee all three''}), increasing precision (\emph{``impossible to know certain properties''} $\to$ \emph{``impossible to know both position and momentum''}), and adding specificity (a generic quote $\to$ an attributed Saint Augustine citation, consistently at both scales). The learned surfaces are also mechanically editable: inverting a layer's coefficients changes greedy output for 9/10 prompts (KL~0.010), providing a geometric mechanism for model steering. Setting surface coefficients to $-1$ creates ``attention walls'' that block value flow through specific dimensions. In a preliminary experiment, a layer-wide wall redirects an explosive-device prompt from specific instructions to general educational content, suggesting a path toward safety-oriented manifold shaping.

</details>


### [421] [Large Language Bayes Is Not Reparameterisation-Invariant](https://arxiv.org/abs/2610.00265)
*Jian Xu*

Main category: cs.LG

TL;DR: LLB 根据“证据下界”的指数进行加权，这一权重会随概率程序的写法（参数化）而变，因而可能系统性扭曲模型后验与下游目标。


<details>
  <summary>Details</summary>
Motivation: LLB 用语言模型采样候选概率程序，再以指数化证据下界为权重做平均，这隐含一个假设：权重反映模型质量而非书写形式。作者要检验该假设是否成立，即加权是否依赖于参数化。

Method: 理论分析（对数边际似然对重参数化不变、证据下界不变）+ 八个学校与 64 维任务实验 + 匹配后验矩的全协方差高斯复现真实推断 + 跨似然族/维度/漏斗严重度扫描 + 360 个程序、6 个语言模型的参数化统计 + 统计等价程序检测与自生成重参数化验证。

Result: 八个学校中中心化与非中心化程序作为测度差异仅 5.7e-14，权重却相差 6.1 倍；重要性加权仅降到 2.2 倍；复现 LLB 实际推断后仍为 1.9 倍（八个学校）与 8.9 倍（64 维）。跨设置差异最高 31.9 倍且符号反转，不存在统一更优写法；会反转对八个自然竞争者的贝叶斯因子，后验与下游误差由下界亏欠的离散度 Δ 经 Hilbert 距离界控制。360 个程序中中心化比例 0%–100%，同一模型内稳定。统计检测等价程序在实用样本预算下会错误合并不同模型。

Conclusion: 证据下界的指数加权不是参数化不变的，LLB 的模型后验可被书写形式显著扭曲，且方向不定；改用自生成重参数化进行验证可闭合这一漏洞，而统计等价检测不可靠。

Abstract: Large Language Bayes (LLB) answers an informal modelling question by sampling candidate probabilistic programs from a language model, running approximate inference on each, and averaging them with weights proportional to an exponentiated evidence bound. We show that this weighting depends on how a model is written. The log marginal likelihood is invariant to reparameterisation; the evidence bound is not. On eight schools the centered and non-centered programs are the same measure to $5.7\times10^{-14}$, yet their weights differ by $6.1\times$; importance weighting reduces this only to $2.2\times$, and reproducing the inference LLB actually runs, a full-covariance Gaussian matched to the posterior moments, still leaves $1.9\times$ on eight schools and $8.9\times$ in $64$ dimensions. Across likelihood families, dimensions and funnel severities the discrepancy reaches $31.9\times$ and reverses sign, so no single writing is uniformly preferable. It inverts Bayes factors against eight natural competitors, and the induced error in the model posterior, and in any downstream target, is controlled by the spread $Δ$ of the bound shortfalls through a known sharp Hilbert-distance bound. Across $360$ programs from six language models the parameterisation written ranges from $0\%$ to $100\%$ centered and is stable within a model. Detecting equivalent programs statistically can falsely merge genuinely different models at practical sample budgets; verifying reparameterisations we generate ourselves cannot, and closes the window.

</details>


### [422] [MOVE: Multimodal Open-world Verification and Expansion for Graph Learning](https://arxiv.org/abs/2610.00268)
*Zekai Chen,Jiayang Xing,Xun Wu,Miao Zhang,Xunkai Li,Kairui Yang,Zhengyu Wu,Xu Wang,Rong-Hua Li,Guoren Wang*

Main category: cs.LG

TL;DR: MOVE是一个多模态开放世界类别验证与扩展框架，联合视觉、文本和图上下文识别未知节点，用多模态LLM生成候选类并仅在多模态证据一致支持时选择性扩展类空间。


<details>
  <summary>Details</summary>
Motivation: 多模态图学习中，部署后可能出现新类别，而模型在固定标签空间上训练。现有方法虽能检测未知节点并用LLM生成候选类描述，但无法判断现有类别是否不足以覆盖这些节点，也无法判断生成的类别是否足够可靠以扩展类空间。

Method: 基于实证研究揭示的三个挑战（未知节点识别需超出单一模态的多模态信息；LLM生成的类描述可能无法充分捕捉多模态类特征；直接添加候选类会引入冗余类别），提出MOVE框架：联合视觉token、文本属性和图上下文识别无法归入现有类别的节点，利用多模态LLM生成候选类，仅当候选类获得多模态证据一致支持时选择性扩展类空间，避免引入冗余类别。
