Result: 在未知识别、开放域标注和下游图学习任务上，MOVE平均提升11.87%。

Conclusion: MOVE通过多模态联合判别与验证机制，实现了可靠的开放世界类验证与扩展，在多个任务上取得显著性能提升。

Abstract: Multimodal graph learning faces a fundamental challenge: new classes may emerge after deployment, while models are trained with a fixed label space. Existing approaches typically detect unknown nodes and use LLMs to generate candidate class descriptions, but they do not determine whether existing classes are insufficient to cover these nodes or whether a generated class is reliable enough to expand the class space. Our empirical study reveals three challenges: multimodal information beyond individual modalities is required for unknown-node identification, LLM-generated class descriptions may not fully capture multimodal class characteristics, and directly adding candidate classes can introduce redundant categories. Based on these observations, we propose MOVE, a multimodal open-world class verification and expansion framework. MOVE identifies nodes that cannot be assigned to existing classes by jointly considering visual tokens, textual attributes, and graph context, leverages a multimodal LLM to generate candidate classes, and selectively expands the class space only when candidates are consistently supported by multimodal evidence without introducing unnecessary categories. Experiments demonstrate that MOVE achieves an average improvement of 11.87\% across unknown recognition, open-domain annotation, and downstream graph learning tasks.

</details>


### [423] [Coupling Perception and Reasoning in Federated Multimodal Graph Foundation Models](https://arxiv.org/abs/2610.00277)
*Zekai Chen,Xun Wu,Hailin Zhang,Xunkai Li,Yu Liu,Kairui Yang,Muyan Huang,Xuaner Chen,Rong-Hua Li,Guoren Wang*

Main category: cs.LG

TL;DR: 本文提出FedCORE，一种联邦多模态图基础模型适配框架，通过共享低维隐状态耦合编码器与GNN更新，在共享状态空间中进行联邦演化，从而保持感知与推理适配的兼容性。


<details>
  <summary>Details</summary>
Motivation: 现有联邦图基础模型适配方法主要只更新图侧模块而冻结多模态编码器，仅能改变信息如何传播，却固定了信息提取方式。作者通过实证发现编码器与GNN的适配并非独立：编码器适配受图关系影响，且跨客户端模块交换表明分别参数化的编码器与GNN更新之间存在显著的配对敏感性，因此需要联合适配以保持二者兼容。

Method: FedCORE将编码器更新与GNN更新表示为共享的低维隐状态（core），从多模态信号与结构信号中联合优化该core，并直接在共享状态空间中进行联邦演化，以维持感知与推理适配之间的兼容性。

Result: 实验表明，FedCORE将编码器—GNN配对差距从30.6降至5.9，相比独立联合适配实现了80.7%的缩减。

Conclusion: 编码器与GNN的适配存在相互依赖，独立适配会产生严重的配对不兼容问题；通过在共享低维隐状态中联合优化并进行联邦演化，FedCORE能有效缓解该配对差距，提升联邦多模态图基础模型适配的协调性与性能。

Abstract: Federated multimodal graph foundation models (GFMs) aim to adapt pretrained multimodal models to decentralized graph data, where each client owns a private multimodal graph and cannot share raw information. These models typically combine a multimodal Encoder that extracts semantic evidence from heterogeneous modalities and a graph neural network (GNN) that performs relational reasoning over graph structures. However, existing federated GFM adaptation methods mainly update graph-side modules while keeping the multimodal Encoder frozen, limiting adaptation to \emph{how information is propagated} while fixing \emph{what information is extracted}. Through empirical studies, we reveal that Encoder and GNN adaptations are not independent: Encoder adaptation is affected by graph relations, while cross-client module swapping reveals substantial pairing sensitivity between separately parameterized Encoder and GNN updates. Motivated by this observation, we propose \textbf{FedCORE}, a federated adaptation framework that represents Encoder and GNN updates through a shared low-dimensional latent state. FedCORE jointly optimizes this core from multimodal and structural signals and performs federated evolution directly in the shared state space, preserving compatibility between perception and reasoning adaptations. Extensive experiments demonstrate that FedCORE reduces the Encoder--GNN pairing gap from $30.6$ to $5.9$, corresponding to an $80.7\%$ reduction over independent joint adaptation.

</details>


### [424] [Stable and Counterfactually Robust Physical World Models from Imposed Structure and Learned Physics](https://arxiv.org/abs/2610.00280)
*Yufeng Wang,Parivesh Priye,Lu Wei,Haibin Ling*

Main category: cs.LG

TL;DR: 该工作探究世界模型需要多少通用物理结构被硬编码、多少系统特定物理可从数据学习，提出以学习能量梯度加固定可逆算子为核心的通用结构框架，并在电磁腔、粒子网格与浅水波三类系统中验证其能同时满足耗散相容、参数干预响应、超长时稳定与扰动鲁棒性。


<details>
  <summary>Details</summary>
Motivation: 现有世界模型虽能从轨迹预测物理系统演化，但其所模仿的系统遵循的物理定律既未被完整提供也未被可靠遵守：模型可能在长程推演中凭空产生能量、漂移或发散，并在被问及改变的定律时仍用训练时观察到的定律作答。因此需要厘清：为同时实现四种性质（符合第二定律的耗散、对物理参数干预的正确响应、稳定到训练时域一百倍、对扰动鲁棒），究竟必须硬编码多少通用物理结构，又有多少系统特定物理可由此从数据中学得。

Method: 施加的通用结构包括：动力学由学习到的能量梯度经固定可逆算子生成；能量被限制在某一约束类内；单向端口只能移除能量而不能注入；驱动通道已知；被干预参数通过可分离映射进入。模型需学习能量泛函、本构关系、耗散率与耦合项。作者在电磁腔、粒子网格（particle-in-cell）与浅水波流体三类系统上进行验证，并设置等容量但无相同结构的对照模型，以及收敛的线性模型作比较。

Result: 参数量约九千的模型可恢复单位斜率的本构函数；用单一组权重即可将守恒世界与耗散世界分离达四个数量级；并能将符号、幅度、速率与重力的变化迁移到未见取值；而等容量但无相同结构的模型表现仅为随机水平或更差。非线性本构律被恢复且曲率得以保留，对留出干预的预测比收敛线性模型好 2 至 17 倍。

Conclusion: 少量通用物理结构（固定可逆算子、约束能量类、单向耗散端口、已知驱动通道、可分离参数映射）即可使小容量世界模型同时获得耗散相容、干预正确响应、超长时稳定与鲁棒性，且系统特定物理仍可有效从数据中学习；缺乏该结构的等容量模型则显著失效。

Abstract: A world model learns to forecast how a physical system evolves from recorded trajectories, yet the systems it imitates obey physical laws that are neither fully supplied nor reliably respected. The model may create energy, drift or diverge over long rollouts, and answer a changed law query using the law observed during training. We ask how much general physical structure must be hard coded into a world model, and how much system-specific physics can then be learned from data, for four properties to hold simultaneously: second law compatible dissipation, correct responses to interventions on physical parameters, stability out to one hundred times the training horizon, and robustness to disturbances. The imposed structure is general: dynamics are generated from the gradient of a learned energy through a fixed reversible operator, the energy is restricted to a confining class, a one way port can remove energy but never inject it, the drive channel is known, and the intervened parameter enters through a separable map. The model learns the energy functional, constitutive relations, dissipation rate, and couplings. Across an electromagnetic cavity, a particle in cell grid, and a shallow-water fluid, models with roughly nine thousand parameters recover constitutive functions with unit slope, separate conserving from dissipating worlds by four orders of magnitude using a single set of weights, and transfer changes in sign, magnitude, rate, and gravity to unseen values, where equal-capacity models without the same structure perform at chance or worse. A nonlinear constitutive law is recovered with its curvature preserved and predicts a held-out intervention $2$-$17\times$ better than a converged linear model.

</details>


### [425] [Bellman-Certified Rounding for Sparse Policy Deployment in MDPs](https://arxiv.org/abs/2610.00325)
*Zhaojun Peng*

Main category: cs.LG

TL;DR: 研究在有限MDP中将连续行混合策略舍入为稀疏二值策略时可保留多少折扣回报，提出基于2d+2次Bellman求解的可复用包络与秩二有理表示，给出均匀及候选特定保证，并证明线性维度依赖不可避免、精确全局曲率阈值化困难。


<details>
  <summary>Details</summary>
Motivation: 连续策略优化可能将一次更新散布到众多状态，但部署往往只允许少量完整的状态级改动。现有全局曲率界因策略相关访问分布耦合行编辑、且长时域导致保守，难以在舍入前提供紧致保证。

Method: 从2d+2次Bellman求解出发，推导可复用的包络，支持舍入前的均匀与候选特定保证；对每次交换建立秩二有理表示，实现沿实际轨迹的加权曲率积分。

Result: 候选特定界将结构化测试集上的舍入前认证覆盖率从48.2%提升至74.1%；在γ=0.95的耦合实例上，局部积分将界与损失比中位数从402.3降至2.08。同时证明预算缩放时线性维度依赖不可避免，精确全局曲率阈值化是困难的。

Conclusion: 通过可复用包络与轨迹上的局部曲率积分，可在稀疏化前提供更紧且可扩展的回报保留认证，同时揭示了该问题在维度与阈值化方面的内在困难性。

Abstract: Continuous policy optimization may spread an update across many states, even when deployment permits only a few complete state-level changes. We study how much discounted return can be retained when continuous row mixtures are rounded to sparse binary policies in finite MDPs. Policy-dependent visitation couples the row edits, while long horizons make global curvature bounds conservative. From $2d+2$ Bellman solves, we derive reusable envelopes that support uniform and candidate-specific guarantees before rounding. A rank-two rational representation of each exchange further permits weighted curvature integration along the realized trajectory. We prove that linear dimension dependence is unavoidable when the budget scales, and that exact global curvature thresholding is hard. Candidate-specific bounds raise pre-rounding certification coverage from $48.2\%$ to $74.1\%$ on the structured suite. At $γ=0.95$, local integration lowers the median bound-to-loss ratio from $402.3$ to $2.08$ on coupled instances.

</details>


### [426] [Beyond Diagonal State Space Models: Exact Non-Abelian Group Tracking, Solvability Barriers, and Geometric Physical Manifolds](https://arxiv.org/abs/2610.00329)
*Zeyu Jia*

Main category: cs.LG

TL;DR: 本文提出非交换状态空间模型（NC-SSM）、其实正交对应SO(3)-SSM及任意维Cayley-SSM，将状态转移提升到紧李群SU(2)、SO(3)、SO(N)，以突破对角SSM受交换性与可解仿射群限制的表达瓶颈。


<details>
  <summary>Details</summary>
Motivation: 现有选择性SSM（Mamba、S4D、LRU等）受限于转移矩阵可交换（A_t A_t' = A_t' A_t）与可解仿射变换群（派生长度≤2的Aff_D），使堆叠多层对角网络在非可解单群（如A_5）上因模拟非阿贝尔交换子的指数级电路深度而出现严重优化退化。

Method: 将状态转移提升至紧李群SU(2)、SO(3)、SO(N)；采用闭式Euler-Rodrigues映射与有理Cayley变换实现严格保范等距（||U_t|| = 1）；引入纯Hopf纤维化的Bloch射影读出（S^3/{±1}=~S^2=~SO(3)）以消除符号歧义；设计真四元数并行前缀扫描（T=2048时9.06倍加速）以及Identity-Gated Lie SSM以消除稀疏语法相位漂移。

Result: 14类实验表明：(1) NC-SSM在S_3、D_4、Q_8及单群A_5上实现100%跟踪，而3层深对角基线崩溃至6.60%（p=8.81e-4）；(2) Cayley-SO(5)-SSM在对称群S_5上突破Klein 1884上限（50.92% vs 对角5.25%，p=0.0015，较SO(3)方差降低7.8倍）；(3) SO(3)-SSM在300步内保持黎曼流形（漂移<3.12e-6，优势>580,000倍），实现0.04度航位推算误差与切空间去噪；(4) NC-SSM在Dyck-2上达74.36%、深层AST作用域跟踪达30.26%（p=0.0081）；(5) 消融证实严格等距对无损长程联想记忆在数学上必要。

Conclusion: 通过将状态转移提升至紧李群并利用Euler-Rodrigues与Cayley变换实现精确等距，NC-SSM突破了交换性与可解群的理论天花板，在非可解群跟踪、对称群表达、流形保持及长程记忆等任务上显著优于对角基线。

Abstract: Selective state space models (SSMs), such as Mamba, S4D, and LRU, are bounded by transition matrix commutativity (A_t A_t' = A_t' A_t) and solvable affine transformation groups (Aff_D of derived length <= 2). Consequently, stacked multi-layer diagonal networks face severe optimization degradation on non-solvable simple groups such as A_5 due to the exponential circuit emulation depth required to simulate non-abelian commutators. We propose Non-Commutative State Space Models (NC-SSM), their real-orthogonal counterpart SO(3)-SSM, and arbitrary-dimension Cayley-SSM, lifting state transitions to compact Lie groups SU(2), SO(3), and SO(N). Via closed-form Euler-Rodrigues maps and rational Cayley transforms, NC-SSM achieves exact norm-preserving isometry (||U_t|| = 1). We introduce pure Hopf-fibration Bloch projective readouts (S^3/{+-1} =~ S^2 =~ SO(3)) to eliminate sign ambiguity, true quaternion parallel prefix scans (9.06x speedup at T=2048), and Identity-Gated Lie SSMs to eliminate sparse syntax phase drift. Extensive benchmarks across 14 experimental regimes show: (1) NC-SSM achieves 100% tracking on S_3, D_4, Q_8 and simple group A_5, where a 3-layer deep diagonal baseline collapses to 6.60% (p = 8.81e-4); (2) Cayley-SO(5)-SSM breaks Klein's 1884 ceiling on symmetric group S_5 (50.92% vs diagonal 5.25%, p = 0.0015, delivering 7.8x variance reduction over SO(3)); (3) SO(3)-SSM preserves Riemannian manifolds across 300 steps (< 3.12e-6 drift, > 580,000x advantage), achieving 0.04 deg dead-reckoning error and active tangent denoising; (4) NC-SSM achieves 74.36% on Dyck-2 and 30.26% on deep AST scope tracking (p = 0.0081); and (5) ablation confirms strict isometry is mathematically necessary for lossless long-range associative memory.

</details>


### [427] [The Weakest Link: Distilling LLM Reasoning with Worst-Case Constrained Reinforcement Learning](https://arxiv.org/abs/2610.00332)
*Matthieu Zimmer,Xiaotong Ji,Tu Nguyen,Haitham Bou-Ammar*

Main category: cs.LG

TL;DR: 该论文将推理蒸馏建模为带最坏情况教师对数似然约束的约束强化学习问题，提出一种无增广的约束MDP奖励变换方法，在保持硬约束语义的同时实现低方差策略梯度分解，实验表明该方法显著扩展了准确率-保真度帕累托前沿，取得最高的严格推理成功率。


<details>
  <summary>Details</summary>
Motivation: 将大语言模型（LLM）的推理能力蒸馏到小模型是高效部署的核心挑战，但现有方法存在根本矛盾：纯任务奖励优化（如GRPO）导致奖励黑客，学生通过有缺陷的中间逻辑得到正确最终答案；而基于KL的软散度正则化蒸馏会稀释任务性能，且允许学生在某一步严重违反逻辑却靠其他步骤的高教师一致性来补偿。作者认为这种"平均"与推理本质相悖——思维链的有效性取决于其最薄弱的一环。

Method: 将推理蒸馏形式化为约束强化学习问题：最大化任务奖励，同时以轨迹每个前缀上教师对数似然的最坏情况为约束。为避免对偶拉格朗日求解器的高昂成本以及Saute等状态增广方法的测试时教师依赖，作者推导出一个无增广的约束MDP，其奖励变换保持硬约束语义，可分解为单步项与长期项的低方差策略梯度，并在惩罚极限下可证明几乎必然满足最坏情况约束。

Result: 在数学推理和代码生成任务上的大量实验表明，该方法显著扩展了准确率-保真度的帕累托前沿：在匹配纯RL的高最终答案正确率的同时，大幅降低教师约束违反，最终在所有评测设置中取得最高的严格推理成功率（Reasoning Success Rate）。

Conclusion: 以最坏情况前缀约束替代平均软正则化，与思维链"最弱环节"的本质更契合；所提无增广约束MDP方法在不依赖测试时教师、避免对偶求解开销的前提下，兼顾任务性能与推理保真度，优于纯RL与KL蒸馏基线。

Abstract: Distilling the reasoning capabilities of large language models (LLMs) into smaller students is a central challenge for efficient deployment. Current approaches face a fundamental tension: optimizing purely for verifiable task rewards (e.g., via GRPO) leads to reward hacking, where students arrive at correct final answers through flawed intermediate logic, while regularizing with soft divergence penalties against a teacher (e.g., KL-based distillation) dilutes task performance and, critically, allows the student to compensate for severe logical violations at one step with high teacher agreement at others. We argue that this averaging is fundamentally misaligned with the nature of reasoning: a chain-of-thought is only as valid as its weakest link. Motivated by this observation, we formulate reasoning distillation as a constrained reinforcement learning problem in which the task reward is maximized subject to a worst-case constraint on the teacher log-likelihood along every prefix of the trajectory. To avoid the prohibitive cost of dual Lagrangian solvers and the test-time teacher dependence of state-augmented methods such as Saute, we derive an unaugmented constrained MDP whose reward transformation preserves the hard-constraint semantics, admits a low-variance policy gradient decomposition into single-step and long-term terms, and provably satisfies the worst-case constraint almost surely in the penalty limit. Through extensive experiments on mathematical reasoning and code generation tasks, we demonstrate that our method significantly expands the accuracy-fidelity Pareto front. By matching the high Final Answer Correctness of pure RL and drastically reducing teacher constraint violations, we ultimately achieve the highest rigorous Reasoning Success Rate across all evaluated settings.

</details>


### [428] [Benchmarking System One decision models against trained classifiers and language models for automated decision gates](https://arxiv.org/abs/2610.00346)
*Amir Rafe,Subasish Das*

Main category: cs.LG

TL;DR: 在匹配条件下对比类型化决策模型（System One，含托管模型Jev）与监督分类器、生成式语言模型：模型类别的优劣取决于条件；有标签时小型训练分类器在意图任务上最准，无标签时多数决策模型在零样本设置下优于蕴含分类器；少选项拟合的温度在多选项下校准变差；无标签微调与级联设计（意图一阶段升级至Jev）可显著降本并保持精度。


<details>
  <summary>Details</summary>
Motivation: 自动化决策门（branching decisions）需要可声明选项及其可阈值化的概率。类型化决策模型（System One）能直接返回概率而无须生成文本，但与其替代方案（监督分类器、生成式语言模型）在同等条件下缺乏系统对比，导致缺少条件依赖的设计规则。

Method: 统一测试框架在同一语义请求上评估：6个家族、8个决策模型检查点（含托管Jev）与2个生成式对照模型；并在同一工作流、意图与社会科学条目上评测监督分类器与零样本分类器。分析维度包括：有无任务标签、选项键似然读数、概率阈值设定（5%风险）、温度校准（少选项拟合→多选项）、选项顺序扰动（是/否交换）、以及意图一阶段级联到Jev的成本-精度权衡（GPU满利用率）。

Result: 在有标签条件下，小型训练分类器在意图上最准，在工作流上与最优决策模型无显著差异；无标签时，除编码器类检查点外，所有决策模型在工作流与意图上均超过零样本蕴含分类器。按选项键似然读数，较大生成模型在工作流和意图上与Jev持平，并在5%风险下接受更多工作流决策；微调决策检查点较未微调骨干提升意图准确率。少量选项拟合的存储温度在选项增多时提高校准误差；5%范围内风险的留出阈值下，Jev仍接受0.310比例的域外请求。交换是/否使Jev每百条翻转50.5个答案，而微调检查点降低了其骨干在社会科学上的翻转。意图训练的一阶段级联到Jev，在GPU满利用率下以0.43成本达到与Jev相当的准确率。

Conclusion: 模型类别与决策模型之间不存在无条件最优解；性能排序随任务标签可得性、阈值与校准条件而变。由此提出面向自动决策门的条件依赖设计规则：有标签时优先小型监督分类器、无标签时优先决策模型、注意温度校准的选项规模泛化、并通过意图一阶段过滤加Jev级联实现低成本高精度部署。

Abstract: Software that hands branching decisions to a model needs a declared option and a probability it can threshold. Typed decision models, also called System One models, return such probabilities without generating text, while supervised classifiers and generative language models are the established alternatives. Under matched conditions, one harness sends eight decision-model checkpoints from six families, including the hosted model Jev, and two generative comparators the same semantic requests, and scores supervised and zero-shot classifiers on the same workflow, intent and social-science items. The ranking of the model classes depends on the conditions. With the task's own labels, small trained classifiers are the most accurate on intents and not significantly different from the best decision models on workflows. Without labels, every decision model except the encoder-based checkpoints exceeds a zero-shot entailment classifier on workflows and intents. Read through option-key likelihoods, a larger generative model is level with Jev on workflows and intents and accepts more workflow decisions at five percent risk, and fine-tuned decision checkpoints gain intent accuracy over their untuned backbones. Stored temperatures fitted on few options raise calibration error with many options, and a held-out threshold for five percent in-scope risk still lets Jev accept 0.310 of out-of-scope requests. Swapping yes and no flips 50.5 answers per hundred for Jev, while fine-tuned checkpoints cut their backbones' social-science flips. An intent-trained first stage escalating to Jev matches its accuracy at 0.43 of its cost at full graphics-processor utilization. The results yield condition-dependent design rules for automated decision gates.

</details>


### [429] [Deep Learning for Anomaly Detection in Railway Systems: A Structured Survey](https://arxiv.org/abs/2610.00363)
*Ammar Bouketta,Smail Niar,Hamza Ouarnoughi*

Main category: cs.LG

TL;DR: 本文是一篇综述，系统梳理了基于深度学习的铁路系统异常检测方法，构建了统一分类体系，探讨数据挑战、评估与部署，并提出面向决策的选型框架。


<details>
  <summary>Details</summary>
Motivation: 现代铁路系统的安全可靠运行日益依赖数据驱动的监测与智能故障检测，铁路车辆与基础设施产生大量异构传感器数据，深度学习成为有效范式，但相关方法分散、缺乏统一组织与选型指导，亟需系统性综述。

Method: 采用结构化综述方法：以异常位置、数据表示与表现形式、传感模态、时间特性构建统一分类体系；将卷积、循环、注意力架构、自编码器、生成对抗网络及Transformer等方法归入基于分类、基于预测、基于重构和混合学习范式；并分析以数据为中心的挑战、评估实践、性能指标及边缘-云架构、计算约束、硬件感知优化等部署问题。

Result: 形成统一分类与范式归纳，梳理数据、评估与部署关键问题，并提出一个将异常特征、数据属性与运行约束关联到合适检测范式和部署配置的决策导向框架。

Conclusion: 该工作为铁路异常检测中深度学习方案的选择与部署提供了结构化参考，并指出面向可靠、可扩展智能监测系统的开放挑战。

Abstract: Ensuring safe and reliable operation of modern railway systems increasingly relies on data-driven monitoring and intelligent fault detection. Deep learning has emerged as an effective paradigm for railway anomaly detection, driven by the growing availability of heterogeneous sensor data from rolling stock and infrastructure. This paper presents a structured survey of deep learning-based anomaly detection approaches for railway systems. The surveyed methods are organized using a unified taxonomy covering anomaly location, data representation and manifestation, sensing modality, and temporal characteristics. Existing approaches, including convolutional, recurrent and attention-based architectures, autoencoders, generative adversarial networks, and transformers, are structured into classification-based, prediction-based, reconstruction-based, and hybrid learning paradigms. The survey also examines data-centric challenges, evaluation practices, performance metrics, and practical deployment aspects, including edge-cloud architectures, computational constraints, and hardware-aware optimization. Finally, a decision-oriented framework links anomaly characteristics, data properties, and operational constraints to suitable detection paradigms and deployment configurations. This work provides a structured reference for selecting and deploying deep learning solutions for railway anomaly detection and highlights open challenges toward reliable and scalable intelligent monitoring systems.

</details>


### [430] [MoRA: MoE Pruning via Router Bias Learning and Expert Approximation](https://arxiv.org/abs/2610.00367)
*Yushuai Sun,Zikun Zhou,Lin Gao,Jun Yu,Wenjie Pei*

Main category: cs.LG

TL;DR: 提出MoRA框架，通过学习路由器偏置并结合路由多样性正则化进行结构化专家剪枝，并引入专家近似机制作为后处理增强，在多个MoE模型上优于现有方法。


<details>
  <summary>Details</summary>
Motivation: MoE模型虽能通过仅激活少量专家实现参数扩展并控制每token计算量，但部署时仍需将完整专家池载入内存。结构化专家剪枝可降低内存占用，然而现有方法存在不足：一是专家排序准则与模型性能对齐不佳，二是依赖计算成本高昂的最优子集搜索，三是普遍忽略了保留专家之间的路由行为冗余。

Method: 提出MoRA（MoE Pruning via Router Bias Learning and Expert Approximation）框架。1）为每个专家引入可学习路由器偏置，通过最小化语言建模损失和路由多样性正则项来优化这些偏置；学习到的偏置可锐化路由概率分布，从而识别对模型性能关键的专家，同时鼓励选择路由偏好多样的专家。2）引入专家近似机制作为剪枝后增强：利用剩余专家通过仿射变换近似被剪枝专家的输出，进一步提升剪枝模型性能。

Result: 在Qwen3-30B-A3B、DeepSeek-V2-Lite和Moonlight-16B-A3B上进行评估，在每层移除25%和50%路由专家。在九个零样本基准上的大量实验表明，MoRA优于最先进的剪枝算法。

Conclusion: MoRA通过路由器偏置学习与专家近似，实现了对MoE模型的有效结构化专家剪枝，在显著降低内存占用（每层移除25%/50%专家）的同时保持较优性能，超越现有SOTA方法。代码将开源。

Abstract: Mixture-of-Experts (MoE) models enable parameter scaling with limited per-token computation by activating only a small subset of experts for each token, but deploying them still requires loading the complete expert pool into memory. Structured expert pruning can effectively reduce the memory usage by removing experts. However, existing pruning methods either use expert ranking criteria that are not well aligned with model performance or rely on effective expert subset searching that is computationally expensive. Moreover, these methods typically overlook the routing-behavior redundancy among the retained experts. In this paper, we propose MoE Pruning via Router Bias Learning and Expert Approximation (MoRA), a framework for structured MoE expert pruning. We introduce a learnable router bias for each expert and optimize these biases by minimizing the language-modeling loss and a routing-diversity regularizer. The learned router biases sharpen the routing probability distributions to identify experts critical to model performance while encouraging the selection of experts with diverse routing preferences. In addition, we introduce an expert approximation mechanism as a post-pruning enhancement. It leverages the remaining experts to approximate the outputs of pruned experts by affine transformation, further improving the performance of the pruned model. We evaluate MoRA on Qwen3-30B-A3B, DeepSeek-V2-Lite, and Moonlight-16B-A3B, removing 25\% and 50\% of the routed experts in each MoE layer. Extensive experiments on nine zero-shot benchmarks show that MoRA outperforms state-of-the-art pruning algorithms. Our code will be released.

</details>


### [431] [A First Glance at Jev for Network Traffic Classification: Accuracy, Processing Time, and Cost](https://arxiv.org/abs/2610.00376)
*Shenghe Xu,Lifan Mei*

Main category: cs.LG

TL;DR: 本文首次实证评估通用决策模型 Jev 在网络流量应用分类上的表现，发现少量标注样本可显著提升其准确率，但仍不及树集成模型。


<details>
  <summary>Details</summary>
Motivation: 通用决策模型（以 Jev 为代表）此前未被用于网络流量的应用分类任务，本文开展首次实证研究，检验其在有限标注样本下的分类能力，并与传统树集成模型及生成式语言模型进行对比。

Method: 在 CESNET-QUICEXT-25 数据集上，仅使用每条流前 10 个数据包的包大小、方向和包间隔时间。评估 Jev 在 10 个数据集定义的应用标签上的表现；对比随机森林与额外树（基于 8000 条记录训练）；并将 Jev 与 OpenAI GPT-5.6 Sol（高推理强度，通过 Azure 调用）在 100 条记录配对子集上比较，包括准确率、请求耗时和 API 费用。

Result: 在训练期后 26 个采集周共 52,000 条记录上，40 个固定标注样本使 Jev 准确率从 9.80% 提升至 28.42%；随机森林和额外树分别达到 69.95% 和 66.80%，且每周均优于 Jev。将 Jev 上下文增至 150 个样本，首个测试周准确率为 34.50%。在 100 条记录配对子集上，Jev（40 样本）准确率 29%、中位请求耗时 0.750 s；GPT-5.6 Sol 为 37%、6.036 s，且 Jev 的 API 费用更低。

Conclusion: 标注样本能显著改善 Jev，但所测试的 Jev 配置准确率仍低于训练好的树集成模型；配对子集未证明任一服务具有准确率优势，耗时的差异反映配置不同。由于监督预算不均且配置固定，尚无法将性能差距归因于单一原因。

Abstract: We evaluate Jev on ten dataset-defined application labels in CESNET-QUICEXT-25 using only the first ten packets' sizes, directions, and inter-packet times. To the best of our knowledge, this is the first empirical study of general-purpose decision models, represented here by Jev, for application classification of network flows. Across 52,000 records from 26 collection weeks following the training period, 40 fixed labeled examples raise Jev's accuracy from 9.80% to 28.42%. Random Forest and Extra Trees trained on 8,000 records achieve 69.95% and 66.80% and outperform Jev in every week. Increasing Jev's context to 150 examples yields 34.50% on the first test week. On a paired 100-record subset, Jev with 40 examples achieves 29% accuracy at a median request time of 0.750 s, versus 37% and 6.036 s for the generative language model OpenAI GPT-5.6 Sol with high reasoning effort through Azure; Jev also incurs lower API charges. The paired subset does not establish an accuracy advantage for either service, and the timing reflects different service configurations. Thus, labeled examples substantially improve Jev, but the tested Jev configurations remain less accurate than trained tree ensembles; unequal supervision budgets and fixed configurations prevent attributing the gap to a single cause.

</details>


### [432] [Fusion techniques of time frequency-based images to predict the outcome of rTMS depression therapy](https://arxiv.org/abs/2610.00380)
*Wael Korani,Md Fahimul Kabir Chowdhury,Mohammed Aledhari,Reza Rostami,Reza Kazemi*

Main category: cs.LG

TL;DR: 该研究探讨了用EEG时频图像预测rTMS抑郁症疗效的可行性，提出montage与blending两种融合技术及轻量级CNN，但发现严格的受试者不交叉验证下性能崩溃，提示此前高准确率源于数据泄漏。


<details>
  <summary>Details</summary>
Motivation: 抑郁症治疗结果预测是临床难题。rTMS是常用非侵入疗法，但基于EEG预测其响应受高个体间变异和单域特征不足的限制，故需更丰富的特征提取与融合方法。

Method: 提出montage与blending两种融合技术，从EEG衍生的时频(TF)图像中提取更丰富特征，并设计轻量级定制CNN在融合TF表示上训练。使用15例主数据集和46例次数据集，进行两组实验：第一组为片段级10折交叉验证（同一患者片段可同时出现在训练与测试）；第二组为严格受试者不交叉交叉验证（同一患者所有片段在同一折）。测试了4种时频方法、6种融合机制和14种模型架构。

Result: 片段级设置下，Montage CWT_ST融合在主数据集达99.90%准确率、次数据集91.90%。严格受试者不交叉设置下性能崩溃：除一个例外，两个队列的所有配置AUC介于0.31–0.54，且所有95%置信区间包含0.5；最佳单一方法的患者级置换检验p=0.703。最佳受试者级结果为主队列上的Montage CWT_ST，AUC 0.874±0.183、准确率82.7%。

Conclusion: 片段级交叉验证的高准确率具有误导性，源于同一患者片段泄漏导致的乐观偏差；在严格受试者不交叉评估下，EEG预测rTMS响应的性能接近随机水平，说明该任务极具挑战，且需谨慎评估方法泛化性。

Abstract: Depression is a mental condition that can lead to suicide and self-harm. Predicting the outcome of depression treatment is one of the most difficult tasks for clinicians. Among various treatment options, repetitive Transcranial Magnetic Stimulation (rTMS) is a widely used non-invasive method. Predicting rTMS response using Electroencephalogram (EEG) data is difficult because of high inter-subject variability and limited features from single-domain analysis. We introduce two fusion techniques, montage and blending, to overcome these limitations and extract richer features from EEG-derived Time-Frequency (TF) images. We then propose a lightweight custom Convolutional Neural Network (CNN) trained on fused TF representations. \textcolor{black}{We use a primary dataset of 15 patients and a secondary dataset of 46 patients. We run two sets of experiments. The first set uses segment-level 10-fold cross-validation. In this setup segments from the same patient can appear in both training and testing. The Montage CWT\_ST fusion reaches 99.90\% accuracy on the primary dataset and 91.90\% on the secondary dataset. The second set uses strict subject-disjoint cross-validation. All segments of a patient stay in one fold and no patient appears in both training and testing. Performance collapses. We test four time-frequency methods, six fusion mechanisms, and fourteen model architectures. With one exception, every configuration on both cohorts falls between AUC 0.31 and 0.54 and every 95\% confidence interval contains 0.5. A patient-level permutation test on the best standalone method returns $p = 0.703$. The best subject-level result is Montage CWT\_ST on the primary cohort, which reaches AUC $0.874 \pm 0.183$ and 82.7\% accuracy.

</details>


### [433] [OmniMed-Jev: Calibrating LVLM Confidence for Trustworthy Medical Multimodal Decisions via System One](https://arxiv.org/abs/2610.00381)
*Luyao Tang,Cheng Chen*

Main category: cs.LG

TL;DR: 提出将医疗多模态通用模型的决策输出从生成式文本改为"决策原生"接口 OmniMed-Jev：以候选集上的 Choice/Noul/Score 三类决策返回完整概率分布，使报告的置信度成为真正语义化的概率。


<details>
  <summary>Details</summary>
Motivation: 通用多模态医疗模型虽扩展了单模型感知能力，但仍以生成文本表达"诊断/发现/细胞计数"等有界决策，报告的"概率"实际是下一个 token 的概率而非决策本身的概率，导致置信度与实际正确率不匹配。受 Jev 等决策原生接口启发，作者希望让报告的置信度真正有意义。

Method: 提出 OmniMed-Jev，将每个医疗决策表示为运行时候选集上的三类决策：Choice（互斥类别）、Noul（某发现的二值存在性）、Score（有界有序值），并返回该候选集上的完整分布。设计在三个方面"omni"：接受多种成像模态、覆盖不同预测任务、统一用一个候选条件化概率模型表达，使其异质输出变为可比较的概率而非任务特定字符串。在相同骨干、数据与训练计划下与生成式基线做"接口受控"对比。

Result: 在接口受控对比中，OmniMed-Jev 报告的概率与观测正确率的吻合度远高于生成式基线：校准误差最多降低一个数量级，可靠性误差最多降低两倍，同时点预测性能相当；唯一例外是计数任务，生成式基线仍更优。

Conclusion: 把决策分布作为模型输出不只是格式改变，而是让报告的数字成为"名副其实"的概率；显式决策建模可使所评估任务中的置信度有意义。作者同时声明：该对比无法将接口贡献与相关训练差异相分离，且结果不构成临床可用性证据。

Abstract: Medical models are judged not only on correctness, but on whether reported confidence matches actual accuracy. Generalist multimodal medical models have expanded what a single model can perceive, yet they still express bounded decisions such as diagnoses, findings or cell counts as generated text, so the reported probability reflects the next token rather than the decision itself. Motivated by decision-native interfaces such as Jev, we introduce OmniMed-Jev, which represents each medical decision as a Choice, Noul or Score decision over a runtime-supplied candidate set and returns a full distribution over that set: mutually exclusive classes, binary presence of a finding, or a bounded ordered value. The design is omni in three respects: it accepts diverse imaging modalities, covers different prediction tasks, and expresses them through one candidate-conditioned probability model, so heterogeneous outputs become comparable probabilities rather than task-specific strings. In an interface-controlled comparison against a generative baseline trained on the same backbone, data and schedule, OmniMed-Jev's reported probabilities track observed correctness far more closely, reducing calibration error by up to an order of magnitude and reliability error by up to two, while point-prediction performance remains comparable; counting is the one family where the generative baseline stays ahead. Making the decision distribution the model's output is not a format change but what turns reported numbers into probabilities that mean what they say. These results support explicit decision modeling as a way to make reported confidence meaningful within the evaluated tasks, and they are not evidence of clinical readiness: the comparison cannot separate the interface from associated training differences, which we state alongside the results. Code is available at github.com/lytang63/OmniMed-Jev.

</details>


### [434] [EvoGen-Harness: Learning Where and How to Evolve Image-Generation Harnesses](https://arxiv.org/abs/2610.00383)
*Jiabin Luo,Yinan Liu,Chunlei Meng,Yufei Guo*

Main category: cs.LG

TL;DR: 本文提出 EvoGen-Harness 框架及 Trace 机制，在不修改生成器参数的前提下，通过多责任协同进化与失败归因引导，显著提升冻结 T2I 系统的生成质量，并在多个基准上超越最强基线。


<details>
  <summary>Details</summary>
Motivation: 现有 T2I 改进方法通常在冻结生成器外围优化单一预定义维度（如提示词、路由或工作流），限制了失败纠正的搜索空间。允许多个生成器外部责任共同进化可扩大适应空间，但由此带来新挑战：视觉反馈只能揭示"失败什么"，无法指出"持续进化应发生在哪里"以及"如何高效探索该空间"。

Method: 提出与生成器无关的框架 EvoGen-Harness，用于多责任图像生成骨架进化；并引入 Trace（Trajectory-Relative Attribution and Coordinated Evolution）。Trace 聚合多次随机执行中的证据，以失败归因作为搜索先验聚焦候选更新，并逐步对残余失败重新归因以协调各责任的进化；同时采用 No-Patch 与留出验证机制避免无必要或有害的更新。

Result: 在 GenEval2、T2I-CompBench++ 和 WISE 上，EvoGen-Harness 相比最强评估基线分别提升 +0.2633、+0.0720 和 +0.0752；归因召回率达 87.9–91.4%，No-Patch 准确率 94.8%，回归率仅 1.9%。

Conclusion: 结果表明，归因引导的多责任进化能够显著增强冻结 T2I 系统，其效果超越单维度适配方法。

Abstract: Modern text-to-image (T2I) systems can be improved without modifying generator parameters by adapting the external system around frozen generators. However, existing approaches typically optimize a predefined dimension, such as prompts, routing, or workflows, restricting the space in which generation failures can be corrected. Allowing multiple generator-external responsibilities to evolve provides a broader adaptation space, but introduces a new challenge: visual feedback reveals what failed, but not where persistent evolution should occur or how this space should be explored efficiently. We introduce EvoGen-Harness, a generator-agnostic framework for multi-responsibility image-generation harness evolution, together with Trace (Trajectory-Relative Attribution and Coordinated Evolution). Trace aggregates evidence across stochastic executions, uses failure attribution as a search prior to focus candidate updates, and progressively re-attributes residual failures to coordinate evolution across responsibilities, while No-Patch and held-out validation prevent unnecessary or harmful updates. Across GenEval2, T2I-CompBench++, and WISE, EvoGen-Harness improves over the strongest evaluated baselines by +0.2633, +0.0720, and +0.0752, respectively, while achieving 87.9-91.4% attribution recall, 94.8% No-Patch accuracy, and only 1.9% regression. These results demonstrate that attribution-guided multi-responsibility evolution can substantially enhance frozen T2I systems beyond single-dimension adaptation.

</details>


### [435] [T2SPO: Trajectory-to-Step Policy Optimization for Agentic Reinforcement Learning](https://arxiv.org/abs/2610.00388)
*Bo-Wen Zhang,Junwei He,Maoqi Liu,Feiran Li,Song-Lin Lv,Wentao Ma,Rongyi Lin,Shuhan Zhong,Lan-Zhe Guo*

Main category: cs.LG

TL;DR: 提出T2SPO方法，利用历史成功轨迹为LLM智能体的多步交互提供步骤级反馈，在ALFWorld和WebShop上稳定优于GRPO。


<details>
  <summary>Details</summary>
Motivation: 许多交互任务只提供最终结果的稀疏奖励，无法指导哪些中间决策真正推进了任务。而成功轨迹中蕴含的中间状态可为后续交互提供监督信号，这一信息尚未被充分利用。

Method: T2SPO从成功轨迹中提取“剩余距离”目标，并与沿途状态表示配对。以这些示例为上下文条件，使用预训练的TabPFN回归器估计新轨迹中每个状态到成功的剩余距离；相邻状态间该估计值的变化为智能体步骤提供辅助信用分配，与任务级监督共同作用。训练过程中，新完成的轨迹持续刷新估计器的上下文，从而在不更新其参数的情况下纳入新经验。

Result: 在1.5B和7B语言模型上于ALFWorld和WebShop环境进行实验，T2SPO相比于GRPO在整体任务成功率上取得了一致的提升。

Conclusion: 利用成功轨迹构建步骤级信用分配信号，可作为稀疏任务级奖励的有效补充，且基于上下文学习的估计器无需参数更新即可随训练持续吸收新经验，是一种轻量且有效的策略优化增强方案。

Abstract: Reinforcement learning enables large language model (LLM) agents to learn multi-step behaviors through interaction with their environments. However, rewards in many interactive tasks reflect only the final outcome, providing limited guidance on which intermediate decisions advance the task. Successful training trajectories contain intermediate states that can provide supervision for subsequent interactions. We introduce Trajectory-to-Step Policy Optimization (T2SPO), a method that uses past interaction trajectories to provide step-level feedback for policy learning. T2SPO derives remaining-distance targets from successful trajectories and pairs them with representations of the states visited along the way. Conditioned on these examples, a pretrained TabPFN regressor estimates the remaining distance to success at each state of a new rollout. Changes in this distance estimate across consecutive states yield auxiliary credit for agent steps alongside task-level supervision. As training proceeds, newly completed trajectories refresh the estimator's context, incorporating new experience without updating its parameters. Experiments with 1.5B and 7B language models on ALFWorld and WebShop show that T2SPO consistently improves overall task success over GRPO.

</details>


### [436] [Interpretable Synthetic Medical Tabular Data Generation for Clinical Decision Support Using Fuzzy Cognitive Maps](https://arxiv.org/abs/2610.00391)
*Michael Vasilakakis,Dimitris K. Iakovidis*

Main category: cs.LG

TL;DR: 提出基于模糊认知图（FCM）的合成医疗表格数据生成框架，以模糊集表征临床特征、以FCM边权编码因果依赖，在CPU上实现优于TVAE与Gaussian Copula的TSTR性能并兼顾隐私。


<details>
  <summary>Details</summary>
Motivation: 真实临床数据受隐私、伦理与可获取性限制，而现概率模型与深度生成模型缺乏可解释性，难以保持临床有意义的依赖关系，不适用于安全攸关的CBMS场景。

Method: 用语言可解释的模糊集描述临床特征，由模糊集交集计算FCM边权以编码特征间依赖；通过将随机初始化的语言激活向量在FCM中迭代传播至收敛，再经去模糊化得到临床一致的数值，生成合成患者记录；方法原生支持混合数据类型与健康记录中的领域约束。

Result: 在UCI医学基准数据集上按TSTR协议评估：Heart Disease数据集准确率最高0.81、AUROC最高0.90，达到或超过TVAE与Gaussian Copula，且仅用CPU运行；KS Complement最高0.91、Correlation Similarity最高0.95，DCR Baseline Protection持续优于TVAE。

Conclusion: 因果基础、可解释的模糊建模为CBMS中可信合成数据生成提供了计算高效且透明的替代方案。

Abstract: Synthetic medical tabular data generation has become essential for developing and validating computer-based medical systems (CBMSs) when real clinical data is restricted due to privacy, ethical, or data availability limitations. Existing probabilistic and deep generative models often lack interpretability and fail to preserve clinically meaningful dependencies, limiting their suitability for safety-critical applications. This paper proposes a novel application of Fuzzy Cognitive Maps (FCMs) in a framework for synthetic medical tabular data generation with explicit causality and privacy preservation. Clinical features are described using linguistically interpretable fuzzy sets, and inter-feature dependencies are encoded as FCM edge weights computed from fuzzy set intersections. Synthetic patient records are generated by propagating randomly initialized linguistic activation vectors through the FCM until convergence, followed by defuzzification to produce clinically coherent numerical values. The approach natively handles mixed data types, and domain constraints common in health records. Experimental evaluation on UCI medical benchmark datasets demonstrates competitive performance under a Train-on-Synthetic-Test-on-Real (TSTR) protocol. The proposed method achieves accuracy of up to 0.81 and AUROC of up to 0.90 on the Heart Disease dataset, matching or exceeding TVAE and Gaussian Copula baselines while running exclusively on CPU. Fidelity metrics including KS Complement (up to 0.91) and Correlation Similarity (up to 0.95) confirm strong statistical coherence, and DCR Baseline Protection scores consistently exceed those of TVAE, confirming adequate privacy guarantees. These results demonstrate that causally grounded, interpretable fuzzy modeling offers a computationally efficient and transparent alternative to deep generative models for trustworthy synthetic data generation in CBMSs.

</details>


### [437] [Forking: Sudden Overfitting Under Replay](https://arxiv.org/abs/2610.00394)
*Shanbin Yu,Shaoyang Guo,Haoran Zhao,Danni Yu,Ziming Liu*

Main category: cs.LG

TL;DR: 该论文研究NanoGPT自动研究中发现的"分叉"（forking）泛化失败现象：在数据回放下，具有过编码n-gram记忆分支的模型在epoch边界出现训练与验证损失的急剧分离，形似分叉。


<details>
  <summary>Details</summary>
Motivation: 作者希望系统刻画"分叉"这一在NanoGPT自动研究中意外发现的泛化失败现象。其动机有二：一是在深度学习经典现象（grokking、双下降）之外揭示又一奇异现象；二是警示自动研究（autoresearch）智能体所提出的技巧可能带来意外且有害的副作用，提示研究者应对智能体产出的大量"看似有用"的结果保持审慎。

Method: 在受控的vanilla NanoGPT设置中复现并研究该现象，同时在带有Engram的DeepSeek风格模型中再现。通过机制分析考察重复更新对训练中出现的续写与未见续写概率的影响，分析n-gram模块形成的弱交互、上下文特定子空间如何放大该效应，并考察上下文频率、训练预算与表拥挤度等因素的作用。此外在短预算、高度重复的SFT和类RL场景中观察分叉。

Result: 重复更新会锐化训练中观察到的续写概率，同时压低未见续写的概率，使其损失随每轮迭代增长；n-gram模块形成的弱交互上下文特定子空间放大了该效应。低频上下文贡献了大部分损失差距，而更大的训练预算与高度拥挤的哈希表可抑制该现象。分叉亦出现于短预算、高度重复的SFT和类RL场景中。

Conclusion: 论文贡献有二：(1) 分叉揭示了深度学习中的又一奇异现象，可与grokking和双下降并列；(2) 分叉是自动研究智能体所提技巧的意外且不愉快的副产品，说明尽管这类智能体能产生大量看似有用的结果，研究者仍须对其结果保持警惕。

Abstract: This paper studies forking, a generalization failure discovered in NanoGPT autoresearch. Under data replay, models with an over-encoding n-gram memory branch show a sharp separation of training and validation loss at epoch boundaries, resembling the shape of forks. We study this phenomenon in a controlled vanilla NanoGPT setting and reproduce it in a DeepSeek-style model with Engram. Mechanistically, repeated updates sharpen the continuations observed in training while suppressing the probability of unseen continuations, whose loss grows with each pass. The n-gram module creates weakly interacting context-specific subspaces, amplifying this effect. Low-frequency contexts contribute most of the gap, whereas larger training budgets and heavily crowded tables suppress it. We also observe forking in short-budget, heavily repeated SFT and RL-like regimes. The contributions of this paper are twofold: (1) Forking reveals yet another curious phenomenon in deep learning, in addition to grokking and double descent. (2) Forking is an unexpected and unpleasant by-product of tricks proposed by autoresearch agents. While these agents produce an enormous number of results that seem useful, we should always be careful with their results.

</details>


### [438] [Specificity-Aware Diffusion Steering via Variance-Reduced Sequential Monte Carlo](https://arxiv.org/abs/2610.00395)
*Luran Wang,Linrui Ma,Hannes Stärk,Regina Barzilay*

Main category: cs.LG

TL;DR: 本文将特异性感知的扩散模型引导建模为目标设计问题，从基于重叠的目标函数导出目标分布，并提出方差最小化局部提议的SMC采样器与固定噪声优化流程，在多个任务上优于负向引导基线。


<details>
  <summary>Details</summary>
Motivation: 推理时引导可让预训练扩散模型无需重训即满足新约束，但特异性感知生成存在困难：从负参考分布排斥样本时，会在正负分布重叠区域侵蚀正分布。核心挑战是在抑制负质量的同时尽量不扭曲正分布。

Method: 将特异性感知引导表述为目标设计问题，从基于重叠的目标函数导出目标分布，仅在正参考相对负参考具有足够偏好（似然比意义下的特异性）的区域保留期望参考分布；为从对应的时间依赖目标路径采样，提出带方差最小化局部提议的序贯蒙特卡洛(SMC)采样器；并引入使用期望与不期望分数场雅可比-向量积(JVP)的实用固定噪声优化流程。

Result: 在合成任务、类别对比生成、文本到图像任务及肽-MHC(p-MHC)结合物实验上，相比负向引导基线，所提方法更有效抑制不期望区域、减少模式漂移，并通过降低SMC权重塌缩提升采样稳定性。

Conclusion: 特异性感知引导可统一为似然比形式的目标设计问题，配合方差最小化的SMC采样与固定噪声JVP优化，可在几乎不扭曲正分布的前提下有效抑制负向区域，为扩散模型的推理时约束满足提供了有效且稳定的方案。

Abstract: Inference-time steering enables pretrained diffusion models to satisfy new constraints without full retraining. However, specificity-aware generation is difficult: repelling samples from a negative reference distribution can also erode the positive distribution where the two overlap. The key challenge is to suppress negative mass while minimally distorting the positive distribution. We address this problem by formulating specificity-aware steering as a target-design problem and deriving a target distribution from an overlap-based objective. The resulting target keeps the desired reference distribution only in regions where it is sufficiently preferred over the undesired reference distribution, giving a likelihood-ratio interpretation of specificity. To sample from the corresponding time-dependent target path, we develop a Sequential Monte Carlo sampler with a variance-minimized local proposal. We further introduce a practical fixed-noise optimization procedure with the Jacobian--vector products with the desired and undesired score fields. Experiments on synthetic task, class-contrastive generation, text-to-image tasks and peptide-MHC (p-MHC) binder show that the proposed method suppresses undesired regions more effectively, reduces mode shift, and improves sampling stability by decreasing the SMC weight collapse compared with negative-guidance baselines. Code is available at: https://github.com/WangLuran/Specificity-Aware-Diffusion-Steering

</details>


### [439] [NEUROTOKEN: Joint Source and Directional AAD with Envelope Decoding via Conditional Flow Matching](https://arxiv.org/abs/2610.00397)
*Ali Alavi,Donald S. Williamson*

Main category: cs.LG

TL;DR: 论文提出 NEUROTOKEN 框架，将听觉注意解码（AAD）重构为"给定 EEG 下被注意包络的条件似然"问题，用一个共享 EEG 前端的网络配合条件流匹配头（ATTUNEFLOW）与两种推理期集成（QUADTRACK、ENV-FLOW）实现候选声源的评分与排序。


<details>
  <summary>Details</summary>
Motivation: 鸡尾酒会问题中，"听者正在注意哪位说话人"是下一代助听器与脑机接口的关键缺失环节，因为它决定设备该放大哪一路语音。现有 AAD 研究彼此割裂：方向型 AAD 只分类左右侧而不映射到具体声流；回归型 source-AAD 仅用单一 Pearson 相关系数排序，在真实设备所需的 1–5 秒短窗下噪声极大；包络重构则缺乏原生的 AAD 判决规则。

Method: 作者主张正确的建模对象不是任何单一统计量，而是给定 EEG 时被注意包络的条件似然。据此提出 NEUROTOKEN：单一网络，三个头共享同一 EEG 前端，其中条件流匹配头 ATTUNEFLOW 通过积分速度残差似然比（integrated velocity-residual likelihood ratio）对候选声源打分。推理阶段引入两种免训练集成：QUADTRACK（融合四种互补统计量）与 ENV-FLOW（对 QUADTRACK 与 ATTUNEFLOW 做 z-normalise 后融合），以吸收单一统计量的失效模式。

Result: 在 KU Leuven、DTU、NJU 三个数据集、5 秒窗设定下，ATTUNEFLOW 相比最强非生成式基线将逐段 source-AAD 提升 9%–16%，并将跨被试方差缩小约 3 倍；试次级（trial-level）融合在其中两个数据集上超过 93%。同时，复现实验显示：在严格的试次不相交（trial-disjoint）协议下，文献中常见的 95%–97% 方向型 AAD 成绩会下降 17%–45%。

Conclusion: 以条件似然为核心的建模方式优于依赖单一统计量的既有 AAD 方案，NEUROTOKEN 通过流匹配似然比与推理期集成在多个数据集上同时提升了准确率与跨被试稳健性。严格的试次不相交协议揭示方向型 AAD 的真实性能上限远低于既有报告，说明现有评测存在乐观偏差，也进一步论证了采用基于似然的统一 AAD 形式的必要性。

Abstract: Identifying which speaker a listener is attending to in a noisy room -- the cocktail-party problem -- is the missing ingredient for next-generation hearing aids and brain-computer interfaces: it tells the device whose voice to amplify. Auditory attention decoding (AAD) reads this answer from EEG, but the literature splits into disconnected pieces: directional-AAD classifies side but does not map side to stream; regression-based source-AAD ranks candidate streams by a single Pearson correlation that is intrinsically noisy at the 1-5 s windows real devices need; and envelope reconstruction has no native AAD rule. We argue the right object is not any single statistic but the conditional likelihood of the attended envelope given EEG, and we make this practical with NEUROTOKEN: a single network whose three heads share one EEG front-end, with a conditional flow-matching head (ATTUNEFLOW) that scores candidates by an integrated velocity-residual likelihood ratio. Two inference-time ensembles -- QUADTRACK (four complementary statistics) and ENV-FLOW (z-normalised QUADTRACK+ATTUNEFLOW) -- absorb per-statistic failure modes for free. On KU Leuven, DTU, and NJU at 5 s, ATTUNEFLOW lifts per-segment source-AAD by 9%-16% over the strongest non-generative baseline and shrinks across-subject variance by ~3x; trial-level fusion exceeds 93% on two of three datasets. In parallel reproductions we show that canonical 95-97% direction-AAD numbers collapse by 17%-45% under a strict trial-disjoint protocol, clarifying both the true ceiling and why a likelihood-based formulation is needed.

</details>


### [440] [WIPSNet: Deep Learning for Paediatric Wheeze Detection from Overnight Impedance Pneumography](https://arxiv.org/abs/2610.00398)
*Felix Oury,Harley Day,Karina Mayoral,Ville-Pekka Seppä,Sejal Saglani,Reiko J. Tanaka*

Main category: cs.LG

TL;DR: 提出WIPSNet，将整夜IP信号的小波变换尺度图堆叠为3D输入，用3D ResNet做夜间喘息分类，AUC由EVI的0.633提升至0.783。


<details>
  <summary>Details</summary>
Motivation: 整夜阻抗肺图（IP）用于儿童呼吸健康监测，但现有临床指标EVI把每段记录压缩为单一标量，判别力有限（AUC 0.633），且长时程、不规则生理时间序列的有效表征仍具挑战。

Method: 构建WIPSNet：对整夜IP信号做连续小波变换得到尺度图，在时间维堆叠成三维张量，输入3D ResNet进行夜间喘息分类；并与EVI、状态空间模型Mamba及两种现代睡眠分期架构对比。

Result: 在15名受试者、60个夜晚、281小时数据集上，WIPSNet取得AUC 0.783±0.026，优于EVI、Mamba及两种睡眠分期架构；性能在对应32分钟时间上下文的体深度处达到峰值。

Conclusion: 结构化的时频表示结合3D卷积架构，是学习长时程、不规则生理时间序列的有效途径；多尺度时间聚合对建模夜间呼吸动态尤为重要。

Abstract: Overnight impedance pneumography (IP) is used to monitor paediatric respiratory health. Its current clinical readout, the Expiratory Variability Index (EVI), compresses each IP recording into a single scalar and achieves an AUC of 0.633 for night-level wheeze classification. We introduce Wheeze Impedance Pneumography Scalogram Network (WIPSNet), a 3D ResNet operating on stacked continuous wavelet transform scalograms of overnight IP signals. On a 15-patient cohort (60 nights, 281 hours), WIPSNet achieves an AUC of $0.783 \pm 0.026$, outperforming EVI, a state-space model (Mamba), and two modern sleep-staging architectures. Performance peaks at a volumetric depth corresponding to 32 minutes of temporal context, suggesting that multi-scale temporal aggregation is important for modelling nocturnal respiratory dynamics. Overall, these results indicate that structured time-frequency representations combined with 3D convolutional architectures provide an effective approach for learning from long, irregular physiological time series.

</details>


### [441] [Metacognitive Reasoning in Energy Based Models using Instance Based Learning Theory](https://arxiv.org/abs/2610.00399)
*Tailia Malloy,Prateek Kumar Rajput,Serge Lionel Nikiema,Cleotilde Gonzalez,Tegawendé F. Bissyandé*

Main category: cs.LG

TL;DR: 该论文提出MERITED框架，将实例学习理论（IBLT）与能量模型（EBM）结合，实现基于不确定性的元认知计算资源动态分配，并训练与开源了191M参数推理EBM。


<details>
  <summary>Details</summary>
Motivation: 现有基于大语言模型的AI系统在给出输出前无法估计不确定性，也无法动态分配推理资源，难以实现元认知式的资源分配；现有EBM虽支持可解释不确定性建模与动态算力分配，但并未直接解决"基于不确定性决定计算分配"这一元认知任务。

Method: 提出MERITED框架（M]Etacognitive Reasoning with Instance-based Learning Theory and Energy Dynamics），以IBLT为理论基础，在EBM中控制投入的计算努力，并实现一个基于IBL模型的动态计算分配机制。

Result: 训练并开放权重共享了一个191M参数的推理用EBM，并实现了MERITED框架的动态计算分配功能。

Conclusion: MERITED框架可在保持计算效率的同时，实现基于不确定性的推理努力元认知控制，为EBM与IBLT相结合解决元认知计算分配问题提供了可行方案。

Abstract: Metacognition involves reasoning about cognitive processes themselves. An example is in resource allocation where we choose how much time and effort to put into a reasoning task before we begin based on our confidence. Current Artificial Intelligence (AI) systems that rely on Large Language Models (LLMs) cannot estimate their uncertainty about an output without first responding, and cannot dynamically allocate resources to producing an output, making this type of metacognitive process difficult. A recently proposed alternative to classic transformer architectures that addresses these two concerns is the Energy Based Model (EBM) which allows for interpretable uncertainty modeling and dynamic allocation of compute resources. While EBMs can allow for control of these two processes, the actual metacognitive task of determining compute allocation based on uncertainty is not directly addressed. Instance-Based Learning Theory (IBLT) provides an approach to modeling human-like decisions from experience that has previously been applied to predicting human metacognitive reasoning. In this paper we introduce a framework for MEtacognitive Reasoning with Instance-based Learning Theory and Energy Dynamics (MERITED). Grounded in IBLT, this framework allows for control of the computational effort allocated in an EBM to allow for metacognitive control over reasoning effort based on uncertainty while remaining computationally efficient. This work has two main contributions, the training and open weight sharing of a 191M parameter reasoning EBM, and an implementation of the MERITED framework for dynamic compute allocation using an IBL model.

</details>


### [442] [Representation Transitions Reveal Emerging Safety Risks in Multi-Turn LLM Agents](https://arxiv.org/abs/2610.00400)
*Haoyu Wang,Wei Zhao,Yedi Zhang,Christopher M. Poskitt,Jun Sun*

Main category: cs.LG

TL;DR: DART 是一个运行时防御框架，通过在智能体内部表征中检测累积的表征转变来识别多轮攻击，并利用去噪安全方向消除良性漂移干扰，从而在低误报和低开销下显著降低攻击成功率。


<details>
  <summary>Details</summary>
Motivation: 多轮攻击可将单步合规动作组合成有害结果，而孤立评估动作或状态的防御难以应对；作者希望找到攻击在智能体内部表征中留下的可检测特征，并解决朴素聚合被良性表征漂移干扰的问题。

Method: 作者发现有害行为表现为跨上下文更新的累积表征转变，且触发上下文可由同一信号定位。为此对对比安全方向去噪：将良性流量锚定为零并移除其主要变化方向，无运行时成本。基于此提出 DART 运行时框架，检测和归因表征偏移，并用针对性提醒进行干预。

Result: 在六个模型和两个多轮基准上，DART 将攻击成功率从 MT-AgentRisk 的 84% 降至 25%（全部检出，平均误报率 12%），ASEval 从 97% 降至 52%（良性非拒答代价分别为 8% 和 0%）。在 MT-AgentRisk 上六个模型均优于 SOTA 的 ToolShield（相同协议下仅 55%）。去噪关键：ASEval 上未去噪监控仅检出 7%-40%，去噪后为 60%-85%。同一监控器无需修改即可覆盖单轮间接注入，每步仅增加 0.14-0.56 秒开销，且无需辅助模型。

Conclusion: 有害多轮行为在智能体内部表征中留下可检测的累积转变信号，通过去噪安全方向可有效区分攻击与良性漂移。DART 作为轻量运行时防御，在多模型多基准上显著优于现有方法，并可扩展到单轮注入，是计算密集型防御的实用补充。

Abstract: Multi-turn attacks on agentic systems can compose individually permissible actions into harmful outcomes, challenging defenses that assess actions or states in isolation. We show that such attacks leave a detectable signature in the agent's internal representations: harmful behavior emerges as an accumulated representation transition across context updates, whose triggering context can be identified from the same signal. We further find that naive aggregation is confounded by benign representation drift, as a contrastive safety direction need not assign zero to benign transitions. We address this by denoising the direction, anchoring benign traffic at zero and removing its leading variation directions, with no runtime cost.
  These findings motivate DART, a runtime framework that detects and attributes representation shifts and intervenes with targeted reminders. Across six models and two multi-turn benchmarks, DART reduces attack success from 84% to 25% on MT-AgentRisk, catching every attack at a mean false-alarm rate of 12%, and from 97% to 52% on ASEval, at costs in benign non-refusal of 8% and 0%, respectively. On MT-AgentRisk, it outperforms ToolShield, the state-of-the-art multi-turn defense, on all six models: under the same protocol, ToolShield reaches only 55%. Denoising is critical: on ASEval, the undenoised monitor catches only 7%-40% of attacks, while the denoised monitor catches 60%-85%. The same monitor covers single-turn indirect injection without modification and adds only 0.14-0.56 s overhead per monitored step without requiring an auxiliary model, making it a lightweight complement to computation-heavy speculative defenses.

</details>


### [443] [The Conflict Between Logic and Memory: Learning Higher-Order Interactions in Shallow MLPs](https://arxiv.org/abs/2610.00403)
*Gongyue Zhang,Honghai Liu*

Main category: cs.LG

TL;DR: 本文以合成任务考查单隐藏层MLP的拟合与规则恢复之分离：纯净parity任务无低阶预测边际、有精确贝叶斯后验、可由宽度k ReLU网络在洁净隐变量上表示。实验显示SGD/Adam/Muon在不同阶数任务上表现分化，并表明nuisance权重学习与偏差干预会改变浅层网络实际学到的高阶规则。


<details>
  <summary>Details</summary>
Motivation: 网络能在训练样本上达到零误差，却未必学到生成标签的真实规则。作者希望在这种“拟合但不恢复规则”的现象中，厘清优化器、任务交互阶数与nuisance输入如何共同约束浅层网络所能实现的高阶规则。

Method: 使用可控制交互阶数与nuisance输入的单隐藏层MLP合成任务。以pure parity为基准：其不含低阶预测边际、具有精确贝叶斯后验、且可在洁净隐变量上由宽度k的ReLU网络表示。进行匹配的2–4阶扫描比较SGD、Adam、Muon；另设混合阶任务，分别通过冻结连接独立nuisance输入的第一层权重、仅在测试时移除这些输入进行干预；并实施偏差干预以考察目标对称性与浅层ReLU表示的关系；在仅含信号的紧凑设置下测试5–8阶及9–11阶学习。

Result: 在2–4阶匹配扫描中，SGD、Adam、Muon在2阶均达100%峰值测试精度；3阶分别达96.25%、50.87%、76.82%，Muon在4阶达99.21%。在混合阶任务中，仅冻结连接独立nuisance输入的第一层权重，使AdamW第10轮精度从44.73%升至95.07%；仅在测试时移除这些输入则升至48.38%。在紧凑信号-only设置下，SGD与Muon均学会5–8阶，且在9–11阶SGD峰值精度更高。

Conclusion: 优化过程与nuisance权重学习共同约束浅层网络所实现的高阶规则。nuisance权重的学习不只即时影响预测，还会改变训练结果；偏差干预揭示了目标对称性与浅层ReLU表示之间的联系。整体上，单隐藏层MLP对不同阶规则的恢复能力受优化器和干扰输入结构显著制约。

Abstract: A network can fit its training examples while failing to recover the rule that generated their labels. We examine this separation in single-hidden-layer multilayer perceptrons (MLPs), using synthetic tasks that control interaction order and the presence of nuisance inputs. We establish elementary benchmark properties: pure parity contains no predictive lower-order marginals, admits an exact Bayes posterior, and can be represented on clean latent inputs by a width-$k$ ReLU network. Experiments then identify distinct optimization outcomes. In a matched order-2--4 sweep, SGD, Adam, and Muon all reach 100\% peak test accuracy at order two; at order three they reach 96.25\%, 50.87\%, and 76.82\%, respectively, while Muon reaches 99.21\% at order four. In a separate mixed-order task, freezing only the first-layer weights connected to independent nuisance inputs raises AdamW's epoch-10 accuracy from 44.73\% to 95.07\%. Removing the same inputs only at test time raises it to 48.38\%. Thus, nuisance-weight learning changes the training outcome beyond its immediate effect on prediction. Bias interventions expose a connection between target symmetry and shallow ReLU representations. In a compact signal-only regime, both SGD and Muon learn orders five through eight, with higher SGD peak accuracy at orders nine through eleven. Together, the results show how optimization and nuisance learning constrain the higher-order rules realized by a shallow network.

</details>


### [444] [EchoPress: Query-Agnostic KV Cache Pruning via Virtual Context Reconstruction](https://arxiv.org/abs/2610.00412)
*Jiawei Lin,Saibo Geng,Thomas Bourgeat*

Main category: cs.LG

TL;DR: 提出EchoPress：一种无需训练、无需额外前向的KV缓存剪枝方法，用标准prefill已有信息近似KVzip的重建重要性评分，仅重建首块进行校准，在50%–90%淘汰率下匹配KVzip精度，同时大幅降低压缩开销。


<details>
  <summary>Details</summary>
Motivation: 长上下文推理的KV缓存占用显存大，需剪枝淘汰次要键值对。KVzip以逐块重建上下文估计重要性，压缩质量好但需额外前向；已有学习式近似方法又依赖模型特定训练。因此需要一种免训练、低开销且质量接近KVzip的剪枝方案。

Method: 分析KVzip识别重要缓存信息的机制，发现其重建分数可用prefill阶段已计算的注意力信息近似。据此提出EchoPress：直接用标准prefill的query与key近似重建注意力，无需训练；每个请求仅重建第一个chunk，用于校准剩余上下文的重要性评分。

Result: 在LongBench与RULER上，使用Qwen3-8B和Llama-3.1-8B-Instruct，50%–90%淘汰率范围内EchoPress任务精度与KVzip相当；压缩开销降低1.7–19.6倍，总prefill时间最高降低2.9倍。

Conclusion: EchoPress通过复用prefill信息、仅校准首块，实现了免训练且高效的KV缓存剪枝，在保持KVzip级精度的同时显著减少压缩与prefill开销，为长上下文推理提供实用方案。

Abstract: KV cache pruning reduces long-context inference memory usage by evicting less important key-value pairs. KVzip estimates importance through context reconstruction: prompting a model to repeat the context chunk by chunk. This achieves strong compression quality at the cost of additional forward passes. Learned approximations reduce this cost but require model-specific training. We analyze how KVzip identifies important cached information and show how to approximate its reconstruction scores using information already computed during prefill. These findings motivate EchoPress, a training-free method that approximates reconstruction attention using queries and keys from standard prefill. For each request, it reconstructs only the first chunk to calibrate importance scores for the remaining context. Experiments on LongBench and RULER with Qwen3-8B and Llama-3.1-8B-Instruct show that EchoPress matches KVzip in task accuracy across eviction ratios from 50% to 90%, while reducing compression overhead by a factor of 1.7-19.6 and total prefill time by a factor of up to 2.9. Code is available at https://github.com/ljwljwljwljw/kvpress/tree/echo-press.

</details>


### [445] [Do Better Scores Mean Better Physics? Physics-Grounded Explanations for Sim2Real Neural Operators](https://arxiv.org/abs/2610.00415)
*Somyajit Chakraborty,Xizhong Chen*

Main category: cs.LG

TL;DR: 机器学习代理模型（含四种神经算子与CNO）在NACA4418翼型流场预测中，较低的预测误差并不必然对应更低的物理相关流动统计误差，故应补充物理诊断指标。


<details>
  <summary>Details</summary>
Motivation: 机器学习代理模型虽能加速物理仿真，但低预测误差未必等同于物理相关流动统计量的低误差，需检验基准误差与实际物理诊断之间的一致性。

Method: 结合CFD仿真与PIV实验测量，针对NACA4418翼型流动；采用保持均值的输入干预（从观测流场历史特定区域移除速度脉动），比较四类神经算子在移除能量最高10%有效观测单元与等面积随机移除时的预测差异；并对CNO比较速度场误差与双分量脉动能误差，另做输出衰减压力测试。

Result: 移除能量最高10%区域脉动对预测的影响大于等面积随机移除，但掩膜未对脉动能量匹配，故该对比仅反映敏感性；CNO速度场误差更低，但其双分量脉动能误差在两子集上均显著高于参考；输出衰减压力测试亦显示基准误差与域求和脉动能之间存在分歧。

Conclusion: 单一基准结果不足以判定物理正确性，需在聚合预测评分之外报告互补的物理诊断指标；这些结果仅为动机性证据，不能确立反事实的物理正确性。

Abstract: Machine-learning surrogates accelerate physical simulation, but lower prediction error need not coincide with lower error in physically relevant flow statistics. We examine this question for flow around a NACA4418 airfoil using paired computational-fluid-dynamics simulations and experimental particle-image-velocimetry measurements. A mean-preserving input intervention removes velocity fluctuations from selected regions of observed flow histories. Across four neural operators, removing fluctuations from the most energetic 10% of valid observed cells changes forecasts more than equal-area random removal. Because the masks are not matched for removed fluctuation energy, this contrast measures sensitivity, not independent evidence of physical importance. Separately, a CNO has lower velocity-field error but substantially higher two-component fluctuation-energy error than the reference on both analysis subsets. An output attenuation stress test also demonstrates disagreement between benchmark errors and domain-summed fluctuation energy. These single-benchmark results motivate reporting complementary physical diagnostics alongside aggregate prediction scores; they do not establish counterfactual physical correctness.

</details>


### [446] [Source Identification Is Not Fitness Testing: Measuring the Limits of Synthetic-Data Attribution](https://arxiv.org/abs/2610.00417)
*Joss Armstrong*

Main category: cs.LG

TL;DR: 模型自生成数据反复训练会导致性能退化。本文检验来源溯源（provenance）能否可靠恢复、以及能否用于筛选更好训练数据。在金融风险文本上，生成段落来源归因在原文上准确率98.7%，改述后降至53.1%，风格改写后降至29.0%；生成与人类文本检测仍近乎完美。随后比较两种筛选规则（来源信息 vs 参考模型打分）进行三轮生成-再训练，两规则选出不同样本，但未检测到结果模型退化上的稳定差异。结论：来源识别与有用性识别是两个不同问题。


<details>
  <summary>Details</summary>
Motivation: 反复用模型自生成数据训练会降低后续模型质量，一种应对思路是借助数据来源（provenance）信息决定复用哪些生成样本。因此需要检验两个前提：来源信息能否被可靠恢复，以及它是否有助于识别更优训练数据。

Method: 以金融风险文本为对象，先对生成段落进行来源（生成器）归因，再在改述与风格改写后重复测试；同时进行生成文本与人类文本的检测。随后设计三轮生成与再训练实验，比较两种生成样本筛选规则：一种使用来源信息，另一种使用独立参考模型的打分，并比较其筛选结果与再训练后模型的退化情况。

Result: 生成器归因在原始段落上准确率98.7%，改述后降至53.1%，风格改写后降至29.0%；生成-人类检测在测试的人类对照集上仍接近完美。两种筛选规则所选样本不同，但计划中的比较未检测到结果模型退化上的稳定差异。

Conclusion: 识别数据来源与识别哪些数据对训练有用是两个分离的问题。实验区分了来源身份、面向准则的筛选与递归训练结果三者的关系：无论是provenance打分还是所测试的面向准则的代理指标，都未被证明足以预测未来递归行为。

Abstract: Repeated training on model-generated data can degrade later models. One possible response is to use provenance when deciding which generated examples to reuse. We test both how reliably that provenance can be recovered and whether it helps identify better training data. Using financial-risk text, we first identify the source of generated passages and then repeat the test after rewriting them. Generator attribution is 98.7% accurate on the original passages but falls to 53.1% after paraphrasing and 29.0% after style rewriting. Generated-versus-human detection remains close to perfect against the tested human comparison set. We then compare two ways of selecting generated examples over three rounds of generation and retraining. One uses source information. The other uses a score from a separate reference model. The two rules select different examples, but the planned comparison does not detect a stable difference in the degradation of the resulting models. The results show that identifying where data came from and identifying which data are useful for training are separate problems. The experiment therefore separates source identity, criterion-facing selection, and recursive training outcome: neither the provenance score nor the tested criterion-facing proxy is established as sufficient for future recursive behaviour.

</details>


### [447] [CommunityKV: Efficient Long-Context Decoding via Graph Partitioning](https://arxiv.org/abs/2610.00418)
*Joe McKenna,Anastasios Alexandridis,Nathan Susanj,Jing Liu*

Main category: cs.LG

TL;DR: CommunityKV将稀疏注意力建模为社区发现问题，利用预填充阶段已计算的QK^T构建token图并划分社区，配合常数时间的局部更新规则实现流式解码中的稀疏检索，在Qwen3与Llama-3.1上取得最高1.71倍的端到端生成吞吐提升且精度相当。


<details>
  <summary>Details</summary>
Motivation: 长上下文Transformer受自注意力二次复杂度和KV缓存显存传输线性增长的制约。现有稀疏注意力方法要么需要大规模训练，要么在免训练框架下依赖语义粗糙的启发式规则，或使用难以在解码时高效更新的昂贵聚类方法。

Method: 提出CommunityKV框架，将稀疏注意力表述为社区发现问题：在标准预填充阶段利用已计算的QK^T分数构建token图，并将图划分为若干社区，从而检索语义连贯的token组；设计局部更新规则，以常数时间将新生成token分配到社区，使整个流式解码过程无需全局重划分即可进行稀疏检索；并在Qwen3和Llama-3.1模型、三个长上下文基准上评估，比较每个查询头一张图与查询组图聚合两种配置。

Result: 在Qwen3和Llama-3.1模型及三个长上下文基准上，每个查询头一张图时，CommunityKV的端到端生成吞吐最高达稠密注意力的1.25倍；采用查询组图聚合时可提升至最高1.71倍，且精度相当。

Conclusion: CommunityKV表明以社区检测视角重构免训练稀疏注意力，可在不损失精度的前提下显著提升长上下文生成吞吐，并通过常数时间的局部社区更新支持高效的流式解码。

Abstract: Scaling Transformers to long contexts is constrained by the quadratic cost of self-attention and the linear growth of key-value cache memory transfer. Sparse attention mitigates this by retrieving only relevant tokens, but current approaches either require large-scale training or, within the training-free regime, rely on semantically coarse heuristics or expensive clustering that is difficult to update efficiently during decoding. We introduce CommunityKV, a framework that formulates sparse attention as a community detection problem. CommunityKV constructs a token graph from the $QK^T$ scores already computed during standard prefill, and partitions the graph into communities to enable retrieval of semantically coherent token groups. A local update rule assigns newly generated tokens to communities in constant time, enabling sparse retrieval throughout streaming decoding without global re-partitioning. We evaluate CommunityKV on Qwen3 and Llama-3.1 models across three long-context benchmarks. With one graph per query head, CommunityKV delivers up to $1.25\times$ the end-to-end generation throughput of dense attention, while query-group graph aggregation yields up to $1.71\times$ with comparable accuracy.

</details>


### [448] [The Life Cycle of a Massive Activation: Stochastic Birth, Weight-Decay-Driven Growth, and Competitive Consolidation](https://arxiv.org/abs/2610.00423)
*S. Aaron McClendon,Jorge Gallego-Feliciano,Antonios Saravanos*

Main category: cs.LG

TL;DR: 本文通过训练轨迹分析与受控干预，揭示了Transformer中"巨量激活"（massive activations）的生命周期（涌现—增长—固化），并证明权重衰减（weight decay）因果性地调控其全局激活尺度。


<details>
  <summary>Details</summary>
Motivation: 巨量激活（幅度远大于常规激活的残差流坐标）与注意力汇（attention sinks）相关，但其规模在训练过程中如何被调控尚不完全清楚。作者旨在厘清其产生、增长与稳定的机制。

Method: 结合训练轨迹分析与受控干预（ablations、受控续训、扫掠衰减系数λ），并建立"AdamW预条件增长对抗权重衰减"的平衡模型（balance model）来刻画巨量激活幅值的上升与峰值。

Result: 承载汇的通道随随机种子变化但在每次训练早期即稳定；长训练下周围通道被侵蚀、汇集中于少数冗余载体。梯度衰减跟随汇token的集体均方根幅度而非单通道。移除衰减使规模持续上升，保留则下降（即使学习率恒定）；扫掠λ使峰值时间近似对数线性偏移，峰值幅度近似按λ^{-1/2}缩放，与平衡模型一致。预条件可使大通道群维持对抗衰减。

Conclusion: 巨量激活的生命周期与调控规模的训练动态相联系，确立权重衰减为控制激活幅值的训练期杠杆。

Abstract: Massive activations, residual-stream coordinates with magnitudes far larger than typical activations, are associated with attention sinks in transformers, but how their scale is regulated during training remains incompletely understood. Combining training-trajectory analyses and controlled interventions, we trace their emergence, growth, and consolidation. Sink-carrying channels vary across random seeds but stabilize early within each run. Over longer training, surrounding channels erode and the sink concentrates onto a few redundant carriers. Across ablations, gradient attenuation follows the sink token's collective root-mean-square magnitude rather than any single channel, making collective scale central to understanding their effects. Our central result is that weight decay causally controls the turnover of global activation scale. In controlled continuations, removing decay near the peak allows this scale to keep rising, whereas retaining it produces decline even at constant learning rate. We develop a balance model for the rise and peak of massive-activation magnitude, in which AdamW-preconditioned growth opposes weight decay. Sweeping the decay coefficient $λ$ shifts peak timing approximately log-linearly and yields peak magnitudes scaling approximately as $λ^{-1/2}$, consistent with this balance. Optimizer measurements further show that preconditioning sustains the large-channel cohort against decay even when raw maintaining forces are too small to do so. Together, these findings connect the observed life cycle to scale-regulating training dynamics and establish weight decay as a training-time lever on activation magnitude.

</details>


### [449] [XOR-Trellis: Ultra-Low-Complexity Dequantization and Curvature-Aware Hadamard-Free LLM Quantization](https://arxiv.org/abs/2610.00432)
*Xiaofan Que,Nir Elkayam,Spandan Pyakurel,Shuokai Pan,Dibakar Gope*

Main category: cs.LG

TL;DR: 本文提出两种互补技术，解决格栅编码量化（TCQ）在LLM权重超低位宽压缩中面临的解码并行吞吐不足与量化精度依赖变换的问题。


<details>
  <summary>Details</summary>
Motivation: 格栅编码量化可在超低位宽下压缩LLM权重，且无需传统向量量化那种指数级码本。但实际部署存在两大挑战：一是压缩权重的重建需足够并行吞吐，避免反量化成为推理瓶颈；二是需在无需昂贵非相干变换（如Hadamard变换）的情况下保持量化精度。

Method: 提出两项互补技术：1）超低复杂度格栅反量化器，采用结构化、硬件友好的状态到数值映射，同时保留格栅搜索所需的多样重建选择；2）用曲率感知目标重新表述离散格栅路径优化，在原始坐标空间中直接反映模型敏感度。

Result: 两项技术共同实现了高质量的超低位格栅量化，运行时重建成本低且高度并行，且不依赖基于Hadamard的非相干处理。

Conclusion: 该工作使TCQ更适配LLM实际部署，在保持精度的同时提升解码并行性并移除对昂贵变换的依赖。

Abstract: Trellis-coded quantization enables high-dimensional compression of large language model (LLM) weights at ultra-low bit widths without the exponentially large codebooks required by conventional vector quantization. Practical deployment, however, presents two challenges: reconstructing compressed weights at sufficient parallel throughput to avoid making dequantization an inference bottleneck, and maintaining quantization accuracy without costly incoherence transformations. We address these challenges with two complementary techniques. First, we introduce an ultra-low-complexity trellis dequantizer that uses a structured, hardware-efficient state-to-value mapping while preserving diverse reconstruction choices for trellis search. Second, we reformulate discrete trellis path optimization with a curvature-aware objective that reflects model sensitivity directly in the original coordinate space. Together, these techniques enable high-quality ultra-low-bit trellis quantization with inexpensive, highly parallel runtime reconstruction and without relying on Hadamard-based incoherence processing.

</details>


### [450] [Every Batch Is Its Own Validation Set: Leave-One-Out Gradient Matching for Online Data Selection in LLM Fine-Tuning](https://arxiv.org/abs/2610.00436)
*Hongyu Chen,Xinyi Luo,Ming Zhao,Lin Tang,Zihan Xu,Jing Li,Yuxuan Wang,Haoran Deng,Wei Zhang*

Main category: cs.LG

TL;DR: 本文揭示in-sample梯度匹配因对角线上的协方差惩罚而偏向噪声样本、无法超越全批次训练的原因，提出去除对角线的leave-one-out匹配目标（等价于按梯度信噪比加权），并实现无需验证集的LOOM方法，在多任务上显著优于全批次训练及现有选择器。


<details>
  <summary>Details</summary>
Motivation: 在线批次选择旨在从候选批次中挑选最有用的样本进行微调。匹配候选批次梯度的选择器因无需held-out数据而有吸引力，但它们几乎无法超越全批次训练。作者旨在解释这一现象并加以修复。

Method: 指出in-sample梯度匹配把每个样本作为自身目标的一部分，目标函数将样本自身梯度噪声计入其中（协方差惩罚位于梯度Gram矩阵对角线上），从而偏向噪声样本。修复方法：对每个样本，其余候选样本构成数据分布的独立采样，去除对角线后，匹配目标成为对总体梯度更新误差的无偏估计。该leave-one-out目标的最优解按梯度信噪比（SNR）加权样本。据此构建LOOM：在常规反向传播中按Adam预条件子度量计算Gram矩阵，用带(1-e^{-γ})保证的贪心算法选择加权子集，无需held-out数据。

Result: 在4个微调任务、7个1.5B–8B参数骨干上，LOOM在Llama-3.1-8B和Qwen2.5-7B上分别比全批次训练提升2.3和2.4分，比所有in-sample梯度匹配方法高2.4分，比验证集引导的GREATS和OPUS高1.6–2.0分，并以低于基准率五分之一的水平选中注入的标签噪声。且当每样本SNR异质性足够大时，半个批次即可获得比全批次更低误差的更新（给出精确条件）。

Conclusion: in-sample梯度匹配的失败源于对角协方差惩罚导致的噪声偏好；去掉对角线得到的leave-one-out目标无偏，其最优解按梯度SNR加权样本。LOOM据此实现，在无需验证数据的条件下一致超越全批次训练和现有梯度匹配及验证引导选择器，且具备抗标签噪声能力。

Abstract: Online batch selection fine-tunes a language model on the most useful part of each candidate batch. Selectors that match the gradient of the candidate batch are attractive because they need no held-out data, yet they rarely beat training on the whole batch. We show why. In-sample gradient matching uses every example as part of its own target, so its objective credits each example with its own gradient noise. This is the covariance penalty that makes training error optimistic, now sitting on the diagonal of the gradient Gram matrix: it steers selection toward the noisiest examples and makes the full batch the best solution the objective can reach. The fix costs nothing. For each example, the other candidates form an independent sample of the data distribution, so removing the diagonal turns the matching objective into an unbiased estimate of the update's error with respect to the population gradient. The minimizer of this leave-one-out objective weights examples by their gradient signal-to-noise ratio (SNR), and whenever per-example SNR is heterogeneous enough, half of a batch yields a lower-error update than the whole batch; we give the exact condition. We build \method{} on this principle. It computes the Gram matrix in the metric of the Adam preconditioner during the ordinary backward pass, selects a weighted subset greedily with a $(1-e^{-γ})$ guarantee, and uses no held-out data. Across four fine-tuning tasks and seven backbones from 1.5B to 8B parameters, LOOM improves on full-batch training by 2.3 and 2.4 points on Llama-3.1-8B and Qwen2.5-7B, exceeds every in-sample gradient matcher by 2.4 points and the validation-guided GREATS and OPUS by 1.6--2.0, and selects injected label noise at under a fifth of its base rate.

</details>


### [451] [One pool, many targets: a conservation layer and what archival data can identify](https://arxiv.org/abs/2610.00445)
*Zahra Khodagholi,Niloofar Yousefi*

Main category: cs.LG

TL;DR: 论文提出可微标量平衡层，以单一守恒方程刻画有限RISC池的引导-转录竞争，证明唯一正根与精确隐式梯度，并给出重分布定理、高资源极限、近似检索分析及条件秩不变性；随后在存档脱靶数据上审计剂量与跨情境实验，发现耦合项未带来可证实的额外预测力，剂量拟合异质且违反模型指数约束。


<details>
  <summary>Details</summary>
Motivation: 成对的引导-转录打分若被独立解释为占有率，就不满足有限引导负载RISC池的守恒约束，导致模型缺乏物理一致性；作者希望引入守恒机制并检验其是否能在剂量与跨情境条件下带来可证实的预测增益。

Method: 构建可微标量平衡层：一个守恒方程、唯一正根、精确隐式梯度；推导重分布定理、限定性高资源极限、检索近似分析及条件秩不变性；在存档脱靶数据上审计剂量与跨情境两类实验，使用校正后的热力学亲和力、配对置换检验、构建簇自助法，并比较\GapNet{}与\GapNetOverSE{}。

Result: 校正热力学亲和力与实测抑制方向一致但关联较弱；配对置换检验与构建簇自助法未能证实耦合带来额外预测价值，仅\GapNet{}（平衡关联簇标准误的描述性\GapNetOverSE{}）在两种置换零基线差异下存活；剂量拟合异质且常违反模型隐含指数约束（为超线性而非亚线性），数据无法识别竞争参数；可饱和竞争者压缩在留出引导家族上保持两项精度目标，但在所测规模下并未更快。

Conclusion: 贡献在于可复用的守恒算子以及检验该算子所需的实验信息；现有数据不足以识别竞争参数，耦合的额外预测价值未被证实，条件秩不变性表明单构建单剂量下的排序无法区分平衡与独立打分。

Abstract: Pairwise guide--transcript scores do not enforce conservation of a finite guide-loaded RISC pool when they are interpreted independently as occupancies. We formulate a differentiable scalar equilibrium layer: one conservation equation with a unique positive root and exact implicit gradients. It yields a redistribution theorem, a qualified high-resource limit, an analysis of the retrieval approximation, and a conditional rank-invariance result: within one construct at one dose, rankings by fractional occupancy cannot distinguish equilibrium from independent scoring. We therefore audit the two experiments that proposition leaves open, dose and cross-context, on archival off-target data. Corrected thermodynamic affinities associate weakly with measured repression in the direction a working predictor requires, but a paired permutation test and a construct-cluster bootstrap do not establish added predictive value from the coupling: what survives their differing permutation-null baselines is \GapNet{}, a descriptive \GapNetOverSE{} of the equilibrium association's cluster standard error. The dose fits are heterogeneous and frequently violate the model-implied exponent constraint, which is superlinear rather than sublinear, so these data do not identify the competition parameter. A saturable compression of the competitor set holds both accuracy targets on held-out guide families but is not faster at the size measured. The contribution is a reusable conservation operator and the experimental information needed to test it. The code for this study is available at https://github.com/shadi97kh/One-Pool-Many-Targets.

</details>


### [452] [Score the Update, Not the Token: Descent-Aligned Routing for Combinatorial LoRA Experts](https://arxiv.org/abs/2610.00493)
*Priya Nair,Lukas Brenner,Maya Lindqvist,Daniel Whitmore,Wen-Hsuan Liu,Tom Saliencro,Amara Okonkwo,Rohan Desai*

Main category: cs.LG

TL;DR: VANE 提出一种基于"有用性"（update usefulness）的 LoRA 专家路由机制：将每个专家拆分为 reader（降投影）与 writer（升投影），在共享 rank-r 空间中以低秩 compass 预测下降方向，对全部 N_A×N_B 对候选进行打分并激活 top-k，无需实际构造 update，从而以更低参数量取得更优性能。


<details>
  <summary>Details</summary>
Motivation: 现有 Mixture-of-LoRA-experts 方法存在两个关键缺陷：(1) 几乎所有方法将输入侧因子与输出侧因子一对一绑定，限制了专家组合空间；(2) 路由器通过给 token 打分来选择专家，即路由时看不到专家实际会写出什么 update。作者主张路由器应直接对"update"打分——在一阶意义上，将某专家的 update 加到层输出上，其降低损失的幅度等于该 update 与输出处负损失梯度的内积，即该专家的"有用性"。该有用性对 token 是二次的，因此线性于 token 的路由器只能看到经由 token 均值传导的部分，而按自身激活范数排序专家的路由器则完全看不到输出侧因子。

Method: 1) 将每个专家分解为 reader（down-projection）与 writer（up-projection），则每一对 reader–writer 的有用性在共享 rank-r 空间中表示为内积，全部 N_A×N_B 对可由 N_A+N_B 个向量打分。2) 据此构建 VANE：用一个低秩 compass 预测每个 token 的下降方向。3) VANE 通过"update 与 compass 的对齐度"对每一对打分，且无需实际构造任何 update。4) 以加性门（additive gates）激活 top-k 对。5) 为每一对提供精确的一阶路由器梯度。

Result: 在 Llama-3.2-3B 与 Llama-3.1-8B 上，单域常识推理任务中 VANE 在十二种 PEFT 与 MoE-LoRA 基线中取得最佳平均成绩，领先 0.9–1.1 分；在四域多任务混合设定中领先 1.3–1.5 分，且可训练参数量不到 8 专家 MoE-LoRA 的一半。此外，其路由器打分与专家实测有用性的吻合程度远高于 token 路由器。

Conclusion: 路由器应基于"update 的有用性"而非 token 本身进行打分；将专家解耦为 reader–writer 对并在共享 rank-r 空间内积打分的 VANE，能在不构造实际 update 的前提下高效地评估全部专家对组合，以更少参数实现更优的多任务与单域性能，并使路由决策与专家真实贡献高度一致。

Abstract: Mixture-of-LoRA-experts methods raise the capacity of low-rank adaptation by routing each token to a few low-rank experts. Nearly all of them tie one input-side factor to one output-side factor per expert, and nearly all of them route by scoring the token: the router picks experts without seeing what any of them would write. We argue that the router should score the update. To first order, adding an expert's update to a layer output lowers the loss by the inner product between that update and the negative loss gradient at the output. This usefulness is quadratic in the token, so a router that is linear in the token sees only the part of it that runs through the token mean, and routers that rank experts by the norm of their own activations never see the output factor. If each expert is split into a reader (down-projection) and a writer (up-projection), the usefulness of every reader--writer pair becomes an inner product in the shared rank-$r$ space, and all $N_AN_B$ pairs can be scored from $N_A+N_B$ vectors. We build VANE on this identity. A low-rank compass predicts the descent direction of each token. VANE scores every pair by the alignment between its update and the compass without forming any update, activates the top-$k$ pairs with additive gates, and gives every pair its exact first-order router gradient. On single-domain commonsense reasoning and a four-domain multi-task mixture with Llama-3.2-3B and Llama-3.1-8B, VANE attains the best average among twelve PEFT and MoE-LoRA baselines, by 0.9--1.1 and 1.3--1.5 points respectively, with less than half the trainable parameters of an 8-expert MoE-LoRA. Its router scores also track the measured usefulness of experts far more closely than token routers do.

</details>


### [453] [Gumbel Straight Flow: Distilling Autoregressive Models into One-step Flow Maps](https://arxiv.org/abs/2610.00497)
*Yeongmin Kim,Arnaud Doucet,Andrew Campbell,Valentin De Bortoli,Thomas Mensink,David Ruhe*

Main category: cs.LG

TL;DR: 本文提出 Gumbel Straight Flow (GSF)——一种连续流映射语言模型，利用预训练自回归（AR）模型中的噪声-数据耦合关系，实现高质量少步文本生成。


<details>
  <summary>Details</summary>
Motivation: 少步语言生成难以在保证质量的同时降低采样步数，现有方法缺少理论支撑的路径构造与教师引导机制。

Method: 理论上证明 AR 模型诱导的 Gumbel 噪声与 one-hot token 序列之间的耦合会产生互不相交的线性路径；采用流映射半群目标，直接用 AR 教师引导切向（速度）条件。

Result: 在预训练及下游任务等多个基准上，GSF 优于现有少步语言生成基线。

Conclusion: GSF 通过理论保证的线性路径与教师引导的流映射目标，为高效少步语言生成提供了有效方案。

Abstract: We present Gumbel Straight Flow (GSF), a continuous flow map language model that leverages the noise-data coupling of a pretrained autoregressive language (AR) model. We theoretically demonstrate that the coupling between Gumbel noise and one-hot token sequences induced by an autoregressive model yields non-intersecting linear paths connecting the noise to the sequence representations. To further enhance high-quality few-step path sampling, we use a flow map semigroup objective where the tangent (velocity) condition is guided directly by the AR teacher. Across various benchmarks, including pretraining and downstream tasks, GSF can outperform current few-step language generation baselines.

</details>


### [454] [Denoising Surface: Modeling and Predicting Inference Cost for Diffusion LLM Serving](https://arxiv.org/abs/2610.00499)
*Haoyu Zheng,Fangcheng Fu,Binhang Yuan,Yongqiang Zhang,Liang Deng,Hao Wang,Yuanyuan Zhu,Xiao Yan,Jiawei Jiang*

Main category: cs.LG

TL;DR: 本文提出去噪工作量曲面（DWS），以二维块-步概率面刻画扩散大语言模型的推理成本，并设计轻量提示预测器，在真实服务中将成本预测误差降低最高2.50倍、端到端延迟降低最高1.92倍。


<details>
  <summary>Details</summary>
Motivation: 扩散大语言模型（dLLM）正从研究走向真实在线服务，而请求调度与资源分配依赖对单请求推理成本的准确估计。常用的成本代理指标不适用：输出长度忽略了单次前向可解掩多个token，去噪步数忽略了每步成本的异质性。块自回归生成机制本质上具有"输出块×块内去噪步"的二维执行结构，而标量代理将其压缩为单一数值，丢失了刻画成本所需的关键信息。

Method: 提出去噪工作量曲面（DWS），保留二维块-步结构，将其表示为概率曲面，用以对异质化的每步成本加权。设计由粗到细的训练方案，使一个仅依赖提示（prompt-only）的轻量预测器能够准确预测复杂的DWS。该预测器可高效运行于单CPU核，避免与serving模型争抢GPU；由于DWS将依赖请求的执行行为与部署相关成本因子解耦，预测器可跨硬件配置迁移而无需重训练。基于DWS引导实现最短作业优先（shortest-job-first）调度。

Result: 在真实服务实验中，DWS相比基于标量的预测器将成本预测误差最高降低2.50倍；在在线聊天机器人场景下，DWS引导的最短作业优先调度将端到端延迟最高降低1.92倍。

Conclusion: 以二维概率曲面刻画dLLM推理成本优于标量代理，且具备跨硬件可迁移、低开销（单CPU核）等实用优势，可直接服务于真实在线调度的性能提升。

Abstract: As diffusion large language models (dLLMs) become more capable, they are moving from research settings to real-world \textit{serving}, where request management (such as scheduling and resource allocation) relies on accurate estimation of per-request inference cost. However, common cost proxies fall short for dLLMs: output length ignores that one forward pass can unmask multiple tokens, and denoising-step count ignores the \textit{heterogeneous} per-step costs. We observe that the block-autoregressive generation mechanism induces a two-dimensional execution structure over output blocks and within-block denoising steps, whereas these proxies collapse it into a scalar, discarding information essential for characterizing the cost. Motivated by this insight, we propose the Denoising Workload Surface (DWS), which preserves this two-dimensional block-step structure as a probability surface to weight the heterogeneous per-step costs. We then design a coarse-to-fine training scheme that enables a lightweight prompt-only predictor to accurately predict the complex DWS. This predictor runs efficiently even on a single CPU core, avoiding GPU contention with the serving model. Since DWS decouples request-dependent execution behavior from deployment-specific cost factors, the predictor transfers across hardware configurations without retraining. In \textit{real-world} serving experiments, DWS reduces cost-prediction error by up to $2.50\times$ over scalar-based predictors, while the DWS-guided shortest-job-first scheduler reduces end-to-end latency by up to $1.92\times$ for online chatbots.

</details>


### [455] [One-Step Generative Modeling via Training Dynamics Action](https://arxiv.org/abs/2610.00518)
*Zhangyong Liang,Ying Huang,Haibin Ling*

Main category: cs.LG

TL;DR: 提出 TDAction，以局部共享参数实现代价来选择一步生成模型的传输目标，将代价建模为软终端控制问题并推导 Batch Tangent Action-to-Go 闭式值，ImageNet 256×256 无蒸馏 FID 低于 1.1。


<details>
  <summary>Details</summary>
