Motivation: 一步生成模型通过训练时的迭代传输构建静态生成器。现有传输目标主要衡量分布层面的运动，但神经生成器需通过共享参数更新同时完成所有样本的位移。由此产生核心问题：当训练本身即为构建最终一步映射的迭代过程时，应优化下一步的分布移动，还是优化有限容量生成器学习最终映射的路径。现有方法忽略了共享参数实现代价及跨样本交互。

Method: 提出 Training Dynamics Action（TDAction）：依据局部共享参数实现代价来选择传输目标，同时保留规定的分布进展。将代价形式化为软终端控制问题，推导闭式 Batch Tangent Action-to-Go 值，兼顾参数努力与终端失配；该准则可刻画独立成对代价所忽略的跨样本交互。在各向同性移动性下，与确定性平衡耦合的二次欧氏分配一致。通过随机切向探针实现低秩构造，生成共享的分离目标，且不增加推理时轨迹。

Result: 受控实验考察了生成器几何、传输选择与实现的局部作用之间的关系；在 ImageNet 256×256 上，TDAction 在无蒸馏条件下取得 FID 低于 1.1。

Conclusion: 优化的重点应从单纯的下一次分布移动转向生成器习得最终映射的路径，以共享参数实现代价指导传输目标选择，可在单步生成中显著提升性能。

Abstract: One-step generative models construct a static generator through iterative training-time transport. Existing transport objectives primarily assess distributional motion, although a neural generator needs to realize the requested sample displacements jointly through shared parameter updates. The training-time construction raises the question: \emph{once training becomes the iterative process that constructs the final one-step map, what to optimize: the next distributional move, or the route by which the finite generator learns the final map?} To address the question, we introduce \textbf{T}raining \textbf{D}ynamics \textbf{A}ction (\textbf{TDAction}), which selects transport targets according to local shared-parameter realization cost while retaining a prescribed level of distributional progress. We formulate the cost as a soft-terminal control problem and derive a closed-form Batch Tangent Action-to-Go value that accounts for parameter effort and terminal mismatch. The criterion captures cross-sample interactions omitted by independent pairwise costs; under isotropic mobility, the criterion agrees with quadratic Euclidean assignment for deterministic balanced couplings. Randomized tangent probes provide a low-rank implementation that constructs shared detached targets without adding an inference-time trajectory. Controlled studies examine the relationship between generator geometry, transport selection, and realized local action. On ImageNet $256\times256$, TDAction attains an FID below $1.1$ without distillation.

</details>


### [456] [SimplexUQ: An Evaluation Framework and Benchmark for Conformal Uncertainty on Simplex-Valued Predictions](https://arxiv.org/abs/2610.00523)
*Liang You,Hengyu Shi,Dongwen Ou*

Main category: cs.LG

TL;DR: 提出 SimplexUQ——首个面向单纯形值预测的共形预测覆盖率分配问题的基准与可复现协议，系统比较已有共形包装器在不同分层下的覆盖公平性。


<details>
  <summary>Details</summary>
Motivation: 共形预测只保证边缘覆盖率，单一校准阈值会导致覆盖率在难度不同的区域分配不均（易区过覆盖、难区欠覆盖），但此前缺乏针对该分配问题的标准基准与可复现评测方法，尤其缺少面向单纯形值预测的系统比较。

Method: 构建 SimplexTasks-12 任务套件，包含 6 个受控合成机制与 6 个冻结预测器的真实任务（类别概率、主题混合、光谱丰度、细胞类型比例、年龄分布、情绪混合）；每次比较固定预测器、分数函数与无响应分层图，仅更换共形包装器；报告指标为边缘覆盖率、最差分层覆盖率、最大差异度、任务内半径与计算开销。

Result: 全局校准可能表面有效实则失效：CIFAR-10 上边缘覆盖率达 0.900 但最差熵分层仅 0.542，Mondrian 校准将该分层提升至 0.886 并将最大差异度从 0.358 降至 0.022。无包装器全面占优：平滑合成异质性下多种修复方法表现相当；固定分层图分析显示排名依赖于评估分组与协议；12 任务比较中 Mondrian 在其单一目标划分上全部 12 个任务差异度更低，BatchMVP 在重叠分组上 5 个任务更低。受控预测器偏差扫描表明，仅消除预测器偏差只能部分降低全局阈值差异度。

Conclusion: 该工作为经验性比较而非新的覆盖保证，将包装器选择视为诊断性对比而非普适排名，并开源任务卡、结果溯源、允许的派生数组与重建说明。局限在于结果不构成新的覆盖理论保证，排名受评估分组与协议影响。

Abstract: Conformal prediction guarantees marginal coverage, but a single calibration threshold can still spread that coverage unevenly, over-covering easy regions and under-covering hard ones. SimplexUQ is, to our knowledge, the first benchmark and reproducible protocol for measuring this allocation problem on simplex-valued predictions; it compares existing conformal wrappers rather than proposing a new one. Its task suite, SimplexTasks-12, combines six controlled synthetic regimes with six frozen-predictor real tasks spanning class probabilities, topic mixtures, spectral abundances, cell-type fractions, age distributions, and emotion mixtures. Each comparison fixes the predictor, score, and response-free stratification map, varies only the wrapper, and reports marginal coverage, worst-stratum coverage, max disparity, and within-task radius and compute. Global calibration can look valid while failing badly: on CIFAR-10 it attains 0.900 marginal coverage but only 0.542 in the worst entropy stratum, and Mondrian calibration raises that stratum to 0.886 while reducing max disparity from 0.358 to 0.022. No wrapper dominates, however. Under smooth synthetic heterogeneity, several repairs are competitive; fixed-map analyses show that rankings depend on the evaluation groups and protocol; and in a 12-task comparison, Mondrian has lower disparity on its single target partition for all 12 tasks, whereas BatchMVP has lower disparity over overlapping groups on five. These are empirical comparisons, not new coverage guarantees. A controlled predictor-bias sweep shows that removing predictor bias only partly reduces global-threshold disparity. We release task cards, result provenance, permitted derived arrays, and rebuild instructions, and treat wrapper selection as a diagnostic comparison rather than a universal ranking.

</details>


### [457] [Random Recursive Models](https://arxiv.org/abs/2610.00541)
*Jama Hussein Mohamud,Mirco Ravanelli*

Main category: cs.LG

TL;DR: 提出随机递归模型（RRM）：维护L个可学习层的层池，每步为每个样本独立有放回采样一层执行T步递归，实现灵活层复用与深度可变。


<details>
  <summary>Details</summary>
Motivation: 递归模型通过参数复用构建计算深度，是提升模型规模之外的参数高效替代方案。但现有递归模型大多重复应用单一变换或固定变换序列，计算被限制在固定的层顺序中，缺乏灵活性。

Method: RRM维护一个含L个可学习层的层池，在T个递归步骤中，为每个样本、每一步独立地进行有放回采样选择一层执行，从而在保留递归参数效率的同时实现灵活的层重用。此外，RRM支持蒙特卡洛推理与概率式测试时缩放。

Result: 在具有挑战性的推理任务上，RRM匹配或超越基线，且通常参数量减少50-75%。推理时可改变深度，包括超出训练阶段所见深度，无需重训练或新增参数，从而改进受益于更深迭代计算的任务。蒙特卡洛推理与概率式测试时缩放均在不重训练的情况下提升了性能。

Conclusion: 随机采样层池的递归方式突破了固定层顺序的限制，兼具参数效率与推理期深度灵活性，并支持蒙特卡洛推理与概率式测试时缩放，为神经网络架构设计开辟了新方向。

Abstract: Recursive models create computational depth through parameter reuse, offering a parameter-efficient alternative to increasing model size. However, most recursive models repeatedly apply one learned transformation or a prescribed sequence of transformations, restricting computation to a fixed layer order. We introduce the Random Recursive Model (RRM), which maintains a pool of $L$ learned layers and performs $T$ recursive steps by sampling one layer independently with replacement for each example and step. This enables flexible layer reuse while retaining the parameter efficiency of recurrence. We evaluate RRM on challenging reasoning tasks, where it matches or exceeds the baselines, often with 50-75 % fewer parameters. RRM can vary its depth at inference, including beyond that seen during training, without retraining or adding parameters, improving tasks that benefit from deeper iterative computation. RRM also supports Monte Carlo inference and probabilistic test-time scaling, both of which improve performance without retraining. These insights may open new directions in neural network architecture design.

</details>


### [458] [Geometry-Dependent Bounds for Online Non-Monotone DR-Submodular Maximization](https://arxiv.org/abs/2610.00545)
*Vaneet Aggarwal*

Main category: cs.LG

TL;DR: 该论文研究在紧凸下闭集上非负、非单调DR-子模函数的对抗性在线最大化问题，提出一种每轮仅需一次梯度查询和一次投影的算法，将在线竞争系数从0.401提升至4/9，并给出上下界匹配的理论分析。


<details>
  <summary>Details</summary>
Motivation: 在线非单调DR-子模最大化已有基准仅为0.401，且缺乏对最优可达系数及问题内在极限的精确刻画，作者希望改进在线竞争系数并建立匹配的上下界理论。

Method: 证明比较器一致的一阶不等式，采用有序坐标论证与目标无关的有理动作；并通过三组对称间隙构造给出离线oracle上界，以及参数化扩展与精确有限实例界定义上界函数。

Result: 在线系数提升至4/9，当ζ1∈K⊆[0,1]^d时系数改进为α(ζ)=1/2−(1−2ζ)_+²/[2(3−2ζ)²]；离线oracle上界β_*=0.470438681380894…（ζ=0）；在ζ≥1/2时上下界在1/2处匹配，且最优亏差为Θ((1/2−ζ)²)；二次型达1/2、三次型起始于8/17（ζ=1/5时0.49）；常数目标序列可得(4/9−ε)近似；并给出O(T^{3/4})的噪声值反馈遗憾。

Conclusion: 该工作通过新的一阶不等式与对称间隙构造，显著提升了在线非单调DR-子模最大化的竞争系数并给出了匹配的上下界，刻画了最优亏差随ζ的渐近行为，并扩展到自适应对手与值反馈设定。

Abstract: We study adversarial online maximization of nonnegative, non-monotone DR-submodular functions over compact convex down-closed sets. A learner commits each action before observing its objective and competes with the best fixed action in hindsight. We prove a comparator-uniform first-order inequality that gives coefficient $4/9$, improving the online $0.401$ benchmark, with one gradient query and one projection per round and $O(\sqrt T)$ expected approximate regret. If $ζ{\bf 1} \in K\subseteq[0,1]^d$, the coefficient improves to $\underlineα(ζ)=\tfrac12-(1-2ζ)_+^2/[2(3-2ζ)^2]$. The proof is a direct ordered-coordinate argument with an objective-independent rational action. Conversely, a three-group symmetry-gap construction yields an offline oracle upper bound $β_*=0.470438681380894\ldots$ at $ζ=0$, even with exact value and full-gradient responses. A parameterized extension and exact finite-instance bounds define an upper function for every $ζ$. The lower and upper bounds match at $1/2$ for $ζ\ge1/2$, and show that the optimal deficit from $1/2$ is $Θ((1/2-ζ)^2)$ as $ζ\uparrow1/2$. For coefficient-revealed polynomials we obtain $1/2$ for quadratics and a geometry-dependent cubic coefficient starting at $8/17$, including $0.49$ at $ζ=1/5$. A constant objective sequence yields an offline $(4/9-\varepsilon)$ approximation with polynomially many first-order queries on the cube and projections, without requiring a supplied positive lower bound on the optimum. We also give nonanticipating adaptive-adversary and value-feedback guarantees, including $O(T^{3/4})$ regret with one noisy value per round.

</details>


### [459] [Evaluating Hybrid Quantum-Classical Models for Reduced-Order Brain Deformation Dynamics](https://arxiv.org/abs/2610.00554)
*Tao Liu,Ge He,Dongyu Liang,Wujie Wen*

Main category: cs.LG

TL;DR: 本文评估量子-经典混合机器学习在脑形变场降阶预测中的表现，发现经典网络（POD-MLP、POD-LSTM）在精度与稳定性上均优于量子及混合模型，但增强型VQC较最小VQC显著提升表达能力。


<details>
  <summary>Details</summary>
Motivation: 高维时空位移场的直接预测计算代价过高，且当前量子机器学习（QML）缺乏严谨、可复现的评测基准，需借助降阶物理场建模为其提供合适的测试平台。

Method: 采用本征正交分解（POD）将高维位移场投影至紧凑潜空间；构造两类学习目标——静态时间到潜变量回归与自回归潜状态预测；系统对比紧凑经典基线（POD-MLP、POD-LSTM）与最小及增强型混合量子架构（VQC、QLSTM），并在不同历史窗口与随机初始化下进行基准测试。

Result: 静态回归中POD-MLP优于所有量子变体，但增强型VQC较大幅超越最小VQC基线；时序预测中POD-LSTM在不同历史窗口与随机初始化下，预测精度与统计稳健性均优于增强型QLSTM。

Conclusion: 降阶物理场学习可作为近期QML的严谨测试平台；混合增强虽能有效恢复弱量子电路的表达能力，但经典架构在保真度与稳定性方面仍具明确优势。

Abstract: We evaluate hybrid quantum-classical machine learning for the reduced-order prediction of spatiotemporal brain deformation fields. To mitigate the computational intractability of high-dimensional displacement fields, we employ Proper Orthogonal Decomposition (POD) to project the data into a compact latent space. Within this framework, we formulate two distinct learning objectives: static temporal-to-latent regression and autoregressive latent state forecasting. We systematically benchmark compact classical baselines against both minimal and enhanced hybrid quantum architectures. Our results demonstrate that classical networks provide the strongest baselines in the present setting. For static regression, a classical POD-MLP outperforms all evaluated quantum variants, although an enhanced Variational Quantum Circuit (VQC) substantially improves upon a minimal VQC baseline. For temporal forecasting, a classical POD-LSTM delivers superior predictive accuracy and statistical robustness compared to an enhanced Quantum LSTM (QLSTM) across varying history windows and random initializations. Overall, this study establishes reduced-order physical field learning as a rigorous testbed for near-term QML, highlighting that while hybrid enhancements successfully recover expressivity in weak quantum circuits, classical architectures retain a definitive advantage in both fidelity and stability.

</details>


### [460] [Redundancy Meets Synergy: Dependency-aware Expert Selection for MoE via Submodular Optimization](https://arxiv.org/abs/2610.00558)
*Zheng Lin,Shaoke Fang,Yuxin Zhang,Jinfeng Xu,Zihan Fang,Zhe Chen,Wei Ni,Jun Luo,Symeon Chatzinotas*

Main category: cs.LG

TL;DR: DS-MoE 提出以差子模（DS）优化重构 MoE 专家选择问题，显式建模专家间的冗余与协同，并用具单调性保证的 MM 算法求解，性能优于现有基线。


<details>
  <summary>Details</summary>
Motivation: MoE 通过稀疏激活扩展容量，但内存开销大，部署受限；提取紧凑专家子集是可行方案，但现有启发式依赖 Top-k 排序，孤立评估单个专家，忽略了门控网络引入的专家间依赖关系。

Method: 提出 DS-MoE 框架：通过分析损失退化的二阶 Taylor 展开，揭示专家组合中的功能二元性——冗余（表示重叠）与协同（互补误差抵消）；将选择目标建模为差子模（DS）函数，从数学上解耦冗余削减与协同最大化；设计定制的 majorization-minimization（MM）算法，具备可证明的单调性保证，高效求解最优专家子集。

Result: 大量实验表明，DS-MoE 能有效保留不可或缺的专家组合，性能优于当前最优基线。

Conclusion: 专家选择不应基于孤立排序，而应建模专家间冗余与协同的耦合关系；DS 优化与 MM 求解为 MoE 压缩提供了理论可行且经验有效的方案。

Abstract: While Mixture-of-Experts (MoE) models effectively scale model capacity through sparse activation, their deployment is often bottlenecked by prohibitive memory requirements. Extracting a compact subset of experts presents a promising solution. However, existing expert selection heuristics predominantly rely on Top-k ranking, which isolates the evaluation of individual experts and ignores the intricate inter-expert dependencies introduced by the MoE gating network. In this paper, we propose DS-MoE, a theoretically grounded framework that redefines expert selection via difference-of-submodular (DS) optimization. By analyzing the second-order Taylor expansion of the loss degradation, we reveal functional duality within expert combinations: redundancy (where experts encode overlapping representations) and synergy (where experts provide complementary error cancellation). To navigate this duality, we mathematically decouple redundancy reduction from synergy maximization by formulating the selection objective as a DS function. Furthermore, we devise a tailored majorization-minimization (MM) algorithm with provable monotonicity guarantees to efficiently identify the optimal expert subset. Extensive experiments demonstrate that DS-MoE effectively preserves indispensable expert combinations, achieving superior performance compared to the state-of-the-art baselines.

</details>


### [461] [Beyond Affine Transformations: A Soft Dominance Layer for Coordinate-Wise Neural Computation](https://arxiv.org/abs/2610.00563)
*Mariano Rivera*

Main category: cs.LG

TL;DR: 本文提出一种可替代仿射变换的"软支配层"（Soft Dominance Layer），在MNIST单次运行实验中最高达0.9173（含退火），低于MLP基线的0.9827，定位为概念验证而非替代方案。


<details>
  <summary>Details</summary>
Motivation: 探索仿射变换之外的新型神经网络层基元，检验该基元的可训练性及其直接阈值解释能力，而非宣称替代仿射层。

Method: Soft Dominance Layer中，每个输出单元将输入坐标与可学习参考向量比较，聚合成平滑不等式响应；用sigmoid松弛保证可微，锐度参数α控制向硬阈值决策的过渡。

Result: 单次运行MNIST实验：无退火最高准确率0.9061，含退火0.9173，MLP基线0.9827。学习到的参考向量呈现空间结构，提供结构化学习的定性证据。结果仅为描述性，未确立可靠的配置排序或统计上支持的退火增益。

Conclusion: 该工作为初步的概念验证；需重复随机种子实验与更广泛数据集来评估鲁棒性和实用价值。

Abstract: This paper presents a preliminary study of an alternative to the affine transformation underlying conventional neural-network layers. In the proposed Soft Dominance Layer, each output unit compares input coordinates with a learnable reference vector and aggregates smooth inequality responses. A sigmoid relaxation makes the comparisons differentiable, while a sharpness parameter $α$ controls their transition toward hard threshold decisions. The aim is to examine the trainability and direct threshold interpretation of this primitive, not to claim a replacement for affine layers. In single-run MNIST experiments, the highest observed Soft Dominance accuracy is $0.9061$ without annealing and $0.9173$ with annealing, compared with $0.9827$ for the MLP baseline. These descriptive results do not establish reliable configuration rankings or a statistically supported annealing benefit. Learned reference vectors exhibit spatial structure, providing qualitative evidence of structured learning. Repeated-seed experiments and broader datasets are required to assess robustness and practical relevance beyond this proof of concept.

</details>


### [462] [Attention Kernels for Learning Maps Between Heavy-Tailed Measures](https://arxiv.org/abs/2610.00564)
*Kailen Hargenrader,Edoardo Calvello,Bohan Chen*

Main category: cs.LG

TL;DR: 该论文研究概率测度上的算子学习，指出softmax的指数权重在重尾测度下会导致测度级注意力积分发散，因此用增长更慢的核替代指数函数，并构建基准验证其效果。


<details>
  <summary>Details</summary>
Motivation: 在概率测度上进行算子学习可用transformer完成，但对于具有多项式尾部的测度，softmax中的指数加权会使测度级注意力积分发散，因此需要以增长更慢的函数替代指数。

Method: 构建两个具有闭式目标的测度算子学习基准，用于研究post-norm transformer中的注意力核增长与数据变换，并比较softmax与三种增长更慢的核；考察sample size对经验能量与Wasserstein距离对尾部差异敏感性的影响。

Result: 无数据变换时，softmax模型在两个重尾基准上出现ensemble collapse，而三种慢增长核避免崩溃；Symlog预处理使softmax在矩阵求逆任务上避免崩溃，但在sheared swap任务上不能；高斯控制下四种核表现相近。

Conclusion: 这些结果支持将增长更慢的注意力核作为post-norm transformer从重尾集成中学习的有效设计选择。

Abstract: Operator learning on probability measures can be accomplished with transformers. For measures with polynomial tails, the exponential weighting in softmax can make the corresponding measure-level attention integrals diverge. This motivates replacing the exponential with slower-growing functions. We construct two benchmarks for operator learning on measures with closed-form targets. We use these benchmarks to study attention kernel growth and data transformation in post-norm transformers. Without data transformation, the softmax models exhibit ensemble collapse on both heavy-tailed benchmarks, while the three slower-growing kernels avoid collapse. Symlog preprocessing allows softmax to avoid collapse on the matrix inverse task but not on the sheared swap task. On the Gaussian control, all four kernels perform similarly. We also examine how sample size affects the sensitivity of empirical energy and Wasserstein distances to tail differences. These results support slower-growing attention kernels as an effective design choice for post-norm transformers learning from heavy-tailed ensembles.

</details>


### [463] [From Task Mixtures to Specialized Experts](https://arxiv.org/abs/2610.00580)
*Hojat Allah Salehi,Mehrdad Mahdavi,Andrew Arash Mahyari,M. Hadi Amini*

Main category: cs.LG

TL;DR: 该论文研究联邦基础模型微调中的"复合异质性"（跨客户端与客户端内部同时异质），提出FedSEE方法，通过输入路由至任务专家来避免负迁移并提升性能。


<details>
  <summary>Details</summary>
Motivation: 传统联邦学习主要处理客户端之间的异质性，而未显式解决每个客户端内部潜在的任务混合问题。实际场景中客户端数据常为多种不同数据分布或任务的未知混合，构成"复合异质性"（跨客户端与客户端内部均异质），这是一个未被充分研究的设定。

Method: 论文在共享冻结表征上进行适配研究。理论分析表明：当任务共享相同特征几何时，平方损失下客户端任务混合的最优模型是各底层任务最优模型的凸组合；当任务最优解构成单纯形时，任务对齐路由的风险低于任何单一适配模型。基于此，利用少量任务标注的公开样本，推导出凸规划以恢复任务专家并匹配对应任务。据此提出FedSEE方法，实现输入依赖的专家选择，与各客户端任务混合对齐。

Result: 实验显示FedSEE避免了所评估基线中观察到的负迁移，整体性能提升2.9个百分点，对服务最差四分之一群体的性能提升3.7个百分点。

Conclusion: 复合异质性下的有效专业化需要与客户端任务混合对齐的输入依赖专家选择；FedSEE通过凸规划恢复任务专家并进行任务对齐路由，在避免负迁移和提升最差群体性能方面有效。

Abstract: In collaborative foundation model fine-tuning, client data is rarely homogeneous. Instead, clients typically possess unknown mixtures of distinct data distributions, or tasks. Conventional federated learning primarily addresses heterogeneity across clients without explicitly resolving latent task mixtures within each client. We study this setting as compound heterogeneity, where data is heterogeneous both across and within clients. We study adaptation over a common frozen representation and show that, when tasks share the same feature geometry, the optimal model for a client's task mixture under squared loss is a convex combination of the optimal models for its underlying tasks. Thus, a single locally trained model represents the client's overall task mixture, while individual inputs may be drawn from different underlying task distributions. This motivates routing inputs to specialized experts, and we show that, when the task optima form a simplex, task-aligned routing achieves lower risk than any single adapted model for genuinely mixed clients. With access to a small set of task-labeled public samples, we derive a convex program to recover task experts and match them to their corresponding tasks. Our routing analysis shows that effective specialization requires input-dependent expert selection aligned with each client's task mixture. Motivated by this analysis, we propose FedSEE. Across our experiments, FedSEE avoids the negative transfer observed in the evaluated baselines and improves performance by 2.9 points overall and 3.7 points for the worst-served quartile.

</details>


### [464] [ALER: Adaptive Learnable Experience Rewriting for Reinforcement Learning](https://arxiv.org/abs/2610.00592)
*Oleg Shchendrigin,Egor Cherepanov,Aleksandr I. Panov,Alexey K. Kovalev*

Main category: cs.LG

TL;DR: 该文提出经验改写与经验融合两类记忆更新需求，并设计ALER智能体（LSTM+槽记忆+独立寻址Gumbel-Softmax写入+学习门融合）及Rune-Mazes基准，在多项任务上超越七个基线。


<details>
  <summary>Details</summary>
Motivation: 现有RL记忆架构与基准多只测试"保持"能力，即信息在需要前保持不变，但实际部分可观测环境中，后续观测可能使已存信息过时或改变其含义，缺乏对改写与经验融合的系统形式化与评测。

Method: 形式化两项额外需求：改写（将决策相关内容设为与旧值无关的值）与经验融合（按后续观测指定的规则变换旧内容）；以所需记忆状态数刻画任务。提出ALER，将LSTM与槽记忆配对，使用独立寻址的Gumbel-Softmax写入将权重集中于单槽以覆盖该槽，并用学习门在策略与价值头之前融合检索内容与循环状态。构建Rune-Mazes三个环境（向量与像素观测下的符文反转、取消、重置、重复更新隐藏线索）。

Result: 对比七个基线：ALER在全部16种Endless T-Maze配置上成功率≥0.82，在全部5种Rune T-Maze组合上≥0.99；在含Invert符文的四分支Rune Multi-Corridor上平均成功率最高；在像素Rune MiniGrid Memory的10种配置中有8种平均成功率高于PPO-LSTM。多个基线在需要更多记忆状态的组合上成功率最低。

Conclusion: 记忆不仅需保持信息，还需改写与融合；ALER通过槽记忆的精确覆盖写入与门控融合有效满足这些需求，Rune-Mazes为相关评测提供了可控基准。

Abstract: In partially observable reinforcement learning (RL), a later observation can make stored information obsolete or change what it implies for the next decision. Memory architectures and benchmarks for RL mostly test retention, the ability to keep information unchanged until it is needed. We formalize two further requirements. Rewriting sets the decision-relevant content to a value independent of the old one, and experience fusion transforms the old content by a rule that a later observation specifies. For tasks built from such updates, we count the memory states that a solution needs, and several baselines reach their lowest success rates on compositions that need more states. We introduce ALER (Adaptive Learnable Experience Rewriting), an agent that pairs an LSTM with a slot memory. An independently addressed Gumbel-Softmax write that concentrates its weight on one slot overwrites that slot, and a learned gate fuses the retrieved content with the recurrent state before the policy and value heads. We also introduce Rune-Mazes, three environments in which rune observations invert, cancel, reset, or repeat updates of a hidden cue under vector and pixel observations. Against seven baselines, ALER reaches a success rate of at least $0.82$ in all sixteen Endless T-Maze configurations and at least $0.99$ on all five Rune T-Maze compositions, and it has the highest mean success rate on four-branch Rune Multi-Corridor with an Invert rune. On pixel-based Rune MiniGrid Memory, it has a higher mean success rate than PPO-LSTM in eight of ten configurations. Project page: https://quartz-admirer.github.io/ALER-Adaptive-Learnable-Experience-Rewriting/.

</details>


### [465] [Learning the identity: a case study of how SGD selects among functional decompositions](https://arxiv.org/abs/2610.00615)
*Andy Arditi,Weian Xie,David Bau,Liu Ziyin*

Main category: cs.LG

TL;DR: 深度线性残差网络学习恒等函数时,总体损失在整个极小值流形上恒定,但SGD可复现地偏好其中特定解;该现象可由"熵损失"视角解释——在总体损失上加入与minibatch梯度期望平方范数成正比的项,其最小化者可解析刻画,并能预测SGD偏好解的结构。


<details>
  <summary>Details</summary>
Motivation: 直觉上,深度线性残差网络学习恒等函数很简单:残差连接本身已实现恒等,网络只需把权重驱为零。但这个零权重解只是整个总体损失极小值流形上的一个点,对应恒等在不同层间的不同分解。总体损失无法区分这些解,然而SGD却可复现地偏好其中某些解(如各向异性标签噪声下学到与噪声相关的谱,即使有weight decay也不一定收敛到零权重解)。仅改变参数化(将权重矩阵分解为两矩阵乘积)就导致权重坍缩为零。作者希望解释这一看似神秘的现象。

Method: 采用"熵损失"视角,在总体损失上增加一项与minibatch梯度期望平方范数成正比的项(Ziyin et al., 2025)。在恒等流形上总体损失为常数,而熵项可区分不同分解。作者解析刻画了熵损失的最小化者,并据此推导SGD偏好解结构的预测,再与SGD训练结果对比验证。

Result: 熵损失的最小化者可解析刻画;由其导出的关于SGD偏好解结构的预测与SGD实际训练结果高度吻合。在恒等流形上总体损失为常数,而熵项区分不同分解,从而解释了SGD在参数化改变时的不同行为(如矩阵分解导致权重坍缩为零)。

Conclusion: 恒等函数学习任务是一个干净、简单的案例,说明"熵损失"视角如何澄清SGD为何偏好同一输入-输出函数的不同分解。该框架为理解SGD的隐式偏好提供了可分析的机制。

Abstract: One might think that learning the identity function with a deep linear residual network is trivial - the path along residual connections already implements the identity, and so the network need only drive its weights to zero. However, this zero-weight solution is just one point on an entire manifold of population-loss minimizers, each corresponding to a different decomposition of the identity across the network's layers. Although the population loss does not distinguish among these solutions, stochastic gradient descent (SGD) reproducibly favors particular ones. For instance, under anisotropic label noise, the learned layers exhibit a noise-dependent spectrum; even with weight decay, SGD does not generally recover the zero-weight solution. Changing only the parametrization, while leaving the set of realizable functions unchanged, yields different behavior: factoring each weight matrix as a product of two matrices causes the weights to collapse to zero, even without explicit weight decay.
  While perhaps mysterious and unintuitive at first, these phenomena can be understood through the lens of entropic loss, which augments the population loss with a term proportional to the expected squared norm of the minibatch gradient (Ziyin et al., 2025). On the identity manifold, the population loss is constant, while the entropic term distinguishes among these decompositions. We characterize its minimizers analytically and use them to derive predictions for the structure of solutions favored by SGD. Networks trained with SGD closely match these predictions.
  Overall, the identity learning task studied here serves as a clean and simple case study of how the lens of entropic loss can clarify why SGD favors particular decompositions of the same input-output function.

</details>


### [466] [Misalignment of Low-Loss Regions Causes Grokking](https://arxiv.org/abs/2610.00620)
*Yongding Tian,Zaid Al-Ars,Maksim Kitsak,Peter Hofstee*

Main category: cs.LG

TL;DR: 本文提出基于模式连通性与低损失区域几何的分析框架，预测并验证了模算术任务中存在的稳定"反grokking"反例，指出grokking源于训练集与验证集诱导的低损失区域未对齐。


<details>
  <summary>Details</summary>
Motivation: grokking现象（模型先过拟合训练集、随后验证集泛化突然提升）的底层机制尚无定论，且现有解释多为相关性层面，缺乏统一机理框架，甚至默认该现象必然出现。

Method: 构建结合模式连通性（mode connectivity）与低损失区域几何的分析框架，并设计保持对称性的训练/验证集划分，在标准模算术设定下进行实验检验。

Result: 在对称保持的划分下观察到稳定的反grokking案例——验证性能始终不恢复，构成对现有多种grokking相关性解释的反例；同时发现当训练与验证的低损失区域良好对齐时，仅靠超参数无法产生grokking，动力学退化为可训练或不可训练两类行为。

Conclusion: grokking的产生条件是训练分区与验证分区所诱导的低损失区域相互错位；区域对齐后该现象消失，说明grokking是几何对齐问题的产物，而非单纯由超参数或数据集特性决定。

Abstract: Grokking refers to the delayed emergence of validation-set generalization after a model has already overfit the training set. Although first observed in small algorithmic tasks trained with transformers, its underlying mechanism remains unsettled. In this work, we develop an analysis framework based on mode connectivity and the geometry of low-loss regions. The framework predicts that the standard modular-arithmetic setting does not always produce grokking: under a symmetry-preserving train/validation split, we observe a stable anti-grokking case in which validation performance does not recover. This counterexample challenges several existing correlational explanations of grokking. More broadly, our analysis framework and results further suggest that grokking arises when the low-loss regions induced by the training and validation partitions are misaligned. Once these regions become well aligned, training hyperparameters alone cannot produce grokking and the observed dynamics collapse to either trainable or non-trainable behavior.

</details>


### [467] [Learning Linear Systems under Heavy-Tailed Noise: A Non-Asymptotic Analysis from A Single Trajectory](https://arxiv.org/abs/2610.00637)
*Xiaomian Yang,Sungho Shin*

Main category: cs.LG

TL;DR: 本文针对指数稳定向量自回归（VAR）模型，在重尾噪声下单条轨迹的最小二乘估计建立了非渐近样本复杂度界，并给出统一分析框架。


<details>
  <summary>Details</summary>
Motivation: 重尾噪声下VAR模型的最小二乘估计缺乏非渐近样本复杂度分析，现有结果多依赖轻尾假设或多条独立轨迹。

Method: 假设独立同分布噪声、有界噪声协方差与持续激励条件，基于单条观测轨迹，在有界p阶矩（p>2）下推导最小二乘估计误差界；提出适用于广泛噪声分布的统一样本复杂度分析方法，并推广至次指数与次高斯噪声；进一步专门化到带外生输入的AR模型（ARX）。

Result: 估计误差为$\widetilde{\mathcal{O}}(r^{1/2}T^{-1/2+1/p})$，其中T为样本数，r为噪声维数，$\widetilde{\mathcal{O}}(\cdot)$隐藏对数项；并给出次指数、次高斯噪声分布下的误差界；对ARX模型，误差界的维数因子与模型阶数无关。

Conclusion: 该工作为重尾噪声下VAR/ARX模型的最小二乘估计提供了非渐近样本复杂度理论，统一框架可扩展至多类噪声分布，且ARX情形下误差界不依赖模型阶数。

Abstract: We establish non-asymptotic sample complexity bounds for the least-squares estimation of vector autoregressive models for exponentially stable systems with heavy-tailed noise based on a single observed trajectory. By assuming i.i.d. noise, bounded noise covariance, and persistent excitation, we show that the estimation error is $\widetilde{\mathcal{O}}(r^{1/2}T^{-1/2+1/p})$ under bounded $p$th moment for $p > 2$, where $T$ is the number of samples, $r$ is the noise dimension, and $\widetilde{\mathcal{O}}(\cdot)$ hides logarithmic terms. We also introduce a unifying approach to sample complexity analysis applicable to broad classes of noise distributions and showcase this by deriving error bounds for sub-exponential and sub-Gaussian noise distributions. Finally, we specialize our analysis to autoregressive models with exogenous inputs and show that the dimension factor of the error bound is independent of the model order.

</details>


### [468] [Group-Invariant Statistics Determine Embedding Geometry: Harmonic Analysis of Representations from Bach to the Night Sky](https://arxiv.org/abs/2610.00647)
*Liam Storan,Andreas Tolias,Nina Miolane*

Main category: cs.LG

TL;DR: 本文将词嵌入几何结构推广到任意群对称性下：若词族共现统计在群G下不变，则嵌入为G不可约表示的矩阵元；圆环与"品客"结构对应循环群（傅里叶模式），并在月份、和弦、天体三个实验中得到验证。


<details>
  <summary>Details</summary>
Motivation: 此前工作将月份、星期、地点等概念嵌入中观察到的圆环和鞍形"品客"流形溯源到词共现统计的平移对称性，但仅限阿贝尔格点上的距离依赖情形。作者希望证明更一般的对称性（任意有限群、紧群、齐性空间）同样能产生结构化的嵌入预测，从而揭示学习表征几何源于数据统计对称性这一普遍规律。

Method: 理论方面：考虑由任意有限群、紧群及齐性空间定义的对称性，证明当某词族的共现统计在群G作用下不变时，所学词嵌入由G的不可约表示（irreps）的矩阵元构成；当G为循环群时不可约表示即傅里叶模式，对应圆环与品客结构。实验方面：(i) 循环群Z12，对一年12个月恢复已知环形几何；(ii) 作用于大三和弦与小三和弦的二面体群，统一音乐理论中移调与和弦转位构成的T/I群与机器学习中"五度圈"现象；(iii) 将LLM中天体对象的球面表示解释并复现为由该理论导出的球谐嵌入。

Result: 理论证明在群不变共现统计下，词嵌入呈现不可约表示矩阵元结构，循环群情形退化为傅里叶模式即圆环/品客几何。实验验证：(i) Z12下成功恢复月份的环形几何；(ii) 二面体群统一了音乐理论的T/I群与机器学习的五度圈，证明后者是前者的蕴含结果；(iii) 解释并复现了LLM中天体的球面表示，其源于理论导出的球谐嵌入。

Conclusion: 学习到的表征几何往往是底层数据统计对称性的必然结果，而不仅是经验观察。该工作将平移对称性的解释框架扩展至任意群对称性，为理解词嵌入及其他学习表征的结构提供了统一的群表示论基础。

Abstract: The representations that language models learn for concepts such as months, weekdays, and places display consistent geometric structure: circles and saddle-shaped "Pringle" manifolds. Recent work traced these structures to $\textit{translation symmetry}$ in word co-occurrence statistics, deriving the observed Fourier geometry when co-occurrence depends only on distance on an abelian lattice of concepts. We demonstrate that more general notions of symmetry lead to equally structured predictions. Considering symmetries defined by arbitrary finite groups, compact groups, and homogeneous spaces, we prove that whenever the co-occurrence statistics of a word family are invariant under a group $G$, the learned word embeddings consist of matrix elements of the irreducible representations (irreps) of $G$. Circles and Pringles arise when $G$ is cyclic, in which case the irreps are Fourier modes. We verify the irrep structure in three experimental settings. (i) The cyclic group $\mathbb{Z}_{12}$: for the months of the year we recover the known circular geometry. (ii) A dihedral group acting on the major and minor triads: we unify two classical observations -- that transposition and chord inversion form a group ($T/I$) acting on chords (music theory), which $\textit{implies}$ that the well-known "circle of fifths" emerges in learned chord embeddings (machine learning). (iii) We explain and reproduce a recently discovered spherical representation of celestial objects in large language models (LLMs) as a spherical-harmonic embedding derived from our theory. Our results demonstrate that the geometry of learned representations is often a consequence of the statistical symmetry of underlying data.

</details>


### [469] [Exploring More, Reasoning Better: Stepwise Risk-Sensitive GRPO for Diffusion Language Models](https://arxiv.org/abs/2610.00661)
*Yue YU,Bowen Zuo,David Crandall,Yinglun Zhu,Dongruo Zhou*

Main category: cs.LG

TL;DR: 提出StepRS-GRPO，通过在去噪状态上变化优势变换的风险系数，提升扩散大语言模型在可验证奖励强化学习中的准确率、覆盖度与多样性。


<details>
  <summary>Details</summary>
Motivation: 扩散大语言模型通过去噪序列或连续块并行生成多个token，而RLVR将终端反馈复用于这些决策，但其条件上下文不断变化，导致同一反馈在不同去噪状态下被同等对待并不合理，需要按状态调整风险敏感度。

Method: StepRS-GRPO：在保留原有训练器的前提下，使组优势变换的风险系数随去噪状态变化。对二值奖励证明该变换等价于对中心化结果优势进行依赖提示与状态的重缩放；用基于能力的校准确定系数尺度，并通过端点与插值消融指导调度选择。

Result: 在多个dLLM骨干与数学推理基准上，StepRS-GRPO相比中心化GRPO同时提升pass@1准确率与pass@k覆盖度，并提高答案多样性。消融中，质量匹配对照支持状态分配与调度方向的贡献，且在将优势RMS匹配到中心化GRPO后增益依然存在。

Conclusion: StepRS-GRPO通过状态依赖的风险敏感优势变换改进dLLM的RLVR训练；推理轨迹诊断表明多样性增益不止于最终答案字符串。

Abstract: Diffusion large language models (dLLMs) generate text by denoising a sequence or successive blocks, allowing several tokens to be revealed in parallel. Reinforcement learning with verifiable rewards (RLVR) reuses terminal feedback across these decisions, even as their conditioning context changes. We propose stepwise risk-sensitive GRPO (StepRS-GRPO), which varies the risk coefficient of the group-advantage transformation across denoising states while retaining the underlying trainer. For binary rewards, we show that this transformation is exactly a prompt- and state-dependent rescaling of centered outcome advantages. A capability-based calibration suggests a coefficient scale, while endpoint and interpolation ablations guide schedule selection. Across multiple dLLM backbones and mathematical reasoning benchmarks, StepRS-GRPO improves both pass@1 accuracy and pass@k coverage over centered GRPO, while increasing answer diversity. In our ablation studies, mass-matched controls support the contributions of state allocation and schedule direction, and the gains persist after matching the root mean square (RMS) of the advantages to that of centered GRPO. Reasoning-trace diagnostics further show that the diversity gains from StepRS-GRPO extend beyond final-answer strings.

</details>


### [470] [Analysis of Quantized and Efficiently Adapted Protein Language Models](https://arxiv.org/abs/2610.00665)
*Ilan Yaniv Zeisler,Sebastian Clancy,Pouriya Bayat,Saaim Raad,Ivan Kraskov,Matthew Xie,Vivian White,Spencer Perkins,Serena Singh,Sepehr Bayat,Keith Pardee*

Main category: cs.LG

TL;DR: 4-bit量化与QLoRA在七类蛋白质语言模型上普遍可保留>90%的全量微调性能、节省近90%显存，但生成模型需补充token级分布分析。


<details>
  <summary>Details</summary>
Motivation: 蛋白质语言模型规模庞大，微调与部署成本高昂；量化与参数高效微调对性能、表征和生成的影响尚未被充分刻画。

Method: 在ESM-2、ESMC、ProtBERT、ProtT5、Ankh、Ankh3、Profluent-E1上进行4-bit量化与低秩适配微调（QLoRA）评测，覆盖蛋白质预测任务；对ProLLaMA、ProtGPT2、ProGen2、ProteinGLM、ESM3进行无条件生成的4-bit量化测试，并结合表征层分析与token级分布分析。

Result: 预测任务中多数模型-任务组合保留>90%全量微调性能，最大模型显存节省近90%，但性能与效率随模型、数据集和训练配置而异；QLoRA常保留浅层表征并在中后层形成任务特化适配，表征变化小于全量微调；训练速度与功耗影响差异较大。生成任务中4-bit量化基本保持结构与序列层面性质，但token级自回归输出分布出现模型依赖的偏移。

Conclusion: QLoRA与4-bit量化可显著降低PLM计算需求（尤其是显存），建议将QLoRA作为显存受限场景的首选适配策略，仅在困难任务、不稳定架构或验证恢复不足时使用全量微调；生成模型评测应以分布分析补充序列与结构指标，并需按模型与任务分别验证。

Abstract: Background: Protein language models (PLMs) are increasingly used for sequence generation and property prediction, but their size makes fine-tuning and deployment expensive. The effects of quantization and parameter efficient fine-tuning on performance, representations and generation remain insufficiently characterized. Results: We evaluated 4-bit quantization and low-rank adapter fine-tuning (QLoRA) across ESM-2, ESMC, ProtBERT, ProtT5, Ankh, Ankh3 and Profluent-E1. Across protein prediction tasks, many model-task pairs retained more than 90% of full fine-tuning performance. Peak GPU memory savings approached 90% for the largest models, although performance and efficiency varied by model, dataset and training configuration. QLoRA often preserved early-layer representations while inducing task-specific adaptations in middle and late layers, resembling full fine-tuning with smaller representational changes. Training speed and power effects were more varied. For unconditional generation with ProLLaMA, ProtGPT2, ProGen2, ProteinGLM and ESM3, 4-bit quantization largely preserved predicted structural and sequence-level properties, but token-level analysis revealed model-dependent shifts in autoregressive output distributions. Conclusion: QLoRA and 4-bit quantization reduce PLM computational requirements, particularly GPU memory usage. Our results support QLoRA as a first-pass strategy for memory limited adaptation, reserving full fine-tuning for challenging tasks, unstable architectures or low validation recovery. For generative PLMs, sequence-level and structural metrics should be complemented with distributional analysis, since downstream predictions alone may miss quantization-induced shifts. These approaches can broaden access to large-scale protein modelling while requiring model- and task-specific validation.

</details>


### [471] [ORBIT-FMIB: Tracking Order-Resolved Epistatic Information Through ESM-2](https://arxiv.org/abs/2610.00672)
*Maryam Rahimimovassagh,Ivan Garibay,Niloofar Yousefi*

Main category: cs.LG

TL;DR: 本文提出ORBIT-FMIB诊断框架，结合Walsh交互分解与子集条件神经依赖估计，探究ESM-2表征中高阶上位性信息是否与低阶信息同等保留。初次测量显示高阶保留较弱，但独立重复实验使该差异大幅缩小且符号不稳定，故无稳健证据支持选择性丢失高阶信息的结论。


<details>
  <summary>Details</summary>
Motivation: 蛋白质基础模型虽能支持突变效应与结构预测，但预测性能本身无法揭示模型不同深度表征中保留何种形式的生物交互信息。作者希望探究ESM-2在其表征层级中是否像保留一阶、二阶信息那样强地保留高阶上位性信息。

Method: 提出ORBIT-FMIB诊断框架，将基于Walsh的交互分解与子集条件的神经依赖估计相结合；先在具有已知交互结构的合成适应度景观上验证方法，再将其应用于稠密的四位点GB1适应度景观，使用冻结的ESM-2表征。通过完整测量网格的独立重复（匹配GPU硬件与相同critic随机种子）及不同评估配对选择进行稳健性检验。

Result: 初次生产运行显示ESM-2对高阶上位性信息的保留弱于低阶信息（Δ_HO-LO=-0.107）；在匹配硬件与相同critic种子的完整测量网格独立重复中，该差异显著缩小（Δ_HO-LO=-0.017），且其符号在针对同一训练critic的不同合理评估配对选择下不稳定（-0.011至+0.015）。

Conclusion: 目前没有稳健证据表明ESM-2选择性地丢失高阶上位性信息，也不能证明各阶保留程度相等，方向性问题仍悬而未决。测量协议本身（包括记录在案的去除池化critic中位置子集捷径）仍经验证且不受此结果影响。ORBIT-FMIB可作为探测蛋白质基础模型交互结构的诊断框架；本研究的重复结果说明，此类探测在被当作生物学发现前需要充分把握度的可重复性检验。

Abstract: Protein foundation models support mutation-effect and structural prediction, but predictive performance alone does not reveal which forms of biological interaction information remain accessible through model depth. We ask whether ESM-2 retains higher-order epistatic information as strongly as first- and second-order information across its representation hierarchy, introducing ORBIT-FMIB, a diagnostic framework combining Walsh-based interaction decomposition with subset-conditioned neural dependence estimation. The method is validated on synthetic landscapes with known interaction structure before being applied to the dense four-site GB1 fitness landscape using frozen ESM-2 representations.
  An initial production run suggested ESM-2 retains higher-order epistatic information less well than lower-order information ($Δ_{\mathrm{HO-LO}}=-0.107$). An independent replication of the complete measurement grid, under matched GPU hardware and identical critic seeds, substantially reduced this contrast ($Δ_{\mathrm{HO-LO}}=-0.017$), and its sign was unstable across otherwise-defensible evaluation-pairing choices applied to the same trained critics ($-0.011$ to $+0.015$). We therefore do not currently have robust evidence that ESM-2 selectively loses higher-order epistatic information, nor that retention is equal across orders; the directional question remains open. The measurement protocol itself, including its documented removal of a positional-subset shortcut in pooled critics, remains validated and is unaffected by this finding. ORBIT-FMIB is offered as a diagnostic framework for probing interaction structure in protein foundation models; this study's own replication result illustrates why such probing requires adequately-powered reproducibility checks before its output is treated as a biological finding.

</details>


### [472] [LabBook: Harnessing Experimental History for Efficient LLM-Driven Discovery](https://arxiv.org/abs/2610.00675)
*Bo Yuan,Wenqian Ye,Zelin Zhao,Lama Moukheiber,Henry Kautz,Aidong Zhang,Yongxin Chen*

Main category: cs.LG

TL;DR: 提出单智能体发现框架 LabBook，将"完整实验日志保留"与"选择性上下文构建"分离，通过智能体维护的记忆指导检索与生成。


<details>
  <summary>Details</summary>
Motivation: 进化式 LLM 发现方法通常只从少量被选中的祖先程序生成新程序，上下文可控但会遗漏其他实验中的有用证据；若纳入全部实验历史，则上下文冗长且冗余。需要一种既能保留完整历史又能构建精简上下文的方法。

Method: 构建围绕 LabBook 的单智能体发现框架。LabBook 是由智能体自行维护的记忆，承担两个互补作用：从完整实验日志中引导相关证据检索；为生成新解提供信息。每次迭代中，同一智能体将记忆与检索到的证据结合，联合产出下一个程序与更新后的 LabBook。该方法无需显式种群或分支搜索结构。

Result: 在 49 个 Frontier-CS 问题上，LabBook 在两种骨干模型下相较所评估的进化基线改善了观测到的质量—成本权衡；在额外九个数学、系统与启发式设计任务上保持竞争力。

Conclusion: 以智能体维护的 LabBook 记忆为核心的单智能体框架，可在不依赖种群搜索的情况下兼顾完整历史保留与选择性上下文构建，并在多项任务上取得更优的质量—成本权衡。代码将开源。

Abstract: Evolutionary approaches to LLM-driven discovery often generate new programs from a small set of selected ancestors. This keeps contexts manageable but can omit useful evidence from other experiments, whereas including the full experimental history produces long, redundant contexts. We introduce a simple, single-agent discovery harness built around LabBook, an agent-maintained memory that serves two complementary roles: guiding retrieval of relevant evidence from a complete experimental log and informing the generation of new solutions. At each iteration, the same agent combines its memory with retrieved evidence and jointly produces the next program and an updated LabBook. This separates complete history retention from selective context construction, without requiring an explicit population or branching search structure. On 49 Frontier-CS problems, LabBook improves the observed quality-cost trade-off over the evaluated evolutionary baselines with two backbones, while remaining competitive across nine additional mathematical, systems, and heuristic-design tasks. Code will be released at https://github.com/BoYuanVisionary/LabBook.

</details>


### [473] [SkillSpec: Consensus-Gated Agent Skill Evolution via Representation Specialization](https://arxiv.org/abs/2610.00704)
*Huancheng Chen,Xiaodi Sun,Zhaoqiong Huang,Shenyang Huang Shreya Singhal,Jingwen Lu*

Main category: cs.LG

TL;DR: 本文提出 SkillSpec，一个通过"共识门控演化"与"表征特化"两阶段框架来优化 LLM 智能体自然语言技能的方法，在六个基准和三个模型上平均成功率较 SkillOpt 提升 6.89%。


<details>
  <summary>Details</summary>
Motivation: 现有方法将自然语言技能视为静态产物或整体式文档，仅用聚合验证分数作为反馈来优化文本内容，无法显式建模程序性知识的检索与执行结构。作者指出关键区别在于"保留哪些知识"与"如何组织知识"是两个互补问题，前者需通过执行证据验证，后者需依据程序性依赖和检索需求来构建结构。

Method: SkillSpec 为两阶段框架。第一阶段为共识门控演化：由互补的编辑意图生成完整候选技能，仅当配对评估达成共识时才提交更新，要求整体提升足够且每次重复评估的聚合配对增益均为非负。第二阶段为表征特化：基于完整优化轨迹（含被接受和被拒绝的候选）推导的过程敏感性与冗余敏感性信号，指导选择扁平、图或混合三种表征。

Result: 在六个基准和三个目标语言模型上，SkillSpec 的平均成功率较 SkillOpt 提升 6.89%（三个模型平均）。

Conclusion: 可靠的技能演化与表征特化解决的是互补目标：决定保留何种知识，以及如何为其推理组织结构。二者结合可有效提升 LLM 智能体的任务成功率。

Abstract: Natural-language skills are textual procedural memories through which large language model (LLM) agents retain reusable task knowledge without updating model weights. Existing methods typically treat skills as either static artifacts or monolithic documents optimized using aggregate validation scores as feedback. However, representing a skill as a monolithic document restricts optimization to its textual content, without explicitly modeling the structure through which procedural knowledge is retrieved and executed. We identify a key distinction between learning what knowledge to retain and determining how to organize it: textual updates should first be validated through execution evidence, after which the retained knowledge should be structured according to its procedural dependencies and retrieval requirements. To this end, we introduce SkillSpec, a two-phase framework comprising consensus-gated evolution and representation specialization. In the consensus-gated phase, complementary editing intents generate complete candidate skills. An update is committed only when paired evaluations reach consensus, requiring sufficient overall improvement and non-negative aggregate paired gain in every repeated evaluation. In the specialization phase, signals of process and redundancy sensitivity derived from the full optimization trajectory, including accepted and rejected candidates, guide the selection of a flat, graph, or hybrid representation.Across six benchmarks and three target language models, SkillSpec improves average success rate over SkillOpt by 6.89%, averaged across the three models. These results demonstrate that reliable skill evolution and representation specialization address complementary objectives: deciding what knowledge to retain and how to structure it for inference.

</details>


### [474] [Beyond Unimodal Bases: Pullback Geometry for Multimodal Data](https://arxiv.org/abs/2610.00708)
*Honglei Brinkmann,Lucas Ng,Georgios Batzolis,Mark Girolami,Carola-Bibiane Schönlieb,Willem Diepeveen*

Main category: cs.LG

TL;DR: 提出一种支持"流形混合"的拉回几何：以高斯混合潜分布定义黎曼度量（责任加权分量精度的矩阵平方），在单分量极限下退化为已有高斯构造，并通过实验验证其降低传输畸变、改善插值真实性与轨迹恢复。


<details>
  <summary>Details</summary>
Motivation: 现有可扩展拉回几何多采用单峰高斯潜分布，隐含假设数据位于单一流形附近。对多模态数据，将分离的模态或局部结构映射进同一高斯区域需要较大的传输形变，损害几何的统计意义与路径的高似然性。

Method: 使用潜高斯混合构建拉回度量，将度量定义为责任加权期望分量精度矩阵的矩阵平方。证明该度量光滑且正定，并在单分量极限下还原原高斯构造。针对结构化重叠混合，给出对数密度沿测地线凹性的条件，建立几何与穿越高似然区域路径的形式联系并推导局部曲率关系。将该几何实例化于带自适应混合学习的归一化流中，使活跃分量数由数据决定，并支持分量级重构与局部有效维数估计。

Result: 在合成几何数据、具有已知参考轨迹的受控多视角图像设定以及 MNIST 上实验，显示传输畸变降低、路径支持度具竞争力、参考轨迹恢复更接近，且插值真实性提升。

Conclusion: 该工作把可扩展拉回几何从"接近单一流形"的数据扩展到多流形混合支撑的数据，同时保持局部结构的可处理性与可解释性。

Abstract: Data-driven Riemannian geometry provides nonlinear interpolation and geometric representations of high-dimensional data. For these operations to be statistically meaningful, paths between observations should preferentially traverse high-likelihood regions. Existing scalable pullback constructions typically use a unimodal Gaussian latent distribution, assuming that the data reside close to a single manifold. For multimodal data, mapping separated modes or local structures into one Gaussian region can require substantial transport deformation and compromise the resulting geometry.
  We introduce a pullback geometry for data supported on mixtures of manifolds. Using a latent Gaussian mixture, we define its Riemannian metric as the matrix square of the responsibility-weighted expected component precision. The metric is smooth and positive definite and recovers the existing Gaussian construction in the single-component limit. For structured overlapping mixtures, we establish conditions under which the log-density is concave along geodesics, providing a formal connection between the proposed geometry and paths through high-likelihood regions, and derive the corresponding local curvature relations.
  We instantiate this geometry in a normalizing flow with adaptive mixture learning, allowing the number of active components to emerge from the data and supporting component-wise reconstruction and local effective-dimension estimation. Experiments on synthetic geometric data, a controlled multi-view image setting with a known reference trajectory, and MNIST show reduced transport distortion, competitive path support, close reference-trajectory recovery, and improved interpolation realism. These results extend scalable pullback geometry beyond datasets that reside close to a single manifold while retaining tractable and interpretable local structure.

</details>


### [475] [WOMBAT: Whitebox Oracle for Molecular Benchmarking and Attribution Testing](https://arxiv.org/abs/2610.00713)
*Dominik Matuszek,Bartosz Zieliński,Tomasz Danel,Dawid Rymarczyk*

Main category: cs.LG

TL;DR: WOMBAT是一个包含14个白盒GNN的基准，模型消息传递权重手工设定以检测特定SMARTS基序，从而提供归因真值，用于识别与量化GNN解释器的错误。


<details>
  <summary>Details</summary>
Motivation: 当GNN解释器对分子产生意外归因时，仅凭归因结果无法判断是解释器失败还是模型学到了捷径；现有评估缺乏构造上已知的决策规则作为归因真值。

Method: 构建14个白盒GNN，手工设定消息传递权重以检测特定SMARTS基序；在数百万PubChem分子上验证模型；评估GNNExplainer、PGExplainer、Integrated Gradients等事后解释器；基于定性分析构造一个使Integrated Gradients将归因扩散至全图、但仍能可靠检测目标基序的模型。

Result: 模型在数百万PubChem分子上得到验证；定性分析发现并复现了归因扩散失败模式，即模型决策正确但 Integrated Gradients 归因弥散于整个图。

Conclusion: WOMBAT通过构造性真值暴露并研究了GNN解释器的归因错误；公开发布数据集、模型与评估代码，以支持新型GNN可解释性工具的开发。

Abstract: When a graph neural network (GNN) explainer produces an unexpected attribution on a molecule, the attribution alone cannot reveal whether the explainer has failed or the model has learned a shortcut. We introduce WOMBAT, a benchmark of 14 whitebox GNNs, each with message-passing weights set by hand to detect a specific SMARTS motif. Each model's decision rule is known by construction, providing attribution ground truth against which explainer errors can be identified and studied. We validate the models on millions of PubChem molecules and evaluate post-hoc explainers including GNNExplainer, PGExplainer, and Integrated Gradients. Guided by our qualitative analysis, we construct a model that causes Integrated Gradients to spread attribution across the graph, even though the model reliably detects the intended motif. We release the dataset, models, and evaluation code to help researchers in the development of newer XAI tools for GNNs.

</details>


### [476] [JEPA-TTT: Persistent Test-Time Training of Latent World Models for Planning under Dynamics Shifts](https://arxiv.org/abs/2610.00722)
*Zheyuan Zhang,Suyu Ye,Nakul Agarwal,Hossein Nourkhiz Mahjoub,Ehsan Moradi Pari,Daniel Khashabi,Tianmin Shu,Vaishnav Tadiparthi*

Main category: cs.LG

TL;DR: JEPA-TTT 在测试阶段用自监督方式持续微调预训练世界模型的潜在动力学预测器，在动力学变化下显著降低预测误差并提升规划性能。


<details>
  <summary>Details</summary>
Motivation: 世界模型能通过预测未来状态支持智能体规划，但当测试时动力学与训练时不同，其预测会变得不可靠，因此需要一种在测试阶段适应变化动力学的方法。

Method: JEPA-TTT 基于预训练的动作条件联合嵌入预测架构（JEPA）世界模型，仅更新其潜在动力学预测器，视觉编码器与奖励头保持固定，从而保留预训练表示与任务目标；使用自监督更新并在多回合间累积，规划无需目标图像或在线环境奖励；同时采用密集回放，在每个时间偏移构造预测窗口，存入不断增长的缓冲区并从中采样小批量用于预测器更新。

Result: 在四个连续控制环境的八种动力学变化中，JEPA-TTT 在每种变化上都提升了规划；经过 500 个测试回合后，自回归潜在预测误差平均降低 83%，规划性能相对冻结的 JEPA 世界模型提升 153%。

Conclusion: 持续的自监督测试时训练能够使预训练的潜在世界模型在动力学改变时完成适应，表明测试时适应是提升世界模型鲁棒规划的有效途径。

Abstract: World models enable agents to plan by predicting future states of the environment, but their predictions can become unreliable when test-time dynamics differ from those seen during training. We present JEPA-TTT, which adapts the latent dynamics predictor of a pretrained action-conditioned Joint-Embedding Predictive Architecture world model throughout test time. Self-supervised updates accumulate across episodes, while the visual encoder and reward head remain fixed, preserving the pretrained representation and task objective. Planning requires neither a goal image nor online environment reward. JEPA-TTT uses dense replay, which forms prediction windows at every temporal offset, retains them in a growing buffer, and samples minibatches from that buffer for predictor updates. Across eight dynamics shifts in four continuous-control environments, JEPA-TTT improves planning on every shift. After 500 test-time episodes, it reduces autoregressive latent prediction error by 83% on average and improves planning performance by 153% over the frozen JEPA world model. These results show that persistent self-supervised test-time training can adapt a pretrained latent world model under changed dynamics.

</details>


### [477] [Benchmarking Generative Models for Weather Data Assimilation on Real Station Observations](https://arxiv.org/abs/2610.00728)
*Ruizhe Huang,Qidong Yang,Jonathan Giezendanner,Sherrie Wang*

Main category: cs.LG

TL;DR: 本文首次在真实气象站观测上对生成式天气数据同化进行受控基准测试，固定数据集、观测算子与网络架构，比较扩散/流匹配、像素/潜空间、多种条件策略及3D-Var基线。


<details>
  <summary>Details</summary>
Motivation: 天气再分析依赖昂贵的数值天气预报与数据同化。深度生成模型可把成本从推理转移到离线训练，但既有生成式方法多在合成观测或不同数据集与评估方案下评测，难以判断哪些设计选择真正提升真实数据同化性能。

Method: 使用美国本土11,849个NOAA MADIS站点、四个气象变量，在固定数据集、观测算子与深度学习架构的前提下评测：扩散 vs 流匹配、像素空间 vs 潜空间、多种推理时条件策略，并与经典3D-Var基线对比；同时评估稠密与稀疏站点设置。

Result: 三点结论：（1）学习到的生成先验优于3D-Var的高斯先验，相对ERA5的RMSE降低35.7% vs 33.3%，且推理时不使用ERA5背景场；（2）全梯度引导一致优于停止梯度与初始噪声优化；（3）其他选择收益甚微——扩散与流匹配在匹配条件下几乎相同，潜空间变量混合无帮助。稀疏站点下生成式AI与全梯度引导的优势更明显。

Conclusion: 明确了生成式天气数据同化中真正提升真实站点观测性能的组件，并建立了标准化基准，为后续研究提供可复现的评测框架。

Abstract: Weather reanalysis products rely on computationally intensive numerical weather predictions followed by data assimilation that corrects the forecast toward observations. Deep generative models offer a cheaper alternative that shifts much of this cost from inference to offline training. However, existing generative approaches have been evaluated on synthetic observations or under different datasets and evaluation schemes, making it unclear which design choices actually improve real-world data assimilation. We present the first controlled benchmark of generative weather data assimilation on real weather station observations. Using 11,849 NOAA MADIS stations across the contiguous United States and four weather variables, we evaluate methods while holding the dataset, observation operator, and deep learning architecture fixed. The benchmark compares the major design choices, including diffusion versus flow matching, pixel versus latent-space formulations, and multiple inference-time conditioning strategies, against a classical 3D-Var baseline. The benchmark reveals three clear conclusions. First, learned generative priors outperform the Gaussian prior of 3D-Var (35.7% vs. 33.3% RMSE reduction over ERA5) despite using no ERA5 background field at inference. Second, full-gradient guidance consistently outperforms stop-gradient and initial-noise optimization. Third, other choices provide little measurable benefit: diffusion and flow matching perform nearly identically under matched conditions, and latent-space variable mixing does not help. We further evaluate both dense and sparse station settings and find advantages from generative AI and full-gradient guidance more pronounced under sparsity. Together, these results identify which components of generative weather data assimilation improve performance on real station observations and establish a standardized benchmark for future work.

</details>


### [478] [Reformulation-Contrastive Learning for Mixed Integer Programs](https://arxiv.org/abs/2610.00730)
*Ousema Bouaneni,Mathis Le Bail,Clément Elliker,Maël Jenny,Sonia Vanier*

Main category: cs.LG

TL;DR: 本文提出 ReMILP，一种基于重构对比的混合整数线性规划（MILP）表示学习方法，利用等价重构作为自监督信号，联合训练图神经网络与超网络以学习变量与约束的通用表示。


<details>
  <summary>Details</summary>
Motivation: MILP 广泛用于建模现实决策问题，但求解开销大。同一 MILP 存在多种等价重构（变量替换、冗余约束添加），这些重构保持优化问题不变却改变具体形式，可作为自监督来源以学习通用表示，从而加速求解。

Method: 作者刻画对所有输入实例均有效的仿射重构，并区分不改变变量的"重述"与可预测变换变量的"替换"。基于等变自监督学习，提出 ReMILP：联合训练图神经网络与超网络，预测变量嵌入在变量替换下的变换方式。

Result: 在无求解器标签的条件下，ReMILP 学到的表示在未见问题类别上展现出预期的不变性与等变性；在二元解、约束活跃度与整数间隙预测任务中，冻结表示即可携带任务相关信息，并可作为微调的有用初始化。

Conclusion: 等价重构可作为有效的自监督信号，ReMILP 无需求解器标签即可学习通用且可迁移的 MILP 表示，为加速 MILP 求解的机器学习方法提供了新思路。

Abstract: Mixed-integer linear programs (MILP) model many real-world decision problems, motivating machine-learning methods that exploit recurring structure to accelerate MILP solving. MILPs can admit many equivalent formulations: integrality-preserving changes of variables and the addition of redundant constraints can alter their formulations while preserving the optimization problem. We leverage these reformulations as a source of self-supervision for learning general-purpose representations of MILP variables and constraints. We characterize the affine reformulations that are valid for every input instance, and distinguish re-descriptions, which leave variables unchanged, from substitutions, which transform them predictably. Building on equivariant self-supervised learning, we introduce ReMILP (reformulation-contrastive MILP representation learning), which jointly trains a graph neural network and a hypernetwork to predict how variable embeddings transform under changes of variables. Without solver-derived labels, ReMILP learns representations that exhibit the intended invariance and equivariance on unseen problem classes. Across binary solution, constraint activity and integrality gap prediction, these representations carry task-relevant information when frozen and provide a useful initialization for fine-tuning.

</details>


### [479] [Localizing Transfer Between Memorization Tasks](https://arxiv.org/abs/2610.00771)
*Yimiao Yu,Florentin Guth*

Main category: cs.LG

TL;DR: 本文研究随机输入-输出映射的记忆任务间的迁移学习，发现两种反直觉的迁移模式：等价迁移（每个预训练epoch约节省一个下游微调epoch）和非等价迁移（不匹配任务的预训练甚至比直接训练下游任务更高效），并将迁移分解为末层的"幅度驱动"平凡效应与其他层的"结构驱动"非平凡效应。


<details>
  <summary>Details</summary>
Motivation: 迁移学习的核心谜题在于：为什么在一个任务上预训练能加速或改善另一个任务的训练，以及其背后的机制是什么。作者希望通过可控的随机映射记忆任务来揭示迁移的底层机制，从而为有原则的预训练策略提供依据。

Method: 作者选取随机输入-输出映射的记忆任务作为研究对象，系统考察任务间的迁移现象；通过消融实验，将迁移效应分解并定位为两种成分：末层由幅度驱动的"平凡"迁移，以及部分可归因于其他层协方差的"非平凡"结构驱动迁移。

Result: 观察到两种出人意料的迁移模式：（1）等价迁移——每多一个预训练epoch，约可节省一个下游微调epoch；（2）非等价迁移——在不匹配任务上预训练，其效率甚至高于直接在下游任务上训练。消融实验进一步将迁移分解为末层幅度驱动的平凡效应与结构驱动的非平凡效应。

Conclusion: 研究结果深化了对迁移学习内在机制的理解，表明迁移可被分解为可定位的独立效应，并有望指导设计出有理论依据的预训练策略。

Abstract: A central puzzle in transfer learning is why pre-training on one task can accelerate training or improve performance on another task, and what mechanisms underlie this transfer. In this work, we examine the transfer between memorization tasks of random input-output mappings. We find two surprising transfer patterns: equivalent transfer, where each additional pre-training epoch saves approximately one downstream fine-tuning epoch; and non-equivalent transfer, where pre-training on a mismatched task can be even more efficient than directly training on the downstream task itself. Through ablation experiments, we decompose and localize the transfer into two separate effects: a "trivial" magnitude-driven transfer in the last layer, and a "non-trivial" structure-driven transfer, partially attributable to the covariance of the other layers. These results advance our understanding of the underlying mechanisms of transfer learning and have the potential to lead to principled pre-training strategies.

</details>


### [480] [Learning Goal-Reaching Quasimetric Geometry From Finite-Time Reachability](https://arxiv.org/abs/2610.00778)
*Daisuke Yamada,Travis Pence,Vikas Singh*

Main category: cs.LG

TL;DR: 提出ReQRL，通过有限时域可达性约束critic的价值梯度，在OGBench上优于或媲美现有拟度量方法与离线GCRL方法。


<details>
  <summary>Details</summary>
Motivation: 在目标条件强化学习（GCRL）中，拟度量学习将目标达成代价建模为拟度量距离，连接局部约束与全局价值几何。但现有局部约束未能反映有限时域内控制复合的方向依赖效应以及环境可行性。

Method: 提出ReQRL，通过有限时域可达性约束critic的价值梯度；借鉴状态约束最优控制，将动力学可达性与边界几何解耦，并从数据中分别估计两者。

Result: 在OGBench上，该方法优于或媲美现有拟度量方法及其他离线GCRL方法。

Conclusion: 通过有限时域可达性约束价值梯度、并解耦估计动力学可达性与边界几何，ReQRL为GCRL提供了一种有效的拟度量学习范式。

Abstract: In goal-conditioned reinforcement learning (GCRL), quasimetric learning models goal-reaching costs as quasimetric distances, connecting local constraints to global value geometry. Its local constraints, however, should reflect the direction- dependent effects of control composition over a finite horizon together with environmental feasibility. We propose ReQRL, which constrains the critic's value gradients through finite-horizon reachability. Drawing on state-constrained optimal control, we decouple dynamical reachability from boundary geometry, estimating both from data. On OGBench, our method outperforms or rivals existing quasimetric approaches and other offline GCRL methods.

</details>


### [481] [Training-Aware Target Coverage for Synthetic Data Selection](https://arxiv.org/abs/2610.00814)
*Yang Ba,Michelle V. Mancenido,Rong Pan*

Main category: cs.LG

TL;DR: 本文提出线性理论刻画合成数据的收益-误差权衡，并据此设计TATC选择方法，用于LLM微调中的合成数据筛选。


<details>
  <summary>Details</summary>
Motivation: 合成数据被广泛用于扩展LLM训练规模，但更多合成数据并不必然带来更好模型。有效合成数据须为目标任务补充相关信息，同时不引入抵消收益的错误，且单个样本的价值会随训练集增大而变化。现有方法缺乏对这种权衡的量化刻画与选择指导。

Method: 建立线性理论，刻画合成数据的收益与误差权衡，确定其有用区间、应添加的数量以及向现有数据集中增加一个样本的边际价值；分析输入覆盖度何时足够、何时须考虑合成误差。基于此提出Training-Aware Target Coverage (TATC)：在候选样本中筛选训练效应对目标任务有益的样本，并在其中选择能扩展目标相关方向覆盖度、且未被现有数据代表的样本。

Result: 在文本与图像数据上的实验验证了线性理论。在数学推理任务中，TATC为Qwen2.5-Math-1.5B-Instruct微调选择合成解，在GSM8K上于各选择预算下均优于其他合成数据选择方法。

Conclusion: 本文通过量化并最大化合成数据对目标任务的价值，提供了合成数据选择的原则性方法，明确了合成数据何时有用、用多少以及边际价值如何变化。

Abstract: Synthetic data are increasingly used to scale LLM training, yet more synthetic data do not necessarily produce better models. Useful synthetic data must add information relevant to the target task without introducing errors that offset their benefit, and the value of an example can change as the training set grows. We develop a linear theory that characterizes this tradeoff and determines where synthetic data are useful, how much should be added, and the marginal value of adding one example to an existing set. The analysis shows the conditions when input coverage alone is sufficient and when synthetic errors must also be considered. Guided by these results, we introduce \emph{Training-Aware Target Coverage} (TATC), a synthetic data selection method for LLM fine-tuning. TATC identifies candidates whose training effects are beneficial to the target task and selects among them to expand coverage of target-relevant directions not already represented by the available data. Experiments on text and image data verify the linear theory. With mathematical reasoning tasks, TATC selects synthetic solutions for fine-tuning Qwen2.5-Math-1.5B-Instruct and outperforms alternative synthetic-data selection methods on GSM8K across selection budgets. In summary, we provide a principled approach to synthetic data selection by quantifying and maximizing its value to the target task.

</details>


### [482] [Quantifying the Impact of Ambulance Ramping: A Multi-Year Analysis of Victorian Emergency Medical Services Cases](https://arxiv.org/abs/2610.00818)
*Ayesha Tanveer,Khandakar Ahmed,Assefa Teshome,Oyetunde Gbadeyan,Ziad Nehme*

Main category: cs.LG

TL;DR: 对澳大利亚维多利亚州EMS系统285万余次救护车出勤进行探索性数据分析，量化救护车压床（ramping）的规模、趋势与运行相关因素。


<details>
  <summary>Details</summary>
Motivation: 救护车压床（到达医院至患者交接之间的延迟）是EMS关键运行瓶颈，但其系统性规模与动态特征在大范围尺度上缺乏充分刻画。本文旨在 statewide 尺度上刻画压床的规模、轨迹及运行关联。

Method: 采用探索性数据分析（EDA）。数据为2020年1月至2024年3月维多利亚州2,850,575次救护车出勤，经预处理后分析队列包含59家有急诊科的医院、79个地方政府辖区的2,026,569次ED转运。方法包括区间分解、帕累托集中度分析、小时级互相关、医院到达并发性分析及按优先级分层的运行比较。

Result: 累计救护车损失工时（AHL）达1,491,127小时，相当于研究期内每天约96个十小时救护车班次损失。59家医院中10家贡献57.8%的损失工时（对应50.9%的病例）。年损失上升57%并于2022年达峰，而转运需求下降3.7%，表明每例交接恶化而非需求增长。交接时长与患者病情严重程度关系不大，但随前一小时内到达同一医院的救护车数量单调上升，且该效应存在于一天中每个时段。小时级需求与2至4小时后的压床呈中度相关（r=0.365）。

Conclusion: 研究结果为医院状态感知的救护车调度（hospital-state aware ambulance routing）确立了实证前提。

Abstract: Ambulance ramping, the delay between hospital arrival and patient handover, is a critical operational bottleneck in Emergency Medical Services (EMS), yet its systemic magnitude and dynamics remain inadequately characterised at scale. This paper quantifies the scale, trajectory, and operational correlates of ramping across an entire statewide EMS system, analysing 2,850,575 ambulance attendances in Victoria, Australia from January 2020 to March 2024 using an Exploratory Data Analysis (EDA). After systematic preprocessing, an analytical cohort of 2,026,569 Emergency Department (ED) transports across 59 hospitals with ED and 79 Local Government Areas (LGA) was examined through interval decomposition, Pareto concentration, hourly cross-correlation, hospital arrival concurrency and priority-stratified operational comparisons. Cumulative Ambulance Hours Lost (AHL) totalled 1,491,127 hours, equivalent to approximately 96 ten-hour ambulance shift lost every day of the study window. Ten of 59 hospitals account for 57.8% of lost hours from 50.9% of cases. Annual losses rose 57% to a 2022 peak while transported demand fell 3.7%, indicating deterioration in per-case handover rather than growth in demand. Handover duration varies little with patient acuity, but rises monotonically with the number of ambulances arriving at the same hospital in the preceding hour, an effect persisting within every hour of the day. Hourly demand is moderately associated with ramping two to four hours later (r = 0.365). These findings establish the empirical preconditions for hospital-state aware ambulance routing.

</details>


### [483] [On-the-fly Weight Generation: A Hypernetwork Proof of Concept on ARC-1D](https://arxiv.org/abs/2610.00820)
*Fabio J. Fehr,Philip Torr*

Main category: cs.LG

TL;DR: 利用ARC-1D测试床，展示了超网络可从少量示例上下文直接生成微型专家模型的参数，形成的结构化权重空间支持部分组合泛化及对未见变换的泛化。


<details>
  <summary>Details</summary>
Motivation: 通用模型能通过上下文适应多种任务，但容量利用率低；专用模型执行单个函数效率更高，却需要任务特定的训练或适配。本文探究能否不经过训练，直接从少量示例生成专家模型。

Method: 以ARC-1D作为受控测试平台，将单个变换表示为微型专家模型，并训练超网络根据上下文生成这些专家的参数；同时对比移除显式任务标识符的设置。

Result: 生成的参数构成结构化权重空间；所得专家表现出部分组合泛化能力，以及对训练中未见变换的泛化能力；在两种设置下，移除显式任务标识符都能将泛化扩展到训练变换之外。

Conclusion: 该结果证明少样本任务上下文可以即时编译为紧凑的可执行模型参数，且所形成的权重空间能够支持已知函数之外的复用与泛化。

Abstract: General-purpose models can adapt to many tasks from context, while specialised models can execute individual functions with less capacity. Yet obtaining such specialists requires task-specific training or adaptation. We ask whether they can instead be generated directly from a few demonstrations. Using ARC-1D as a controlled testbed, we show that individual transformations can be represented by tiny specialist models, and that a hypernetwork can generate their parameters from context. The generated parameters form a structured weight space, while the resulting specialists show partial compositional generalisation and generalisation to transformations not seen during training. In both settings, removing explicit task identifiers improves generalisation beyond the training transformations. Together, these results provide a proof of concept that few-shot task context can be compiled on-the-fly into compact executable model parameters, and that the resulting weight space can support reuse and generalisation beyond known functions.

</details>


### [484] [AnyJev Technical Report](https://arxiv.org/abs/2610.00831)
*Jiamu Zhang,Tianze Yang,Yucheng Shi,Evan Chen,Zixiang Nie,Kelly Wan,Liangjie Hong,Ninghao Liu,Liang Wu*

Main category: cs.LG

TL;DR: AnyJev 通过一次 prefill 从指令微调语言模型读取"类型化决策"（在固定选项集中输出概率），用标签先验校正与选项列表 K 次循环旋转的 log-prob 平均，零梯度、零参数改动地消除标签偏置与位置偏置，并用停止规则减少所需 prefill 数。


<details>
  <summary>Details</summary>
Motivation: 今天的类型化决策系统依赖为此专门训练的模型。本文希望不训练、不改参数，直接利用预训练指令微调语言模型读取类型化决策。核心问题是：把答案位置的下一个 token 分布限制在选项 token 上时，存在两种缺陷——模型无论输入为何都给某些标签更高概率（标签先验偏置），以及给选项列表中某些位置更高概率（位置偏置）。

Method: AnyJev 从一次 prefill 中读取决策：在答案位置将 next-token 分布限制到选项 token。两项零梯度、零参数修改的校正：(1) 除以由无标注输入估计的标签先验；(2) 对选项列表的 K 次循环旋转平均 log-probabilities。为降低 K 次 prefill 的开销，引入停止规则：在无标注状态上针对全旋转决策选择阈值，并在另一无标注划分上约束其不一致性。

Result: 在两个 20 选项任务上，旋转把 order-flip rate 从 0.33 降到 0.14 与从 0.33 降到 0.18，并在两个任务的全部 11 个模型上提升准确率。停止规则：在一个无标注划分上选阈值、在第二个划分上约束不一致性时，在四格中的两格上读取 18 次旋转中的 10.6 次，verified bound 为 0.008；在单一划分上选择并约束（如实际服务运行），读取 7.3 次旋转，在 vLLM 上每秒服务 2.2 倍的决策数。代码开源。

Conclusion: 无需训练或改参数，仅靠标签先验校正与选项旋转平均即可从单次 prefill 得到稳健的类型化决策，显著降低顺序翻转率并提升准确率；配合停止规则可大幅减少 prefill 次数、提高服务吞吐。

Abstract: A typed decision is a choice among a fixed set of options, returned as a probability rather than as text. Systems that need typed decisions today use models trained for that purpose. This report describes AnyJev, which reads a typed decision from one prefill of a pretrained instruction-tuned language model. The readout restricts the next-token distribution at the answer position to the option tokens. It has two defects: the model assigns higher probability to some labels whatever the input, and to some positions in the option list. AnyJev corrects both with no gradient steps and no parameter changes: it divides out a label prior estimated from unlabelled inputs, and it averages log-probabilities over the K cyclic rotations of the option list. On two 20-option tasks the rotations lower the order-flip rate from 0.33 to 0.14 and from 0.33 to 0.18, and raise accuracy on 11 of 11 models on both. Reading every rotation requires K prefills. A stopping rule selected against the full-rotation decision on unlabelled states cuts that. Selecting the threshold on one unlabelled split and bounding its disagreement on a second, it reads 10.6 rotations of 18 at a verified 0.008 bound on two of four cells; selected and bounded on one split, as our serving run did, it reads 7.3 and serves 2.2 times as many decisions per second on vLLM. The code is open source.

</details>


### [485] [TrueMuse: A Benchmark for Data Attribution in Text-to-Music Models](https://arxiv.org/abs/2610.00835)
*Jiawei Yu,Jian Liu*

Main category: cs.LG

TL;DR: 本文提出 TrueMuse，一个用于文本到音乐生成数据归因的受控数据集与基准，通过微调已知归因样本的扩散模型提供可靠评估目标。


<details>
  <summary>Details</summary>
Motivation: 文本到音乐生成模型基于海量音乐数据训练，亟需量化单个训练样本贡献的数据归因方法；但现有方法缺乏可靠的真值（ground truth），难以严格评估其实际有效性。

Method: 构建 TrueMuse：在精心挑选的归因样本上微调三个基于扩散的文本到音乐模型，利用已知的微调纳入样本作为受控归因目标；覆盖旋律结构、音色特征、艺术家级风格特征、流派级共享模式四类归因设定，包含133个属性、648个微调模型、95,456个生成样本、两种提示类型。

Result: 基于 TrueMuse 系统评估现有黑盒归因方法，从微调改进、提示类型难度、多任务训练、微调数据规模四个维度分析；结果显示归因仍具挑战性，现有方法在不同评估设定下波动显著。

Conclusion: 当前文本到音乐生成的归因方法可靠性不足，亟需更可靠、更可泛化的归因方法；代码与数据集将在录用后发布。

Abstract: Text-to-music generation models are trained on massive music collections, creating a growing need for data attribution methods that can quantify the contribution of individual training samples. However, existing attribution methods are difficult to rigorously evaluate due to the lack of reliable ground truth, making it challenging to reliably assess their actual effectiveness. To address this gap, we introduce TrueMuse, a controlled dataset and benchmark for text-to-music data attribution. TrueMuse is constructed by fine-tuning three diffusion-based text-to-music models on carefully curated attribution samples, whose known inclusion in fine-tuning provides controlled attribution targets for evaluation. The benchmark covers four attribution settings, spanning melodic structure, timbral characteristics, artist-level stylistic signatures, and genre-level shared patterns, and includes 133 attributes, 648 fine-tuned models, and 95,456 generated samples across two prompt types. Using TrueMuse, we systematically evaluate existing black-box attribution methods along four dimensions: fine-tuning improvement, prompt-type difficulty, multi-task training, and fine-tuning data size. Our results show that attribution remains challenging, with existing methods exhibiting substantial variation across evaluation settings, highlighting the need for more reliable and generalizable attribution methods for text-to-music generation. Code and Dataset will be released upon acceptance.

</details>


### [486] [SHARPO: Segment-Level Credit Assignment for Agentic Reinforcement Learning](https://arxiv.org/abs/2610.00838)
*Xinchen Du,Zhengze Zhou,Wenhui Zhu,Han Yu,Sen Na,Rohit Jain,Alborz Geramifard*

Main category: cs.LG

TL;DR: 本文提出SHARPO，一种面向智能体强化学习的段级信用分配机制，通过段内教师-学生对数概率差计算有界乘子来重加权GRPO优势，在ALFWorld与WebShop上超越GRPO等基线。


<details>
  <summary>Details</summary>
Motivation: 智能体强化学习需在长程多步交互中训练LLM，但单个局部错误即可导致任务失败，而轨迹级奖励难以为各决策分配信用，信用分配粒度不足。

Method: SHARPO在面向环境的段（segment）层面细化GRPO。受在线策略自蒸馏（OPSD）启发，计算每段内教师与学生的对数概率差，据此生成有界乘子作用于GRPO优势，该乘子在段内所有token间共享，使信用可跨段差异化。

Result: 在Qwen2.5-7B-Instruct上，SHARPO在ALFWorld与WebShop基准上优于现有基线，包括GRPO、SDAR、RLSD与StepOPSD。

Conclusion: 段级优势重加权可有效缓解长程智能体任务的信用分配问题，并提升策略优化性能。

Abstract: Agentic reinforcement learning (RL) trains a large language model (LLM) to act over long, multi-step interactions. However, a single localized error can cause task failure, while trajectory-level rewards provide limited guidance for assigning credit to individual decisions. To address this limitation, we introduce Segment-level Hindsight Advantage Reweighting for Policy Optimization (SHARPO), a credit-assignment mechanism that refines Group Relative Policy Optimization (GRPO) at the level of environment-facing segments. Inspired by the existing on-policy self-distillation (OPSD) method, SHARPO computes teacher-student log-probability gaps within each segment and uses the resulting signal to compute a bounded multiplier on the GRPO advantage. This multiplier is shared by all tokens within the segment, allowing credit to vary across different segments. With Qwen2.5-7B-Instruct, SHARPO outperforms existing baselines on the ALFWorld and WebShop benchmarks, including GRPO, SDAR, RLSD, and StepOPSD.

</details>


### [487] [Fixing a Model That Learned Worse Cancer Means Lower Risk: Monotonic Constraints in Bladder Cancer Recurrence Prediction](https://arxiv.org/abs/2610.00858)
*Saram Abbas,David Thomas,Naeem Soomro,Rishad Shafik,Rakesh Heer,Kabita Adhikari*

Main category: cs.LG

TL;DR: 该研究提出反事实方向检验与单调约束框架，用于识别并纠正XGBoost模型中与医学常识相悖的风险方向倒置（如肿瘤分期、原位癌预测更低复发风险），且不损失判别性能。


<details>
  <summary>Details</summary>
Motivation: 临床通常预期癌症严重程度越高复发风险越大，但无约束的机器学习模型可能学习到相反关系（肿瘤分期、原位癌预测更低复发），而传统判别力（AUC）、校准和SHAP等评估手段对此倒置均不敏感，缺乏有效的检测与纠正手段。

Method: 基于BOXIT多中心试验数据（472例患者，435例随访≥2年，153例复发，35.2%），在18个预测变量（7个有方向性）上开展50折交叉验证。开发反事实方向检验，逐个使患者在有方向特征上恶化，检验风险是否反而下降；并采用约束方向来源于EORTC和EAU风险系统的单调约束进行纠正，与无约束XGBoost及逻辑回归对比，同时评估SHAP方向和校准。

Result: 肿瘤分期和原位癌与更低复发相关，与医学直觉相反；无约束模型在90.2%的病例中反转原位癌反事实，分期为74.3%。判别力（ΔAUC 0.005，p=0.47）、校准及SHAP幅度均未察觉该倒置。单调约束消除全部违规，判别力无损失（0.723 vs 0.718），并优于EORTC（p=8.9e-16）。

Conclusion: 已学习到此类倒置的模型仍能通过所有常规检验。将反事实方向检验与预先设定的单调约束作为单次重拟合运行，可在不损失性能的前提下捕捉该失败模式，应在临床部署前常规使用。

Abstract: Background and Objective: Clinicians expect recurrence risk to climb with cancer severity. In a UK multicentre trial, an unconstrained XGBoost model learnt that higher tumour stage and carcinoma in situ predicted lower recurrence risk, and discrimination, calibration, and SHAP were all blind to it. We developed a counterfactual testing framework to detect this inversion and a monotonic-constraint framework to remove it without hurting performance. Methods: BOXIT enrolled 472 patients with protocol-mandated cystoscopy across 51 UK sites (2007-2012); 435 had at least two years' follow-up (153 recurrences, 35.2%). We developed a counterfactual direction test and a monotonic-constraint correction, with constraint directions drawn from the EORTC and EAU risk systems, and evaluated both against unconstrained XGBoost and logistic regression on 18 predictors (seven directed) over 50 cross-validation folds. The test worsened each patient on one directed feature at a time to check whether risk fell; SHAP direction and calibration were also assessed. Key Findings and Limitations: Tumour stage and carcinoma in situ were associated with lower recurrence, opposite to medical intuition; the unconstrained model reversed carcinoma in situ counterfactuals in 90.2% of cases and stage in 74.3%. Discrimination ($Δ$AUC 0.005, p=0.47), calibration, and SHAP magnitude were all blind to the inversion. Monotonic constraints eliminated every violation at no cost to discrimination (0.723 vs 0.718) and outperformed EORTC (p=8.9e-16). Limitations: single trial, internal-external validation only. Conclusions and Clinical Implications: A model that had learned this inversion passed every conventional check. A counterfactual direction test, run as a single refit with pre-specified monotonic constraints, catches this failure at no cost to performance and should be routine before clinical deployment.

</details>


### [488] [Rethinking Data Augmentation under Covariate Shift: Invariant-Guided Diffusion and Prototype Reweighting](https://arxiv.org/abs/2610.00873)
*Hongyu Cao,Xinyuan Wang,Arun Vignesh Malarkkan,Kunpeng Liu,Haifeng Chen,Yanjie Fu*

Main category: cs.LG

TL;DR: 该论文提出新任务AWL-CS（协变量漂移下的增广与加权学习），并给出统一框架IGDPR：用不变势引导扩散采样以生成任务相关样本，用原型重加权评估样本可靠性以稳定适配，在真实数据上提升了数据质量与鲁棒学习效果。


<details>
  <summary>Details</summary>
Motivation: 工业场景中表格数据稀缺且不平衡，训练与部署分布存在协变量漂移，验证集与未见测试环境不一致，且标准生成模型仅模仿过时源分布。现有增广与适配流水线在此设定下稳定性不足。

Method: 将问题形式化为AWL-CS，并针对两大挑战（生成指导易偏向源相似性而非下游任务相关性；密度重加权易过拟合噪声验证信号）提出IGDPR：i) 用不变势引导扩散采样，使合成样本对齐稳定决策边界而非过时相关性；ii) 基于原型的重加权策略，通过结构簇而非孤立点评估样本可靠性，过滤验证噪声。

Result: 在真实数据上进行了大量实验，表明该方法通过增广对鲁棒学习最有益的数据，提升了数据质量。

Conclusion: IGDPR将稳定合成与结构适配统一起来，为AWL-CS问题提供了有效解决方案，能够生成更利于下游鲁棒学习的增广数据。

Abstract: In many industrial applications, 1) tabular data is scarce and imbalanced and thus requires synthetic expansion; 2) input distributions drift between training and deployment (covariate shift); 3) validation sets often diverge from unseen test environments; or 4) standard generative models simply mimic outdated source distributions. This learning setting limits the stability of standard augmentation and adaptation pipelines. We generalize the task under such setting as the Augmented and Weighted Learning under Covariate Shift problem (AWL-CS). AWL-CS imposes two critical challenges on existing methods: 1) misleading generative guidance where models optimize for source similarity rather than downstream task relevance, and 2) structural instability of distributional density where reweighting mechanisms overfit to noisy validation signals. To tackle these challenges, we propose IGDPR (Invariant-Guided Diffusion with Prototype Reweighting), a unified framework that synergizes stable synthesis and structural adaptation: i) To achieve task-relevant generation, we steer the diffusion sampling process using invariant potentials to ensure synthetic samples align with stable decision boundaries rather than outdated correlations. ii) To ensure stable adaptation, we develop a prototype-based reweighting strategy that assesses sample reliability through structural clusters instead of isolated points, effectively filtering validation noise. Extensive experiments on real data demonstrate our method improves data quality by augmenting the most beneficial data for robust learning.

</details>


### [489] [Match the Distribution, Not the Compute: Post-Training Multi-Token Prediction Heads](https://arxiv.org/abs/2610.00888)
*Prachi Badarayani,Aidan Jay,Chenghui Zhou,Dayquan Julienne,Yuan Gao,Tianwei Chen,George Zerveas,Ishmam Zabir,Xiren Zhou,Chris Quirk,Xia Song*

Main category: cs.LG

TL;DR: 本文研究在冻结推理模型上进行轻量级后训练以构建多token预测（MTP）草稿头，并提出链感知验证松弛与自适应控制器优化推理加速。


<details>
  <summary>Details</summary>
Motivation: 现有多token预测（MTP）方案（MiMo-7B、DeepSeek-V3、Qwen3）均需在数万亿token的全预训练过程中联合训练草稿头，草稿质量在预训练阶段即被固定，代价高昂。作者希望验证：仅对冻结推理模型做一次轻量级后训练（基于目标模型生成的思维链），能否达到同等的期望吞吐加速，并进一步优化基于该检查点的推理服务系统。

Method: 1）在冻结的Qwen3-8B上使用K=3的链式MTP头，采用朴素交叉熵在约2.5B token上进行后训练；2）提出链感知的草稿token验证松弛规则，允许对主干语言模型token分布的有界漂移；3）提出自适应控制器，在推理时动态选择启用的MTP头数量，并采用固定最大MTP草稿长度。

Result: 1）后训练方案在数学、代码与知识基准上达到或超过联合训练的MiMo-7B的期望加速，且所用MTP训练token比MiMO-7B联合预训练基线少10^3–10^4倍；2）验证松弛使各基准期望加速提升+12%至+16%，同时保持任务准确率；3）自适应控制器在使用固定最大MTP草稿长度时，可恢复高达11%–14%的加速损失。

Conclusion: 在冻结推理模型上通过轻量级后训练即可获得与联合预训练相当甚至更优的MTP加速效果，且验证规则松弛与自适应头数控制能进一步提升服务吞吐，为MTP推理部署提供了低成本、高效的方案。

Abstract: Multi-token prediction (MTP) improves the throughput of autoregressive generation by enabling the language model to draft multiple next tokens per forward pass, while a verification step over draft tokens ensures that token distribution of the backbone is preserved. Every open MTP-family release (MiMo-7B, DeepSeek-V3, Qwen3) trains its heads jointly with the backbone over the full pretraining run of tens of trillions of tokens, thus setting the drafter quality at pretraining time. We ask whether a lightweight post-training pass on target-generated chain-of-thought is enough to reach the same expected throughput speedup on a frozen reasoning model, and study how a serving-time system built on such a checkpoint can be optimized. We present three findings. 1) On a frozen Qwen3-8B with $K{=}3$ chained MTP heads, we show that a post-training recipe with plain cross-entropy on $\approx\!2.5$B tokens reaches or exceeds the expected speedup of jointly trained MiMo-7B on math, coding and knowledge benchmarks. Our post-training recipe utilizes $10^3$-$10^4\times$ less MTP-training tokens as compared with joint pre-training of MiMO-7B MTP baseline. 2) We propose a chain-aware relaxation of draft token verification rule that allows a bounded drift from backbone language model token distribution. We show that this relaxation lifts expected speedups by $+12$ to $+16\%$ per benchmark while preserving task accuracy. 3) We propose an adaptive controller that dynamically chooses the number of MTP heads to be engaged at inference time and demonstrate recovery of upto $11$--$14\%$ loss in speedup using fixed maximum MTP draft length.

</details>


### [490] [Cross-Benchmark Transfer from RL on Agentic Coding Tasks](https://arxiv.org/abs/2610.00890)
*Sushant Mehta,Logan Ritchie,Edwin Chen*

Main category: cs.LG

TL;DR: 通过仅用强化学习（RL）对 Kimi K2.7 Code 进行后训练，在六个外部基准上显著提升编码智能体的"最后一公里"表现，且增益可迁移到训练分布之外。


<details>
  <summary>Details</summary>
Motivation: 编码智能体常在"最后一公里"失败：功能大部分完成却遗漏需求、只测试已实现的情况、破坏本应保持的行为、或基于未验证假设做验证。作者想探究 RL 在专家构建的智能体编码任务上的训练能否弥补这一差距，以及所学能力能否泛化到训练分布之外。

Method: 对 1T 参数（32B 激活）的开放权重 MoE 模型 Kimi K2.7 Code 做纯 RL 后训练，使用 1,700 个任务：1,000 个仓库任务（用隐藏的 fail-to-pass 测试和现有行为的 pass-to-pass 测试评分）和 700 个终端任务（用专家编写的隐藏验证器评分）。奖励为目标检查通过的比例，若任一 pass-to-pass 测试失败则降为零。在 rank-32 LoRA 适配器上执行一个 epoch 的 GSPO。

Result: 在三种智能体框架下，六个外部基准的 pass@1 均有提升：SWE-Bench Pro（60.1→64.8）、DeepSWE（31.0→43.4）、Terminal-Bench 2.1（67.4→82.0）、Terminal-Bench 3（1.4→12.1）、Terminal-Bench 4（0.0→7.6）、SWE-Marathon（5.0→25.0）。在五个独立任务集上合并提升显著（p<0.001），在训练数据收集后发布的三个集合上仍显著（p=0.004）；在两个训练中从未使用的框架下也有提升。DeepSWE 和 Terminal-Bench 3 的中位轨迹在智能体步数上缩短 24-35%。
