Result: 在赛车与开门任务上，模仿学习性能较零样本LLM生成结构提升最高15%，达到同等强化学习性能所需算力减少75%。

Conclusion: 表格化rollout分析可为LLM生成的策略结构提供有效反馈信号，使其与专家演示对齐，从而实现策略结构的自动生成。

Abstract: Structured policies improve efficiency, robustness, and interpretability in imitation learning by introducing task-specific inductive bias, but existing structure generation methods rely either on extensive human input or on static domain knowledge encoded in LLMs, which may be inconsistent with the expert demonstrations. We propose a closed-loop framework that iteratively refines structured policies using LLM-guided analysis of policy rollouts. By logging rollouts as semantically meaningful tabular data and prompting the LLM to generate diagnostic analysis code, our method identifies suboptimalities in the policy structure and iteratively corrects them without requiring human instruction. Experiments on car racing and door opening tasks show that our approach improves imitation learning performance by up to 15% over zero-shot LLM-generated structures and requires 75% less compute to achieve the same reinforcement learning performance. These results demonstrate that tabular rollout analysis provides an effective feedback signal to align LLM-generated policy structures with expert demonstrations, and we can utilize it to generate good policy structures automatically.

</details>


### [559] [pCoMole: Pareto-Constrained Molecule Editing with Discrete Flows](https://arxiv.org/abs/2610.01663)
*Tong Chen,Maximilian Holsman,Lin Zhao,Pranam Chatterjee*

Main category: cs.LG

TL;DR: pCoMole：基于离散流匹配的帕累托约束分子编辑框架，通过Doob h-变换实现多目标偏好引导与硬可行性约束，成功用于GFP缩短、Cas9正交体截短及肽结合物压缩，湿实验验证eGFP变异体保持荧光。


<details>
  <summary>Details</summary>
Motivation: 生物分子治疗药物常从已知序列出发，需在满足生化与可制造性硬约束的前提下进行靶向编辑以改善多重性质。然而现有生成方法无法在离散、变长生物空间中同时支持多目标优化、硬可行性与序列编辑。

Method: 提出pCoMole框架，基于离散流匹配（discrete flow matching）引导预训练的Edit Flow朝用户偏好方向编辑。采用增广Tchebycheff效用定义可行性门控的终端分布，并通过底层编辑过程的Doob h-变换实现偏好倾斜。为提升实用性，用短蒙特卡洛rollout近似所需调和函数，得到高效引导编辑器，并具备可证明的偏好一致性。

Result: 在GFP缩短并保留荧光相关性质、多种Cas9正交体截短并保持PAM特异性、肽结合物压缩为短肽模拟物并优化七项药物相关性质（硬约束下）三类任务中验证。湿实验中，两个229残基的pCoMole设计eGFP变异体经10处缺失及1或2处替换后，在BL21细胞中仍保持明显绿色荧光。

Conclusion: pCoMole实现了离散、变长空间中约束感知、帕累托对齐的生物分子序列编辑，兼具多目标优化、硬可行性与序列编辑能力。

Abstract: Biomolecular therapeutics often start from known sequences and require targeted editing to improve multiple properties while satisfying hard biochemical and manufacturability constraints. However, existing generative methods do not jointly support multi-objective optimization, hard feasibility, and sequence editing in discrete, variable-length biological spaces. In this work, we introduce Pareto-Constrained Molecule Editing (pCoMole), a framework built on discrete flow matching that steers a pre-trained Edit Flow toward user-specified preferences while enforcing terminal feasibility. pCoMole defines a feasibility-gated terminal distribution using an augmented Tchebycheff utility and realizes the resulting preference tilt through a Doob-h transform of the underlying edit process. To make this construction practical, we approximate the required harmonic function using short Monte Carlo rollouts over candidate edits, yielding an efficient guided editor with provable preference consistency. We validate pCoMole by shrinking GFP while retaining fluorescence-related properties, shortening diverse Cas9 orthologs while preserving PAM specificity, and compressing peptide binders into short peptidomimetics that optimize seven drug-related properties under hard constraints. In wet lab testing, two 229-residue pCoMole-designed eGFP variants retained clear green fluorescence in BL21 cells after 10 deletions, with either one or two substitutions. Together, pCoMole enables constraint-aware, Pareto-aligned editing of biomolecular sequences in discrete, variable-length spaces.

</details>


### [560] [Invent a Dataset: Measuring dataset generation abilities with zero seed](https://arxiv.org/abs/2610.01674)
*Shivalika Singh,Andrija Djurisic,Gbemileke Onilude,Sudip Roy,Sara Hooker*

Main category: cs.LG

TL;DR: 提出 Invent-A-Dataset——一种基于提示词的零数据 regime 数据集生成系统，可从数据集描述直接生成大规模、真实的微调数据，在质量、多样性和下游训练效果上显著优于五个前沿模型 API。


<details>
  <summary>Details</summary>
Motivation: 构建数据集仍是 AI 开发中最依赖人工且最脆弱的环节之一。本文聚焦最极端也最常见的"零数据 regime"——实践者完全没有目标能力的数据，亟需一种无需现有数据即可生成训练数据的方法。

Method: Invent-A-Dataset 是一个基于提示词（prompt-based）的系统，输入为数据集描述，输出为真实、大规模的后训练数据集。评测对比 Anthropic、Google、OpenAI、DeepSeek、Zai 五个前沿模型 API，覆盖八种任务类型，数据规模最高达 20K 样本。

Result: Invent-A-Dataset 显著优于对比方法：质量相对提升 17%，多样性相对提升 19%；多样性优势随数据规模扩大而增大（200 样本时持平，20K 样本时相对提升 37%）。下游训练收益显著，所微调模型性能更强。

Conclusion: Invent-A-Dataset 的微调结果在不同后训练模型架构上均持续优于其他生成器微调方案，表明其在零数据场景下生成高质量、多样化训练数据方面具有稳定优势。

Abstract: Building datasets remains one of the most manual and brittle parts of AI development. In this technical report, we focus on the most extreme but also most prevalent setting real world practitioners face: a zero data regime. Here, practitioners don't have any data for the capability they want to learn. We introduce Invent-A-Dataset which is a prompt based system to go from dataset description to realistic and large scale post-training datasets. We evaluate Invent-A-Dataset against five frontier model APIs including Anthropic, Google, Open AI, DeepSeek, Zai. Across eight task types and dataset sizes up to 20K samples, Invent-A-Dataset significantly outperforms with both the highest quality (17% relative gains) while simultaneously producing the most diverse samples (19% relative gains). Its diversity advantage widens with scale of training dataset size (from parity at 200 samples to 37% relative gains at 20K samples). This translates into considerable downstream training gains, resulting in far more performant post-trained models. Invent-A-Dataset fine-tune consistently ranks higher compared to other generator fine-tunes across different post-trained model architectures.

</details>


### [561] [MiLoop: Selective Memory Propagation for Neural Combinatorial Optimization](https://arxiv.org/abs/2610.01685)
*Changliang Zhou,Yuanyao Chen,Rongsheng Chen,Zhiyun Lin,Zhenkun Wang*

Main category: cs.LG

TL;DR: 本文提出MiLoop——一种纯强化学习的构造式神经组合优化框架，利用rollout过程中多步计算进行选择性记忆传播，使浅层策略无需标签或搜索空间剪枝即可学到有效的动态嵌入。


<details>
  <summary>Details</summary>
Motivation: 现有构造式NCO方法虽泛化性好，但每步都用深层注意力从头重建子问题表示；许多高性能方法依赖解标签/伪标签训练，或在RL中做激进搜索空间剪枝。上述做法带来计算开销、对标签的依赖及剪枝导致的性能受限。

Method: MiLoop为纯RL的构造式框架：复用rollout本身所需的多步计算以进行选择性记忆传播。每个rollout既提供解质量反馈用于学习，又传播历史表示。具体地，在注意力层之前将当前嵌入与历史记忆融合，之后施加自适应门控更新；更新后的表示同时支持当前决策与逐步复用。

Result: 在四类组合优化问题上的大量实验表明，MiLoop在100到1000万节点规模的实例上均能持续产生高质量解，展现出强泛化能力。

Conclusion: MiLoop证明纯RL的浅层策略可通过rollout内记忆传播获得有效动态嵌入，摆脱外部解标签与训练期搜索空间剪枝，并具备从百级到千万级节点的规模泛化性。

Abstract: Constructive neural combinatorial optimization (NCO) has emerged as a promising paradigm that learns to construct solutions to combinatorial optimization problems (COPs) step by step, which reduces reliance on handcrafted rules and enables fast inference. While many methods with dynamic embeddings generalize well, they typically rebuild subproblem representations from scratch at each step using deep attention stacks. Many high-performing methods in this category rely on solution labels or pseudo-labels for efficient training, or on aggressive search space pruning during reinforcement learning (RL). To address these limitations, we propose Memory-in-the-Loop (MiLoop), a purely RL-based constructive framework that leverages the multi-step computation already required by a rollout for selective memory propagation. Each rollout provides solution-quality feedback for learning while propagating historical representations, thereby enabling a shallow policy to learn effective dynamic embeddings without external solution labels or training-time search-space pruning. Specifically, MiLoop fuses current embeddings with historical memory before the attention layers and applies adaptive gated updates afterward. The updated representations support both current decisions and stepwise reuse. Extensive experiments across four COPs demonstrate that MiLoop consistently produces high-quality solutions on instances ranging from 100 to 10 million nodes, highlighting its strong generalization ability.

</details>


### [562] [Artifact Annotations Partially Substitute for Per-User Calibration: SAFE-EDA and a Normalization-Controlled Evaluation of Wrist-EDA Affect Recognition](https://arxiv.org/abs/2610.01692)
*Haochen Chai,Xinbi Luo,Zining Liu,Fangfang Jiang*

Main category: cs.LG

TL;DR: 腕部皮肤电活动的个体差异使情感识别模型依赖输入归一化；本研究证明，若归一化统计取自被留出受试者自身记录，预训练收益会显著缩水，因此归一化数据来源必须被明确报告。


<details>
  <summary>Details</summary>
Motivation: 腕部皮肤电活动幅度存在个体差异，情感识别模型通常需在分类前做归一化。然而，多数在留出受试者上评估的模型未说明归一化统计量来自何处；若统计量取自被留出受试者自身记录，模型获得的是设备首次佩戴时并不具备的信息。作者由此追问：这一选择如何改变所测得的预训练收益。

Method: 采用紧凑卷积网络 SAFE-EDA，先在 43 名受试者的专家伪迹标注上预训练，再与从头训练版本在 WESAD 数据集（15 人、留一受试者法）上对比。实验交叉设置两种归一化来源（仅训练受试者统计量 vs 留出用户完整记录统计量）与四种窗口跳步，并比较伪迹监督与自监督预训练，另在第二个数据集（26 人）上跨 13 种配置验证交互作用。

Result: 统计量仅来自训练受试者时，预训练使 macro-F1 提升 0.078–0.227；来自留出用户完整记录时，增益降至 0.020–0.050 且不再显著。伪迹监督远优于同批录音的自监督预训练（0.078 vs 0.008）。跨两数据集 13 种配置中，预训练网络在 12 种中占优；但在第二数据集上，逐用户归一化反而增大增益，说明该交互依赖数据。50 项已发表 WESAD 研究中仅 5 项说明归一化所用数据。

Conclusion: 归一化统计量的来源会实质性改变预训练收益的评估结果：使用留出用户自身记录会高估"首次使用"性能。因此，报告归一化数据来源是把首次使用性能与校准后性能区分开的必要条件，现有文献普遍缺失这一信息。

Abstract: Wrist electrodermal activity (EDA) differs in amplitude from one person to the next, so affect-recognition models normalize their input before classification. Studies that test such models on held-out subjects seldom report where the normalization statistics come from, yet statistics computed from the held-out subject's own recording give the model information that a device does not have when it is first worn. We asked how this choice alters the measured benefit of pretraining. A compact convolutional network, SAFE-EDA, was pretrained on expert artifact annotations from 43 subjects and compared with the same network trained from scratch on the Wearable Stress and Affect Detection (WESAD) dataset (15 subjects, leave-one-subject-out), with two normalization sources crossed with four window hops. When the statistics came only from training subjects, pretraining raised macro-F1 by 0.078 to 0.227; when they came from the held-out user's full recording, the gain fell to between 0.020 and 0.050 and was no longer significant. Artifact supervision was far more useful than self-supervised pretraining on the same recordings (0.078 versus 0.008). Across 13 configurations in two datasets, the pretrained network was better in 12, but on the second dataset (26 subjects) per-user normalization increased the gain instead of reducing it, so the interaction depends on the data. Only five of 50 published WESAD studies state which data were used for normalization. Reporting this choice is necessary to separate first-use performance from performance after calibration.

</details>


### [563] [Learning PDE Dynamics between Submanifolds Using Green's Observation Operators](https://arxiv.org/abs/2610.01697)
*Jan Tauberschmidt,Jephte Abijuru,Samuel Okon,Naukshatro Bose,Sophie Fellenz,Marius Kloft,Jonas Latz,Sebastian Josef Vollmer*

Main category: cs.LG

TL;DR: 提出Green's Observation Operator (GObO)，将固定环境介质一次性映射为限制在源与观测子流形上的线性PDE Green核，使新源响应只需一次低维积分且无需网络推理，实现零样本预测运动源、跨分辨率迁移及弱非线性修正。


<details>
  <summary>Details</summary>
Motivation: 许多物理系统仅在较大空间域的低维子流形上被驱动和观测（如红外相机成像的激光加热区域、传感器平面测得的地面排放），但其动力学由占据整个域的环境介质决定。全域求解器对每个新源都要计算整个体积，而实际只需观测子流形；黑箱代理模型则未利用环境介质固定不变这一事实。

Method: 提出Green's Observation Operator (GObO)：将环境介质一次性映射为线性PDE的Green核，并限制在源子流形与观测子流形上。新源响应仅需一次低维积分，无需网络评估。利用核的指数速率构造精确的有限流式状态，实现与时间horizon无关的常数内存；并证明该流式状态的稳定性以及对限制热核的逼近速率。

Result: 在三维热传导与对流-扩散问题上（源与观测几何包含同位与异位配置），基于静态源训练的GObO能零样本预测运动源的响应，误差比黑箱代理模型低4–8倍，单次条件化后每次查询耗时1.4 ms。同一核可跨分辨率迁移，并能对温和非线性（辐射损失、温度相关导热系数）进行修正而无需重训练，代价是分布内精度下降。

Conclusion: GObO通过将固定环境介质预计算为限制在源/观测子流形上的Green核，把新源响应求解降为低维积分，在保持常数内存与稳定性的同时，实现了零样本运动源预测、跨分辨率泛化及无需重训练的弱非线性修正，显著优于黑箱代理模型。

Abstract: Many physical systems are driven and observed only on lower-dimensional submanifolds of a larger spatial domain, while their dynamics are governed by the ambient medium occupying that domain. Examples include laser-heated parts imaged by an infrared camera, and ground-level emissions measured on a sensor plane. Full-domain solvers, however, compute the entire volume for every new source although only the observation submanifold is needed, and black-box surrogates do not exploit that the ambient medium remains fixed. We introduce the \emph{Green's Observation Operator (GObO)}, which maps the ambient medium once to the Green's kernel of a linear PDE restricted to the source and observation submanifolds. New sources then cost one lower-dimensional integral and no network evaluation. Exponential rates in the kernel yield an exact finite streaming state with horizon-independent memory; we prove its stability and an approximation rate for the restricted heat kernel. On three-dimensional heat conduction and advection--diffusion with collocated and distinct source and observation geometries, GObO trained on static sources predicts responses to moving sources zero-shot with 4--8$\times$ lower error than black-box surrogates, at 1.4\,ms per query after a single conditioning pass. The same kernel transfers across resolutions and admits corrections for mild nonlinearities, including radiative losses and temperature-dependent conductivity, without retraining, at the cost of lower in-distribution accuracy.

</details>


### [564] [Anomaly Detection and Localization for the Pantograph-Catenary System](https://arxiv.org/abs/2610.01721)
*Francesco Vitale,Hangli Ge,Francesco Flammini*

Main category: cs.LG

TL;DR: 本文提出一种将受电弓-接触网系统（PCS）的高度/之字形测量与参考线路GPS标称坐标对齐进行定位，并基于集体异常检测评估PCS健康状态的框架，在意大利铁路真实工业数据集上验证了其定位与检测性能。


<details>
  <summary>Details</summary>
Motivation: 现有基于视频监控与卷积神经网络的工业方案虽能追踪PCS接触线高度与之字形（PCS高度/之字形），但未考虑列车线路的地理位置信息，导致测量结果缺乏与具体里程/地点的对应关系，难以支撑线路基础设施与受电弓健康状态的精细化评估。

Method: 提出一个新颖框架，包含两个核心环节：1）利用参考线路的标称GPS坐标对PCS高度/之字形测量进行对齐定位（localization）；2）采用集体异常检测（collective anomaly detection）方法评估PCS健康状态。方法在真实工业数据集上进行应用与评估。

Result: 在由某铁路运输公司提供的真实工业数据集上开展了案例研究，该数据集涵盖意大利铁路多条线路上若干列车行程的PCS高度/之字形数据；论文对框架的定位性能与异常检测性能均进行了评估与验证。

Conclusion: 通过将PCS高度/之字形测量与参考线路GPS坐标对齐并结合集体异常检测，可在真实铁路运营数据中实现PCS健康状态的定位化评估，弥补现有视频监控方案缺乏地理定位信息的不足。

Abstract: Monitoring the Pantograph-Catenary System (PCS) provides insight into the health conditions of the pantograph and the railway infrastructure. Recent industrial solutions trace the pantograph's contact wire height and stagger (PCS height/stagger) using video monitoring through convolutional neural networks. However, these solutions do not account for the train route's geographic location. Therefore, in this paper we propose a novel framework for 1) localization of the PCS height/stagger by alignment with the nominal GPS coordinates of the reference route, and 2) collective anomaly detection to evaluate the health conditions of the PCS. We apply and assess the localization and detection performance of the methodology to a case-study based on a real-world industrial dataset provided by a railway transportation company, which includes the PCS height/stagger of several train journeys across Italian railway routes.

</details>


### [565] [RelICL: Training-free Relational Learning with Tabular Foundation Models](https://arxiv.org/abs/2610.01725)
*Simon Forbat,Rainer Gemulla*

Main category: cs.LG

TL;DR: 本文针对关系型学习中使用深度特征合成（DFS）扁平化关系模式存在的特征爆炸和交互盲区两大问题，提出替代方法 RelICL，通过在模式图上逐步传播与融合信息来保留 DFS 优势并缓解上述问题，在 RelBench 任务上达到与最强 DFS 方法相当的性能。


<details>
  <summary>Details</summary>
Motivation: 表格基础模型无需训练即可在单表任务上取得最优性能；近期研究表明其也可借助 DFS 将关系模式扁平化为单表来做关系型学习，且能直接受益于底层表格基础模型的改进与定制。但 DFS 存在两个关键问题：一是随着模式复杂度增加，DFS 特征数量快速增长，导致特征爆炸，限制可扩展性与性能；二是按列聚合无法考虑特征之间的交互，即交互盲区，限制性能。

Method: 提出并探索替代方法 RelICL。其核心是在模式图上逐步传播并融合信息，并且使用最终用于预测的同一个表格基础模型来完成这一传播与融合过程，从而在保留 DFS 优势的同时缓解特征爆炸与交互盲区问题。

Result: 在 RelBench 任务上的实验研究表明，RelICL 的性能与基于深度特征合成的最强方法相当（on par）。

Conclusion: RelICL 作为一种替代 DFS 的关系型学习方法，能够规避特征爆炸与交互盲区，在 RelBench 上达到与最强 DFS 方法相当的效果，表明基于表格基础模型在模式图上逐步传播融合信息是一个有前景的方向。

Abstract: Tabular foundation models achieve state-of-the-art performance on single-table tasks without any training. Recent work suggests that they are also well-suited for relational learning via deep feature synthesis (DFS), which flattens a relational schema into a single table by adding aggregates of the other tables' columns as features. This approach is appealing because it directly benefits from improvements to or customization of the underlying tabular foundation model. In this paper, we identify two key problems with DFS: feature explosion and interaction blindness. The first problem arises because the number of DFS features grows quickly as the schema becomes more complex, limiting scalability and performance. The second problem arises because column-wise aggregates do not account for feature interactions, limiting performance. We propose and explore an alternative method termed RelICL, which keeps the benefits of DFS but alleviates these two problems. At its heart, RelICL propagates and fuses information step by step through the schema graph, using the same tabular foundation model that is eventually used for prediction to do so. In our experimental study using RelBench tasks, RelICL was on par with the strongest approach based on deep feature synthesis.

</details>


### [566] [Removing spurious minima for planar features by skip connections](https://arxiv.org/abs/2610.01728)
*Jakob Paul Zimmermann,Moritz Grillo,Andrei Balakin,Georg Loho*

Main category: cs.LG

TL;DR: 研究无偏置浅层ReLU网络在高斯总体损失下的损失景观：引入可学习线性跳跃后，当学生网络宽度≥教师网络时，可消除所有输出权重非负的伪局部极小；而无跳跃时，构造出任意过参数化仍存在伪极小值的反例。


<details>
  <summary>Details</summary>
Motivation: 理解损失景观结构是解释神经网络训练的核心，但即便在简单模型中其结构也仅被部分认识。作者选取teacher-student框架下无偏置浅层ReLU网络的高斯总体损失作为简单模型，以研究特征学习与过参数化等本质问题。

Method: 在teacher-student设定下研究浅层无偏置ReLU网络的高斯总体损失。针对输出权重为正、特征为平面的教师网络，分析加入可学习线性跳跃(linear skip)后学生网络的临界点结构；并对比无跳跃情形，构造反例。进一步分析局部极小处学生特征方向与教师特征张成子空间的关系，以及二维情形下有效宽度受教师宽度控制的性质，最后将良性结果推广到任意半径参数球上的经验极小。

Result: 1) 对输出权重为正、平面特征的教师网络，当学生宽度≥教师宽度时，加入可学习线性跳跃可消除所有学生输出权重非负的伪局部极小；2) 无跳跃时，构造出输入维度为2、仅含3个隐藏神经元的固定教师网络，其伪局部极小在任意学生宽度≥3时持续存在，说明线性跳跃能消除任意过参数化也无法去除的伪极小；3) 输出权重非负的学生网络在局部极小处的特征始终落在教师特征张成的子空间内，即总能学到教师特征子空间；4) 在二维ReLU网络中，即使学生网络严重过参数化，其有效宽度仍受教师宽度控制——每个输出权重为正的临界点，其不同学生特征方向数至多为教师神经元数的两倍；5) 良性结果可推广至任意指定半径参数球上的经验极小，所需采样精度依赖于该半径。

Conclusion: 可学习线性跳跃是消除伪局部极小、实现良性优化的关键结构，而无跳跃时伪极小可抵抗任意过参数化；同时学生网络的有效宽度本质上受教师宽度限制，且关于总体损失的良性结论可迁移至有限样本的经验极小，采样精度取决于参数球半径。

Abstract: Understanding loss landscapes is central to explaining neural-network training, yet their structure remains only partially understood even in simple models. We study the Gaussian population loss of shallow, bias-free ReLU networks in the teacher--student setting. This provides a simple model for studying essential aspects such as feature learning and overparameterization. For teacher networks with positive output weights and planar features, we show that including a learned linear skip removes all spurious local minima with non-negative student output weights once the student network is at least as wide as the teacher network. In contrast, without the skip, we construct a fixed teacher network with positive output weights and only three hidden neurons in input dimension two whose spurious local minima persist at every student width at least three. Thus, a learned linear skip can remove spurious minima that persist under arbitrary overparameterization. Furthermore, we show that a positive output weight student network always learns the subspace spanned by the teacher features: student features at local minima with non-negative student output weights lie in the span of the teacher features. For ReLU networks in two dimensions, even heavily overparameterized student networks have effective width controlled by the teacher width: every critical point with positive student output weights has at most twice as many distinct student feature directions as teacher neurons. Finally, we transfer the benignity result to empirical minima over parameter balls of any prescribed radius, with the required sampling accuracy depending on that radius.

</details>


### [567] [Function-Structured Reinforcement Learning with Executable Verifiers for Mathematical Reasoning](https://arxiv.org/abs/2610.01729)
*Zihan Liu,Xurong Xie*

Main category: cs.LG

TL;DR: 本文提出函数结构化图强化学习（FSG-RL），将子问题图与Python实现及多验证器反馈相连接，先用SFT学习从函数图生成代码，再用GRPO配合答案门控奖励与跨度级信用分配优化策略，在GSM8K、MathQA、MATH和Omni-MATH构建的基准上显著超越SFT。


<details>
  <summary>Details</summary>
Motivation: 算法数学推理需要可靠的分解、计算与聚合。最终答案奖励对中间错误的指导有限，而成功执行代码也不能保证数学正确性，因此需要更细粒度的过程监督与验证机制。

Method: 提出FSG-RL框架，连接子问题图与Python实现，并引入多验证器反馈。策略先通过监督微调（SFT）学习从函数图生成代码；随后使用组相对策略优化（GRPO），结合答案门控奖励和跨度级信用分配进行优化。框架还支持教师监督与结构化记忆。基准由GSM8K、MathQA、MATH、Omni-MATH整理，配对公开函数图与私有验证规范。

Result: 在统一评测协议下，GRPO相较SFT将最终答案准确率从43.25%提升至67.50%，完整解答成功率从32.25%提升至52.25%。在教师监督下继续进行强化学习可获得额外增益。提升不仅限于生成格式正确的代码。

Conclusion: 实验结果支持验证器引导的强化学习用于数学推理，表明结构化图表示、多验证器反馈与细粒度信用分配能够有效提升算法数学推理的可靠性与正确性。

Abstract: Algorithmic mathematical reasoning requires reliable decomposition, computation, and aggregation. Final-answer rewards provide limited guidance on intermediate errors, while successful execution does not guarantee mathematical correctness. This work proposes Function-Structured Graph Reinforcement Learning (FSG-RL), connecting subproblem graphs and Python implementations with multi-verifier feedback. The policy first learns to generate code from function graphs through supervised fine-tuning (SFT). Group Relative Policy Optimization (GRPO) then optimizes the policy using answer-gated rewards and span-level credit assignment. The framework also supports teacher supervision and structured memory. A benchmark curated from Grade School Math 8K (GSM8K), MathQA, MATH, and Omni-MATH pairs public function graphs with private verification specifications. Under a unified evaluation protocol, GRPO improves final-answer accuracy from 43.25% to 67.50% and full solution success from 32.25% to 52.25% over SFT. Continued reinforcement learning (RL) with teacher supervision yields additional gains. The gains extend beyond producing correctly formatted code, supporting verifier-guided reinforcement learning for mathematical reasoning. Code is available at https://github.com/ZihanLiummyycc/FSG-RL.

</details>


### [568] [Fixed-point neural samplers on discrete spaces](https://arxiv.org/abs/2610.01739)
*Jiajun He,Denis Blessing,Mouyang Cheng,Yuanqi Du,Carles Domingo-Enrich*

Main category: cs.LG

TL;DR: 提出离散 Gibbs 迭代神经采样器（Discrete Gibbs Iterative Neural Sampler），一种基于掩码扩散的不动点神经采样框架，缓解模式崩溃、支持高维扩展、条件摊销采样并可用于合金相图估计。


<details>
  <summary>Details</summary>
Motivation: 从离散、未归一化分布中采样且无法访问训练数据本身是一类困难问题。现有离散神经采样器存在三方面不足：易发生模式崩溃；以不动点迭代训练时缺乏收敛保证；且通常绑定于特定参考过程（如掩码扩散或均匀扩散），限制了通用性。

Method: 构建离散 Gibbs 迭代神经采样器：一种不动点（fixed-point）神经采样器，以掩码扩散（masked diffusion）为基础框架，并将其推广至任意两分布之间的传输（transport between pairs of distributions），从而不依赖单一参考过程；训练过程依据密度评估进行，具备收敛性方面的考量。

Result: 该方法可有效扩展至高维系统，支持跨不同条件的摊销采样（amortized sampling），并能准确估计合金相图；在实践中显著减少了模式崩溃。

Conclusion: 该工作针对离散神经采样器的模式崩溃、收敛缺乏保证与参考过程绑定等局限给出统一的不动点框架，验证了其在高维、条件化与材料相图等任务上的有效性与可扩展性。

Abstract: Sampling from discrete, unnormalized distributions without access to data is a challenging problem. Neural samplers offer a promising approach by training generative models from density evaluations directly. Despite recent progress, existing discrete neural samplers are prone to mode collapse, come without convergence guarantees when trained via fixed-point iterations, and are often tied to a specific reference process such as masked or uniform diffusion. In this work, we introduce Discrete Gibbs Iterative Neural Sampler, a fixed-point neural sampler that addresses these limitations, enabling efficient, scalable learning, substantially reducing mode collapse in practice. Our framework builds on masked diffusion and also extends to transport between pairs of distributions. We demonstrate that the resulting method scales effectively to high-dimensional systems, supports amortized sampling across different conditions, and enables accurate estimation of alloy phase diagrams.

</details>


### [569] [Evidence-Gated Research: Statistically Controlled Model Adoption in Adaptive Search](https://arxiv.org/abs/2610.01751)
*Yifan Guo*

Main category: cs.LG

TL;DR: 论文提出证据门控研究（EGR），一种面向“移动在位者”自适应模型搜索的统计采纳层，通过对挑战者在证据揭示前冻结、构建随时有效证据、可预测路由与持久候选 e-value 并交由在线控制器，在条件有效性与可预测性条件下控制全环境采纳目标的 FDR，并在基准中显著提升证据效率。


<details>
  <summary>Details</summary>
Motivation: 自适应模型搜索具有路径依赖性：一旦某挑战者被采纳，它就成为后续候选生成的参照，因此一次统计上缺乏支持的替换会改变尚未被提出的假设，导致误差沿搜索轨迹累积，而传统仅对单次比较或固定序列的统计控制无法应对这种“移动在位者”结构。作者希望将模型替换识别为独立且需要专门统计控制的决策点。

Method: 提出 Evidence-Gated Research（EGR）作为移动在位者搜索的统计采纳层。其做法包括：在决策证据揭示前冻结每个挑战者；在一组预先声明的环境上构建 anytime-valid 证据；将证据可预测地路由到尚未解决的分量；组合出持久候选 e-value；再将该 e-value 传给在线控制器。理论分析在显式的条件有效性（conditional validity）与可预测性（predictability）条件下证明该过程对声明的全环境采纳目标控制 FDR，即使先前采纳已改变后续挑战者。

Result: 在 5,000 条轨迹的闭环基准中，仅用开发集的 e-LOND 出现持久 FDR 0.621，而审计的 EGR 变体在该有限运行中未观察到持久错误采纳路径；在 600 对挑战者—在位者的匹配重放中，Stagewise EGR 在代表性阈值下保持固定 anytime 的替代交叉决策，同时减少 56.1% 的决策证据；三环境公开数据研究与 40,000 样本的受控神经基准重现了证据效率模式。

Conclusion: 结果表明，模型替换是自适应模型开发中一个独立的统计控制点；EGR 为路径依赖的自适应搜索提供了可证明的 FDR 控制与更高的证据效率，提示未来自适应开发流程应将采纳决策本身纳入统计框架。

Abstract: Adaptive model search is path dependent: once a challenger is adopted, it becomes the reference from which later candidates are generated. A statistically unsupported replacement can therefore alter hypotheses that have not yet been proposed. We introduce Evidence-Gated Research (EGR), a statistical adoption layer for moving-incumbent search. EGR freezes each challenger before decision evidence is revealed, builds anytime-valid evidence across a predeclared set of environments, routes evidence predictably toward unresolved components, composes a persistent candidate e-value, and passes that e-value to an online controller. Under explicit conditional-validity and predictability conditions, the resulting procedure controls false discovery rate for the declared all-environment adoption target even though earlier adoptions change later challengers. In a 5,000-trajectory closed-loop benchmark, development-only e-LOND attains persistent FDR 0.621, whereas no persistent false-adoption path is observed for the audited EGR variants in that finite run. In matched replay over 600 challenger--incumbent pairs, Stagewise EGR preserves fixed-anytime alternative crossing decisions while using 56.1% less decision evidence at the representative threshold. A three-environment public-data study and a 40,000-sample controlled neural benchmark reproduce the evidence-efficiency pattern. These results identify model replacement as a distinct statistical control point in adaptive model development.

</details>


### [570] [Physics-Refined Spatiotemporal Forecasting on Open-Boundary Hydrologic Graphs](https://arxiv.org/abs/2610.01765)
*Haoyang Jiang,Zhengui Wang,Shenghan Gao,Y. Joseph Zhang,Xingquan Zhu,Yi He*

Main category: cs.LG

TL;DR: 该论文针对开边界水文图上时空预测的不稳定性问题，提出学习"幽灵节点代理"近似未观测外部强迫，并借助两个物理精炼器控制自回归误差累积。


<details>
  <summary>Details</summary>
Motivation: 开边界系统会与未观测的外部区域交换通量，边界节点受到上游入流、潮汐信号等外部强迫，但这些信息在预测时刻往往不可得。缺失该信息会在自回归预测中逐层放大误差，导致长时程性能下降。

Method: 提出一个包含两部分的计算框架：(1) 从边界节点与内部节点学习幽灵节点代理（ghost node proxies），近似未观测的外部输入以补偿边界强迫；(2) 使用两个物理精炼器抑制误差累积——一个通过将幽灵代理与其两跳邻居（边界节点及其直接内部节点）对齐来强制局部一致性，另一个通过物理引导的图神经算子校正模型预测，提升全局稳定性、减少长时程数值漂移。

Result: 在两个真实水文图上进行实证评估，与基于学习的模型和物理信息模型对比，所提方法在预测精度和长时程稳定性上均取得更优表现。

Conclusion: 通过学习代理建模缺失的边界强迫，并结合局部一致性与全局稳定性的物理精炼，可有效缓解开边界水文图自回归预测中的不稳定性，提升长期预测精度。

Abstract: Spatiotemporal forecasting on hydrologic graphs is especially prone to instability in open-boundary systems, where the forecast domain exchanges fluxes with an unobserved exterior. In such systems, boundary nodes receive external forcing, e.g., upstream inflows in rivers or tidal signals in coastal regions, that is typically unavailable at prediction time. The absence of this information can compound errors as forecasts unfold in an autoregressive fashion, leading to inferior long-horizon performance. This paper dissects this instability issue by exploring two questions. 1) What boundary forcing enters the forecast domain when information beyond the boundary is missing? 2) How should this forcing propagate through the domain without incurring error amplification under autoregressive rollout?
  To address both, we propose a new computing framework comprising two key components. First, to compensate for the boundary forcing, our framework learns ghost node proxies from the boundary and interior nodes, striving to approximate unobserved external inputs. Second, to control error accumulation from these learned proxies, we leverage two physics refiners. In particular, one refiner enforces local consistency by aligning ghost proxies with their two-hop neighbors (i.e., boundary nodes and their immediate interiors). The other refiner enhances global stability by correcting the model forecasts through a physics-guided graph neural operator, reducing long-horizon numerical drift. Two real-world hydrologic graphs are employed for empirical evaluation. Comparative results show that our proposal enjoys higher prediction accuracy and long-horizon stability over both learning-based and physics-informed model competitors.

</details>


### [571] [SAGE: Similarity-Based Cleaning of Poisoned Training Data from Verified Examples](https://arxiv.org/abs/2610.01788)
*Chaeeun Han,Soodeh Atefi,Yevgeniy Vorobeychik,Aron Laszka*

Main category: cs.LG

TL;DR: 提出SAGE方法，仅依赖少量经过专家验证的干净与投毒样本，通过非参数相似度加权预测检测训练集中的投毒样本，在七个clean-label攻击基准上取得显著效果。


<details>
  <summary>Details</summary>
Motivation: 机器学习依赖公开且不可信的公开数据源，数据投毒攻击威胁日益严重。现有防御要么假设对哪些样本被投毒毫无真实信息，要么假设拥有大量已验证的干净样本；后者验证成本极高，对干净标签攻击尤为突出，因此需要一种只需少量验证样本的防御方案。

Method: 提出SAGE（Similarity-based Approach for Ground-truth-driven Exclusion）：在独立数据集上训练通用特征提取器，然后基于包含干净与投毒样本的小规模验证集，采用非参数、相似度加权的预测方式标记训练样本中的投毒样本。

Result: 在标准基准上针对七种clean-label攻击方法进行评估，仅需少量已验证投毒样本即可带来显著优势；且验证集干净样本在各类别间的分布比验证样本数量更为重要。

Conclusion: 少量经专家验证的样本（包括干净和投毒样本）足以有效检测投毒数据，验证样本的类别分布均衡性比样本数量更关键，为降低数据验证成本提供了可行路径。

Abstract: As machine learning increasingly relies on public, untrusted data sources, data poisoning attacks, which inject malicious examples into training data to induce misclassification of a chosen target, pose a growing threat. Existing defenses either assume zero ground-truth information about which examples are poisoned, or they assume access to a large set of examples verified to be clean. Satisfying the latter assumption incurs significant cost since reliable verification can be very resource- or labor-intensive. This cost is particularly high for clean-label attacks, where poisoned examples are visually indistinguishable from clean data. Since requiring a large set of verified examples is impractical, we propose relying on a small set of verified examples including both clean and poisoned ones, i.e., each example verified either to be clean or poisoned through inspection by a forensic expert. The challenge is then to detect poisons based on a set of verified examples that is so small that most classification models would overfit. To address this challenge, we propose Similarity-based Approach for Ground-truth-driven Exclusion (SAGE), which trains a generic feature extractor on a separate dataset and then flags poisoned training examples using a non-parametric, similarity-weighted prediction based on the verified set. On standard benchmarks against seven clean-label attack methods, we demonstrate that having access to even a handful of verified poisoned examples provides a substantial advantage. We also find that the distribution of verified clean examples across classes matters more than the number of verified examples.

</details>


### [572] [iADD: Improving Alignment and Diversity in Diffusion Policy Optimization](https://arxiv.org/abs/2610.01789)
*Ashok Prasad Neupane,Saugat Adhikari,Pramish Paudel,Ajad Chhatkuli,Danda Pani Paudel*

Main category: cs.LG

TL;DR: 本文针对扩散模型强化学习后训练（如DDPO）中奖励优化牺牲多样性与质量的问题，通过理论分析与方法改进，提出基于Feynman-Kac的增量式训练方法，实现了目前最优的对齐-多样性权衡。


<details>
  <summary>Details</summary>
Motivation: 现有基于强化学习的扩散模型后训练方法（如DDPO）在优化奖励函数时，往往以牺牲生成样本的多样性和质量为代价，亟需在保持对齐性能的同时改善多样性-质量权衡。

Method: 一方面进行理论分析，数学上证明扩散模型仅在后期时间步（only-latter timestep）进行更新可能损害多样性，这与先前工作的结论相反；另一方面提出一种具有坚实理论基础的增量式Feynman-Kac训练方法，以改善对齐与多样性的权衡。

Result: 在三种不同任务上，与相关扩散策略优化方法进行大量对比实验，并对每个组件进行了充分的消融实验，验证了在对齐与多样性两方面均取得显著性能提升。

Conclusion: 通过严谨的理论分析与方法设计，所提方法在扩散模型强化学习后训练中实现了迄今最优的对齐-多样性权衡，并得到实验与消融的有效验证。

Abstract: Reinforcement learning based post training of diffusion models, such as Denoising Diffusion Policy Optimization (DDPO), optimizes a reverse diffusion process under a reward function. However, current approaches to reward optimizations do so at the cost of diversity and quality. In this paper, we provide better tradeoffs through careful theoretical considerations and method design. We analyze the theoretical framework and mathematically demonstrate that \emph{only-latter timestep} updates of diffusion model may be harmful for diversity contrary to the conclusions presented in a previous work. Additionally, we propose an incremental Feynman-Kac training based on strong theoretical foundations in order to achieve the best-yet alignment-diversity tradeoffs. We perform extensive experiments and compare our method against related diffusion policy optimization approaches in three different tasks and also provide strong ablations for each component, thus validating strong performance gains in both alignment and diversity.

</details>


### [573] [SkillEvoLean: Mutation-enhanced skill evolution for Lean provers](https://arxiv.org/abs/2610.01799)
*Kuo Zhou,ZiXion Yang,Lu Zhang*

Main category: cs.LG

TL;DR: 本文提出一种面向 Lean 证明器的“变异增强技能自演化”框架，在参数不更新的前提下联合演化求解策略与参考知识，在 MiniF2F、PutnamBench、IMO 2025、USAMO 2026 上取得领先的证明成功率。


<details>
  <summary>Details</summary>
Motivation: 技能演化可在不更新参数的情况下提升大模型智能体，但在形式化定理证明中探索不足。现有方法主要针对自然语言推理，依赖对成功/失败轨迹的分析来增量修正策略；当所有采样轨迹均失败时，缺乏成功轨迹以推断有效更新方向。此外现有方法多聚焦根指令文件，对数学概念与证明技巧等参考知识的演化关注不足。

Method: 提出变异增强的技能自演化框架，构建技能增强的 Lean 证明器，联合演化高层求解策略与其参考知识，采用渐进式与基于变异的更新：渐进演化从成功与失败轨迹中提取局部改进；当无法生成完整证明时触发变异，采样数学概念以生成并筛选新的技能候选，并依据验证器反馈进行选择。

Result: 在 MiniF2F、PutnamBench、IMO 2025、USAMO 2026 上评测，相同骨干模型、轨迹采样预算与测试时算力下，使用 GPT-5.5 的证明成功率分别为 100.0%、90.6%、4/6、4/6，优于基线。消融显示，概念引导变异在 MiniF2F 与 PutnamBench 上分别比随机文本引导变异高 6.9 与 8.2 个百分点，并在 IMO 2025 与 USAMO 2026 上各多解出一题。

Conclusion: 该框架通过渐进演化与变异增强相结合，克服了全失败场景下缺乏成功轨迹的更新瓶颈，并将技能演化扩展到参考知识层面，验证了概念引导变异在形式化定理证明中的有效性。

Abstract: Skill evolution offers a promising way to improve large language model agents without updating their parameters, but its use in formal theorem proving remains underexplored. Existing methods mainly target natural-language reasoning, improving skills by analyzing successful and failed trajectories and incrementally revising solving strategies. Although the Lean verifier provides reliable execution feedback, when all sampled trajectories fail, existing skill evolution methods lack successful trajectories from which to infer effective update directions. Furthermore, these methods also focus mainly on the root instruction file, thus underexploring the evolution of reference knowledge including mathematical concepts and proving techniques. To address these limitations, we propose a mutation-enhanced skill self-evolution framework for building skill-augmented Lean provers. The framework jointly evolves a high-level solving policy and its reference knowledge through progressive and mutation-based updates. Progressive evolution derives local improvements from successful and failed trajectories, while mutation is triggered when no complete proof can be generated, sampling mathematical concepts to produce and select new skill candidates under verifier feedback. We evaluate our method on MiniF2F, PutnamBench, the 2025 International Mathematical Olympiad (IMO 2025), and the 2026 USA Mathematical Olympiad (USAMO 2026). Under the same backbone model, trajectorysampling budget, and test-time compute, our method achieves proof success rates of 100.0%, 90.6%, 4/6, and 4/6, respectively, with GPT-5.5, outperforming the baseline methods. Further analysis shows that concept-guided mutation outperforms random-text-guided mutation by 6.9 and 8.2 percentage points on MiniF2F and PutnamBench, respectively, while solving one additional problem on both IMO 2025 and USAMO 2026.

</details>


### [574] [Debias Anything: Fairness with Diversity without Supervision in Diffusion Models](https://arxiv.org/abs/2610.01815)
*Théau d'Audiffret,Mariia Vladimirova,Jean-Yves Franceschi*

Main category: cs.LG

TL;DR: 提出一种通用扩散模型去偏方法，通过适配器连接冻结的扩散模型与预训练视觉-语言嵌入空间，在无需敏感属性标注的情况下联合实现公平性与多样性引导，适用于无条件与文本条件模型。


<details>
  <summary>Details</summary>
Motivation: 扩散模型会复现并放大训练数据中的人口统计失衡。现有去偏方法（如分类器引导、显式文本额外条件）依赖敏感属性标注或额外条件，降低适用性与输出多样性；而仅提升多样性的方法又无法保证属性表征公平。因此需要一种同时兼顾公平与多样性、且通用性强的方法。

Method: 用适配器将冻结的扩散模型连接到预训练的视觉-语言嵌入空间，从而在无需敏感属性标注下进行公平与多样性引导。公平性方面，用成对文本提示定义属性方向，引导批次组成趋向特定比例；多样性方面，引入一个分数衡量该表征所推导的语义估计之间的一致性差异。该公式化支持无条件与文本条件扩散模型，且不需要敏感属性的先验知识或数据。

Result: 实验证实，在可比的公平性水平下，该方法提升了生成图像的质量分数与多样性分数。

Conclusion: 该方法可普遍应用于任意扩散模型与任意敏感属性，在不需要敏感属性标注与先验知识的条件下，联合改善公平性与多样性，同时保持甚至提升生成质量。

Abstract: Although diffusion models produce high-quality images, they also reproduce and amplify demographic imbalances in their training data. Debiasing their generation process post-training w.r.t. some sensitive attribute usually relies on classifier guidance or explicit text extra-conditioning, but this reduces methods' applicability and output diversity. Conversely, methods promoting diversity alone do not ensure fair attribute representation. In this paper, we propose a method tackling fairness and diversity jointly that is generally applicable to any diffusion model and any sensitive attribute. To this end, an adapter connects the frozen diffusion model to a pretrained vision-language embedding space, enabling fairness and diversity guidance without sensitive-attribute annotations. For fairness, pairs of text prompts define attribute directions which guide batch composition towards specific proportions. For diversity, we introduce a score measuring disagreement between the semantic estimates derived from this representation. The formulation supports unconditional and text-conditional diffusion models, while requiring no prior knowledge or data of sensitive attribute. Experiments confirm that our method improves quality and diversity scores at comparable fairness levels.

</details>


### [575] [MECHVAR: Variance-Guided Mechanism Discrimination for Autonomous Machine Learning Experiment Selection](https://arxiv.org/abs/2610.01819)
*Yifan Guo*

Main category: cs.LG

TL;DR: 论文提出MECHVAR，用于有限候选机制库下的序贯实验选择；该准则在共享高斯预测模型下等价于Box–Hill后验加权成对KL准则，具备O(KE)向量化重评分与可加性审计能力，并在压力测试与Digits实验中验证了竞争力与效率。


<details>
  <summary>Details</summary>
Motivation: 基准性能提升往往机制不明：复现改进本身无法说明改进为何发生，因此需要主动实验来判别候选机制。在有限机制库、有限实验预算下，顺序选择最具判别力的探针成为一个序贯实验设计问题。

Method: 将问题形式化为有限库机制判别下的序贯实验选择，定义后验加权候选机制、可执行探针与预算约束。MECHVAR以预测响应的后验加权方差最大化为准则选择下一个探针；在共享高斯预测模型下，该得分与经典Box–Hill后验加权成对KL准则成正比，并支持O(KE)向量化重评分及机制对的可加性审计；局部展开在预测响应间隔较小时将得分与期望信息增益（EIG）联系起来。

Result: 25块压力审计中，MECHVAR在若干中等误设情形下优于confirmation-first，但与EIG的主要比较在统计上未定论。留出Digits循环中，归一化机制识别AUC为MECHVAR 0.8975、score-greedy 0.7825、EIG 0.9092。在K=100、E=200、单线程条件下，MECHVAR全库评分中位时间为10.36微秒，六节点求积EIG为57.69毫秒。

Conclusion: 当共享预测尺度是可辩护的近似时，MECHVAR为有限库实验选择提供了一种轻量、可审计的采集规则，兼具计算效率与机制判别性能。

Abstract: Benchmark gains are often mechanism-ambiguous: reproducing an improvement does not by itself identify why it occurs. We study finite-library mechanism discrimination, where posterior-weighted candidate mechanisms, executable probes, and a limited experimental budget define a sequential experiment-selection problem. MECHVAR selects the next probe by maximizing the posterior-weighted variance of its predicted responses. Under a shared-Gaussian predictive model, this score is exactly proportional to the classical Box--Hill posterior-weighted pairwise-KL criterion, yet it admits O(KE) vectorized rescoring and a transparent additive audit over mechanism pairs. A local expansion further links the score to expected information gain (EIG) when predicted response separations are small. In a 25-block stress audit, MECHVAR outperforms confirmation-first in several moderate misspecification regimes, while its primary comparisons with EIG remain statistically unresolved. In a held-out Digits loop, normalized mechanism-identification AUC is 0.8975 for MECHVAR, 0.7825 for a score-greedy policy, and 0.9092 for EIG. At K = 100, E = 200, median single-thread full-library scoring is 10.36 microseconds for MECHVAR versus 57.69 ms for six-node quadrature EIG in the recorded environment. MECHVAR therefore provides a lightweight, auditable acquisition rule for finite-library experiment selection when a shared predictive scale is a defensible approximation.

</details>


### [576] [Scientific Discovery under Validation Congestion via Multi-Fidelity Pairwise Rankings](https://arxiv.org/abs/2610.01827)
*Kevin Tirta Wijaya,Alston Lo,Michael Sun,Wojciech Matusik,Vahid Babaei*

Main category: cs.LG

TL;DR: 提出PRISMS框架，用多层级专家的成对排序替代回归模型驱动候选筛选，并按Fisher信息准则在低/高保真排序器间升级查询，在筛选与优化任务中均优于基线。


<details>
  <summary>Details</summary>
Motivation: 现代计算方法能大规模生成候选分子、材料与设计，但实验验证能力有限，形成"验证拥堵"。现有筛选方法多依赖数据驱动的回归模型预测绝对分数，而训练这类模型本身需要大量实验数据；然而科学设计发现常具有比较性质，成对排序信号更易获取，因此有必要摆脱对数据饥渴型回归器的依赖。

Method: 提出PRISMS框架：以来自一个或多个专家（可跨多个专业层级，包括计算工具、经验法则、智能体工作流乃至资深科学家）的成对排序作为主要筛选信号来识别最有前景的候选。当专家在保真度与成本上存在差异时，依据Fisher信息准则将成对查询从低保真排序器逐级升级到高保真排序器。在固定药物发现库的迭代筛选中将其与仅回归的主动学习、无选择性升级的排序方法对比；在不受预定义库限制的生成式优化中与贝叶斯优化基线对比。

Result: 在固定药物发现库的迭代筛选中，PRISMS达到50%的top-10发现召回率所需轮次比仅回归的主动学习少约42%，比无选择性升级的排序方法少约15%。在生成新设计的优化任务中，PRISMS的超体积（hypervolume）比贝叶斯优化基线高约18.8%。

Conclusion: 以专家成对排序为核心、并结合基于Fisher信息准则的多保真度选择性升级，能够在不依赖数据饥渴型回归器的前提下高效筛选候选设计，并在筛选与生成式优化两类任务上均优于现有基线，为缓解验证拥堵提供了可扩展的策展范式。

Abstract: Modern computational methods can now propose candidate molecules, materials, and other scientific designs at an unprecedented scale, creating a validation congestion where candidates are abundant, but experimental capacity to physically evaluate them remains scarce. Discovering novel scientific designs has therefore become increasingly dependent on curation: selecting a small set of promising designs for slow and costly experiments. Existing curation methods typically rely on data-driven regression models that predict absolute scores, but training these models requires substantial experimental data to begin with. Yet, useful curation signals do not have to take the form of absolute measurements, as scientific design discovery is often comparative in nature. Here, we propose that curation can instead be primarily driven by expert pairwise rankings, which are substantially easier to gather. The expertise can come from computational tools or human input of multiple levels of fidelity, ranging from empirical rules of thumb to agentic workflows and experienced scientists. We introduce PRISMS, a framework that uses pairwise rankings from one or more experts, potentially spanning multiple levels of expertise, to identify the most promising candidates without relying on data-hungry regressors. When experts differ in fidelity and cost, PRISMS escalates pairwise queries from lower- to higher-fidelity rankers based on a Fisher-information criterion. In iterative screening that selects designs from fixed drug discovery libraries, PRISMS achieves 50% top-10 discovery recall in ~42% fewer rounds than regression-only active learning, and in ~15% fewer rounds than the ranking-based method with no selective escalation. In optimization that generates new designs without restriction to a predefined library, PRISMS achieves ~18.8% higher hypervolume than the Bayesian optimization baseline.

</details>


### [577] [Pooling Helps, Learned Weighting Hurts In-Context: Decomposing Group Attention](https://arxiv.org/abs/2610.01831)
*Michael Fore,James Mason Inder,Mrishika Nair,Praneetha Vaddamanu,Sharlina Keshava*

Main category: cs.LG

TL;DR: 该论文对 Chronos-2 提出的 group attention 进行机制拆解，发现其收益主要来自 V/O 的均匀池化，而非学习到的 Q/K 权重；Q/K 权重在 MV 场景有益或中性，但在 ICL 场景显著有害。


<details>
  <summary>Details</summary>
Motivation: Chronos-2 提出 group attention（在固定 patch 索引上对组内变量做注意力），同时服务于多变量（MV）与上下文学习（ICL）预测，但该跨变量注意力设计作为一个整体并未被拆解评估。作者希望回答：机制中哪一部分真正带来收益，以及它对 MV 与 ICL 两种范式是否同样适用。

Method: 在推理阶段直接编辑注意力矩阵 α，将单个注意力头的两条通路分离：V/O（对组内做加权汇总并投影）与 Q/K（决定权重）。通过控制 α 的取值（如将其均匀化）来分别消融 Q/K 加权，考察均匀池化与学习权重各自的贡献；并进一步逐层隔离，定位关键层。

Result: 均匀池化（无 Q/K 加权的 V/O）在 20 个传感器网络配置中有 18 个为正收益；学习到的 Q/K 加权则依组类型分化：在 MV 上为正或可忽略，但在 10 个传感器网络 ICL 配置中有 8 个显著退化，其中 4 个甚至差于单变量推理。逐层分析显示，仅在第一个 block 中将 α 均匀化即可提升所有测试的 ICL 配置。

Conclusion: group attention 的收益主要来自 V/O 的均匀池化，而非 Q/K 的学习加权；Q/K 在 ICL 场景可能有害。因此跨变量注意力设计应被拆分评估，第一层均匀化 α 是一个简单有效的改进方向。

Abstract: Group attention, introduced by the time series forecasting model Chronos-2, attends over the variates of a group at a fixed patch index and serves both multivariate (MV) and in-context learning (ICL) forecasting. Rather than evaluating this cross-variate attention design as a whole, we ask which part of the mechanism earns the benefit and probe its applicability to both MV and ICL regimes. By editing the attention matrix $α$ at inference we separate the two pathways a head comprises: V/O, which projects a weighted summary of the group, and Q/K, which decides the weights. Uniform pooling (V/O without any Q/K weighting) is positive on 18 of our 20 sensor-network configurations, while the learned weighting (Q/K) splits by group type: its contribution is positive or negligible for MV, but materially degrades 8 of the 10 sensor-network ICL configurations, leaving 4 of them worse than univariate inference. By isolating the impact of different layers, we find that uniforming $α$ in the first block alone improves every ICL configuration we test.

</details>


### [578] [Flowing Faster to Coordinate: One-Step Online Multi-Agent Flow Policies](https://arxiv.org/abs/2610.01882)
*Zhuoran Li,Yunzhan Li,Xun Wang,Yihan Du,Longbo Huang*

Main category: cs.LG

TL;DR: 提出 OMAF，一种基于单步流模型的在线多智能体强化学习框架，用 Transformer 流策略兼顾表达力与高效动作生成，显著提升性能与样本效率。


<details>
  <summary>Details</summary>
Motivation: MARL 策略既要对复杂、多模态动作分布进行有表达力的建模，又需保证训练与执行的高效性。扩散类生成策略虽能忠实刻画复杂多模态行为，但其迭代采样成本高，制约了在在线多智能体场景中的可扩展性。

Method: OMAF 采用基于 Transformer 的流策略捕捉复杂协同行为，并以近似路径得分代理（approximate path score surrogate）为同步流策略优化提供理论路径；同时设计联合优化方案，将 softmax Q 值估计与联合流策略目标耦合，实现稳定、样本高效的协同策略学习，并通过消除迭代采样降低训练开销。

Result: 在 MPE 和 MAMuJoCo 的 10 个标准任务上，OMAF 一致取得更优性能，回报最高提升 3.4 倍，样本效率最高提升 10.5 倍。

Conclusion: OMAF 验证了单步流策略范式可作为在线 MARL 中兼具表达力与计算效率的有效方案。

Abstract: Multi-agent reinforcement learning (MARL) provides a powerful framework for learning coordinated behaviors through interactions with the environment. Developing MARL policies requires balancing expressive modeling of complex and multimodal action distributions with efficient training and execution. Generative policies, particularly diffusionbased policies, can faithfully capture complex and multimodal behaviors, but costly iterative sampling hinders their scalability in online multi-agent settings. We propose an Online MARL framework via one-step Flow model (OMAF) that combines expressive generative policies with efficient one-step action generation. OMAF employs a Transformer-based flow policy to capture complex coordination behaviors, while its approximate path score surrogate provides a principled route to synchronized flow policy optimization. To enable stable and sampleefficient learning, we further develop a joint optimization scheme coupling softmax Q-value estimation with a joint flow policy objective for coordinated policy learning. By eliminating iterative sampling, OMAF dramatically reduces training overhead without sacrificing policy expressiveness. Extensive experiments across 10 standard tasks from MPE and MAMuJoCo show that OMAF consistently achieves superior performance, with up to 3.4x higher returns and 10.5x sample efficiency improvement compared with baseline methods. These results validate the effectiveness of OMAF as an expressive and computationally efficient one-step flow policy paradigm for online MARL.

</details>


### [579] [Selection-Based Structured Reasoning: Toward Efficient Multimodal Search Agents](https://arxiv.org/abs/2610.01892)
*Feiyu Gavin Zhu,Xiaoyu Zhu,Jiqi Yang,Rui Yang,Arnab Kumar Mondal,Yancheng Wang,Xinke Deng,Jean Oh,Reid Simmons,Joerg Liebelt,Xiang Kong,Zhongyu Jiang*

Main category: cs.LG

TL;DR: 该论文提出 Selection-based Structured Reasoning (SSR)，将多模态智能体的推理从自由生成重formulate为从预设候选中的选择，实现并行打分，在七个多模态搜索基准上以2B/4B小模型取得显著效率提升且性能不降。


<details>
  <summary>Details</summary>
Motivation: 小模型能力有限，在每个动作前生成自由形式的推理往往冗长却缺乏对动作生成的有效指导，同时带来高昂的推理开销，因此需要一种更高效的推理范式。

Method: SSR将反复出现的高层推理表示为预先设定的、可复用的自然语言候选；每轮模型根据当前上下文对候选的似然进行选择，无需辅助任务头。预设推理轨迹支持并行打分：利用共享上下文KV cache，通过teacher-forced预填充在候选内部及候选之间并发计算token似然。

Result: 在七个多模态搜索基准上，用2B与4B模型、多种强化学习目标及监督微调进行评估。SSR在同规模搜索智能体中成功率具竞争力，同时将每轮推理延迟降低90%以上，将每题总模型推理延迟降低28%-54%。

Conclusion: 将推理重构为候选选择可在不牺牲任务性能的前提下大幅提升小模型多模态智能体的推理效率，验证了结构化、可复用推理候选与并行打分的有效性。

Abstract: Multimodal agents commonly generate free-form reasoning before each action. For small models, limited model capacity can result in lengthy reasoning that provides little useful guidance for action generation while incurring substantial inference cost. To address this challenge, we introduce Selection-based Structured Reasoning (SSR), a framework that reformulates reasoning as selection instead of open-ended generation. SSR represents recurring high-level reasoning as pre-specified, reusable natural-language candidates. At each turn, the model selects from these reasoning candidates based on their likelihoods given the current context, without requiring an auxiliary task head. Using pre-specified reasoning traces enables parallel scoring, where teacher-forced prefilling computes token likelihoods concurrently within and across candidates using a shared context KV cache. We evaluate SSR on seven multimodal search benchmarks using 2B and 4B models. Across multiple reinforcement learning objectives and supervised fine-tuning, SSR delivers significant efficiency gains without sacrificing task performance. SSR achieves an average success rate competitive with leading search agents of the same scale, while reducing per-turn reasoning latency by over 90% and total per-question model inference latency by 28-54%. Project page: https://zfy0314.github.io/ssr-webpage/.

</details>


### [580] [A foundation for systematic analysis of transformers and RNNs for tractography](https://arxiv.org/abs/2610.01894)
*Emmanuelle Renauld,Philippe Poulin,Hugo Larochelle,Antoine Théberge,Maxime Descoteaux*

Main category: cs.LG

TL;DR: 本文系统评估RNN与Transformer在扩散磁共振成像(dMRI)纤维追踪中的迭代式应用，提出"生成-验证"训练阶段以实现流线级监督，在ISMRM2015数据集上取得迄今最佳性能，并量化了训练集缺陷的影响。


<details>
  <summary>Details</summary>
Motivation: dMRI纤维追踪长期受制于局部扩散信息与全局解剖合理性之间的内在张力，机器学习被视为缓解该矛盾的潜在途径，但序列模型在该任务上的训练策略、输入表征等尚缺乏系统评估。

Method: 系统评估RNN与Transformer用于迭代式纤维追踪，重点考察训练策略、输入表征（含CNN嵌入与EOS标记）及超参数选择；提出生成-验证阶段，在训练中实现流线级监督，以缓解局部损失函数与全局流线质量不匹配的问题；基于ISMRM2015追踪挑战数据集开展受控实验。

Result: 模型在ISMRM2015数据集上达到迄今报道的最高性能；量化了训练集中纤维束缺失、含噪或不完美训练流线、无效纤维的影响；并在Tractoinferno数据库的活体数据上验证了最优模型的适用性。

Conclusion: 结果既揭示了Transformer、RNN等序列型深度学习模型在纤维追踪中的潜力，也暴露其局限，强调活体验证亟需改进的仿真体模与评价方法，并为后续研究提供训练与验证序列型监督方法的要点与建议。

Abstract: Machine learning (ML) has emerged as a promising approach for improving diffusion MRI (dMRI) tractography, a task that remains limited by the intrinsic tension between local diffusion information and global anatomical plausibility. In this work, we systematically evaluate recurrent neural networks (RNNs) and Transformer models for iterative tractography, with particular attention to training strategies, input representations (including convolutional neural network (CNN)-based embeddings and end-of-sequence (EOS) tokens), and hyperparameter selection. We introduce a generation-validation phase enabling supervision at the streamline level during training, allowing supervision despite the mismatch between local loss functions and global streamline quality. Using the ISMRM2015 tractography challenge dataset, our models achieve the highest reported performance to date. Through controlled experiments, we quantify the impact of missing bundles, noisy or imperfect training streamlines, and invalid fibers in the training set. Finally, we demonstrate the applicability of our best-performing models for in vivo data from the Tractoinferno database. Overall, our results highlight both the potential and the limits of sequence-based deep learning models such as Transformers and RNNs for tractography, and emphasize the need for improved phantoms and evaluation methods for in vivo validation. We provide takeaways and recommendations for future researchers training and validating sequence-based supervised methods for tractography.

</details>


### [581] [Asynchronous LLM Post-Training: Group-Mass Capping and Convergence Analysis](https://arxiv.org/abs/2610.01896)
*Qijia He,Ruinan Jin,Jun Luo,Shaofeng Zou,Yingbin Liang*

Main category: cs.LG

TL;DR: 本文从理论上刻画了异步GRPO中陈旧rollout带来的收敛性权衡，并提出GMC-GRPO方法将延迟项阈值依赖从O(ε^-4)改进至O(ε^-2)。


<details>
  <summary>Details</summary>
Motivation: 异步强化学习提升了大模型后训练效率，但陈旧rollout（旧策略生成的数据）对收敛的影响缺乏理论理解，且如何缓解其影响尚不明确。

Method: 推导GRPO类算法的收敛界，显式刻画梯度估计器二阶矩与偏差的权衡；分析轨迹级重要性加权估计器中延迟通过裁剪/重缩放偏差进入界的方式；据此提出组质量封顶GRPO（GMC-GRPO），在共享二阶矩保证的加权估计器类中最小化基于比值的偏差界。

Result: 建立异步GMC-GRPO收敛保证；相比TIC-GRPO，将四阶延迟项阈值依赖从O(ε^-4)改进到O(ε^-2)；局部策略重叠下延迟相关项随组大小G以G^-2/5下降；固定行为与当前策略时，组重缩放偏差随G→∞消失而轨迹级裁剪偏差可能持续。Qwen3模型与推理基准实验显示对陈旧rollout更鲁棒，大延迟下性能最佳。

Conclusion: GMC-GRPO通过优化偏差界有效缓解异步RL中的陈旧性问题，兼具理论收敛保证与实证鲁棒性提升。

Abstract: Asynchronous reinforcement learning (RL) improves the efficiency of large language model post-training but introduces stale rollouts generated by earlier policies. Theoretical understanding of how this staleness affects convergence and how to mitigate its impact remains limited. We derive a convergence bound for GRPO-style algorithms that explicitly characterizes the tradeoff between the gradient estimator's second moment and bias. For trajectory-level importance-weighted estimators, our analysis shows that once the second moment is uniformly controlled, delay enters the bound through the bias introduced by clipping or rescaling. Guided by this insight, we propose a novel group mass capping GRPO (GMC-GRPO) method, which minimizes a ratio-based bias bound within a class of weighted estimators sharing a common second-moment guarantee. We establish convergence guarantees for asynchronous GMC-GRPO and show that, compared with TIC-GRPO, it improves the threshold dependence of the fourth-order delay term from $O(ε^{-4})$ to $O(ε^{-2})$ as $ε\to0$, where $1+ε$ is the ratio threshold. Under local policy overlap, the delay-dependent term decreases as $G^{-2/5}$ after tuning the step size, where $G$ is the group size. For fixed behavior and current policies, the bias introduced by group rescaling also vanishes as $G\to\infty$, whereas the bias from trajectory-wise clipping can persist. Experiments across Qwen3 models and reasoning benchmarks demonstrate improved robustness to stale rollouts, with GMC-GRPO achieving the best performance among stable baselines under large rollout delays.

</details>


### [582] [Higher-Order Positional Encodings for Graph Representation Learning](https://arxiv.org/abs/2610.01903)
*Caleb Stam,Aagrim Hoysal,Sanjukta Krishnagopal*

Main category: cs.LG

TL;DR: 本文提出“高阶位置编码”（higher-order positional encodings），通过将图的团复形上的 Hodge Laplacian 谱信息注入节点级位置编码，使标准图学习模型（如 Graph Transformer）无需改动骨干网络即可利用高阶拓扑结构。


<details>
  <summary>Details</summary>
Motivation: 现实系统普遍存在成对关系无法刻画的高阶交互；Graph Transformer 与 GNN 依赖位置编码丰富图表示，但现有位置编码仅由原始图计算，无法直接捕获高阶交互。拓扑深度学习虽通过将图提升到单纯复形来应对，但通常需在高阶神经表示上执行消息传递或注意力，改动骨干、代价高。

Method: 提出一种表示学习范式：以位置编码为媒介，将高阶拓扑信息注入图表示，保持骨干网络不变。理论上刻画高阶位置编码的表达能力，证明高阶提升诱导的节点级算子能以标量图谱滤波器无法实现的方式混合图 Laplacian 频率。基于该理论，使用团复形导出的 Hodge Laplacian 实例化高阶位置编码。

Result: 在 ZINC 数据集与受控合成基准上，Graph Transformer 的预测性能获得提升；固定 1-骨架实验表明，当高阶单元独立于图提供时，该流程仍能传递高阶信息。

Conclusion: 高阶位置编码可作为连接图位置编码与拓扑深度学习的原理性桥梁，在不改动骨干模型的前提下为图学习引入高阶拓扑归纳偏置。

Abstract: Many real-world systems exhibit higher-order interactions among groups of entities that cannot be captured by pairwise relationships alone. Graph Transformers and Graph Neural Networks increasingly rely on positional encodings to enrich graph representations, yet existing positional encodings are computed solely from the original graph and therefore cannot directly capture observed higher-order interactions. Topological Deep Learning addresses this limitation by lifting graphs to simplicial complexes, but typically requires performing message passing or attention on higher-order neural network representations. We introduce a representation learning paradigm that enriches graph representations with higher-order topology through positional encodings, enabling standard graph learning models to exploit lifted incidence structure without modifying the backbone. We derive a theoretical characterization of the expressivity of higher-order positional encodings, proving that node-level operators induced by higher-order lifts can mix graph Laplacian frequencies in ways that scalar graph spectral filters cannot. Guided by this theory, we instantiate higher-order positional encodings using Hodge Laplacians derived from clique complexes. Experiments with Graph Transformers on ZINC and controlled synthetic benchmarks demonstrate improvements in predictive performance, while a fixed-1-skeleton experiment shows that the pipeline can transmit higher-order information when cells are supplied independently of the graph. Together, our results establish higher-order positional encodings as a principled bridge between graph positional encodings and topological deep learning.

</details>


### [583] [Same Reward, Different Skills: When Multimodal RL Learns to Look](https://arxiv.org/abs/2610.01908)
*Haocun Ye,Xinlong Jiang,Qile Chen,Bingyu Wang,Teng Zhang,Shubai Chen,Tingyu Wu,Zhenkun Zheng,Yiqiang Chen*

Main category: cs.LG

TL;DR: 该研究指出RLVR中"提示中的图像≠学习信号中的图像",提出"视觉可解性"设计准则,并在反事实坐标场景上验证:满足该准则的训练能显著提升7B模型的图像目标发现能力,且增益确实来源于视觉证据。


<details>
  <summary>Details</summary>
Motivation: 现有RLVR即使训练时不含视觉信息也能提升视觉语言基准分数,说明基准分数提升并不等于模型真正学会了利用图像。研究旨在揭示并解决"提示中有图像但学习信号中无图像"这一根本缺口。

Method: 提出"视觉可解性"准则:视觉证据必须是答对的必要条件,且任务需保持可学习。据此设计反事实坐标场景——问题固定、目标从不被命名,必须看图才能定位。用标准GRPO加正确性+格式奖励训练7B模型,并设置多组控制实验(灰底图测试、灰底图训练、加入可答题的文字描述等)。

Result: 7B模型在比训练密度更高的留出场景上,发现准确率从0.425提升至0.875,并泛化到未训练过的问题类型。控制实验:测试图换成灰底,发现率降为零;用灰底训练(匹配第30步、四个随机种子)几乎无增益;加入能答题的文字描述后增益削减近三分之二。技能还可迁移到独立构建的grounding任务。

Conclusion: "改变奖励所要求的内容,就改变了RL所学到的东西"。只有当视觉证据对正确答案不可或缺时,RLVR才能学到真正的视觉技能,否则基准上的分数提升可能只是假象。

Abstract: Reinforcement learning with verifiable rewards (RLVR) improves vision-language benchmark scores even without visual information during training. With images at test, blind-trained models recover roughly half of the real-image gain at 3B and nearly four fifths at 7B. Prolonged real-image training can erode grounding while benchmark gains persist. Both findings expose the same gap: an image in the prompt is not an image in the learning signal. Our design rule, visual resolvability, asks that visual evidence be necessary for a correct answer and that the task remain learnable. We test it on counterfactual coordinate scenes in which the question stays fixed and the target is never named, so a correct answer requires finding the target in the image. With standard GRPO and correctness-and-format rewards, a 7B model raises its accuracy at finding the target (discovery) from 0.425 to 0.875 on held-out scenes denser than any it trained on, and it improves on question types it never trained on. Two controls locate the source of the gain. Replacing test images with gray canvases drops discovery to zero; training on gray canvases instead, at matched step 30 and in each of four seeds, yields essentially none of the gain even when the model is then tested with real images. The learned skill carries over to grounding tasks built independently of the training corpus. A caption that answers the training question, added to the same images, reward and budget, cuts the gain by nearly two thirds. Changing what reward requires changes what RL learns.

</details>


### [584] [Learning to Predict Distributions over Weight Updates for Test-Time Adaptation](https://arxiv.org/abs/2610.01934)
*Azal Ahmad Khan,Keshav Ramji,Tahira Naseem,Ali Anwar,Ramón Fernandez Astudillo*

Main category: cs.LG

TL;DR: 本文研究仅凭输入查询（query）即可为LLM提供多少自适应信号，提出query-conditioned分布化Hypernetwork来估计LoRA，实现权重更新采样形式的测试时扩展。


<details>
  <summary>Details</summary>
Motivation: 已有Hypernetwork依赖任务描述或额外示例等信号在运行时动态调整LLM参数，但尚不清楚仅使用输入查询本身能提供多少自适应信号；作者希望探索query-only条件下的自适应潜力，并进一步获得可扩展的权重分布。

Method: 研究query-conditioned Hypernetwork用于LoRA估计；引入分布化Hypernetwork，不仅输出参数适配器的点估计，还输出LoRA上的分布；提出基于可微蒙特卡洛近似的简单端到端损失，并探索回归与凸组合等多种分布参数化方式。

Result: 即使仅使用所学分布的均值也能优于确定性Hypernetwork；所学分布支持一种新的测试时扩展——对权重更新采样而非对token序列采样，为同一查询生成多个适配模型，性能随权重样本增多而提升，且强于对应的token采样自适应基线；生成的更新可跨查询迁移，说明Hypernetwork学到了可复用的适配结构。

Conclusion: query-conditioned的权重更新分布能够同时支持自适应与测试时扩展，表明仅凭输入查询即可获得有效自适应信号，并且分布化建模带来了可采样、可迁移的权重更新。

Abstract: Hypernetworks have recently shown success in dynamically adapting the parameters of Large Language Models (LLMs) at runtime based on signals such as task descriptions or additional demostrations. Here we ask: how much adaptation signal can be obtained using only the input query to an LLM?. To answer this, we study query-conditioned Hypernetworks for LoRA estimation. Further, we introduce distributional Hypernetworks, able to produce not only point estimates of parameter adaptors, but also a distribution over possible LoRAs. For this we propose a simple end-to-end loss using a differentiable Monte Carlo approximation and explore multiple distribution parametrizations including regression and convex combination variants. Results show that even using the mean of the learned distribution can outperform deterministic hypernetworks. Crucially, the learned distribution enables a different form of test-time scaling: instead of spending additional compute only by sampling more token sequences from a fixed model, we sample weight updates, yielding multiple adapted models for the same query. Performance improves as more weight samples are considered and remains stronger than corresponding token-sampling adaptation baselines. Finally, we find that generated updates can transfer across queries, suggesting that the hypernetwork learns reusable structure in how the model should adapt. Together, these results show that query-conditioned distributions over weight updates can support both adaptation and test-time scaling.

</details>


### [585] [Graph Representation via Elements of Discrete Morse and Cobordism Theories](https://arxiv.org/abs/2610.01937)
*Jennifer Rozenblit,Chenguang Yang,Yuxin Liu,Yuzhou Chen,Yulia Gel*

Main category: cs.LG

TL;DR: 本文主张将低维拓扑（如Morse理论、配边理论）引入机器学习，提出MG-Diff流程，用离散Morse理论改进图扩散模型，并在理论上给出稳定性保证，应用于时空图预测与图再生。


<details>
  <summary>Details</summary>
Motivation: 拓扑天然适合刻画非线性、多尺度、非平稳结构，但在机器学习中其应用基本局限于拓扑数据分析（TDA）。低维拓扑工具几乎只存在于纯数学领域，被视为理解数据生成过程与学习任务隐结构的互补且尚未探索的视角。

Method: 引入配边理论（cobordism theory）的概念，并利用离散Morse理论的工具，构建名为MG-Diff的流程，将其作为诱导扩散引导用于改进图扩散模型；同时推导在正决策间隔（positive decision-gap）条件下的理论保证与充分条件，证明Morse理论工具及其扩散引导应用在小扰动下具有稳定性。

Result: 在时空图预测与图再生任务上验证了离散Morse理论应用于图扩散模型的有效性；并给出扰动稳定性方面的理论保证与充分条件。作者认为这些应用只是低维拓扑能为机器学习领域提供价值的一小部分窗口。

Conclusion: 低维拓扑（配边理论、离散Morse理论）为图扩散模型提供了有效且理论可保证的补充视角，在时空图预测与图再生中展现效用，并预示其更广泛的机器学习应用潜力。

Abstract: Topology is, by its nature and design, suited to structure that is nonlinear, multiscale, and nonstationary - however, within machine learning, its use remains largely confined to topological data analysis. We advocate that tools from low-dimensional topology which have remained almost exclusively contained within the domain of pure mathematics (such as Morse theory) offer a strong, complementary, and yet virtually unexplored perspective on the hidden structure of data-generating processes and learning tasks built upon them. Here we introduce concepts from cobordism theory and harness tools from discrete Morse theory to improve the performance of graph diffusion models through our pipeline MG-Diff. Further, we derive theoretical guarantees and sufficient conditions so that under a positive decision-gap, the Morse-theoretic tools and their application for induced diffusion guidance are stable under small perturbations. Finally, we illustrate the utility of discrete Morse theory in application to graph diffusion models for spatio-temporal graph forecasting and graph regeneration, and argue that these applications are only a small window into the part of what low-dimensional topology can offer to the field of machine learning.

</details>


### [586] [Do Your Own Research: Learning to Forecast by Learning to Search](https://arxiv.org/abs/2610.01955)
*Yusuf Afifi,Artur Kiulian,Anton Polishko,Mykola Khandoga,Hamudi Naanaa,Alina Krasnobrizha*

Main category: cs.LG

TL;DR: 提出agentic预测环境与数据集（2100+ Polymarket已结算问题），用单轮GRPO和Brier奖励训练Qwen3.5-35B-A3B，使模型在rollout时自主检索证据，校准提升30-40%，搜索次数由3.8降至2.25，并在同构评测中超越全部前沿模型。


<details>
  <summary>Details</summary>
Motivation: 既有事件预测工作存在局限：要么在训练前冻结研究语境，要么仅在测试时启用agentic检索，导致"证据搜集"这一能力从未被奖励信号塑造。

Method: 构建由2100+个已结算Polymarket问题组成的agentic预测环境、数据集与评测harness；智能体在rollout时自行获取语境（网页搜索、页面阅读、金融时间序列），并通过分层防泄漏过滤限制为各问题截止时间前发布的信息；对Qwen3.5-35B-A3B（3B激活参数）以单轮GRPO、Brier分数为奖励进行训练。

Result: 训练改变了智能体的信息交互方式：校准提升30-40%，每次rollout的搜索尝试从3.8次降至2.25次。在相同harness下与四个前沿模型比较，训练后策略在基于证据的预测上领先所有被测前沿模型，包括Claude Opus 4.5（soft-Brier 0.254 vs. 0.256，n=265），推理成本约为其5%；优势在 crowd 本身未决的最难问题上最大。

Conclusion: 释放环境、数据集与逐rollout记录，作为可复用的时间预测智能体harness。

Abstract: Outcome-based reinforcement learning can train language models to forecast real-world events, but prior forecasting work either freezes research context before training or deploys agentic research only at test time, so the skill of gathering evidence is never shaped by the reward. We introduce an agentic forecasting environment, dataset, and harness built from 2,100+ resolved Polymarket questions; the agent acquires its own context at rollout time (web search, page reading, and financial time series, all restricted by layered leak filtering to information published before each question's cutoff), and we train Qwen3.5-35B-A3B (3B active parameters) on it with single-epoch GRPO under a Brier-score reward. Training changes how the agent interacts with information: calibration improves 30-40%, and search attempts fall from 3.8 to 2.25 per rollout as evidence discipline is learned. Evaluated in an identical harness against four frontier models, the trained policy also finishes ahead of every frontier model tested at evidence-based forecasting, including Claude Opus 4.5 (soft-Brier 0.254 vs. 0.256, n=265), at about 5% of the inference cost, and its margin is widest on the hardest questions, the ones the crowd itself had not decided. We release the environment, dataset, and per-rollout records as a reusable harness for temporal forecasting agents.

</details>


### [587] [FastCI: Efficient GPU-Intensive CI for LLM Training Frameworks](https://arxiv.org/abs/2610.01967)
*Tianshuo Qiao,Naiqian Zheng,Xiaopeng Liu,Shuguang Wang,Diandian Gu,Xuanzhe Liu,Xin Jin*

Main category: cs.LG

TL;DR: FastCI 通过运行时证据选取受影响测试、剪枝等价上下文中的测试、按风险排序并优化测试负载，将 LLM 训练框架的 CI 时延降低 77.5%、GPU 资源占用降低 63.9%，同时提升改动代码覆盖率保持率 3.2%，并已集成到字节跳动的 CI 流水线。


<details>
  <summary>Details</summary>
Motivation: LLM 规模与复杂度持续增长，其训练框架迭代迅速，持续集成（CI）对保障框架质量与稳定性至关重要。但与传统软件不同，LLM 训练框架的 CI 依赖 GPU 密集型测试（通常包含完整模型训练或评估），使 CI 本身成为快速迭代的新瓶颈。

Method: FastCI 包含四个关键机制：1）利用运行时证据选取受影响的测试；2）剪枝在等价上下文中执行变更代码的测试；3）对高风险测试进行优先级排序，以更早暴露潜在失败；4）在各测试预期验证范围之外的维度上优化测试工作负载。

Result: 在作者所在 LLM 训练框架的 CI 工作负载上评估：相比当前部署的 CI 流水线，FastCI 将 CI 时延降低 77.5%，GPU 资源使用降低 63.9%，同时将改动代码覆盖率保持率提升 3.2%。

Conclusion: FastCI 可显著提升 LLM 训练框架 CI 的效率并减少 GPU 资源消耗，且不损害（甚至改善）代码覆盖率保持，已实际集成到字节跳动 LLM 训练框架的 CI 流水线中，具备工业落地价值。

Abstract: As large language models (LLMs) keep growing in size and complexity, their training frameworks evolve at a rapid pace as well. Therefore, continuous integration (CI) is critical for maintaining the quality and stability of these frameworks. However, unlike traditional software, CI for LLM training frameworks relies on GPU-intensive tests, which usually involve complete model training or evaluation. This leads CI itself to become a new bottleneck for fast-paced development. In this paper, we introduce FastCI, a framework that improves the efficiency of CI for LLM training frameworks. FastCI leverages runtime evidence to select affected tests and prune tests that execute changed code in equivalent contexts. Then FastCI prioritizes high-risk tests to expose potential failures earlier, and optimizes test workloads along dimensions outside the intended validation scope of each test. Evaluated on the CI workload of our LLM training framework, FastCI reduces the CI latency by 77.5% and the GPU resource usage by 63.9%, while improving the modified code coverage retention by 3.2%, compared with the currently deployed CI pipelines. FastCI has now been integrated into the CI pipelines of our LLM training framework at ByteDance.

</details>


### [588] [Sim+Real: Joint Simulation - Experiment Training Improves Balanced Prediction in Physical Systems](https://arxiv.org/abs/2610.01974)
*Mahindra Rautela,Alexander Scheinker,Ayan Biswas,Diane Oyen,Nathan DeBardeleben,Earl Lawrence*

Main category: cs.LG

TL;DR: 该论文将"仿真→实验"预测建模为多目标学习问题，提出联合训练以同时优化仿真与实验域目标，在RealPDEBench四个流体系统上验证其平衡性能最优。


<details>
  <summary>Details</summary>
Motivation: 仿真数据与实验测量在时空物理系统学习中互补，但标准的"仿真到实验"微调（Sim→Exp）在迁移后仅优化实验目标，会导致仿真性能退化（仿真域遗忘），缺乏对两域性能的兼顾。

Method: 将仿真-实验预测表述为含域特定仿真风险与实验风险的多目标学习问题；在RealPDEBench的四个流体系统和两种模型容量下，对比Simulation only、Experiment only、Sim→Exp与Joint training四种策略，并在两个域的留出集上评估每个最终模型；同时分析不同仿真-实验评估权重下的表现及仿真独有场（实验中未测量的场）的保持情况。

Result: Sim→Exp倾向于更强地专门化到实验数据，代价是仿真域遗忘；Joint training在广泛的仿真-实验评估权重范围内一致地取得最佳平衡性能，且相较Sim→Exp显著提升仿真保持能力，并更好地保留实验中缺失的仿真独有场。

Conclusion: 联合训练（Joint training）是兼顾仿真与实验两域性能的更优策略，可缓解Sim→Exp带来的仿真域遗忘问题，并保持仿真独有物理场的预测能力。项目主页：https://mahindrautela.github.io/morph。

Abstract: Simulation and experimental measurements provide complementary data for learning spatiotemporal physical systems, but standard simulation-to-experiment fine-tuning optimizes only the experimental objective after transfer and can degrade simulation performance. We formulate simulation--experiment prediction as a multi-objective learning problem with domain-specific simulation and experimental risks. On four fluid systems from RealPDEBench and two model capacities, we compare Simulation only, Experiment only, Sim$\rightarrow$Exp, and Joint training, evaluating every final model on both held-out domains. Sim$\rightarrow$Exp tends to specialize more strongly to experimental data at the cost of simulation-domain forgetting. Joint training consistently achieves the best balanced performance over a broad range of simulation--experiment evaluation weightings, while substantially improving simulation retention over Sim$\rightarrow$Exp. Joint also better preserves simulation-only fields absent from experimental measurements. Project page: https://mahindrautela.github.io/morph.

</details>


### [589] [Universal interpolation for deep residual self-attention networks](https://arxiv.org/abs/2610.01981)
*Sibylle Marcotte,Joan Bruna*

Main category: cs.LG

TL;DR: 该工作研究深度自注意力模型的"对偶"逼近机制：以固定参数、跨层强共享的方式，仅用两个冻结的单头残差softmax注意力块，通过选择块的应用顺序、符号与持续时间，即可实现任意序列集合到任意序列集合的插值，且在连续与有限深度下均成立，并给出了因果掩码下的相应保证。


<details>
  <summary>Details</summary>
Motivation: 通用逼近性是学习架构能受益于规模定律的必要定性性质，现有验证多依赖无限宽度极限。作者转向"对偶"机制，即逼近能力完全由深度提供，并受Looped Transformers等近期模型的启发，强调跨层强参数共享。核心问题是：能否找到一组预定义、与输入输出无关的有限参数（每个参数定义一个注意力块），使得通过调整块的施加顺序、符号与持续时间，就能把任意N条n个token的序列集合映射到任意另一个同类集合。

Method: 聚焦深度自注意力，采用参数冻结与跨层共享的"对偶"设定。构造仅含两个冻结的单头残差softmax注意力块（投影矩阵为高斯初始化）的有限参数集；通过按任务选择块的施加顺序、符号和持续时间（即插值调度）来实现任意序列集合间的映射。分析在连续深度与有限深度两种情形下的构造，并进一步刻画因果掩码所施加的限制。

Result: 主要结果：仅用两个冻结的单头残差softmax注意力块（高斯初始化投影矩阵），即可实现任意N条n-token序列集合间的通用插值；该结论在连续深度和有限深度下均成立。同时刻画了因果掩码带来的限制，并给出了对应的通用插值保证。

Conclusion: 通用插值能力可由深度而非宽度（无限宽极限）驱动，且仅需极少量冻结、共享参数的注意力块配合输入相关的调度即可实现。这为Looped/循环Transformer类模型提供了理论依据，并明确了因果掩码对逼近能力的约束。

Abstract: Universal approximation is a necessary qualitative property of learning architectures to benefit from scaling laws. While it is generically verified on a variety of neural architectures and random feature models, it typically involves infinite width limits. In this work, we focus on deep self-attention models and consider instead the `dual' regime, where approximation power is enabled entirely by depth, and featuring strong parameter sharing across layers, motivated by recent models such as the Looped Transformers. More specifically, we ask whether one can find a predefined finite set of parameters, each defining an attention block, such that the resulting finite set of transformations can map any collection of $N$ sequences of $n$ tokens to any other collection of $N$ sequences of $n$ tokens. Crucially, these transformations are \emph{fixed independently of the input and output} collections: only the order in which the blocks are applied, their signs, and their durations depend on the particular interpolation task. Our main result establishes it for residual softmax attention using only two frozen single-head blocks with Gaussian-initialized projection matrices. The result holds at both continuous and finite depth. We also characterize the restrictions imposed by causal masking and establish corresponding universal interpolation guarantees.

</details>


### [590] [Bellman Meets Lyapunov: Unsupervised Reinforcement Learning via Mastering Chaos](https://arxiv.org/abs/2610.02012)
*Tristan Shah,Wooyoung Chung,Volodomyr Makarenko,Juan Wachs,Stas Tiomkin*

Main category: cs.LG

TL;DR: 本文提出 Forward CIP (F-CIP)，一种无需选取信息变量的无监督强化学习内在动机目标，仅由系统动力学定义，可实现平衡、可控性维持等原始行为的无监督发现。


<details>
  <summary>Details</summary>
Motivation: 强化学习依赖人工工程师为每个新任务设计奖励信号，需大量领域专业知识。无监督 RL 试图通过内在动机（IM）减少这种工程负担，但现有 IM 目标仍需选择信息变量，重新引入了希望消除的领域专业知识。

Method: 提出 F-CIP，即可控信息生产（CIP）目标的 RL 原生表述。该目标完全由系统动力学定义，不需要选择任何信息变量；同时证明 F-CIP 与 RL 兼容，并可与现有算法结合使用。

Result: 用 F-CIP 训练智能体可无监督地发现平衡与维持可控性等原始行为；将其与简单的前向速度奖励结合，可产生跳跃、奔跑等原本需要奖励工程才能学到的协调步态。

Conclusion: F-CIP 消除了内在动机中信息变量选择带来的领域专业知识依赖，为无监督 RL 提供了 RL 原生且由动力学定义的目标，并能与简单任务奖励结合产生复杂机器人行为。

Abstract: Reinforcement learning (RL) is a powerful paradigm for training agents, yet its success rests on domain expertise of human engineers who design informative reward signals for every new task. Unsupervised RL aims to reduce this engineering with intrinsic motivation (IM): reward signals that emerge from the agent environment interaction itself. Existing IM objectives, however, involve the selection of information variables, which re-introduces domain expertise the field has sought to eliminate. We introduce Forward CIP (F-CIP), an RL-native formulation of the Controllable Information Production (CIP) objective, which is defined by the system's dynamics alone and requires no such selection. We prove that F-CIP is compatible with RL and demonstrate its effectiveness with existing algorithms. Training agents with F-CIP results in unsupervised discovery of primitive behaviors such as balancing and maintaining controllability, which are essential for more complex robot behaviors. Paired with a simple forward-velocity reward, our method produces coordinated gaits such as hopping and running which otherwise require reward engineering to learn.

</details>


### [591] [BranchIP: Learning Adaptive Equivariant Computation for Interatomic Potentials](https://arxiv.org/abs/2610.02013)
*Laura Zichi,Gil Harari,Chuin Wei Tan,Marc L. Descoteaux,Albert Zhu,Menghang Wang,Yoel Zimmermann,H. T. Kung,Boris Kozinsky*

Main category: cs.LG

TL;DR: 提出 BranchIP，一种单模型框架，通过学习式自适应张量积计算并结合新型蒸馏损失来加速等变机器学习原子间势（MLIPs），在两个物理体系上实现最高 2.4× 加速与 2.6× 显存降低，同时保持物理保真度并提供可解释性。


<details>
  <summary>Details</summary>
Motivation: 等变 MLIPs 虽革新了原子尺度建模，但对复杂材料与分子体系的精确描述需要昂贵的大模型，限制了模拟的尺度与时间范围。张量积是主要计算瓶颈，且近期基础规模（foundation-scale）MLIPs 的出现进一步加剧了该问题，因此亟需在保持精度的前提下降低计算与显存开销。

Method: 提出 BranchIP——面向学习式自适应张量积计算的单模型框架，使用一种新颖的蒸馏损失进行训练，使模型能够根据交互的复杂度自适应地分配计算量。

Result: 在两个具有物理意义的多相催化体系与质子传导固态酸电解质体系上，BranchIP 在不同模型规模下实现最高 2.4× 加速，显存占用最高降低 2.6×，同时维持物理保真度。

Conclusion: 学习式自适应计算不仅带来效率提升，还提供了模型可解释性：可揭示哪些相互作用需要更深层计算，并展现计算深度与化学复杂度及动力学之间的关系。

Abstract: Equivariant machine learning interatomic potentials (MLIPs) have revolutionized atomistic modeling, but accurate treatment of complex materials and molecular systems demands expensive models. This limits simulation length- and time-scales, with tensor products a key computational bottleneck. The recent emergence of foundation-scale MLIPs further exacerbates this challenge. We present Branch Interatomic Potential (BranchIP), a single-model framework for learned adaptive tensor product computation, trained with a novel distillation loss. In our experiments on two systems of physical interest, a heterogeneous catalysis system and a proton-conducting solid acid electrolyte, BranchIP accelerates MLIPs across model sizes by up to $2.4\times$ while reducing memory usage by up to $2.6\times$. This is achieved while maintaining physical fidelity. Furthermore, the learned adaptive computation provides model interpretability by revealing which interactions demand deeper computation and showing how computational depth relates to chemical complexity and dynamics.

</details>


### [592] [On Language Drift during RLVR Post-Training](https://arxiv.org/abs/2610.02015)
*Michael Sullivan,Alexander Koller*

Main category: cs.LG

TL;DR: 该论文研究LLM思维链（CoT）中的语言漂移现象：理论证明RLVR优化压力下语言漂移可无界增长，而监督微调不会；实证表明漂移特发于在新推理任务上进行RLVR时（即基座模型无法自然生成目标行为时）；并证明在不牺牲期望奖励的前提下无法约束语言漂移。


<details>
  <summary>Details</summary>
Motivation: RLVR后训练显著提升了LLM的复杂推理能力，但模型CoT中日益出现非标准、看似无意义的"语言漂移"，可能损害CoT的可监控性（monitorability）。然而，这种语言漂移的成因此前缺乏清晰解释，论文旨在识别其发生条件并揭示其与优化目标之间的内在权衡。

Method: 采用理论分析与实证验证相结合的方法：1）从理论上比较RLVR与监督微调（SFT）优化压力对语言漂移的约束能力；2）通过实验观察语言漂移在何种任务条件下出现，重点考察基座模型能否自然产生目标行为的"新推理任务"场景；3）从理论上分析约束语言漂移与期望奖励之间的权衡关系。

Result: 理论结果：RLVR的优化压力允许语言漂移无界增长，而SFT不具备该性质；同时证明无法在不约束期望奖励的情况下约束语言漂移。实证结果：语言漂移特发于在新推理任务上执行RLVR时，即当目标行为无法从基座模型中引出时。

Conclusion: 语言漂移是RLVR的固有产物，尤其在模型需要习得基座能力之外的新推理行为时出现。由于约束语言漂移必然以牺牲期望奖励为代价，在前沿RLVR后训练中，提升CoT可监控性无法不损害模型性能，二者之间存在内在张力。

Abstract: Recent advances in LLM reasoning models---driven primarily by the paradigm of post-training via reinforcement learning with verifiable reward (RLVR)---have enabled them to accomplish impressively complex tasks. However, in parallel with their rising capabilities, LLMs have increasingly displayed signs of language drift in their chains of thought (CoTs): unusual, non-standard, and seemingly nonsensical language use. Although it is well-documented---and can potentially impair CoT monitorability---the causes of language drift are thus far poorly understood. In this paper, we identify the conditions under which language drift occurs: we prove theoretically that RLVR optimization pressure permits unbounded language drift, while supervised fine-tuning does not. We then show empirically that language drift specifically arises during RLVR on novel reasoning tasks---i.e. when the target behavior cannot be drawn out of the base model. Finally, we prove that it is not possible to constrain language drift without constraining expected reward, suggesting that CoT monitorability cannot be improved without harming performance during RLVR post-training at the frontier.

</details>


### [593] [Relative Transitions, Not Absolute Destinations: A Transfer-and-Ground Framework for Target-Trajectory-Free Human Mobility Generation](https://arxiv.org/abs/2610.02033)
*Yidi Wang,Yunhe Zhang,Bangchao Deng,Dingqi Yang,Pengyang Wang*

Main category: cs.LG

TL;DR: 该论文研究"无目标轨迹"的轨迹生成问题，提出Nomad框架：在源城市学习与城市无关的"相对转移"先验，再将其落地到目标城市的POI地图上，从而在仅有目标城市POI坐标与类别的条件下生成轨迹。


<details>
  <summary>Details</summary>
Motivation: 现有轨迹生成器通常依赖部署城市的观测数据，而许多城市恰恰缺乏轨迹数据，尽管其POI及属性可从公开地图获取。此外，既有方法多直接预测绝对目的地，将可复用的移动行为与城市特有的POI身份和空间布局纠缠在一起，导致跨城市迁移困难。
