Method: 提出Nomad，一个"转移—落地"（transfer-and-ground）框架，将"人如何移动"与"移动在何处实现"分离。首先用历史条件流匹配模型在源城市轨迹上学习一个转移先验，该先验作用于POI上下文间的语义位移、地理位移与时间间隔；推理阶段，通过行为图与"探索—返回"游走（exploration–return walk），将采样得到的转移落地到目标城市的POI地图上。

Result: 在十个城市、14组迁移任务上的大量实验表明，Nomad在轨迹保真度与下游效用上均优于适配基线：分布保真度指标相对各指标最优基线平均降低约15%误差，下游效用指标平均降低约3%。

Conclusion: 以情境条件下的相对转移替代城市绑定的绝对输出，可在不假设完整移动分布不变的前提下，直接检验表示层面的可迁移性，为缺乏轨迹数据的城市提供有效的轨迹生成方案。

Abstract: Individual mobility trajectories support urban analysis and location-based services, yet most trajectory generators require observations from their deployment city. This assumption excludes precisely the cities where trajectories are unavailable even though points of interest (POIs) and their attributes can be obtained from public maps. We study target-trajectory-free generation: learning from POIs and trajectories in source cities while utilizing only POI coordinates and categories in a target city, with no target trajectory or trajectory-derived statistic available for training, model selection, or generation. Existing trajectory generators typically predict absolute destinations, entangling reusable movement behavior with city-specific POI identities and spatial layouts. Our core insight is to replace this city-bound output with context-conditioned relative transitions. We propose Nomad, a transfer-and-ground framework that separates learning how people move from determining where those movements are realized. Specifically, a history-conditioned flow-matching model learns from source trajectories a transition prior over semantic displacement between POI contexts, geographic displacement, and elapsed time; at inference, a behavior graph and an exploration--return walk ground sampled transitions onto the target POI map. This factorization enables a direct test of representation level transferability without assuming invariance of the full mobility distribution. Extensive experiments across ten cities and 14 transfers show that Nomad outperforms adaptation baselines in trajectory fidelity and downstream utility, lowering the average error over the best baseline of each metric by about 15% in distributional fidelity and about 3% in downstream utility.

</details>


### [594] [Distributionally Robust Schrödinger Bridge](https://arxiv.org/abs/2610.02043)
*Jinhwan Sul,Panagiotis Theodoropoulos,Vincent Pacelli,Jaemoo Choi,Evangelos Theodorou*

Main category: cs.LG

TL;DR: 提出分布鲁棒薛定谔桥（DRSB），学习在初始分布存在不确定性时仍能恢复目标分布的单一控制器。


<details>
  <summary>Details</summary>
Motivation: 标准薛定谔桥（SB）学习预设初始分布与目标分布间的随机传输，但当测试时初始分布发生偏移，所学动力学可能无法恢复目标分布，即对初始分布扰动缺乏鲁棒性。

Method: DRSB目标由控制能量与终端分布同目标分布间的KL惩罚组成，在名义分布周围的模糊集内最小化该目标的最坏情况值。论文推导该目标的精确变分形式，并将其固定终端代价子问题与随机最优控制及分布鲁棒优化相联系；据此设计交替算法，迭代更新对抗性初始分布、估计终端对数密度比并训练控制器；利用随机控制最优性条件近似对抗更新所需梯度，开发了Wasserstein与Sinkhorn两种变体。

Result: 在二维传输任务与图像到图像翻译上，相对标准SB提升了对输入扰动的鲁棒性，但名义性能有所折衷；在高斯混合传输中，Sinkhorn DRSB在两个测试的未见噪声水平下均取得比固定水平噪声增强更低的平均切片Wasserstein距离。

Conclusion: DRSB通过单一鲁棒控制器有效应对初始分布不确定性，在鲁棒性与名义性能间提供可控折衷，Sinkhorn变体在噪声鲁棒性上表现更优。

Abstract: Schrödinger bridge (SB) learns stochastic transport between prescribed initial and target distributions. When the initial distribution shifts at test time, the learned dynamics can fail to recover the target distribution. We introduce the Distributionally Robust Schrödinger Bridge (DRSB), which learns a single controller that accounts for uncertainty in the initial distribution. The DRSB objective consists of control energy and a KL penalty between the resulting terminal distribution and the target distribution. DRSB seeks a single controller that minimizes the worst-case value of this objective as the initial distribution varies within an ambiguity set around the nominal distribution. We derive an exact variational formulation of this objective and connect its fixed-terminal-cost subproblem to stochastic optimal control and distributionally robust optimization. This formulation motivates an alternating algorithm that updates the adversarial initial distribution, estimates the terminal log-density ratio, and trains the controller. We develop Wasserstein and Sinkhorn variants using stochastic control optimality conditions to approximate the gradients required for adversarial updates. Experiments on two-dimensional transport tasks and image-to-image translation show improved robustness to input perturbations relative to standard SB, with a tradeoff in nominal performance. On Gaussian mixture transport, Sinkhorn DRSB also achieves lower mean sliced Wasserstein distance than fixed-level noise augmentation at both tested unseen noise levels.

</details>


### [595] [Foundations without Fundamentals: Zero-Shot Blind Spots in Time Series FMs](https://arxiv.org/abs/2610.02058)
*Nafiseh Ghoroghchian,Haipeng Zhang,Shuyi Han,Alex Labach,George Stein*

Main category: cs.LG

TL;DR: 本文提出 SimpleTimeBench 诊断基准，发现主流多变量时间序列基础模型（Chronos-2、Moirai、Toto）在单调趋势、周期信号、领先指标协变量等"单元测试"级任务上零样本表现欠佳，且微调会引发能力此消彼长，揭示预训练规模与基础时序推理能力之间的鸿沟。


<details>
  <summary>Details</summary>
Motivation: 时间序列基础模型（TSFM）在广泛基准上表现优异，但其对基本时序逻辑（尤其是借助外生协变量的场景）的内化能力尚未被充分检验。作者意图探究这些模型是否真正具备捕捉简单可预测函数的归纳偏置，而非仅依赖预训练规模。

Method: 提出 SimpleTimeBench，一个针对单变量与多变量原语的诊断性"单元测试"套件，涵盖单调趋势、周期信号、领先指标协变量等本应近乎完美预测的简单场景；对 Chronos-2、Moirai、Toto 等主流多变量 TSFM 进行零样本评估，并对 Chronos-2 进行微调对比实验，同时在真实传感器预测数据上验证结论。

Result: 显著的预训练模型在简单输入上频繁给出次优零样本预测；微调 Chronos-2 虽能改善特定任务表现，却会损害其他基本模式的性能，而非提升可泛化的基础能力；这些失败同样出现在真实世界传感器预测中，模型持续未能充分利用观测协变量中的领先指标。

Conclusion: 当前 TSFM 可能存在归纳偏置缺失，难以捕捉简单的可预测函数；预训练规模与基础时序推理能力之间存在鸿沟。这种无法捕捉简单关系的能力缺陷限制了现有多变量模型的实用性与可靠性。

Abstract: Despite the success of Time Series Foundation Models (TSFMs) on broad benchmarks, their ability to internalize basic temporal logic, especially in settings supported by exogenous covariates, remains under-examined. We introduce SimpleTimeBench, a diagnostic univariate and multivariate "unit test" suite for primitives such as monotonic trends, periodic signals and leading indicator covariates, scenarios where near-perfect forecasts should be trivial. Surprisingly, prominent multivariate TSFMs (Chronos-2, Moirai and Toto) frequently produce suboptimal zero-shot forecasts for these inputs. While fine-tuning Chronos-2 improves its behaviour on specific tasks, we show that this adaptation degrades performance on other fundamental patterns rather than enhancing its generalizable foundational capabilities. This reveals a gap between pre-training scale and basic temporal reasoning, suggesting that current TSFMs could potentially lack the inductive biases needed to capture simple predictable functions. We further demonstrate that these failures are not merely synthetic curiosities: they persist in real-world sensor forecasting, where TSFMs consistently underutilize leading indicators available in observed covariates. This inability to capture simple relationships limits the practical utility and reliability of current multivariate models.

</details>


### [596] [Learn the Directions, Normalize the Gains: Post-Training Normalization for LoRA](https://arxiv.org/abs/2610.02067)
*Zailong Tian,Yanzhe Chen,Zhuoheng Han,Houfeng Wang,Lizi Liao*

Main category: cs.LG

TL;DR: LoRA-Norm 是一种免训练、无推理开销的后处理归一化方法，通过对 LoRA 更新的奇异值做谱重平衡并恢复核范数，缓解"适应失衡"问题，在专门化与能力保留上均优于后处理谱剪枝和梯度引导编辑。


<details>
  <summary>Details</summary>
Motivation: LoRA 虽能高效实现任务专门化，但其学习到的更新会损害目标任务之外的能力。作者识别出"适应失衡"现象：少数奇异方向主导了训练更新，使性能对增益分配方式高度敏感。核心论点是：学会"在哪里适应"并不能保证适应增益得到良好平衡。

Method: 提出 LoRA-Norm，一种训练后归一化方法，在保留已学习方向的前提下重新平衡其增益。方法包含两部分：谱重平衡（对奇异值施加固定的非线性变换）与核范数恢复（保持原始总谱质量）。该方法无需校准数据、无需额外训练，也不引入推理开销。

Result: 在两个骨干网络和三个适应任务上，LoRA-Norm 提升了平均专门化性能与能力保留，在两项指标上均优于所评估的后处理谱剪枝和梯度引导编辑配置。此外，更强的函数均衡化并未带来一致的额外收益。

Conclusion: 平衡适配器增益与均衡其响应是两个不同的目标；通过固定非线性变换重平衡奇异值并保持总谱质量，可在不牺牲方向信息的前提下缓解适应失衡，兼顾专门化与能力保留。

Abstract: While Low-Rank Adaptation (LoRA) enables efficient task specialization, its learned updates can compromise capabilities beyond the target task. We identify \textbf{adaptation imbalance}: a few singular directions dominate the trained update, leaving its performance sensitive to how gains are allocated. We argue that \textbf{learning where to adapt does not ensure that adaptation gains are well balanced}. This motivates \textbf{LoRA-Norm}, a post-training normalization method that retains learned directions while rebalancing their gains. LoRA-Norm combines spectral rebalancing, a fixed nonlinear transformation of singular values, with nuclear-norm restoration, which preserves the original total spectral mass. It requires no calibration data or additional training and introduces no inference overhead. Across two backbones and three adaptation tasks, LoRA-Norm improves average specialization and capability retention, outperforming the evaluated post-hoc spectral pruning and gradient-guided editing configurations on both measures. Stronger functional equalization brings no consistent additional gains, revealing that balancing adapter gains and equalizing their responses are distinct objectives.

</details>


### [597] [Are We Recovering Mechanisms? Objective-Level Recovery Gaps in Mechanistic Interpretability](https://arxiv.org/abs/2610.02098)
*Chuqin Geng,Li Zhang,Haolin Ye,Mark Zhang,Luke Zhang,Xujie Si*

Main category: cs.LG

TL;DR: 该论文指出机制可解释性中"干预定义的忠实度"评价目标存在缺陷：它会偏好行为复现更差的同规模电路，形成目标层面的恢复差距，并证明仅靠改进发现算法无法解决此问题。


<details>
  <summary>Details</summary>
Motivation: 自动化电路发现通常被表述为搜索问题，即更好的归因或优化应能找到更好的机制。但这一假设的前提是评价目标本身能够"识别"出更优电路；若目标函数本身失真，那么即使发现算法再优，也无法保证找到真正好的机制。

Method: 作者在四个有人类参考的任务及 InterpBench 上，将"验证忠实度"与"留出提示上的行为表现"进行对比，行为标准采用与完整模型（含其错误）的一致性（Greater-Than 任务用语义准确率）。在固定普通重采样条件下，通过受控的参考编辑在不使用任何发现算法的前提下揭示排序错误，并检验 EAP、EAP-IG、ACDC、Edge-SP 的输出。进一步以"上下文失真"作为解释机制并进行修复实验。

Result: 干预定义的忠实度会偏好同规模但行为复现更差的电路。EAP、EAP-IG、ACDC、Edge-SP 均表现出相同失败。在重采样下，KL 在这四个方法上对人类参考任务的候选对中有 9.4%–41.2% 被错误排序。上下文失真是原因：替换被排除信号改变了保留组件所作用的输入；从接收方完整模型执行中恢复选定信号后，可在验证与留出提示上修复 100 个持续 KL 错误排序中的 96 个，而电路及其原始行为得分保持不变。

Conclusion: 当评价目标奖励错误的候选时，仅靠更好的发现算法是不充分的。忠実度指标（如 KL）在重采样下可能系统性误排电路，其根源在于上下文失真；修复上下文失真可显著纠正误排，表明需要重新审视并改进电路发现的评价目标本身。

Abstract: Mechanistic interpretability aims to recover the internal computations responsible for model behavior. Progress in automated circuit discovery is often framed as a search problem: better attribution or optimization should identify better mechanisms. This assumes that the evaluation objective can recognize a better circuit once it is found. We show that intervention-defined faithfulness can instead prefer an equally sized circuit that reproduces the model's behavior less well, creating an objective-level recovery gap. Across four human-reference tasks and InterpBench, we compare validation faithfulness with behavior on held-out prompts under fixed ordinary resampling. The behavioral criterion is agreement with the intact model, including its mistakes, except on Greater-Than, where we use semantic accuracy. Controlled reference edits reveal misranking without any discovery algorithm, and outputs of EAP, EAP-IG, ACDC, and Edge-SP exhibit the same failure. Under resampling, KL misranks 9.4%-41.2% of candidate pairs across these methods on the human-reference tasks. We investigate context distortion as an explanation: replacing excluded signals changes the inputs on which retained components operate. Restoring selected signals from the recipient's intact-model execution repairs 96 of 100 persistent KL misrankings from the discovery pool on both validation and held-out prompts. The circuits and their original behavioral scores remain unchanged. These findings show why better discovery alone is insufficient when its objective rewards the wrong candidate.

</details>


### [598] [Local Support Learning](https://arxiv.org/abs/2610.02126)
*Assaf Ben-Kish,Akarsh Kumar,James Glass,Raja Giryes*

Main category: cs.LG

TL;DR: 将灾难性遗忘视为权重矩阵输入空间上的几何问题，提出局部支持学习（LSL）框架：用权重适配器+高斯混合模型门控函数使更新仅局部于当前分布，无需旧数据即可在70亿参数LLM上保持旧能力。


<details>
  <summary>Details</summary>
Motivation: 大预训练模型在新任务上微调时会出现灾难性遗忘，且实际中往往无法访问旧阶段数据，需要一种无旧数据的通用遗忘缓解方法。

Method: 把遗忘建模为各权重矩阵输入空间中的几何问题，推出一个自然保持目标，并指出梯度优化更新在此目标下是次优的。据此提出LSL：结合权重适配器（照常最小化损失）与门控函数（仅对来自自身训练分布的激活启用），使更新局部化。门控采用GMM，其似然在远离训练数据时快速衰减，因此对先前阶段数据倾向关闭。

Result: 在参数量达70亿的LLM上解决遗忘问题，跨多个训练阶段同时保留预训练与微调能力，且内存与计算高效、对超参选择鲁棒，并展现规模扩展潜力。

Conclusion: LSL是一种通用、事后训练型框架，可在无旧数据条件下有效缓解大模型遗忘，兼具高效性、鲁棒性与可扩展性。

Abstract: We explore catastrophic forgetting in the context of large pre-trained models. By considering forgetting as a geometric problem in the input space of each weight matrix, we uncover a natural retention objective under which updates produced by gradient-based optimizers are suboptimal. Following this observation, we propose Local Support Learning (LSL), a general-purpose framework that augments gradient-based training for retention of prior capabilities without access to prior data. During a new learning phase, LSL pairs two components with distinct roles: a standard weight adapter, trained as usual to minimize the loss, and a gating function that enables the adapter only on input activations from its own training distribution, making the update local to that distribution. The key challenge is that this gate must route data from all learning phases while training only on data from the current one. We address this with a gate based on a Gaussian Mixture Model (GMM), whose likelihood decays rapidly away from its training data, giving it a natural tendency to stay closed on data from prior phases. We show that this post-training approach can resolve forgetting in LLMs of up to 7 billion parameters, retaining both pretrained and finetuned capabilities across multiple training phases, while being efficient in memory and compute, robust to hyperparameter choice, and showing scaling potential.

</details>


### [599] [Linear Programming Representations and Strongly Polynomial Algorithms for Robust Markov Decision Processes](https://arxiv.org/abs/2610.02131)
*Han Zhong,Yinyu Ye*

Main category: cs.LG

TL;DR: 本文为具有有理多面体状态-动作矩形不确定性的鲁棒MDP构建了单一LP表示，并给出强多项式算法与复杂度分析。


<details>
  <summary>Details</summary>
Motivation: 鲁棒马尔可夫决策过程（RMDP）的LP表示与强多项式算法尚不完善，尤其针对奖励与转移中的有理多面体状态-动作矩形不确定性，需要统一的LP刻画及更优复杂度界。

Method: 通过编码有限步鲁棒策略迭代过程，构造单个LP，其最优解可恢复鲁棒最优值与全部最优平稳随机策略；在固定折扣下，LP具有多项式维数和编码长度且可在强多项式时间内构造。同时建立鲁棒策略迭代的一般复杂度分析，将不确定集上最小化代价与策略评估所需迭代次数相结合。

Result: 固定折扣因子下，改进l1与l∞ RMDP的已知复杂度界，并为一般区间、加权l1与Wasserstein RMDP及具有此类不确定集的回合制随机博弈建立新的强多项式界。

Conclusion: 该工作给出RMDP的统一LP表示与强多项式算法框架，扩展了可高效求解的不确定集类别并提升了复杂度界。

Abstract: We study linear programming (LP) representations and strongly polynomial algorithms for robust Markov decision processes (RMDPs) with rational polyhedral state-action rectangular uncertainty in rewards and transitions. By encoding a finite sequence of robust policy-iteration steps, we construct a single LP whose optimal solutions recover the robust optimal value and all optimal stationary randomized policies. At fixed discount, the LP has polynomial dimension and encoding length and can be constructed in strongly polynomial time. We also develop a general complexity analysis of robust policy iteration that combines the cost of minimizing over uncertainty sets with the number of iterations needed to evaluate a policy. For a fixed discount factor, we use this analysis to improve the known complexity bounds for $\ell_1$ and $\ell_\infty$ RMDPs and establish new strongly polynomial bounds for general interval, weighted $\ell_1$, and Wasserstein RMDPs, as well as turn-based stochastic games with these uncertainty sets.

</details>


### [600] [Faynt: Scaling and Optimizing Policies for Competitive Melee](https://arxiv.org/abs/2610.02144)
*Ali Janati,Nikita Kuzmin,Rohit Swamy,Charles Niu*

Main category: cs.LG

TL;DR: Faynt是一系列10M/75M参数的Transformer策略，单checkpoint控制《任天堂明星大乱斗DX》全部26个角色；经强化学习后10M在同角色对战中胜率达98.4%，并在零延迟设置下表现优异，同时开源权重、基准与自动化锦标赛平台。


<details>
  <summary>Details</summary>
Motivation: 将Transformer策略与强化学习应用于复杂实时格斗游戏（Super Smash Bros. Melee），探索多角色统一控制、架构与优化、超参迁移，以及大规模人类回放预训练的有效性。

Method: 基于约840,000条人类回放进行预训练，研究架构、优化、扩展与超参数迁移；后训练结合排名与结果导向的课程学习、75M到10M蒸馏，以及仅限Fox镜像对局的强化学习；单checkpoint控制全部26角色。

Result: 10M模型在244场同角色对战中赢下240场（98.4%），对所有发布的对手均保持胜绩；对阵私下提供的零延迟Slippi-AI模型68场全胜。初始152场基准上，监督10M胜率69.7%，优于预训练75M的45.4%，尽管其留出控制器预测损失更高；加权验证损失与四种策略胜率排序一致。监督后训练后两模型每分钟受伤更少、早期领先更大、丢掉首条命后更常翻盘。T4上每决策推理10M为5.2 ms、75M为8.7 ms（不含模拟器执行与通信）。

Conclusion: 单一checkpoint可统一控制全部角色，小模型经监督后训练后性能可超越大模型，加权验证损失可作为胜率的有效代理指标；研究开源权重、两套基准与自动化模型锦标赛平台以促进后续研究。

Abstract: We introduce Faynt, a family of 10M- and 75M-parameter Transformer policies for Super Smash Bros. Melee, each controlling all 26 characters with a single checkpoint. After reinforcement learning (RL), the 10M wins 240 of 244 same-character games (98.4%) against fourteen specialist and multi-character releases on their supported rosters, with a winning record against every release. These opponents retain 21- or 24-frame action delays; Faynt uses no added delay, and we have not isolated the effect of this difference. In a separate evaluation against a privately supplied zero-delay Slippi-AI model, the 10M wins all 68 games across two conditioning settings. We study architecture, optimization, scaling, and hyperparameter transfer to guide pretraining on approximately 840,000 human replays. Post-training combines rank- and outcome-based curricula, 75M-to-10M distillation, and RL restricted to Fox mirror matches. On the initial 152-game benchmark, the supervised 10M wins 69.7% of games, compared with 45.4% for the pretrained 75M, despite higher overall held-out controller-prediction loss. The weighted validation loss used for supervised checkpoint selection agrees with the win-rate ordering of all four pretrained and supervised policies. After supervised post-training, both models take less damage per minute, build larger early leads, and win more often after losing the first life. Optimized inference on recorded game states averages 5.2 ms per decision for the 10M and 8.7 ms for the 75M on an NVIDIA T4, excluding emulator execution and communication. We open-source the weights, both benchmark suites, and a platform for automated model tournaments.

</details>


### [601] [When Do Intrinsic Rewards Lead to Exploration?](https://arxiv.org/abs/2610.02159)
*Scott W. Viteri,Laura Gomezjurado Gonzalez,Clark Barrett*

Main category: cs.LG

TL;DR: 本文提出以“反事实信息”作为探索的形式化准则，并构造反例表明现有内在奖励目标在最大化时可能帕累托次优。


<details>
  <summary>Details</summary>
Motivation: 现有内在奖励（预测误差、学习进度等）虽被用于引导探索，但最大化这些奖励并不必然产生最有信息量的经验，缺乏一个衡量“探索是否最优”的正式标准。

Method: 提出比较策略所获取反事实信息的准则：考察策略的历史能在多大程度上替代在替代策略下的经验；构造一个单一简单环境，使计数型、预测误差、赋能（empowerment）、信息增益等目标的极大化策略在反事实信息获取上帕累托次优；分析失败原因并给出内在奖励成功促进最优探索的条件；并构造一个在准则下探索严格改善时赋予更高价值的目标函数。

Result: 在构造的环境中，指定的计数型、预测误差、赋能和信息增益目标均存在帕累托次优的极大化策略；同时给出了这些目标能够有效鼓励最优探索的条件，并设计出与反事实信息准则一致的新目标。

Conclusion: 反事实信息可作为评价探索质量的原则性准则，揭示现有内在奖励的局限，并为设计更优探索目标提供理论基础。

Abstract: Intrinsic rewards are designed to guide exploration in reinforcement learning by assigning value to an agent's experience, for example through prediction error or learning progress. However, maximizing these rewards need not produce the most informative experience available. We propose a formal criterion for exploration that compares policies by the counterfactual information they acquire: how well their histories can substitute for experience under alternative policies. We construct a single, simple environment in which specified count-based, prediction-error, empowerment, and information-gain objectives have maximizing policies that are Pareto-suboptimal at acquiring counterfactual information. We explain these failures and establish conditions under which existing intrinsic rewards successfully encourage optimal exploration. We also construct an objective that assigns a higher value whenever exploration strictly improves under our criterion.

</details>


### [602] [Effective Resistance and Graph Neural Network Reliability in Tissue-Specific Interactomes](https://arxiv.org/abs/2610.02175)
*Jianru Shen*

Main category: cs.LG

TL;DR: 本文探究组织特异性相互作用网络中的有效电阻（effective resistance）残差是否携带蛋白功能注释中"不该信任哪些预测"的信息，发现该残差在控制多种混杂因素后仍能解释额外的逐节点损失，效应随深度增强，但受度退化限制。


<details>
  <summary>Details</summary>
Motivation: 蛋白功能注释不仅需要模型预测什么，更需要知道哪些预测不可信。作者希望检验组织特异性相互作用结构是否携带这种"可信度"信息，以弥补现有仅关注预测结果的不足。

Method: 以有效电阻为候选信号（此前用于通过重连缓解过挤压问题）。在24个组织特异性相互作用组中分析其与逆度的关系，并构造度保持零模型（degree-preserving null graph）作为对照。计算残差偏离，控制预测熵、度、注释基数、局部结构和仅特征难度等因素，用置换检验（permutation floor）评估残差对逐节点损失的额外解释力，并考察深度变化。

Result: 在24个网络中有效电阻均由逆度主导，共表达过滤网络增长时退化加剧，Spearman相关为-0.955。残差偏离在所有24个网络中均超过度保持零图。控制混杂并减去置换底线后，残差在24个留出网络中的19个解释了额外的逐节点损失，且在每一深度均成立，效应随深度单调增强。增量达控制变量未解释方差的0.37%，为置换底线的5.6倍；而在度保持零世界重训模型时仅为1.5倍。选择性预测提升甚微。

Conclusion: 该信号具有可复现性，但其作用受度退化所限制；组织特异性相互作用结构的有效电阻残差确实携带关于预测可信度的额外信息，但程度有限。

Abstract: Protein function annotation needs to know which predictions to distrust, not only what a model predicts. We ask whether tissue-specific interaction structure carries that information. Our candidate signal is effective resistance, used previously to relieve over-squashing by rewiring. Across 24 tissue-specific interactomes it is dominated by inverse degree, and the degeneration deepens as the co-expression filtered network grows, with a Spearman correlation of -0.955. The residual departure from that limit exceeds degree-preserving null graphs in all 24 networks. Controlling for predictive entropy, degree, annotation cardinality, local structure and feature-only difficulty, the residual explains additional per-node loss in 19 of 24 held-out networks once a permutation floor is subtracted, at every depth, and the effect strengthens monotonically with depth. The increment reaches 0.37% of the variance the controls leave unexplained, 5.6 times a permutation floor, against 1.5 times when the model is retrained in a degree-preserving null world. Selective prediction improves negligibly. The signal is reproducible; degree degeneration bounds it.

</details>


### [603] [From Gradients to Capabilities: Understanding Multi-Teacher On-Policy Distillation](https://arxiv.org/abs/2610.02179)
*Siqi Zhu,Suozhi Huang,Kaixuan Zhang,Yuheng Yang,Zhanyang Jin,Yihang Sun,Jiaxuan You*

Main category: cs.LG

TL;DR: 该论文研究多教师在线策略蒸馏(MOPD)中教师信号如何影响参数变化，揭示损失平均方式、Adam一阶矩、BF16舍入精度及梯度近似策略对蒸馏效果的关键影响。


<details>
  <summary>Details</summary>
Motivation: MOPD旨在将多个经RL训练的教师优势整合到单个学生模型中，但教师信号影响参数变化的具体机制尚未被充分研究，缺乏对梯度、优化器更新和学习曲线的系统分析。

Method: 以Qwen3-1.7B为研究对象，使用从同一初始化经RL训练的四个领域教师（辅以SmolLM3-3B诊断），对比梯度、优化器更新和任务学习曲线，考察损失平均规则、Adam一阶矩、BF16精度及top-64 vs 全词表KL梯度等因素。

Result: (1)损失平均隐式加权响应：token平均偏向长响应，域等权仍在域内保留该加权；(2)Adam一阶矩减小参数更新差异，教师间余弦相似度0.83、平均规则间0.96；(3)BF16舍入掩盖小变化，约97%的FP32主权重偏离初始化而BF16仅7-11%；(4)top-64交集KL梯度接近全词表梯度，但任务效果依赖平均方式：响应平均下数学准确率比采样token PG高2.6点，全局token平均下低2.1点。

Conclusion: 教师信号的影响受损失平均规则、优化器动量、数值精度和梯度近似多重因素共同调节；蒸馏效果并非简单叠加，而需综合考虑这些隐性因素，尤其平均规则与梯度近似的交互会显著改变任务性能。

Abstract: Multi-teacher on-policy distillation (MOPD) aims to combine the strengths of RL-trained teachers in a single student, but how teacher signals affect parameter changes remains underexplored. We study Qwen3-1.7B with four domain teachers trained with RL from the same initialization as the student, comparing gradients, optimizer updates, and task learning curves, with additional SmolLM3-3B diagnostics. We find that several factors influence teacher signals. First, loss averaging implicitly weights responses: token averaging favors longer responses, and equalizing domain contributions retains this weighting within domains. Second, Adam's first moment reduces differences in parameter updates: the cosine similarity is 0.83 between teachers and 0.96 between averaging rules, despite differences in raw gradients. Third, BF16 rounding hides small changes: about 97\% of FP32 master weights differ from initialization, but only 7--11\% of BF16 weights do. Finally, the top-64 intersection KL gradient closely matches Qwen's full-vocabulary gradient, but the effect on task performance depends on averaging: mathematics accuracy is 2.6 points higher than with sampled-token policy-gradient (PG) under response averaging and 2.1 points lower under global token averaging.

</details>


### [604] [SoftServe: A Scalable Quasi-Newton Method for Deep Learning](https://arxiv.org/abs/2610.02182)
*Joohwan Ko,Tetiana Parshakova,Diana Cai,Robert M. Gower*

Main category: cs.LG

TL;DR: SoftServe是一类无需线搜索和曲率修正的拟牛顿方法，通过变分目标获得正定曲率估计，支持对角与Kronecker分解变体，并利用Newton-Schulz迭代实现GPU友好运算，在病态问题和大规模网络上优于Adam、Muon、SOAP等基线。


<details>
  <summary>Details</summary>
Motivation: 拟牛顿方法在大规模无约束凸优化中高效，但因深度学习的非凸性和超大参数量而受限，本文旨在克服这两大障碍。

Method: SoftServe从Berglund等人的变分目标推导正定曲率估计，即使在负曲率下也成立；提出保持正定性的对角和对Kronecker分解变体以扩展到大型神经网络；并使用稳定的耦合Newton-Schulz迭代替代昂贵的矩阵分解，实现GPU友好的矩阵乘法运算。

Result: 在严重病态问题上表现优异，包括循环网络、深度自编码器、物理信息神经网络以及1.36亿参数的物理信息扩散模型，通常取得比Adam、Muon和SOAP等基线更低的损失。

Conclusion: SoftServe为深度学习中的大规模非凸优化提供了一类无需线搜索和曲率修正的可扩展拟牛顿方法，在病态任务上优于现有基线。

Abstract: Quasi-Newton (QN) methods have long been among the most effective methods for large-scale unconstrained convex optimization. Two obstacles have limited their use in deep learning: non-convexity and enormous parameter sizes. We introduce SoftServe, a family of QN methods designed to overcome these obstacles without line searches or ad hoc curvature corrections. SoftServe derives positivedefinite curvature estimates from the variational objective of Berglund et al. (2025), even in the presence of negative curvature. We develop diagonal and Kroneckerfactored variants that preserve positive definiteness by construction and scale to massive neural networks. Finally, SoftServe relies on the stable coupled Newton-Schulz iteration for the required matrix operations, replacing costly matrix decompositions with GPU-friendly matrix multiplications. SoftServe excels on problems that are severely ill-conditioned, including tasks such as recurrent networks, deep autoencoders, physics-informed neural networks, and a 136M-parameter physics-informed diffusion model, often achieving lower losses than established baselines including Adam, Muon, and SOAP.

</details>


### [605] [Decoding Looped Transformers Better for (Almost) Free](https://arxiv.org/abs/2610.02185)
*Weihao Liu,Huangjie Zheng,Tianrong Chen,Rohit Dilip,Richard He Bai,Yizhu Jiao,Yuyang Wang,Ruixiang Zhang*

Main category: cs.LG

TL;DR: 本文提出LoopCD，一种免训练的对比解码框架，通过将循环Transformer的最终预测与早期循环状态进行对比来引导token选择，在无需辅助模型的情况下显著提升解码质量并降低推理计算量。


<details>
  <summary>Details</summary>
Motivation: 循环Transformer通过重复执行共享块实现参数效率，每个循环都会产生可用于预测同一next token的中间表示，但标准解码会丢弃早期状态。由于早期循环蕴含的计算更少，这种循环结构天然提供了对齐的"弱-强"预测对，无需辅助模型或额外训练即可利用。

Method: 提出LoopCD，一个免训练的对比解码框架，通过对比最终预测与较早的循环pass来引导token选择。提供两种变体：LoopCD-Logits在logit空间操作，需要额外一次输出pass；LoopCD-Hidden在隐状态空间操作，零输出开销。

Result: 在四种循环Transformer系列上，LoopCD在完整循环深度下取得显著且一致的提升：LoopCD-Logits将Ouro-2.6B-Thinking的AIME 2024 pass@1从61.88%提升至73.33%；LoopCD-Hidden将Huginn的HumanEval pass@1从22.56%提升至31.71%。这些增益使得循环次数减半的同时仍能匹配或超越全深度未引导基线，减少前向FLOPs 22.5%至48.2%。

Conclusion: 通过将中间循环状态转化为有效的引导信号，LoopCD在显著降低推理计算量的同时实现了更优的解码质量。

Abstract: Looped Transformers achieve parameter efficiency by repeatedly executing a shared block across recurrent loops. Each loop yields an intermediate representation decodable for the same next token, yet standard decoding discards earlier states. Because earlier loops embody less computation, recurrence inherently supplies aligned weak-and-strong prediction pairs without auxiliary models or external training. We introduce LoopCD, a training-free contrastive decoding framework that guides token selection by contrasting the final prediction with an earlier recurrent pass, operating either in logit space with one extra output pass (LoopCD-Logits) or in hidden-state space with zero output overhead (LoopCD-Hidden). Across four looped Transformer families, LoopCD delivers substantial, consistent gains at full recurrent depth: LoopCD-Logits raises Ouro-2.6B-Thinking's AIME 2024 pass@1 from 61.88% to 73.33%, while LoopCD-Hidden lifts Huginn's HumanEval pass@1 from 22.56% to 31.71%. Crucially, these performance gains enable halving the number of recurrent loops while still matching or exceeding full-depth unguided baselines, reducing forward FLOPs by 22.5% to 48.2%. By transforming intermediate recurrent states into effective guidance signals, LoopCD achieves superior decoding quality while substantially reducing inference compute.

</details>


### [606] [Higher-Order Molecular Grammars for Generative and Foundation Models in Chemistry](https://arxiv.org/abs/2610.02186)
*Yiming Huang,Yujie Zeng,Vijay Prakash Dwivedi,Simone Foti,Jianmin Wang,Jure Leskovec,Tolga Birdal*

Main category: cs.LG

TL;DR: 本文提出高阶文法表示（HGR），将分子提升为组合复形并用上下文无关高阶文法解析为产生式规则序列，从而把高阶拓扑高效地序列化，兼容标准序列模型。同时构建环系丰富基准 RingDiv 及环多样性指数（RDI）。实验表明 HGR 在分子生成上兼具 100% 有效性与领先分布对齐（五个基准 FCD 第一），在表示学习上于七个 MoleculeNet 基准取得最高平均 AUC。


<details>
  <summary>Details</summary>
Motivation: 分子学习模型高度依赖底层表示，但标准序列与图表示难以显式编码环系、重复基序等高阶拓扑；已有的高阶表示虽能直接刻画这些结构，却计算开销大且难以解码为有效分子。此外，现有基准偏向简单环系，缺乏对环系覆盖度的衡量。

Method: 提出 HGR 框架：将分子提升为组合复形，并在上下文无关高阶文法下把每个复形解析为紧凑的产生式规则序列，把高阶拓扑序列化为规则序列，从而规避显式高阶编码的计算开销，同时保留拓扑表达能力。此外构建环系丰富的 RingDiv 基准（含 118 万分子及精选的 RingDiv300k 子集），并提出环多样性指数 RDI 量化环系覆盖度。

Result: 在分子生成任务中，基于 HGR 的模型通过构造保证 100% 有效性，并具备领先的分布对齐，在全部五个生成基准的 FCD 上排名第一；在表示学习中，HGR-FM 在两种迁移协议下于七个 MoleculeNet 基准取得最高平均 AUC，相比最强基线在 probing 与全量微调下分别提升 8.3 和 3.3 个 AUC 点。

Conclusion: HGR 是一种高效的高阶表示，可同时服务于分子生成与可迁移表示学习，兼顾拓扑表达能力与计算效率。

Abstract: Molecular learning models are strongly shaped by their underlying representations. Yet standard sequential and graph formalisms struggle to explicitly encode higher-order topology, such as ring systems and recurring motifs. Existing higher-order representations can capture these structures directly, but they are often computationally demanding and difficult to decode into valid molecules. Here, we introduce Higher-order Grammar Representation (HGR), a principled, topology-aware framework that lifts molecules to combinatorial complexes and parses each complex into a compact sequence of production rules under a context-free higher-order grammar. By serialising higher-order topology into rule sequences, HGR makes these structures directly compatible with standard sequence models, avoiding the computational overhead of explicit higher-order encodings while preserving topological expressiveness. To reduce benchmark bias towards simple ring systems, we construct RingDiv, a ring-enriched benchmark containing 1.18 million molecules, including the curated RingDiv300k subset, and introduce the ring diversity index (RDI) to quantify ring-system coverage. In molecular generation, HGR-based models uniquely combine 100% validity by construction with leading distributional alignment, ranking first in FCD on all five generation benchmarks. In representation learning, HGR-FM achieves the highest mean AUC across seven MoleculeNet benchmarks under both transfer protocols, improving on the strongest baseline by 8.3 and 3.3 AUC points under probing and full fine-tuning, respectively. Collectively, these results establish HGR as an efficient higher-order representation for molecular generation and transferable representation learning.

</details>


### [607] [Generative modeling of intrinsically disordered protein regions by reinforcing sparse autoencoder features](https://arxiv.org/abs/2610.02189)
*Jason X. Liu,Sebastian Ibarraran,Frank Hu,Soojung Yang,Xinyu A. Feng,Abigail Park,Anagha Aneesh,Lacramioara Bintu,Alexander R. Dunn,Grant M. Rotskoff*

Main category: cs.LG

TL;DR: 提出IDiom（基于IDR数据集的蛋白质语言模型）与RL-SAE后训练方法，实现可控、可解释、可组合的IDR功能设计。


<details>
  <summary>Details</summary>
Motivation: IDR在转录调控、信号转导、亚细胞定位等过程中作用关键，但基于结构的设计方法不适用于IDR，且现有蛋白质语言模型在全长序列上训练，其先验偏向折叠结构域，导致IDR功能设计困难。

Method: 构建IDiom-DB数据集（从AlphaFold数据库筛选的5400万条预测IDR）；训练自回归蛋白质语言模型IDiom；提出RL-SAE后训练方法，以稀疏自编码器特征为奖励，强化生成能激活指定特征集的序列。

Result: 在8项IDR设计任务中，RL-SAE生成序列平均激活30个目标特征中的90%，而activation steering仅24%；相比steering与监督微调，RL-SAE提升预测的亚细胞定位与转录活性，并支持将不同生物学功能的特征组合到同一序列中。

Conclusion: IDiom与RL-SAE通过显式控制功能相关序列特征，实现可解释、可组合的IDR设计；RL-SAE有望推广至其他可提供可解释特征作为设计目标的蛋白质设计场景。

Abstract: Intrinsically disordered protein regions (IDRs) play central roles in cellular processes such as transcriptional regulation, signal transduction, and subcellular localization, yet their functional design remains challenging. Structure-based design methods do not readily apply to IDRs, and existing protein language models are trained on full-length protein sequences, thus learning a prior that is biased towards folded domains. Here, we present IDiom, an autoregressive protein language model trained on IDiom-DB, a dataset of 54 million predicted IDRs curated from the AlphaFold Database. IDiom generates diverse sequences that recapitulate the composition, patterning, motifs, and predicted disorder of natural IDRs. To control function-associated sequence patterns, we also introduce reinforcement learning with sparse autoencoder features (RL-SAE), a post-training method that rewards the generation of sequences that activate specified feature sets. Across eight IDR design tasks, RL-SAE sequences activate, on average, 90% of 30 targeted features, compared to 24% for activation steering. We demonstrate that RL-SAE improves the predicted subcellular localization and transcriptional activity of generated IDRs compared to steering and supervised fine-tuning, and enables features associated with distinct biological functions to be combined within individual sequences. Thus, IDiom and RL-SAE enable interpretable and composable IDR design through explicit control of function-associated sequence features. More broadly, RL-SAE could extend to other protein design settings where interpretable features provide useful design targets. Code is available at https://github.com/rotskoff-group/idiom.

</details>


### [608] [Trust the Direction, Search the Step: Zero-and-First-Order Methods for LLM Fine-Tuning](https://arxiv.org/abs/2610.02190)
*Cristian McGee,El Houcine Bergou,Aritra Dutta*

Main category: cs.LG

TL;DR: 本文提出ZFO轻量框架，将优化方向选择与步长选择解耦：方向由受信任的一阶优化器决定，步长仅在沿该方向的一维子空间上通过零阶评估确定。ZFO利用当前梯度信息与两次额外函数评估构建局部模型，在有限区间内选取曲率感知的自适应步长，成本低于完整线搜索。理论证明共享样本评估可得到可靠的有限差分曲率估计、局部模型可选出近最优步长、算法收敛至驻点邻域。实验表明ZFO在语言模型与数据集上常优于固定步长一阶基线，但增益与最佳局部模型依赖具体目标。


<details>
  <summary>Details</summary>
Motivation: 步长选择是大规模神经网络优化的核心难题：步长保守会拖慢收敛，步长激进会导致训练不稳定。现有方法难以在低额外开销下自适应地平衡二者。

Method: ZFO将方向与步长解耦：用受信任的一阶优化器确定更新方向，仅在该方向构成的一维子空间上进行零阶评估以决定移动距离。结合当前梯度信息与两次额外目标函数评估，沿该方向构建目标的局部模型，并在有界搜索区间内选择曲率感知的自适应步长，总开销低于完整线搜索。

Result: 理论层面：证明共享样本评估能得到可靠的有限差分曲率估计；诱导的局部模型可在搜索区间内选出近最优步长；ZFO可收敛至驻点邻域。实验层面：在多种设置、语言模型与数据集上，ZFO相对固定步长的一阶基线常改善优化过程与最终性能，且增益幅度与最优局部模型选择因目标函数而异。

Conclusion: ZFO提供了一种低成本、具理论保证的自适应步长框架，将一阶方向与零阶步长搜索结合，在语言模型优化中普遍有效，但最佳性能仍与应用目标相关；代码已开源。

Abstract: Step-size selection remains a central challenge in large-scale neural network optimization; conservative steps slow convergence, while aggressive steps can destabilize it. We combine \textbf{Z}ero-and-\textbf{F}irst-\textbf{O}rder optimization~(ZFO) and propose a lightweight framework that decouples direction selection from step-size. ZFO uses a trusted first-order optimizer to determine the direction and performs zeroth-order evaluations only along this one-dimensional subspace to choose how far to move. Using the current {gradient information} and two additional objective function evaluations, ZFO instances construct a local model of the objective function along the proposed direction and select a curvature-aware step within a bounded search interval. This yields an adaptive step-selection mechanism that costs less than a full line search. We provide theoretical guarantees to show that shared-sample evaluations produce reliable finite-difference curvature estimates, that the induced local model selects a near-optimal step along the search interval, and that ZFO converges to a neighborhood of a stationary point. Across the evaluated settings, language models and datasets, ZFO frequently improves optimization and final performance relative to fixed-step first-order baselines, with the magnitude and preferred local model depending on the objective. Our code is publicly available at: https://github.com/nizswan/Zeroth-First-Order-Framework.

</details>


### [609] [The Missing Primitive: Diagnosing and Repairing Mathematical Reasoning in Large Language Models](https://arxiv.org/abs/2610.02191)
*Shuo Xing,Zilin Dai,Chengyuan Qian,Fangzhou Lin,Wenjing Chen,Ping He,Pan Lu,Alvaro Velasquez,Mohit Bansal,Zhengzhong Tu*

Main category: cs.LG

TL;DR: 本文提出"数学基元"概念与四维评测基准，系统诊断LLM的数学理解能力，并据此设计基元优先的自蒸馏训练框架，显著提升数学推理性能。


<details>
  <summary>Details</summary>
Motivation: LLM在数学问题上表现优异，但尚不清楚其是否具备支撑解题的结构性数学理解。现有评测多依赖最终答案准确率，掩盖了能力结构的差异，因此需要系统性地诊断并利用这些发现改进后训练。

Method: 1) 提出"数学基元"（Mathematical Primitive）概念，用于探测结构性数学理解；2) 构建新基准，从发现（Discovery）、生成（Generation）、消化（Digestion）、执行（Execution）四个维度评估数学推理；3) 基于该基准进行系统诊断与后训练分析；4) 提出基元优先的自蒸馏框架，将基元引导的推理选择性迁移至学生模型。

Result: 诊断显示：解题准确率会掩盖不同的能力画像；基元可释放大量潜在执行能力；发现是数学推理的主要瓶颈；且受限于发现的失败更易被修复。所提自蒸馏框架在不同模型规模和多个高难度基准上均持续优于基线。

Conclusion: 将评测从答案正确性转向结构性能力诊断，能够揭示LLM数学理解的真实瓶颈，并使基元引导的自蒸馏成为提升数学推理的有效后训练策略。

Abstract: While Large Language Models (LLMs) have demonstrated striking capabilities on frontier mathematical problems, it remains unclear whether they possess the structural mathematical understanding underlying their solutions. In this paper, we take a first step toward systematically studying mathematical understanding in LLMs, from diagnosing its distinct capabilities to leveraging these findings to improve post-training. First, we introduce the notion of Mathematical Primitive to probe structural mathematical understanding and propose \hlei{}, a novel benchmark that evaluates mathematical reasoning along four distinct dimensions: Discovery, Generation, Digestion, and Execution. Second, our systematic diagnosis shows that solution accuracy masks distinct capability profiles, primitives unlock substantial latent execution capacity, and Discovery is the dominant bottleneck in mathematical reasoning. Our post-training analysis further shows that discovery-limited failures are particularly amenable to repair. Finally, building on these findings, we introduce \abs{}, a primitive-privileged self-distillation framework that selectively transfers primitive-guided reasoning into the student model. Extensive experiments demonstrate that \abs{} consistently improves mathematical reasoning over baselines across model scales and challenging benchmarks.

</details>


### [610] [Cost-augmented Schrödinger bridges on graphs are exactly solvable: a Feynman-Kac tilt replaces learned control](https://arxiv.org/abs/2610.02195)
*Akshay Balsubramani*

Main category: cs.LG

TL;DR: 该论文提出在图上的广义薛定谔桥问题中，将状态代价以Feynman-Kac倾斜（tilt）方式并入参考过程，使代价增广桥退化为对倾斜参考的普通桥，从而无需时间差分惩罚；桥可由两次端点重标定的交替精确计算（各为一次稀疏矩阵指数应用），无需时间离散化或学习。


<details>
  <summary>Details</summary>
Motivation: 现有方法通过学习的受控连续时间马尔可夫链速率来求解广义薛定谔桥，并依赖时间差分惩罚项来恢复代价，这引入了学习与时间离散化的复杂度。作者希望找到一种无需学习、无需时间离散化、可精确求解的替代途径。

Method: 将状态代价折入参考过程形成Feynman-Kac倾斜，使代价增广桥成为对倾斜参考的普通桥；用交替两个端点重标定的方式精确计算桥，每次重标定只需一次稀疏矩阵指数运算；对时间平均占据量上的二次拥塞代价，以围绕精确桥的阻尼最佳响应进行梯度下降（目标为强凸函数），并用残差界定误差。

Result: 交替算法的收敛速率仅由端点耦合决定；阻尼最佳响应的残差可界定其误差。在蛋白质折叠模型上，自由能代价降低了折叠路径的期望势垒。在学习方法的道路网络上，精确桥的roll-out在采样误差内匹配目标分布；在含数百万交叉口的网络上，内存呈线性增长。

Conclusion: 该工作表明广义薛定谔桥可被精确、无学习地求解：代价通过Feynman-Kac倾斜吸收进参考过程，桥由稀疏矩阵指数交替重标定得到，兼具理论收敛保证与在大规模网络上的可扩展性（线性内存）。

Abstract: The generalized Schrödinger bridge on a graph moves mass between two distributions while charging a cost for the states visited. It has been approached by learning the rates of a controlled continuous-time Markov chain, with a temporal-difference penalty that restores the cost. A state cost folds into the reference process as a Feynman-Kac tilt. The cost-augmented bridge is then a plain bridge against the tilted reference, and the penalty is unnecessary. The bridge is computed exactly by alternating two endpoint rescalings, each one sparse matrix-exponential application; nothing is discretized in time or learned. The alternation converges at a rate set by the endpoint coupling alone. For a quadratic congestion cost on time-averaged occupancies, damped best response around the exact bridge is gradient descent on a strongly convex function, and its residual bounds its error. On a protein-folding model, a free-energy cost lowers the expected barrier of the folding paths. On the learned approach's road network, roll-outs of the exact bridge match the target within sampling error, and on networks with millions of intersections its memory grows linearly.

</details>


### [611] [TACO: Ternary Absolute-max Column-wise One-sparse Optimizer for LLM Fine-Tuning](https://arxiv.org/abs/2610.02199)
*Jichao Jiang,Cristian McGee,El Houcine Bergou,Hanqin Cai,Aritra Dutta*

Main category: cs.LG

TL;DR: 本文提出TACO优化器，通过列级稀疏的算子范数最速下降方向，将优化器状态压缩174倍并显著降低训练内存，同时保持精度，实现单卡80GB H100上30-32B模型的全参数微调。


<details>
  <summary>Details</summary>
Motivation: 全参数微调LLM带来巨大的优化器状态内存开销，限制了可训练模型规模。现有方法或压缩优化器状态、或放弃一阶梯度、或改变更新几何但仍保留稠密状态。Muon虽减少内存，但其几何与AdamW不同，微调AdamW预训练模型时可能导致性能下降。因此需要在保持精度和计算效率的前提下大幅降低优化器内存。

Method: 提出TACO（Ternary Absolute-max Column-wise One-sparse optimizer），沿袭Muon的算子范数最速下降视角并进一步推进几何路线。TACO在维度归一化的1→1算子范数下，通过选取二维权重矩阵每列中绝对值最大元素的符号来计算精确的最速下降方向。实际实现中，每列仅保留一小组低精度梯度分量，从而保留一阶梯度信息，使优化器状态内存几乎可忽略。

Result: 在OPT-13B上，相对AdamW8bit将持久优化器状态内存减少174倍（27.7 GB→0.16 GB），峰值训练内存减少2.9倍（80.6 GB→27.5 GB），同时达到相当的精度和运行时。TACO还支持在单张80 GB H100 GPU上对30-32B参数模型进行全参数微调，覆盖多种模型族和任务。

Conclusion: TACO通过列级稀疏的算子范数最速下降更新，在不牺牲精度与计算效率的情况下极大降低优化器状态与峰值训练内存，使大模型全参数微调在单卡上可行。

Abstract: Full-parameter fine-tuning of large language models (LLMs) incurs substantial optimizer state memory overhead, limiting the model sizes that fit on modern GPUs. Existing approaches either compress optimizer state, abandon first-order gradients, or change the update geometry while retaining dense state. The recently introduced Muon optimizer reduces optimizer memory through matrix-valued updates. Still, its geometry differs from AdamW and can lead to performance degradation when fine-tuning AdamW-pretrained models. To reduce optimizer memory without sacrificing accuracy or computational efficiency in LLM fine-tuning, we propose Ternary Absolute-max Column-wise One-sparse optimizer, or TACO, which follows Muon's operator-norm steepest-descent view but takes the geometric route further. TACO computes the exact steepest-descent direction under a dimension-normalized $1\to1$ operator norm by selecting the sign of the largest magnitude entry in each column of two-dimensional weight matrices. This retains first-order gradients while making optimizer state memory nearly negligible. Our practical TACO optimizer maintains only a small set of low precision gradient components per column, reducing persistent optimizer state by $174\times$ relative to AdamW8bit (from 27.7 GB to 0.16 GB) and peak training memory by $2.9\times$ (from 80.6 GB to 27.5 GB) on OPT-13B, while achieving comparable accuracy and runtime. TACO further enables full-parameter fine-tuning of 30-32B-parameter models on a single 80 GB H100 GPU across multiple model families and tasks.

</details>

### [612] [A2Z GameSpec-Bench: How Faithfully Can Coding Agents Generate Games from Game Design Specifications?](https://arxiv.org/abs/2609.39564)
*Seonho Lee,Wonryeol Jeong,Alberto Cereser,Inha Kang,Hyeonjong Kim,Seungmin Kwak,Dongmin Park*

Main category: cs.AI

TL;DR: 提出 A2Z GameSpec-Bench，包含 100 份长篇游戏设计文档（GDD），用于端到端评估编码智能体开发游戏的规范遵循度（GDD Fidelity）。


<details>
  <summary>Details</summary>
Motivation: 将完整应用开发交由编码智能体时，需保留原始设计意图而非仅靠朴素提示生成看似合理的产物。游戏开发是严苛测试场景，因长篇 GDD 要求游戏逻辑、视觉渲染与玩家交互协同满足。现有基准多用紧凑规范，缺乏对长篇 GDD 中跨维度相互依赖需求的评估支持。

Method: 将每份 GDD 转为依赖感知契约（含规则、约束、前置关系），结合源码检查与智能体生成测试策略，进行场景回放与自适应试玩；契约在智能体与修订轮次间保持固定，判定与证据绑定同一需求以支持一致比较与失败检测。

Result: 当前智能体难以在代码实现与实际游玩中同时满足相互依赖的需求；相比自我修订，需求特定反馈在两轮后将 GDD Fidelity 提升 10.9%。

Conclusion: A2Z GameSpec-Bench 超越实现层面判断，评估端到端规范遵循能力，并提供针对性反馈以支持更忠实的游戏开发。

Abstract: Delegating complete application development to coding agents requires preserving the intended design rather than simply producing plausible outputs through naive prompting. Game development provides a demanding testbed, as long-form Game Design Documents (GDDs) describe requirements that must work together across game logic, visual rendering, and player interactions. However, existing game-development benchmarks typically use compact specifications and provide limited support for evaluating interdependent requirements across these aspects in long-form GDDs. We introduce A2Z GameSpec-Bench, a benchmark of 100 long-form GDDs for evaluating end-to-end game development by agents. We measure faithfulness by checking whether the game satisfies the GDD requirements and preserves the relationships among them. Each GDD is turned into a dependency-aware contract that contains rules, constraints, and prerequisite relations. Following game-development practices, we combine source-code inspection with agent-generated test policies for scenario-based replay and adaptive playtesting. The contract remains fixed across agents and revision rounds, while judgments and evidence linked to the same requirements support consistent comparison and failure detection. Our evaluations show that current agents struggle to jointly satisfy interdependent requirements across code implementation and actual play. Requirement-specific feedback improves GDD Fidelity by 10.9% relative to self-revision after two rounds. A2Z GameSpec-Bench assesses end-to-end specification-following ability beyond implementation judgments and provides targeted feedback to support more faithful game development. Code and datasets are available at https://a2z-gamespec-bench.github.io.

</details>


### [613] [Frozen Scenes, Shifting Winners: Configuration Fragility in Text-to-3D Evaluation](https://arxiv.org/abs/2610.00447)
*Anson Y. Lam,Shuqing Li,Michael R. Lyu*

Main category: cs.AI

TL;DR: 论文审计了渲染图像式文本到3D评测的协议敏感性：在300个冻结场景、六个生成器、八种渲染与描述因素、19个对齐评测器加1个感知质量对照下，发现评测峰值配置方差在17/19个对齐评测器上超过生成器间方差，18/19个评测器在某配置下改变点估计冠军，但无翻转通过全搜索的同时推断。


<details>
  <summary>Details</summary>
Motivation: 文本到3D排行榜通常被当作生成器能力的稳定度量，但渲染式评测中相机设置和描述措辞本身构成测量协议的一部分。作者希望检验：当生成场景固定不变时，单纯改变协议是否就足以改变排行榜结论。

Method: 使用六个生成器的300个冻结场景，对每个场景变动八种渲染与描述因素；用19个对齐评测器和1个感知质量对照评测；另做四种针对性场景退化测试；采用提示自助法下界、成对协议边际包络及全搜索同时推断等统计手段。

Result: 17/19个对齐评测器的峰值配置方差超过生成器间方差，11/19的提示自助下界大于1；排名比分数稳定，但18/19个评测器在某种配置下改变点估计冠军；成对边际包络识别出方向稳健的比较，部分选定对出现相反的点区间，但全搜索同时推断下无翻转存活；无评测器（含无提示对照）在布局打乱上超过67%的平局校正方向判别率。

Conclusion: 观测到的冠军变化是描述性的，而非生成器优越性的确证变化；分数稳定性、决策不确定性与针对性敏感性应分开报告；建议报告(生成器, 分数, 卡片ID)三元组，采用协议相关比较与选择感知的不确定性，且敏感性测试为诊断性而非人类验证的真值。

Abstract: Can a text-to-3D leaderboard change when every generated scene stays fixed? We audit this question for rendered-image evaluation, where camera settings and caption wording become part of the measurement protocol. Across 300 frozen scenes from six generators, we vary eight render and caption factors for 19 alignment evaluators plus one perceptual-quality control, then test four targeted scene degradations. Peak configuration variance exceeds between-generator variance for 17/19 alignment evaluators, with prompt-bootstrap lower bounds above 1 for 11/19. Rankings are more stable than scores, yet 18/19 evaluators change their point-estimate winner under some configuration. Pairwise protocol margin envelopes show which comparisons keep their direction across the tested settings. Selected pairs have opposite pointwise intervals, but no reversal survives simultaneous inference over the full search. Thus the observed winner changes are descriptive, not confirmed changes in generator superiority. Sensitivity remains separate: no evaluator, even the prompt-free control, exceeds 67% tie-adjusted directional discrimination on layout scrambling, which is diagnostic rather than human-validated ground truth. The audit separates score stability, decision uncertainty, and targeted sensitivity, and recommends reporting (generator, score, card ID) with protocol-dependent comparisons and selection-aware uncertainty.

</details>


### [614] [AiSearch: Interactive Multi-Modal Search with VLMs](https://arxiv.org/abs/2610.01389)
*Ali Koksal,Mei Chee Leong,Vicky Sintunata,Ching Ling Chin,Wee Teck Fong*

Main category: cs.AI

TL;DR: AiSearch：基于视觉语言模型零样本能力的多模态交互式图文/视频检索框架，支持反馈式检索精炼与跨模型可视化基准测试。


<details>
  <summary>Details</summary>
Motivation: 现代检索系统需同时具备自动化与交互性，支持用户实时搜索并精炼结果；同时多模态（图像、视频）与自然语言检索场景下，模型选择缺乏便捷的评估手段。

Method: 提出AiSearch框架，利用视觉语言模型（VLM）的零样本能力实现图像与视频的自然语言检索；通过用户反馈进行交互式检索精炼以贴合用户意图；并支持对多个VLM进行可视化基准测试。

Result: 框架可实现自然语言驱动的图像/视频检索、基于反馈的结果精炼，以及多VLM对比的可视化基准测试，帮助用户为任务选择最合适模型。（摘要未给出定量实验结果）

Conclusion: AiSearch提供了一个灵活、可交互、可扩展的多模态检索方案，兼具零样本检索、用户意图对齐与模型选型支持能力。

Abstract: Modern retrieval systems must both be automated and interactive, allowing users to search and refine results in real time. We present AiSearch, a flexible multimodal retrieval framework that leverages the zero shot capabilities of Vision Language Models (VLMs) for natural language search over images and videos. AiSearch supports interactive search refinement through user feedback to tailor results to the user's intent, and allows visual benchmarking across multiple VLMs, enabling users to select the most suitable model for their task.

</details>


### [615] [Towards Reliable Vision-Language Models for Autonomous Driving](https://arxiv.org/abs/2610.01531)
*Manasa Mariam Mammen,Priyanka Mary Mammen,Zafer Kayatas,Stefan Wagner*

Main category: cs.AI

TL;DR: 该论文评估了五种视觉语言模型（VLM）在自动驾驶场景下、不同视觉输入设置与视觉退化条件下的鲁棒性与置信度可靠性，并检验了推理时方法VEA的改进效果。


<details>
  <summary>Details</summary>
Motivation: VLM在自动驾驶中的场景理解、推理、决策与端到端驾驶任务中日益重要，而真实环境中传感器缺陷和环境条件会造成视觉输入退化，可能同时影响模型预测与置信度。在安全攸关的自动驾驶场景中，模型既要预测准确，也要能识别自身预测何时不可靠，因此有必要系统评估VLM在视觉退化下的鲁棒性与置信度可靠性。

Method: 选取五个VLM（Qwen3.5-9B、Gemma4-E4B、LLaVA-OneVision-7B、DriveFusion/DriveFusionQA-4B、NVIDIA Alpamayo-1.5-10B），在四个驾驶相关QA数据集上，采用四种视觉输入设置（单帧、多视角、多帧、单目）进行评测；分析不同视觉损坏条件下准确率与置信度可靠性的变化；并应用推理时方法Visual Evidence Augmentation（VEA），考察其在视觉退化条件下能否提升模型可靠性。

Result: 视觉损坏的影响因模型、数据集和输入设置而异；准确率与置信度可靠性的变化在不同条件下也各不相同。VEA对部分模型和数据集带来性能提升，但增益并非在所有设置下都保持一致。

Conclusion: VLM在自动驾驶中的视觉退化鲁棒性尚无统一规律，模型、数据集与输入设置之间存在显著差异；推理时增强方法VEA具有一定潜力但效果不稳定，说明在退化视觉条件下提升VLM可靠性仍需更稳健的方法。

Abstract: Vision-Language models (VLMs) are increasingly being explored in autonomous driving for tasks such as scene understanding, driving reasoning, decision-making, and end-to-end driving. As their role becomes more prominent, ensuring their robustness and reliability is increasingly important. In real-world conditions, visual inputs may be degraded by sensor imperfections and environmental conditions, potentially affecting both model predictions and their associated confidence. Such degradation is especially concerning in autonomous driving, where safety-critical decisions require models to make accurate predictions and recognize when their predictions may be unreliable. In this work, we evaluate five VLMs (Qwen3.5-9B, Gemma4-E4B, LLaVA-OneVision-7B, DriveFusion/DriveFusionQA-4B, and NVIDIA Alpamayo-1.5-10B) across four driving-related QA datasets with different visual input settings, including single-frame, multi-view, multi-frame, and monocular inputs. Our results show that the effects of visual corruption vary across models, datasets, and input settings, with changes in accuracy and confidence reliability and also differing across conditions. We then apply Visual Evidence Augmentation ($\mathrm{V}{\scriptstyle \mathrm{EA}}$), a recent inference-time method to examine whether it can improve model reliability under degraded visual conditions. We find that $\mathrm{V}{\scriptstyle \mathrm{EA}}$ improves performance for some models and datasets, although the gains are not consistent across all settings.

</details>


### [616] [CoEvolve: Construct-to-Edit Visual Grounding with Bidirectional State Refinement](https://arxiv.org/abs/2610.01710)
*Dongwei Sun,Yujie Zhang,Bowen Yao,Pei Liu,Jing Yao,Xiangyong Cao*

Main category: cs.AI

TL;DR: 提出CoEvolve框架，将视觉定位分解为显式状态构建与状态编辑，用RER组织语义-空间推理轨迹、BDR精修坐标，以9B主干媲美241B模型并显著提升误差恢复能力。


<details>
  <summary>Details</summary>
Motivation: 现有大多数多模态定位模型将目标识别、空间推理与边界估计压缩为单一终端预测；自由形式的推理链虽让推理"语言化"，却未暴露可度量、可编辑的空间状态，导致中间定位错误难以诊断与纠正，最终框内可能遗留错误区域选择与不精确边界。

Method: CoEvolve为"构建-编辑"框架，把定位拆为显式状态构建与状态编辑。Region-Evolution Reinforcement（RER）将定位分析组织为渐进式"语义—空间"轨迹，每步推理显式提交一个候选区域；Bidirectional Denoising Refiner（BDR）将推理文本视为固定语义上下文，通过双向同位置重建精修轨迹坐标字段；并设计几何级与行为级目标，提供目标几何与编辑偏好信号，用于巩固可靠候选、保留准确输入或向标注纠正。

Result: 评估覆盖自然图像与遥感定位。9B主干下，CoEvolve的定位精度可与多达241B参数的模型相当；在受控损坏条件下，单次BDR处理使平均框重叠率提升超过27个百分点，显示对大幅定位误差的强恢复能力；状态来源对比进一步验证显式状态构建与来源匹配编辑的互补性。

Conclusion: 将视觉定位显式化为可度量、可编辑的中间空间状态，并以构建与编辑互补的机制加以强化，可在小参数量下取得强定位性能并提升错误可诊断性与可纠正性。项目见 https://sundongwei.github.io/CoEvolve_Project/。

Abstract: Visual grounding localizes an object described by language with a bounding box. Most multimodal grounding models compress target identification, spatial reasoning, and boundary estimation into one terminal prediction. Free-form rationales make reasoning linguistically explicit but do not necessarily expose measurable, editable spatial states. Intermediate localization errors are therefore difficult to diagnose and correct, allowing incorrect region choices and imprecise boundaries to persist in the final box. We introduce CoEvolve, a construct-to-edit framework that separates grounding into explicit state construction and state editing. Region-Evolution Reinforcement (RER) organizes grounding analysis into a progressive semantic--spatial trajectory, with each reasoning step committing to an explicit candidate region. Bidirectional Denoising Refiner (BDR) treats the reasoning text as fixed semantic context and refines the trajectory's coordinate fields through bidirectional same-position reconstruction. Geometry- and behavior-level objectives provide target geometry and edit-preference signals for consolidating reliable candidates, preserving accurate inputs, or correcting toward annotations. Evaluations cover natural-image and remote-sensing grounding. With a 9B backbone, CoEvolve rivals models up to 241B parameters in grounding accuracy. Under controlled corruption, a single BDR pass improves mean box overlap by over 27 percentage points, demonstrating strong recovery from substantial localization errors. State-source comparisons further support the complementarity of explicit state construction and source-matched editing. The project is at https://sundongwei.github.io/CoEvolve_Project/.

</details>


### [617] [VideoEvolve: Evolving Agent Harnesses for Video Temporal Grounding](https://arxiv.org/abs/2610.01766)
*Bingjun Luo,Yuhuan Fan,Jialin Guo,Siqi Li*

Main category: cs.AI

TL;DR: 提出 VideoEvolve 框架，自动演化视频时序定位的 agent harness，通过结构化表示与分支引导演化提升性能。


<details>
  <summary>Details</summary>
Motivation: 围绕冻结的视频-语言模型构建的 agent，其 harness 决定了自然语言查询如何引导时序预测以及预测如何被细化。手工设计 harness 需要诊断定位失败并协调 agent 工作流与指令的修改，成本高、难度大。

Method: VideoEvolve 采用 Cloze-Structured Harness Representation，在保留各阶段接口的同时让 agent 工作流与指令可自由演化；并采用 Branch-Guided Harness Evolution，保留有潜力的代码分支继续优化，利用执行反馈引导局部编辑，通过验证决定哪些改进被保留。

Result: 在多个基准上取得更好的定位性能。组件分析表明指令细化是收益的稳定来源，而演化代码带来的收益在不同评测设置下存在差异。

Conclusion: 结果支持自动 harness 演化是提升视频时序定位的有效途径。代码已开源。

Abstract: Video temporal grounding aims to localize events in videos from natural-language queries. For agents built around frozen video-language models, the harness determines how queries guide temporal predictions and how those predictions are refined. Manually refining these harnesses requires diagnosing grounding failures and coordinating changes to both agent workflows and instructions. We introduce VideoEvolve, a framework that automatically evolves agent harnesses for video temporal grounding. VideoEvolve uses a Cloze-Structured Harness Representation that preserves stage interfaces while leaving agent workflows and instructions open to evolution. Branch-Guided Harness Evolution preserves promising code branches for continued refinement, using execution feedback to guide local edits and validation to determine which improvements are carried forward. Experiments demonstrate improved grounding performance across multiple benchmarks. Component analyses identify instruction refinement as a consistent source of gains, while the benefits of evolved code vary across evaluation settings. Together, these results support automated harness evolution as an effective approach to improving video temporal grounding. Code is available at https://github.com/bingjunluo/VideoEvolve .

</details>


### [618] [VISTA: A Visual Harness for Reasoning in an Interactive World](https://arxiv.org/abs/2610.02200)
*Qiushi Han,Keya Hu,Linlu Qiu,Cathy Wu,Kaiming He*

Main category: cs.AI

TL;DR: 提出 VISTA 视觉执行框架，使通用多模态模型具备长时程视觉能力，在 ARC-AGI-3 上将相对人类行为效率从 40.68 提升至 100.00。


<details>
  <summary>Details</summary>
Motivation: 多模态模型本身具备较强推理能力，但缺乏合适的外部框架（harness）来释放其在多样交互环境中的潜力，尤其在需要长时程记忆与主动信息调取的视觉任务上表现受限。

Method: VISTA 是一种视觉 harness：模型直接以视觉观测感知环境，并维护无损视觉记忆，将历史观测以原始形式保存；推理过程中模型可主动检索这些观测并重组织视觉输入。设计简洁，可低适配成本迁移到多种视觉环境。

Result: 在 ARC-AGI-3 上，Claude Opus 5.0 的相对人类行为效率（Relative Human Action Efficiency）由 40.68 提升至满分 100.00，完成全部 25 个公开游戏，且所用动作数比首次参与的人类玩家少 57.4%。在另外三个涵盖多种视觉游戏与谜题的基准上，VISTA 也显著优于使用同一底层模型但仅配最小 harness 的基线。

Conclusion: VISTA 有望成为一种通用视觉 harness，推动多模态智能体在复杂视觉环境中的能力提升。

Abstract: We show that multimodal models possess strong reasoning abilities and that an appropriate harness can unlock their potential to solve tasks across diverse interactive environments. We introduce VISTA, a visual harness that gives a general-purpose multimodal model long-horizon vision. VISTA allows the model to directly perceive the environment through visual observations and maintains a lossless visual memory that preserves past observations in their original form. The model can actively retrieve these observations and reorganize its visual input as it reasons. On ARC-AGI-3, VISTA improves Claude Opus 5.0's Relative Human Action Efficiency score from 40.68 to a perfect 100.00, with the model completing all 25 public games using 57.4% fewer actions than first-time human participants. VISTA's simple design also allows it to extend naturally to diverse visual environments with minimal adaptation. Across three additional benchmarks covering a diverse range of visual games and puzzles, it substantially outperforms baselines using the same underlying model with minimal harnesses. Our results highlight VISTA's potential as a general-purpose visual harness for advancing multimodal agents in complex visual environments.

</details>


### [619] [Enterprise Representation Simplification (ERS): Reducing Representational Complexity for Enterprise AI](https://arxiv.org/abs/2610.00791)
*Terry Dorsey,Kevin Huggins*

Main category: cs.AI

TL;DR: 本文提出企业表示简化(ERS)与企业表示复杂度(ERC)模型，用四个维度刻画表示复杂度，并建立生命周期义务与经济模型，说明任务级复杂度降低可改善AI推理表现。


<details>
  <summary>Details</summary>
Motivation: 企业信息经由应用、项目、技术、组织边界与本地需求塑形，随时间累积出表示复杂度，增加企业维护负担并加重信息消费者与AI系统的解读难度。现有研究缺乏表示中立的复杂度比较框架，难以区分架构性简化与检索优化、评估转换效果与AI推理影响。

Method: 提出ERC表示中立模型，从Representation Objects、Interactions、Behaviors、Supporting Sources四个维度刻画表示范围，前三维为依赖类别，Supporting Sources刻画表示暴露；在表示层与任务层定义ERC，以支持比较并区分架构简化与检索优化。进而构建经济模型，区分周期性全局表示成本、周期性任务级成本与一次性转换成本，用于在给定时间范围内评估。并以Text-to-SQL研究作为经验证据支撑任务级ERC降低与推理准确性关系的分析。

Result: 识别出ERS的两个推论：一是表示结构产生维护、治理、依赖、变更、增强与运营的生命周期义务，可由经济模型在时间范围内量化评估；二是任务级ERC的降低可减少AI系统需识别、关联与解读的表示范围，Text-to-SQL研究表明模式与推理复杂度的降低可提升推理准确性。

Conclusion: ERC并非通用复杂度、性能或成本指标，而是提供可度量的架构变量，用于比较表示方案、转换效应、经济结果与AI推理表现。

Abstract: Enterprise information is represented through artifacts shaped by applications, projects, technologies, organizational boundaries, and local requirements. These structures accumulate over time, creating representational complexity that must be maintained by the enterprise and interpreted by information consumers and AI systems. This paper introduces Enterprise Representation Simplification (ERS) as reducing unnecessary representational complexity while preserving required information within a defined scope, and Enterprise Representation Complexity (ERC), a representation-neutral model for comparing complexity across representation states.
  ERC characterizes representational extent through four dimensions: Representation Objects, Interactions, Behaviors, and Supporting Sources. Objects, Interactions, and Behaviors form dependent categories, while Supporting Sources characterize representation exposure. ERC is defined at representation and task levels, enabling comparison and distinguishing architectural simplification from retrieval optimization.
  The paper develops two consequences of ERS. First, representational structures create lifecycle obligations for maintenance, governance, dependencies, change, enhancement, and operation. An economic model distinguishes recurring global representation cost, recurring task-level cost, and one-time transformation cost, enabling evaluation over a defined time horizon. Second, reductions in task-level ERC reduce the representational extent an AI system must identify, relate, and interpret. Text-to-SQL research provides evidence that reduced schema and reasoning complexity can improve reasoning accuracy.
  ERC is not a universal complexity, performance, or cost metric. It provides measurable architectural variables for comparing representational alternatives, transformation effects, economic outcomes, and AI reasoning performance.

</details>


### [620] [Neither Black nor White: Balancing Semantic and Collaborative Signals with Graph-Informed Semantic IDs (GrIS)](https://arxiv.org/abs/2610.01533)
*Aleksei Medvedev,Alejandro Ariza-Casabona,Steven Derby,Gonzalo Fiz Pontiveros,Xinyang Shao,Florian Spiess*

Main category: cs.AI

TL;DR: 本文将语义ID（SID）构建重新定义为递归聚类问题，提出层次化图划分统一框架GrIS，把RQ-VAE/RQ-KMeans看作空图的特例，并实例化出RecDMoN与RQ-GAE，在多个数据集上最高提升Hit@10达52%。


<details>
  <summary>Details</summary>
Motivation: 既有工作把SID构建当作表示学习问题（将物品编码到量化隐空间再读取码字），作者认为这一视角是偶然的、片面的。SID构建的本质是递归聚类问题，因此自然应被聚类的对象是图：节点携带语义内容、边携带协同信号，SID分配即成为层次化图划分。该重构能统一而非取代先前方法，并把此前被压缩的两条设计轴——图构建与递归划分算法——显式展开。

Method: 提出统一框架GrIS（Graph-Informed Semantic IDs）。将SID构建分解为两个可独立配置的组件：图构建与递归划分算法。RQ-VAE与RQ-KMeans被证明是图退化为空图时的特例，即纯内容量化只是设计空间的一个角落。探索两种对比性实例：RecDMoN通过可微图池化完成层次化分配；RQ-GAE在RQ-VAE基础上扩展出图感知的物品表示并引入图重建目标。

Result: 在多个真实数据集上，GrIS持续优于协同过滤感知的SOTA方法，Hit@10最高提升52%。由于图构建与划分是显式、可分别配置的组件，两条设计轴上的改进可被组合并系统评估。

Conclusion: SID构建应被视为递归（层次化）图划分问题，而非单纯的表示学习问题。GrIS作为统一框架兼容并涵盖既有方法，揭示出图构建与划分算法两条此前被折叠的设计轴，为生成式推荐的SID设计提供了可组合、可系统评测的新范式。

Abstract: Existing work on Semantic IDs (SIDs) for generative recommendation treats SID construction as a representation learning problem: encode items into a quantised latent space and read off codes. We argue this view is incidental. SID construction is, at heart, a recursive clustering problem, and once stated this way the natural object to cluster is a graph whose nodes carry semantic content and whose edges carry collaborative signal; SID assignment becomes a hierarchical graph partition. This reframing yields a unified framework, Graph-Informed Semantic IDs (GrIS), that subsumes prior approaches rather than displacing them. RQ-VAE and RQ-KMeans are recovered as the special case where the graph is empty, exposing content-only quantisation as one corner of a larger design space along two so-far-collapsed axes: graph construction and recursive partition algorithm. We explore two contrasting instantiations: RecDMoN, which performs hierarchical assignment via differentiable graph pooling, and RQ-GAE, which extends RQ-VAE with graph-aware item representations and a graph reconstruction objective. On multiple real-world datasets, GrIS consistently improves over CF-aware SOTA, with gains of up to +52\% Hit@10. Because graph construction and partition are explicit, separately configurable components, improvements on either axis can be combined and evaluated systematically.

</details>


### [621] [ScholarCatalyst: A Benchmark for Retrieving Papers That Inspire New Research](https://arxiv.org/abs/2610.02202)
*Sohyeon Kim,Yoonho Lee,Bo Liu,Dayoon Ko,Rulin Shao,Seungone Kim,Graham Neubig,Pang Wei Koh,Aakanksha Chowdhery,Akari Asai,Omar Khattab,Yejin Choi,Gunhee Kim,Chelsea Finn*

Main category: cs.AI

TL;DR: 论文提出 ScholarCatalyst 数据集与检索任务，用 184 位作者对 207 篇近期计算机科学论文的标注，考察模型能否在项目开始时可得文献中检索出真正推进该项目的先前工作。结果显示智能体检索（0.42 R@20）不及嵌入检索（0.48 R@20），即使基于可能见过成稿的大模型智能体也仅达 0.51 R@20，说明模型仍缺乏专家式的"选题直觉"。


<details>
  <summary>Details</summary>
Motivation: 科学家相较于 AI 的核心优势之一，是在浩如烟海的文献中判断哪些先前想法能推进一个尚处雏形的新问题。这一"专家直觉"或选题品味难以量化研究，因为难以确定作者本人真正依赖了哪些早期工作。作者希望将这种隐性能力转化为可评测的任务，以推动科学智能体的发展。

Method: 1) 构建可扩展的作者标注流程：设计自动化流水线，使标注工作对作者而言负担可控。2) 邀请 207 篇近期计算机科学论文的 184 位第一作者，对候选文献逐一标注其是否实际或有潜力推进自己的项目，并给出详细理由。3) 提出检索任务：给定一个初始研究问题，仅从项目开始时就已存在的文献中检索出这些被作者标注的论文。4) 对比基线：嵌入检索、以该检索器为工具的智能体检索，以及基于 Claude Fable 5.1 的智能体（可能已在训练中见过成稿）。

Result: 智能体检索表现不优于单纯的嵌入检索，Recall@20 分别为 0.42 和 0.48；即便使用可能见过已完成论文的 Claude Fable 5.1 智能体，也仅达到 0.51 R@20。这表明当前方法均难以复现作者的文献判断能力。

Conclusion: 现有模型在"从广域语料中检索出真正相关的先前工作"这一能力上明显不足，需要新的训练方案来赋予模型专家级的检索直觉。ScholarCatalyst 被视为迈向科学智能体的一步，目标使智能体能够接收一个半成形的想法并指出其所需的先前研究。

Abstract: What makes great scientists great? Even as AI systems start to make progress on open problems, scientists remain far ahead of them at sensing which prior idea, buried in an ever-growing archive of research, a new problem needs. To study this skill, we draw on researchers who know firsthand which earlier work advanced their completed projects, with papers serving as pointers to the ideas within. Using our automated pipeline that makes author annotation scalable, we build ScholarCatalyst by having 184 lead authors of 207 recent computer science papers label which candidates did or could have advanced their project, each with a detailed rationale. We introduce a retrieval task with author-provided judgments: given an initial research question, retrieve these papers from only the literature available when the project began. Agentic search does no better than embedding retrieval (0.42 vs. 0.48 Recall@20) despite calling that same retriever as a tool. Even an agent built on Claude Fable 5.1, which may have seen the completed papers during training, reaches only 0.51 R@20. These results highlight the need for new training recipes that equip models with expert intuition for searching broad corpora. We envision ScholarCatalyst as a step toward scientific agents that can take a half-formed idea and point to the prior research it needs.

</details>


### [622] [Trajectory-Aware Clinical Risk Prediction via Severity-Grounded Knowledge Graphs and Retrieval-Augmented Generation](https://arxiv.org/abs/2607.18270)
*Kyunghoon Jeon,Youmin Ko,Woohwan Jung,Hyunjoon Kim*

Main category: cs.AI

TL;DR: TRACER：一个轨迹感知且临床接地的预测框架，通过整合带严重度信息的医学知识图谱、临床笔记事件提取与相似病例增强，提升EHR临床风险预测性能。


<details>
  <summary>Details</summary>
Motivation: 现有EHR风险预测方法受限于数据稀疏性、非结构化临床笔记利用不足，难以刻画疾病严重程度、治疗反应与细微的临床进展，同时缺乏有效融合异构外部知识的手段。

Method: TRACER包含四个组件：(1) 从医学文献构建富含严重度信息的医学知识图谱；(2) 从知识图谱中检索临床相关、按严重度加权的患者病程路径；(3) 从非结构化临床笔记中抽取临床相关事件；(4) 利用相似同伴病例增强患者上下文。

Result: 在MIMIC-III与MIMIC-IV数据集上显著优于现有最优基线：死亡率预测的Macro F1最高提升28.5%，再入院预测提升19.7%。

Conclusion: 通过将严重度加权的知识图谱路径、临床笔记事件与相似病例上下文相结合，TRACER有效缓解数据稀疏与非结构化信息利用不足问题，显著提升临床风险预测效果，具备较强的临床应用潜力。

Abstract: While Electronic Health Records (EHRs) offer a wealth of clinical data, effectively augmenting a patient's records with heterogeneous external knowledge to predict the patient's clinical risk remains a significant challenge. Existing methods fail to capture disease severity, treatment responses, and nuanced clinical progression, due to data sparsity and the underutilization of unstructured clinical notes. To address these challenges, we propose TRACER (a trajectory-aware and clinically grounded prediction framework) that (1) constructs a medical knowledge graph enriched with severity information from medical literature, (2) retrieves clinically relevant, severity-weighted paths of a patient's progression from the knowledge graph, (3) extracts clinically relevant events from unstructured clinical notes, and (4) augments patient context with similar peer cases. Experiments on the MIMIC-III and MIMIC-IV datasets demonstrate large gains over state-of-the-art baselines, with up to 28.5% increase in Macro F1 score for the mortality prediction task, and 19.7% increase for the readmission prediction task.

</details>


### [623] [What Do Rationales Communicate? A Message-Intervention Study in Role-Specialized QA](https://arxiv.org/abs/2610.00018)
*Jiameng Zhang,Hongqiu Wu*

Main category: cs.AI

TL;DR: 该论文提出"消息干预诊断"方法，在固定证据与候选答案的前提下仅改变reasoner传给verifier的rationale，发现忠实rationale对答案准确率几乎无增益，但被污染rationale会显著改变支持性判断，且显式检查提示会放大该效应。


<details>
  <summary>Details</summary>
Motivation: 角色分工式QA流水线越来越普遍地在reasoner与verifier之间传递rationale，但这一消息通道的实际价值不明：它究竟带来更好答案、更强支持性评估，还是仅仅制造了新的失败面。作者希望厘清rationale传递的真实作用机制。

Method: 设计消息干预诊断：固定证据与候选答案，仅变化跨越reasoner-to-verifier边界的rationale。在MuSiQue、HotpotQA、2WikiMultiHopQA的400个样本上，用DeepSeek分别作为generator和verifier。比较无rationale、忠实rationale、无害改写、污染rationale等条件，并对比盲验证提示与显式rationale检查提示；辅以人工审计、跨模型与任务边界检验。

Result: 忠实rationale相比无rationale在答案准确率上几乎无提升；污染rationale则强烈改变支持性判断。盲验证提示下，无害改写仅使支持判断偏移0–2.5%，污染rationale偏移10–22%；显式检查提示将该模式放大至34–55%。最终答案变化较小（2–30%），仅2.9–35.3%的支持翻转与答案变化共现。人工审计显示16/42有效污染属"污染过度信任"案例，盲人评估者对模型接受的10条污染rationale中有9条拒绝或标记为不明确。

Conclusion: 跨模型与任务边界检验表明该消息通道可能处于活跃、放大、惰性或被折叠进任务标签等不同状态。rationale共享应被视为一种验证消息机制来评估，而不仅仅是通向更高答案准确率的路径。

Abstract: Role-specialized QA pipelines increasingly pass rationales from a reasoner to a verifier, but it is unclear what this message actually buys: better answers, stronger support assessment, or a new failure surface. We introduce a message-intervention diagnostic that fixes the evidence and candidate answer while varying only the rationale passed across the reasoner-to-verifier boundary. On 400 MuSiQue, HotpotQA, and 2WikiMultiHopQA examples with DeepSeek as generator and verifier, faithful rationales add almost no answer accuracy over no rationale, while corrupted rationales strongly alter support judgments. Under a blind verifier prompt, harmless paraphrases shift support by only 0--2.5%, whereas corrupted rationales shift support by 10--22%; an explicit rationale-checking prompt amplifies the same pattern to 34--55%. Final answers move less (2--30%), and only 2.9--35.3% of corrupted support flips co-occur with answer changes. Human audits show why this matters: 16/42 valid corruptions are corruption-overtrust cases, and blind humans reject or mark unclear 9/10 audited corrupted rationales that the model accepts. Cross-model and task-boundary checks show when the channel is active, amplified, inert, or folded into the task label. Rationale sharing should be evaluated as a verification-message mechanism, not merely as a route to higher answer accuracy.

</details>


### [624] [Characterizing a Configuration Where Inference-Time PRM-Pruned Fragment Grafting Is Inert: Evidence from Three Reasoning LMs](https://arxiv.org/abs/2610.00047)
*Khawaja Murad ul Hassan,Mehran Ebrahimi*

Main category: cs.AI

TL;DR: 本文将"PRM剪枝片段嫁接"（PPFG）这一跨轨迹步骤级迁移机制孤立出来，在Qwen2.5-7B-Instruct + Math-Shepherd + MATH500（n=500，三种子）等条件下进行严格测试，发现其与独立并行CoT基线在各项指标上统计不可区分；通过322次注入事件四分类、等价性检验（TOST）与事后oracle上界（+0.13pp）证明该机制在上述操作点上是"惰性"的，并给出推理期机制零假设的等价性检验模板。


<details>
  <summary>Details</summary>
Motivation: 并行链式思维存在"多样性坍塌"，此前工作提出用过程奖励模型（PRM）剪枝链的高分前缀作为上下文示范嫁接给仍在解码的兄弟链，但已有片段嫁接的增益往往依赖额外补偿性组件。作者希望把PPFG这一最省算力的跨轨迹步骤级迁移操作化方式单独隔离，并在先前报告增益所依赖的操作点上检验其是否真的有效。

Method: 将PPFG定义为：PRM剪枝某条链时，抽取其高PRM前缀，逐字嫁接为上下文示范注入仍在解码的兄弟链。在Qwen2.5-7B-Instruct上配Math-Shepherd，于完整MATH500（n=500，三种子）测试停滞-目标与随机-目标两种变体，对照独立并行CoT基线。进一步做322次停滞规则注入事件的四桶分类、复合门控精炼、随机对照、跨3个基础LM/6个基准/第2个PRM/兼容门扫的复现、TOST等价性检验、逐事件抽查与幸存兄弟反事实、事后oracle上界分析。

Result: PPFG两种变体在所有测量轴上与独立并行CoT基线统计不可区分；322次注入事件中仅14%真正针对挣扎中的链，其余落在已成功、接近完成或PRM平台期的链上。无复合门控能同时实现良好命中与足够密度，随机对照以2.4倍触发率同样达到持平，说明惰性并非启发式特有。结果在3个基础LM、6个基准、第2个PRM及兼容门扫下复现；TOST在全部12个Qwen/LLaMA单元上将持平升级为正向等价。逐事件抽查显示注入链以2.75倍匹配步速率被剪枝，但幸存兄弟反事实未见群体级补偿。事后oracle将选择PPFG相对独立基线的单题增益上界限定为+0.13pp。

Conclusion: 在测试的操作点上，PPFG作为跨轨迹步骤级迁移的最省算力实现是惰性的，无法带来可测收益，且其失效具有机制普遍性而非启发式特异。作者提出一套用于确立推理期机制零假设的等价性检验模板，并将所有结论严格限定于所测操作点。

Abstract: Diversity collapse in parallel chain-of-thought has motivated inference-time interventions built on a natural design: when a process reward model (PRM) prunes a chain, its high-PRM prefix is extracted and grafted verbatim as an in-context demonstration into a still-decoding sibling. We isolate this mechanism, PRM-Pruned Fragment Grafting (PPFG), as the most cost-minimal operationalization of cross-trajectory step-level transfer, and test it at the operating point where prior fragment-grafting work reports gains only under additional compensating ingredients. On Qwen2.5-7B-Instruct with Math-Shepherd on full MATH500 (n=500, three seeds), PPFG in both stagnation- and random-targeting variants is statistically indistinguishable from an independent parallel-CoT baseline on every measured axis. We characterize why: a four-bucket classification of 322 stagnation-rule injection events shows only 14% targeted a genuinely struggling chain; the rest landed on chains that had already succeeded, were near completion, or sat on a flat PRM plateau, states a rescue graft cannot change. No compound-gate refinement jointly achieves well-targeted firing and adequate density, and a random control matches the same parity at 2.4x the firing rate, so the inertness is not heuristic-specific. The finding replicates across three base LMs, six benchmarks, a second PRM, and a compatibility-gate sweep; two-one-sided-tests analysis promotes the parity to positive equivalence on all twelve Qwen/LLaMA cells. A per-event spot-check finds injected chains prune at 2.75x the matched-step rate, but a surviving-sibling counterfactual finds no population-level compensation. A hindsight oracle bounds any per-problem gain from choosing PPFG over independent at +0.13 pp. We contribute an equivalence-testing template for establishing inference-time mechanism nulls, with every claim scoped to its tested operating point.

</details>


### [625] [Scientific Agents: Evaluating Profession-Specific System Prompts on Scientific Tasks](https://arxiv.org/abs/2610.00084)
*Timothy Kassis*

Main category: cs.AI

TL;DR: 该论文评估了503个专业领域AGENTS.md系统提示词对智能体性能的影响：在九个文本科学基准与一个生物信息学工具基准上，专业提示词并未带来一致的准确率提升，却使输出token增加1.5–2.3倍、单次成功调用成本增加2.2–4.5倍。


<details>
  <summary>Details</summary>
Motivation: 业界普遍为科学智能体加载详尽的专业角色系统提示词，但其收益从未被系统性地量化。作者希望厘清：细化的专业提示词究竟是否提升准确率，其token与成本代价是否值得。

Method: 构建开源语料 Scientific Agents（503个专业AGENTS.md画像），在Pi智能体框架中调用Gemini 3.8 Flash（经OpenRouter）。设置四个对照：极简基线（"You are a helpful assistant"）、画像开篇角色句、通用科学严谨性指南、以及无关领域画像。在九个文本科学基准（4,531题、100个匹配画像）上比较五种条件，4,488题完成全部条件，采用自动化规则评分；另在60道工具调用的BioMysteryBench生物信息学问题上各跑三次。统计使用固定任务上的bootstrap区间。

Result: 画像与基线的平均准确率差为-0.6个百分点（95% bootstrap区间[-1.5, +0.2]），无任何基准显示统计上明确的提升。匹配画像的输出token为基线的1.5–2.3倍，每次成功调用成本为2.2–4.5倍。BioMysteryBench上画像平均解决率46.7%，基线56.7%，差-10.0个百分点（区间[-16.7, -3.3]），主因是画像下更频繁触发token与时间上限而中断。意外发现：SuperGPQA上因供应商API频繁断连，短基线仅54.0%题项首答正确，而长画像达71.6%；通用与错配提示词表现相当，说明该优势来自提示词长度或格式而非领域专业性。

Conclusion: 对被测模型与任务而言，默认加载完整专业画像既不提升准确率，又显著增加成本，因此不建议作为默认策略。未来需检验按需检索画像片段、以及在开放式科学任务上是否会改变这一结论。

Abstract: Detailed profession-specific system prompts raise token use and estimated cost per response without a consistent accuracy gain. We evaluate Scientific Agents, an open-source corpus of 503 profession-specific AGENTS.md profiles, with Gemini 3.8 Flash via OpenRouter in the Pi agent harness. We compare matched profiles with four controls: a minimal baseline ("You are a helpful assistant"), the profile's opening role sentence, a generic scientific rigor guide, and a profile from an unrelated domain. Across nine text-based science benchmarks (4,531 sampled questions, 100 matched profiles), 4,488 items completed all five conditions after API-error retries, scored with automated, rule-based grading. The average profile-baseline accuracy difference is -0.6 percentage points (95% bootstrap interval [-1.5, +0.2] across fixed tasks), and no benchmark shows a statistically clear improvement. Matched profiles produced 1.5-2.3 times as many output tokens and cost 2.2-4.5 times more per successful call. On 60 tool-using BioMysteryBench bioinformatics problems (three runs each for baseline and profile), mean solve rates were 46.7% with the profile and 56.7% at baseline, a difference of -10.0 percentage points (95% interval [-16.7, -3.3]) driven by more frequent token- and time-limit stops under the profile. Longer prompts had one unexpected operational advantage: on SuperGPQA, frequent provider API drops left the short baseline with a correct first-pass answer on only 54.0% of items, against 71.6% with the profile. Generic and mismatched prompts were about as reliable, so this gain comes from prompt length or formatting rather than domain expertise. For the tested model and tasks, loading full profession profiles by default does not improve accuracy and costs considerably more; whether selective retrieval of profile sections or open-ended scientific tasks would change this remains to be tested.

</details>


### [626] [Comedic Fool's Gold: Reward Exploits and Countermeasures in Conversational Humor](https://arxiv.org/abs/2610.00197)
*Sam Larson*

Main category: cs.AI

TL;DR: 本文研究对话幽默中语言模型训练的自动化奖励设计，重点分析奖励漏洞及其对策。通过受控实验揭示两类奖励（基于嵌入的"惊喜"奖励和受众笑点预测模型）均存在可被利用的捷径，并提出相应防御措施，但对策在堵住漏洞的同时会误伤目标任务行为。三轮强化学习实验显示最终方案提升了综合评分0.0903并减少40%零分会话，但幽默专项提升仍低于预注册目标。


<details>
  <summary>Details</summary>
Motivation: 自动化奖励在对话幽默训练中易被模型"钻空子"（reward exploit），即模型学会利用奖励函数的缺陷而非真正产生幽默。作者旨在系统识别这些捷径并设计对策，揭示自动化奖励设计中"堵漏洞"与"保行为"之间的根本矛盾。

Method: 研究两类奖励方法：(1) 基于嵌入的"可理解惊喜"奖励，配合流畅性过滤器；(2) 基于受众模型的"预测笑声"奖励，配合跨说话人线索归一化。通过受控测试检验各奖励对词序打乱回复的误接受情况，并开展三轮强化学习实验，采用逐次修订的奖励版本进行训练评估。

Result: 基于嵌入的惊喜奖励对词序打乱回复与真正机智回复同样接受；流畅性过滤器可检测打乱回复，但组合奖励会误拒部分机智回复且在进一步验证中失败。受众模型的预测笑声易受双方消息中的笑声线索攻击，跨说话人归一化可阻断已被覆盖的攻击，但未匹配的表达仍可被利用。最终一轮训练将综合评分提升0.0903、零分会话减少40%，但幽默专项提升低于预注册目标。

Conclusion: 自动化奖励设计面临普遍挑战：对策必须阻断可被利用的捷径，同时保留奖励原本旨在鼓励的行为。单纯堵漏洞往往以牺牲目标行为为代价，二者之间存在张力，需要在奖励设计中权衡。

Abstract: We investigate automated rewards for training language models in conversational humor, focusing on reward exploits and countermeasures. Two approaches aim to capture understandable surprise and predicted audience amusement. Controlled tests show that an embedding-based surprise reward accepts word-shuffled replies as readily as witty ones. A fluency filter detects the shuffles, but the combined reward also rejects some witty replies and fails further validation. An audience model's predicted laughter is instead vulnerable to laughter cues in either speaker's messages. Normalizing these cues across speakers blocks the covered attacks, although unmatched expressions remain exploitable. Three reinforcement-learning runs evaluate training with successive reward revisions. The final run improves the combined evaluation score by 0.0903 and reduces zero-score sessions by 40%, but its humor-specific improvement remains below our preregistered target. These findings illustrate a broader challenge for automated reward design: countermeasures must block exploitable shortcuts while preserving the behavior the reward was intended to encourage.

</details>


### [627] [Robust Is Salient: An Informed Adversary Moves the Optimal Signal onto the Salience Pole](https://arxiv.org/abs/2610.00233)
*Cris Huynh*

Main category: cs.AI

TL;DR: 在受约束信号通道中，当知情对手与听众共享通道时，最保护真相的信号即最能描述真相的信号；对抗鲁棒最优与既有研究的显著性极点完全重合，仅在显著性—贝叶斯坐标未定义处出现差异。


<details>
  <summary>Details</summary>
Motivation: 本文关注对抗环境下信号选择的鲁棒性问题：当知情且具有说服预算的对手能观察信号并影响听众时，何种信号策略能最好地保护真相。作者希望厘清对抗鲁棒最优策略与既有"显著性"（salience）启发式之间的关系，并揭示这种重合对经验评测造成的结构性限制。

Method: 将对抗者引入一个强制选择任务（抽象自桌游《Deception: Murder in Hong Kong》）。对手知道目标答案、观察信号，并利用说服预算 β 为最强错误答案辩护。分析随 β 增大最优信号如何从后验最大化选项转向边际最大化选项；在 β=0 时退化为原始 oracle 模型（听众温度 τ=1）。并在 108 个确认性条目与 200,000 条目池上进行验证，计算每个条目的临界预算。

Result: 在 108 个确认性条目上，对抗鲁棒最优与既有显著性极点完全一致；在 200,000 条目池中二者仅于 2,748 个条目上不同，且差异恰出现在显著性—贝叶斯坐标未定义处。在坐标有定义处，鲁棒性完全通过从贝叶斯判别转向显著性实现。池中 18.2% 的条目在有限预算下最优解发生移动，每个条目的临界预算可精确计算。两种对抗框架使七个语言模型在 108 个条目中的 30 至 77 个上改变所选选项，相对精确的零效应率而言具有实质影响。

Conclusion: 由于对抗鲁棒最优与显著性启发式目标在评测条目上高度重合，任何测量都无法判定语言模型的行为变化是朝向对抗感知最优还是朝向显著性，因为二者在结构上不可区分。这是结构性限制而非零结果。作者建议在进行对抗感知评测前，先检验鲁棒目标是否与启发式目标在评测条目上重合——该诊断成本低廉。

Abstract: When an informed adversary shares the audience of a constrained signalling channel, the signal that best protects the truth is the signal that best describes it. On 108 confirmatory items, the adversary-robust optimum aligns exactly with the salience pole from prior work.
