Across a 200,000-item pool, the two differ on only 2,748 items --- lying exactly where the prior salience-to-Bayes coordinate is undefined. Where defined, robustness is achieved by moving from Bayesian discrimination entirely to salience. We show this by introducing an adversary to a forced-choice task (abstracted from Deception: Murder in Hong Kong). The adversary knows the target, observes the signal, and argues for the strongest wrong answer using a persuasion budget, $β$. As $β$ grows, the optimal signal shifts from the posterior-maximizing option to the margin-maximizing one; at $β= 0$, the game reproduces the original oracle model with a listener temperature of $τ= 1$. This effect is real: 18.2 percent of the pool has an optimum that shifts under a finite budget, and each item's critical budget is exact. This coincidence structurally limits empirical evaluation. Two adversary framings change the chosen option of seven language models on 30 to 77 of 108 items against an exact no-effect rate. Yet, no measurement can determine whether this movement is toward the adversary-aware optimum or toward salience, because the two options are identical. This is a structural limit, not a null result. The diagnostic check is cheap: before evaluating adversary-awareness, verify whether the robust target coincides with a heuristic target on the evaluation items.

</details>


### [628] [ContractRL: Shielded Group-Relative Policy Optimization for Auditable Tool-Call Repair](https://arxiv.org/abs/2610.00328)
*Miaobo Hu,Shuhao Hu,Xiaobo Guo,Xin Wang,Bokun Wang,Yina Sa,Daren Zha,Jun Xiao*

Main category: cs.AI

TL;DR: 提出 ContractRL：将验证器引导的 JSON 修复建模为有界决策过程的契约约束顺序修复协议，在相同验证信息下以更少 token 取得更高语义成功率。


<details>
  <summary>Details</summary>
Motivation: 结构化工具调用常因少量字段违反 schema 或执行契约而失败；重新生成完整对象会扩大动作空间，并使反复修复难以审计。因此需要一种局部化、可审计的修复方法。

Method: 将基于验证器反馈的 JSON 修复形式化为有界决策过程：每步策略观察候选对象、类型化验证反馈、JSON Pointer、不可变修复历史与剩余预算；由契约派生的动作掩码在执行前过滤非法或禁止的 RFC-6902 操作，再由确定性验证器完成状态转移。设计契约约束的组相对目标，用于 patch、retry 与 abstention 决策，并在轨迹冻结前将规范目标与语义标签排除于在线状态之外。

Result: 相同验证信息下，ContractRL 取得 0.9362 语义成功率、34.4 生成 token；Patch-SFT 为 0.9076 与 44.9 token，完整重生成 为 0.9148 与 137.2 token（每种子 192 个案例、5 个种子）。策略优化将语义成功率从监督式 ContractRL 的 0.9186 提升至 0.9375。与 Patch-SFT 的独立三种子配对评估显示语义差异为 +0.0396（95% CI [+0.0137, +0.0662]，p=0.0039）。反馈、动作掩码、预算与 schema 漂移分析将增益归因于局部化修正；对抗与多轮评估刻画了残余失败模式。

Conclusion: ContractRL 通过契约约束的顺序修复与动作掩码，在保持高语义成功率的同时显著降低生成开销，且策略优化带来进一步提升，验证了局部化修正在结构化工具调用修复中的有效性。

Abstract: Structured tool calls often fail after only a small number of fields violate a schema or an execution contract. Regenerating the complete object enlarges the action surface and makes repeated repair difficult to audit. We introduce ContractRL, a contract-constrained sequential repair protocol that models verifier-guided JSON repair as a bounded decision process. At each step the policy observes the candidate, typed verifier feedback, JSON Pointer, immutable repair history, and remaining budget; a contract-derived action mask filters malformed or prohibited RFC-6902 operations before a deterministic validator performs the transition. We specify a contract-constrained group-relative objective for patch, retry, and abstention decisions while keeping canonical targets and semantic labels outside the online state until trace freeze. Under identical verifier information, ContractRL attains 0.9362 semantic success with 34.4 generated tokens, compared with 0.9076 and 44.9 tokens for Patch-SFT and 0.9148 and 137.2 tokens for full regeneration over 192 cases per seed and five seeds. Policy optimization improves semantic success from 0.9186 for supervised ContractRL to 0.9375. A separate three-seed paired evaluation against Patch-SFT yields a semantic difference of +0.0396 (95% CI $[+0.0137,+0.0662], p=0.0039$). Feedback, action-mask, budget, and schema-shift analyses connect these gains to localized correction, while adversarial and multi-turn evaluations characterize the remaining failure modes.

</details>


### [629] [Legal Research Bench: Measuring End-to-End Reliability in Long-Horizon Legal Research Agents](https://arxiv.org/abs/2610.00609)
*Katrina Drozdov,Oliver Chen,Langston Nashold,Rayan Krishnan*

Main category: cs.AI

TL;DR: 本文提出法律研究基准LRB，包含413道由专家编写的美国法律研究开放题，每道题配有标准答案、支持性法律依据和二元评分标准。测试13个前沿模型（配备网络搜索、判例检索、页面解析和检索工具），采用全通过评分和来源验证。结果显示最强模型Claude Opus 4.8完全正确率仅42.9%，且更多轮次、工具调用和推理成本并不predict更高准确率。


<details>
  <summary>Details</summary>
Motivation: 法律研究是核心但耗时的法律工作流程，需要识别权威依据、验证其有效性、调和法规与判例并形成有依据的答案。语言模型智能体天然适合这一检索密集型流程，自动化部分流程具有价值。但该价值取决于可靠性：单个遗漏的权威依据、失效的引用或错误结论都可能使看似合理的答案不可用。因此需要建立评估基准来衡量智能体在该流程中的可靠性。

Method: 构建Legal Research Bench（LRB）基准，包含413道专家编写的美国法律研究开放题，每题配有gold答案、支持性权威依据和二元评分标准。在配备网络搜索、判例法检索、页面解析和检索工具的harness中评估13个前沿模型。采用全通过（all-pass）评分与来源验证：只有当所有必需标准均满足且所引权威依据经验证通过时才判定答案正确。同时将LLM评判者与专家律师进行对比验证，确保基准分数与律师判断一致。

Result: 智能体可靠性远未达标：测试模型中最强的Claude Opus 4.8仅在42.9%的问题上完全正确。性能随任务设置差异显著：不同法律领域的all-pass率不同，在需要调和冲突权威依据的问题上准确率更低。跨模型来看，更多的轮次、工具调用和推理成本并不能预测更高的准确率。

Conclusion: 当前前沿语言模型智能体在法律研究任务上距离可靠应用仍有较大差距，且增加计算量或工具调用并不必然提升准确率，表明该流程的瓶颈可能在于推理与调和能力而非检索量。

Abstract: Legal research is a core and time-consuming legal workflow. Lawyers must identify controlling authority, verify that it remains valid, reconcile statutes and cases, and synthesize a grounded answer. Language model agents are a natural fit for this retrieval-intensive workflow, and automating even part of it would be valuable. But that value depends on reliability: a single missing authority, stale citation, or wrong legal conclusion can make an otherwise plausible answer unusable. We introduce \textbf{Legal Research Bench} (LRB), a benchmark of 413 open-ended U.S. legal research questions written by experts, each paired with a gold answer, supporting authorities, and a binary grading rubric. We evaluate thirteen frontier models in a harness with web search, case-law search, page parsing, and retrieval tools. We score agent responses through all-pass grading with source verification, where a response is correct only if every required criterion is satisfied and its cited authorities verify. We also validate the LLM judge against expert attorneys ensuring that benchmark scores track attorney judgment. Agents remain far from reliable: among the models we tested, the strongest, Claude Opus 4.8, is fully correct on 42.9\% of questions. Performance also varies substantially by task setting: all-pass rates differ across areas of law and are lower on questions requiring reconciliation of conflicting authorities. Across models, more turns, tool calls, and inference cost do not predict higher accuracy.

</details>


### [630] [Sapien: A Stateful Policy Engine for Autonomous AI Agents](https://arxiv.org/abs/2610.00797)
*Corinn Tiffany,Wen Zhang,Eugene Bagdasarian,Lillian Tsai*

Main category: cs.AI

TL;DR: Sapien 是一个用于在 AI 智能体工具调用上强制状态化上下文策略的策略引擎，能以极小效用损失拦截大部分攻击。


<details>
  <summary>Details</summary>
Motivation: 多步任务中，哪些动作有效往往取决于智能体已执行和已获知的内容，现有上下文安全防御缺乏对状态依赖策略的支持。

Method: Sapien 使用扩展正则表达式来规定允许的工具调用序列，并引入状态化谓词、延迟策略生成以及作用域语义检查。

Result: Sapien 的效用与无约束智能体相差仅几个百分点；即使智能体被完全劫持，其策略也能排除 AgentDojo 上 93-95% 的攻击，以及 Toolathlon 上 62-85% 的攻击（在长时任务上为工具白名单的两倍）。

Conclusion: Sapien 证明了状态化上下文策略可在保持高可用性的同时显著提升多步智能体任务的安全性。

Abstract: Contextual security defenses prevent AI agents from taking rogue actions by synthesizing a task-specific policy and enforcing it on the agent's tool calls. In multi-step tasks, however, which actions are valid often depends on what the agent has already done and learned. We present Sapien, a policy engine for enforcing stateful contextual policies. A Sapien policy specifies permitted tool-call sequences using a regular expression extended with stateful predicates, deferred policy generation, and scoped semantic checks. We show that Sapien stays within a few percent of an unconstrained agent's utility. Even if the agent is fully hijacked, Sapien's policies rule out 93-95% of attacks on AgentDojo and 62-85% on Toolathlon (twice as many as tool allowlists on long-horizon tasks).

</details>


### [631] [ActiveSaddler: Automated Curriculum Learning for Agent Harness Optimization](https://arxiv.org/abs/2610.00906)
*Sungho Park,Wonjoong Kim,Jue Zhang,Wook-Shin Han,Pengfei Gao,Chanyoung Park,Yongqiang Yao,Rao Fu,Elsie Nallipogu,Qingwei Lin,Victor Rühle*

Main category: cs.AI

TL;DR: 本文提出将"训练场景选择"作为harness优化的新维度，形式化为自动化课程学习问题，并给出方法ActiveSaddler：把演化的课程建模为非平稳bandit，用可复用的失败模式臂表示优化目标，估计学习进展并自适应平衡回访已知弱点与探索新场景，使课程与harness协同演化。在GAIA2与Terminal-Bench 2.0上，相较固定场景顺序的同一优化器，测试Pass@1分别提升4.4与7.5个百分点。


<details>
  <summary>Details</summary>
Motivation: 现有自动化harness优化方法主要改进"如何更新harness"（提示、工具接口、控制逻辑），却基本固定"哪些训练场景产生反馈"。随着harness演化，最有价值的训练场景会变化，因此训练课程本身应随之自适应，这一维度此前被忽视。

Method: 将harness优化中的课程选择形式化为自动化课程学习问题。ActiveSaddler把演化课程建模为非平稳bandit，并动态实例化优化目标：将反复出现的失败抽象为可复用的"失败模式臂"，估计对各模式继续优化可带来的潜在学习进展，自适应平衡对已知弱点的回访与对未见场景的探索。优化结果持续更新已发现失败模式的集合及其优先级，使课程与harness协同演化。

Result: 在GAIA2与Terminal-Bench 2.0上，ActiveSaddler持续发现更强的harness：相比在优化前固定场景顺序的同一harness优化器，测试Pass@1分别提升4.4与7.5个百分点。消融实验表明，这些收益依赖于动态构建优化目标、估计其演化效用，以及平衡持续优化与新失败发现。

Conclusion: 自动化课程学习构成harness优化中一个关键的新优化维度；课程应随harness共同演化，而非固定于优化前。

Abstract: Automated harness optimization can substantially improve LLM agents by iteratively updating their prompts, tool interfaces, and control logic from execution feedback. However, existing methods primarily optimize how the harness is updated while largely fixing which training scenarios generate the feedback that drives those updates. As the harness evolves, the scenarios most useful for further optimization can change, suggesting that the training curriculum itself should adapt alongside the harness. We formulate this missing dimension of harness optimization as an automated curriculum learning problem and introduce ActiveSaddler. ActiveSaddler models the evolving curriculum as a non-stationary bandit with dynamically instantiated optimization targets. It abstracts recurring failures into reusable failure-pattern arms, estimates the potential learning progress from further targeting each pattern, and adaptively balances revisiting known weaknesses with exploring unseen scenarios for new ones. Optimization outcomes continually update both the set of discovered failure patterns and their priorities, allowing the curriculum to co-evolve with the harness. Experiments on GAIA2 and Terminal-Bench 2.0 show that ActiveSaddler consistently discovers stronger harnesses, improving test Pass@1 by 4.4 and 7.5 percentage points over the same harness optimizer using a scenario order fixed before optimization, respectively. Ablations further show that these gains depend on dynamically constructing optimization targets, estimating their evolving utility, and balancing continued optimization with new failure discovery. Together, these results establish automated curriculum learning as a new crucial optimization dimension for harness optimization.

</details>


### [632] [Pay for the Fault, Not the Flow: Label-Free In-Flow Multi-Agent Workflow Optimization](https://arxiv.org/abs/2610.01017)
*Xuehang Guo,Haoyu Wang,Shengyu Chen,Zach Chen,Wei Cheng,Qingyun Wang,Haifeng Chen*

Main category: cs.AI

TL;DR: 本文提出 InFlowOp，用统一的"无标签成本"同时指导多智能体工作流的任务分解粒度、智能体分配与执行中的故障修正，并发布 Braid 基准，性能优于单智能体基线最高 +11.97%。


<details>
  <summary>Details</summary>
Motivation: 多智能体工作流构建面临三大前置决策难题：任务如何细分、每个子任务信任哪个智能体、何时新建专家智能体；这些决策在运行前难以验证，而改进工作流成本高昂（定位故障通常需要参考答案、评分结果或训练好的评估器，修复需整体重执行、重搜索或重训练）。

Method: 提出 InFlowOp：以单一无标签成本对每个决策定价，该成本权衡智能体能力与子任务需求的匹配程度和智能体运行开销。执行前，InFlowOp 依据成本双向确定任务分解粒度与智能体分配，而非依赖固定模板；执行中，用同一成本以最廉价的动作修正故障，使成本函数在构建与运行两个阶段统一服务。同时提出 Braid 基准，其任务需要超越单智能体能力的多智能体协作。

Result: 在多个领域与骨干模型上，InFlowOp 相对单智能体基线提升最高达 +11.97%，在流内优化（in-flow optimization）下取得 +9.64%。

Conclusion: InFlowOp 通过统一的无标签成本机制将工作流的构建与运行期修正打通，避免了对参考答案或训练评估器的依赖，在跨领域、跨骨干设置下验证了多智能体工作流的有效性；Braid 基准为工作流级评估提供了支撑。

Abstract: Large language models (LLMs) increasingly construct multi-agent workflows that decompose a complex task and assign specialist agents from a pool. However, building such a workflow well remains challenging: how finely to divide the task, which agent to trust with each subtask, and when to create a new specialist are all critical decisions a workflow constructor needs to settle up front. Thus, whether each subtask succeeds remains unknown until the workflow runs. Yet, improving a workflow is costly. Locating a fault usually requires a reference answer, a graded outcome, or a trained assessor, and the fix is applied to the whole workflow through re-execution, re-search, or retraining. We propose InFlowOp, which prices every decision in one label-free cost that weighs how well an agent's competence meets what a subtask demands against how much that agent takes to run. Before execution, InFlowOp bidirectionally determines the granularity of task decomposition and agent assignment following from the cost rather than from a fixed template. During execution, InFlowOp corrects a fault with the cheapest move via the same cost that serves the workflow both as it is built and as it runs. Facing the workflow-level evaluation challenge, we introduce Braid, a benchmark whose tasks require multi-agent coordination beyond single-agent capability. Across various domains and backbones, InFlowOp outperforms single agent baselines by up to $+11.97\%$, achieving $+9.64\%$ with in-flow optimization. Our project page: https://xhguo7.github.io/InFlowOp/.

</details>


### [633] [Beyond Final Accuracy: Auditing Communication in LLM Multi-Agent Systems](https://arxiv.org/abs/2610.01042)
*Shixuan Li,Wei Yang,Peiyu Zhang,Anzhe Cheng,Heng Ping,Paul Bogdan*

Main category: cs.AI

TL;DR: 提出受控框架ICR，将多智能体通信拆解为独立推理后的答案修正，发现相同聚合准确率可能掩盖不同的修正行为。


<details>
  <summary>Details</summary>
Motivation: 多智能体通信评估存在根本歧义：系统性能提升究竟来自有效通信、有利的智能体架构，还是单纯的额外推理难以区分；且最终准确率把纠正的错误与被污染的答案合并为单一结果，掩盖了通信如何改变决策。

Method: 提出Independent–Communicate–Revise（ICR）受控框架：固定初始推理轨迹，在双方初始正确性条件下分别度量纠正（correction）与保持（preservation），并设置无消息修正对照以剥离额外推理带来的收益；在四个推理基准上审计文本与潜在通信，并在MedQA与GPQA-D上比较接收方策略。

Result: 相似的整体准确率可能对应显著不同的修正行为；相比仅传递答案，传递完整推理在四个基准上均提高纠正率、降低保持率；结构化验证策略使各通道整体转向更高保持与更低纠正，其选择性效果随通道与任务而异。

Conclusion: 通信质量并非通道的内在属性；ICR将评估重心转向选择性修正，为考察消息内容与接收方策略如何共同产生收益与损害提供统一框架。

Abstract: Multi-agent communication aims to help agents benefit from one another's information. Yet improvements in system performance leave a fundamental ambiguity: do they reflect effective communication, a favorable agent architecture, or simply additional reasoning? Because communication methods are commonly evaluated within the systems they were designed for, these factors are difficult to disentangle. Final accuracy further merges corrected errors and corrupted answers into a single outcome, obscuring how communication changes decisions. We introduce Independent--Communicate--Revise (ICR), a controlled framework that evaluates communication as answer revision following independent reasoning. ICR fixes initial reasoning trajectories, measures correction and preservation conditional on both agents' initial correctness, and uses a no-message revision control to quantify gains beyond additional reasoning. Across four reasoning benchmarks, our audit of textual and latent communication reveals that similar aggregate accuracy can conceal substantially different revision behaviors. Compared with transmitting answers alone, full reasoning increases correction while reducing preservation on all four benchmarks, so richer messages amplify beneficial and harmful influence alike. Receiver-policy comparisons on MedQA and GPQA-D further show that a structured verification policy shifts every channel toward greater preservation and lower correction, while its effect on selectivity varies across channels and tasks. These findings challenge treating communication quality as an intrinsic property of a channel. ICR therefore recenters evaluation on selective revision, providing a unified framework for examining how message content and receiver policies jointly produce benefits and harms.

</details>


### [634] [Empty Commitments: When Agents Promise What Their Runtime Cannot Deliver](https://arxiv.org/abs/2610.01045)
*Jiaqi Tang,Lan Wei,Bingyu Shen,Boyang Li*

Main category: cs.AI

TL;DR: 论文提出"空洞承诺"（empty commitment）概念：智能体承诺在当前轮次之后执行某动作，但其工具或运行时无法兑现。该性质仅由智能体配置决定，无需后续轨迹即可判定。作者基于承诺语义给出定义、三类失败形式、锚定条件及响应级结果分类，并提出五级消融式测量协议。


<details>
  <summary>Details</summary>
Motivation: 聊天机器人在用户不再输入时即无法再次运行，却常承诺"明天提醒你"之类动作。此类承诺并非事后违背，而是从配置上就不可能兑现，现有工作缺少对这种"与轨迹无关的空洞性"的刻画与度量。

Method: 以承诺语义（commitment semantics）为基础定义空洞承诺，区分三类失败类型；提出锚定条件（anchoring condition），用于判定某工具是否能使承诺变为真实；建立响应级结果分类法。测量协议采用后续请求（follow-up requests），在五种逐步添加单一持久化能力（persistence affordance）的设置中运行，环境信息分别为隐含或明示。

Result: 摘要为概念与协议描述，未报告具体实验数据或量化结果。

Conclusion: 空洞承诺可在不观察后续轨迹的情况下被识别，为智能体承诺能力的评估提供了形式化定义与可操作的测量框架。

Abstract: A chatbot that says "I will remind you tomorrow" will not run again until the user writes. We call such a promise an empty commitment: a promise of an action after the current turn that nothing in the agent's tools or runtime can carry out. Unlike a broken promise, its emptiness follows from the agent's configuration alone; no later trajectory is needed. We define empty commitments on top of commitment semantics, with three failure types, an anchoring condition for promises that a tool could make real, and a response-level outcome taxonomy. We then describe a measurement protocol: follow-up requests run in five setups that add one persistence affordance at a time, with the environment either left implicit or stated.

</details>


### [635] [Revision-Aware Independent Agent Graphs for Dynamic Reasoning](https://arxiv.org/abs/2610.01249)
*Yan Luo,Selim-Antoine Lali,Jeremy Moebel,Iliass Khoutaibi,Ahmadou Aidara,Mengyu Wang*

Main category: cs.AI

TL;DR: 本文研究动态任务路由问题，将六个主流基准重构为31,119个动态episode、373,428个按时序分类的查询，并提出RIAG多智能体策略，在同质设置下达到54.24%联合路由与回答准确率，每查询仅0.62次调用。


<details>
  <summary>Details</summary>
Motivation: 传统推理协议预设固定任务，无法检验智能体是否能传播相关更新、保留未受影响的工作成果，或重建历史任务绑定。因此需要一个能动态修订任务绑定、并按查询时间选择有效文档版本的新问题设定。

Method: 提出修订感知独立智能体图（RIAG）：一种有界多智能体策略，将确定性时间解析与任务推理分离；按不可变文档标识缓存解答；每个新任务以两次未暴露尝试开始；条件性触发审计与修复，每个文档版本最多使用四次调用。

Result: 在由MMLU、MMLU-Pro、MedMCQA、MATH、GPQA、HumanEval重构的集合上，同质RIAG以0.62次/查询取得54.24%的联合路由与回答准确率；最强对比方法为32.22%准确率但需18.00次/查询；异质RIAG以0.63次/查询达到49.78%。

Conclusion: 动态任务路由揭示了重算浪费与无保护复用产生过时结论之间的核心权衡；RIAG通过缓存、有界尝试与条件审计修复，在显著降低调用成本的同时大幅提升联合路由与回答准确率。

Abstract: Conventional reasoning protocols present a fixed, preselected task, so they cannot test whether an agent propagates relevant updates, preserves unaffected work, or reconstructs a historical task binding. We therefore study \emph{dynamic task routing}, in which an event stream revises task bindings and a system must select the document version valid at each query time before solving it. To study this problem, we repurpose six widely used benchmarks: MMLU, MMLU-Pro, MedMCQA, MATH, GPQA, and HumanEval into 31{,}119 dynamic episodes comprising 373{,}428 temporally categorized queries. This setting exposes a central trade-off: recomputing after every event wastes work, whereas unguarded reuse returns stale conclusions. We introduce the Revision-Aware Independent Agent Graph (RIAG), a bounded multi-agent policy that separates deterministic temporal resolution from task reasoning. RIAG caches solutions by immutable document identity, starts each fresh task with two unexposed attempts, and conditionally invokes audit and repair, using at most four calls per document version. On this collection, homogeneous RIAG achieves 54.24\% joint routing-and-answer accuracy at 0.62 calls/query, compared with 32.22\% at 18.00 calls/query for the strongest comparison method; heterogeneous RIAG reaches 49.78\% at 0.63 calls/query.

</details>


### [636] [SCOPE-AD: Sequential cost-aware ordinal-belief planning with energy-based models for diagnostic agents](https://arxiv.org/abs/2610.01278)
*Ziwen Yu,Ivan Koychev,Elizabeth Coulthard,Ting Zhou,Bolin Chen,Dian Hong,Zinuo You,Yujiao Wang,Anthony Mulholland,Qiang Liu*

Main category: cs.AI

TL;DR: 提出SCOPE-AD，一种面向阿尔茨海默病序贯诊断的成本感知智能体框架，在ADNI上以平均50.46美元成本实现77.70% Macro-F1，较最强基线提升9.34个百分点。


<details>
  <summary>Details</summary>
Motivation: AD诊断需在异质检测成本与患者负担下序贯获取证据，而固定模态预测器无法联合决定"该做哪项检测"与"证据何时足够"。

Method: 构建掩码感知的序贯（ordinal）模型，沿CN-MCI-AD有序连续体建模不确定性；用回顾性训练记录为基于能量的教师模型采样Bellman目标，将其动作分布蒸馏进Qwen策略；部署时智能体在可用性与预算约束下选择采集或诊断动作，每步采集后更新证据与序贯信念。

Result: ADNI上达到77.70% Macro-F1，平均采集成本50.46美元，超出最强基线9.34个百分点；全模态评估仅提升1.89个点，成本却增加116.7倍。

Conclusion: 选择性采集可实现成本高效的AD诊断，避免全模态检测带来的高昂成本与有限收益。

Abstract: Alzheimer's disease (AD) diagnosis requires sequential evidence acquisition under heterogeneous test costs and patient burden. Fixed-modality predictors do not jointly decide which test to acquire or when the available evidence is sufficient for diagnosis. We propose SCOPE-AD (Sequential Cost-Aware Ordinal-Belief Planning with Energy-Based Models for Diagnostic Agents) for cost-aware classification of cognitively normal (CN), mild cognitive impairment (MCI), and AD cases. A mask-aware ordinal model represents uncertainty along the ordered CN--MCI--AD continuum. Retrospective training records provide sampled Bellman targets for an energy-based teacher, whose action distributions are distilled into a Qwen policy. At deployment, the agent selects acquisition or diagnosis actions under availability and budget constraints without access to unacquired values. After each acquisition, the evidence and ordinal belief are updated before the next decision. On ADNI, SCOPE-AD achieves 77.70\% Macro-F1 at an average acquisition cost of \$50.46, exceeding the strongest evaluated baseline by 9.34 percentage points. Full-modality evaluation raises Macro-F1 by only 1.89 points while increasing acquisition cost by 116.7 times. These results support selective acquisition for cost-effective diagnosis.

</details>


### [637] [DAYJOB: A Benchmark for Long-Horizon Professional Work](https://arxiv.org/abs/2610.01306)
*Stephanie Finley,Liudas Panavas,Thomas Mikkelson,Cam Hinton,Stacey Ganss,Bradley Monton,Emily Kendall,Michelle Spradlin,Lydia Bye,Michael O'Brien,Lauren Ylvisaker,Derek Ray,Suhaas Garre,Sushant Mehta,Edwin Chen*

Main category: cs.AI

TL;DR: 论文提出DAYJOB基准，包含医疗（50项）与金融（80项）专业任务，用于评估AI代理在开放式专业工作场景中的端到端交付能力。


<details>
  <summary>Details</summary>
Motivation: 真实专业工作常始于简短请求，需要专业人员自行推断需求、判断相关材料、并验证请求前提是否成立。现有基准缺乏对此类开放式、需自主体判断的专业任务的评估。

Method: 构建130项由医疗和金融从业者设计的任务，采用容器化Harbor环境；每项任务配有专家评分标准（二值判据，中位数医疗47.5项、金融57.5项），由代理式评审器对交付文件逐条判定，全部通过才算成功。

Result: 任务平均预计耗时：医疗13.6小时、金融16.6小时。在13家开发者的30种模型配置中，最强的Claude Opus 5.5在医疗上通过24.7%、金融23.9%；中位配置仅通过0.6%和2.5%。案例研究显示代理会接受与记录矛盾的前提，并将错误输入贯穿于表面一致的分析中。

Conclusion: DAYJOB揭示当前模型在真实专业工作任务上的显著不足，并开放全部医疗任务、50项金融任务、评测框架及排行榜以推动后续研究。

Abstract: Professional work often starts with a brief request that leaves the professional to work out what is needed, which documents matter, and whether the request's premise holds. We introduce DAYJOB, a benchmark of 130 tasks built by professionals in healthcare (50) and finance (80). The tasks are estimated to take a professional 13.6 hours on average in healthcare and 16.6 in finance. Each task is a containerized Harbor environment with an expert rubric of binary criteria (median 47.5 and 57.5 per task) that an agentic judge applies to the delivered files, and an attempt passes only if it meets every criterion. Across 30 model configurations from 13 developers, the strongest, Claude Opus 5.5, passes 24.7% of healthcare and 23.9% of finance attempts, and the median configuration passes 0.6% and 2.5%. In case studies, agents accept premises that the record contradicts and carry wrong inputs through otherwise consistent analyses. We release all healthcare tasks, 50 of the 80 finance tasks, the evaluation harness, and the leaderboard.

</details>


### [638] [Generation Provenance Before Behavior Attribution: Auditing Synthetic Speech Research Objects](https://arxiv.org/abs/2610.01378)
*Sidi Chang,Peiying Zhu*

Main category: cs.AI

TL;DR: 论文提出"生成溯源基座"（generation-provenance substrate），将合成研究对象的来源规格、生成内容、波形、目标、事实要求、质量信号、审核谱系与不可变清单身份绑定，并在日语护理交接流水线中审计，论证生成溯源是行为归因的必要非充分条件。


<details>
  <summary>Details</summary>
Motivation: 要对模型行为归因于合成训练数据，必须先知道每个训练样本由何产生，再估计其造成的影响；而单纯的"波形—标签"对无法保留这一知识。存储位置与变量名不决定证据意义，生产者与选择机制才决定。

Method: 提出生成溯源基座：合成研究对象绑定来源规格、生成内容、波形、目标、事实要求、质量信号、审核谱系与不可变清单身份。在私有日语护理交接流水线中进行审计，考察含113项资产的审核总体（1.552小时合成语音、六个场景族，均链有音频、转写、候选笔记与事实清单）；两个"仅忠实"清单按场景种子不相交且不可变版本化。

Result: 人工证据具有选择性与来源特异性；精确上游归因受阻于浮动的生成器别名、缺失的逐片段TTS与代码戳记、以及未版本化的核查提示词。基座定义了候选因果图与审计单元，但贡献性归因仍需冻结的训练运行与干预/影响力证据。

Conclusion: 贡献为一份紧凑的溯源契约、一套审计协议与一个有界案例研究。作者不主张因果训练数据归因、临床有效性或不受限的公开释放，但可提供受控研究访问。

Abstract: Attributing model behavior to synthetic training data requires knowing what produced each training item before estimating what that item caused. A waveform-label pair does not preserve this knowledge. We propose a generation-provenance substrate in which a synthetic research object binds source specification, generated content, waveform, target, fact requirements, quality signals, review lineage, and immutable manifest identity. Producer and selection mechanism determine evidentiary meaning; storage location and variable name do not. We audit this substrate in a private Japanese care-handoff pipeline. A 113-asset review population contains 1.552 hours of synthetic speech across six scenario families; all items have linked audio, transcripts, candidate notes, and fact checklists, but human evidence is selective and source-specific. Two faithful-only manifests are scenario-seed-disjoint and immutably versioned, while exact upstream attribution remains blocked by floating generator aliases, missing per-clip TTS and code stamps, and an unversioned checking prompt. We argue that generation provenance is necessary but not sufficient for behavior attribution: it defines the candidate causal graph and audit units, whereas contributive attribution still requires frozen training runs and intervention or influence evidence. The paper contributes a compact provenance contract, an audit protocol, and a bounded case study for synthetic-data attribution; controlled research access may be offered, but we do not claim causal training-data attribution, clinical validity, or unrestricted public release.

</details>


### [639] [Gacha Decoding: Eliciting Diverse Generations Through Instruction Following](https://arxiv.org/abs/2610.01382)
*Scott Geng,Yufei Zhang,Joseph Lee,Jerry Li,Marjan Ghazvininejad,Pang Wei Koh*

Main category: cs.AI

TL;DR: 提出 Gacha Decoding，一种将多样性视为指令遵循问题的推理时解码方法，利用外部 RNG 工具引入随机性，在相同质量下显著超越现有生成多样性方法，并使多样性与模型能力正相关。


<details>
  <summary>Details</summary>
Motivation: 现有生成多样性方法依赖语言模型的 token 熵，而 token 熵随模型能力提升反而下降，导致多样性与模型能力之间存在长期张力。作者希望突破这一瓶颈，实现随模型能力提升而增强的多样性。

Method: 将多样性建模为指令遵循问题：不依赖 LM 的 token 熵，而是结合其指令遵循能力与外部 RNG 工具提供的随机性，通过"掷骰子规划"识别并实现响应空间中不同的模式（modes）。

Result: 在开放域任务（真实场景对话、创意写作、图像生成规划、蛋白质设计）中，相同质量下 Vendi 分数最高达次优方法 2.4 倍；以少一个数量级（11.0x）的样本量达到相同数量的高质量模式；发现其他方法无法揭示的新模式。

Conclusion: 指令遵循而非 token 熵本身可以驱动生成多样性，Gacha Decoding 反转了多样性与模型能力之间的紧张关系：模型作为指令遵循者越强，多样性持续提升。

Abstract: We introduce Gacha Decoding, an inference-time method for eliciting diverse language model generations that scales with model capability. Across open-ended domains (in-the-wild chat, creative writing, planning for image generation, and protein design), Gacha Decoding significantly outperforms existing generation diversity approaches at equal quality (up to 2.4x Vendi over the next-best prior approach), reaching the same number of high-quality modes with over an order of magnitude fewer samples (11.0x) and discovering novel modes that no other approach surfaces. Our key insight is to treat diversity as an instruction-following problem: rather than relying on the LM's token entropy, we combine its instruction-following capability with randomness from an external RNG tool to scalably identify and realize distinct modes of the response space. This approach of "planning with dice" enables Gacha to invert the long-observed tension between diversity and model capability. As the underlying LM becomes a better instruction follower, diversity under Gacha Decoding consistently improves--even as its token entropy and diversity under prior approaches decline. Together, our results highlight that instruction following, rather than token entropy alone, can drive generation diversity.

</details>


### [640] [Counterfactual Auditing of Bias in Open-Source Large Language Models for Clinical Triage](https://arxiv.org/abs/2610.01963)
*Manar Aljohani,Brandon Ho,Kenneth McKinley,Dennis Ren,Xuan Wang*

Main category: cs.AI

TL;DR: 本文对十个开源大语言模型进行反事实偏见审计，评估其在儿科急诊分诊（ESI）预测中对人口学、社会经济及系统语境信息的敏感性。


<details>
  <summary>Details</summary>
Motivation: 急诊分诊是高风险的优先级排序任务，人口学、社会经济和系统语境信息可能不当影响分诊等级判定；开源大模型日益被考虑用于本地化、隐私保护的临床决策支持，但其反事实偏见在不同模型家族、规模、医学领域模型及领域适配模型间的差异尚不清楚。

Method: 基于真实及手册式临床情景构建配对反事实变体，仅改变单一注入变量（人口学、社会经济、医疗可及性、行为、社会或系统语境），保持临床表现不变；对包括Qwen2.5-7B、Qwen2.5-14B-Instruct、QLoRA微调Qwen2.5-7B、MedGemma系列、MedLLaMA2-7B、GPT-OSS-20B与GPT-OSS-120B在内的十个开源模型进行ESI预测；测量任何反事实偏移、分诊不足、分诊过度、超过一个ESI等级的偏移、平均偏移及平均绝对偏移。

Result: 反事实敏感性差异显著，且并未随模型规模增大或医学领域预训练而一致降低。微调后的Qwen2.5-7B总体敏感性最低（任何偏移率5.27%，平均绝对偏移0.0534），而基座模型为16.02%和0.1706；若干更大或医学领域模型表现出更显著的偏移。分层与相关性分析进一步揭示了聚合率所掩盖的临床重要方向性与共同失效模式。

Conclusion: 反事实审计可作为轻量、临床可解释的框架，用于在临床部署前比较开源大模型的公平性风险。

Abstract: Emergency department (ED) triage is a high-stakes prioritization task in which demographic, socioeconomic, and system-context information may improperly influence acuity assignment. Although open-source large language models (LLMs) are increasingly considered for local and privacy-preserving clinical decision support, it remains unclear how counterfactual bias varies across model families, sizes, medical-domain models, and domain-adapted models. We present a comparative counterfactual audit of ten open-source LLMs for pediatric Emergency Severity Index (ESI) prediction. Starting from real and handbook-style clinical vignettes, we construct paired counterfactual variants that change only one injected demographic, socioeconomic, healthcare-access, behavioral, social, or system-context variable while holding the clinical presentation fixed. Models include Qwen2.5-7B, Qwen2.5-14B-Instruct, a QLoRA fine-tuned Qwen2.5-7B, MedGemma variants, MedLLaMA2-7B, GPT-OSS-20B, and GPT-OSS-120B. We measure any counterfactual shift, undertriage, overtriage, shifts greater than one ESI level, mean shift, and mean absolute shift. Counterfactual sensitivity varied substantially and did not consistently decrease with larger model size or medical-domain pretraining. The fine-tuned Qwen2.5-7B showed the lowest overall sensitivity, with a 5.27% any-shift rate and mean absolute shift of 0.0534, versus 16.02% and 0.1706 for the base model. Several larger or medical-domain models showed more significant shifts. Stratified and correlation analyses further revealed clinically important directionality and shared failure patterns hidden by aggregate rates. These findings support counterfactual auditing as a lightweight, clinically interpretable framework for comparing fairness risks in open-source LLMs before clinical deployment.

</details>


### [641] [Mingbird: A Local-First Agent Harness Enabling Small Open Models to Complete Real Tasks](https://arxiv.org/abs/2610.02001)
*Hao Wang,Ting Huang*

Main category: cs.AI

TL;DR: 论文指出小型开源模型在云规模智能体框架下任务完成率低，主要是框架（harness）而非模型的问题；提出本地优先框架 Mingbird，用十项机制针对性补偿小模型失效模式，在 LRAB 上得分 0.886，显著高于 goose（0.631）、opencode（0.479）、agent-mini（0.405），并在 τ²-bench 上取得 0.856。


<details>
  <summary>Details</summary>
Motivation: 小型开源模型（2–9B）可在普通笔记本上运行，但在云端规模的 agent harness 下几乎无法完成真实任务，表现为工具预填充溢出上下文、自纠正发散、工具示例循环、任务被静默放弃。作者希望验证这些失败在多大程度上归因于 harness 而非模型本身，并据此设计补偿方案。

Method: 通过受控单机对比与一个第三方基准收集证据；提出 Mingbird——面向 Windows 与 Ollama 的本地优先 agent harness，含十项机制逐点补偿小模型失效形式，其中三项代表性机制为：字节级净零预填充预算、接受完成前重读任务的 finish gate、签名级循环检测。LRAB 评测固定机器、模型、预算与评分（4 harness × 4 开源模型（2B–35B）× 18 项真实任务，确定性产物评分），并公开全部 288 个单元结果；在 τ²-bench（278 任务、三组、统一协议）上评测；另做前沿模型探针与 leave-one-mechanism-out 消融（仅作方向性参考）。

Result: LRAB 上 Mingbird 总体 0.886，对比 goose 0.631、opencode 0.479、agent-mini 0.405；τ²-bench 上为 0.856，对比 0.791 与 0.737；同一批 18 任务的前沿模型探针跨 harness 得分从 0.997 到 0.478，结构良好的脚手架之间差距在 0.072 以内。消融显示同一 arm 的同夜重测均值波动可达 0.069，与所有名义单次试验差值相当；唯一批次匹配对比（完整机制栈 vs 仅文本重读）中可执行完成守卫三重复配对增益 +0.10。

Conclusion: 证据表明小型开源模型的大量失败可归因于 harness 而非模型能力，针对性设计的补偿机制能大幅提升真实任务完成率。但结论存在明确局限：基准为自建、仅单机环境、单次试验评分，消融结果仅具方向性。

Abstract: Small open-weight models (2-9B) run on ordinary laptops, but under cloud-scale agent harnesses they rarely complete real tasks: tool prefill overflows the context, self-correction diverges, tool demonstrations loop, and tasks are silently abandoned. We present evidence, from a controlled single-machine comparison and one third-party benchmark, that a substantial share of these failures is attributable to the harness rather than the model. We introduce Mingbird, a local-first agent harness for Windows and Ollama whose ten mechanisms compensate point-by-point for small-model failure forms, three of them representative: a byte-level net-zero prefill budget, a finish gate that re-reads the task before accepting completion, and signature-level loop detection. On LRAB, a controlled comparison holding machine, models, budgets, and scoring fixed (4 harnesses $\times$ 4 open models (2B-35B) $\times$ 18 real tasks, deterministic artifact scoring), Mingbird reaches 0.886 overall against 0.631 (goose), 0.479 (opencode), and 0.405 (agent-mini), with all 288 cells published; on $τ^2$-bench (278 tasks, three arms, one protocol) it totals 0.856 against 0.791 and 0.737; and a frontier-model probe on the same 18 tasks spans 0.997 to 0.478 across harnesses, with well-formed scaffolds staying within 0.072 of each other. A leave-one-mechanism-out ablation is reported as directional only: same-night replications of the same arm move its mean by up to 0.069, the size of every nominal single-trial delta, and the one batch-matched comparison (full mechanism stack versus text re-read alone) gives the executable completion guards a paired +0.10 across three replications. The evidence carries stated limits: a self-built benchmark, a single machine, and single-trial scoring.

</details>


### [642] [A Comparative Explainability Framework for DeBERTa-v3 in Zero-Shot Medical Abstract Classification](https://arxiv.org/abs/2610.02116)
*Javier Diaz Esteban-Herreros,David Muñoz-Valero,Raquel Martínez-España,Jose M. Juarez,Juan Moreno-Garcia*

Main category: cs.AI

TL;DR: 本文提出一个比较性可解释性框架，用于审计DeBERTa-v3在医学摘要零样本分类中的表现，通过五种归因方法的一致性与预测准确性分析，揭示解释稳定性与预测确定性的一致性及三类系统性失效机制。


<details>
  <summary>Details</summary>
Motivation: 解决可解释人工智能（XAI）中的"分歧问题"，即不同归因方法对同一输入和预测产生相互矛盾的解释，从而影响对Transformer模型在医学文本分类任务中的可信度审计。

Method: 在Medical Abstracts语料上构建自然语言推理引擎，每个诊断类别配置五个增强假设，每类平衡采样一千篇文本；比较五种解释方法：模型无关方法SHAP和LIME、深度学习特定方法occlusion和Input x Gradient、Transformer特定方法Attention x Gradient；通过top-token归因标准化解释，并用Jaccard指数量化成对一致性。

Result: 在定义明确的临床领域取得高预测准确率，但在高语义歧义下性能下降；解释稳定性与预测确定性直接对应，在单一含义类别中强收敛，在诊断不确定性下明显下降；定性错误审计发现三类系统性失效机制：词汇过度敏感、语义重叠和归因连贯性丧失。

Conclusion: 结果支持在审计基于Transformer的医学文本分类模型时，结合使用多种解释方法与定量一致性指标，并建议优先采用特定临床本体而非宽泛的诊断标签。

Abstract: A comparative explainability framework is presented to audit DeBERTa-v3 under zero-shot classification of medical abstracts. The work addresses the disagreement problem in Explainable Artificial Intelligence, where different attribution methods produce divergent explanations for the same input and prediction. A natural language inference engine is implemented over the Medical Abstracts corpus with five enriched hypotheses per diagnostic category and a balanced sample of one thousand texts per class. Five explanation methods are compared: SHAP and LIME as model-agnostic approaches, occlusion and Input x Gradient as deep-learning-specific approaches, and Attention x Gradient as a transformer-specific approach. Explanations are standardized through top-token attribution, and pairwise agreement is quantified using the Jaccard index. High predictive accuracy is achieved across well-defined clinical domains, whereas performance degrades under high semantic ambiguity. Explanatory stability directly mirrors predictive certainty, exhibiting strong convergence in univalent categories and a marked drop under diagnostic uncertainty. Furthermore, qualitative error auditing uncovers three systemic failure mechanisms: lexical hypersensitivity, semantic overlap, and loss of attribution coherence. The results support the combined use of several explanation methods and quantitative agreement metrics when auditing transformer-based models in medical text classification, and suggest prioritizing specific clinical ontologies over broad diagnostic labels.

</details>


### [643] [Spatial Strategies, Not Actions: Vector-Quantized Geodesics as Tools for LLM-Driven Agents](https://arxiv.org/abs/2610.00613)
*Gabriel Turinici*

Main category: cs.AI

TL;DR: 该论文研究LLM智能体的空间理解能力，提出将几何工具与LLM高层编排相结合的分层架构：离线用向量量化从测地轨迹中提取代表性行为模式并由LLM赋予自然语言描述形成工具库，在线由LLM根据状态与目标选择工具、由原始动作执行轨迹。在部分可观测动态2D网格环境中，用开源视觉语言模型（Qwen3.6-35B-A3B）验证，几何工具库配合智能体中心缩放与碰撞检测工具，使非推理配置达到昂贵思维链版本的目标达成率，同时将单次决策成本从数分钟降至数秒。


<details>
  <summary>Details</summary>
Motivation: LLM智能体常被批评缺乏空间理解、主要依赖统计性文本模式。作者希望探究LLM是否具备空间理解能力，并通过引入几何工具来弥补其在网格世界中的空间推理短板，同时避免依赖昂贵的高层推理。

Method: 提出分层智能体架构：智能体先采集测地轨迹，经向量量化提取代表性子集；离线阶段由LLM为所选轨迹的行为模式关联自然语言描述，将其转化为"工具"；在线阶段LLM依据当前状态与目标选择合适工具，底层控制由执行该工具对应轨迹的原始动作完成。从智能体AI视角看，学习被拆为两层——工具发现由轨迹的无监督量化处理，推理与决策由LLM处理。在部分可观测的动态2D网格环境中使用开源视觉语言模型（Qwen3.6-35B-A3B）测试，并加入以智能体为中心的缩放工具与碰撞检测工具。

Result: 几何衍生的工具库与智能体中心缩放工具、碰撞检测工具配合后，快速非推理配置的目标达成率可匹敌成本高得多的思维链版本，同时把单次决策成本从数分钟降至数秒。

Conclusion: 将空间任务中的工具发现与推理决策解耦、以几何量化提供可复用行为工具、由LLM负责高层编排，能够在不牺牲目标达成率的前提下大幅降低决策开销，说明LLM智能体的空间能力可通过结构化工具增强而非仅靠扩大推理规模获得。

Abstract: Large language model (LLM) based agents are often criticized for lacking spatial understanding and mainly exploiting statistical text patterns. We investigate their spatial comprehension through an architecture combining geometrical tools with a LLM serving as a high-level orchestrator in grid-world environments. The agent first collects geodesic trajectories, which are then vector-quantized to extract a representative subset. Offline, the LLM associates a natural language description of the underlying behavioral patterns to each selected trajectory, making it a tool. Online, the LLM chooses the appropriate tool conditioned on the current state and goal. Low-level control is handled by primitive actions that execute the trajectory associated with the tool. From an agentic AI perspective, this approach separates learning into two levels: tool discovery is handled through unsupervised quantization of trajectories, while reasoning and decision-making are handled by the LLM. We test the approach in a partially observable dynamic 2D grid environment with an open vision-language model (Qwen3.6-35B-A3B). Pairing the geometry-derived tool library with an agent-centered zoom tool and a collision detection tool lets a fast, non-reasoning configuration match the goal-reaching rate of a much more costly chain-of-thought version, while cutting the cost of a decision from minutes to seconds.

</details>


### [644] [AVSD-Scenes: A Dataset for Audio-Visual Description of Urban Scenes](https://arxiv.org/abs/2610.01861)
*Dhanunjaya Varma Devalraju,Arshdeep Singh,Mark D. Plumbley*

Main category: cs.AI

TL;DR: 该论文提出了AVSD-Scenes——一个面向城市环境的成对音视频场景描述数据集，包含12,291条音视频场景描述，并对其进行了多维度基准评测。


<details>
  <summary>Details</summary>
Motivation: 自然语言可为城市音视频场景提供丰富语义表示，但同时描述听觉与视觉信息的联合数据集仍十分有限，亟需构建此类资源并验证其价值。

Method: 基于TAU Urban Audio-Visual Scenes数据集，先用Qwen2-Audio-7B生成音频描述、Qwen2.5-VL-7B生成视觉描述，再用Qwen3-14B、Mistral-Small-3.2-24B-Instruct-2506和Gemma-3-27B-it等大语言模型融合为多模态描述；随后通过语义对齐、跨模态检索、场景分类、LLM-as-a-judge评测及人工主观评估进行基准测试。

Result: 多模态描述在语义对齐和跨模态检索上优于单模态描述，同时保留强场景判别信息；生成描述在城市场景分类上最高达94.5%准确率，融合音频、视觉与描述嵌入后提升至95.4%；即便从提示指令中移除场景标签，描述仍保持高度场景判别性。

Conclusion: AVSD-Scenes验证了多模态场景描述在语义对齐、检索与分类任务中的有效性，且其判别能力源于音视频内容本身而非标签泄漏，为音视频场景理解提供了有价值的描述性资源。

Abstract: Natural language descriptions can provide rich semantic representations of audio-visual urban scenes, yet datasets that jointly describe both auditory and visual information remain limited. In this paper, we introduce AVSD-Scenes, a paired audio-visual scene description dataset for urban environments. The dataset contains 12,291 audio-visual scene descriptions generated from the TAU Urban Audio-Visual Scenes dataset. To construct the dataset, we first generate audio- and visual-based descriptions using Qwen2-Audio-7B and Qwen2.5-VL-7B, respectively. These modality-specific descriptions are then combined using large language models, namely Qwen3-14B, Mistral-Small-3.2-24B-Instruct-2506, and Gemma-3-27B-it, to produce multimodal descriptions that capture complementary information from both modalities. We benchmark AVSD-Scenes using semantic alignment, cross-modal retrieval, scene classification, LLM-as-a-judge evaluation, and human subjective assessment. Results show that multimodal descriptions improve semantic alignment and cross-modal retrieval performance compared with modality-specific descriptions while preserving strong scene-discriminative information. The generated descriptions achieve up to 94.5% accuracy in urban scene classification, while combining audio, visual, and description embeddings further improves accuracy to 95.4%. Furthermore, the descriptions remain highly scene-discriminative even when scene labels are removed from the prompting instructions, indicating that they capture semantic information derived from the audio-visual content rather than merely reflecting label information.

</details>


### [645] [Learning Multiple Timescales for Goal-Conditioned Reinforcement Learning](https://arxiv.org/abs/2610.00849)
*Pedro Robles Dutenhefner,Dikshant Shehmar,Wagner Meira,Marlos C. Machado*

Main category: cs.AI

TL;DR: GITA 通过将单一价值函数条件化于时间抽象尺度 k，并对多个 k 值进行优势加权监督聚合，解决离线目标条件强化学习中折扣导致长时程信号消失与固定 k 无法兼顾局部分辨率的问题，在 OGBench 上显著超越离线 GCRL 基线。


<details>
  <summary>Details</summary>
Motivation: 离线目标条件强化学习（GCRL）在长时程任务上表现不佳。折扣会使远距离状态间的价值差异收缩到函数逼近误差以下，导致智能体失去状态排序信号。时间抽象（将 k 个环境步视为单步转移）能在长程恢复该信号，但不存在对所有状态-目标距离都适用的固定 k：大 k 保留长时程价值差异却抹平近邻状态区分，小 k 则相反。因此需要在单一 k 的选择上做出权衡。

Method: 作者将上述权衡显式化，提出 Generalized Implicit Temporal Abstraction（GITA）。GITA 让一个单一价值函数以 k 为条件，并通过聚合多个 k 值上的优势加权监督来训练一个策略：对某状态-目标对分配更大正优势的尺度，其对该更新的贡献更强。

Result: 在 OGBench 上，GITA 优于广泛的离线 GCRL 基线。相比 HIQL，所有任务的平均成功率提升 25 个百分点（相对提升 73%）；相比最强的固定 k 方法 OTA，提升 7 个百分点（相对提升 14%）。

Conclusion: GITA 无需在局部分辨率与长程信号之间二选一，而是同时保留两者，无需绑定单一 k。实验表明该多尺度优势加权聚合策略在离线 GCRL 长时程任务上有效且优于固定 k 方案。

Abstract: Existing approaches to offline goal-conditioned reinforcement learning (GCRL) struggle with long-horizon tasks. Discounting shrinks value differences between distant states until they fall below the function approximation error, leaving the agent with no signal for ranking states. Temporal abstraction, which treats k environment steps as a single transition, restores this signal at long range, but no single fixed k suits all state-goal distances: large k preserves value differences across long temporal distances while collapsing distinctions between nearby states, and small k does the reverse. We make this trade-off explicit and introduce Generalized Implicit Temporal Abstraction (GITA), which conditions a single value function on k. GITA trains one policy by aggregating advantage-weighted supervision across multiple k values, so scales assigning larger positive advantages to a state-goal pair contribute more strongly to its update. GITA does not need to choose between local resolution and long-range signal; it retains both without committing to a single k. On OGBench, GITA outperforms a broad range of offline GCRL baselines, raising average success rate across all tasks by 25 percentage points (73% relative improvement) over HIQL. It also improves over the strongest fixed-k method, OTA, by 7 percentage points (14% relative).

</details>


### [646] [Measuring the Microtask Eligibility Gap: When Is an Off-the-Shelf SLM Enough for an Agent Harness?](https://arxiv.org/abs/2610.00025)
*Jundong Hu,Shekar Ramachandran*

Main category: cs.AI

TL;DR: 该论文构建了4个代理微任务基准，考察现成小语言模型（SLM）能否达到从业者设定的阈值。结果发现Qwen3 0.6–8B共16个配置全部不合格，量化不改变结论，差距主要随模型规模而非精度变化；实践建议是将SLM置于满足CI阈值基线的后备位置。


<details>
  <summary>Details</summary>
Motivation: 代理框架（agent harness）希望用SLM处理前沿大模型规划器周边的微任务（如自动批准shell命令、写记忆、选工具、排序历史轮次），但尚不清楚现成SLM能否满足实践者定义的阈值、失败原因何在、量化是否会改变结论。

Method: 构建含4个微任务的基准，提示固定、指标自动；每个任务预设阈值τ，锚定于廉价非LLM基线，并采用CI感知的合格规则（置信界需越过τ）。在FP16、贪心解码、单一冻结提示、无微调的最优设置下扫描Qwen3 0.6/1.7/4/8B；用logprob决策阈值诊断（T1/T3/T4，T2用上下文长度/级联探针）区分能力缺陷与可通过调整解码阈值解决的失败（4种情形）；再做4-bit量化（RTN/GPTQ/AWQ）测试。

Result: 出现"合格缺口"：16个配置（4任务×4模型）无一合格（经原始输出与解析器行为核验）。量化损害依赖模型规模，但没有任何配置进入合格（在可重构硬标签任务T1/T3上已认证，T2/T4作诊断/窗口稳健性分析），缺口更多随模型规模而非精度变化。结论在Llama-3.x上复现（12/12不合格），对锚点选择（τ扫描）和提示措辞（原提示加3个中性改写，0/112合格）均稳健。

Conclusion: 应将SLM置于满足CI背书阈值的基线之后，仅在基线未达标处使用SLM；例如用4B重排器在BM25候选集上重排可优于BM25（+0.047 [0.020, 0.073]），但其自身仍未通过合格认证。

Abstract: Agent harnesses increasingly want to run small language models (SLMs) on the microtasks around a frontier large language model (LLM) planner: auto-approving shell commands, writing memory, selecting tools, ranking past turns. We ask whether off-the-shelf SLMs meet practitioner-defined thresholds and, when they fail, why, and whether quantization changes the answer. We build a benchmark of 4 such microtasks with fixed prompts and automatic metrics, each with a pre-specified threshold $τ$ anchored to a cheap non-LLM baseline and a CI-aware eligibility rule (a configuration passes only if its confidence bound clears $τ$). Sweeping Qwen3 0.6/1.7/4/8B at their best (FP16, greedy, one frozen prompt, no tuning), we find an eligibility gap: 0 of 16 (4 tasks $\times$ 4 models) configurations pass (verified by checking the raw outputs and parser behavior). A logprob decision-threshold diagnostic (T1/T3/T4; T2 via a context-length/cascade probe) separates the failures into capability deficits and failures that can be addressed by changing the decoding threshold (4 regimes). Quantization to 4-bit (RTN/GPTQ/AWQ) does damage that depends on model size and moves no configuration into eligibility (certified on the reconstructable hard-label tasks T1/T3, diagnostic/windowed robustness on T2/T4), so the gap tracks model size more than precision; it replicates on Llama-3.x (12/12 ineligible) and is robust to the anchor choice (a $τ$-sweep) and to prompt wording (0/112 eligible across the original plus 3 neutral paraphrases per cell). The practical implication: place SLMs behind a baseline that meets the CI-backed threshold, and use the SLM only where the baseline fails to meet the threshold; e.g. a 4B re-ranker over a BM25 shortlist beats BM25 ($+0.047$ [0.020, 0.073], without itself certifying eligibility).

</details>


### [647] [Benchmarking Prompt Optimization of Large Language Models With Chess](https://arxiv.org/abs/2610.00416)
*Timothée Lesort,Alejandra López de Aberasturi Gómez,Tristan Karch,Tom Veniat,Philippe Modard,Karl Tuyls,Ludovic Denoyer*

Main category: cs.AI

TL;DR: 本文提出基于1,118道Lichess国际象棋谜题的基准，用于研究冻结大语言模型的自动提示优化（APO）。该基准评分廉价且确定性、难度适中可留提升空间、并可持续更新以对抗污染。研究在8个模型上评估6种APO算法，并连接解题增益与同域短对局表现。


<details>
  <summary>Details</summary>
Motivation: 随着LLM能力提升，评测日益困难：基准饱和、公开测试集存在污染风险、更难任务需昂贵评分或执行设施。这些问题在自动提示优化（APO）中被放大，因为搜索更优提示过程中需反复评测。因此需要一个廉价、确定性、足够难且可随模型演进更新的基准。

Method: 构建由1,118道Lichess谜题组成的国际象棋基准，用于冻结LLM的APO研究（仅优化提示、不更新权重）。利用国际象棋的精确匹配评分、基于引擎的替代走法评估，以及可调难度的可再生题库。基准不仅报告孤立测试项成功率，还将解题增益与同域短对局rollout关联。在8个目标模型上评估6种APO算法，测量基线强度、模型对优化的响应度，以及优化提示跨模型与到对局的迁移性。

Result: 最强评测模型Gemini 3.5 Flash（作为meta-model）仅解出约55%谜题，说明基准具有挑战性；方法间和模型间呈现增益、无变化与回退，具区分度；新鲜谜题降低污染风险且难度可调以维持提升空间；完整研究成本约800美元，具可负担性。

Conclusion: 国际象棋是适合APO的基准，具备四点特性：(i) 有挑战性；(ii) 有区分度；(iii) 可再生；(iv) 成本可负担。作者发布谜题、优化与评测代码及数据集更新脚本（https://github.com/imec-ailabs/Automatic-Prompt-Optimization-with-Chess）。

Abstract: Evaluating large language models becomes increasingly challenging as their capabilities advance: benchmarks can saturate, public test sets risk contamination, and assessing harder tasks can require expensive grading or execution infrastructure. These challenges are amplified in automatic prompt optimization (APO), where evaluation is repeated throughout the search for better prompts. Studying APO therefore requires a benchmark that is cheap and deterministic to score, hard enough to leave room for improvement, and renewable as models evolve. We introduce a chess benchmark built from 1,118 Lichess puzzles to study APO for frozen LLMs: we optimize their prompts without updating their model weights. Chess combines inexpensive exact-match scoring, engine-based evaluation of alternative moves, and a renewable supply of problems with adjustable difficulty. Unlike evaluations that report only success on isolated test items, the benchmark also connects puzzle-solving gains to short game-play rollouts within the same domain. We use it to evaluate six APO algorithms on eight target models, measuring not only baseline strength but also how much each model responds to optimization and whether optimized prompts transfer across models and to game play. Chess is thus a well-suited benchmark for APO: it is (i) challenging, as even the strongest evaluated model, Gemini 3.5 Flash (used as the meta-model), solves only about 55\% of puzzles; (ii) discriminative, revealing gains, unchanged performance, and regressions across methods and models; (iii) renewable, with fresh puzzles to reduce contamination risk and adjustable difficulty to maintain headroom as models improve; and (iv) affordable, as the complete study runs for around \$800. We release the puzzles, optimization and evaluation code, and dataset-renewal scripts (https://github.com/imec-ailabs/Automatic-Prompt-Optimization-with-Chess).

</details>


### [648] [CompMat-Bench: Benchmarking AI Agents for Computational Materials Science](https://arxiv.org/abs/2610.00636)
*Chenmu Zhang,Levi Felix,Jun-Jie Zhang,Xingfu Li,Xuelian Jiang,Tao Jiang,Subhendu Mishra,Xixi Qin,Boris Yakobson*

Main category: cs.AI

TL;DR: 提出 CompMat-Bench 基准，用94个源自近期计算材料学研究任务，通过预复现输入与结果、固定规则评分（无需LLM评判），在避免重复昂贵模拟的前提下评估AI智能体，并支持单任务/工作流×完整/精简指导四种条件。


<details>
  <summary>Details</summary>
Motivation: 在科研任务上评估AI智能体受限于实验或计算所需的时间与资源；在计算材料研究中，跨智能体、跨试验重复昂贵模拟使评估不切实际，亟需一种可规避重复高成本模拟的评估方案。

Method: 构建 CompMat-Bench：94个取自近期已发表计算材料学研究的任务，每个任务要求智能体完成通向该研究科学目标的一步；预先复现研究步骤，只考察智能体准备输入与分析输出，从而避免评估期间运行昂贵模拟；以复现的输入与结果作为真值，采用固定规则评分，不使用LLM评判；设置单任务与相关工作流组合，每种又分完整指导与精简指导，共四种评估条件；基于三种LLM的智能体进行测试，并做失败分析。

Result: 在单任务+完整指导下，基于三种LLM的智能体能够完成单个材料研究步骤，94个任务的通过率为66.0%–90.4%；更长的工作流与精简指导均会限制智能体表现，但方式因智能体而异——二者会降低较弱智能体的通过率，而最强智能体仅在长工作流与精简指导同时出现时表现下降；失败分析显示多数失败源于科学错误，而非软件使用错误。

Conclusion: CompMat-Bench 为在真实材料研究步骤上比较智能体、并分析其失败模式提供了基础，同时以预复现+固定评分的方式降低了评估成本。

Abstract: Evaluating AI agents on scientific research tasks is constrained by the time and resources required for the underlying experiments or calculations. In computational materials research, repeating the same expensive simulations across agents and trials can make evaluation impractical. We introduce CompMat-Bench, a benchmark of 94 tasks derived from recently published computational materials studies, each asking agents to complete a step toward achieving the study's scientific goal. We reproduce the research steps in advance and assess agents on preparing inputs and analyzing outputs for expensive simulations, so expensive simulations can be avoided during evaluation. The reproduced inputs and results serve as ground truth for grading agents with fixed rules, without an LLM judge. The benchmark supports four evaluation conditions: single tasks and workflows composed of related tasks, each with full or reduced methodological guidance. With full guidance on single tasks, agents based on three LLMs demonstrate the ability to complete individual materials research steps, with pass rates of 66.0-90.4% across 94 tasks. Both longer workflows and reduced guidance can limit agent performance, but in different ways for different agents: they lower the pass rates of the weaker agents, whereas the strongest agent falls only when a long workflow is combined with reduced guidance. Failure analysis attributes most failures to scientific errors rather than to errors in software usage. CompMat-Bench provides a basis for comparing agents on the steps of real materials research and for analyzing agent failure modes.

</details>


### [649] [Agent Evaluation Reliability: More Tasks Won't (Always) Fix An Agent Leaderboard](https://arxiv.org/abs/2610.00651)
*Michael Hardy,Ruhana Azam,Anka Reuel,Mykel Kochenderfer,Sanmi Koyejo*

Main category: cs.AI

TL;DR: 该论文提出贝叶斯方差分解框架，用于分析稀疏、不平衡的智能体排行榜，并应用于22个基准，揭示评测可靠性依赖声明类型：固定模型-脚手架系统排名可靠（0.935-0.994），但底层模型排名可靠性显著较低（0.148-0.841）。


<details>
  <summary>Details</summary>
Motivation: 智能体评测越来越多用于比较LLM并指导部署决策，但排名不仅反映模型本身，还受评测条件（如脚手架、任务）影响，导致可靠性依赖具体声明：一个能可靠排名部署系统的评测未必能可靠排名底层模型。作者因此追问当前智能体评测究竟能可靠支撑哪些结论，以及需要哪些额外评测来改进。

Method: 开发了一个贝叶斯方差分解框架，面向稀疏、不平衡的智能体排行榜，将信号（与目标声明相关的性能差异）与噪声（虽无关但仍可改变排名的变异）分离；并将其应用于Holistic Agent Leaderboard和Harbor Index中的22个基准。

Result: (1)可靠性取决于测量目标：固定模型-脚手架系统排名可靠（0.935-0.994），底层模型可靠性显著更低（0.148-0.841）。(2)脚手架选择可改变结论，脚手架间可靠性表明脚手架效应在各评测间差异显著。(3)增加任务无法解决所有不确定性：当不确定性主要来自有限的脚手架覆盖时，即使无限增加同类构造任务，基准的模型排名可靠性最多提升0.097。(4)池化多样基准能以更低成本改善跨任务排名：在相同任务预算下，池化基准可将预测可靠性从0.44提升到0.75，并最多降低83%的预测成本。

Conclusion: 评测设计应遵循预期声明：明确分数或排名应代表什么，诊断是什么限制了其可靠性，并将评测预算投向真正重要的不确定性来源。

Abstract: Agent evaluations are increasingly used to compare LLMs and inform deployment decisions, yet ranks can reflect not only the model but also the effects of the evaluation conditions such as the scaffolds or tasks. This makes reliability claim-dependent: an evaluation that reliably ranks deployed systems may not reliably rank underlying models. We ask which conclusions current agent evaluations reliably support and what additional evaluation would improve them. We develop a Bayesian variance-decomposition framework for sparse, imbalanced agent leaderboards and apply it to 22 benchmarks from the Holistic Agent Leaderboard and Harbor Index. The framework separates signal, performance differences relevant to the intended claim, from noise, irrelevant variation that can still change rankings. We find: (1) Reliability depends on the measurement goal. Fixed model-scaffold systems are ranked reliably (0.935-0.994), while underlying-model reliability is substantially lower (0.148-0.841). (2) Scaffold choice can change conclusions. Inter-scaffold reliability measures whether scaffolds preserve model rankings, showing that scaffold effects vary substantially across evaluations. (3) More tasks cannot resolve all uncertainty. Even infinitely many similarly constructed tasks improve model-ranking reliability of a benchmark by at most 0.097 when uncertainty is dominated by limited scaffold coverage. (4) Pooling diverse benchmarks can improve cross-task rankings at lower cost. For rankings across diverse agentic tasks, pooling benchmarks raises projected reliability from 0.44 to 0.75 at the same task budget and can reduce projected cost by up to 83\%. Evaluation design should follow the intended claim: identify what a score or ranking should mean, diagnose what limits its reliability, and spend evaluation budget on the sources of uncertainty that matter.

</details>


### [650] [When More Data Is Not Enough: The Context-Sufficiency Frontier in Generative AI Personalization](https://arxiv.org/abs/2610.00654)
*Merieme Askour,Ayoub Merimi*

Main category: cs.AI

TL;DR: 该文提出"上下文充分性"理论，区分客户证据与提供方上下文，指出在生成式AI个性化中上下文的相关性比数量更重要，并界定不足、充分、饱和与干扰四种状态，通过家具零售商的生成式推荐实验验证。


<details>
  <summary>Details</summary>
Motivation: 传统个性化依赖客户历史行为与偏好推断其价值。生成式AI使提供方能在响应生成时即时注入情境信息，无需预先编码所有条件。但这种便利带来新问题：上下文易于提供后，更多并不一定更好，亟需明确何种上下文才真正有效。

Method: 提出"上下文充分性"理论，明确客户证据与提供方侧上下文的区分，将上下文相关性置于数量之上；界定不足、充分、饱和、干扰四种状态，并引入"上下文充分性前沿"以定位最小相关集。在一家大型家居用品零售商开展全因子实验，使用生成式推荐系统进行验证。

Result: 相关上下文提升了推荐的适当性；不相关上下文降低适当性，并使检索过程不稳定。

Conclusion: 个性化应从"提供更多上下文"转向"识别当前交互真正需要什么"，并在整个服务流程中持续施加约束，以最小相关上下文实现充分性。

Abstract: Personalization has long relied on customer data to infer what an individual is likely to value. We call this customer evidence: the customer's historical behavior and preferences. Generative AI extends personalization by allowing providers to supply changing situational information at the moment a response is produced, without encoding every condition in advance. We define this provider-side context as information about what is possible, permitted, or advisable now. This flexibility creates a new problem: once context becomes easy to supply, more is not necessarily better. We develop a theory of context sufficiency in which the relevance of context to the customer's current intent matters more than its volume. The theory identifies four states, insufficiency, sufficiency, saturation, and interference, and introduces the Context-Sufficiency Frontier to locate the minimal relevant set. In a full-factorial experiment with a generative recommender at a large home-furnishing retailer, relevant context improved appropriateness, while irrelevant context reduced it and destabilized retrieval. The framework shifts personalization from supplying more context toward identifying what the current interaction actually requires and enforcing constraints throughout the service process.

</details>


### [651] [Backdoor Containment via Expert Quarantine and Shutdown in LLMs](https://arxiv.org/abs/2610.00663)
*Jianwei Li,Min-Seon Kim,Jung-Eun Kim*

Main category: cs.AI

TL;DR: 提出"学习但隔离"新范式，通过正则化引导的MoE结构将后门行为隔离到指定专家，部署时零化该专家路由权重即可将ASR从100%降至0-10%。


<details>
  <summary>Details</summary>
Motivation: 现有后门防御分为"抑制学习"（过滤数据/打断优化）和"先学后净化"（修复权重/门控输入）两类策略，各有局限。本文探索第三种策略："学习但隔离"——允许训练时形成后门，但将其路由至可部署时关闭的隔离组件。

Method: 提出QES（Quarantined Expert Shutdown），在正则化引导的类MoE设置中构建：为Transformer语言模型添加路由化的专家专属LoRA分支和轻量路由器，通过辅助路由目标将触发条件行为吸引到指定专家，同时在其他地方保留良性能力。部署时仅需零化隔离专家的路由权重（常数时间操作，无需触发器筛查或权重更新）。

Result: 在两个任务、三种攻击、四个模型族上，多数设置下将攻击成功率（ASR）从100%降至0-10%，同时下游效用通常保持不变或仅受轻微影响。

Conclusion: 结果确立了"学习但隔离"作为生成式LLM后门遏制的一个此前未探索的新范式。

Abstract: Backdoored large language models (LLMs) can behave normally on benign inputs while producing attacker-specified outputs under hidden triggers. Existing defenses span four stages--prior-training, in-training, post-training, and inference-time--and share one of two underlying strategies: either suppress backdoor learning (by filtering poisoned data or interrupting its acquisition during optimization) or learn, then purify (by repairing model weights or gating inputs after a fully backdoored model has formed). We propose a third strategy, learn, but channel: allow backdoor formation during training but route it into a designated, quarantined component that can be disabled at deployment. To this end, we propose Quarantined Expert Shutdown QES, a computationally efficient containment strategy built in a regularization-steered MoE-like setting. Specifically, given a poisoned dataset, QES augments a Transformer-based language model with routed expert-specific LoRA branches and lightweight routers, and uses auxiliary routing objectives to attract trigger-conditioned behavior into a designated expert while preserving benign capability elsewhere. At deployment, mitigation reduces to a single constant-time operation: zeroing the quarantined expert's routing weight, without trigger screening or further updating model weights. Empirically, our methods reduce the attack success rate ASR from 100% to 0-10% on most settings across two tasks, three attacks, and four model families, while downstream utility is often preserved or only modestly affected. These results establish learn, but channel as a previously unexplored regime for backdoor containment in generative LLMs.

</details>


### [652] [Ontology-Grounded, Reasoner-Verified Benchmarks for Evaluating LLM Reasoning in Scientific AI](https://arxiv.org/abs/2610.00682)
*Nishtha N. Vaidya,Stephan Grimm,Thomas Hubauer,Thomas A. Runkler*

Main category: cs.AI

TL;DR: 该论文提出一套自动化流水线，可从任意充分公理化的OWL 2本体生成多选题（MCQ）基准，正确答案由本体保证，干扰项通过对类定义公理右侧类表达式进行扰动并由OWL推理机形式化验证其错误性，在Pizza、PMDco和DOID三个本体上分别生成112、2491和15216道题，用于诊断式评估科学AI的逻辑推理能力。


<details>
  <summary>Details</summary>
Motivation: 大语言模型越来越多地支撑从生物医学问答到材料信息学的科学AI应用，其依赖结构化知识进行推理，但逻辑推理常存在不足，产生在这些场景中不可接受的事实错误。同时可靠评估困难：人工构建数据集难以规模化，而基于LLM的生成可能引入它本欲衡量的缺陷。高质量基准须将正确与错误标注示例均建立在明确背景知识之上，并可由标准推理机形式化验证。

Method: 提出自动化流水线，从任意充分公理化的OWL 2本体生成本体基础的多选题基准，正确答案由设计保证本体可推导。干扰项通过扰动类定义公理的右侧类表达式生成，其错误性由OWL推理机通过蕴含检查进行形式化验证。干扰项涵盖从类不可满足到弱化包含关系的四类语义类别，支持对特定推理失败的诊断式评估。在Pizza（小型学术）、PMDco（复杂材料科学）、DOID（大型生物医学）三个本体上评估。

Result: 分别在三个本体上生成112、2491和15216道多选题。题目达到自然语言质量标准：LLM评审平均得分分别为4.02、4.36和3.36（满分5），确认流畅性；正确答案与干扰项相似度高于0.8，表明错误选项无法仅凭表面形式排除。六个LLM零样本评估准确率为41.1%–76.8%，远高于25%随机猜测基线，表明基准具有挑战性和区分度。

Conclusion: 该工作是迈向更可靠基准的一步，用于评估科学AI中的逻辑推理能力，通过本体基础与形式化验证兼顾可扩展性与标注可靠性。

Abstract: Large language models (LLMs) increasingly underpin scientific AI applications that reason over structured knowledge, from biomedical question answering to materials informatics. However, their logical reasoning often falls short, producing factual inaccuracies unacceptable in these settings. Reliable evaluation remains challenging: manual dataset construction scales poorly, and LLM-based generation risks embedding the very flaws it aims to measure. High-quality benchmarks must ground both correct and incorrect labelled examples in explicit background knowledge, formally verifiable by a standard reasoner. We propose a pipeline that automatically generates ontology-grounded multiple-choice question (MCQ) benchmarks from any sufficiently axiomatised OWL 2 ontology, with correct answers grounded in the ontology by design. Distractors are generated by perturbing the right-hand-side class expressions of class definition axioms, and their incorrectness is formally verified by an OWL reasoner via entailment checks. We evaluate the pipeline on three ontologies: Pizza (small, academic), PMDco (complex, materials science), and DOID (large, biomedical), generating 112, 2,491, and 15,216 MCQs respectively. Distractors span four semantic categories from class unsatisfiability to weakened subsumptions, enabling diagnostic evaluation of specific reasoning failures. Items meet natural language quality standards: mean LLM judge scores of 4.02, 4.36, and 3.36 out of 5 confirm fluency, and correct-answer-to-distractor similarity above 0.8 shows that wrong options cannot be dismissed on surface form alone. Six LLMs evaluated zero-shot achieve 41.1-76.8% accuracy, well above the 25% random-guessing baseline, indicating the benchmarks are challenging and discriminative. This work is a step towards more reliable benchmarks for assessing logical reasoning in scientific AI.

</details>


### [653] [Backdoor Purification for LoRA-Tuned LLMs via Null-Space Projection](https://arxiv.org/abs/2610.00685)
*Jianwei Li,Jung-Eun Kim*

Main category: cs.AI

TL;DR: 该论文提出一种无需触发器先验、无需干净参考、无需事后重训练的LoRA后门净化方法：通过数据整理与特征近似提取后门方向，在输入/输出通道构造正交零空间并投影LoRA更新，将ASR从近100%降至10%以下，同时保留基座模型通用能力与适配器下游能力。


<details>
  <summary>Details</summary>
Motivation: LLM与PEFT（如LoRA）广泛部署后，后门攻击风险加剧；现有净化方法依赖触发器先验、干净参考数据或激进重训练等强假设，且评估不充分，实际适用性受限。

Method: 在无上述假设、且不对可疑参数做事后重训练的前提下进行净化。通过消融研究，将方法从文本分类的单层逐步扩展到生成任务的全参数LLM；借助精心数据整理与特征近似提取高保真后门方向，针对每层或每个注意力头在输入与输出通道构造正交零空间，并将LoRA更新投影到该零空间上。

Result: 实证显示，零空间投影方法将攻击成功率从接近100%降低至不足10%，同时保持基座模型的良性性能与适配器在下游任务中习得的能力。

Conclusion: 该工作表明可在不依赖强假设、不进行事后重训练的情况下有效净化LoRA微调后的LLM后门，兼顾安全性与效用，具备较强实用价值。

Abstract: With the rapid adoption of large language models (LLMs) and parameter-efficient fine-tuning (PEFT) methods, the risk of backdoor attacks has become more severe. Existing backdoor purification methods typically rely on at least one of the strong assumptions, such as prior knowledge of triggers, access to clean references, or aggressive retraining, and they often lack comprehensive evaluations. These constraints substantially limit their practical applicability. To overcome these challenges, our work proposes purifying LoRA-tuned LLMs without these assumptions and even without post-hoc retraining of the suspect parameters. Our objective is to significantly reduce the attack success rates (ASR) while preserving both (i) the base model's general capabilities and (ii) the new downstream skills learned through the adapter. Through a series of ablation studies, we progressively scale our approach from a single layer in a text classification setting to a full-parameter LLM in the generative task. Through careful data curation and feature approximation, we extract high-fidelity backdoor directions and, for each layer or head, construct orthogonal null spaces in both the input and output channels, onto which the LoRA updates are projected. Empirically, our null-space projection method reduces the ASR from nearly 100% to less than 10%, while preserving the base model's benign performance and the adapter's learned abilities during downstream task adaptation.

</details>


### [654] [R-GroundBench: A Diagnostic Benchmark for R-Group Groundingin Markush Molecular Editing](https://arxiv.org/abs/2610.00700)
*Xin Wang,Zichuan Ying,Xinna Lin,Junqi Zhang,Hanyi Xiong,Tianyu Gao,Hairong Zhang,Qixiang Hua,Botian Shi,Zhenhailong Wang,Kaicheng Yu*

Main category: cs.AI

TL;DR: 提出 R-GroundBench，一个基于真实专利 Markush 结构的诊断基准，用于评估模型对含可变 R 基团（R₁、R₂、X 等）的分子家族在多模态、化学与文本间的“grounding”能力，揭示现有模型在识别与分子接地之间存在显著差距。


<details>
  <summary>Details</summary>
Motivation: 现有 molecule-language 基准聚焦于完全指定结构的分子，未对 Markush 结构中 R 基团的接地问题进行评价；而 Markush 结构在制药专利中普遍存在，其分子、文本与化学信息交叉的特点使得推理与设计能力难以被现有基准衡量，因此需要专门的诊断基准。

Method: 构建 R-GroundBench：从真实专利 Markush 结构出发，包含带可控难度与模态划分的多选题（VQA）赛道，以及开放式生成（Generation）赛道，用于诊断模型在 R 基团识别与分子接地上的表现。

Result: 模型在 Easy VQA 上准确率超过 90%，但在控制捷径条件下 Hard VQA 降至 56–66%；化学领域 VLM 即便经过领域预训练，在 Hard VQA 上仍仅达 25.7–46.2%；生成任务中多数模型 Exact Match 低于 20%，当需要视觉输入时低于 8%。

Conclusion: 当前 AI 系统在 Markush 编辑任务上缺乏可靠的 grounding 与执行能力，识别与分子接地之间存在显著鸿沟，为 AI 驱动的科学发现提出了关键挑战。

Abstract: Recent advances in AI for scientific discovery enable molecular understandingand design, yet reasoning over incomplete chemical representations remainsunclear.Markush structures, which encode molecular families through variable R-groupplaceholders (\textit{R\textsubscript{1}}, \textit{R\textsubscript{2}}, \textit{X}, etc.), are ubiquitous in pharmaceutical patents and requiregrounding across molecular, textual, and chemical information.However, existing molecule-language benchmarks focus on fully specifiedmolecules, leaving R-group grounding largely unevaluated.We introduce R-GroundBench:, a diagnostic benchmark built from real patent Markushstructures, featuring a Multiple-Choice (VQA) track with controlled difficultyand modality splits, and an open-ended Generation track.Our results reveal a substantial gap between recognition andmolecular grounding.While models achieve over 90\% accuracy on Easy VQA, performance drops to56--66\% on Hard VQA when shortcuts are controlled.Chemical-domain VLMs also remain unreliable, achieving only 25.7--46.2\% on HardVQA despite domain-specific pretraining.Moreover, Generation Exact Match remains below 20\% for most models and below8\% when visual input is required.These findings reveal that current AI systems lack reliable grounding andexecution for Markush editing, highlighting challenges for AI-drivenscientific discovery.

</details>


### [655] [Beyond Answer Confidence: A Controlled Audit of Self-Knowledge in a Black-Box Decision Model](https://arxiv.org/abs/2610.01006)
*Sharath M Shankaranarayana,Davor Runje,Jan Jannink*

Main category: cs.AI

TL;DR: 该论文审计决策模型Jev中"答案置信度"与"是否掌握知识"的区别。Jev在熟悉的闭式任务上校准良好，但作为"缺失知识"指标失效，需要显式控制表面线索。


<details>
  <summary>Details</summary>
Motivation: 决策模型（用于路由、弃权、自动行动）输出的概率经校准后可平均意义上有效，但校准无法确立：低置信度究竟反映随机性或信息缺失，以及模型越过知识边界时置信度是否下降。作者据此动机，研究置信度能否作为"知识缺失"的有效指标。

Method: 以决策模型Jev为对象，使用15个以上公开数据集和6类生成任务族，采用配对干预（对同一固定条目改变所提供的信息），并对比"答案置信度"与专门设计的yes/no问题（例如结果是否已定、证据是否充分、模型是否知道答案）等探针，涵盖超知识边界的新闻、虚构实体等场景。

Result: Jev的置信度在熟悉的闭式选择任务上已校准，但作为缺失知识指标失败：无答案相关信息时对显著选项给出高达0.80的概率；在超出已观察知识边界的新闻上，置信度超出准确率0.21--0.33，且用早期月份数据重校准无法消除该差距。针对性yes/no问题读出更锐利：结果是否已定AUROC 1.00，证据是否充分0.95（同条目上置信度为0.85）。"Jev是否知道答案"可标记虚构实体与边界后新闻（0.91），但换成真实姓名或去掉日期后不再优于答案不确定性。

Conclusion: 黑箱知识审计必须对表面线索设置显式控制；单纯校准或答案置信度不能可靠区分"不知道"与"随机猜测"。

Abstract: Decision models return probabilities intended for routing, abstention and automated action. Calibration makes those probabilities useful on average, but does not establish whether low confidence reflects chance or missing knowledge, nor whether confidence falls when a model moves beyond what it knows. We audit this distinction in Jev, a decision model, with over 15 public datasets and 6 generated task families, with paired interventions that vary the information supplied for a fixed item. Jev's confidence is calibrated on familiar closed-choice tasks but fails as an indicator of missing knowledge: with no answer-relevant information it assigns up to 0.80 to a salient option, and on news beyond an observed knowledge boundary it exceeds accuracy by 0.21--0.33, a gap that recalibration on earlier months does not close. Targeted yes/no questions give sharper readouts of the case: whether an outcome is settled (AUROC 1.00) and whether the evidence suffices (0.95, against 0.85 for confidence on the same items). Asking whether Jev knows the answer appears to flag fabricated entities and post-boundary news (0.91), but with realistic names or with dates removed it shows no advantage over answer uncertainty. Black-box knowledge audits therefore need explicit controls for surface cues. Code: https://github.com/Syntheme/beyond-answer-confidence.

</details>


### [656] [Grounding Large Language Models in DSGE Simulators for Policy Generation and Forecasting](https://arxiv.org/abs/2610.01128)
*Aditya Dubey,Namah Gupta,Vinti Agarwal*

Main category: cs.AI

TL;DR: 将指令微调的语言模型置于六个 Snowdrop 支持的 DSGE 模拟器中，检验其政策行动是否符合经济动态：PPO 为主方法，GRPO 为无评论家的匹配基线，考察长时程信用分配、语义方向信号、奖励时域、轨迹热启动、跨模拟器迁移及历史锚定的冲击场景。


<details>
  <summary>Details</summary>
Motivation: 大语言模型能给出听起来合理的经济政策回应，但这并不证明其行动与经济动态一致；需要以模拟经济后果而非语言合理性来评判政策行动。

Method: 构建统一 Python 接口支持重复 rollout、持续冲击、状态克隆与滚动时域模拟；模型每轮观察经济状态与经济论述变化，选择有界政策动作并获得下一状态与经济奖励；采用 PPO（学习价值函数，通过广义优势估计将延迟奖励回传至早期 token）作为主方法，GRPO（无学习价值函数，使用完整 rollout 回报的分组相对优势）作为匹配的无评论家基线。

Result: 长时程信用分配问题突出：政策效应可能在行动后数季度才显现，GRPO 无法区分是哪个早期轮次导致结果，若所有 rollout 回报相同则归一化优势为零；实验还测试了方向性语义信号、奖励时域、轨迹热启动、跨模拟器迁移以及历史锚定的疫情与货币政策冲击。

Conclusion: 应以模拟经济后果而非仅凭貌似合理的语言来评判政策行动，PPO 在延迟奖励传播上更适合该长时程设定，GRPO 作为对照揭示了无价值函数方法在信用分配上的固有局限。

Abstract: Large language models can produce economic policy responses that sound reasonable, but this does not show that their actions are consistent with economic dynamics. We test this by placing an instruction-tuned language model inside six Snowdrop-backed dynamic stochastic general equilibrium (DSGE) simulators. At each turn, the model observes the economy and a change in economic discourse, selects a bounded policy action, and receives the next simulated state and an economic reward. We implement a common Python interface for repeated rollouts, persistent shocks, state cloning, and rolling-horizon simulation.
  This setting creates a long-horizon credit-assignment problem. Policy effects may appear several quarters after an action is taken. PPO has a learned value function that can propagate delayed reward to earlier tokens through generalized advantage estimation. GRPO has no learned value function and instead assigns a group-relative advantage from complete rollout returns. It therefore cannot distinguish which earlier turn caused the outcome; if every rollout receives the same return, the normalized advantage is zero. We use PPO as the primary method and GRPO as a matched critic-free baseline. The experiments also test directional semantic signals, reward horizon, trajectory warm starts, cross-simulator transfer, and historically anchored pandemic and monetary-policy shocks. The objective is to judge policy actions by their simulated economic consequences rather than by plausible language alone.

</details>


### [657] [Verify Claims, Not Scores: Evidence-Based Verification of Modular Agents](https://arxiv.org/abs/2610.01348)
*Ali Atiah Alzahrani*

Main category: cs.AI

TL;DR: 提出一种针对模块化智能体的"按论断验证审计"协议：不评分智能体，而评分其证据——将每个结论连同支撑证据、四种判定（有支撑/无支撑/未解决/未评估）及成立边界一起记录；以Oracle策略、逐组件完美替换、验证器校准测试三件工具产出证据，并在带隐藏区制的合成市场组合配置智能体上演示。


<details>
  <summary>Details</summary>
Motivation: 开发者通常以聚合任务分数判断对智能体某组件（控制器、学习模型或验证器）的修改，但该分数无法说明改进是否本可达成、哪个组件损失了价值、以及智能体自身检查认证了什么，需要更细粒度的证据性评估。

Method: 面向"规划—行动—检查—精化"的模块化智能体，采用按论断验证审计而非打分，结论附带证据、四类判定与成立边界。三件工具：1）Oracle策略在明确给定动作集下度量可达改进，使低分可归因于评估而非环境；2）逐次用完美对应组件替换单一组件以定位价值损失，当下游组件可能掩盖时以null结果记为"未解决"；3）独立检验验证器分数是否确实界定了其所被解读为界定的量。

Result: 在带已知隐藏区制的合成市场中，对受限组合配置智能体的审计显示：完美区制信息的价值取决于测量所用的动作集；情景生成器丢弃了大部分区制信号，而更高的局部保真度并未改进决策；运行时验证器可被绕过而结果无可见变化。

Conclusion: 主要贡献是该协议及其强制的证据性区分；实证发现仅特定于所研究的智能体与环境，不具普遍性。

Abstract: When developers change one component of an agent, such as its controller, a learned model or its verifier, they usually judge the change by an aggregate task score. That score cannot tell whether improvement was attainable, which component lost value, or what the agent's own checks certify. We introduce a claim-specific verification audit for modular agents that plan, act, check and refine. Instead of scoring the agent, the audit scores the evidence: each conclusion is recorded with the evidence behind it, one of four verdicts (supported, unsupported, unresolved or not evaluated) and the boundary within which it holds. Three tools supply that evidence. Oracle policies measure attainable improvement under an explicitly stated action set, so that a low value can be traced to the evaluation rather than to the environment. Replacing one component at a time with a perfect counterpart locates lost value, with null results read as unresolved whenever a downstream component could mask them. A separate test asks whether the verifier's score identifies the quantity it is read as bounding. Applied to a constrained portfolio-allocation agent in a synthetic market with known hidden regimes, the audit shows that the value of perfect regime information depends on the action set used to measure it, that the scenario generator discards most of the regime signal while better local fidelity does not improve decisions, and that the runtime verifier can be bypassed with no visible change in outcomes. The contribution is the protocol and the evidential distinctions it enforces; the empirical findings are specific to the agent and environment studied.

</details>


### [658] [OpenMTB-Audit: Exposing Over-Refusal and Clinical Expert Perspectives in LLM-Based Molecular Tumor Board Safety Evaluation](https://arxiv.org/abs/2610.01497)
*Negin Ashrafi,Jia Luo,Stacey M. Frumm,Roxana Daneshjou*

Main category: cs.AI

TL;DR: 提出开源基准OpenMTB-Audit与确定性七模块框架MTB-AuditAgent，解决大模型在分子肿瘤委员会中过度拒答、标签坍缩问题，将过度拒答降至6.7%、准确率达91.2%。


<details>
  <summary>Details</summary>
Motivation: 分子肿瘤委员会（MTB）需整合基因组、临床与治疗证据以支持精准肿瘤学。随着AI进入该流程，关键安全挑战在于区分真正无证据支持的推荐与"有证据支持但因信息不全、ECOG体能状态差等临床保留条件仍需肿瘤科医生复核的选项"。现有大模型可能通过标签坍缩获得表面安全分数，而非临床校准的推理。

Method: 构建OpenMTB-Audit：包含500例合成非小细胞肺癌病例的开源基准，涵盖5类对抗性错误类别与4种安全标签（Supported、Partially Supported、Unsupported、Insufficient Information）。评估8种大语言模型配置。进而开发MTB-AuditAgent：确定性七模块框架，将证据核验、缺失信息检测、安全分类与弃答（abstention）相分离。另开展双肿瘤科医生标注研究。

Result: 所有LLM配置在83.3%-100%的真实Partially Supported病例中未能保留该标签，出现普遍性过度拒答，以标签坍缩换取高总体安全分数。MTB-AuditAgent将过度拒答降至6.7%，准确率达91.2%（95% CI: 88.6-93.6%）。双医生标注分歧集中于信息充分性与治疗优化之间的边界。

Conclusion: 仅以聚合安全分数评估LLM在MTB场景中的安全性会产生误导，需保留临床上有意义的标签区分。确定性、模块化的证据核验与弃答分离设计可有效缓解过度拒答，提升临床校准度。

Abstract: Molecular tumor boards integrate genomic findings, clinical context, and therapeutic evidence to support precision oncology. As AI enters this workflow, a key safety challenge is distinguishing truly unsupported recommendations from evidence-supported options that still require oncologist review because of incomplete information, poor ECOG performance status, or other clinical caveats. We introduce OpenMTB-Audit, an open-source benchmark of 500 synthetic non-small cell lung cancer cases spanning five adversarial error categories and four safety labels: Supported, Partially Supported, Unsupported, and Insufficient Information. Across eight large language model configurations, we identify pervasive over-refusal: all LLM configurations failed to retain the Partially Supported label in 83.3-100% of true Partially Supported cases, achieving high aggregate safety scores through label collapse rather than clinically calibrated reasoning. To address this limitation, we developed MTB-AuditAgent, a deterministic seven-module framework separating evidence verification, missing-information detection, safety classification, and abstention. It reduces over-refusal to 6.7% and achieves 91.2% accuracy (95% CI: 88.6-93.6%). A two-oncologist annotation study found disagreement concentrated at the boundary between information sufficiency and treatment optimization, underscoring the need to preserve clinically meaningful distinctions.

</details>


### [659] [Sharpening Tax in Post-Training](https://arxiv.org/abs/2610.01509)
*Changdae Oh,Qi Zeng,Qi Qi,Andrey Zhmoginov,Deren Lei,Yun He,Hoang Phan,Hangoo Kang,Azalia Mirhoseini,Sharon Li*

Main category: cs.AI

TL;DR: 预训练LLM配合轻量推理框架即可作为有能力的智能体，其在重复采样（pass@K）上的解题覆盖率常优于RL后训练模型；后训练将任务推向"恒解/恒不解"两极，提升采样效率却损失覆盖范围。作者提出"锐化税"指标量化该损失，并提出PTGS贝叶斯采样器以缓解该问题。


<details>
  <summary>Details</summary>
Motivation: 已有假设认为RL后训练仅"锐化"基础模型已有行为，以牺牲解覆盖率为代价换取单次准确率。但该权衡主要在数学与编程任务中观察，未必适用于需要多轮工具使用与交互的智能体任务——后者可能需要后训练阶段新获得的能力。

Method: 1) 对比预训练模型（配轻量推理框架）与后训练模型在pass@1与pass@K上的表现差异；2) 机制分析：考察后训练如何将任务分布推向"总是解出"或"永不解决"的两极；3) 提出诊断指标"Sharpening Tax"（锐化税），量化后训练造成的测试时可扩展性损失，并在4个模型家族、14对基础/后训练模型、3个智能体基准（共42例）上验证，考察其可估计性与相关性；4) 提出posterior-tempered group sampling（PTGS），一种即插即用的贝叶斯采样器，按估计难度自适应调整每个prompt的采样温度，在两个智能体环境的RL训练中验证。

Result: 预训练模型尽管pass@1远低，但在给定充足测试时预算下，pass@K常超越其后训练对应模型。锐化税在42例中的大多数设置普遍存在，可由少量rollout估计，并与其他指标良好相关。PTGS相较固定温度基线缴纳的锐化税更小，在重复采样下解决更多任务，同时提升单次准确率。

Conclusion: RL后训练在智能体任务中并非单纯获取新能力，而更多是锐化既有行为：提升采样效率与一致性却牺牲解覆盖率。预训练模型的覆盖优势可被测试时采样预算释放；"锐化税"为量化该代价提供了简洁诊断工具，PTGS则表明通过自适应温度采样可在训练中兼顾覆盖与单次精度，缓解该权衡。

Abstract: An emerging hypothesis about reinforcement learning (RL) post-training of large language models (LLMs) is that it merely sharpens existing behaviors of a base model, improving single-shot accuracy at the cost of solution coverage. Although this trade-off has been observed in math and coding tasks, it need not extend to agentic tasks, where multi-turn tool use and interaction may require capabilities newly acquired during post-training. Our surprising finding is that pre-trained LLMs, equipped with a light inference harness, can serve as capable agents. Despite far lower accuracy (pass@1), they often surpass their post-trained counterparts in solution coverage (pass@K) given a sufficient test-time budget. We further analyze the underlying mechanism and show that post-training pushes tasks toward two extremes, always solved or never solved, and thereby improves sampling efficiency and consistency at the cost of solution coverage. To measure this cost, we propose Sharpening Tax, a diagnostic metric that quantifies the loss in test-time scalability after post-training. Across 14 base/post-trained model pairs from four families and three agentic benchmarks (42 cases in total), the tax is prevalent in most settings, can be estimated from a few rollouts, and correlates well with other metrics. Finally, we present posterior-tempered group sampling (PTGS), a simple plug-and-play Bayesian sampler that adapts the sampling temperature per prompt to its estimated difficulty. Applied during RL training in two agentic environments, PTGS pays a smaller tax than the fixed-temperature baseline, solving more tasks under repeated sampling while also improving single-shot accuracy.

</details>


### [660] [Decision Titan: Test-Time Training for Long-Term Memory in Offline Reinforcement Learning](https://arxiv.org/abs/2610.01513)
*Jude Waide,Robert Lieck*

Main category: cs.AI

TL;DR: 本文将TTT（测试时训练）框架引入离线强化学习，提出Decision Titan模型，在X-Maze环境中验证其长程依赖建模能力，并可视化门控值以分析记忆机制。


<details>
  <summary>Details</summary>
