Motivation: 序贯决策中的长期依赖仍是难题：RNN受梯度消失与向量隐状态表达力限制，Transformer受注意力二次复杂度制约。TTT框架通过在训练与测试时用梯度下降将情节记忆存入网络参数，已在NLP取得成功，但尚未应用于强化学习，也缺乏对其记忆机制的实证分析。

Method: 在Decision Transformer中引入TTT层构建Decision Titan，用于离线RL；在T-Maze扩展环境X-Maze（专门测试序贯记忆）上评估性能与特性；通过可视化门控值随时间的变化，探究记忆机制的学习过程。

Result: Decision Titan能学习到比上下文窗口长20倍范围的长程依赖；可泛化至训练数据1.7倍的长度；但时间泛化能力依赖于所采用的时间嵌入（time embeddings）；学习长程依赖的能力取决于相关信息如何被编码。

Conclusion: TTT框架在离线RL中具有潜力，可显著扩展有效记忆跨度并具一定长度外推能力；但时间嵌入设计与信息编码方式是其长程建模与时间泛化的关键决定因素。

Abstract: Long-term dependencies remain a major challenge for sequential decision-making in the field of AI: RNNs suffer from vanishing gradients and the limited expressivity of vector-based hidden states, whilst Transformer-based models are limited by the quadratic scaling of attention. Recent work has proposed tackling this problem with the Test-Time Training (TTT) framework, which stores episodic memories in the parameters of a neural network through gradient descent at both train and test-time. This approach has seen success in the domain of Natural Language Processing, however, to the best of our knowledge it has not yet been applied to the domain of Reinforcement Learning (RL), nor has there been a study analysing how this memory practically functions. In this paper, we study the potential of the TTT framework for offline RL by augmenting a Decision Transformer with TTT layers, dubbed the Decision Titan. We analyse performance and properties of the model in the X-Maze environment, an extension of T-Maze designed to test sequential memory, and investigate how the memory mechanism learns by visualising gate values over time. Our key findings are that Decision Titan can learn long-term dependencies with ranges 20x longer than the context window, generalises to lengths 1.7x the training data, but crucially temporal generalisation depends on the time embeddings used, and the ability to learn long-term dependencies depends on how the relevant information is encoded.

</details>


### [661] [Q-Learning for Reachability in MEC-Free MDPs](https://arxiv.org/abs/2610.01781)
*Lu-Chin Chang,Suguman Bansal*

Main category: cs.AI

TL;DR: Quasar：首个针对无终止极大端分量（非终止MEC）片段的免模型可达性强化学习算法，具备渐近最优性保证。


<details>
  <summary>Details</summary>
Motivation: 可达性规格的强化学习是序列决策的基础。已有工作虽证明了最优策略的渐近收敛，但仅限基于模型的方法，需要显式估计底层MDP的转移概率，导致内存与样本开销巨大，阻碍实际部署。

Method: 采用经典Q-learning框架，通过时序差分（TD）更新直接从样本学习最优策略，无需估计转移概率。理论分析限定在无非终止极大端分量（MEC）的MDP片段上，该片段可作为通用MDP经标准MEC商约简后的构建模块。

Result: 内存占用由基于模型方法的O(|S|²|A|)降至O(|S||A|)；在标准定量验证基准集（Quantitative Verification Benchmark Set）上，收敛到最优策略所需样本数比此前基于模型的最优方法少若干个数量级。

Conclusion: Quasar是迈向可达性学习及规格引导强化学习实际部署的具体进展。

Abstract: Reinforcement learning (RL) for reachability specifications is fundamental to sequential decision-making. Prior work establishes asymptotic convergence to optimal policies, but only through model-based methods that must explicitly estimate the transition probabilities of the underlying Markov Decision Process (MDP). We present Quasar, the first model-free algorithm with asymptotic guarantees for reachability on the fragment of MDPs free of non-terminal maximal end components (MECs), a building block to which every MDP reduces by the standard MEC quotient. Our algorithm follows the classical Q-learning approach, using temporal-difference updates to converge to an optimal policy without ever learning the transition probabilities. The resulting learner reduces the memory footprint from the O(|S|^2|A|) that model-based methods require to O(|S||A|). On the standardized Quantitative Verification Benchmark Set, our algorithm converges to the optimal policy with orders of magnitude fewer samples than the previous model-based state-of-the-art. Together these results are a concrete step toward the practical deployment of reachability learning and, with it, of specification-guided RL.

</details>


### [662] [Code Owns the Simulation, Jev Owns the Evaluation](https://arxiv.org/abs/2610.01834)
*Yaodong Yang,Hongyao Tang,Yi Ma,Xingyu Fan,Weixun Wang,Jinpeng Li,Tianpei Yang*

Main category: cs.AI

TL;DR: 本文发现Judgment模型（如JEV）在单一调用、无推理文本条件下，能可靠完成"评估"决策，但在需要"模拟"（预测输入未给出的信息）时失败；若由代码提供模拟，JEV即可成为专家级控制器。


<details>
  <summary>Details</summary>
Motivation: Judgment模型单次调用即可对每个选项输出概率，适合作为智能体的动作选择层，但其可信决策范围不明，需系统界定其能力边界。

Method: 在反思测试（Cognitive Reflection Test）、单次矩阵博弈、文本游戏ALFWorld与机器人控制四类任务上测试JEV，对比"评估"与"模拟"两类需求下的表现，并测试将模拟交由代码完成后的效果。

Result: JEV解决99%反直觉的CRT问题；但在博弈中因对手动作未给出而表现次优，在ALFWorld中偏好提及任务描述中物体/地点的指令（如未洗刀直接放入抽屉）；然而单独询问对手动作时它常能正确回答，说明失败并非知识缺失，而是单次调用须同时完成模拟与评估。

Conclusion: 应让代码承担预测或模拟，JEV专注于基于给定信息的评估：当ALFWorld的lookahead与机器人控制的物理模拟由代码提供时，JEV凭借通用评估能力成为专家级控制器。

Abstract: Judgment models such as \jev{} return, in a single call and without reasoning text, a probability for each described option. This makes them attractive as an agent's action-selection layer, but it is unclear which decisions they can be trusted with. We test \jev{} on reflection tests, one-shot matrix games, the text game ALFWorld and robot control, and find a sharp boundary. \jev{} succeeds when the right option can be judged from what the input describes, which we call \emph{evaluation}. Specifically, it solves 99\% of the counterintuitive Cognitive Reflection Test questions. However, it fails when the right option depends on \emph{simulation} (i.e., predicting something not in the input), such as the opponent's action or the subgoal that must come first. In games, \jev{} plays suboptimally as if its rational opponent acted at random, because the opponent's action is not given. In ALFWorld, \jev{} favors commands that mention an object or place named in the task description. For example, given the task ``put a clean knife in the drawer'', \jev{} carries an unwashed knife straight to the drawer instead of first washing it at the sink. Surprisingly, many of these failures are not due to a lack of knowledge. Asked separately what the opponent will do, \jev{} usually answers correctly, and it responds well given the opponent's action. It fails when one call must both perform the simulation and evaluate based on it. This suggests letting code make the prediction or simulation. When code supplies it, such as a lookahead in ALFWorld and physics simulation in robot control, \jev{} becomes an expert controller through its general evaluation ability.

</details>


### [663] [Heavy-Tailed Memory Traces in Long-Horizon Language Agents](https://arxiv.org/abs/2610.00010)
*Xinyuan Song,Zekun Cai*

Main category: cs.AI

TL;DR: 论文提出"记忆使用形态"这一被忽视的评估维度，通过尾部审计发现记忆检索呈重尾分布，并提出基于秩的记忆控制器 CTWM，在保持覆盖率的同时降低提示词开销与尾部预测误差。


<details>
  <summary>Details</summary>
Motivation: 长时程语言智能体日益依赖外部记忆作为"冻结的世界模型"，但现有记忆系统仅以任务成功率或 token 成本作为评价指标。作者认为缺失的关键对象是"记忆使用的形态"：在有限上下文与重复检索下，记忆会集中于一个小核心，而稀有状态留在长尾中，导致预测误差在尾部累积。

Method: 首先进行保守的尾部审计（tail audit），考察不同策略下检索痕迹的分布形态；随后提出 Core–Tail World Model（CTWM），一种基于秩（rank-based）的记忆控制器，用单一指数 τ 分配提示预算，并对尾部进行摘要式保留。

Result: 审计发现集中效应可复现但依赖策略：随机游走智能体产生符合对数正态分布的检索痕迹，语义 LLM 策略则产生最符合截断幂律的核心–尾部形态。在 Synthetic Graph World 上，CTWM 保持完整的状态与转移覆盖，提示 token 减少 5.9%，下半部分尾部预测误差相对图记忆基线降低 13.6%；在 ALFWorld 上配对比较得到一致的 token 节省，在 LongMemEval 上 token 减少 24.48% 且总体准确率持平。

Conclusion: 重尾记忆痕迹不仅是有限检索条件下的一种诊断指标，也可作为 token 高效智能体世界模型的实用控制信号。

Abstract: Long-horizon language agents increasingly rely on external memory as a frozen world model, yet current memory systems are usually judged only by task success or token cost. We argue that the missing object is the shape of memory use: under finite context and repeated retrieval, agent memory can concentrate on a small core while leaving rare states in a long tail where prediction errors accumulate. We study this effect through a conservative tail audit and find that concentration is reproducible but policy-dependent. Random-walk agents produce log-normal-compatible retrieval artifacts, whereas semantic LLM policies yield the strongest truncated-power-law-compatible core--tail traces. Motivated by this audit, we propose Core--Tail World Model (CTWM), a rank-based memory controller that allocates prompt budget with a single exponent $τ$ while retaining a summarized tail. On Synthetic Graph World, CTWM preserves full state and transition coverage, reduces prompt tokens by 5.9%, and lowers bottom-half tail prediction error by 13.6% relative to a graph-memory baseline. The same paired comparison gives consistent token savings on ALFWorld and a 24.48% token reduction on LongMemEval with aggregate accuracy parity. These results suggest that heavy-tailed memory traces are not only a diagnostic of finite retrieval, but also a practical control signal for token-efficient agent world models.

</details>


### [664] [When Do Causal World Models Help Modular LLM Agents](https://arxiv.org/abs/2610.00012)
*Xinyuan Song,Zekun Cai*

Main category: cs.AI

TL;DR: 论文提出 FedCausalCompose 因果世界模型框架，论证模块化 LLM 智能体需要干预响应证据而非观测轨迹，并给出因果结构有效的具体条件。


<details>
  <summary>Details</summary>
Motivation: 模块化 LLM 智能体（订单、支付、库存、物流等）中，一个模块的动作会改变另一模块的合法状态转移。标准世界模型多拟合观测轨迹，但规划所需的是干预响应量：观测序列只能显示"支付先于发货"，无法区分支付是否授权发货、库存是否中介效应、或有隐藏变量同时驱动两者。存在观测世界模型无法消除的干预误差。

Method: 提出 FedCausalCompose 框架，让局部动作提供跨模块接口的干预-响应证据。理论层面分析后门路径未阻断时的不可约干预误差、接口恢复与干预-响应覆盖度的关系，以及 oracle 因果组合在覆盖度与局部机制误差受控时优于非因果下界。随后在诊断性智能体环境中验证该预测。

Result: 因果接口在结构化工具环境中最有效，因 API 签名暴露前置条件与下游效应；在对话与叙事环境中，原始边列表常被忽略，除非有简短注意力锚点使因果信息与决策相关。接口恢复随干预-响应覆盖度提升；oracle 因果组合在误差受控时可突破非因果下界。

Conclusion: 因果世界模型在 LLM 智能体中有效的具体条件是：跨模块接口既统计可识别，又能在动作时以智能体可用的形式呈现。统计可识别但呈现形式不可用（如对话环境中的裸边列表）则收益消失。

Abstract: LLM agents increasingly act through modular systems, such as order, payment, inventory, and shipment services, where actions in one module change which transitions are valid in another. Standard world models usually fit observational traces, but this is not the quantity needed for intervention-time planning: a trace may show that payment precedes shipment without identifying whether payment authorizes shipment, inventory mediates the effect, or a hidden trigger explains both. We study this gap through FedCausalCompose, a causal world-model framework for modular LLM agents in which local actions provide intervention-response evidence for cross-module interfaces. We first show that observational world models incur an irreducible interventional error under unblocked back-door paths, that interface recovery improves with intervention-response coverage, and that an oracle causal composition can beat the non-causal lower bound when coverage and local mechanism errors are controlled. We then test the resulting prediction in diagnostic agent settings. Causal interfaces help most in structured tool environments, where API signatures expose preconditions and downstream effects. In contrast, dialogue and narrative environments often ignore raw edge lists unless a short attention anchor makes the causal information decision-relevant. These results identify a concrete condition for causal world models in LLM agents: causal structure helps when cross-module interfaces are both statistically identifiable and presented in a form the agent can use at action time.

</details>


### [665] [From Proposal to Verified Effect: Praxa, an Evidence-Bound Harness for Governed AI Agent Execution](https://arxiv.org/abs/2610.00015)
*Stefan G. Creadore*

Main category: cs.AI

TL;DR: 论文提出 Praxa——一个将"提议、授权、派发、经验证的外部效应、服务上线"显式区分并可测试的 agent harness，但其证据仅支持"证据绑定架构"这一贡献，未能确立安全性、生产性能或优越性。


<details>
  <summary>Details</summary>
Motivation: 大语言模型 agent 能够提议并执行动作，但"提议""授权""派发""经验证的外部效应""服务上线"是彼此不同的断言，常被混为一谈，导致 agent 的权限—效应转换缺乏显式、可审计、可测试的表示。

Method: Praxa 通过五类机制显式表达上述状态：确定性准入（deterministic admission）、代理执行（brokered execution）、外部回读（external read-back）、对账（reconciliation）、评审式上线（reviewed promotion）。作者以四条证据链评估：①固定 revision 的仓库内审计（单元测试、Workerd 测试、源码插桩、覆盖率下限）；②基于提供商后端的 Terminal-Bench Core 0.1.1 12 任务试点，对比 baseline 与 reliability-layer 双组；③调试后双顺序协调代理开发对比，baseline 与源码 authored candidate 各 180 次试验；④部署态源码/配置证据，覆盖有界反思、召回核算、记忆编译与工具健康路径。

Result: ①审计通过 1,027/1,027 单元测试、89/89 Workerd 测试，插桩全部 363 个预期源码文件并满足四项覆盖率下限，但原始逐测试记录与独立复现不可得；②Terminal-Bench 试点中 baseline 与 reliability-layer 各通过 17/36 严格试验，后者多消耗 37.49% 输入与 50.73% 输出 token，不支持优越性；③协调代理对比中双方均 180/180 完成、精度相同、具备完整 hermetic 崩溃恢复与零受保护违规，candidate 少用 37.11% token、33.84% 估计端点成本、11.63% 步数，但未证明质量、延迟或生产行为改善；④部署证据仅有机制性路径，无生产结果提升。

Conclusion: Praxa 可支持的贡献是一个证据绑定（evidence-bound）架构，使"授权到效应"的转换变得显式且可测试。现有证据尚不能确立对抗性安全、生产安全、通用专家优越性、自主递归优化或用户收益。

Abstract: Large-language-model agents can propose and execute actions, but proposal, authority, dispatch, verified external effect, and serving promotion are different claims. We present Praxa, an agent harness that represents these states explicitly through deterministic admission, brokered execution, external read-back, reconciliation, and reviewed promotion. We report four evidence lanes. First, an author-run repository-local audit at a pinned revision passed 1,027/1,027 unit tests and 89/89 Workerd tests, instrumented all 363 expected source files, and met four coverage floors; raw per-test transcripts and independent reproduction are unavailable. Second, in a provider-backed Terminal-Bench Core 0.1.1 pilot across 12 curated tasks, baseline and reliability-layer arms each passed 17/36 strict trials. The reliability layer used 37.49% more input and 50.73% more output tokens, so the pilot does not support superiority. Third, in a post-debug, two-order coordination-proxy development comparison, baseline and a source-authored candidate each completed 180/180 trials with equal measured accuracy, full hermetic crash recovery, and zero protected violations. The candidate used 37.11% fewer tokens, 33.84% lower estimated endpoint cost, and 11.63% fewer steps; this does not establish improved quality, latency, or production behavior. Fourth, deployed source/configuration evidence shows bounded reflection, recall accounting, memory compilation, and tool-health paths, but no production outcome lift. Praxa's supported contribution is an evidence-bound architecture that makes authority-to-effect transitions explicit and testable. Current evidence does not establish adversarial security, production safety, general specialist superiority, autonomous recursive optimization, or user benefit.

</details>


### [666] [Gradient-Aligned Pair Selection for Personalized Preference Optimization](https://arxiv.org/abs/2610.00061)
*Ruoming Jin,Xinyu Li,Hao Zhou,Jianfeng Zhu,Ruixin Guo,Feodor Dragan,Lei Xu,Haixun Wang,Yang Zhou*

Main category: cs.AI

TL;DR: 本文将个性化偏好学习形式化为几何对齐优化问题，提出 GAP-DPO，通过效用感知、几何对齐的偏好对选择并配合逐轮重生成控制分布偏移，在个性化文本生成基准上一致优于标准 DPO 变体。


<details>
  <summary>Details</summary>
Motivation: 个性化 LLM 需对齐用户特定偏好而非仅追求聚合质量。DPO 虽稳定，但其个性化效果关键取决于偏好对的选取方式；现有方法多用启发式准则（如基于似然的极值），使优化与显式用户效用脱耦，可能导致个性化性能退化。

Method: 作者通过分析期望用户效用梯度与 DPO 更新方向之间的一阶交互，将个性化偏好学习形式化为几何对齐优化问题。分析表明：在离策略采样下，当偏好边际与效用梯度方向对齐时，DPO 更新从纯误差纠正信号转变为类强化更新。据此提出 GAP-DPO，一种执行效用感知、几何对齐偏好对选择的迭代算法，并通过逐轮（epoch-wise）重生成控制分布偏移。

Result: 在个性化文本生成基准上，GAP-DPO 在风格保真度、偏好对齐和生成质量方面均持续优于标准 DPO 变体。

Conclusion: 结果确立梯度对齐为个性化偏好优化的统一原则，并表明偏好对选择是优化几何的内在组成部分，而非启发式预处理步骤。

Abstract: Personalizing large language models (LLMs) requires aligning generation behavior with user-specific preferences rather than aggregate quality. While Direct Preference Optimization (DPO) provides a stable framework for preference learning, its effectiveness in personalized settings critically depends on how preference pairs are selected. Existing approaches typically rely on heuristic criteria, such as likelihood-based extremes, which decouple optimization from explicit user utility and can lead to degraded personalization. We formalize personalized preference learning as a geometry-aligned optimization problem by analyzing the first-order interaction between gradients of expected user utility and DPO update directions. Our analysis reveals that, under off-policy sampling, the DPO update transitions from a purely error-corrective signal to a reinforcement-like update when preference margins are directionally aligned with utility gradients. This perspective exposes pair selection as a geometric decision that governs whether preference optimization advances or hinders personalization. Motivated by this insight, we propose GAP-DPO (Geometry-Aligned Preference DPO), an iterative algorithm that performs utility-aware, geometry-aligned pair selection while controlling distribution shift via epoch-wise regeneration. Experiments on personalized text generation benchmarks show that GAP-DPO consistently improves stylistic fidelity, preference alignment, and generation quality compared to standard DPO variants. Together, our results establish gradient alignment as a unifying principle for personalized preference optimization and demonstrate that pair selection is an intrinsic component of the optimization geometry rather than a heuristic preprocessing step.

</details>


### [667] [K-Dense BYOK: An Open-Source AI Research Assistant That Runs Locally and Keeps a Hash-Chained Lab Notebook](https://arxiv.org/abs/2610.00074)
*Aubrey M. Brueckner,Darshil Patel,Yuhuan He,Timothy Kassis*

Main category: cs.AI

TL;DR: K-Dense BYOK 是一款免费、开源、本地运行的科研 AI 助手，通过科学脚手架、Living Lab Notebook 与不可篡改的观测日志三项机制支撑研究，在二十个跨学科提示的预设评分标准下于科学质量与研究执行两方面领先两个托管平台。


<details>
  <summary>Details</summary>
Motivation: 通用聊天助手与通用编码智能体缺乏科研场景所需的科学程序库、结构化记录与环境可追溯性，且模型"过度声称"（overclaiming）是常见失效模式；同时研究者需要数据、代码与记录长期保存在自己可管理的机器上。

Method: 采用 BYOK 模式：研究者自带模型（托管或本地），应用提供运行环境、科学脚手架与完整记录；每个项目为普通文件夹。区别于聊天助手的三点：①内置书面科研流程库、引导式工作流模板、研究数据来源目录及审稿/写作角色；②Living Lab Notebook，条目相互链接构成论证，只增不删；③通过观测智能体行为而非采信其自述来记录过程，日志对智能体无写入工具。以二十个跨学科研究提示，在预先固定的评分标准下与两个托管平台对比。

Result: 在科学质量与研究执行两项指标上均领先两个托管平台；其交付物是唯一记录了所运行软件的，且通常附带可复现结果的命令；其中一个托管平台使用相同前沿模型却未提供这些内容。需注意这些环境记录是智能体写入的文件，而非观测日志的一部分，当前日志尚未捕获软件环境本身。

Conclusion: 通过在本地文件夹中组织数据、代码、结果与记录，并以不可由智能体写入的观测日志使主张可被核验而非直接阻止，K-Dense BYOK 在可比条件下展现出优于托管平台的科研质量与执行能力；代码以 MIT 许可证开源。未来需将软件环境本身纳入观测日志以补足可追溯性。

Abstract: K-Dense BYOK (bring your own keys) is a free, open-source AI research assistant for scientists in any field that runs on the researcher's own computer. The researcher supplies access to a model of their choice, hosted or running locally, and the application supplies everything else: a place for the work to run, a layer of scientific scaffolding, and a complete record. Each project is an ordinary folder, so the data, the code, the results, and the record stay on a machine the researcher administers and can be read years later without the application. Three things separate it from a chat assistant or a general-purpose coding agent. It ships a library of written scientific procedures, guided workflow templates, catalogs of where research data can be found, and reviewer and writer roles the agent can hand work to. It keeps a Living Lab Notebook whose entries link into an argument and are added to but never erased. And it records what happened by watching what the agent does rather than by taking the agent's word for it, in a log the agent has no tool that can write to. That choice targets the most common failure, model overclaiming, in our earlier benchmark of nine frontier models, by making claims checkable rather than preventing them. On twenty interdisciplinary research prompts, scored under a rubric fixed in advance, K-Dense BYOK led two managed platforms on both scientific quality and research execution. Its deliverables were the only ones that recorded the software they ran in, and the only ones that usually arrived with a command that regenerates the results. One of the managed platforms ran the same frontier model and supplied neither. Those environment records were files the agent wrote, not part of the observed log, which does not yet capture the software environment itself. The code is available under the MIT license at https://github.com/K-Dense-AI/k-dense-byok.

</details>


### [668] [EviGraph: Proof-Carrying Selective Recommendation over Temporal Public-Service Knowledge Graphs](https://arxiv.org/abs/2610.00212)
*Yixi Zhou,Sikun Wang,Lei Fan,Fan Zhang*

Main category: cs.AI

TL;DR: 论文提出 EviGraph 框架，区分决策的“关键要求”与可暂不解决的信息，通过语言智能体将关键要求关联到时序知识图谱中的证据，并由确定性检查器判定推荐是否受支持，从而在双语香港公共服务基准上减少不必要的弃答。


<details>
  <summary>Details</summary>
Motivation: 公共服务推荐需要与所请求的服务、范围和时间相匹配的证据，但若把每个缺失细节都视为决定性因素，就会过度保守地拒绝给出有用推荐，导致不必要的弃答。

Method: EviGraph 将关键决策要求与可保留未决的信息相区分：语言智能体负责把这些关键要求链接到时序知识图谱中的证据，随后由一个确定性检查器判定推荐是否得到证据支持；评估使用带有可执行政策引用的双语香港公共服务基准。

Result: 该方法能够减少不必要的弃答；但额外的验证步骤可能撤回本已受支持的推荐，且并未提升决策质量。

Conclusion: 可靠的基于证据的导航取决于明确“为做出决策必须确立什么”，而非单纯叠加更多验证环节。

Abstract: Public-service recommendations require evidence that matches the requested service, scope, and date. Yet treating every missing detail as decisive can withhold useful recommendations. We introduce EviGraph, which distinguishes critical decision requirements from information that can remain unresolved. A language agent links these requirements to evidence in a temporal knowledge graph, while a deterministic checker establishes whether a recommendation is supported. Evaluation on a bilingual Hong Kong public-service benchmark with executable policy references shows that this distinction reduces unnecessary abstention. Additional verification, however, can withdraw supported recommendations without improving decision quality. These findings suggest that reliable evidence-based navigation depends on specifying what must be established for a decision, rather than simply adding more verification.

</details>


### [669] [Build2SPARQL: A Large-Scale Text-to-SPARQL Benchmark Dataset for Building Knowledge Graph Querying](https://arxiv.org/abs/2610.00224)
*Wooyoung Jung*

Main category: cs.AI

TL;DR: 本文提出 Build2SPARQL，一个面向建筑知识图谱的大规模 text-to-SPARQL 基准，通过 KG 驱动的流水线生成 6,136 条可执行 SPARQL 查询与 30,680 个自然语言问题，并验证其质量与检索增强评估效果。


<details>
  <summary>Details</summary>
Motivation: 建筑自动化系统日益以 Brick、ASHRAE 223P 等本体构建语义知识图谱，为 AI 应用提供机器可读基础。将自然语言问题翻译为 SPARQL 可让建筑运营者通过语言智能体查询图谱，但该任务受限于缺乏大规模自然语言/SPARQL 基准。

Method: 采用 KG 驱动的生成流水线：SPARQL 查询完全由图遍历代码生成并验证，大语言模型仅负责生成自然语言问题，从而保证查询正确性与模型行为解耦。流水线挖掘六类查询模式（线性链、分支、UNION、聚合、OPTIONAL、属性过滤），并以五种词汇风格表述每个查询。

Result: 基于 201 个建筑 KG（180 个 Brick、21 个 ASHRAE 223P），生成 6,136 条可执行 SPARQL 查询和 30,680 个问题。对 300 个问题的双标注者人工验证显示语义保真度 98.8%、自然度 98.8%、操作合理性 84.0%。在三个开源权重语言模型上的检索增强评估将精确匹配准确率从零样本的 0.2–20% 提升至三样本检索的 56–65%。

Conclusion: Build2SPARQL 为建筑知识图谱的 text-to-SPARQL 研究提供了大规模、高质量基准，验证了 KG 驱动生成流程在保证查询正确性方面的有效性，并表明检索增强可显著提升开源模型的准确率。

Abstract: Building automation systems are increasingly represented as semantic knowledge graphs (KGs) using ontologies such as Brick and ASHRAE 223P, creating a machine-readable substrate for artificial-intelligence applications. One promising application is translating natural-language questions into SPARQL (text-to-SPARQL), which would let building operators query these graphs through language agents, but progress is limited by the scarcity of large natural-language/SPARQL benchmarks. This paper presents Build2SPARQL, a large-scale benchmark for building KGs generated by a KG-grounded pipeline: SPARQL queries are produced and validated entirely by graph-traversal code, while large language models generate only the natural-language questions, keeping query correctness independent of model behavior. The pipeline mines six query-pattern families -- linear chains, branching, UNION, aggregation, OPTIONAL, and attribute-filtered -- and phrases each query across five vocabulary registers. Applied to 201 building KGs (180 Brick, 21 ASHRAE 223P), it yields 6,136 executable SPARQL queries and 30,680 questions. A two-rater human validation of 300 questions found 98.8% semantic fidelity, 98.8% naturalness, and 84.0% operational plausibility. A retrieval-augmented evaluation across three open-weight language models raised exact-match accuracy from 0.2-20% (zero-shot) to 56-65% (three-shot retrieved).

</details>


### [670] [Conflicting Supervision Moves Commitment, Not Capability: A 12.29σ arrangement effect that is exactly zero under a convention-agnostic score](https://arxiv.org/abs/2610.00234)
*Wenhui Chen*

Main category: cs.AI

TL;DR: 该论文研究数据排序（顺序）对模型参数的影响，证明学习率调度是决定排序效应的"平均算子"，将排列效应与调度解耦为两个相乘因子，并通过受控实验验证。


<details>
  <summary>Details</summary>
Motivation: 以往"顺序有影响"与"顺序无影响"被视为对立结论，且衰减调度能缓和顺序效应虽在预训练中被观察到，但其机制、分离原理与受控测量缺失。作者旨在厘清学习率调度在排序效应中的角色。

Method: 对同一语料采用十种排列、同一预算，除路径外全部固定，在仅 lr_scheduler_type 不同的调度族下各运行两次（常数率与单一余弦）。证明一个界，使排列与调度以相乘因子进入排序效应：排列仅作为块周期，调度仅作为端点能给某一时刻的最大权重。

Result: 常数率下内部跨度达 0.2221（分配）、11.63（对比下限），随块化程度单调；余弦下十个臂仅占据约两个可区分状态。跨十二臂 acc_A+acc_B 在 9.7% 内恒定，而分配份额从 0.04 到 0.87，说明 12.29-sigma 的排列切换在约定无关指标下恰为零。在提示中标记约定可消除该切换，达到联合上限的 87.5%。

Conclusion: "顺序重要"与"顺序不重要"是同一旋钮的两端；路径写入的是模型承诺的约定，而任何精确匹配基准都无法察觉。该守恒引自衰减族，常数率族更嘈杂。

Abstract: "Train a model on the same problems written under two incompatible conventions, both correct, and ask what the ordering of that data writes into the parameters. The learning-rate schedule is not a background condition for that question. It is the averaging operator, and it decides the answer. We prove a bound in which the arrangement and the schedule enter the ordering effect as separate multiplied factors: the arrangement only as a block period, the schedule only as how much weight the endpoint can place on any one moment of the run. A decaying schedule cannot put a large step size and an uncontracted remainder at the same moment; a constant one does exactly that at the last step. That decay moderates ordering effects has been reported in pretraining; the mechanism, the separation, and a controlled measurement of both halves are ours. Ten orderings of one corpus, one budget, everything but the path held fixed, run twice under families differing in lr_scheduler_type and nothing else: at a constant rate the interior spans 0.2221 in allocation, 11.63 contrast floors, monotone in how blocked the arrangement is. Under the single cosine every published arm uses, the same ten arms occupy two distinguishable states where their own resolution would allow about ten. "Order matters" and "order does not matter" are the two ends of one knob. What the path writes is which convention the model commits to, and no exact-match benchmark can see it. Across twelve arms acc_A+acc_B is constant to within 9.7% while the allocation share runs 0.04 to 0.87, so the 12.29-sigma arrangement switch this paper measures is exactly zero under a convention-agnostic metric. That conservation is quoted from the decayed family throughout, the constant-rate one being a noisier place to read it. Marking the convention in the prompt collapses the switch and reaches 87.5% of the union ceiling."

</details>


### [671] [Knowing When to Yield: Grounded Arbitration of User Corrections in Text-Based Embodied Agents](https://arxiv.org/abs/2610.00282)
*Yezhou Cheng,Runjia Du,Zeming Liu,Hang Lyu,Zehua Yang,Bojun Lin*

Main category: cs.AI

TL;DR: 论文提出"接地纠正仲裁"（grounded correction arbitration）问题，将智能体对可能错误的纠正的响应建模为四种动作的抉择：接受、拒绝、检查世界、询问说话者；并实现GAVA方法（基于观测受限证据、合法探针与一步期望损失规则），在ALFWorld中验证其证据契约与选择性信息收集的收益。


<details>
  <summary>Details</summary>
Motivation: 具身智能体在面对人类纠正时会遇到纠正本身可能错误的情形。既有工作通常默认纠正正确或只做接受/拒绝的二元判断，缺少在"相信纠正""拒绝纠正""主动检查环境""向说话者澄清"之间进行权衡的框架，因此需要一个可形式化、可量化的仲裁机制来界定证据边界与成本结构。

Method: 形式化为在"接受、拒绝、检查世界、询问说话者"之间的选择问题；GAVA以观测受限的证据（observation-bounded evidence）、合法探针（legal probes）和一步期望损失规则（one-step expected-loss rule）实现该接口。在纯文本ALFWorld中，用162个checkpoint生成972对真/假干预配对；比较对象包括always verify、固定策略、均匀先验GAVA，以及匹配校准的无VOI（value of information）对照；并加入仅训练可用的物体位置先验，冻结策略、成本、基线与多重性计划后进行重复验证。

Result: 完整局部检查使GAVA与always verify均达到100%纠正准确率，确立证据契约而非相对优势。同回合执行中，GAVA相对always verify降低交互成本，但在完美说话者下与某成本阈值打平。仅训练可用的物体位置先验使340个未见场景的交互成本与声明联合成本分别相对均匀GAVA下降0.490与0.420；冻结后于77个不重叠已见checkpoint（308场景）上复现为0.595与0.517，两个95% checkpoint-bootstrap置信区间均不含零；联合成本亦优于相同先验的固定策略，而匹配校准的无VOI比较结论不确定。语义GAVA在两队列中各出现4个事实错误，准确率98.8%与98.7%，所有方法均完成任务。

Conclusion: 结果支持在声明成本下结合语义先验进行选择性信息收集，但未能确立环境信息价值（VOI）相对澄清（clarification）的一般性优势。研究基于规范化声明、完整符号观测与受控说话者，未评估真人参与者、视觉输入或物理机器人，因而结论的适用范围有限。

Abstract: How should an embodied agent respond when a person's correction may be wrong? We formulate grounded correction arbitration as a choice among accepting, rejecting, inspecting the world, and asking the speaker. GAVA implements this interface with observation-bounded evidence, legal probes, and a one-step expected-loss rule. In text-only ALFWorld, 162 checkpoints produce 972 paired true and false interventions. Complete local inspections give GAVA and always verify 100 percent correction accuracy, establishing the evidence contract rather than a comparative advantage. In same-episode execution, GAVA reduces interaction cost against always verify but ties a cost threshold under a perfect speaker. An exploratory training-only object-location prior lowers interaction and declared joint cost on 340 unseen scenarios by 0.490 and 0.420 relative to uniform GAVA. After freezing the policy, costs, baselines, and multiplicity plan, the gains replicate on 77 non-overlapping seen checkpoints, covering 308 scenarios: 0.595 and 0.517, with both 95 percent checkpoint-bootstrap confidence intervals excluding zero. Joint cost also improves over an identical-prior fixed policy, while the matched calibrated no-VOI comparison remains inconclusive. Semantic GAVA makes four factual errors in each cohort, corresponding to 98.8 percent and 98.7 percent accuracy, and all methods complete every task. Results support selective information gathering with semantic priors under declared costs, but do not establish a general advantage of environmental value of information over clarification. The study uses normalized claims, complete symbolic observations, and controlled speakers; it evaluates neither human participants, visual input, nor physical robots.

</details>


### [672] [Rules to Tools: Executable Checks for LLM Agents in Scientific Computing](https://arxiv.org/abs/2610.00313)
*Jingjie Ning,Guojiang Zhao,Chen Xu,Shanshan Zhong,Xiaochuan Li,Ji Zeng,Guolin Ke*

Main category: cs.AI

TL;DR: 论文提出 Rules to Tools (R2T)，将公开科学需求转化为可执行检查并供编码智能体调用，在 SciCode 修复任务上比较"文本规则"与"预置检查工具"两种条件下的修复成功率与成本。


<details>
  <summary>Details</summary>
Motivation: 科学编码智能体需依据书面方程、边界条件与输出要求来评估并修改程序，但纯文本需求易产生歧义、难以验证。作者希望探究：若把公开科学要求预先做成可调用、可执行的工具（检查器），是否能提升智能体修复程序的表现，并明确其收益是否依赖任务类型及代价（输出token与CPU开销）。

Method: 采用匹配对照实验设计。SciCode 修复组在书面检查、初始程序、模型与预算上完全对齐，唯一差异是工具组额外获得可调用的检查实现。评估两个任务-ID队列（8-ID 与更大规模队列）及共享定义队列；报告完整修复计数、任务级偏好、任务簇 bootstrap 95% 置信区间。另设"源码直通 Python"新臂与专用命令对比，并进行匹配 PDE 对照（详细文本 vs 检查），记录报告输出量与公共 CPU 使用。

Result: 任务-ID队列：完整修复 26/30（文本）对 29/30（检查）；3 个任务偏好工具、1 个偏好文本、11 个持平。8-ID 队列 13/16 对 15/16，差异的 bootstrap 95% 区间 [-12.5, 43.75] 个百分点；更大共享定义队列持平于 13/24。开发暴露且更换初始程序的 5 个任务为 3/10 对 7/10。工具组偏好任务 17、77、11；初始检查标记任务 17，对 77、11 未报告违规；偏好文本的任务 37 亦无初始违规报告。源码直通 Python 臂达 15/16，与专用命令聚合一致。PDE 对照：文本 23/24，检查 24/24，检查组报告模型输出低 31.2%。智能体侧输出节省随队列变化，公共 CPU 使用在两个任务-ID队列均上升。

Conclusion: 预置可执行检查可稳定改善科学编码智能体的修复结果（整体与多数子队列），但收益具有任务依赖性，并非普遍有效，且部分受益任务并非由初始检查违规信号直接指示。智能体侧输出成本可下降，但公共 CPU 成本上升，说明收益需在准确率与计算开销之间权衡；R2T 的效能取决于需求能否被可靠工具化。

Abstract: Scientific coding agents receive equations, boundary conditions, and output requirements in writing, then must assess the programs they revise. Rules to Tools (R2T) supplies prepared executable checks of public scientific requirements. Matched SciCode repair groups share written checks, starting programs, model, and budgets; the tool group receives a callable implementation. Across two task-ID cohorts, complete repair is 26/30 with text and 29/30 with the prepared checks. Three task IDs favor tools, one favors text, and eleven tie. The eight-ID cohort scores 13/16 versus 15/16, with a task-cluster bootstrap 95% interval of [-12.5, 43.75] percentage points for the difference. The larger shared-definition SciCode cohort ties at 13/24 per group. Five development-exposed tasks with alternate starting programs score 3/10 versus 7/10. The tool group favors tasks 17, 77, and 11; initial checks flag task 17 and report no violation for tasks 77 and 11. Task 37 favors text and has no initial reported violation. A fresh source-through-Python arm also reaches 15/16, matching the dedicated command's aggregate. In a matched PDE comparison, detailed text scores 23/24 and checks score 24/24, with 31.2% lower reported model output for checks. Agent-side output savings vary by cohort, while public CPU use rises in both task-ID cohorts. These results measure task-dependent repair outcomes and agent-side costs with prepared checks.

</details>


### [673] [Predictive Credit: Measuring What Scientific Explanations Add to Experimental Forecasts](https://arxiv.org/abs/2610.00314)
*Jingjie Ning,Xueqi Li,Yibo Kong,Dongting Li*

Main category: cs.AI

TL;DR: 研究提出预测性信度（predictive credit）测量协议，通过配对预测在控制学习、Tox21与OpenML任务上检验"匹配解释"能否带来可证实的预测增益，结果显示v5冻结判定为不确定，匹配点准确率增益与新解释的预测信度均未被确认。


<details>
  <summary>Details</summary>
Motivation: 针对研究代理常以自然语言解释其计划实验这一现象，作者希望量化"解释"本身是否具有可验证的预测性贡献，即区分描述性文本与匹配解释对预测表现的真实作用，从而为研究代理基准与科学预测建立可信的信度评估方法。

Method: 设计配对预测：固定干预、预测者与结果，仅变化描述（description）、匹配解释（matched explanation）与供体上下文（donor context）。设置五项检查：承诺、交付、预测增益、对齐与已知信号采纳。在控制学习的336个前瞻状态、12个Tox21端点及24个OpenML任务上进行评估，并包括DeepSeek V4 Pro与V4 Flash的复现实验。

Result: v5冻结信度判定为不确定；Tox21预注册ROC AUC区间评分损害检验未通过（D-M=-.0026，95%区间[-.0174, .0104]）；OpenML的联合形成、点等价与可重复性规则未通过。匹配点准确率增益未被确认，Tox21/OpenML种子-供体区间跨零。在DeepSeek V4 Pro下，匹配与供体卡片分别使Tox21次级漂移降低64.5%与59.1%。Flash复现中匹配点MAE由.01823升至.02020，未达匹配-供体区间评分等价。OpenML全卡片分配使名义80%区间扩大21%，覆盖率49.3%（描述为51.4%），144张卡片中66张受影响。直接文本Flash提交144条笔记无可检测的匹配点准确率增益。研究者撰写的机制阳性对照使点MAE较描述降低2.60个百分点。

Conclusion: 该协议为研究代理基准与科学预测提供了预测性信度的测量框架，但在所测试的供体分辨率下，自然解释的信度仍未被确认。

Abstract: Research agents explain planned experiments. We measure predictive credit with paired forecasts sharing an intervention, forecaster, and outcome while varying description, matched explanation, and donor context. Five checks track commitment, delivery, predictive gain, alignment, and known-signal uptake. Across 336 prospective states in controlled learning, 12 Tox21 endpoints, and 24 OpenML tasks, v5's frozen credit decision was inconclusive. Tox21's preregistered ROC AUC interval-score harm test was unmet ($D-M=-.0026$, 95 percent interval [$-.0174$, .0104]); OpenML's joint formation, point-equivalence, and repeatability rule was unmet. Matched point-accuracy gains over description remained unconfirmed, and Tox21/OpenML seed-donor intervals spanned zero. Under requested DeepSeek V4 Pro, matched and donor cards reduced secondary Tox21 drift by 64.5 and 59.1 percent. A DeepSeek V4 Flash replay raised matched point MAE from .01823 to .02020 and missed matched-donor interval-score equivalence. OpenML full-card assignment widened nominal 80 percent intervals by 21 percent, with 49.3 percent coverage versus 51.4 percent for description and content in 66/144 cards. Direct-text Flash delivered all 144 notes without detectable matched point-accuracy gain. A researcher-authored mechanism positive control lowered point MAE by 2.60 percentage points versus description. The protocol measures predictive credit for research-agent benchmarks and scientific forecasting; natural-explanation credit remained unconfirmed at the tested donor resolutions.

</details>


### [674] [Mathematical Transfer in LLMs Follows Reasoning Approach More Than Topic](https://arxiv.org/abs/2610.00331)
*Sajad Goudarzi,Samaneh Zamanifard,Seyed Amin Seyed Haeri,Moloud Nasiri,Hamed Rahimian*

Main category: cs.AI

TL;DR: 在数学训练数据选择中，按“推理方法”匹配（而非“主题”匹配）能带来更强的迁移效果，在40组模型-目标比较中一致优于主题匹配。


<details>
  <summary>Details</summary>
Motivation: 选择数学训练数据时存在两种组织原则：按主题匹配（如用概率题目训练概率目标）与按推理方法匹配（用共享解法但不同数学领域的题目）。作者希望厘清哪种关系在微调后能产生更大的迁移。

Method: 采用两个平衡的2×2设计：设计一为概率与组合数学，交叉不变式推理与双重计数（2000题）；设计二为数论与几何，交叉补集法与鸽巢原理（800题）。每个单元轮流作为留出目标：同方法（SA）来源共享目标方法但改变主题，同主题（ST）来源共享主题但改变方法。每个来源在每种角色中出现一次，使加性来源质量效应在等权聚合对比中抵消。跨5个基础模型、每个设计3个训练种子进行评估。

Result: 在所有40组种子合并的模型-目标比较中，SA均优于ST。模型级优势：主设计为8.2至16.2个百分点（均值10.8），第二设计为12.0至16.0（均值14.3）；全部十个模型级95%置信区间均不含零。两个设计中ST来源在嵌入与词汇相似度指标上更接近目标，说明SA优势与陈述级相似度的测量排序相反。

Conclusion: 在所评估的主题-方法组合中，推理方法比主题是更有效的数学迁移匹配准则。

Abstract: When selecting mathematical training data for LLMs, a natural organizing principle is topic: probability examples for probability targets. An alternative is reasoning approach: worked solutions that share a solution method with the target, even when the mathematical domain differs. We ask which relation produces greater transfer after fine-tuning. We evaluate two counterbalanced $2\times2$ designs: probability and combinatorics crossed with invariant reasoning and double counting (2,000 problems), and number theory and geometry crossed with complement and pigeonhole reasoning (800 problems). In each design, every cell serves as the held-out target in turn: same-approach (SA) sources share the target's method but change the topic, while same-topic (ST) sources share the topic but change the method. Every source appears once in each role, so additive source-quality effects cancel from the equally weighted aggregate contrast. Across five base models and three training seeds per design, SA outperforms ST in all 40 seed-pooled model--target comparisons. Model-level advantages range from 8.2 to 16.2 percentage points in the primary design (mean: 10.8) and from 12.0 to 16.0 in the second design (mean: 14.3); all ten model-level 95% confidence intervals exclude zero. In both designs, ST sources are more similar to targets under embedding and lexical measures, so the SA advantage runs opposite to the measured ordering of statement-level resemblance. These findings identify reasoning approach as a more effective matching criterion than topic for mathematical transfer across the evaluated topic--approach combinations.

</details>


### [675] [Fault-Tolerant Budget Conservation in Distributed Multi-Agent Delegation](https://arxiv.org/abs/2610.00349)
*Genliang Zhu,Chu Wang*

Main category: cs.AI

TL;DR: 本文形式化了分布式多智能体委托中的容错预算守恒机制，通过排他托管信用、动作预留、加密调度许可与隔离机制，在崩溃、重试、重复、分区、连接及延迟完成等故障场景下保持预算不超支。


<details>
  <summary>Details</summary>
Motivation: AI智能体在并发且易故障的工作节点间委派任务时，资源限制正成为授权边界。现有的父子分配约束、仿射对象和分布式托管本身无法防止超支，尤其当回复丢失、超时后效果才完成、消息重复、分支分区或DAG连接混淆同一谱系时。

Method: 将预算形式化为量化的资源向量，用排他托管信用经委托DAG流转；派发前将信用转换为绑定谱系、纪元、规范化效果、最大费用、接收方和幂等键的操作预留，持久化带隔离的签名调度许可，由网关在首次接受前验证；不确定效果保持计费，直到认证结算、隔离的权威无效果证明或永久退休。

Result: 证明了所有权分区、账本与效果守恒、后代非放大、至多一次结算、延迟完成安全性和分区遏制等性质（在显式中介、持久性、认证、规范化及网关假设下）；不可区分性结果表明分区本地可用性需要排他预分配。通过有界TLA+检查、独立JavaScript探索器和崩溃注入的双进程SQLite实验验证了声明范围，并检测出超时退款和历史证书验证两类变异体。

Conclusion: 该机制在所评估的崩溃、重试、重复、分区、连接和延迟完成调度下均保持了已发行预算的上界。

Abstract: Resource limits are becoming an authorization boundary for AI agents that delegate work across concurrent and failure-prone workers. Parent-child allocation constraints, affine objects, and distributed escrow do not by themselves prevent overspend when replies are lost, effects complete after timeout, messages repeat, branches partition, or DAG joins alias one lineage. We formalize fault-tolerant budget conservation for distributed multi-agent delegation. Budgets are quantized resource vectors represented by exclusive escrow credits that move through a delegation DAG. Before dispatch, a branch converts credit into an operation reservation bound to lineage, epoch, normalized effect, maximum charge, receiver, and idempotency key. It persists a signed dispatch permit with quarantine; the gateway verifies that permit before first acceptance. Uncertain effects remain charged until authenticated settlement, a fenced authoritative no-effect proof, or permanent retirement. We prove ownership partition, ledger and effect conservation, descendant non-amplification, at-most-once settlement, late-completion safety, and partition confinement under explicit mediation, durability, authentication, normalization, and gateway assumptions. An indistinguishability result shows that partition-local availability requires exclusive preallocation. Bounded TLA+ checking, an independent JavaScript explorer, and crash-injected two-process SQLite experiments exercise the declared scope and detect timeout-refund and historical-certificate-validation mutants. The mechanism preserves the issued budget bound across the evaluated crash, retry, duplicate, partition, join, and late-completion schedules.

</details>


### [676] [JusticeAxis: Benchmarking Legal Judgment between Rigid Rule Application and Ungrounded Discretion](https://arxiv.org/abs/2610.00353)
*Zhengkai Tu,Mingda Zhang,Zijia Wang,Xiaoying Tang,Jimmy Huang*

Main category: cs.AI

TL;DR: 本文提出"参照锚定"的法律判决形式化任务，发布JusticeAxis基准（18国256个真实刑事案件，含音/图/文证据及三种律师判决），并设计JusticeAgent（元素智能体建事实、法官智能体依法用技能裁量，技能经贝叶斯可信界筛选）。实验发现：失败方向随规模反转——开源权重模型偏向无据理由，前沿模型偏向法律默认值；JusticeAgent可将冻结的开源权重骨干提升至商业模型水平。


<details>
  <summary>Details</summary>
Motivation: 现有法律推理方法在"僵硬的法条匹配"与"无根基的自由裁量"之间摇摆；基准仅评分单一标签或评分表，而判决所依赖的具体情境经验长期缺乏验证。

Method: 将法律判决形式化为"参照锚定"任务：对象是同时绑定法条与情境的单一决策。构建JusticeAxis（18国256个真实刑事案件，音/图/文多模态证据，每案三个律师判决：实际记录判决及两个失败方向判决）；提出JusticeAgent：元素智能体确立事实，法官智能体在带有情境经验技能下适用法律；技能从执行轨迹蒸馏，仅通过贝叶斯可信界筛除的才被接纳。

Result: 实验显示失败方向随模型规模反转：开源权重骨干漂移到无据理由，前沿模型漂移到法条默认值；JusticeAgent作为简单有效的插件，可将冻结的开源权重骨干提升至商业水平。

Conclusion: 以参照锚定框架和三判决设计可同时衡量法条依赖与情境裁量两类失败；蒸馏经验技能并以贝叶斯可信界把关，是提升开源法律智能体至商业水平的有效且低成本的路径。

Abstract: A sound judgment applies the law to established facts and weighs the circumstances in which they arose. However, existing methods swing between rigid statute matching and ungrounded discretion, benchmarks score a label or a rubric, and the experience that would supply the balance stays unverified. We formalize legal judgment as a reference-anchored task, whose object is a single decision that stays tied to the statute and to the circumstances at once. We introduce JusticeAxis, 256 real-world criminal cases from 18 countries with audio, image, and text evidence, and three lawyer-written judgments for every case: the recorded one and one for each failure. We further propose JusticeAgent, a harness whose element agents establish the facts and whose judge agent applies the law under skills carrying experience of the circumstances. Skills are distilled from execution trajectories and admitted only under Bayesian credible bounds. Experiments show that failure turns direction with scale: open-weight backbones drift to unsupported grounds, frontier models to the statutory default. We further verify that JusticeAgent, as a simple yet effective plugin, carries a frozen open-weight backbone to commercial level. Project resources are available at https://github.com/beita6969/JusticeAxis.

</details>


### [677] [What Should an Agent Remember? Disentangling Retention from Retrieval in Bounded-Memory Evaluation](https://arxiv.org/abs/2610.00366)
*Juli Huang*

Main category: cs.AI

TL;DR: 本文构建流式召回基准，交叉保留与选择规则并在同一批300个种子episode上评估，发现混合比较会严重混淆两种决策的效果：固定访问条件下查询感知选择仅提升15.5个百分点，而混合比较报告的68.7个百分点优势中有53.2个百分点来自访问差异；有界保留下失败全部源于驱逐而非排序错误。


<details>
  <summary>Details</summary>
Motivation: 持续型智能体需同时决定"随信息到达保留什么"与"查询出现后呈现什么"，但现有记忆评估常比较在保留与选择两方面都不同的方法，导致两种决策的效果相互混淆，无法判断性能差异真正来自哪一环。

Method: 构建流式召回（streaming-recall）基准，交叉组合保留规则与选择规则，所有条件在相同的300个种子episode上评估；在固定访问（history access）的前提下单独考察查询感知选择，并与同时改变历史访问的混合比较对照；另在有界保留条件下对比查询感知、稠密与oracle选择，并在SQuAD上重复该评估。

Result: 固定访问时，查询感知选择将必需事实召回率提升15.5个百分点（95% CI：12.8–18.2）；混合比较报告68.7个百分点优势，其中53.2个百分点可归因于访问差异。有界保留下，查询感知、稠密与oracle选择均触及保留上限；有界recency条件下全部319次失败均由驱逐造成，而非排序错误。目标足够久远时召回率降至0%。在SQuAD上保留上限依然成立，且稠密检索在自然文本上可优于词汇检索。

Conclusion: 有界记忆评估应固定访问条件，并分别报告保留与选择两个指标，否则记忆方法的性能优势会被访问差异所混淆，无法反映真实的能力来源。

Abstract: A persistent agent must decide both what to retain as information arrives and what to surface once a query appears, yet memory evaluations can confound these decisions by comparing methods that differ in both retention and selection. We build a streaming-recall benchmark crossing retention and selection rules and evaluate every condition on the same 300 seeded episodes. Holding access fixed, query-aware selection improves required-fact recall by 15.5 percentage points (95% CI: 12.8 to 18.2), whereas a mixed comparison that also changes history access reports a 68.7-point advantage, of which 53.2 points are attributable to access. Under bounded retention, query-aware, dense, and oracle selection reach the retention ceiling, and all 319 observed failures in the bounded recency condition are caused by eviction rather than ranking errors. Recall falls to 0% as targets recede sufficiently far into the past. Repeating the evaluation on SQuAD preserves the retention ceiling while showing that dense retrieval can outperform lexical retrieval on natural text. These results show that bounded-memory evaluations should hold access fixed and report retention and selection separately.

</details>


### [678] [When Harnesses Lose the Signal: Causal Evaluation of Recovery in LLM Agents](https://arxiv.org/abs/2610.00372)
*Shuyao Xiao,Shengling Wang,Xuan Chen,Ke Chao,Ming Cui,Feifei Qian,Chaoyang Mei,Fanlin Meng,Ziming Yu,Junxi Yin*

Main category: cs.AI

TL;DR: 本文提出将大模型智能体的"恢复"操作视为因果决策问题，通过对比同一执行状态下有无恢复的结果来区分"拯救"与"破坏"，并据此设计了轻量策略CIR，在ALFWorld长程任务上把成功率从70.33%提升到73.33%。


<details>
  <summary>Details</summary>
Motivation: 现有工作通常只用平均任务成功率来评价恢复机制，掩盖了一个核心矛盾：同一种恢复操作既可能挽救即将失败的轨迹，也可能干扰本可成功的轨迹。因此需要从因果角度重新定义和评估恢复的价值。

Method: 把恢复建模为因果决策问题：从相同执行状态出发，对比施加恢复与不施加恢复两种情形的结果，从而将"拯救"与"伤害"分离，并考察恢复价值随时间的演化。在此基础上提出因果干预路由器（CIR），一种利用恢复前可用信息的轻量策略，用于判断何时干预是值得的。

Result: 在Qwen3-14B上的ALFWorld长程任务中，CIR将成功率从70.33%提升至73.33%，绝对提升3.00个百分点；对所有观测正确的轨迹不做任何改动；额外对照实验表明该收益不能仅由环境返回的新观测来解释。

Conclusion: 该工作提供了一种评估恢复行为并选择性施加恢复的实用方法，表明从因果视角区分恢复的正负效应、并依此做选择性干预，能够在不破坏原有成功轨迹的前提下提升整体任务表现。

Abstract: Large language model agents rely on external harnesses to pass information between the model and its environment and to recover from execution errors. Yet recovery is usually judged only by average task success. This hides an important tension. The same operation can rescue a failing trajectory or disrupt one that would otherwise succeed. We frame recovery as a causal decision problem. Starting from the same execution state, we compare what happens with and without recovery, separate rescue from harm, and study how the value of recovery changes over time. We then introduce the Causal Intervention Router (CIR), a lightweight policy that uses information available before recovery to decide when intervention is worthwhile. On long-horizon ALFWorld tasks with Qwen3-14B, CIR raises success from 70.33% to 73.33%, a gain of 3.00 percentage points. It leaves all evaluated trajectories with correct observations untouched. Additional controls show that the benefit of recovery cannot be explained solely by the new observation returned by the environment. These results provide a practical way to evaluate recovery and apply it selectively.

</details>


### [679] [JevSpawn: Adaptive Agentic Inference through Compositional Action Spaces](https://arxiv.org/abs/2610.00437)
*Haoyang Su,Weiran Huang*

Main category: cs.AI

TL;DR: JevSpawn 是一种组合式策略，将自然语言任务规范与有限概率探索连接起来，通过并行动作生成与反馈驱动的分支选择，提升 LLM 智能体的任务性能与推理速度，且无需额外训练。


<details>
  <summary>Details</summary>
Motivation: LLM 智能体逐 token 生成推理与动作，导致长交互过程缓慢且计算开销大。Jev 类模型可对有限域提供快速概率预测，但要求预先指定域，这限制了其自主任务求解能力——因为可用动作需从自然语言指令中推导并随交互动态调整。

Method: 提出 JevSpawn 组合式策略：将自然语言任务规范映射到有限概率探索；采用并行动作衍生（parallel action spawning），并结合反馈驱动的分支选择、表示修正以及从保留备选方案中恢复的机制；通过共享动作结构与模型前缀减少重复生成与上下文计算。

Result: 在八个基准任务上，与七个智能体基线及一个 TypeSafe Jev 变体进行对比评估，JevSpawn 在任务性能上有所提升，导航速度更快。

Conclusion: JevSpawn 是通向结构化智能体推理的一条有前景的路径，在无需额外训练的前提下实现了性能与效率的改进。

Abstract: LLM agents generate intermediate reasoning and actions token by token, making extended interactions slow and computationally expensive. Jev-style models offer fast probabilistic predictions over finite fields, but require those fields to be specified in advance. This requirement limits autonomous task solving, where the available actions must be derived from natural language instructions and adapted through interaction. We introduce JevSpawn, a compositional policy that connects natural language task specifications to finite probabilistic exploration. Parallel action spawning is coupled with feedback driven branch selection, representation revision, and recovery from retained alternatives. Shared action structure and model prefixes reduce repeated generation and context computation without additional training. Evaluations on eight benchmark tasks against seven agent baselines and a TypeSafe Jev variant establish JevSpawn as a promising approach to structured agentic inference, with improved task performance and faster navigation.

</details>


### [680] [Before Agents Decide: Epistemic Action in LLM-Based Systems](https://arxiv.org/abs/2610.00511)
*Yizhi Liu,Balaji Padmanabhan,Siva Viswanathan*

Main category: cs.AI

TL;DR: 本文借鉴认知科学中的"认知行动"（epistemic actions）概念，提出LLM智能体设计应关注决策前的"证据准备"问题，并区分三种模式：获取缺失证据、转化已有证据、探测系统以产生可揭示的响应，同时提出"认知脚手架"作为支撑这些行动的接口、工具与环境。


<details>
  <summary>Details</summary>
Motivation: 当前LLM智能体的设计侧重于搜索与探索能力，却忽视了更前置的问题：现有证据是否已经"决策就绪"。现实中，有时关键证据缺失，有时证据虽在但形式掩盖了要点，有时用于判断的比较尚未形成。作者认为智能体设计必须回应"决策就绪的证据如何被生产出来"这一问题。

Method: 这是一篇立场/概念性论文（position paper），采用概念引入与框架构建的方法：将认知科学的"认知行动"概念迁移到LLM智能体语境，划分出三种认知行动模式（获取、转化、探测），并提出"认知脚手架"（epistemic scaffolding）这一术语来指称使这些行动成为可能且可审计的接口、工具与环境。

Result: 论文未报告实证实验或量化结果，其"结果"在于提出一个分析框架：以决策就绪性为核心，将智能体的证据处理行为归为三类模式，并用"认知脚手架"统一描述其支撑条件与可审计性要求。

Conclusion: 智能体设计不应止于搜索与探索，而必须把"如何生产决策就绪的证据"作为核心议题，通过显式建模认知行动与构建相应的认知脚手架来实现。

Abstract: Before a difficult decision, people often act simply to understand the situation better. We turn an object to see another side, place alternatives next to each other, or change one condition and observe what happens. These actions may not complete the task, but they improve the evidence needed for the next choice. LLM-based agents can search and explore, yet agent design gives less attention to an earlier question: is the available evidence ready for the decision? Sometimes necessary evidence is missing. In other cases, the evidence is present but its form hides what matters, or the comparison needed to judge it does not yet exist. Cognitive science calls actions that improve the basis for a later choice epistemic actions. We bring this idea to LLM-based agents and distinguish three modes: acquiring missing evidence, transforming available evidence, and probing a system to create a revealing response. We use the term epistemic scaffolding for the interfaces, tools, and environments that make these actions possible and auditable. This paper argues that agent design must address how decision-ready evidence is produced.

</details>


### [681] [Ontology-Based Contextual AI Evaluations (OB-CAIE) Methodology](https://arxiv.org/abs/2610.00529)
*Julie Krugler Hollek,Michael Zargham,Mala Kumar*

Main category: cs.AI

TL;DR: 本文提出基于本体的情境化AI评估方法（OB-CAIE），通过构建领域特定本体（DSO）与评估过程本体（EPO）来明确界定AI评估中"测什么"与"怎么测"，以提升评估的测试覆盖清晰度、人机协作平衡性及环境可复现性。


<details>
  <summary>Details</summary>
Motivation: 现有AI评估存在科学严谨性不足的问题，根源在于测试覆盖范围界定不清、人类专业知识与自动化之间的平衡难以把握，以及评估测试环境缺乏可复现性。

Method: 开发OB-CAIE方法，沿科学方法第一步明确界定测试对象。该方法用两个本体表征可处理问题空间：领域特定本体（DSO）回答"测什么"，评估过程本体（EPO）回答"怎么测"；一个OB-CAIE问题空间可支持一项或多项AI评估，并在特定节点以科学化方式引入人类判断。

Result: OB-CAIE在测试覆盖界定、人机分工及可复现性方面改进了AI评估现状；其关键优势在于失败点可在规范化的问题空间内被追溯、可视化与分析。人类判断被限定在复杂且机器不可替代的环节，实现有机整合。

Conclusion: OB-CAIE通过双本体框架为AI评估提供结构化、可复现且人机协同的科学方法论，其中失败点可追溯与可视化是核心优势。

Abstract: The ontology-based contextual AI evaluation (OB-CAIE) methodology was developed to address a lack of scientific rigor that arises from unclear testing coverage, to balance human expertise and automations, and to address a lack of reproducibility of AI evaluation testing environments. OB-CAIE strengthens the current state of AI evaluations by addressing the first step in the scientific method by clearly defining what will be tested. Two ontologies represent the tractable problem space in the OB-CAIE methodology: the Domain-Specific Ontology (DSO) and the Evaluation Process Ontology (EPO). The DSO is the what; the EPO is the how. An OB-CAIE problem space can be used for one or multiple AI evaluations. The OB-CAIE methodology allows for human judgment at specific points, in scientifically grounded ways, and in complex subject areas where human feedback is genuinely irreducible or machine irreplaceable. A key advantage of the OB-CAIE methodology is that failure points can be traced, visualized and analyzed within the canonical OB-CAIE methodology problem space.

</details>


### [682] [Science or Slop?: Benchmarking and Mitigating Scientific Slop in AI-Generated Papers](https://arxiv.org/abs/2610.00531)
*Yerim Oh,Young-Jun Lee,Jaewoo Ahn,Gunhee Kim,Dongyeop Kang*

Main category: cs.AI

TL;DR: 该论文提出"科学slop"概念，构建包含390篇AI生成论文的SciSlopBench基准，从结构、论证、产物六个维度量化AI论文的推理断裂问题，检测准确率达85.9%，并提出SciSlopHarness框架在证据支持下修减slop，将AI-人类差距缩小63%。


<details>
  <summary>Details</summary>
Motivation: AI生成内容（AI slop）在学术界日益普遍，但AI生成科学论文的slop模式更复杂，现有基于token的AI检测器难以识别。这类论文各部分看似合理，但连接各部分的科学推理却断裂，会误导读者对工作的评估。因此需要新的度量方式来刻画这种全局推理层面的失败。

Method: 1. 提出六项度量指标，跨Structure（结构）、Argument（论证）、Artifacts（产物）三个维度量化"科学slop"；2. 构建SciSlopBench基准，包含390篇AI生成论文（以计算机科学为主，涵盖生命、社会、自然科学），每篇配对一篇研究问题与贡献类型匹配的人类撰写论文；3. 提出SciSlopHarness框架，在实验记录支持修改的地方引导固定LLM修订slop，强调严格证据基础而非单纯文本润色。

Result: 1. 度量指标以85.9%准确率识别每对中的AI论文，优于Binoculars的68.7%；2. 更高的科学slop对应更低的ICLR评分，在2017至2025年每一年都能超过随机水平区分被拒与录用论文；3. 直接优化度量并不可行；标准修订残留slop，直接slop感知提示引发奖励黑客；SciSlopHarness在不需人类参考目标的情况下，将剩余AI-人类差距较最强修订基线缩小63%。

Conclusion: AI生成科学论文在全局推理层面留下根本性痕迹，负责任地缓解这类问题需要严格的证据基础，而非仅仅进行文本润色。

Abstract: AI-generated content, often called AI slop, is increasingly common everywhere, particularly in academia. Slop in AI-generated scientific papers, however, has more complex patterns that cannot be easily detected by existing token-based AI detectors. Each part of such a paper looks plausible while the scientific reasoning that connects the parts breaks down, which can mislead how readers assess the work. We benchmark these failures as scientific slop through six measures across Structure, Argument, and Artifacts. We construct SciSlopBench with 390 AI-generated papers, mostly in computer science but spanning the life, social, and natural sciences, each paired with a human-written paper matched by research problem and contribution type. Our measures identify the AI paper in each pair with 85.9% accuracy, compared with 68.7% for Binoculars. Higher scientific slop accompanies lower ICLR ratings and distinguishes rejected from accepted papers above chance in every year from 2017 to 2025. Reducing these patterns, however, is not as simple as directly optimizing the measures. We therefore propose SciSlopHarness, a harness-level framework that guides a fixed LLM to revise slop only where the experiment records support the change. While standard revisions leave residual slop and direct slop-aware prompting triggers reward hacking, SciSlopHarness reduces the remaining AI-human gap by 63% over the strongest revision baseline without requiring human reference targets. Overall, we demonstrate that AI-generated scientific papers leave fundamental traces in their global reasoning, and that responsible mitigation demands strict evidentiary grounding rather than mere prose refinement.

</details>


### [683] [Worse Together: How Performance Breaks Down in Multi-User Multi-Agent Teams](https://arxiv.org/abs/2610.00583)
*Sahan Paliskara,Nattaput Namchittai,Andrew Lampinen*

Main category: cs.AI

TL;DR: 该论文研究多用户、多智能体（multi-user, multi-agent）协调问题，跨5个前沿模型、4类环境（API密钥、诊所、个人助理、合并队列）、77个场景，对比单个协调者（coordinator）与多智能体团队（带/不带通信通道）的表现，发现团队在各环境下群体结果均更差，并识别出若干失败行为及环境特定的缓解措施，同时发布包含74个场景的MAMUBench。


<details>
  <summary>Details</summary>
Motivation: 随着人们越来越多地将任务委托给AI智能体，多个为不同用户服务的智能体在共享资源（如代码库、日历、预算）上频繁交互。当各智能体服务目标不同的用户时，协调常常失败，导致群体境况不如由单一智能体统一代理。论文旨在系统研究这种多用户、多智能体协调失效现象及其成因。

Method: 研究横跨5个前沿模型、4类环境（共享算力预算的API密钥环境、共享日历的诊所、共享团购或预订的个人助理环境、共享发布截止时间的合并队列）中的77个场景。每个场景中对比：服务所有用户的单一协调者智能体，与每个智能体仅服务一名用户的团队（分带通信通道和不带通信通道两种情况）。通过实验观测并归纳失败行为，并测试多种缓解方案。

Result: 团队在所有环境下的群体结果均差于协调者：无通信通道时在两个环境中完全崩溃（collapse）；即使有通信通道，协调开销仍造成显著差距。例如，个人助理环境中协调者满足目标用户请求的频率约为团队的两倍。识别出的失败行为包括：团队规模增大时停滞（stalling）、相互覆盖对方操作、以及编造声明（fabricating claims）。

Conclusion: 论文发现有效但依赖具体环境的缓解措施，如设置团队负责人（team lead）、明确流程指令、以及要求智能体在行动前阅读同伴消息的平台校验。研究将发布API密钥、诊所和个人助理三类环境作为MAMUBench，包含74个场景，用于评估多用户、多智能体协调能力。

Abstract: People are increasingly delegating tasks to AI agents, and those agents are increasingly encountering other people's agents over shared resources such as a codebase, a calendar, or a budget. When each agent acts for a different user with different goals, coordination often fails, and the group ends up worse off than if a single agent had acted for everyone. We study this multi-user, multi-agent setting across five frontier models and 77 scenarios in four environments: an API key environment in which agents share a compute budget, a clinic in which they share a calendar, a personal assistant environment in which they share a group order or booking, and a merge queue in which they share a release cutoff. In each scenario, we compare a single agent that serves every user (a coordinator) to a team in which each agent serves one user, with and without a communication channel between the agents. Teams deliver worse group outcomes than the coordinator in every environment: without a channel, they completely collapse in two environments, and even with one, coordination overhead creates substantial gaps. For example, in the personal assistant environment, the coordinator fulfills a targeted user request about twice as often as teams. We identify distinct behaviors associated with this poor group-level performance, including stalling as teams grow, overriding each other's actions, and fabricating claims. We find effective but environment-specific mitigations, such as a team lead, explicit procedural instructions, and a platform check that makes an agent read its peers' messages before committing. We will release the API key, clinic, and personal assistant environments as MAMUBench, comprising 74 scenarios for evaluating multi-user, multi-agent coordination.

</details>


### [684] [Incident-Arena: Getting agents to the last nine of reliability](https://arxiv.org/abs/2610.00648)
*Andre Fu,Malik Drabla,Leon Liu,Meji Abidoye,Marek Suppa,Lata Mishra,Adnan El Assadi,Yiyuan Li*

Main category: cs.AI

TL;DR: 该论文提出 Incident-Arena，一个基于真实开源软件、部署在临时 Kubernetes 集群上的 20 任务基准，用于评估 AI 编码智能体在 agentic SRE（生产事故响应）中的能力；并引入功能性验证器替代静态检查。前沿模型在 20 个任务上得分低于 64.3%，失败涵盖诊断定位错误、修复不完整与不安全回归。


<details>
  <summary>Details</summary>
Motivation: AI 编码智能体在工程工作流中已普遍使用，但其在生产事故响应（agentic SRE）方面的能力关注不足。现有 SRE 基准存在三大局限：(1) 环境不真实，多为玩具仓库；(2) 框架实现非标准；(3) 验证器仅为简单静态检查。因此需要一个更贴近真实生产、具备功能级验证的评测基准。

Method: 构建 Incident-Arena：人工设计的 20 个任务，基于真实部署的开源软件。每个任务将生产应用部署到临时 Kubernetes 集群，从配置层到底层镜像注入故障，并按任务需求施加持续负载曲线。验证方法上，超越静态检查，采用功能性验证器，在保持系统级指标稳定的同时确保修复安全完成。

Result: 智能体试验平均消耗 2.81M tokens、41 轮交互，超出既有基准，体现长时程智能体推理。在 20 个任务、3 种应用基板上，前沿模型得分均低于 64.3%；失败类型包括诊断/定位错误、修复不完整以及不安全回归。

Conclusion: 现有前沿模型在真实生产事故响应场景中能力不足，Incident-Arena 通过真实 Kubernetes 环境、故障注入、负载曲线与功能性验证，为 agentic SRE 提供了更具挑战性和真实性的评测标准，揭示了长时程智能体推理中的关键短板。

Abstract: AI coding agents are ubiquitous in engineering workflows amongst industry and academia. Yet, despite their use in app coding, relatively less attention has been paid to their ability to execute on production incident response. This emerging field, termed agentic site-reliability-engineering (SRE) contains benchmarks limited by (1) unrealistic environments, typically toy repositories (2) non-standard framework implementations and (3) simple static verifiers. We introduce Incident-Arena, a human-built benchmark of 20 carefully selected tasks grounded in real-world deployed open source software. Each task deploys a production application to an ephemeral Kubernetes cluster, injecting a fault from the config layer through underlying images, and a sustained load profile given the task requirements. We also present a novel verification method, going beyond static checks to functional verifiers, holding systems level metrics stable, while ensuring repairs are done safely. Agent trials run an average of 2.81M tokens and 41 turns, going beyond existing benchmarks, demonstrating agentic long horizon reasoning. Across 20 tasks and 3 application substrates, frontier models score below 64.3%, with failures extending from diagnosis/localization errors, through incomplete repairs and unsafe regressions.

</details>


### [685] [A Simple Doxastic Deontic Logic for Norm-Guided Decision Making](https://arxiv.org/abs/2610.00668)
*Thorsten Engesser,Agata Ciabattoni*

Main category: cs.AI

TL;DR: 本文提出一种信念道义逻辑，并定义"信念规范合规优化问题"，研究主客观优化的重合条件及可归约为加权部分MaxSAT。


<details>
  <summary>Details</summary>
Motivation: 自主系统需在规范冲突、信息不完整或不可靠的情况下做决策，然而现有逻辑工具难以同时处理信念、条件规范与多智能体情境下的优化问题，因此需要一个形式化框架来刻画并求解此类决策。

Method: 构造一个简单信念道义逻辑：取Chellas极小道义逻辑的可经典归约片段，加入显式条件规范，并与多智能体KD45结合，使规范可依赖于智能体对事实和规范的信念。在此基础上定义"信念规范合规优化问题"，智能体选择使加权违规最小化的决策，并区分相对于信念的主观优化与相对于事实的客观优化。

Result: 给出了两类条件：(i) 主观优化与客观优化相重合的条件；(ii) 最优决策可在多项式时间内归约为加权部分MaxSAT的条件。

Conclusion: 该逻辑框架为不确定与规范冲突下的自主决策提供了形式化基础，并通过归约到加权部分MaxSAT为求最优决策提供了可行的计算方法。

Abstract: Making decisions despite conflicting norms and incomplete or unreliable information is a fundamental challenge for autonomous systems. We introduce a simple doxastic deontic logic for this setting: a classically reducible fragment of Chellas' Minimal Deontic Logic, extended with explicit conditional norms and combined with multi-agent KD45, so that norms can depend on agents' beliefs about both facts and norms. On this logic we define the Doxastic Norm Compliance Optimization Problem, where an agent chooses a decision minimizing weighted norm violations. We distinguish subjective optimization (relative to the agent's beliefs) from objective optimization (relative to the actual facts). We give conditions under which (i) the two coincide and (ii) optimal decision-making can be reduced to weighted partial MaxSAT in polynomial time.

</details>


### [686] [Meta-Multi-Agent Reinforcement Learning for Fast Adaptation of Interactive Policies with Applications to Autonomous Driving](https://arxiv.org/abs/2610.00705)
*Huiwen Yan,Kyriakos G. Vamvoudakis,Mushuang Liu*

Main category: cs.AI

TL;DR: 本文提出元多智能体强化学习（meta-MARL）框架，将MARL问题建模为马尔可夫博弈，实现跨MG分布的交互策略快速自适应，并通过自动驾驶任务验证其适应速度优于预训练MARL基线。


<details>
  <summary>Details</summary>
Motivation: 现有元强化学习（meta-RL）主要面向单智能体系统，其双层优化机制难以直接扩展到多智能体系统。多智能体任务不仅由环境决定，还取决于智能体间的策略交互，这给快速适应带来额外挑战。

Method: 将多智能体强化学习建模为马尔可夫博弈（MG），提出面向MG分布的meta-MARL框架；定义新概念meta-NE以刻画元多智能体问题下的目标解概念；建立meta-NE与基于梯度博弈（gradient-play）的meta-MARL算法稳定点之间的等价性充分条件。

Result: 在自动驾驶任务上的评估表明，所提meta-MARL方法相比预训练MARL基线实现了更快的适应。

Conclusion: 该工作将元学习与多智能体博弈结合，为多智能体交互策略的快速自适应提供了理论刻画与实证支持，验证了框架的有效性。

Abstract: This paper develops a meta-multi-agent reinforcement learning (meta-MARL) framework to enable fast adaptation of interactive policies in a multi-agent system (MAS). Meta-reinforcement learning (meta-RL) enables agents to rapidly adapt to new tasks/environments using a bi-level optimization mechanism. However, existing meta-RL generally focuses on single-agent systems. Extending these frameworks and algorithms to multi-agent systems poses additional challenges, as tasks are characterized by not only the environment but also agents' strategic interactions. To address these challenges, we model multi-agent reinforcement learning (MARL) problems as Markov games (MGs) and develop a meta-MARL framework for rapid interactive policy adaptation across a distribution of MGs. A new concept, called meta-NE, is defined to describe the desired solution concept in a meta-MARL problem. Sufficient conditions for the equivalence between a meta-NE and a stationary point of the gradient-play-based meta-MARL algorithm are established. Our evaluation on autonomous-driving tasks demonstrates that the proposed meta-MARL method achieves faster adaptation than pretrained MARL baselines, validating the effectiveness of our framework.

</details>


### [687] [ReLiveGym: Evaluating Long-Lived Agents over Weeks of Replayed Reality](https://arxiv.org/abs/2610.00710)
*Xisen Jin,Jingheng Li,Zhenglun Chen,Junyi Du,Xiang Ren*

Main category: cs.AI

TL;DR: 该论文提出ReLiveGym，一个面向长期运行LLM智能体的诊断性评测环境，通过按时间顺序回放数周的真实新闻、市场与社交媒体流，考察智能体的动作时机判断、性能及持续学习能力。


<details>
  <summary>Details</summary>
Motivation: 随着LLM智能体被广泛部署于需要持续监控或周期性动作的任务（如市场分析），它们需在无人值守下运行数天至数周、在恰当时机行动并适应动态环境。然而现有长时程智能体研究多假设静态环境、不随时间变化，未能充分刻画这些挑战，缺乏相应的诊断性评测平台。

Method: 构建ReLiveGym诊断性评测环境，其中智能体在按时间顺序回放的数周真实新闻、市场与社交媒体流中稀疏地行动；任务覆盖不同的时间敏感性、推理强度和重复性水平。在八个基础语言模型上，考察模型选择与harness设计如何影响长期任务表现，并评估基于事后反馈的持续学习对性能的影响及对失败模式的改善。

Result: 智能体如何判断"何时行动"成为长期任务中重要的harness设计维度；最优设计随任务而异，有时也随模型选择而变化。持续学习利用事后反馈可影响性能并改善所观察到的失败模式。

Conclusion: 模型选择、动作时机机制与反馈利用是设计长期运行智能体的重要考量因素。代码已开源于 https://github.com/SaharaLabsAI/ReLiveGym。

Abstract: As large language model (LLM) agents become widely adopted, they are increasingly deployed for tasks that require persistent monitoring or recurring actions (e.g., market analysis). These agents are expected to operate unattended for days or weeks, act at the right timing, and adapt to the dynamic environment over time. These challenges are not fully captured in the existing long-horizon agent work, as they often consider a static environment that is not temporally changing. We introduce ReLiveGym, a diagnostic evaluation environment of long-lived tasks in which agents act sparsely over simulated weeks of chronologically replayed real-world news, market, and social-media streams. The tasks span diverse levels of time sensitivity, reasoning intensity, and recurrence. Across eight base language models, we investigate how model choice and harness design affect agent performance on such long-lived tasks. Our results show that how agents determine when to act arises as an important harness-design axis for long-lived tasks; and that the optimal design varies across tasks and sometimes model choices as well. We also evaluate how continuous learning from hindsight feedback affects performance and addresses failure modes observed in these long-lived tasks. These findings indicate model choice, action timing mechanism, and use of feedback as important considerations in the design of long-lived agents. Code: https://github.com/SaharaLabsAI/ReLiveGym

</details>


### [688] [Robust Nash Alignment under Preference Uncertainty](https://arxiv.org/abs/2610.00715)
*Shihab Ahmed,Debamita Ghosh,David Tang,Yudan Wang,Alvaro Velasquez,Yue Wang*

Main category: cs.AI

TL;DR: 提出 Robust Nash Alignment 博弈论框架，应对成对偏好不确定下的对齐问题，并给出四玩家代理博弈与单环路优化算法及收敛保证。


<details>
  <summary>Details</summary>
Motivation: 现有基于偏好的对齐方法通常针对单一偏好模型优化，当成对偏好存在噪声、异质性或部署后发生偏移时表现脆弱，因此需要面向不确定偏好的鲁棒对齐方法。

Method: 将问题建模为博弈：主学习者寻求策略，使其在对抗竞争者与位于名义偏好周围不确定集内的任意偏好核下最大化最坏情况胜率，从而直接给出最坏情况性能的认证下界。由于原问题计算困难，引入包含领导者策略、跟随者策略、对抗核与对偶变量的四玩家原始-对偶代理博弈，并设计单环路乐观镜像下降-上升算法进行求解。

Result: 证明代理博弈始终下界截断硬约束目标，量化代理与硬约束目标之间的差距，并给出代理可精确恢复鲁棒目标的精确性条件；证明代理博弈对偶间隙具有 O(1/√T) 的平均迭代收敛率，进而得到原鲁棒目标的近优鲁棒策略。在受控表格博弈与不确定偏好下的 LLM 对齐实验中验证了收敛理论，并优于名义基线。

Conclusion: Robust Nash Alignment 为不确定成对偏好下的对齐提供了具有认证下界与收敛保证的博弈论方法，实验表明其收敛性与性能均优于名义基线。

Abstract: Preference-based alignment methods typically optimize against a single preference model, and can therefore be brittle when pairwise preferences are uncertain: noisy, heterogeneous, or shift after deployment. To address these issues, we propose Robust Nash Alignment, a game-theoretic framework for alignment to uncertain pairwise preferences. Our formulation has a major learner seeking a policy with a large worst-case win rate against both an adversarial competitor and any preference kernel lying in an ambiguity set around a nominal preference. When the ambiguity set captures the uncertainty in preferences, the resulting robust objective of the game directly yields a certified lower bound on worst-case performance. However, we note this problem is computationally challenging to optimize, and to address this, we introduce a four-player primal-dual proxy game involving the leader policy, follower policy, adversarial kernel, and dual variable, and develop a single-loop optimistic mirror descent-ascent algorithm for it. We show that the proxy always lower-bounds the truncated hard-constrained objective, quantify the proxy-to-hard gap, and characterize an exactness condition under which the proxy recovers the robust objective. We then prove an \(\mathcal{O}(1/\sqrt{T})\) average-iteration convergence for the proxy-game duality gap, which implies a near-optimal robust policy for the original robust objective. Experiments on controlled tabular games and LLM alignment with uncertain preference further validate the convergence theory and show improved performance over nominal baselines.

</details>


### [689] [Kepler: Auditable World Models for ARC-AGI-3](https://arxiv.org/abs/2610.00834)
*Wensen Wu*

Main category: cs.AI

TL;DR: 提出开源评测框架 Kepler，用可执行世界模型表达假设，并通过回溯性转移检查与条件预测检查进行验证；在 ARC-AGI-3 全部 25 个公开游戏上达到服务端验证的 100.00 RHAE，同时报告三类评测失效与公开集分数区分度不足的问题。


<details>
  <summary>Details</summary>
Motivation: ARC-AGI-3 要求在交互环境中通过观察推断规则与目标，这类任务的评测容易被"结果分数"掩盖过程性问题：分数可能来自源码泄漏、脚手架被隐式重建、或自动修复掩盖规划器故障。因此需要一种能够显式表示并验证假设的评测框架，以及更细粒度的报告口径。

Method: Kepler 是开源评测 harness，将智能体假设表示为可执行的世界模型，并用两类检查验证：回溯性转移检查（回顾已发生转移是否与世界模型一致）与条件预测检查（在给定条件下预测后续结果）。评测在单一冻结配置（Claude Opus 5）下进行，不做逐游戏模型选择、不做分数条件化重跑；同时设置控制条件以检测 harness 被移除后的行为，并记录 provider 会话级 token、缓存与成本。

Result: 单冻结 Claude Opus 5 配置下，25 个公开游戏全部达到服务端验证的 100.00 RHAE。183 个已完成关卡中有 181 个的最终 Opus 尝试所用动作数不超过对应人类中位数基线。保留的有效运行共 8,256 次环境动作，其中 7,292 次发生在计分关卡内。保留的本地 provider 会话记录为 8.580 亿 token、97.37% 为缓存读取，按 2026-09-01 API 等价目录价计为 777.72 美元。另报告三类评测失效：源码泄漏导致无效的满分运行；控制条件下智能体自行重建被移除的 harness；自动修复掩盖了规划器损坏。单游戏观察案例显示动画帧包含已沉降文本网格中缺失的任务相关信息。在最终 Claude Opus 5 与 GPT-5.6 Sol 面板中，50 个游戏-模型单元有 48 个达到 100。

Conclusion: 公开集分数本身区分度有限（50 个单元中 48 个满分），不足以衡量智能体能力；应转向首次尝试口径、成本条件化以及验证感知的评价报告方式，并正视源码泄漏、脚手架重建、自动修复掩盖故障等评测有效性威胁。

Abstract: ARC-AGI-3 evaluates agents in interactive environments whose rules and objectives must be inferred from observation. We present Kepler, an open-source harness that represents hypotheses as executable world models and validates them through retrospective transition checks and conditional prediction checks. Under one frozen Claude Opus 5 configuration, Kepler obtained a server-verified 100.00 RHAE on all 25 public games, with no per-game model selection or score-conditioned reruns. On 181 of 183 completed levels, the final Opus attempt used no more actions than the corresponding median-human baseline. The retained board runs used 8,256 environment actions, of which 7,292 occurred in scored levels. Retained local provider-session records yield 858.0 million tokens, 97.37% cache reads, and a \$777.72 cost at September 1, 2026 API list-equivalent rates. We also report three evaluation failures: source-code leakage that produced an invalid perfect run, agents reconstructing a removed harness in a control condition, and autonomous repair masking a broken planner. A single-game observation case study showed that animation frames contained task-relevant information absent from settled text grids. Across the final Claude Opus 5 and GPT-5.6 Sol boards, 48 of 50 game-model cells reached 100. These results indicate that public-set score alone has limited discriminative value and motivate first-attempt, cost-conditioned, and verification-aware reporting.

</details>


### [690] [An Educator-Guided LLM Pedagogical Agent for Scaffolded Feedback in Conceptual Database Design](https://arxiv.org/abs/2610.00870)
*Sara Riazi,Pedram Rooshenas*

Main category: cs.AI

TL;DR: 提出一种教育者引导的LLM教学智能体，在ERD编辑器中以四阶段工作流提供分阶段脚手架反馈，实现"隐藏诊断"与"面向学生披露"的解耦；在三个环境、383个反馈回合的部署中，71.1%的变更完全或部分采纳了隐藏诊断目标，访谈反馈偏向延迟披露与学生自主性。


<details>
  <summary>Details</summary>
Motivation: 概念数据库设计（ERD）学习中，学生需要脚手架式反馈，但LLM直接生成的反馈往往脱离学生具体制品与课程要求，且一次性全量披露答案会削弱学生的自主探究；同时，将诊断结果直接暴露给学生还可能因错误诊断而误导学习。因此需要一种既能基于教育者意图进行可靠诊断、又能控制反馈形式与披露层级的教学智能体架构。

Method: 系统嵌入ERD编辑器，反馈依据学生制品、作业要求、教育者编写的评分标准和教学资源进行接地（grounding）；架构将"隐藏的、基于制品的诊断"与"控制学生可见支持形式及披露层级的工作流"分离。实例化为四阶段流程：概念检查→引导应用→低细节反馈→局部澄清。每次反馈请求生成一个有状态回合，并与版本化的ERD状态关联。

Result: 在覆盖三个ERD环境、383个反馈回合的部署中，71.1%的观测到的目标层级修改完全或部分纳入了隐藏诊断目标，其中不少发生在第一、二阶段之后。定性分析显示：分阶段披露有时能抑制不准确细节、支持选择性采纳或允许后续纠正，但部分错误仍影响了学生修改。自选样本的问卷偏好延迟披露与学生自主性，同时指出反馈间接、重复的问题。

Conclusion: 教育者引导、诊断与披露解耦的分阶段脚手架反馈架构，可在保持学生自主性的同时有效传递教学意图；但需权衡披露延迟带来的间接性与重复感，并防范诊断错误对学生修改的持续影响。

Abstract: We present an educator-guided LLM pedagogical agent for scaffolded feedback in conceptual database design. Integrated into an entity--relationship diagram (ERD) editor, the system grounds feedback in the student artifact, assignment requirements, educator-authored rubrics, and instructional resources. Its architecture separates hidden, artifact-grounded diagnosis from the workflow that controls the form and disclosure level of student-facing support.
  We instantiate the architecture as a four-stage workflow progressing from concept checks and guided application to low-detail feedback and localized clarification. Each feedback request creates a stateful episode linked to versioned ERD states. In a deployment spanning three ERD environments and 383 feedback episodes, 71.1\% of observed target-level changes fully or partially incorporated the hidden diagnostic target, including many after Stages~1--2. Qualitative analysis showed that staged disclosure sometimes withheld inaccurate details, supported selective uptake, or allowed later recovery, though some errors still shaped revisions. Survey responses from a self-selected sample favored delayed disclosure and student agency but noted indirectness and repetition.

</details>


### [691] [MemFit: Efficient Long-Term Agentic Memory](https://arxiv.org/abs/2610.00872)
*Mitchell Piehl,Muchao Ye*

Main category: cs.AI

TL;DR: MemFit 是一种面向对话智能体的长期记忆系统，通过免LLM的写入与多路径检索，在降低记忆构建成本与延迟的同时，于三个基准上达到最优性能。


<details>
  <summary>Details</summary>
Motivation: 现有 LLM 长期记忆系统依赖 LLM 智能体来组织与整合记忆，导致写入操作昂贵且低效，亟需降低记忆构建的成本与延迟。

Method: MemFit 将每轮对话逐字存入仅追加存储，插入过程免 LLM、近乎即时；以片段摘要为轮次建立索引而非替换原文；并采用免 LLM 的多路径检索策略，在文本与多模态场景下融合词汇与语义信号，并对标题增强的片段进行交叉编码器重排序。

Result: 在 LoCoMo、MemGallery 与 LongMemEval-S 三个常用基准上，MemFit 取得当前最优性能，同时将记忆构建时间与成本降低数倍。

Conclusion: MemFit 为持久化智能体记忆提供了一种可扩展且高效的解决方案，在保证检索与推理质量的同时显著降低记忆构建开销。

Abstract: Long-term memory systems for large language models (LLMs) have gained popularity for extending reasoning capabilities across applications. Current memory systems rely on LLM agents to organize and consolidate memory, resulting in costly, inefficient write operations. To address this limitation, we propose MemFit, a long-term memory system for conversational agents that reduces the cost and latency of memory operations. Unlike existing systems that rely on expensive LLM calls for memory construction or discard surface-level details through compression, MemFit stores each turn verbatim in an append-only store with near-instantaneous, LLM-free insertion, indexing turns with segment summaries rather than replacing them. Additionally, MemFit uses an LLM-free, multi-path retrieval strategy that combines lexical and semantic signals with cross-encoder reranking over caption- augmented episodes in both textual and multimodal settings. Empirical results on three widely used benchmarks, LoCoMo, MemGallery, and LongMemEval-S, show that MemFit achieves state-of-the-art performance while reducing memory construction time and cost several-fold, providing a scalable and efficient solution for persistent agentic memory.

</details>


### [692] [OR for AI That Does OR: Routing LLMs up the Escalator inside the OSCAR Framework](https://arxiv.org/abs/2610.00912)
*Jinzhi Bu,Haixin Tang,Huanan Zhang*

Main category: cs.AI

TL;DR: 本文提出 OSCAR 框架，利用经标注决策样例认证的离线 Simulator、Coder 和 Reviewer，在多个价格与能力不同的 LLM 之间分配尝试次数，并持续搜索直至获得可认证的改进，从而以低成本生成准确的优化模型。


<details>
  <summary>Details</summary>
Motivation: LLM 可将业务描述转化为优化模型，但生成的代码可能错误表达约束或目标，导致求解器为错误问题返回最优解；即使方案满足既定规则，也可能存在更优计划。面向反复使用优化建模的组织，需要一个低成本、可本地部署且能验证改进并合理分配多 LLM 尝试的框架。

Method: 提出 OSCAR，包含离线 Simulator、Coder 和 Reviewer；Simulator 用带标签的可行/不可行决策样例进行认证，用于比较候选并超越可行性继续搜索。将寻找下一次可认证改进建模为难度不可观测下的序贯决策，决定调用哪些 LLM 及何时停止；在已知先验简化设定下给出按成本递增升级最优的条件，对一般菜单推导无先验竞争保证。

Result: 在五个基准问题上，OSCAR 使用两个可单 GPU 本地部署的小型开放权重 LLM，在报告设置下达到 95% 至 100% 准确率，而单次尝试准确率平均仅为 29% 和 48%。每个问题五次运行中，Codex 和 Claude Code 的平均 token 成本分别是 OSCAR 的 3.1 倍和 5.8 倍。

Conclusion: OSCAR 支持开放权重模型本地或云端部署，兼顾预算与保密需求。企业应维护可行与不可行决策的标注样例以澄清自然语言运营规则，并在 LLM 解释冲突时以标签为准。随着 LLM 能力与价格变化，OSCAR 的简单操作规则与可调设置有助于企业调整模型选择并受益于技术进展。

Abstract: Large language models can translate business descriptions into optimization models, but executable code may misrepresent constraints or objectives. A solver can then return an optimal solution to the wrong problem. Even when the solution satisfies the intended operating rules, a better plan may exist. For organizations that repeatedly use optimization modeling, an LLM-based framework should produce accurate formulations at low cost and, ideally, run locally. We study how to verify improvements and allocate attempts across LLMs that differ in price and capability. We develop OSCAR (Optimization modeling by Simulator, Coder, And Reviewer), which uses an offline Simulator certified against labeled decision examples to compare candidates and continues searching beyond feasibility. We model the search for the next certified improvement as sequential decisions under unobserved difficulty: which LLMs to call and when to stop. In a simplified known-prior setting, we give conditions under which cost-ordered escalation is optimal. For general menus, we derive a prior-free competitive guarantee. On five benchmark problems, OSCAR achieves 95% to 100% accuracy at the reported settings using two small open-weight LLMs, each deployable locally on a single GPU. Their single-attempt accuracies average 29% and 48%. In five runs per problem, Codex and Claude Code incur average token costs 3.1 and 5.8 times OSCAR's, respectively. OSCAR supports open-weight models locally or in the cloud, depending on budget and confidentiality requirements. Firms should maintain labeled decision examples of feasible and infeasible decisions to clarify plain-language operating rules. OSCAR follows these labels when an LLM's interpretation conflicts with them. As LLM capabilities and prices change, OSCAR's simple operating rules and adjustable settings help firms adapt their model choices and benefit from these advances.

</details>


### [693] [Finding the Right Fit: Model-Harness Interactions across Agent Tasks](https://arxiv.org/abs/2610.00917)
*Yixuan Li,Yiyun Zhou,Yao Long Teng,Fuchao Yang,Yanchen Deng,Zhiyi Lyu,Xuyu Dong,Feng Chen,Bo An*

Main category: cs.AI

TL;DR: 论文评估了66种"模型+执行框架(harness)"组合在三个基准上的表现，发现模型排名会随框架和基准变化，模型能力、框架与任务应联合评估，而非单独比较模型。


<details>
  <summary>Details</summary>
Motivation: 选择智能体系统意味着同时选择语言模型和其行动的框架。论文质疑：强模型、强框架或强配对在设定改变时是否依然强，即模型能力是否具有跨框架、跨任务的稳定性。

Method: 构建66种配置：四种可配置框架（OpenHands、DeepSeek Harness、PI、openJiuwen）与五种模型组合，外加原生Codex-GPT与Claude Code-Claude配对；在TUA-Bench、ALE-CLI和Terminal-Bench 4上评测，并结合匹配轨迹分析失败反馈方式与成本。

Result: 模型排名在不同框架间发生反转：Terminal-Bench 4上Claude在OpenHands领先GPT 7.94分，在PI却落后30.16分。五种模型中四种的最佳框架随基准变化，但openJiuwen在三基准上均给Kimi最高分（高出5.61–11.11分）。厂商自家框架不一定最优，成本高也不必然得分高——GPT在PI下比DSH得分更高且单任务成本不到四分之一。轨迹分析显示模型几乎自行发起所有修复，成效取决于框架能否把失败以可用形式返回；GPT偏好PI的简洁脚手架，而常发出畸形工具调用的Kimi最适配openJiuwen。

Conclusion: 模型、框架与任务应作为一个整体联合评估，而非孤立比较模型能力；作者公开了框架适配器、评测代码及全部6,204条评分轨迹。

Abstract: Choosing an agent system means choosing both a language model and the harness through which it acts. We ask whether a strong model, harness, or pairing stays strong when the setting changes. We evaluate 66 configurations: four configurable harnesses (OpenHands, DeepSeek Harness, PI, and openJiuwen) paired with five models on TUA-Bench, ALE-CLI, and Terminal-Bench 4, plus the native Codex-GPT and Claude Code-Claude pairings. Model rankings reverse across harnesses. On Terminal-Bench 4, Claude leads GPT by 7.94 points in OpenHands but trails it by 30.16 points in PI. For four of the five models, the best harness changes from one benchmark to another, yet some pairings hold: openJiuwen gives Kimi its highest score on all three benchmarks, by 5.61 to 11.11 points. A model's own vendor harness is not reliably its best, and higher cost does not reliably buy a higher score. On Terminal-Bench 4, GPT scores higher under PI than under DSH at less than a quarter of the cost per task. Matched trajectories suggest why fit varies. Models start almost all repairs themselves, so much depends on whether the harness hands failures back in a form the model can use.
