GPT does best with PI's lean scaffold, while Kimi, which often issues malformed tool calls, does best in openJiuwen. We argue that the model, the harness, and the task should be evaluated together, and we release the harness adapters, evaluation code, and all 6,204 scored trajectories at https://github.com/liyix/finding-the-right-fit and https://huggingface.co/datasets/yixuanli97/finding-the-right-fit.

</details>


### [694] [ABDA-NL: A Natural-Language Scenario Explorer for Argument-Based Reasoning](https://arxiv.org/abs/2610.00947)
*Shawn Bowers,Martin Caminada,Haoyang Liu,Bertram Ludäscher*

Main category: cs.AI

TL;DR: ABDA-NL 在 ABDA（基于 ASPIC- 知识库、采用 grounded 语义的论证式讨论系统）上增加自然语言接口，用户可查看结论的接受/拒绝/未定状态、展开 grounded 讨论博弈理解原因、通过暂停假设与规则或更改偏好探索 what-if 方案、基于场景参考文档提问，并以英文撰写新事实、假设和规则。LLM 充当语言与形式化之间的桥梁：既基于文档和当前场景状态回答问题，也把自然语言编辑翻译为候选形式化陈述。确定性的 ABDA 引擎仍是论证、攻击与接受标签的唯一来源，模型的每个提案都须经用户验证确认后方能生效。


<details>
  <summary>Details</summary>
Motivation: 使非形式化背景的用户也能使用基于 ASPIC- 与 grounded 语义的论证系统，降低形式化编辑与理解论证过程的门槛。

Method: 在 ABDA 之上叠加自然语言界面：由 LLM 完成文档问答与自然语言到候选形式化陈述的翻译；ABDA 确定性引擎负责论证、攻击与接受标签的计算；所有模型提案经用户校验确认后生效。

Result: 系统支持三类交互：结论状态查看与 grounded 讨论博弈的可视化解释、通过暂停假设/规则或修改偏好进行 what-if 探索、基于参考文档的问答与用自然语言撰写事实/假设/规则。

Conclusion: 通过"LLM 负责语言桥接、确定性引擎负责论证推理、用户负责最终确认"的分工，ABDA-NL 在保持形式化语义可靠性的同时提供了自然语言可交互性。

Abstract: ABDA-NL adds a natural-language interface to ABDA, a system for argument-based discussion using ASPIC- knowledge bases under grounded semantics. Users see which conclusions are accepted, rejected, or undecided, open an interactive rendering of the grounded discussion game to learn why, explore what-if alternatives by suspending assumptions and rules or changing preferences, ask questions that are answered from a scenario's reference documents, and author new facts, assumptions, and rules in plain English. A large language model provides the bridge between language and formalism: it answers questions from the documents and the current state of the scenario, and it translates plain-English edits into candidate formal statements. The deterministic ABDA engine remains the sole source of arguments, attacks, and acceptance labels, and every proposal of the model is validated and confirmed by the user before it takes effect.

</details>


### [695] [PG-SFT: Balancing Capability Acquisition and Retention in Offline Agent Fine-Tuning](https://arxiv.org/abs/2610.00949)
*Ronghua Li,Zi Liang,Zhishan Li,Shinan Liu*

Main category: cs.AI

TL;DR: 本文提出 Privilege-Guided SFT (PG-SFT)，利用 agent 轨迹的 turn-level 信息增益来调节监督强度，从而缓解 SFT 带来的分布漂移与通用能力退化。


<details>
  <summary>Details</summary>
Motivation: 对离线 agent 轨迹做标准 SFT 是训练工具使用型 agent 的常规做法，但逐 token 强制模仿会损害基座模型的通用推理、工具调用、代码生成等能力。作者关注如何在 agent trace SFT 中平衡“获取新能力”与“保留既有能力”。

Method: 对比多种基线后，发现标准 SFT 提升目标任务但降低非目标 benchmark 分数；KL 惩罚约束分布漂移或限制更新幅度均无法避免退化。受 token-wise 自适应学习目标启发，提出 PG-SFT，以 agent 轨迹的 turn-level 信息增益作为指标来调整监督强度。

Result: PG-SFT 在所评估的 benchmark 上取得更有利的权衡：显著降低分布漂移和广泛的 capability degradation，代价是目标任务性能略有下降。

Conclusion: 平衡获取—保留权衡不仅取决于模型是否被锚定于其基座行为，还取决于监督应在何处以及以多强的程度偏离该行为。

Abstract: Supervised fine-tuning (SFT) on offline agent trajectories is the standard approach for training specialized tool-using agents, but forcing models to imitate reasoning and actions token by token may harm other capabilities (e.g., general reasoning, tool calling, code generation) of the base model. In this work, we focus on studying \emph{how to better balance the trade-off between acquiring new capabilities and preserving existing ones during agent trace SFT}. By comparing several baselines in our setup, standard SFT improves the target benchmark while lowering several non-target benchmark scores; meanwhile, simply constraining distributional drift using KL penalty or limiting the update magnitude did not avoid this regression trend. Motivated by recent token-wise adaptive learning objectives, this work proposes \textbf{Privilege-Guided SFT (PG-SFT)} to leverage turn-level information gain of agent trajectories as an indicator to adjust supervision strength. PG-SFT yields a more favorable observed trade-off on the evaluated benchmarks, substantially reducing distributional drift and broad capability degradation at the cost of slight degradation in target-task performance. Our findings suggest that balancing the acquisition--retention trade-off depends not only on whether the model is anchored to its base behavior, but also on where and how strongly supervision should depart from that behavior.}

</details>


### [696] [Cybernetic and Epistemic: A Missing Vocabulary for Trustworthy Agentic Delegation](https://arxiv.org/abs/2610.00961)
*Jérémie Lumbroso*

Main category: cs.AI

TL;DR: 随着代码生成日益交由AI承担，监督系统（而非写代码）成为瓶颈。论文指出当前"人类监督"话语缺乏对语言两种功能的区分——协调行动（控制论）与协调理解（认识论），并指出真实失败是"认识论形式的语言在做控制论的工作"。作者提出一项治理准则：每个重要选择都应附带其"本可不同"的条件，且形式上可被第三方检验；并给出可操作化的"两段式重建检验"与审议记录规范ORRCF。


<details>
  <summary>Details</summary>
Motivation: 代码生成逐渐被委托给AI系统，瓶颈从"写代码"转向"监督写代码的系统"，但领域在要求"人类监督"时缺乏可用的概念区分：语言的两种功能——协调行动（控制论：话语成功当世界与之相符）与协调理解（认识论：话语成功当它回应世界、听者能核查）。缺乏这一区分导致"仅检查输出是否被批准"的监督可被橡皮图章式认可满足，而真正的问责要求推理可检索、可核查。

Method: 以概念分析结合三类委托实例（作为示例而非对照证据）：(1) 认识论参与可行且仍可审计的委托案例；(2) 公开记录中一项建议依据其自身陈述的条件被撤回的案例；(3) 一个失败案例，展示不需给出裁量理由的监督。在此基础上提出：将"每个重要选择都携带其本可不同的条件、且第三方可检验"作为代理系统治理准则，并给出操作化形式——两段式重建检验（由第二位读者判断能否预测扰动下代理的行为），以及审议记录规范 ORRCF，把该条件列为每项记录选择的必备组成部分。

Result: 提出了一项面向代理系统治理的准则，可与现有技术信任属性并存：每个重要选择都应携带其"本可不同"的条件，并以第三方可测试的形式呈现；否则第三方无法区分"决策"与"橡皮图章"。给出该准则的操作化实现：两段式重建检验（对委托记录打分，看第二位读者能否预测代理在扰动下的行为）与审议记录规范 ORRCF（把条件设为每项记录选择的必填项）。三个委托实例用于说明认识论参与在实践中可行且可审计，另含一个依据自身条件撤回建议的公开记录与一个失败案例。

Conclusion: 监督的关键不在于输出是否被批准，而在于代理工作背后的推理是否可检索、可核查；为此应把"本可不同"的条件制度化，通过两段式重建检验与ORRCF记录规范，使第三方能够区分真正的决策与橡皮图章，从而支撑对AI代码生成系统的实质问责。

Abstract: As code generation is increasingly delegated to AI systems, the bottleneck is shifting from writing code to supervising the systems that write it --- a shift CS-education researchers have begun to name. This shift exposes a vocabulary gap: the field asks for "human oversight" without a working distinction between the two things language does in a delegation channel --- coordinate action (cybernetic: words succeed when the world comes to match them) and coordinate understanding (epistemic: they succeed when they answer to the world and a hearer can check that they do). The failure this names is not cybernetic language but epistemic-form language doing cybernetic work: explanation-shaped output calibrated for approval rather than truth. Oversight that checks only whether an output was approved is satisfiable by rubber-stamping; oversight that holds an agent accountable requires the reasoning behind its work be retrievable and checkable. We present three delegation episodes --- illustrations, not controlled evidence --- in which epistemic engagement proved practicable while remaining auditable, one public record where a recommendation was withdrawn on its own stated terms, and one failure case illustrating oversight that requires no reasons for its discretionary choices. We propose a criterion for agentic-system governance, alongside existing technical trust properties: every consequential choice should carry the condition under which it would have gone otherwise, in a form a third party can test. Without such a condition, a third party cannot distinguish a decision from a rubber stamp. We give the criterion an operational form --- a two-part reconstruction test scoring a delegation record by whether a second reader can predict what the agent does under a perturbation --- and a deliberation-recording convention, ORRCF, that makes the condition a required component of every recorded choice.

</details>


### [697] [VeriHarness: Scaling Agentic Verification for Long-Horizon Tasks](https://arxiv.org/abs/2610.00972)
*Caiqi Zhang,Rujun Han,Zifeng Wang,Zoey CuiZhu,Nigel Collier,Tomas Pfister,Chen-Yu Lee*

Main category: cs.AI

TL;DR: 本文提出 VeriHarness，一种在固定基座模型、测试时无参考答案或评分标准的条件下，通过智能体验证机制提升长时程任务输出验证能力的方法，在五个基准和两个前沿模型上取得最优选择分数。


<details>
  <summary>Details</summary>
Motivation: 随着 LLM 智能体承担越来越复杂、长时程的任务，其输出验证变得愈发困难。重复采样可产生包含互补正确论断的多个 rollout，但缺乏在测试时无参考答案与评分标准情况下可靠的验证机制来判断哪些论断可信。

Method: 作者先观察到分歧常暴露正确替代方案、而共识可能掩盖错误。据此提出 VeriHarness：将生成器所用 LLM 转变为智能体验证器，为其提供工作区、证据工具与可复用验证技能。其中"分歧解决器"针对环境证据检验相互竞争的论断，"共识挑战器"测试共享论断并搜索遗漏的需求，二者发现结果用于最终产物的选择与修订。验证技能还可从失败反馈中自我改进。

Result: 在五个长时程工作区基准和两个前沿模型上，VeriHarness 在所评估基线中取得最高的选择分数；基于证据的修订进一步提升平均性能，相较单次 rollout 分别提升 6.2 分（Gemini 3.5 Flash）和 6.4 分（Claude Opus 4.8）。

Conclusion: VeriHarness 是扩展长时程智能体验证的一种新颖且关键的方法。作者公开了约 26,000 个 rollout、覆盖全部五个基准与两个模型，成本超过 10 万美元，以支持后续智能体验证研究。

Abstract: As LLM agents undertake increasingly complex, long-horizon tasks, verifying their outputs becomes increasingly challenging. We study how verification capability can be strengthened with a fixed base model, without access to reference answers or grading rubrics at test time. Repeated sampling yields multiple rollouts that can contain complementary correct claims, but we need a reliable verification mechanism to determine which claims to trust. We first find that disagreement often exposes correct alternatives, while consensus can conceal errors. These observations motivate VeriHarness, which turns the underlying LLM a generator uses into an agentic verifier by giving it a workspace, evidence tools, and reusable verification skills. A disagreement resolver checks competing claims against environmental evidence, while a consensus challenger tests shared claims and searches for omitted requirements. Their findings guide the selection and revision of the final artifact. Across five long-horizon workspace benchmarks and two frontier models, VeriHarness achieves the highest selection scores among the evaluated baselines. Evidence-backed revision further improves average performance, bringing gains over a single rollout to 6.2 points with Gemini 3.5 Flash and 6.4 points with Claude Opus 4.8. We further show that verification skills can self-improve from failure feedback, demonstrating VeriHarness as a novel and critical approach for scaling long-horizon agentic verification. We release the full pool of approximately 26,000 rollouts across all five benchmarks and both models, produced at a cost of over $100,000, to support future research on agentic verification.

</details>


### [698] [RISED: RubrIcs for agentic multi-environment Selection and sElf-Distillation](https://arxiv.org/abs/2610.00979)
*Jingtan Wang,Sirajul Salekin,Young mok Jung,Javier Movellan,Bryan Kian Hsiang Low,Manjot Bilkhu*

Main category: cs.AI

TL;DR: 该论文提出RISED框架，将评分量表（rubrics）从单纯的奖励信号扩展为在线数据选择与策略监督的指导信号，用于多环境联合训练的LLM智能体。实验表明RISED在不同模型骨干上取得最高平均通过率，并在各单一环境中排名第一或第二。


<details>
  <summary>Details</summary>
Motivation: 在多环境联合训练通用LLM智能体时，现有的课程与数据选择策略通常以环境为粒度分配训练，或依赖局部奖励信号，未显式考虑跨环境当前rollout之间的关系以进行prompt组选择；同时由于各环境学习速率不同，批次内会同时存在全失败与全成功的rollout组，这些数据缺乏组内相对奖励信号。二者共同暴露了多环境RL中仅依赖标量奖励的局限：标量奖励无法提供跨环境关系信息，且在奖励相同时缺乏组内对比。这促使研究者引入更丰富的文本反馈（如描述rollout行为的rubrics）来指导学习。

Method: RISED将rubrics的用途从奖励扩展为三重功能：（1）数据选择——用LLM评判器依据跨环境共享的预定义rubric词表为每个rollout打标签，得到的profile用于选择与混合环境批次整体行为构成一致、同时限制与已选数据重叠的样本；（2）策略监督——利用可用的正向rubrics（描述期望行为）作为privileged context供on-policy自蒸馏教师使用，提供额外的token级监督；（3）生成引导——利用负向rubrics（描述不期望行为）引导后续rollout生成远离反复出现的失败模式。三者共同构成RISED框架。

Result: 在不同模型骨干上，RISED在跨环境的平均通过率上取得最高值，并在每个单独环境中排名第一或第二。基于rubric的分析还能刻画伴随这些性能提升所发生的行为变化。

Conclusion: 将rubrics从奖励信号重新利用为在线数据选择和策略监督的指导信号，是一种有效的多环境RL训练范式；它能弥补标量奖励在跨环境关系建模与组内对比缺失方面的不足，rised在多环境通用智能体训练中展现出稳定优势。

Abstract: Training a single LLM agent jointly across diverse interactive environments has attracted increasing attention as a route to generalist agents. Existing curriculum and data-selection strategies often allocate training at the environment level or prioritize local reward-based signals, without explicitly considering relationships between current rollouts across environments for prompt-group selection. Meanwhile, as environments are learned at different rates, all-failure and all-success rollout groups can coexist within a batch, leaving those data without group-relative reward signals. Both challenges highlight limitations of relying solely on scalar rewards in multi-environment RL: they provide limited information about cross-environment relationships and no within-group reward contrast when rewards are identical. This motivates richer textual feedback, such as rubrics describing rollout behaviours, to guide learning. Beyond rubrics' usage as reward, we repurpose rubrics to guide both online data selection and policy supervision. An LLM judge tags each rollout using a predefined rubric vocabulary shared across environments. The resulting profiles guide the selection of data that aligns with the overall behavioural composition of the mixed-environment batch while limiting overlap with already-selected data. Available positive rubrics (describing desired behaviours) provide privileged context for an on-policy self-distillation teacher, supplying additional token-level supervision, while negative rubrics (describing undesired behaviours) guide subsequent rollout generation away from recurring failure modes. Together, these components form RISED. Across model backbones, RISED achieves the highest mean pass rate across environments and ranks first or second in every individual environment. Rubric-based analysis of RISED can further characterize the behavioural changes accompanying these gains.

</details>


### [699] [Evaluating LLM-Generated Preference Distributions](https://arxiv.org/abs/2610.01000)
*Fan Huang,Minsuk Kim,C. Tyler Diggans,Filippo Radicchi*

Main category: cs.AI

TL;DR: 本文系统分析了LLM作为概率生成器时输出的偏好分布，发现模型内部具有自洽性但模型间存在显著不一致，结果更多受模型选择而非提示词表述影响。


<details>
  <summary>Details</summary>
Motivation: LLM日益被用作仿真、合成数据生成和决策支持的的概率生成器，但其生成分布的结构与可靠性尚未被充分研究，尤其在其替代真实调查受访者时的可靠性存疑。

Method: 系统分析LLM生成的航空旅行、餐厅和消费品偏好分布，覆盖九个开放权重模型、三个选择域，并在温度变化、贪心解码及提示词与顺序扰动条件下进行稳健性检验。

Result: 所有模型均表现出自洽性，最可能结果在重复采样下快速稳定；但不同模型家族与规模间存在显著不一致，即使最可能结果也鲜有共识；上述模式在多种条件下稳健。

Conclusion: LLM生成结果更多受模型选择影响而非提示词表述，挑战了"足够强的LLM作为调查受访者替代时会产生相似偏好分布"的常见假设。

Abstract: Large Language Models (LLMs) are increasingly used as probabilistic generators for simulation, synthetic data generation, and decision support in settings where real-world data are unavailable. Yet, the structure and reliability of the distributions they produce remain understudied. Here, we systematically analyze LLM-generated distributions of preferences for air travel, restaurants, and consumer products. Encouragingly, all models considered in our analysis exhibit self-coherence, with the most probable outcomes stabilizing rapidly under repeated sampling. At the same time, we observe substantial discordance across both model families and scales, with little consensus even among their most probable outcomes. These patterns hold across nine open-weight models, three choice domains, and show robustness under temperature changes, greedy decoding, and perturbations of prompt and ordering. Our findings indicate that outcomes are influenced more by the choice of model than by the wording of the prompt, challenging the common assumption that sufficiently capable LLMs produce similar preference distributions when used as stand-ins for survey respondents.

</details>


### [700] [Calibration-risk routing for controlled world-model adaptation](https://arxiv.org/abs/2610.01001)
*Yifan Zhang,Liang Zheng*

Main category: cs.AI

TL;DR: 提出MC-WM框架，通过数据分区与标定风险比较解决MBRL中模拟器到目标的模型选择问题。


<details>
  <summary>Details</summary>
Motivation: 基于模型的强化学习可利用模拟经验，但模拟器与目标环境之间存在simulator-to-target shift，导致模型选择困难：在目标数据有限时，直接修正模拟器或直接拟合目标都可能失败。

Method: MC-WM将初始目标数据划分为互不重叠的拟合、选择、标定三个分区，依据标准化标定风险在候选模型族中选择风险更低者；并引入学习到的置信信号与确定性有效性谓词，对一步想象策略更新进行加权，而不改写物理奖励。

Result: 在三个受控的MuJoCo（Multi-Joint dynamics with Contact）迁移场景中，共评估540个唯一报告运行单元；其中一个精确路由单元在部署前伪影门控后重复执行，最终完成541次执行。

Conclusion: MC-WM通过分区化的模型选择与风险标定，在有限目标数据下缓解了模拟器到目标的迁移问题，并保持了物理奖励的原义。

Abstract: Model-based reinforcement learning (MBRL) can exploit simulated experience, but a simulator-to-target shift creates a model-selection problem: correcting the simulator and fitting the target directly can each fail under limited target data. We introduce the Model-Corrected World Model (MC-WM), which separates initial target data into disjoint fit, selection, and calibration partitions and deploys the family with lower standardized calibration risk. A learned confidence signal and deterministic validity predicates weight one-step imagined policy updates without rewriting physical rewards. We evaluate 540 unique reported run cells across three controlled Multi-Joint dynamics with Contact (MuJoCo) shifts; one exact-routing cell was repeated after a pre-deployment artifact gate, giving 541 completed executions.

</details>


### [701] [What Can Analogy Tell Us About Artificial Consciousness?](https://arxiv.org/abs/2610.01002)
*Keith J. Holyoak,Martin M. Monti*

Main category: cs.AI

TL;DR: 该文提出一个评估"意识类比论证"的因果框架，区分"意识生成因素的相似性"与"下游行为/认知效应的相似性"，并按因果相关性加权源-目标相似度，允许未知原因、失效差异与替代路径的存在。应用于生物系统可解释类比支持随"因果距离"增加而减弱；应用于当代AI则表明，行为相似性对意识的证据力有限，因为相关因果对应仍未被充分建立；并明确了何种证据能加强人工意识主张。


<details>
  <summary>Details</summary>
Motivation: 主观体验仅能第一人称直接通达，因此判定其他实体是否具有意识必须部分依赖类比推理。历史上此类推断主要针对非人动物，而AI的进展使"有意识的人工系统"成为可能议题，需要一个更严格的方法论来评估这类类比证据的强度。

Method: 构建因果框架来评价类比证据：核心区分在于"与意识生成相关的因素相似性"和"下游行为或认知效应相似性"；框架以因果相关性对源-目标相似度加权，并容纳三类情形——未知原因、失效性差异（disabling differences）、以及通往意识的替代路径。

Result: （1）在生物系统上，框架解释了为何随着与人类的因果距离增大，类比支持通常减弱；（2）在当代AI上，行为相似性只能为意识提供有限证据，因为相应的因果对应关系尚未被充分确立。

Conclusion: 行为层面的相似不足以支撑人工意识主张；该框架同时澄清了哪些类型的证据（即与意识生成因素建立可靠的因果对应）能够加强人工意识的论断。

Abstract: Who or what is conscious? Because subjective experience is directly accessible only in the first person, judgments about consciousness in other entities depend partly on analogy. Historically, such inferences have focused on nonhuman animals, but advances in artificial intelligence have raised the possibility of conscious AI. Here we develop a causal framework for evaluating such evidential analogies. The key distinction is between similarities in factors plausibly involved in generating consciousness and similarities in downstream behavioural or cognitive effects. Our framework weights source-target similarity by causal relevance while allowing for unknown causes, disabling differences and alternative routes to consciousness. Applied to biological systems, it explains why analogical support generally weakens with increasing causal distance from humans. Applied to contemporary AI, it suggests that behavioural similarity provides only limited evidence for consciousness because relevant causal correspondences remain poorly established. The framework also clarifies what evidence would strengthen claims of artificial consciousness.

</details>


### [702] [From Discovery to Decision: Finite-Budget Recoverability in LLM Voting](https://arxiv.org/abs/2610.01014)
*Shaoang Li,Jian Li*

Main category: cs.AI

TL;DR: 本文将多响应投票中的"发现-决策差距"形式化为基于已实现投票状态与剩余调用预算的可恢复性问题，推导了尖锐的可恢复性阈值与候选级转换窗口，并给出无金标准的精确锁定证书；实验显示多数"已发现但未被选中"的正确答案是在被发现之后才失去可达性，输入置换提升21.1个点，精确锁定在16次预算下节省28-30%调用。


<details>
  <summary>Details</summary>
Motivation: 测试时扩展与集成推理中，增加采样可扩大候选池、提高正确解被发现的概率；但在固定调用预算下，被发现的正确答案还需在剩余调用中累积足够支持才能成为多数投票赢家，由此产生"发现-决策差距"。本文旨在刻画这一差距，解释为何许多正确答案虽被发现却最终未被选中。

Method: 以已实现的投票状态和剩余调用预算为状态变量进行建模：推导尖锐的可恢复性阈值；证明随采样推进，已观测候选集只增、可达终点获胜者集只减，从而诱导候选级"转换窗口"；在指定iid响应分布下，由同一状态给出精确的有限时域终点概率；分析错误答案身份合并对单次正确性与plurality精度的影响，以及错误答案概率重分配效果对已实现状态的依赖；由单例可达性构造无金标准的精确锁定证书，其首次触发为所有可允许延续都产生相同固定预算输出的最早前缀。

Result: 多数"已发现但未被选中"的正确答案，其可达性丧失发生在被发现之后；在受控Word16实验中，输入置换使原始plurality准确率提升21.1个点，而单次调用正确率基本不变；精确锁定在16次调用预算下节省28-30%的调用，同时保持所有固定预算输出不变。

Conclusion: 多响应投票中存在可精确刻画的发现-决策差距：可达获胜者集随采样单调收缩，形成候选级转换窗口，并可用无金标准证书在保持输出不变的前提下提前锁定、节省调用预算；错误答案身份合并不改善plurality精度，而错误答案概率重分配的效果取决于已实现投票状态。

Abstract: Voting over multiple LLM responses is a common primitive in test-time scaling and ensemble inference. Collecting more responses can expand the candidate pool and increase the chance that a correct answer is discovered. Under a fixed call budget, a discovered answer still needs to accumulate enough support within the remaining calls to become the final plurality winner, creating a discovery-to-decision gap. In this work, we characterize this gap through the realized vote state and remaining call budget. We derive a sharp recoverability threshold and show that, as sampling proceeds, the observed candidate set can only expand while the set of reachable endpoint winners can only contract, inducing a candidate-level conversion window. Under a specified iid response law, the same state yields exact finite-horizon endpoint probabilities. We further show that merging wrong-answer identities preserves single-call correctness and cannot improve plurality accuracy, and that the effect of redistributing wrong-answer probability depends on the realized vote state. Singleton reachability yields a gold-free exact locking certificate. For a known answer universe, its first trigger is the earliest prefix at which all admissible continuations yield the same fixed-budget output. Empirically, most discovered-but-unselected correct answers lose reachability only after discovery. In a controlled Word16 study, input permutation improves raw-plurality accuracy by 21.1 points with essentially unchanged single-call correctness. Exact locking saves 28-30% of calls at a 16-call budget while preserving every fixed-budget output.

</details>


### [703] [Network World Models as Environments for Algorithm Design on Complex Systems](https://arxiv.org/abs/2610.01048)
*Rishab Alagharu,Hongji Pu,Zeeshan Memon,Xinyuan Song,Yuntong Hu,Liang Zhao*

Main category: cs.AI

TL;DR: 提出动作条件网络世界模型(ANWM)，学习网络在时序干预下的扩散动力学，作为快速评估器嵌入由编码智能体驱动的算法设计循环，在8类网络任务、5种扩散模型中141个设置里138个达到或超过最强基线，rollout提速最高14.5倍。


<details>
  <summary>Details</summary>
Motivation: 机器人等复杂系统中，动作效果并非即时显现（如播种节点、免疫节点），需评估多步展开后的结果；此类最大化期望性能的动作选择算法本质上是迭代的，需对每个候选动作按其产生的outcome打分。传统依赖蒙特卡洛模拟获得outcome，当候选需在多条采样轨迹上评估时，仿真成本成为瓶颈。

Method: 提出动作条件网络世界模型（Action-conditioned Network World Model）：学习网络在时间维度上受干预时的扩散动力学，对网络施加每个动作并预测随后的outcome。将其作为快速评估器嵌入算法设计循环，由编码智能体（coding agent）利用完整rollout反馈、动作级信用分配（action-level credit）以及对替代干预的反事实探测（counterfactual probes）来设计并迭代改进可执行算法。

Result: 在8类网络任务与5种扩散模型上，所设计算法在141个设置中的138个里匹配或超越已报告的最强基线；相比蒙特卡洛模拟，rollout速度最高提升14.5倍。

Conclusion: 动作条件网络世界模型可作为低成本、高保真的替代仿真器，支撑智能体自动设计网络干预算法，在保持或提升性能的同时大幅降低轨迹采样开销。代码将在录用后发布。

Abstract: World models, which simulate an environment and predict how it changes under actions, are increasingly used in real-world applications such as robotics. Complex systems call for the same tool because the effect of an action is not immediate. Seeding nodes for a campaign, or immunizing nodes against an epidemic, changes little on its own; what matters is the outcome that unfolds over the steps that follow. Designing an algorithm that selects such actions to maximize expected performance on a task is inherently iterative, and every candidate must be scored by the outcome it produces. Obtaining that outcome has relied on simulation, whose cost becomes a bottleneck when candidates are evaluated over many sampled trajectories. We propose an action-conditioned Network World Model that learns a network's diffusion dynamics under interventions over time, applies each action to the network, and predicts the outcome that follows. It serves as a fast evaluator inside an algorithm design loop in which a coding agent designs and refines executable algorithms using feedback from full rollouts, action-level credit, and counterfactual probes over alternative interventions. Across eight network tasks and five diffusion models, the designed algorithms match or exceed the strongest reported baseline in 138 of 141 settings while enabling up to 14.5 times faster rollouts than Monte Carlo simulation. Code will be released upon acceptance.

</details>


### [704] [Improving Math Reasoning through Value-guided Informative Search](https://arxiv.org/abs/2610.01080)
*Shaohuai Liu,Yuning Wu,Haoran Liu,Enzo Jia,Devin Chen,Kai Wei*

Main category: cs.AI

TL;DR: 提出 APIVIS 训练框架，将有限预算的 Gumbel 搜索适配到分块级数学推理，通过在 rollout 组内混合直接与搜索响应并选择性监督搜索改进的 token，解决"搜索提升多样性但未必提升策略"的问题，在多个数学推理基准上显著优于现有搜索类方法。


<details>
  <summary>Details</summary>
Motivation: RLVR 已显著提升大模型数学推理能力，近期工作将搜索引入 RLVR rollout 以增加轨迹多样性。然而，多样性本身并不能保证搜索诱导的 rollout 策略优于当前策略，即搜索带来的探索未必转化为有效策略改进。论文旨在填补这一空白，使搜索真正服务于策略优化而非仅增加样本多样性。

Method: 提出 APIVIS 训练时框架，将有限预算的 Gumbel 搜索适配到分块（chunk）级数学推理。核心做法：在每个 rollout 组内同时包含直接响应与搜索响应，使搜索找到的改进能产生有信息量的相对奖励；进一步对搜索改进的 token 施加选择性监督，避免组内奖励趋同导致 GRPO 失效时丢失学习信号。理论上证明精确值引导选择可提升每个搜索状态下的期望验证器奖励，并将该保证扩展到完整 rollout 策略，在值估计误差有界时给出近似保证。

Result: 在公认的数学推理基准及不同模型规模上的实验表明，APIVIS 相较有竞争力的搜索类方法取得显著提升，验证了框架的有效性。

Conclusion: APIVIS 通过混合直接与搜索响应、选择性监督搜索改进 token，将有限预算搜索有效融入 RLVR，实现了可理论保证的策略改进，并在多基准多规模上验证了优越性能。

Abstract: Reinforcement learning with verifiable rewards (RLVR) has substantially improved the mathematical reasoning capabilities of large language models. Recent work introduces search into RLVR rollouts to increase trajectory diversity, but diversity alone does not ensure that the search-induced rollout policy improves upon the current policy. To address this gap, we propose APIVIS, a training-time framework that adapts finite-budget Gumbel search to chunk-level mathematical reasoning. APIVIS combines direct and searched responses within each rollout group, allowing improvements found by search to produce informative relative rewards. It further applies selective supervision to search-improved tokens, preserving a learning signal when uniform group rewards render GRPO ineffective. We show that exact value-guided selection improves the expected verifier reward at each searched state and that this guarantee extends to the complete rollout policy, with a corresponding approximate guarantee under bounded value-estimation error. Experiments on widely recognized mathematical reasoning benchmarks and different model scales demonstrate substantial improvements over competitive search-based methods, validating the effectiveness of APIVIS.

</details>


### [705] [YouRA: A Persistent-State Architecture for Evidence-Traceable Autonomous Research Agents](https://arxiv.org/abs/2610.01097)
*Yoonkyu Woo,Woojin Lee,Jin-Xia Huang*

Main category: cs.AI

TL;DR: YouRA 是一种有状态的、证据可追溯的自主科研智能体架构，通过验证状态架构、独立控制器与状态化反思维护研究状态、执行证据与失败历史，在 MLR-Bench 端到端子集上稳定优于 MLR-Agent 与 AI Scientist V2。


<details>
  <summary>Details</summary>
Motivation: 端到端科研智能体已能生成完整科学论文，但手稿中的论断常与真实执行的实验相偏离。这一差距具有结构性成因：研究状态、失败历史与论断—证据一致性未被作为持久、可验证的状态在长周期流程中维护。

Method: YouRA 由三个组件构成：(1) 验证状态架构（VSA），跟踪假设、门控与证据指针；(2) 独立控制器，将状态与反思记录转化为生命周期、恢复与辩论/评审控制，并实现控制与执行解耦；(3) 状态化反思，将失败记录为结构化经验，并通过有界修复、重设计或重置路由恢复过程。此外还引入 MCP 工具访问。

Result: 在 MLR-Bench 预定义的十任务端到端子集上，YouRA 在三个匹配主干模型的标量 Overall 指标上均优于 MLR-Agent 与 AI Scientist V2；基于 MLR-Bench 幻觉分类法的自动诊断报告了四类事实型失败的交集/并集计数；数据溯源诊断显示其产出更多基于真实数据。消融 VSA、独立控制器、MCP 工具访问与反思引导恢复四个组件均验证其可分离贡献，移除任一核心状态组件都会使性能低于完整系统。

Conclusion: 维持持久、可验证的研究状态（状态架构与独立控制）是缓解科研智能体论断—证据偏离的关键；消融结果表明各状态组件具有不可替代的独立贡献。

Abstract: End-to-end research agents can now produce complete scientific papers, yet manuscript claims often diverge from executed experiments. This gap is structural: research state, failure histories, and claim-evidence alignment are not maintained as persistent, verifiable state across long-horizon pipelines. We present YouRA (Your Research Agent), an architecture for stateful, evidence-traceable autonomous research. YouRA preserves research state, execution evidence, and failure history across the research trajectory by integrating three components: a Verification State Architecture (VSA) that tracks hypotheses, gates, and evidence pointers; an Independent Controller that turns state and reflection records into lifecycle, recovery, and debate/review control while separating control from execution; and Stateful Reflection that logs failures as structured lessons and routes recovery through bounded repair, redesign, or reset. On MLR-Bench's predefined ten-task end-to-end subset, YouRA improves over both MLR-Agent and AI Scientist V2 on scalar Overall across all three matched backbones. An automated diagnostic using MLR-Bench's hallucination taxonomy reports intersection/union counts for four fact-based failure types, and data-provenance diagnostic shows more real-data-based outputs. Ablating each of the four components (the VSA, the Independent Controller, MCP tool access, and reflection-guided recovery) supports their separable contributions. Removing either core-state component drops YouRA below the full system. Code: https://github.com/PrayPrey/Your-Research-Agent.

</details>


### [706] [Beyond State-of-the-Art: Standardising Environmental Impact Metrics for AI Research](https://arxiv.org/abs/2610.01116)
*Lachlan McGinness,Dan Pagendam,Robert Offner*

Main category: cs.AI

TL;DR: 该论文对NeurIPS 2025的5285篇录用论文进行自动化文献综述，发现环境影响报告几乎缺失，为此提出标准化可持续性指标、推理碳成本估计方法、carbonbenchmark工具及SMAJ框架，以推动AI领域关注计算效率与环境责任。


<details>
  <summary>Details</summary>
Motivation: 随着大语言模型能力增强和普及，其环境足迹不断扩大；尽管学界呼吁负责任AI，机器学习社区仍缺乏标准化的碳排放核算实践，且现有研究普遍忽视环境影响报告。

Method: 对NeurIPS 2025录用的5285篇论文开展自动化文献综述以评估环境影响报告现状；定义标准化的可持续性评价指标，用于衡量模型训练效率；提出估计LLM推理碳成本的简单启发式方法；实现即插即用软件工具carbonbenchmark用于追踪与报告排放；并形式化SMAJ（实现任务的最小模型）框架。

Result: 综述结果显示，录用论文中环境影响报告几乎完全缺失；由此构建了标准化指标、推理碳成本启发式估算方法及carbonbenchmark工具，并提出SMAJ框架。

Conclusion: 机器学习社区亟需建立标准化的碳核算实践。通过标准化指标、carbonbenchmark工具与SMAJ框架，论文呼吁在追求SotA准确率的同时，优先考虑计算效率与环境责任，避免以不成比例的环境代价换取边际精度提升。

Abstract: As the capabilities and ubiquity of Large Language Models (LLMs) grow, so does their environmental footprint. Despite calls for responsible AI, the machine learning community lacks standardised practices for carbon accounting. Our automated literature review of the 5,285 papers accepted to NeurIPS 2025 reveals that reporting of environmental impact is nearly non-existent. To catalyse a shift toward sustainable AI, we define standardised sustainability metrics for evaluating model training efficiency, accompanied by simple heuristics to estimate the carbon cost of LLM inference. We implement these metrics in carbonbenchmark, a drop-in software solution for tracking and reporting emissions.
  Finally, to combat the pursuit of marginal accuracy gains at disproportionate environmental costs, we formalise the `Smallest Model that Achieves the Job' (SMAJ), a framework which challenges the field to prioritise computational efficiency and environmental accountability alongside traditional `State-of-the-Art' (SotA) accuracy.

</details>


### [707] [AbsorbEvo: An Agentic Framework for Autonomous Inverse Design of Microwave Absorbers](https://arxiv.org/abs/2610.01119)
*Zhicheng Feng,Yubo Zhao,Xuefeng Yao*

Main category: cs.AI

TL;DR: AbsorbEvo 是一个面向微波吸收体的自主逆向设计智能体框架，可将自然语言性能目标转化为经全波仿真验证的设计，在 AbsorbBench-36 上成功率 79.17%，显著优于通用智能体（25.00%）与随机搜索（12.50%）。


<details>
  <summary>Details</summary>
Motivation: 高性能微波吸收体设计需要电磁理论、材料科学与仿真编程的交叉专业知识，且优化过程耗时；因此需要一种能自主完成"自然语言目标→可验证设计"的逆向设计方法。

Method: 提出 AbsorbEvo 智能体框架，其候选进化策略融合语言推理、物理预测与历史反馈：由大语言模型依据任务目标与计算历史给出参数调整的方向与幅度；将有向增量与全局采样结合生成候选；用低成本预测模型作为物理先验对候选排序，仅对高排名设计执行全波仿真；通过物理有效性校验的结果用于性能评估并指导后续搜索；训练任务经验被蒸馏为文本化技能，经验证后方可用于新任务。

Result: 在相同提案预算下，于留出的 AbsorbBench-36 任务上，AbsorbEvo 任务成功率达 79.17%，通用智能体为 25.00%，随机搜索为 12.50%；平均最优覆盖率 0.7816，对照组分别为 0.6434 与 0.6448。

Conclusion: 将语言推理与基于物理的反馈整合进设计决策，AbsorbEvo 为自然语言驱动的微波吸收体自主逆向设计提供了方法论基础。

Abstract: Designing high-performance microwave absorbers requires specialized expertise in electromagnetic theory, materials science and simulation programming, and entails time-consuming optimization. Here, we present AbsorbEvo, an agentic framework for autonomous inverse design that translates natural-language performance objectives into designs verified by full-wave simulations. Its candidate evolution strategy integrates language reasoning, physics-based prediction and historical feedback. A large language model proposes the directions and magnitudes of parameter adjustments based on task objectives and computational history. The system combines directed increments with global sampling to generate candidates and uses a low-cost predictive model as a physics prior to rank them. Only high-ranking designs undergo full-wave simulation. Results passing physical validity checks are used to evaluate performance and guide subsequent search. Experience from training tasks is further distilled into textual skills, which are independently validated before use in new tasks. Under identical proposal budgets on held-out AbsorbBench-36 tasks, AbsorbEvo achieved a task success rate of 79.17%, versus 25.00% for a generic agent and 12.50% for random search. Its mean best coverage was 0.7816, compared with 0.6434 and 0.6448, respectively. By integrating language reasoning and physics-based feedback into design decisions, AbsorbEvo provides a methodological foundation for natural-language-driven autonomous inverse design of microwave absorbers.

</details>


### [708] [CortexBridge: Cortical Alignment of EEG Montages for Foundation Models](https://arxiv.org/abs/2610.01124)
*Jiazhen Hong,Xiaotian Zhou,Zihao Ding,Kailong Wang,Yu Wu*

Main category: cs.AI

TL;DR: 提出轻量适配器CortexBridge，将任意电极布局的EEG映射到共享皮层潜空间，提升冻结基础模型在跨蒙太奇BCI任务上的迁移性能。


<details>
  <summary>Details</summary>
Motivation: 现有EEG基础模型多以固定通道词表或有限蒙太奇预训练，电极布局变化时迁移困难，需解决异构蒙太奇到预训练模型的适配问题。

Method: CortexBridge结合EEG特征与电极坐标及图谱（atlas）坐标，将任意蒙太奇映射到共享皮层潜空间；在3个冻结基础模型（EEGPT、LaBraM、CBraMod）与MOABB的5个BCI数据集上评估，并进行图谱表征可视化分析。

Result: 15项评估中13项性能提升；平衡准确率平均提升EEGPT 0.80%、LaBraM 0.70%、CBraMod 3.26%，12类SSVEP分类最大提升13.02%；所学图谱表征呈任务依赖空间模式，SSVEP在Yeo视觉网络中的表征比听觉P300更集中。

Conclusion: 皮层对齐可作为从异构EEG蒙太奇到预训练基础模型的可学习且具解剖学依据的路径机制。

Abstract: Electroencephalography (EEG) foundation models are often pretrained with a fixed channel vocabulary or a limited set of montages, making transfer difficult when electrode layouts change. We propose CortexBridge, a lightweight adapter that combines EEG features with electrode and atlas coordinates to map arbitrary montages into a shared cortical latent space. Evaluated with three frozen foundation models on five brain-computer interface (BCI) datasets from the Mother of All BCI Benchmarks (MOABB), CortexBridge improves performance in 13 of 15 evaluations. The gains in balanced accuracy average 0.80% for EEGPT, 0.70% for LaBraM, and 3.26% for CBraMod, with a maximum gain of 13.02% on 12-class steady-state visual evoked potential (SSVEP) classification. Visualizations of the learned atlas representations reveal task-dependent spatial patterns, with SSVEP showing a more concentrated representation in the Yeo Visual network than auditory P300. These results establish cortical alignment as a learnable and anatomically grounded routing mechanism from heterogeneous EEG montages to pretrained foundation models.

</details>


### [709] [Auditing Action Settlement in LLM Agent Environments: Order, Progress, and Replay](https://arxiv.org/abs/2610.01138)
*Haotian Chen,Bowen Ye,Yuning Zhang,Jingkun Yu*

Main category: cs.AI

TL;DR: 论文实现类型化快照-结算契约，审计顺序敏感性、有效进展与重放一致性；在28,800次排列试验与2,160个多步回合中比较五种结算策略。


<details>
  <summary>Details</summary>
Motivation: LLM智能体环境中并发动作即使各自有效也需仲裁，需明确执行语义层面的仲裁策略是否影响结果。

Method: 实现typed snapshot-settlement契约，构造三类审计属性（顺序敏感、有效进展、重放一致）；对五种结算策略做28,800次穷举排列试验与2,160次脚本化多步回合；另设全状态journal审计，含156个检查点与1,332个构造性污染。

Result: 联合策略在固定优先级下具空间顺序不变性；保守拒绝在六智能体门场景仅完成31.25%，随机凭票为90.28%，配对提升59.03个百分点（95% bootstrap区间50.00–68.06）；所有策略保持测试空间约束，但优先级仲裁仍低于小规模独立最优；journal审计精确重放156检查点并拒绝1,332污染且保留终端锚点。

Conclusion: 证据关于执行语义，不涉及人类真实性或长期公平性；仲裁策略显著影响任务进展与重放可靠性。

Abstract: Concurrent actions in large language model (LLM) agent environments require arbitration even when each proposal is individually valid. We implement a typed snapshot-settlement contract and audit three distinct properties: order sensitivity, useful progress, and replay consistency. Five settlement policies are tested in 28,800 exhaustive permutation trials and 2,160 scripted multistep episodes. Joint policies are spatially order-invariant conditional on fixed priorities, yet conservative rejection completes only 31.25% of agents in a six-agent doorway task versus 90.28% for random tickets; the paired improvement is 59.03 percentage points (95% bootstrap interval: 50.00-68.06). All policies preserve the tested spatial constraints, and priority arbitration still misses the independent small-instance optimum. A separate full-state journal audit exactly replays 156 checkpoints and rejects 1,332 constructed corruptions with a retained terminal anchor. The evidence concerns execution semantics, not human realism or long-run fairness.

</details>


### [710] [ReSolve: Reusing Candidate Reasoning through Selective Generative Moderation](https://arxiv.org/abs/2610.01140)
*Bangji Yang,Jiajun Fan,Hongba Ma,Xi Zhu,Weizhi Zhang,Minghao Guo,Ye Li,Hamid Palangi,Jiaxuan You*

Main category: cs.AI

TL;DR: ReSolve是一种免训练的推理过程，通过"选择性生成式调控"复用候选推理中的中间推导，在130道竞赛数学题上以更少token取得高于投票和自洽采样的准确率。


<details>
  <summary>Details</summary>
Motivation: 多候选采样会把计算浪费在中间推导、未完成论证以及最终答案上，现有投票方法仅利用最终答案，未能复用候选推理中的过程性计算。作者希望验证"候选推理可作为一种可复用的推理计算"这一假设。

Method: 提出ReSolve：一个免训练的推理流程，包含"答案分布控制器"。当候选答案出现分歧或无法解析出答案时，控制器调用模型检查已有推导，并把生成的新解答纳入一个有界循环（bounded loop）。采用Hybrid评分。消融实验移除可见推导但保留答案键、投票计数和每状态输出上限规则；并对比"选择性调控"与"始终开启的Uniform调控"。

Result: 在130道竞赛数学题、两个独立采样的候选池上，Hybrid评分下ReSolve分别答对100和99题，而相同四个候选的投票为91和92题，且相对投票无正确变错误的改变。八样本自洽采样为94和96题，但token消耗显著更高，ReSolve两次评估分别少用46.3%和47.2%的token。消融实验（去掉可见推导）准确率从100降至93，尽管计算量增加。选择性与始终开启的Uniform调控都解出97题，但选择性将调控token减少约54%，整个流程token减少6.2%。

Conclusion: 结果支持"候选推理是可复用的推理计算"这一观点。但未证明相对额外采样具有准确率优势，也未证明专门的路线指令带来独特收益。

Abstract: Sampling multiple solutions spends computation on intermediate deductions and unfinished arguments as well as final answers. We introduce ReSolve, a training-free inference procedure that reuses this candidate reasoning through selective generative moderation. An answer-distribution controller invokes a model to examine existing derivations when candidates disagree or lack a parseable answer, then incorporates the generated solution into a bounded loop. Under Hybrid scoring on 130 competition-mathematics problems evaluated with two independently sampled candidate pools, ReSolve obtains 100 and 99 correct answers, compared with 91 and 92 for voting over the same four candidates, with no correct-to-incorrect changes relative to that vote in either pool. Eight-sample self-consistency obtains 94 and 96 correct answers while consuming substantially more tokens; ReSolve uses 46.3% and 47.2% fewer tokens in the two evaluations. A controlled ablation removes visible derivations while retaining answer keys, vote counts, and the per-state output-cap rule, reducing accuracy from 100 to 93 correct despite increasing computation. Selective and always-on Uniform moderation both solve 97 problems, while selectivity reduces moderation tokens by approximately 54% and total pipeline tokens by 6.2%. These results support candidate reasoning as reusable inference computation. They do not establish an accuracy advantage over additional sampling or a distinct benefit from specialized route instructions.

</details>


### [711] [When Does Exercise-Specific Joint Selection Help? An Audit of Evaluation and Control Design](https://arxiv.org/abs/2610.01188)
*Haotian Chen,Jingkun Yu,Yuning Zhang,Bowen Ye*

Main category: cs.AI

TL;DR: 通过审计1,057次重复动作数据，重新评估"运动特定关节选择"对骨架动作正确性分类的增益，发现该增益高度依赖评估聚合方式、子集结构与时间表示，且缺乏显著性与结构匹配对照的支持。


<details>
  <summary>Details</summary>
Motivation: 原始关于"运动特定关节选择能提升骨架正确性分类"的结论可能存在评估偏差：聚合方式、子集结构和时间表示等混杂因素未被充分控制，因此需要审计该增益是否稳健、是否真正成立。

Method: 对REHAB24-6的10名受试者共1,057次重复动作进行探索性审计。区分三种评估维度：聚合方式（pooled out-of-fold AUROC vs. 等权within-person AUROC）、子集结构（是否匹配双侧结构与躯干纳入）、时间表示（序列顺序、paired-seed对照）。使用kNN、RBF-SVM、逻辑回归及随机卷积对照分类器，并采用1,000个维度匹配的随机映射作为结构性对照，比较在特定匹配条件下随机映射超越人工子集的频次。

Result: 人工子集kNN增益从pooled out-of-fold AUROC的0.055降至等权within-person AUROC的0.020，两个配对置信区间均包含零。1000个维度匹配随机映射中，仅14个匹配或超过人工pooled结果；当同时匹配双侧结构与躯干纳入时，该数字升至145个。RBF-SVM在within-person估计量下仍保留正向增益，而逻辑回归与随机卷积对照在该估计量下点增益为负。序列顺序与paired-seed对照进一步限定了结论解释。

Conclusion: 本探索性审计表明，运动特定关节选择的增益主张高度依赖明确定义的估计量（estimand）与结构匹配的对照设计；在更严格的评估下增益并不稳健。研究不提出新算法，也未证实临床收益，仅强调此类声称需要明确估计量并采用结构适当的对照。

Abstract: Exercise-specific joint selection can improve skeleton-based correctness classification, but what does that gain establish? We audit 1,057 repetitions from ten REHAB24-6 subjects, separating evaluation aggregation, subset structure, and temporal representation. The manual-subset kNN gain changes from 0.055 for pooled out-of-fold AUROC to 0.020 for equal-weight within-person AUROC; both paired intervals include zero. Among 1,000 dimension-matched random maps, 14 match or exceed the manual pooled result, versus 145 when bilateral structure and trunk inclusion are also matched. RBF-SVM retains a positive within-person gain, whereas logistic regression and a random-convolution comparator have negative point gains under that estimand. Sequence-order and paired-seed controls further qualify the interpretation. This exploratory audit shows why joint-selection claims require explicit estimands and structurally appropriate controls; it does not establish a new algorithm or clinical benefit.

</details>


### [712] [Federated Agent Optimization](https://arxiv.org/abs/2610.01195)
*Qiang Yang,Zhiqiang Kou,Xueyi Zhang,Dong-Dong Wu,Hanlin Gu,Jing Guo,Yang Liu,Di Jiang,Qian Xu*

Main category: cs.AI

TL;DR: 该文提出"联邦智能体优化（FAO）"问题，研究分布式LLM智能体如何在保护原始数据、完整轨迹与私有知识的前提下，通过受控信息交换协同提升能力，并将其建模为效用、隐私泄露与通信成本的多目标优化问题。


<details>
  <summary>Details</summary>
Motivation: LLM智能体在私有环境中积累了大量经验（任务执行、工具使用、反馈、本地知识），但这些经验因隐私与专有约束分散于各组织间而无法直接共享。传统联邦学习仅聚焦模型参数，无法覆盖智能体在记忆、工具、奖励、技能和结构化知识等方面的能力，因此需要新的问题框架。

Method: 这是一篇立场/综述性论文。作者将FAO形式化为多目标优化问题（权衡智能体效用、隐私泄露与通信成本），并把优化空间按策略、记忆、工具使用、奖励、结构化知识与技能进行组织；进一步刻画私有经验如何被抽象、保护、聚合与适配为可迁移能力，给出无需直接共享经验即可相互受益的统一视角。

Result: 论文给出的是一套概念框架与分类体系，而非实验性结果：明确了FAO的问题定义、优化空间的结构化划分，以及私有经验转化为可迁移能力的信息流通路径，并归纳了该领域的关键挑战。

Conclusion: FAO为构建可信联邦智能体系统提供了统一研究视角；作者指出若干关键挑战并展望了未来研究方向，呼吁围绕受控信息交换实现分布式智能体的协同增强。

Abstract: Large language model (LLM) agents increasingly operate in private environments and accumulate valuable experience from task execution, tool use, feedback, and local knowledge. Yet such experience is distributed across organizations and cannot be directly shared because of privacy and proprietary constraints. Conventional federated learning is insufficient for this setting, as agent capabilities extend beyond model parameters to memory, tools, rewards, skills, and structured knowledge. In this paper, we formulate \textbf{Federated Agent Optimization (FAO)}, which studies how distributed agents can collaboratively improve through controlled information exchange while keeping raw data, complete trajectories, and private knowledge local. We define FAO as a multi-objective problem balancing agent utility, privacy leakage, and communication cost, and organize its optimization space across policy, memory, tool use, reward, and structured knowledge and skills. We further characterize how private experience can be abstracted, protected, aggregated, and adapted into transferable capabilities, providing a unified view of how agents can benefit from one another without direct experience sharing. Finally, we identify the key challenges of FAO and outline several promising directions for future research toward trustworthy federated agent systems.

</details>


### [713] [Dependency-Aware Reward Shaping for Agentic Reinforcement Learning](https://arxiv.org/abs/2610.01207)
*Ziyi Chen,Yan Zhang,Jianhui Wei,Daoan Zhang,Zuozhu Liu*

Main category: cs.AI

TL;DR: 论文提出依赖感知奖励塑造（DARS），将任务进度表示为带前置依赖关系的谓词，并在依赖图上分配步骤级信用，从而在仅有最终成败奖励的强化学习训练中缓解信用分配问题。


<details>
  <summary>Details</summary>
Motivation: 在强化学习训练大语言模型时，终端奖励对"哪一步重要"的指导信息极少。常见步骤信用分配方法忽略了错误传播的依赖结构：建立在未纠正错误之上的工作被浪费，而独立于错误的工作仍然有效。仅凭最终成败奖励时，失败回合中即使某步取得了进展，其总未来奖励也为零。

Method: DARS 将任务进度建模为谓词并通过前置依赖关系连接，在依赖图上分配步骤级信用。标注者标记每步验证、失效或修复哪些谓词。已验证谓词依据其与最近被破坏前置谓词的图距离进行折扣，而独立谓词不受影响；修复根据残留错误更新权重，失效谓词需重新验证才能重获信用。固定势函数将标注转换为带符号的每步奖励。统一的奖励与标注接口使 DARS 可接入 GiGPO、ARPO/AEPO 等多种推理与智能体训练方法，无需改动其 rollout 策略或优化器。

Result: 在五个任务族、1.5B 至 8B 模型上，DARS 相比同预算同框架训练的 GiGPO 在 ALFWorld 上成功率最多提升 10 个百分点，提升 WebShop 任务分数与 Search-R1 问答准确率，在带 Python 解释器的 AIME24/25 上补充 AEPO 的熵基训练，并在 1.7B 和 4B 的受控无工具推理对比中超过 OmniOPD。消融实验表明步骤级信用、依赖衰减和图拓扑均有贡献。在 ALFWorld 上，蒸馏的 8B 标注器可匹配 API 标注器，使 DARS 无需前沿评判模型即可高效运行。

Conclusion: DARS 通过依赖图的步骤级奖励塑造有效缓解了终端奖励下的信用分配难题，在多种任务与方法上带来稳定提升，且可借助蒸馏标注器低成本部署，具有较好的通用性与集成性。

Abstract: When training large language models with reinforcement learning, terminal rewards provide little guidance about which steps matter. Common methods for assigning step credit overlook that work built on uncorrected mistakes is wasted while independent work remains valid. With only a final success/failure reward, every step in a failed episode has zero total future reward, even when it made progress. We propose Dependency-Aware Reward Shaping (DARS), which represents task progress as predicates linked by prerequisite relations and assigns step-level credit over the dependency graph. An annotator marks which predicates each step verifies, invalidates, or repairs. Verified predicates are discounted according to graph distance from the nearest broken prerequisite, while independent predicates are unaffected. Repairs update these weights based on any errors that remain; invalidated predicates need re-verification to regain credit. A fixed potential converts these annotations into signed per-step rewards. A common reward and annotation interface allows DARS to integrate with a range of reasoning and agentic training methods, such as GiGPO and ARPO/AEPO, without changing their rollout strategies or optimizers. Across five task families and models from 1.5B to 8B, DARS improves success by up to 10 points over GiGPO trained with the same budget and harness (ALFWorld), raises the WebShop task score and Search-R1 QA accuracy, complements AEPO's entropy-based training on AIME24/25 with a Python interpreter, and exceeds OmniOPD in controlled tool-free reasoning comparisons at 1.7B and 4B. Ablations show that step-level credit, dependency attenuation, and graph topology each contribute. On ALFWorld, a distilled 8B annotator matches the API annotator, enabling DARS to run efficiently without a frontier judge. Code is available at https://github.com/JianhuiWei7/DARS.

</details>


### [714] [Reputation, Strategy, and Emotion Effects on Generative AI Cooperation: A Comparison Across Reasoning and Non-Reasoning Models](https://arxiv.org/abs/2610.01222)
*Celso de Melo,Zishan Feng,James Hale,Kazunori Terada,Giorgio Coricelli,Jonathan Gratch*

Main category: cs.AI

TL;DR: 本文利用迭代囚徒困境范式，考察前沿生成式AI模型的合作倾向。非推理模型（Claude 3.5、Gemini 2.0 Flash、GPT-4o）的合作受声誉、策略与情绪信号三重影响，与人类行为模式相似但权重各异；推理模型（Claude 4.6、Gemini 3、GPT-5.2）则更集中依赖策略与声誉，几乎消除"波将金效应"，情绪作用更条件化，并呈现异质的终局行为。


<details>
  <summary>Details</summary>
Motivation: 随着生成式AI在经济与社会重要互动中承担越来越自主的角色，理解其合作倾向及塑造该倾向的线索变得至关重要，但相关实证研究仍显不足。

Method: 采用迭代囚徒困境任务，系统操纵对手声誉（正、未知、负）、策略（勒索型 vs. 慷慨型）与非语言情绪信号（表达竞争或合作评价的面部表情）。研究一测试非推理模型（Claude 3.5、Gemini 2.0 Flash、GPT-4o）；研究二测试推理模型（Claude 4.6、Gemini 3、GPT-5.2），并借助诊断性"和谐博弈"检验波将金效应。

Result: 非推理模型的合作被三个因素系统塑造，与人类行为研究一致，但各因素权重因模型而异。推理模型更集中于策略与声誉，几乎消除非推理模型中观察到的波将金效应（和谐博弈中合作近乎一致），情绪作用更条件化，符合层级线索加权而非社会敏感性丧失。推理模型终局行为异质，从持续合作到系统性末轮背叛不等，显示模型特异的可被利用性特征。

Conclusion: 生成式AI模型是日益复杂但高度异质的社会行动者；其合作行为的差异对谈判等多轮互动场景的部署具有直接实践意义，凸显制定标准化合作基准以指导负责任部署的价值。

Abstract: As generative AI (Gen AI) systems take on increasingly autonomous roles in economically and socially consequential interactions, understanding their propensity to cooperate -- and the signals that shape this propensity -- has become essential. We examine cooperative behavior in frontier Gen AI models using the iterated prisoner's dilemma, manipulating counterpart reputation (positive, unknown, negative), strategy (extortion vs. generosity), and non-verbal emotional signaling (facial expressions conveying competitive or cooperative appraisals). In a first study with non-reasoning models (Claude 3.5, Gemini 2.0 Flash, GPT-4o), cooperation was systematically shaped by all three factors, paralleling patterns long documented in human behavioral research, though models varied substantially in how heavily each factor was weighted. A second study with reasoning models (Claude 4.6, Gemini 3, GPT-5.2) revealed a more concentrated reliance on strategy and reputation, a near-elimination of the Potemkin effect observed in non-reasoning models (evidenced by near-uniform cooperation in a diagnostic harmony game), and a more conditional role for emotion consistent with a hierarchical cue-weighting strategy rather than a simple loss of social sensitivity. Reasoning models also showed heterogeneous end-game behavior, ranging from sustained cooperation to systematic last-round defection effect, revealing model-specific exploitability profiles with direct practical relevance for deployment in negotiation and other multi-round interactions. Together, these findings characterize Gen AI models as increasingly sophisticated, though heterogeneous, social actors, and underscore the practical value of developing standardized cooperation benchmarks to inform the responsible deployment of Gen AI in interactive, socially consequential settings.

</details>


### [715] [HHR: Hierarchical Hash Retrieval for Efficient LLM Generation](https://arxiv.org/abs/2610.01230)
*Lianjun Liu,Tiantian Zheng,You Huang,Weiqi Yan,Mingte Qiu,Huazhong Liu,Xiaofeng Zhu,Yunshan Zhong*

Main category: cs.AI

TL;DR: 提出分层哈希检索(HHR)框架，通过几何感知路由与学习式哈希投影，解决哈希二值化丢弃幅值信息导致的检索错配，提升长上下文稀疏注意力精度与速度。


<details>
  <summary>Details</summary>
Motivation: 长上下文推理是LLM的计算瓶颈。基于哈希的检索虽高效，但二值化丢弃特征幅值，而Query-Key logits同时依赖方向相似度与幅值，导致高低logit键的误检与漏检，即海明距离与注意力相关性存在本质错配。

Method: HHR采用由粗到精框架：Geometry-Aware Key Routing (GKR)学习逐头正交变换，重分布特征幅值并导出更具判别性的页级logit上界，从而剪除低logit键、保留重要候选；Learned Hash Projection (LHP)学习逐头投影空间，使海明距离对齐真实Query-Key相关性排序，实现细粒度检索。二者结合抑制误检、召回漏检。

Result: 在多种LLM与基准上优于现有方法。LongBench平均分提升1.10分；在128K上下文下，Llama-3.1-8B-Instruct实现最高3.30x解码加速与2.83x端到端加速。

Conclusion: HHR通过几何感知路由与学习式哈希投影，有效弥合海明距离与注意力相关性的错配，显著提升哈希稀疏注意力的保真度，兼顾精度与长上下文推理效率。代码已开源。

Abstract: Efficient long-context inference is essential for large language models (LLMs), yet it poses a severe computational bottleneck. Hash-based retrieval offers an efficient alternative by encoding queries and keys into binary codes and using Hamming distance for key selection. However, this leads to a critical mismatch between Hamming distance and attention relevance. Query-Key logits depend jointly on directional similarity and feature magnitudes, whereas hash binarization discards magnitude information, causing both false-positive retrieval of low-logit keys and false-negative omission of high-logit keys. To address these failures, we propose Hierarchical Hash Retrieval (HHR), a coarse-to-fine framework that progressively improves retrieval accuracy through Geometry-Aware Key Routing (GKR) and Learned Hash Projection (LHP). GKR learns a head-wise orthogonal transformation to redistribute feature magnitudes and derive more discriminative page-level logit bounds, enabling effective pruning of low-logit keys while preserving important candidates. LHP then learns a head-wise projection space that aligns Hamming distance with the true Query-Key relevance ranking for fine-grained retrieval. By combining GKR and LHP, HHR suppresses false positives and recovers false negatives, substantially improving the fidelity of hash-based sparse attention. Extensive experiments across diverse LLMs and benchmarks demonstrate that HHR achieves superior performance over existing methods. For example, on LongBench, HHR improves the average score by 1.10 points and, at a context length of 128K, achieves up to a 3.30x decoding speedup and a 2.83x end-to-end speedup for Llama-3.1-8B-Instruct. The code is publicly available at https://github.com/lianjunl13-sudo/HHR.

</details>


### [716] [Learning to Ask: Information Acquisition for SLM-LLM Collaboration, under a budget](https://arxiv.org/abs/2610.01236)
*Yongjun Kim,Xiaoxiao Li,Jaeho Lee*

Main category: cs.AI

TL;DR: 该论文将小模型(SLM)与大模型(LLM)的协作重新定义为在API预算约束下的信息获取问题，而非传统的算力分配问题。


<details>
  <summary>Details</summary>
Motivation: 现有SLM-LLM协作方法主要视为算力分配问题，决定哪个模型处理推理的哪部分。但在黑盒API场景下，这种范式因粗粒度委派或模型切换时重复传输上下文而效率低下。

Method: 将协作形式化为API预算约束下的信息获取问题：SLM作为主推理者，仅在需要时向黑盒LLM顾问发起针对性查询而非委派推理过程。为此提出三阶段RLVR框架，学习是否调用顾问、如何构造有效查询、以及如何将协作整合进推理过程，联合优化顾问调用与信息使用。

Result: 在数学推理和编程任务上，该方法相比现有协作基线提升了性能-成本权衡，在某些设置下匹配或超越oracle问题级路由；并可无需额外训练迁移到其他顾问模型家族。

Conclusion: 将SLM-LLM协作建模为信息获取问题并结合三阶段RLVR训练，能在API预算约束下高效利用黑盒LLM顾问，实现更优的性能-成本权衡并具备跨模型族的迁移能力。

Abstract: Collaboration between a small language model (SLM) and a large language model (LLM) offers an opportunity to combine the efficiency of smaller models with the strong reasoning capabilities of larger ones. Existing approaches primarily frame such collaboration as a computation allocation problem, determining which model should handle each portion of the reasoning process. In black-box API-based settings, however, this paradigm can be inefficient due to coarse-grained delegation or repeated transmission of context across model switches. In this work, we instead formulate SLM-LLM collaboration as an information acquisition problem, under an API budget constraint. The SLM remains the primary reasoner and selectively queries a black-box LLM advisor only when needed, issuing targeted queries rather than delegating the reasoning process itself. To realize this strategy, we develop a three-stage RLVR framework that learns whether to call the advisor, how to formulate useful queries, and how to integrate the collaboration into the reasoning process by jointly refining advisor invocation and information use. Across mathematical reasoning and coding tasks, our approach improves the performance--cost tradeoff over existing collaboration baselines and, in some settings, matches or exceeds oracle problem-level routing. Finally, we show that our strategy can transfer to other advisor model families, without further training.

</details>


### [717] [DeFA: Dependency-Guided Failure Attribution for LLM Agents](https://arxiv.org/abs/2610.01256)
*Bo Deng,Xinlei Zheng,Yi Wei,Kang Zhou,Chongyang Tao,Renzhao Liang,Xuanren Chen,Lifan Guo,Chi Zhang*

Main category: cs.AI

TL;DR: 提出 DeFA，一个基于依赖图的 LLM Agent 失败归因框架，通过事件依赖图与失败传播图定位决定性错误、责任 Agent 与错误类型。


<details>
  <summary>Details</summary>
Motivation: LLM Agent 执行中的错误与其可见后果常相隔多个步骤，仅看单步内容难以定位决定性错误，必须同时理解步骤内容与步骤间的依赖关系。

Method: DeFA 首先将协议关系与语义依赖融合为覆盖整条轨迹的事件依赖图；随后识别可能违反任务要求的事件，并追踪其来源与后续影响，构建失败传播图；最后结合步骤证据及其在失败传播中的角色，判定决定性错误、责任 Agent 与错误类别。为支持长轨迹，将执行划分为片段，用当前片段的细节内容与其他片段的摘要组合，使局部诊断可获取全局执行上下文。

Result: 在 Who and When 及 Who and When Pro 文本子集上，DeFA 在所有评测 backbone 下均取得最高的责任 Agent 准确率与精确步骤准确率；在 Pro 上于与错误分类体系对齐的方法中取得最高 failure-mode 准确率。图像与视频轨迹实验证明其适用于多模态失败归因。消融实验支持分段、事件依赖图与失败传播图的贡献。将 DeFA 的诊断反馈用于 Trace2Skill 的技能演化，可使下游任务准确率较原生流程提升 6–15 个百分点。

Conclusion: 依赖引导的失败归因能有效定位决定性错误并提供可操作的诊断反馈，既支持多模态失败归因，也可驱动 Agent 在后续任务上的持续改进。

Abstract: Errors in LLM agent executions and their visible consequences can be separated by many steps, making decisive-error localization a matter of understanding both step content and step dependencies. We introduce DeFA, a dependency-guided framework for agent failure attribution. DeFA first combines protocol relations and semantic dependencies into an event dependency graph spanning the trajectory. It then identifies events that may violate task requirements and traces their sources and subsequent effects to construct a failure propagation graph. Finally, DeFA uses step evidence and the steps' roles in failure propagation to identify the decisive error, responsible agent, and error category. To support long trajectories, DeFA partitions executions into segments and combines the current segment's detailed content with summaries of the other segments, giving local diagnosis access to global execution context. Across Who and When and the Who and When Pro text subset, DeFA achieves the highest responsible-agent and exact step accuracy with all evaluated backbones, and the highest failure-mode accuracy among taxonomy-aligned methods on Pro. Further experiments on image and video trajectories demonstrate its applicability to multimodal failure attribution. Ablations support the contributions of segmentation, the event dependency graph, and the failure propagation graph. Using DeFA's diagnostic feedback for skill evolution in Trace2Skill improves downstream task accuracy by 6-15 percentage points over the native pipeline, showing that the diagnoses can also support agent improvement on subsequent tasks.

</details>


### [718] [Feedback Without the Wait: Piloting a Generative AI Practice Platform in a Large Maths Class](https://arxiv.org/abs/2610.01262)
*Lili Chen,Gavin Buskes,Yuxin Ren,Chin Tong Leong*

Main category: cs.AI

TL;DR: 该文设计并试点了一个生成式AI练习平台，在自主练习中提供即时、支架式反馈，将人工监督从实时评分前移至题目答案的事前核验，以解决反馈即时性与可信度之间的张力。


<details>
  <summary>Details</summary>
Motivation: 大型电气工程课程中生师比高，学生遇到困难可能数天才能得到反馈，而及时具体的反馈对学习影响极大。GenAI可扩展对话式反馈，但用于作业评分会引发信任与问责问题；若保留人工实时审核，又会重新引入削弱反馈价值的延迟。因此核心矛盾是反馈即时性与人工监督可信度之间的张力。

Method: 设计并试点一个GenAI练习平台，在自主练习环节提供即时、支架式（scaffolded）反馈；将人工监督的角色从实时评分转移到对解答的前置核验。研究目标为考察学生的使用参与情况、对反馈价值与可靠性的感知，以及可迁移至其他工程学科的经验。

Result: 摘要未报告具体量化结果，研究问题聚焦于三方面：学生如何参与使用该工具、如何评价其反馈的价值与可靠性、以及哪些经验可迁移到其他工程学科。

Conclusion: 通过将人工监督前移至解答核验，该方案在实践中缓解了即时反馈与可信度之间的矛盾，为大型工程课程中的GenAI反馈应用提供了可迁移的经验参考。

Abstract: Timely and specific feedback is one of the strongest influences on student learning, yet it is difficult to sustain in large electrical engineering classes where the ratio of students to demonstrators is high and a learner who is stuck may wait days to find out why an approach was wrong. Generative Artificial Intelligence (GenAI) offers a way to scale conversational feedback, but using it to grade assessed work raises trust and accountability concerns, and keeping a human in the loop to assure its judgements reintroduces the very delay that erodes the value of feedback. The result is a tension between the immediacy that makes feedback so impactful and the human oversight that makes it trustworthy. In this work, we set out to resolve that tension in practice by designing and piloting a GenAI practice platform that delivers immediate, scaffolded feedback during self-directed practice. This relocates human oversight from real-time grading to the upfront verification of solutions. Our goal was to understand how students engaged with the tool, how they perceived the value and reliability of its feedback, and what lessons transfer to other engineering subjects.

</details>


### [719] [Trustworthy Data- and ML-Ops for Intelligent Transportation Systems and Logistics](https://arxiv.org/abs/2610.01282)
*Antonio Emanuele Cinà,Giovanni Scodeller,Cecilia Caterina Pasquale,Silvia Siri,Davide Anguita,Fabio Roli,Simona Sacone,Luca Oneto*

Main category: cs.AI

TL;DR: 本文综述了智能交通与物流（ITS&L）领域中可信数据运维（DataOps）与机器学习运维（MLOps），梳理其必要性、关键组件、工具与案例，并讨论AI可信性问题及未来挑战。


<details>
  <summary>Details</summary>
Motivation: ITS&L已成为现代社会经济的重要支柱，高度依赖数据、人工智能与机器学习的融合；但现有文献在DataOps与MLOps及其可信性方面尚存空白，亟需系统梳理以提升交通与物流服务的效率、可靠性与决策精度。

Method: 采用综合性文献综述方法：首先识别现有研究空白并给出研究背景；随后剖析DataOps与MLOps的复杂性，涵盖其必要性、关键组件、可用工具、实践洞见及ITS&L相关案例；进而探讨AI应用中的可信性问题，考察增强AI系统置信度的方法与工具。

Result: 文章系统整合了ITS&L场景下DataOps与MLOps的组件、工具及实践案例，并梳理了可信AI的评估与保障方法与工具，同时归纳了该领域持续存在的挑战与未来发展方向。

Conclusion: 该工作为ITS&L中的DataOps与MLOps奠定了基础知识框架，并为研究人员、行业从业者与政策制定者提供了重要参考，指明了构建更高效、可持续且可信的智能交通与物流系统的研究与创新路径。

Abstract: The rapid evolution of Intelligent Transportation Systems and Logistics (ITS\&L) has become a cornerstone of the modern social economy, relying heavily on the integration of Data, Artificial Intelligence (AI), and, more specifically, Machine Learning (ML). This paper provides a comprehensive review of Trustworthy Data and Machine Learning Operations (DataOps and MLOps) in the ITS\&L domain, underscoring their importance in improving efficiency, reliability, and decision-making precision within transportation and logistics services. We begin by identifying gaps in current literature, offering clear context for our contribution. Subsequently, we explore the complexities of DataOps and MLOps, discussing their necessity, key components, available tools, practical insights, and case studies relevant to ITS\&L. Additionally, we address the critical issue of Trustworthiness in AI applications, examining methods and tools designed to strengthen confidence in AI systems - especially in real-world ITS\&L scenarios. The paper concludes with a discussion of persisting challenges and future prospects in this rapidly advancing field, aiming to serve as a vital resource for researchers, industry practitioners, and policy makers. Overall, this work not only establishes a foundational understanding of DataOps and MLOps in ITS\&L but also charts a path for further research and innovation in developing more efficient, sustainable, and trustworthy intelligent transportation and logistics systems.

</details>


### [720] [ITC-MoE: Importance-guided Token-aware Compression for MoE Diffusion Language Models](https://arxiv.org/abs/2610.01296)
*Lianjun Liu,Shipeng Li,You Huang,Weiqi Yan,Mingte Qiu,Huazhong Liu,Xiaofeng Zhu,Yunshan Zhong*

Main category: cs.AI

TL;DR: 本文提出ITC-MoE，一个面向MoE扩散语言模型的重要性引导、Token感知压缩框架，通过自适应Tucker压缩与Token感知补偿路由，在30%压缩预算下保持生成质量并实现最高7.22倍端到端加速。


<details>
  <summary>Details</summary>
Motivation: MoE扩散语言模型具备灵活并行解码与更大模型容量，但大量专家参数带来高昂计算与存储开销。现有低秩MoE压缩方法多采用静态分解与固定秩分配，忽略了MoE扩散语言模型的两个特性：跨模式非均匀冗余（输入、输出、专家模式上的冗余与秩截断敏感度不同）和Token级利用率差异（热/冷Token具有不同谱特征与专家激活模式）。

Method: ITC-MoE包含两个互补组件：1）重要性引导自适应Tucker压缩（IATC），将激活与梯度重要性纳入专家权重变换，对专家权重跨多模式联合分解，并在固定参数预算下自适应分配秩；2）Token感知补偿与路由（TCR），对压缩敏感的热Token施加轻量低秩补偿，并对路由模式集中的冷Token限制候选专家集合。

Result: 在SDAR-30B-A3B-Chat-b32上，30%压缩预算下MultiArith准确率保持96.33%，端到端加速最高达7.22倍。代码已开源。

Conclusion: 通过将压缩容量与推理执行同时适配参数冗余和Token级差异，ITC-MoE在显著降低MoE扩散语言模型计算与存储成本的同时保持了生成质量。

Abstract: Mixture-of-Experts (MoE) Diffusion Language Models (DLMs) offer flexible parallel decoding and increased model capacity, but their large number of expert parameters incurs substantial computation and storage costs. Existing low-rank MoE compression methods largely rely on static factorization and fixed rank allocation, which overlook the distinctive properties of MoE DLMs. Specifically, we identify two properties: cross-mode non-uniform redundancy, where parameter redundancy and sensitivity to rank truncation vary across the input, output, and expert modes, and token-wise utilization variation, where hot and cold tokens exhibit distinct spectral characteristics and expert activation patterns. To address these challenges, we propose ITC-MoE, an Importance-guided Token-aware Compression framework for MoE DLMs. ITC-MoE consists of two complementary components. First, Importance-guided Adaptive Tucker Compression (IATC) incorporates activation and gradient importance into expert weight transformation, jointly factorizes expert weights across multiple modes, and adaptively allocates ranks under a fixed parameter budget. Second, Token-aware Compensation and Routing (TCR) applies lightweight low-rank compensation to compression-sensitive hot tokens and restricts the candidate expert set for cold tokens with concentrated routing patterns. By jointly adapting compression capacity and inference execution to both parameter redundancy and token-wise variation, ITC-MoE substantially reduces the computation and storage costs of MoE DLMs while preserving their generation quality. For example, on SDAR-30B-A3B-Chat-b32, ITC-MoE maintains an accuracy of 96.33% on MultiArith under a 30% compression budget, while achieving up to a 7.22x end-to-end speedup. The code is publicly available at https://github.com/lianjunl13-sudo/ITC-MoE.

</details>


### [721] [Questionnaire-Guided Disaggregation of Energy Appliance Use for Domestic Smart Meter Data](https://arxiv.org/abs/2610.01297)
*Achal Nanjundamurthy,Rupam Misra,Suzanne Little,Alan F. Smeaton*

Main category: cs.AI

TL;DR: 提出一种无标签负荷分解系统，结合高功率负荷事件检测与问卷引导估计，将30分钟粒度用电数据分解为9类家电，在多个数据集上取得最低整体分解误差。


<details>
  <summary>Details</summary>
Motivation: 爱尔兰智能电表虽覆盖超80%家庭并以30分钟分辨率记录用电，但该粒度太粗，无法捕捉家电级别的用电情况；同时缺乏逐设备标签数据，难以直接训练监督式分解模型。

Method: 一种无标签（label-free）分解系统：对高功率负荷采用事件检测，对低功率或难以检测的负荷采用问卷引导估计，二者融合形成混合方法，将30分钟用电数据分解为9类家电。

Result: 在四类数据集上评估：1个带商业对比产品的标定家庭、2个带逐设备分表计量的公开基准（UK-DALE、REFIT）、以及包含2,968名爱尔兰用户逾4,800年用电量的智能电表数据集。与两个独立开发的分解系统相比，该混合方法在所有数据集的所有建筑上取得最低整体分解误差，并在54个配对月份上取得更优的月度性能（p<0.001，Holm校正）。

Conclusion: 该方法可为家庭用电模式提供有用建议，并针对部分家电给出降低或转移用电以节省成本的建议。

Abstract: Ireland's smart metering programme records electricity use at 30-minute resolution, with smart meters installed in over 80\% of households as of late 2025. While this is useful for billing of smart, time-of-use tariffs, it is too coarse to capture use of domestic appliances. We present a label-free disaggregation system that breaks usage data into 9 appliance categories by combining event detection for high-power loads with questionnaire-guided estimation. Our evaluation draws on four datasets: a calibration household with a commercial comparator, two public benchmarks (UK-DALE and REFIT) with per-appliance sub-metering, and a smart meter dataset of more than 4,800 years of use from 2,968 Irish consumers. Compared against two independently developed disaggregation systems our hybrid method combining analysis of usage data with questionnaire results, achieves the lowest whole-decomposition error on all buildings across the datasets, with better month-level performance over 54 paired months ($p<0.001$, Holm-corrected). Our method provides useful advice on a household's energy consumption patterns and advice on how to reduce or shift usage on some appliances in order to reduce costs.

</details>


### [722] [ProtoFlow: Prototype-Guided Flow Matching for Multivariate Time Series Forecasting](https://arxiv.org/abs/2610.01320)
*Shibo Feng,Wanjin Feng,Yang Qiu,Deheng Ye,Peilin Zhao,Chunyan Miao*

Main category: cs.AI

TL;DR: ProtoFlow 将 VQ 码本作为结构化原型先验，用 DiT 整流流做非自回归潜在预测，克服 AR 曝光偏差并提升效率与精度。


<details>
  <summary>Details</summary>
Motivation: 扩散模型虽在多变量时间序列预测中表现优异，但推理需大量采样步；VAE/VQ 非迭代框架高效，却普遍依赖自回归 token 生成，存在曝光偏差与训练-推理不匹配。已有 flow matching 虽为非自回归替代方案，但通常从通用高斯先验初始化传输，未利用已训练 VQ 码本中的代表性潜在原型。

Method: ProtoFlow 分三步：1) 用向量量化自编码将多变量序列映射到紧凑离散潜在空间；2) 从学习到的码本构建结构化原型先验，替代通用高斯噪声；3) 学习基于 DiT 的整流流（rectified flow），在历史观测条件下将样本从该先验传输到未来潜在表示，实现非自回归潜在预测。

Result: 在多个基准数据集上的大量实验表明，ProtoFlow 持续取得更优的预测性能，同时保持高效推理，并相比 AR token 预测促进更快的训练收敛。

Conclusion: 以学习到的原型先验替换通用噪声初始化，可在避免自回归 rollout 不匹配的同时兼顾预测精度与推理效率，为 VQ 潜在预测提供了有效的非自回归范式。

Abstract: Generative modeling has shown strong promise for multivariate time mseries (MTS) forecasting, especially scale to high-dimensional settings. Diffusion-based methods achieve competitive performance but typically require many sampling steps at inference. VAE-based non-iterative forecasting frameworks have therefore emerged as an efficient alternative. Within this line of work, vector quantization (VQ) enables controllable latent space modeling by mapping multivariate series into compact discrete representations. Existing VQ-based forecasting methods, however, typically rely on autoregressive (AR) token generation, which suffers from exposure bias and training-inference mismatch. Flow matching provides an efficient non-autoregressive alternative for latent forecasting, but existing formulations usually initialize transport from a generic Gaussian prior. We instead observe that the trained VQ codebook already captures representative latent prototypes and can thus serve as a more informative prior for flow matching. Based on this insight, we propose ProtoFlow, a forecasting framework that combines vector-quantized autoencoding with Prototype-prior Flow matching. Our method first maps multivariate sequences into a discrete latent space, then constructs a structured prior from the learned codebook, and finally learns a DiT-based rectified flow to transport samples from this prior to future latent representations conditioned on historical observations. By replacing generic noise initialization with a learned prototype prior, ProtoFlow avoids the rollout mismatch of AR token prediction and promotes faster training convergence. Extensive experiments on benchmark datasets show that it consistently achieves superior forecasting performance with efficient inference.

</details>


### [723] [TRACE: Trajectory Return Attribution and Contrastive Erasure for Multi-Turn Safety](https://arxiv.org/abs/2610.01323)
*Fengpeng Li,Kemou Li,Qizhou Wang,Haiwei Wu,Jiantao Zhou,Di Wang*

Main category: cs.AI

TL;DR: 本文提出TRACE方法，通过token级目标控制多轮对话中的安全风险，在35个模型-攻击组合中取得最低攻击成功率，且模型效用几乎不降。


<details>
  <summary>Details</summary>
Motivation: 安全对齐的LLM常拒绝单轮有害请求，但当同一目标分散到多轮对话时却会顺从。偏好目标仅对单轮完整回复打分，其训练损失无法控制未见历史下的风险。

Method: 首先给出理论分析：在监督单轮上下文中的抑制可对多轮轨迹风险形成上界，该界考虑覆盖率、迁移松弛与泄漏，并刻画相对于基策略风险预算的收缩。基于此提出TRACE（Trajectory Return Attribution and Contrastive Erasure），将原则转化为token级目标：在安全回复上，每个token按拒绝相关优势的折扣回报加权，该优势通过冻结参考模型与其拒绝能力消融副本对比得到，使靠前token获得后续拒绝证据的信用；在拒绝回复的高差距位置，TRACE将观测token与策略选择的替代项结合进擦除目标；并以梯度范数惩罚替代保留集。

Result: 在五个开源权重模型和七种多轮攻击上，TRACE在全部35个模型-攻击组合中取得最低攻击成功率（ASR），而MMLU和HellaSwag上的模型效用最多下降1.23分。

Conclusion: TRACE通过token级多轮安全目标有效抑制多轮攻击，同时保持模型通用效用，源代码见补充材料。

Abstract: Safety-aligned large language models (LLMs) often refuse a harmful request but comply once the same goal is spread over several turns. Preference objectives score whole responses to single prompts, so their training loss alone cannot control risk on unseen histories. Our analysis gives sufficient conditions under which suppression at supervised single-turn contexts yields a bound on multi-turn trajectory risk. The bound accounts for coverage, transfer slack, and leakage, and characterizes contraction relative to a base-policy risk budget evaluated on the trained policy's contexts. TRACE (Trajectory Return Attribution and Contrastive Erasure) turns this principle into a token-level objective. On the safe response, each token is weighted by the discounted return of a refusal-attributable advantage. The advantage compares a frozen reference model with its refusal-ablated copy, allowing earlier response tokens to receive credit from later refusal-related evidence. At high-gap positions on rejected responses, TRACE combines the observed token with policy-selected alternatives in the erasure target. A gradient-norm penalty replaces the retain set. Across five open-weight models and seven multi-turn attacks, TRACE gives the lowest attack success rate (ASR) in all 35 model and attack pairs, while the model utility evaluated on MMLU and HellaSwag drop by at most 1\.23 points. Source code can be found in the supplemental material.

</details>


### [724] [PPO-HRAP: Proximal Policy Optimization with a Hybrid Regime-Aware Policy for Risk-Controlled Trading](https://arxiv.org/abs/2610.01325)
*Duong Hien Chi Kien,Thanh Trung Huynh*

Main category: cs.AI

TL;DR: 提出 PPO-HRAP，将 PPO 与可解释的市场状态先验相融合，在 SPY 2020-2022 测试窗口上显著降低回撤并提升风险调整收益，但换手率较高、跨资产稳健性证据有限。


<details>
  <summary>Details</summary>
Motivation: 强化学习交易策略难以在上涨参与度与回撤控制之间取得平衡：仅优化收益的策略在上涨资产上易退化为被动多头暴露，而风险惩罚过强的奖励在波动期又过于防御。需要一种既能参与上行又能控制回撤的策略。

Method: 提出 PPO-HRAP：在 PPO 基础上引入可解释的市场状态（regime）先验。智能体观测市场特征与组合状态变量；奖励由组合对数收益、VIX 条件化的回撤增加惩罚、目标暴露偏离度、换手成本组成；最终动作是 PPO actor 输出与 regime 推导的目标暴露之间的混合（blended action）。

Result: 在 2020-2022 SPY 留出测试窗口：总收益 27.62%、年化收益 8.48%、Sharpe 0.6447、Sortino 0.8588、Calmar 0.4592，最大回撤由 Buy and Hold 的 34.10% 降至 18.47%。五个 SPY 随机种子下表现稳定：平均总收益 0.2725 ± 0.0109，平均 Sharpe 0.6219 ± 0.0565。在 QQQ 与 DIA 的单次跨资产测试中，方法在三个资产的总收益与 Sharpe 上均排名第一。

Conclusion: 将学习动作与波动率感知的状态先验相融合，是改善风险调整后交易行为的实用途径；但当前策略换手率仍偏高，且 SPY 之外的跨资产稳健性仅有单次运行证据支撑。

Abstract: Reinforcement learning for trading often struggles to balance upside participation with drawdown control. Profit-only policies can collapse toward passive long exposure on upward-drifting assets, while aggressively risk-penalized rewards can become too defensive during volatile periods. This paper proposes PPO-HRAP, a hybrid regime-aware policy that combines Proximal Policy Optimization with an interpretable regime prior. The agent observes both market features and portfolio-state variables, receives a reward combining portfolio log return, VIX-conditioned drawdown-increase penalty, target-exposure deviation, and turnover cost, and executes a blended action between the PPO actor output and a regime-derived target exposure. On the held-out 2020-2022 SPY test window, PPO-HRAP achieves 27.62% total return, 8.48% annualized return, 0.6447 Sharpe ratio, 0.8588 Sortino ratio, and 0.4592 Calmar ratio, while reducing maximum drawdown from 34.10% for Buy and Hold to 18.47%. Across five SPY seeds, PPO-HRAP remains stable with mean total return $0.2725 \pm 0.0109$ and mean Sharpe ratio $0.6219 \pm 0.0565$. Single-run cross-asset tests on QQQ and DIA further show that the proposed method ranks first on total return and Sharpe ratio for all three reported assets. These results suggest that blending learned actions with a volatility-aware regime prior is a practical way to improve risk-adjusted trading behavior, although the current policy still incurs high turnover and cross-asset robustness beyond SPY remains limited to single-run evidence.

</details>


### [725] [An ontology for cross-sectoral crisis management: core and public health modules](https://arxiv.org/abs/2610.01326)
*Aldo Gangemi,Rita T. Sousa,Luigi Asprino,Giorgia Lodi,Andrea G. Nuzzolese,Valentina Presutti,Johannes Gysen,Diana F. Sousa,Luigi Spagnolo*

Main category: cs.AI

TL;DR: 本文提出欧洲危机管理本体ECMO，一个模块化的OWL本体，作为灾害风险减少与响应的跨领域参考，并通过流行病学新闻知识图谱构建流程验证其效用。


<details>
  <summary>Details</summary>
Motivation: 灾害风险减少与响应领域缺乏跨领域、统一的正式知识表示参考，导致不同来源与部门的数据难以一致地表示和整合。

Method: ECMO以模块化OWL本体网络组织：ECMO-CORE刻画hazard、event、exposure、impact、response measure等核心概念，采用本体设计模式与OWL2 punning技术消解危害类型与事件表现之间的歧义；领域模块如公共卫生模块对齐SNOMED CT与ICD-11。作者用ECMO表示联合研究中心的Epidemic Intelligence from Open Sources系统数据，构建从非结构化流行病学新闻到ECMO合规知识图谱的端到端流水线。

Result: 初步结果表明，ECMO提供了实现一致、统一的知识表示与整合所需的形式化约束（formal guardrails）。

Conclusion: ECMO可作为灾害风险减少与响应的模块化、跨领域本体参考，支持异构数据向合规知识图谱的转化；本体已公开（DOI: 10.5281/zenodo.20070268），采用CC BY 4.0许可。

Abstract: This paper presents the European Crisis Management Ontology (ECMO), a modular OWL-based ontology intended as a cross-sectoral reference for disaster risk reduction and response. ECMO is designed to be organised as a network of ontological modules. Among the modules, ECMO-CORE captures fundamental crisis management concepts such as hazard, event, exposure, impact, and response measure and uses ontology design patterns and the OWL2 punning technique to resolve ambiguities between hazard types and event manifestations. In addition, domain-specific modules are defined as in the case of the public health module aligned with SNOMED CT and ICD-11. To demonstrate the resource's utility, we used ECMO to represent the data of the Epidemic Intelligence from Open Sources system of the Joint Research Centre to generate an end-to-end pipeline that populates an ECMO-compliant knowledge graph from unstructured epidemiological news. Initial results demonstrate that ECMO provides the formal guardrails necessary for consistent and unified knowledge representation and integration. The ontology is publicly available at https://doi.org/10.5281/zenodo.20070268 and is released under the Creative Commons Attribution 4.0 International (CC BY 4.0) license.

</details>


### [726] [PRISM: A Category-Theoretic Framework for Measuring and Refining Multimodal Analogies](https://arxiv.org/abs/2610.01383)
*Mirella Zeisler,Ojas Shirekar,Mircea Licǎ,Chirag Raman*

Main category: cs.AI

TL;DR: PRISM 是一个模态无关的框架，基于范畴论将类比表示为显式关系映射，通过 pullback 分数度量多模态类比的关系对齐，并以该分数作为反馈迭代改进图像生成。在 AnaloBench 上，仅用 pullback 分数选择正确类比达 82.5% 准确率；迭代细化在隐喻一致性和类比适当性上优于零样本生成，人类在 57.65% 的成对比较中偏好细化结果，但定性分析显示细化有时偏向视觉拥挤而非真正更深的关系对应。


<details>
  <summary>Details</summary>
Motivation: 现有 AI 驱动的多模态类比生成缺乏可解释的度量来判断生成输出是否理解并保持了跨域的关系结构，因此需要一个可度量且可改进关系对齐的框架。

Method: PRISM 以范畴论为基础，将类比表示为显式关系映射，并用视觉语言模型（VLM）跨模态实例化这些结构。其第一组件 pullback 分数从图表示中量化关系对齐；第二组件是迭代细化循环，以 pullback 分数作为上下文反馈信号，逐步修订生成图像以提升关系深度。评估任务为视觉隐喻生成。

Result: 在 AnaloBench 基准上，仅凭 pullback 分数选择正确类比达到 82.5% 准确率。VLM 评判与人类评估表明，PRISM 相比零样本生成持续提升隐喻一致性和类比适当性，人类在 57.65% 的成对比较中偏好细化输出。定性分析发现细化可能偏向视觉上拥挤的构图，而非真正更深的关系对应。

Conclusion: PRISM 提供了可解释的关系对齐度量并有效改进多模态类比生成，但 pullback 分数驱动的细化存在偏好视觉复杂度而非真正关系深度的局限，提示未来需改进分数以更准确衡量关系对应深度。

Abstract: Analogical reasoning involves identifying and preserving relational structures across domains. However, existing approaches to AI-driven multimodal analogy generation lack an interpretable measure of whether this structure is understood and maintained in the generated output. We address this gap with Pullback Refinement via Interpretable Structural Mapping (PRISM), a modality-agnostic framework for measuring and improving relational alignment in multimodal analogies, evaluated on visual metaphor generation. PRISM represents analogies as explicit relational mappings grounded in category theory and uses VLMs to instantiate these structures across modalities. Its first component, the pullback score, quantifies relational alignment from the resulting graph representation. On the AnaloBench benchmark, selecting the correct analogy purely by pullback score achieves 82.5% accuracy, demonstrating that the score captures meaningful relational information. PRISM's second component is an iterative refinement loop that uses the pullback score as an in-context feedback signal to iteratively revise the generated image towards greater relational depth. VLM-as-a-judge and human evaluations show that PRISM consistently improves metaphor consistency and analogy appropriateness over zero- shot generation, with human participants preferring the refined output in 57.65% of pairwise comparisons. However, a qualitative analysis reveals that refinement can favour visually crowded compositions rather than genuinely deeper relational correspondences.

</details>


### [727] [Contrastive Attention Mitigates Spectral Bias in Spiking Transformers](https://arxiv.org/abs/2610.01403)
*Xiaoli Liu,Malu Zhang,Yang Yang*

Main category: cs.AI

TL;DR: 该论文通过多尺度谱分析发现脉冲神经元与脉冲自注意力均为低通滤波器，导致高频信息耗散，进而提出脉冲对比注意力（SCA）以增强高频信息，并在多任务上稳定提升性能。


<details>
  <summary>Details</summary>
Motivation: 脉冲Transformer结合了SNN的能效与自注意力的表征能力，但与ANN对应模型仍存在性能差距。以往工作多将此归因于二值激活，本文则试图从频域角度重新揭示该差距的成因。

Method: 通过多尺度谱分析发现脉冲神经元与脉冲自注意力（SSA）均表现为低通滤波器，导致高频成分耗散。受生物视觉系统边缘检测与差分感知特性启发，提出脉冲对比注意力（SCA）：通过全局对比聚合提取对比原型，并结合局部差分细化，从而有效增强高频信息。

Result: 大量实验表明，SCA是一种通用模块，在图像分类、语义分割和基于事件的跟踪任务中均能持续提升脉冲Transformer的性能；同时其复杂度更低，相比原始SSA具有更优的效率。

Conclusion: SCA可作为高能效脉冲Transformer的基础构建模块，为缩小与ANN的性能差距提供了频域视角的解决方案。

Abstract: Spiking Transformers merge the energy-efficiency of spiking neural networks (SNNs) with the representational power of self-attention, creating a promising architecture for high-performance, energy-efficient computation. However, a performance gap persists versus its counterparts in artificial neural networks (ANNs). Unlike prior works attributing this to binary activations, we reveal that both spiking neurons and spiking self-attention (SSA) act as low-pass filters through multiscale spectral analysis. This characteristic leads to the dissipation of high-frequency components. To address this issue, we propose the Spiking Contrastive Attention (SCA) paradigm, which draw inspiration from the edge-detection and differential sensing properties of biological visual system. By extracting contrast prototypes via global contrastive aggregation and applying local differential refinement, SCA effectively enhances high-frequency information. Extensive experiments show that SCA is a general module that consistently boosts Spiking Transformers across image classification, semantic segmentation, and event-based tracking. Furthermore, it achieves lower complexity, offering superior efficiency over original SSA. These results establish its potential as a fundamental building block for energy-efficient Spiking Transformers.

</details>


### [728] [Beyond Memory: Harnessing Long-Horizon Agents with Explicit Belief States](https://arxiv.org/abs/2610.01415)
