Empirically, identification fails for 54% of required memories on LongMemEval and 67% on LoCoMo, and the failure persists in a deployed memory system. CMP improves discrimination between required and non-required memories from 0.54 to 0.66 AUC. Finally, we show that identified memory utility alone is insufficient for retention decisions: per-query utility reaches 0.78 AUC on the query for which it is estimated, yet no aggregation available to a retention policy predicts a memory's value on unseen queries. Code is available at: https://anonymous.4open.science/r/cmp-release-D0C3/.

</details>


### [761] [PyPottery: an AI-powered end-to-end suite for pottery processing and publication](https://arxiv.org/abs/2610.02072)
*Lorenzo Cardarelli*

Main category: cs.AI

TL;DR: 本文提出开源AI工具套件PyPottery，通过四个集成模块半自动化陶器文档全流程，在50张手绘图（240件陶器）上评估，用户报告的中位感知加速达40倍。


<details>
  <summary>Details</summary>
Motivation: 陶瓷材料研究是考古学的基石，但陶器文档的后期制作流程仍高度依赖人工，造成严重的发表瓶颈，亟需自动化手段提升效率。

Method: 开发开源、AI驱动的PyPottery套件，包含四个集成模块：PyPotteryScan（自动图像提取与手写识别）、PyPotteryInk（铅笔图自动上墨）、PyPotteryTrace（语义感知矢量化）、PyPotteryLayout（自动排版生成）。

Result: 在意大利Terramara di Montale的50张手绘图纸（含240件陶器绘图）上评估，可用性研究参与者报告相较传统流程的中位感知加速为40倍（区间17.5–120倍），确认了显著的时间节约。

Conclusion: AI辅助工具有望应用于考古文档工作，其价值在于将认知劳动策略性地重新分配，实现增强而非替代人工。

Abstract: The study of ceramic materials constitutes a cornerstone of archaeological research, yet the post-production workflow for pottery documentation remains labor-intensive and creates significant publication bottlenecks. This paper presents PyPottery, an open-source, AI-powered suite designed to semi-automate the complete ceramic documentation pipeline. The suite comprises four integrated modules: PyPotteryScan for automated image extraction and handwriting recognition; PyPotteryInk for automatic inking of pencil drawings; PyPotteryTrace for semantically-aware vectorization; and PyPotteryLayout for automated layout generation. Evaluated on 50 hand-drawn sheets containing 240 pottery drawings from the Terramara di Montale (Italy), the framework achieved substantial time savings confirmed by usability study participants, who reported a median perceived speedup of 40$\times$ over traditional workflows (range: 17.5$\times$--120$\times$). These results highlight the potential of AI-assisted tools in archaeological documentation, while the paper addresses the strategic redistribution of cognitive labor toward augmentation rather than automation.

</details>


### [762] [Homomorphic Advantage Operator: Stabilizing Reinforcement Learning Under Fully Homomorphic Encryption Constraints](https://arxiv.org/abs/2610.02074)
*Abid Mohamed Nadhir,Ahmad Al Hanbali,Beggas Mounir*

Main category: cs.AI

TL;DR: 本文提出同态优势算子（HAO），通过将零均值中心化投影应用于时序差分目标，抑制FHE深度强化学习中的Bellman漂移，从而防止多项式近似发散。


<details>
  <summary>Details</summary>
Motivation: 在云端智能系统中，全同态加密（FHE）可保障机密数据的隐私计算，但将FHE用于强化学习需用多项式近似替代非线性操作。由于一种独特的递归误差现象——Bellman漂移，多项式近似会发生灾难性发散，导致FHE强化学习难以部署。

Method: 提出同态优势算子（HAO）稳定框架：将基于优势的价值估计中的零均值中心化投影直接适配到时序差分（TD）目标上。该线性投影消除驱动Bellman漂移的均匀状态价值基线，同时保持逐状态动作排序，且不需要额外的非线性乘法深度，也避免了昂贵的密文自举（bootstrapping）。评估采用三层实验方法：表格型马尔可夫决策过程（MDP）、使用真实CKKS加密操作的加密CartPole环境，以及具有密集连续特征的20节点物流路径规划基准。

Result: HAO严格将网络预激活值限制在安全的多项式近似域内；在所有随机种子上实现0%边界越界，而仅用正则化（L2权重衰减与梯度裁剪）在5个种子中有3个越界，未稳定基线在83.8%的回合中越界。HAO智能体在表格域中将最优策略准确率提升18.0个百分点，并在裁剪梯度上加入DP-SGD风格高斯噪声时仍保持稳定。

Conclusion: HAO通过线性中心化投影有效抑制Bellman漂移，在不增加乘法深度和自举开销的前提下保证多项式近似的数值稳定性，为FHE环境下深度强化学习的隐私保护部署提供了可行方案。

Abstract: Privacy-preserving machine learning presents significant deployment challenges on the cloud for intelligent systems with confidential data. Fully Homomorphic Encryption (FHE) offers a compelling solution for secure computation, preserving data confidentiality of cloud computations. However, applying FHE to reinforcement learning (RL) requires replacing non-linear operations with polynomial approximations, which diverge catastrophically due to a unique recursive error phenomenon known as the Bellman drift. This article introduces the Homomorphic Advantage Operator (HAO), a stabilization framework designed to prevent polynomial approximation divergence in FHE-based deep RL. HAO adapts the zero-mean centering projection from advantage-based value estimation directly to temporal-difference (TD) targets. This linear projection annihilates the uniform state-value baseline that drives the Bellman drift, maintaining per-state action rankings while requiring zero additional non-linear multiplicative depth and avoiding expensive ciphertext bootstrapping. The proposed HAO framework was evaluated using a three-tier experimental methodology, including a tabular Markov Decision Process (MDP), an encrypted CartPole environment using real CKKS cryptographic operations, and a 20-node logistics routing benchmark with dense continuous features. The results demonstrate that the proposed HAO strictly bounds network pre-activations within the safe polynomial approximation domain. The proposed HAO RL agents achieved 0% boundary breaches across all random seeds used, whereas regularization alone (L2 weight decay and gradient clipping) breached the bound on 3 of 5 seeds and the unstabilized baseline did so in 83.8% of episodes. Finally, HAO agents improve optimal policy accuracy by 18.0 percentage points in tabular domains and remain stable when DP-SGD-style Gaussian noise is added to the clipped gradients.

</details>


<div id='cs.RO'></div>

# cs.RO [[Back]](#toc)

### [763] [DriftOPD: Sequence-Level Reverse-KL Distillation for One-Step VLA Policies](https://arxiv.org/abs/2610.00317)
*Youngjun Jun,Kyumin Choi,Youngmin Kim,Seonghyun Jin,Sunwoo Park,Jangho Park,Jong Chul Ye*

Main category: cs.RO

TL;DR: DriftOPD 提出一种无需教师、无需在线 rollout 的序列级 on-policy 蒸馏框架，将序列级 reverse KL 分解为 chunk 级 reverse-KL 项与未来势能项，仅用离线数据与单步动作生成即可把长时程行为蒸馏进一步 VLA 动作专家。


<details>
  <summary>Details</summary>
Motivation: 现有 VLA 动作专家在滚动时域控制下生成短动作块，chunk 级训练虽便于跨具身迁移，但只优化局部动作似然，未显式考虑长时程任务成功率；而序列级强化学习通常依赖策略 rollout 与闭环交互，在真实机器人操作中代价高昂。

Method: 证明序列级 reverse KL 散度可分解为 chunk 级 reverse-KL 项与一个刻画当前动作长时程影响的未来势能项；分别用一步 drifting 目标优化前者、用从离线示范学习的 Q 函数 critic 优化后者，从而在仅使用离线数据和一步动作生成的情况下实现序列级优化。

Result: 在仿真与真实世界操作任务、多种 VLA 架构上，DriftOPD 总体优于现有一步蒸馏基线，并达到与多步教师策略相当的任务成功率。

Conclusion: 长时程行为可以有效蒸馏进一步 VLA 动作专家，且无需在线交互或独立教师模型。

Abstract: Vision-Language-Action (VLA) models increasingly rely on action experts that generate short action chunks under receding-horizon control. While chunk-level training is convenient across robot embodiments, it optimizes local action likelihood without explicitly accounting for long-horizon task success. Sequence-level reinforcement learning can address this limitation, but typically requires policy rollouts and closed-loop interaction, which are costly for real-robot manipulation. We introduce DriftOPD, a teacher-free, rollout-free framework for sequence-level on-policy distillation of continuous VLA action experts. We show that the sequence-level reverse Kullback-Leibler (KL) divergence decomposes into a chunk-level reverse-KL term and a future-potential term that captures the long-horizon effect of the current action. DriftOPD optimizes these two terms using a one-step drifting objective and a Q-function critic learned from offline demonstrations, respectively, enabling sequence-level optimization with only offline data and one-step action generation. Across multiple VLA architectures in simulation and real-world manipulation, DriftOPD generally outperforms existing one-step distillation baselines while achieving task success performance comparable to multi-step teacher policies. These results demonstrate that long-horizon behavior can be effectively distilled into one-step VLA action experts without online interaction or a separate teacher.

</details>


### [764] [Retrospective Open-Vocabulary Memory for Long-Term Object Search](https://arxiv.org/abs/2610.00330)
*Jiaming Wang,Zhiwei Xue,Chen Jizhuo,Peng Shiqi,Harold Soh*

Main category: cs.RO

TL;DR: 本文提出回顾式开放词汇记忆问题，将其建模为对删失观测的概率推断，并给出ECROM方法，在HM3D长期基准上提升支撑级AP与搜索SPL。


<details>
  <summary>Details</summary>
Motivation: 长期物体搜索需要从环境中重复但不均匀的观测中学习物体常出现的位置。传统记忆方法未考虑机器人观察某个位置的机会本身不均等，导致检测与否的证据被错误加权。

Method: 将回顾式开放词汇记忆形式化为基于删失观测的概率推断，核心是"按机会计权证据"：一次检测或未检测仅应按机器人观察对应位置的机会成比例地影响信念。提出ECROM，用该原则估计仅在查询时指定的概念的长期流行度，并将所得信念直接转化为主动搜索先验。

Result: 在十个HM3D家庭中构建可控长期基准，重复遍历中独立变化物体摆放与观察机会。ECROM在留出查询上的支撑级AP比最强竞争记忆提升4.5个百分点，搜索SPL提升4.2个百分点。

Conclusion: 按观察机会加权的概率记忆能有效支持长期开放词汇物体搜索，且本文基准、数据集与代码将开源。

Abstract: Long-term object search requires learning where objects usually appear from repeated but uneven observations of a changing environment. We formulate retrospective open-vocabulary memory as probabilistic inference from censored observations, where the key idea is to reason with evidence per opportunity: a detection or non-detection should influence belief only in proportion to the robot's opportunity to observe the corresponding location. We introduce ECROM, which uses this principle to estimate long-term prevalence for concepts specified only at query time and converts the resulting belief directly into an active-search prior. To evaluate this problem, we introduce a controlled long-term benchmark in ten HM3D homes that independently varies object placement and observation opportunity across repeated traversals. ECROM improves support-level AP on held-out queries by 4.5 points and search SPL by 4.2 points over the strongest competing memory in each metric. The benchmark, dataset, and code will be open-sourced.

</details>


### [765] [DexPolicy: Scheduled Exploration for Trajectory-Guided Dexterous Manipulation](https://arxiv.org/abs/2610.00360)
*Haoyu Wang,Siyuan Qian,Yanjun Li,Zeyu Zhang,Yandong Guo,Boxin Shi,Hao Tang*

Main category: cs.RO

TL;DR: 该论文提出 DexPolicy，将 RL 探索尺度显式建模为训练步数的退火函数，在轨迹引导的灵巧操作中显著提升确定性目标任务成功率，并在仿真与真机上验证。


<details>
  <summary>Details</summary>
Motivation: 灵巧操作 RL 需先发现手指-物体接触，再精确控制物体；服务前者的动作噪声会干扰后者。在 ViViDex 等轨迹引导设置中，基线 PPO 训练 5M 步后动作噪声仍接近初始值，说明需要显式控制探索尺度。

Method: DexPolicy 将探索尺度设为训练步数的显式函数，从宽到窄退火，同时固定损失、架构、奖励与优化器设置。研究三种策略优化设置：PPO、无 critic 的 GRPO 续训，以及流参数化的 PPO 变体（FPO）。

Result: 5 个 YCB 物体、3 个训练种子下，平均确定性 Target 成功率：FPO 49.4%→68.1%，GRPO 14.1%→45.4%，PPO 32.0%→35.7%。RealMan RM75 机械臂配 Inspire/RH56 手、3 个物体 360 次试验：FPO 25.0%→85.0%，GRPO 10.0%→63.3%，PPO 8.3%→43.3%。PPO 组件筛选显示噪声控制优于所测优化器收缩；所选 PPO 调度在三个测试物体上平均 Target 成功率高于相同端点的线性衰减。

Conclusion: 训练回报、确定性 Target 成功率和执行噪声容忍度相互解离；调度应以目标执行条件下的最终任务成功率来评判，并需按任务与策略优化设置分别评估。

Abstract: Reinforcement learning (RL) for dexterous manipulation must discover finger-object contacts and then control the object precisely; the action noise that serves the first goal can interfere with the second. In trajectory-guided settings such as ViViDex, where RL refine hand-object trajectories from human video, our baseline PPO runs end near their initial action noise after 5M steps, motivating explicit control of exploration scale. DexPolicy makes that scale an explicit function of training steps, annealing from broad to narrow exploration while holding loss, architecture, reward, and optimizer settings fixed. We study three policy-optimization settings: PPO, critic-free GRPO continuation, and a flow-parameterized PPO variant (FPO). Across five YCB objects and three training seeds, mean deterministic Target success rises from 49.4% to 68.1% (FPO), 14.1% to 45.4% (GRPO), and 32.0% to 35.7% (PPO). On a RealMan RM75 arm with an Inspire/RH56 hand, 360 trials over three objects raise mean Target success from 25.0% to 85.0% (FPO), 10.0% to 63.3% (GRPO), and 8.3% to 43.3% (PPO), with one trained model per object-method condition. PPO component screening favors noise control over the tested optimizer contraction; the selected PPO schedule yields higher mean Target success than linear decay with the same endpoints on three tested objects. Training return, deterministic Target success, and tolerance to execution noise dissociate; schedules should therefore be judged by terminal task success under the intended execution conditions, per task and policy-optimization setting. Code: https://github.com/AIGeeksGroup/DexPolicy. Website: https://aigeeksgroup.github.io/DexPolicy.

</details>


### [766] [Kinematic MeanFlow: One-Step Action Generation Policy for Robotic Foundation Models](https://arxiv.org/abs/2610.00864)
*Jiawei Fan,Sifeng Wang,Yuqing Hou,Anbang Yao*

Main category: cs.RO

TL;DR: 本文提出Kinematic MeanFlow (K-MF)，一种面向机器人基础模型(RFM)的单步动作生成策略，通过在MeanFlow中解耦时间导数项为两个子区间项来分别捕捉去噪早期与晚期动态，从而实现单步推理并显著降低延迟。


<details>
  <summary>Details</summary>
Motivation: 多步flow matching在机器人基础模型中存在高推理延迟问题；现有MeanFlow框架直接应用会导致性能崩溃，其根源在于RFM速度场展现的两种特殊动态：(1)"局部加速度"早期稳定但去噪末期剧烈激增；(2)其幅值在样本间的离散度随去噪推进而扩大。

Method: 提出K-MF，基于运动学恒等式，将MeanFlow公式中的时间导数项解耦为由一个中间点分隔的两个子区间项。该解耦形式使两项分别捕捉早期和晚期的去噪动态，同时缓解整个过程中的误差放大问题。

Result: K-MF使RFM在从头训练和微调两种范式下、跨多种任务实现单步动作生成，并在多数设置下优于多步flow matching。效率方面，将GR00T-N1.6的动作头延迟在L40和Jetson Orin上的eager与compiled模式下降低67.5%~74.4%，端到端延迟降低30.3%~54.9%。

Conclusion: K-MF通过运动学解耦有效解决了MeanFlow直接应用于RFM时的性能崩溃问题，实现了高质量的单步动作生成，在大幅提升推理效率的同时保持甚至超越多步方法的性能。

Abstract: In this paper, we study how to achieve one-step action generation in Robotic Foundation Models (RFMs), aiming to overcome the high inference latency of multi-step flow matching. MeanFlow provides a promising framework for this goal, yet its direct application leads to performance collapse. We discover that this stems from two distinctive dynamics exhibited in the RFM velocity field: (1) the ``local acceleration" exhibits stability early on, but surges sharply towards the end of the denoising process, and (2) the spread of its magnitudes across samples widens as denoising progresses. To address these issues, we introduce Kinematic MeanFlow (K-MF), a novel one-step action policy tailored for RFMs. Specifically, grounded in a kinematic identity, K-MF decouples the time derivative term in the MeanFlow formulation into two sub-interval terms separated by an intermediate point. This decoupled formulation enables the two terms to capture early-stage and late-stage denoising dynamics, respectively, while mitigating the error amplification across the process. As a result, our K-MF empowers RFMs to achieve one-step action generation in both training from scratch and fine-tuning paradigms across diverse tasks, while outperforming multi-step flow matching in most settings. In terms of inference efficiency, K-MF reduces action-head latency of GR00T-N1.6 by 67.5%~74.4% across L40 and Jetson Orin in eager and compiled modes, yielding end-to-end latency reductions of 30.3%~54.9%. Code will be available at https://github.com/IntelChina-AI/K-MF.

</details>


### [767] [UniTrackPLA: Unified Panorama-Language-Action Model for Instruction-Guided Navigation and Dynamic Person Tracking](https://arxiv.org/abs/2610.00878)
*Pengfei Qi,Haoran Lin,Sizhuang Chen,Kai Luo,Sirui Zhang,Xinqi Liu,Fei Cheng,Wenrui Chen,Liming Yin,Kailun Yang*

Main category: cs.RO

TL;DR: UniTrackPLA：统一全景-语言-动作模型，同时支持指令导航与动态人跟踪，借全景感知编码、共享视觉语言主干与世界-动作一致性机制改善全向感知和闭环控制，并构建 OmniTrackNav-Bench 基准。


<details>
  <summary>Details</summary>
Motivation: 通用具身机器人需在语言指定目的地导航与任意初始方位角下动态跟踪人两类任务上均为有效；现有方法多依赖前向观测，且用两套独立策略分别处理，限制全向感知与统一闭环控制。

Method: 提出 UniTrackPLA 统一模型：Panoramic-Aware Encoding（PAE）保留全景投影透视视图的时序与方位结构，使透视预训练视觉编码器处理全向观测；共享视觉-语言主干将指令接地于全景上下文并预测连续机器人中心 waypoint 块；World-Action Consistency（WAC）预测动作条件未来视觉状态并在线校验 waypoint 前缀，可靠动作复用、不一致时触发重规划。同时构建 OmniTrackNav-Bench（5000 条仿真跟踪轨迹、10000 条仿真 VLN 路线、96 条真实路线，共 919978 个 waypoint 监督实例）。

Result: 整体跟踪 SR 从 23.50% 提升至 35.00%；Omni-VLN SR/SPL 从 13.00%/12.77% 提升至 19.75%/19.29%；加入 76 条真实路线后，held-out EP@0.2m 从 42.92% 提升至 92.08%。在 Go2-W 机器人上完成室内外统一全景跟踪与导航闭环实验。

Conclusion: UniTrackPLA 以统一全景-语言-动作框架实现全向感知下的导航与动态人跟踪闭环控制，并通过新基准与真机实验验证其有效性与统一性。

Abstract: General-purpose embodied robots should support both navigation toward language-specified destinations and dynamic person tracking under arbitrary initial target azimuths. However, existing methods typically rely on forward-facing observations and address these tasks with separate policies, limiting omnidirectional perception and unified closed-loop control. We present UniTrackPLA, a unified panorama-language-action model for instruction-guided navigation and dynamic person tracking. Its Panoramic-Aware Encoding (PAE) preserves the temporal and azimuthal structure of perspective views projected from each panorama, enabling perspective-pretrained visual encoders to process omnidirectional observations. A shared vision-language backbone grounds instructions in the panoramic context and predicts continuous robot-centric waypoint chunks for both tasks. World-Action Consistency (WAC) further predicts action-conditioned future visual states and verifies waypoint prefixes online, allowing reliable actions to be reused while triggering replanning upon inconsistency. We also introduce OmniTrackNav-Bench, comprising 5,000 simulated tracking trajectories, 10,000 simulated VLN routes, and 96 verified real-world routes, providing 919,978 waypoint-supervision instances. UniTrackPLA improves overall tracking SR from 23.50% to 35.00% and Omni-VLN SR/SPL from 13.00%/12.77% to 19.75%/19.29%. Incorporating 76 real-world routes further improves held-out EP@0.2m from 42.92% to 92.08%. Closed-loop experiments on a Go2-W robot demonstrate unified panoramic tracking and navigation across indoor and outdoor environments. The project page is at https://tw5775.github.io/UniTrackPLA.

</details>


### [768] [A Survey on End-to-End Autonomous Driving Training from the Perspectives of Data, Strategy, and Platform](https://arxiv.org/abs/2610.00926)
*Chengkai Xu,Yiming Cui,Jiaqi Liu,Yicheng Guo,Cheng Qin,Geyuan Zhang,Xinwei Dong,Shiyu Fang,Peng Hang,Jian Sun*

Main category: cs.RO

TL;DR: 本文综述端到端自动驾驶（E2E-AD）的训练方法与生态系统，提出"数据-策略-平台"三层分类体系，并展望从数据量到数据价值、从孤立优化到基础模型泛化、从静态训练到训练-测试闭环的转变。


<details>
  <summary>Details</summary>
Motivation: 端到端自动驾驶通过统一可微模型直接将多模态感知输入映射为驾驶动作，但其效果最终取决于训练生态系统的质量。现有研究分散，缺乏对训练方法及生态的系统性梳理与框架化分析。

Method: 采用综述方法，提出Data-Strategy-Platform（数据-策略-平台）分类法，将训练视为相互依赖的系统：数据层定义可学习内容，策略层决定学习如何对齐驾驶目标，平台层支撑可扩展性与持续演进。基于该框架，调研数据中心化流水线、学习范式与训练基础设施的最新进展，并分析三者交互对性能、鲁棒性与可部署性的影响。

Result: 系统总结了E2E-AD训练生态在数据、策略、平台各层的研究进展，揭示了各层之间的相互作用机制，并指出当前局限。同时维护了一个持续更新的前沿文献与工作仓库（GitHub项目页）。

Conclusion: 未来应实现三大转变：从数据数量转向数据价值，从孤立优化转向基础模型驱动的泛化，从静态训练转向训练-测试一体化闭环，从而迈向鲁棒、可扩展且可信的自动驾驶系统。

Abstract: Autonomous driving is a cornerstone technology for the future of intelligent transportation, where end-to-end learning has emerged as a transformative paradigm that directly maps multimodal sensory inputs to driving actions through unified differentiable models. While offering advantages, the effectiveness of end-to-end autonomous driving (E2E-AD) is ultimately determined by the quality of its training ecosystem. This paper provides a comprehensive review of training methods and ecosystem for E2E-AD. We introduce a Data-Strategy-Platform taxonomy that conceptualizes training as an interdependent system. The data layer defines what can be learned, the strategy layer governs how learning aligns with driving objectives, and the platform layer supports scalability and continuous evolution. Within this framework, we survey recent advances across data-centric pipelines, learning paradigms, and training infrastructures, and analyze their interplay in shaping model performance, robustness, and deployability. Finally, we reflect on current limitations and articulate a forward-looking vision that emphasizes a shift from data quantity to data value, from isolated optimization to foundation-driven generalization, and from static training to integrated training-testing loops, aiming toward robust, scalable, and trustworthy autonomous driving systems. We maintain a continuously updated repository tracking cutting-edge literature and works at \href{https://github.com/Jiaaqiliu/Awesome-Training-Ecosystem-for-E2E-AD}{Our Project Page}.

</details>


### [769] [NarrativeFlow: Flow-Based Vision-Language-Action Model Using Robot Velocity Fields](https://arxiv.org/abs/2610.00981)
*Shota Kobayashi,Koki Seno,Daichi Yashima,Komei Sugiura*

Main category: cs.RO

TL;DR: 本文提出 NarrativeFlow，将机器人流建模为语言条件下的连续速度场（流匹配），生成物理一致的机器人流，在标准数据集与真实任务中均优于基线方法。


<details>
  <summary>Details</summary>
Motivation: 语言条件操作对实际机器人系统至关重要，但机器人基础模型的扩展受限于特定具身数据采集的高成本。机器人流作为具身无关、以运动为中心的表示，可复用多平台数据；现有方法或以稀疏关键点位移粗略近似机器人流，或无法处理语言条件操作，因此需要一种能生成连续、物理一致的机器人流的方法。

Method: 提出 NarrativeFlow，采用流匹配（flow-matching）公式，在以语言为条件的情况下将机器人流建模为连续速度场，从而生成与真实操作物理一致的机器人流。

Result: 在语言条件操作的标准数据集上，NarrativeFlow 在标准评价指标上优于代表性基线方法；真实世界实验中，在多项操作任务上取得高于基线的成功率。

Conclusion: NarrativeFlow 通过语言条件的连续速度场建模机器人流，验证了其在仿真标准指标与真实操作任务中的有效性，为跨具身数据利用的语言条件操作提供了可行方案。

Abstract: We focus on language-conditioned flow-based manipulation, where robot flows (robot velocity fields) serve as embodiment-agnostic, motion-centric representations for leveraging data collected from multiple robot platforms. This task is crucial because language-conditioned manipulation is essential for practical robotic systems, yet scaling robot foundation models remains limited by the labor-intensive collection of embodiment-specific data. Existing methods either coarsely approximate robot flows with sparse keypoint displacements, or cannot handle language-conditioned manipulation. To address this limitation, we propose NarrativeFlow, which models robot flows as continuous velocity fields using a flow-matching formulation conditioned on language. Accordingly, NarrativeFlow generates robot flows that are physically consistent with real-world manipulation. To validate NarrativeFlow, we have conducted experiments on standard datasets for language-conditioned manipulation. The experimental results show that NarrativeFlow outperforms representative baseline methods on standard evaluation metrics. Furthermore, through real-world experiments, we show that NarrativeFlow achieves higher success rates than baseline methods across multiple manipulation tasks. The project page is available at https://shota0520.github.io/NarrativeFlow-project-page/

</details>


### [770] [ALFRED: Requirement-driven development of an open-source mobile manipulator for long-term plant monitoring](https://arxiv.org/abs/2610.01477)
*Ciarán Miceal Johnson,Christopher Quail,Garry Ellard,Alistair McConnell,Steve Tonneau,Fernando Auat Cheein*

Main category: cs.RO

TL;DR: 提出开源移动操作机器人ALFRED，经四次迭代满足六项户外长期部署需求，完成一年月度森林调查（528次穿行）无遗漏采集。


<details>
  <summary>Details</summary>
Motivation: 农作物与森林的季节性变化监测需要重复观测同一植株，地面机器人可近距离作业，机械臂能提供更多视角。然而，支撑长期野外数据集的机器人很少公开设计文件，且机器人自身结构对机械臂可达范围与传感器遮挡的影响鲜有在版本间对比。

Method: ALFRED采用商用组件构建，由可重构铝型材框架承载六自由度机械臂、LiDAR、RGB-D相机、RTK GNSS与IMU，底盘为Ackermann转向，软件以容器化ROS运行。围绕重复户外部署的六项需求（耐久性、模块化、可维修性、感知可达性、续航、可复现性），历经四次构建迭代；对后三个版本开展基于模型的分析（可达位姿可用比例、光线投射评估LiDAR水平视野遮挡）。

Result: 后三次构建中，机械臂可达位姿的可用比例由34.0%提升至60.0%、再至66.1%；光线投射击表明仅最终版本能保持框架安装式LiDAR前后水平视野均无遮挡。ALFRED完成一年月度森林调查（528次穿行），未错过任何计划采集，其间经历电池衰减、为他人研究进行重构，以及并行开发用于自主作物行作业的ALFRED 2.0，每次版本切换约需六小时。

Conclusion: 长期户外部署验证了迭代式结构设计对感知可达性与视野遮挡的显著改善。同时表明，机械模块化的可靠性取决于与其同步维护的机器人描述模型（URDF等），否则模块化优势难以兑现。

Abstract: Tracking seasonal change in crops and forests requires observing the same plants repeatedly. Ground robots can do this at close range, and a manipulator gives their sensors more viewpoints. Yet the robots behind long-term field datasets are rarely released with their design files, and how a robot's own structure limits arm reach and occludes its sensors is seldom compared between builds. We present ALFRED, an open-source mobile manipulator built from commercially available components. It carries a six-degree-of-freedom arm, LiDAR, RGB-D cameras, RTK GNSS and an IMU on an Ackermann-steered base, all mounted on a reconfigurable aluminium strut frame, and runs containerised ROS software. It was developed through four builds against six requirements for repeated outdoor deployment: durability, modularity, repairability, sensing reach, endurance and reproducibility. Model-based analysis of the last three builds shows the usable share of the arm's reachable poses rising from 34.0% to 60.0% and then 66.1%, and ray casting shows that only the final build keeps the frame-mounted LiDAR's horizontal view clear both forwards and backwards. ALFRED completed a year of monthly forest surveys (528 traversals) without missing a scheduled collection. This was despite battery degradation, reconfiguration for another researcher's study, and the parallel development of ALFRED 2.0 for autonomous crop-row operation, with each switch between builds taking about six hours. The deployment also showed that mechanical modularity is only as dependable as the robot description that tracks it.

</details>


### [771] [Beyond Leaderboard Scores: A Deployment-Focused Protocol for Interpretable Tracking Evaluation in Pedestrian-Centric Environments](https://arxiv.org/abs/2610.01682)
*Dominik Wojcikiewicz,Diego Paez-Granados*

Main category: cs.RO

TL;DR: 提出面向部署的仅跟踪器评测协议，用共享检测隔离跟踪器行为，在JRDB上评测六个开源跟踪器与PedRefTrack，发现漏检续跟是主要瓶颈、运行时高负载下难以满足实时。


<details>
  <summary>Details</summary>
Motivation: 移动机器人在行人中导航需要快速可得、在漏检下仍空间可信、保持身份且适配嵌入式算力的轨迹。聚合跟踪分数难以揭示轨迹何时、如何失败，且不同检测器输入会混淆跟踪器与检测器质量的影响，因此需要一种能隔离跟踪器本身行为、面向部署的评测方法。

Method: 提出仅跟踪器评测协议：所有跟踪器使用共享检测以隔离跟踪器影响，直接评估初始化、检测间隙续跟、身份恢复、近邻关联及负载相关跟踪步运行时，并保留HOTA作为补充聚合指标。在JRDB数据集上评测六个开源跟踪器和自研轻量Pedestrian Reference Tracker（PedRefTrack），另设GT辅助变体以在理想关联与运动下估计跟踪器侧残余间隙。

Result: 固定检测下，非GT跟踪器HOTA仅在24.26%–29.67%之间，但能力画像差异显著。检测器缺失1.0秒后，无GT辅助的跟踪器在不超过一半的合格案例中能保持空间正确且身份一致的输出，说明漏检续跟是所测属性中最主要的限制。近邻失败较少，主要在最短间距处增加。NVIDIA Jetson Orin上跟踪步运行时呈重尾且对负载敏感，拥挤帧中若干跟踪器低于10 Hz实时目标。

Conclusion: 该协议提供了可复现的方式，用于刻画以行人为中心场景中跟踪器的行为与部署适用性；代码与评测脚本已开源于https://github.com/SCAI-Lab/tracker_eval。

Abstract: Mobile robots operating among pedestrians need trajectories that become available quickly, remain spatially credible through missed observations, preserve identity, and fit within an embedded computing budget. Aggregate tracking scores provide limited insight into when and how trajectories fail, while varying detector inputs can confound tracker and detector quality. We present a deployment-focused, tracker-only evaluation protocol that uses shared detections to isolate tracker behavior and directly evaluates initialization, detector-gap continuation, identity recovery, close-neighbor association, and load-dependent tracker-step runtime, while Higher Order Tracking Accuracy (HOTA) is retained as a complementary aggregate measure. We apply the protocol to the JackRabbot Dataset and Benchmark (JRDB) using six open-source trackers and our lightweight Pedestrian Reference Tracker (PedRefTrack), together with a GT-assisted variant that estimates the remaining tracker-side gap under idealized association and motion. Under fixed detections, the non-GT trackers span only 24.26%-29.67% HOTA yet exhibit markedly different capability profiles. After 1.0 s without detector support, no tracker without GT assistance maintains spatially correct, same-identity output in more than half of eligible cases, making missing-observation continuation the dominant limitation among the tested properties. Close-neighbor failures are smaller and increase mainly at the shortest separations. Tracker-step runtime on an NVIDIA Jetson Orin is heavy-tailed and load-sensitive, causing several trackers to fall below the 10 Hz real-time target in crowded frames. The protocol provides a reproducible way to characterize tracker behavior and deployment suitability in pedestrian-centric environments. Code and evaluation scripts are released at https://github.com/SCAI-Lab/tracker_eval.

</details>


### [772] [World Motion Models: Flexible Sequence Modeling of SE(3) Trajectories](https://arxiv.org/abs/2610.01742)
*Jiahui Lei,Qianqian Wang,Trevor Darrell,Angjoo Kanazawa*

Main category: cs.RO

TL;DR: 本文提出 World Motion Models (WMMs)，用稀疏 SE(3) 位姿轨迹统一表示动态 3D 世界中各类实体，并通过带逐 token 噪声水平的流匹配进行序列建模，从而以同一网络支持多种 3D 视觉与机器人任务。


<details>
  <summary>Details</summary>
Motivation: 赋予人工代理空间智能需要动态 3D 世界的全面生成先验。现有方法通常针对特定任务或特定实体类型建模，缺乏统一、可复用的 4D 表示与生成框架，难以支持跨任务、跨实体、跨时间步的灵活条件建模。

Method: 核心观察是动态场景元素可由一组刚性 SE(3) 轨迹良好近似，作为 4D 建模的最小且具表达力的基元。该表示统一了关节物体、人体、手-物交互、分片刚性场景动态、相机运动乃至机器人状态与动作。在此基础上，将多实体联合分布建模为序列建模问题，采用 per-token 噪声水平的 flow-matching，并引入 context token 机制处理非序列条件，支持任意数量实体与时间步之间的 any-to-any 边缘条件化。

Result: 未来预测、运动补全、模型预测控制、逆运动学、跨本体重定向与策略学习等任务均归结为对同一网络施加不同掩码。在 3D 视觉与机器人领域的 6 类多样应用中验证，WMMs 展现出强性能与良好的通用性、灵活性。

Conclusion: WMMs 通过统一的 SE(3) 轨迹表示与掩码式序列建模，将多类 3D 视觉与机器人任务纳入同一生成框架，证明统一 4D 生成先验的可行性与通用性。

Abstract: Equipping artificial agents with spatial intelligence requires a comprehensive generative prior over the dynamic 3D world. We propose World Motion Models (WMMs) that capture "what was, is, and will be where across time" via sparse SE(3) pose trajectories. WMMs are built on the observation that elements of dynamic scenes can be well approximated by a set of rigid SE(3) trajectories, a minimal yet expressive primitive for 4D modeling. This representation unifies articulated objects, human bodies, hand-object interactions, piecewise-rigid scene dynamics, camera motion, and even robot states and actions into a single shared space. Given this representation, we cast the joint distribution of these entities as a flexible sequence modeling problem, utilizing flow-matching with per-token noise levels. Coupled with a context token mechanism for non-sequential conditioning, this formulation supports any-to-any marginal conditioning across an arbitrary number of entities and time steps. Tasks such as future prediction, motion infilling, model-predictive control, inverse kinematics, cross-embodiment retargeting, and policy learning all reduce to the application of different masks over the same network. Experiments on 6 diverse applications of 3D vision and robotics demonstrate the versatility and flexibility of WMMs with strong performance.

</details>


### [773] [End-to-End Learning vs. Modular Architectures: Comparative Insights into Autonomous Driving Systems](https://arxiv.org/abs/2610.01746)
*Kartik B. Kapse*

Main category: cs.RO

TL;DR: 本文对端到端学习与模块化架构两种自动驾驶设计范式进行系统对比，并提出四维架构选择框架以指导实际部署。


<details>
  <summary>Details</summary>
Motivation: 自动驾驶是智能交通研究的核心，端到端学习与模块化架构是两大主流实现范式，但缺乏对其优势、局限与权衡的系统性比较，难以指导不同应用场景下的架构选择。

Method: 综合文献综述，从可解释性、可扩展性、鲁棒性和实际适用性等关键维度对两种范式进行对比分析；并进一步提出"四维架构选择框架"，包含覆盖安全、运行环境、数据/算力资源、部署情境的十二项二元判据。

Result: 端到端学习强调简洁性与动态环境适应性，但缺乏透明性且高度依赖大规模数据；模块化架构可解释性与任务针对性优化更强，却面临集成复杂与扩展性问题。所提出的选择框架在10个已发表自动驾驶系统上验证，正确推荐7/10的部署架构。

Conclusion: 本文系统梳理了两种范式间的关键权衡，指出混合架构（融合双方优势）是克服各自局限、值得未来研究的重要方向。

Abstract: Autonomous driving systems have become a central focus of intelligent transportation research, with End-to-End Learning and Modular Architectures offering two prominent design paradigms for their implementation. E2E Learning uses deep learning algorithms to map raw sensory inputs directly to driving actuators, providing a streamlined and adaptable solution. while Modular Architectures employ a pipeline-based approach, dividing the system into distinct subsystems for perception, cognition, planning, and control. This paper presents a comprehensive comparative analysis of these paradigms, focusing on their strengths, limitations, and trade-offs to provide insights into their suitability for various autonomous driving applications. The study evaluates key factors such as interpretability, scalability, robustness, and real-world applicability. While End-to-End Learning emphasizes simplicity and adaptability in dynamic environments, it lacks transparency and is highly dependent on large datasets. Conversely, Modular Architectures offer superior interpretability and task-specific optimization, but face challenges related to integration complexity and scalability. To address these limitations, hybrid approaches that combine the strengths of both paradigms have emerged, offering a promising direction for overcoming these challenges. Beyond this comparative synthesis, following work proposes a Four-Dimensional Architecture Selection Framework, comprising twelve binary criteria across safety, operating environment, data/computational resources, and deployment context, and validate it against ten published autonomous driving systems, correctly recommending 7/10 deployed architectures. This work synthesizes existing literature to highlight key trade-offs between the paradigms and identifies hybrid architectures as a promising direction for future research.

</details>


### [774] [InterEvolve: Test-Time Evolution of Reward Programs for Humanoid Loco-Manipulation](https://arxiv.org/abs/2610.02196)
*Zhuo Lin,Sirui Xu,Liuyu Bian,Yu-Xiong Wang,Liang-Yan Gui*

Main category: cs.RO

TL;DR: 本文提出 InterEvolve 框架，实现人形机器人 loco-manipulation 的测试时演化：无需重新训练，即可通过复用控制器已有技能、从自身尝试中改进并保留所学，完成未训练过的任务。


<details>
  <summary>Details</summary>
Motivation: 现有控制器通常只针对特定任务训练，面对新任务时能力难以释放；人类设计的奖励函数往往无法充分挖掘控制器已有的 loco-manipulation 能力。

Method: 核心在于设计一个兼具表达力与可执行性的"规划—控制"接口。1）提出 object-aware forward-backward（FB）行为基础模型，在冻结的身体先验上加入物体残差，将关于身体或物体的新奖励在测试时转化为 loco-manipulation 行为；2）将任务表示为"奖励程序"：带完成条件与可调常数的分阶段奖励。由 LLM 智能体基于执行反馈与已验证程序技能库，在上下文中修改程序结构，数值优化器调节其常数；每个候选在并行仿真场景中验证。

Result: 实验表明，人工设计的奖励仅释放了 FB 模型 loco-manipulation 能力的一部分，而 InterEvolve 演化出的程序能进一步释放该能力，甚至产生新颖策略；在仿真中可应对多样任务、复杂场景与长时程组合，且演化出的技能可基于第一视角机载感知在 Unitree G1 实机上自主运行。

Conclusion: 通过规划与控制的表达性接口，结合 FB 基础模型与 LLM 引导的奖励程序演化，可在不重训练的前提下持续挖掘并组合控制器已有运动能力，实现人形机器人测试时技能复用与演化，并成功迁移至真实硬件。

Abstract: We study test-time evolution for humanoid loco-manipulation: solving tasks that a controller was never trained for by repurposing its existing skills, improving from its own attempts, and retaining what it learns, without retraining. Our key insight is that a broad controller already holds much of the competence a new task needs, and that this competence becomes accessible through an interface between planning and control that is expressive enough to specify contact-rich, multi-stage interactions, yet executable and measurable enough that execution feedback can guide planning from experience. InterEvolve realizes this interface with two components. First, we develop an object-aware forward-backward (FB) behavioral foundation model, whose object residuals on a frozen body prior turn a new reward about the body or objects into loco-manipulation behavior at test time. Second, we specify tasks as reward programs: staged rewards with completion conditions and tunable constants. A large language model (LLM) agent revises the program structure in context, drawing on execution feedback and a skill library of verified programs, while a numerical optimizer tunes its constants. With every candidate verified across parallel simulation scenarios, the program explores new ways to induce, repurpose, and compose the controller's existing motor competence for the task at hand, and thus improves over iterations. Experiments show that human-designed rewards leave much of the FB model's loco-manipulation competence untapped, whereas the programs InterEvolve evolves release it, sometimes through novel strategies. It further produces behaviors for diverse tasks, complex scenes, and long-horizon compositions in simulation, and evolved skills run autonomously on a physical Unitree G1 from egocentric onboard perception.

</details>


### [775] [Bounded-Fidelity Sim-as-Demo-Stage: Mocap Handoff for Governance Benchmarks](https://arxiv.org/abs/2610.00008)
*Xue Qin,Simin Luan,Cong Yang,Zhijun Li*

Main category: cs.RO

TL;DR: 提出 bounded-fidelity sim-as-demo-stage 设计模式：在显式括起的交接包络内抑制接触物理，其余区域保留完整动力学，用 MuJoCo mocap-body 原语加 220 行 Python 适配器实现，使治理基准测试的事件日志哈希在重放间达到字节级一致。


<details>
  <summary>Details</summary>
Motivation: 仿真到现实研究以物理保真度为首要目标，但在 LLM 驱动机器人的治理基准测试中，评测对象是准入/策略/合约/审计流水线是否行为正确，而物体交接（抓取、搬运、放置）处的接触保真度反而成为负担：接触力积分噪声会注入与待测治理属性结构性无关的审计链分歧，干扰基准判定。

Method: 提出 bounded-fidelity sim-as-demo-stage 设计模式，在显式括起的交接包络内抑制接触物理、包络外保留完整动力学。实现基于 MuJoCo 的 mocap-body 原语，由 220 行 Python 适配器驱动，治理桥通过结构化意图调用。将审计链稳定性形式化为重放之间哈希事件日志的字节相等，并给出可推出该性质的两条包络结构属性。实验设置：每种姿态 N=1000 次重放；时间步扫描 1、2、5、10 ms；包络边缘时序抖动 ±10 仿真步共 1400 次重放；K∈{1,2,3} 个顺序交接物体共 1500 次重放。

Result: mocap 变体每姿态仅产生 1 个不同审计链哈希（1000/1000 字节相同，Wilson 95% CI [0.997, 1.000]）；接触力基线产生 584 个不同哈希（993/1000 分歧，CI [0.987, 0.998]）。时间步扫描显示分歧为结构性而非调参产物，各步长均维持 0.985。包络边缘时序抖动（±10 步，1400 次重放）产生 0 分歧；K∈{1,2,3} 顺序交接下审计链保持字节相等（1500 次重放），每次抓取-放置开销呈亚线性。

Conclusion: 该模式以近乎零工程成本为基准设计者提供审计链可复现性，同时明确了其有害适用范围（仿真到现实验证、策略训练、接触密集任务），以避免误用。

Abstract: Sim-to-real research pursues physics fidelity as a primary objective: simulators are judged by how closely they reproduce real-world contact dynamics. For governance benchmarking of LLM-driven robots, where the simulator demonstrates that an admission/policy/contract/audit pipeline behaves correctly, contact fidelity at object handoffs (grasp, carry, place) becomes a liability: contact-force integration noise injects audit-chain divergence that is structurally unrelated to the governance property under test. We propose bounded-fidelity sim-as-demo-stage, a design pattern that suppresses contact physics within explicitly bracketed handoff envelopes while preserving full dynamics elsewhere. The construction uses MuJoCo's mocap-body primitive driven by a 220-line Python adapter that the governance bridge invokes via structured intents. We formalise audit-chain stability as byte-equality of the hashed event log across replays and identify two structural envelope properties that imply it. Across N=1000 replays per posture, the mocap variant produces one distinct audit-chain hash (1000/1000 byte-identical; Wilson 95% CI [0.997, 1.000]); the contact-force baseline produces 584 distinct hashes (993/1000 diverged; CI [0.987, 0.998]). A timestep sweep (1, 2, 5, 10 ms) shows the divergence is structural, not a tuning artefact: it stays at 0.985 at every timestep. Envelope-edge timing jitter (+/-10 simulation steps, 1,400 replays) produces 0 divergence, and audit chains remain byte-equal across K in {1, 2, 3} sequentially handed-off objects (1,500 replays) with sub-linear per-pick-and-place overhead. The pattern gives benchmark designers audit-chain reproducibility at near-zero engineering cost; we also map where it is harmful (sim-to-real validation, policy training, contact-rich tasks) so it is not mis-deployed.

</details>


### [776] [Multi-Reference Path Tracking Control for an Agricultural Tractor with Nonlinear Model Predictive Control](https://arxiv.org/abs/2610.00057)
*Marcel Moll,Timo Oksanen*

Main category: cs.RO

TL;DR: 提出基于非线性模型预测控制（NMPC）的拖拉机路径跟踪控制器，将分段线性参考路径的多段直接纳入目标函数，并给出可行驶参考段选取方法；经拖拉机机具管理转向接口实车试验验证。


<details>
  <summary>Details</summary>
Motivation: 精准农业需要引导拖拉机沿预定参考路径行驶，路径跟踪控制是其关键环节，需兼顾曲线路径的跟踪精度与实时性。

Method: 构建基于NMPC的路径跟踪控制器，将分段线性参考路径的多段约束/目标直接嵌入优化目标函数，并提出从完整路径中筛选有效参考段的方法；通过Tractor Implement Management转向接口实现实车控制与田间试验。

Result: NMPC求解器平均3.45 ms收敛；对曲线参考路径跟踪的平均绝对横向偏差为6.1 cm。

Conclusion: 该NMPC路径跟踪方案计算效率高、跟踪精度达厘米级，适用于精准农业拖拉机自动导航的实际应用。

Abstract: Guiding a tractor along a predefined reference path is a key component of precision agriculture. This study develops a path tracking controller based on Nonlinear Model Predictive Control, which incorporates multiple segments of a piecewise-linear reference path directly into the objective function. In addition, methods for selecting viable reference segments from the full path are presented. The control system is evaluated during a field test with a tractor controlled via the Tractor Implement Management steering interface. The NMPC solver converged on average after 3.45 ms and tracked the curved reference path with a mean absolute cross-track error of 6.1 cm.

</details>


### [777] [Probabilistic Plan Legibility with Off-the-shelf Planners](https://arxiv.org/abs/2610.00065)
*Michele Persiani,Thomas Hellström*

Main category: cs.RO

TL;DR: 该论文提出一种面向任意PDDL领域的可读性规划方法，通过扩展既有可读性研究至经典规划而无需构建专用规划器，并利用二阶心智理论估计观察者视角，实现规划器与观察者任务空间的关联；实验表明可读性与效率之间存在权衡，需引入正则化因子进行平衡。


<details>
  <summary>Details</summary>
Motivation: 可读性规划旨在生成从观察者角度能最大程度区分目标与候选目标的计划，从而支持人-机器人协作场景中机器人通过计划隐式传达目标。

Method: 将先前可读性研究扩展到经典规划，面向任意PDDL领域提出可读性规划方法，不依赖临时构建的专用规划器；并通过二阶心智理论连接规划者与观察者的任务空间来估计观察者视角。

Result: 在若干PDDL规划领域进行了基准测试，结果显示计划可读性与计划效率通常存在权衡关系，但并非所有规划领域都能以相同方式提升可读性，因此需要正则化因子来平衡可读性与效率。

Conclusion: 可读性规划可应用于人-机器人团队场景，使自主机器人通过生成可读计划隐式沟通其目标；同时表明可读性与效率的平衡需要依赖正则化机制，且不同PDDL领域的可读性提升方式存在差异。

Abstract: Legible planning is the creation of plans that best disambiguate their goals from a set of other candidates from an observer's perspective. In this paper we propose a method for legible planning for arbitrary PDDL domains, by extending previous research on legibility to classical planning without requiring to construct ad-hoc planners. We also discuss how the observer perspective may be estimated through a second order theory of mind that connects the planner's and the observer's task spaces. Our solution can for example be deployed in human-robot teaming scenarios, where an autonomous robot in a team can implicitly communicate its goal by producing legible plans. We present benchmark results on several PDDL planning domains. Our results generally show that plan legibility is a trade-off with plan efficiency, however, not all planning domains allows to increase legibility in the same way and a regularizing factor to balance legibility and efficiency was proved necessary.

</details>


### [778] [HumanoidTTT: Test-Time Capability Reuse for Efficient Humanoid Control](https://arxiv.org/abs/2610.00198)
*Jingtai Yang,Yining Wu,Yanjun Li,Zeyu Zhang,Hao Tang*

Main category: cs.RO

TL;DR: 提出HumanoidTTT框架，通过选择性完整动作复用与测试时能力固化，实现人形机器人持续部署中已验证动作能力的可靠高效复用。


<details>
  <summary>Details</summary>
Motivation: 人形机器人持续部署中，相同动作能力会被反复请求；但中间动作会改变机器人进入状态，导致此前成功的动作无法盲目重放；同时已验证能力不断累积，而存储有限，需决定保留哪些能力。

Method: 提出HumanoidTTT：1）选择性完整动作复用（Selective Full-Motion Reuse），仅从经认证的适用进入状态授权直接复用已验证完整动作，被接受的复用可跳过全新生成；2）测试时能力固化（Test-Time Capability Consolidation），以后续部署中的复用情况为反馈，在有界完整动作库中自适应决定哪些合格能力留存。

Result: 实验显示零不安全接受（zero unsafe accepts），端到端相比全新生成提速16.4倍；在线固化相比冻结版本每200次请求平均多避免13.2次生成器调用。

Conclusion: HumanoidTTT在持续部署中实现了已验证动作能力可靠且高效的复用，并能自适应保留有用能力，代码与网站已开源。

Abstract: Recent advances in motion generation and whole-body tracking have enabled humanoid robots to execute increasingly diverse motions, yet the same motion capabilities may be requested repeatedly during continual deployment. Reliable reuse is challenging because intervening motions can change the robot's entry state, making previously successful motions unsafe to replay blindly. Meanwhile, validated capabilities accumulate during deployment, while bounded storage requires deciding which ones are worth retaining. To address these challenges, we present HumanoidTTT, a framework for test-time capability reuse in continual humanoid control. Specifically, we introduce Selective Full-Motion Reuse, which authorizes direct reuse of validated complete motions only from certified applicable entry states, allowing accepted reuse to bypass fresh generation. We further introduce Test-Time Capability Consolidation, which adapts which qualified capabilities persist in a bounded Full-Motion Store using subsequent deployment reuse as feedback. Experiments demonstrate zero unsafe accepts and a 16.4$\times$ end-to-end speedup over fresh generation, while online consolidation improves avoided generator calls by 13.2 per 200 requests over its frozen counterpart. Overall, HumanoidTTT enables reliable and efficient reuse of validated motion capabilities while adaptively retaining useful capabilities throughout continual deployment. Code: https://github.com/AIGeeksGroup/HumanoidTTT. Website: https://aigeeksgroup.github.io/HumanoidTTT.

</details>


### [779] [Real-Time Whole-Body Safe Motion Generation for Multi-Segment Tendon-Driven Continuum Robots](https://arxiv.org/abs/2610.00220)
*Fangju Yang,Siyi Ma,Tonghao Guan,Tingcong Liu,Hang Yang,Zhengqiang Zhang,Jian S. Dai,Ke Wu*

Main category: cs.RO

TL;DR: 提出面向平面多段腱驱动连续体机器人的统一驱动空间框架，结合能量基变曲率建模与多点CBF-QP，实现实时全身无碰撞运动生成。


<details>
  <summary>Details</summary>
Motivation: 腱驱动连续体机器人的实时运动生成需要精确建模非均匀弯曲并实现全身碰撞避免，而现有方法在建模精度、计算维度与安全性约束之间难以兼顾。

Method: 构建能量基变曲率模型以刻画空间变化的腱间距与弯曲刚度，并给出解析雅可比用于微分逆运动学与安全监测；采用多点CBF-QP在障碍物运动与驱动速度约束下保证骨架间隙，其决策维度仅取决于独立驱动段数。

Result: 模型与GVS参考吻合，最大曲率误差5.223×10⁻² m⁻¹；100次MuJoCo试验中静态与动态场景无碰撞成功率分别为96%和100%，无CBF约束时约为60%和80%；穿洞测试验证受限环境下的安全运动；600个骨架监测点下平均控制步耗时6.66 ms。

Conclusion: 该统一驱动空间框架在保证建模精度的同时实现了实时全身安全运动生成，验证了CBF约束对碰撞避免有效性的显著提升。

Abstract: Real-time motion generation for tendon-driven continuum robots requires accurate modeling of nonuniform bending and whole-body collision avoidance. This paper presents a unified actuation-space framework for planar multi-segment tendon-driven continuum robots. An energy-based variable-curvature model captures spatially varying tendon spacing and bending stiffness and provides analytical Jacobians for differential inverse kinematics and safety monitoring. A multipoint CBF-QP enforces backbone clearance under obstacle motion and actuation-velocity bounds, while its decision dimension depends only on the number of independently actuated segments. The model closely agrees with GVS references, with a maximum curvature error of $5.223 \times 10^{-2}\,\mathrm{m}^{-1}$. Over 100 MuJoCo trials, the proposed method achieves collision-free success rates of 96% and 100% in static and dynamic scenarios, respectively, compared with approximately 60% and 80% without CBF constraints. Hole-traversal tests further demonstrate safe motion in constrained environments. With 600 backbone monitoring points, the mean control-step time is 6.66 ms, demonstrating real-time whole-body safe motion generation.

</details>


### [780] [IndoorBEV: A Lightweight Real-Time LiDAR BEV Perception System for Indoor Mobile Robots](https://arxiv.org/abs/2610.00355)
*Haichuan Li*

Main category: cs.RO

TL;DR: 提出 IndoorBEV，一种轻量级室内 LiDAR 感知框架，通过高度感知 BEV 表示与几何条件特征融合，在严格延迟与内存约束下兼顾三维几何信息与计算效率。


<details>
  <summary>Details</summary>
Motivation: 移动机器人在室内杂乱三维环境中需满足严格的延迟与内存约束。现有点云/体素方法计算开销大，而传统 BEV 表示虽高效却丢失垂直几何信息，存在效率与精度的权衡问题。

Method: 采用高度感知 BEV 表示：用统计高度特征与多频高度编码总结每个 BEV 单元内的垂直点分布，使三维线索可由二维卷积高效处理；轻量编码器融合互补几何特征、多尺度局部表示与紧凑全局场景上下文；解耦的稠密预测头联合输出语义 BEV 图与有向目标框。

Result: 模型仅 0.6M 参数、2.3 MB 存储；NVIDIA AGX Orin 上单次推理占用 21.52 MB GPU 显存，200 ms 感知截止期内平均延迟 169.6 ms，超时率 1.8%。在仿真场景、真实机器人扫描与开源室内点云数据集上均表现出感知精度、延迟与内存的良好权衡。

Conclusion: 在紧凑 BEV 表示中显式编码垂直几何，是资源高效室内 LiDAR 感知的有效途径。

Abstract: Efficient indoor LiDAR perception is challenging because mobile robots must understand cluttered three-dimensional environments under strict latency and memory constraints. Existing point-based and voxel-based methods often incur substantial computational overhead, whereas conventional bird's-eye-view (BEV) representations improve efficiency at the cost of discarding vertical geometric information. We present IndoorBEV, a lightweight LiDAR perception framework that mitigates this tradeoff through a height-aware BEV representation and geometry-conditioned feature fusion. IndoorBEV summarizes the vertical point distribution in each BEV cell using statistical height features and multi-frequency height encoding, allowing informative three-dimensional cues to be processed efficiently by two-dimensional convolutions. A lightweight encoder then integrates complementary geometric features with multi-scale local representations and compact global scene context. Decoupled dense prediction heads jointly produce semantic BEV maps and oriented object bounding boxes. IndoorBEV contains only 0.6M parameters and requires 2.3 MB of model storage. On an NVIDIA AGX Orin, it uses 21.52 MB of GPU memory per inference and achieves a mean latency of 169.6 ms under a 200 ms perception deadline, with a deadline miss ratio of 1.8\%. Evaluations on simulated scenes, real-world robot scans, and an open-source indoor point-cloud dataset demonstrate a favorable tradeoff among perception accuracy, latency, and memory consumption. These results indicate that explicitly encoding vertical geometry within a compact BEV representation provides an effective approach to resource-efficient indoor LiDAR perception.

</details>


### [781] [DeepJEPA: Scaling World Models from Within](https://arxiv.org/abs/2610.00368)
*Zijian Jin,Yunbei Zhang,Yuanzhe Liu,Ming Liu,Baian Chen,Weirui Ye,Shilong Liu,Marco Pavone*

Main category: cs.RO

TL;DR: DeepJEPA提出将世界模型中每个转移的计算深度作为内层测试时缩放轴，通过权重共享的联合嵌入预测模型自适应学习何时需要额外递归更新，在多个视觉控制任务中匹配或超越最强固定深度规划器，同时平均每转移仅需1.00-1.26次更新。


<details>
  <summary>Details</summary>
Motivation: 现有世界模型规划器通常通过滚动更远、采样更多轨迹或优化更长时间来向外扩展，并对每个想象转移分配相同计算量。作者指出均匀加深每个转移会浪费计算并可能损害规划，因为有用的精细化仅集中在少量决策关键事件上。

Method: 提出DeepJEPA，一种权重共享的联合嵌入预测（JEPA）世界模型，将转移深度视为内层测试时缩放轴，并学习对每个候选与滚动步骤判断是否值得再执行一次递归更新。

Result: 在五个视觉控制设置中，DeepJEPA提升或匹配最强固定深度规划器，平均每转移仅1.00-1.26次更新；额外计算集中在接触开始与持续物体交互阶段，这些潜在修正确实影响精英候选集合与动作选择。表示探测表明，规划改善并不需要一致更好的物体状态可解码性。

Conclusion: DeepJEPA将世界模型缩放重新表述为内部计算的分配问题：在能改变规划器决策的地方进行思考，即在决策关键转移处更深思考，而非让每个滚动转移都统一更深或更长。

Abstract: World-model planners typically scale outward by rolling farther, sampling more trajectories, or optimizing longer, while assigning the same computation to every imagined transition. We show that making every transition uniformly deeper wastes computation and can degrade planning because useful refinement is concentrated at a small set of decision-critical events. We introduce DeepJEPA, a weight-tied joint-embedding predictive world model that treats transition depth as an inner test-time scaling axis and learns when another recurrent update is worth computing for each candidate and rollout step. Across five visual-control settings, DeepJEPA improves or matches the strongest fixed-depth planner while averaging only 1.00-1.26 updates per transition. Its additional computation concentrates at contact onset and sustained object interaction, where latent corrections can change which candidates enter the planner's elite set and which action is selected. Representation probes further show that improved planning does not require uniformly better object-state decodability. DeepJEPA therefore reframes world-model scaling as a problem of allocating internal computation where it can change the planner's decision: think deeper at decision-critical transitions instead of making every rollout uniformly deeper or longer.

</details>


### [782] [Whole-Body Aerial Grasping and Lifting via Partial Visual Observations](https://arxiv.org/abs/2610.00404)
*Jiaye Jin,Rui Jin,Xinhang Xu,Haotian Jin,Ruiyang Liu,Yi Wang,Jiayan Zhao,Kun Cao,Lihua Xie*

Main category: cs.RO

TL;DR: 提出循环教师-学生框架，在仿真中学习单一策略，无需显式任务阶段输入即可联合控制飞行、机械臂运动与夹爪闭合，完成空中抓取-提升任务。


<details>
  <summary>Details</summary>
Motivation: 空中抓取-提升任务需要全身协调，且在目标观测不完整的情况下完成接近、获取、提升等阶段。训练早期接近阶段易失败，导致后续阶段曝光不足；执行时可见性变化也会影响对准与闭合时机。

Method: 采用循环教师-学生框架：特权教师通过强化学习并配合关键状态课程训练，先暴露获取与提升状态再连接正常接近轨迹；将其行为蒸馏为循环视觉学生，用双视角点云与本体感受替代特权目标状态，并整合观测历史做闭环控制。另设闭合目标，从持续的模型定义就绪序列监督闭合时机。

Result: 在条件触发锁存、虚拟附着与基于力旋量的负载加载仿真模型下完成8,996个回合：冻结学生在标称、物理/控制随机化、额外相机随机化条件下全任务成功率分别为99.97%、97.14%、95.84%；标称条件下按锁存计数加权的每种子90百分位对准误差均值为8.12 mm。

Conclusion: 该框架无需任务阶段输入即可实现高鲁棒性的空中抓取-提升全身控制，对物理、控制与视觉随机化均保持较高成功率，并取得毫米级对准精度。

Abstract: Aerial grasp-and-lift tasks require whole-body coordination across approach, acquisition, and lifting under partial target observations. Early approach failures can limit exposure to later task stages during training, while changing visibility complicates alignment and closure timing during execution. We present a recurrent teacher-student framework that learns a single policy in simulation to jointly command flight, arm motion, and gripper closure without an explicit task-phase input. A privileged teacher learns through reinforcement learning with a critical-state curriculum that exposes acquisition and lifting states before connecting them to normal approach trajectories. Its behavior is distilled into a recurrent visual student that replaces privileged target states with dual-view point clouds and proprioception, integrating observation history for closed-loop control. A dedicated closure objective supervises closure timing from sustained model-defined readiness sequences. Training and primary evaluation use a simulated acquisition-and-payload model with condition-triggered latching, virtual attachment, and wrench-based payload loading for short-distance lifting. Across 8,996 completed simulation episodes under this model, the frozen student achieves full-task success rates of 99.97%, 97.14%, and 95.84% under nominal, physics/control-randomized, and additional camera-randomized conditions, respectively. The nominal latch-count-weighted mean of per-seed 90th-percentile alignment errors at acquisition is 8.12 mm.

</details>


### [783] [Towards a General Humanoid Loco-Manipulation Model via Egocentric Whole-Body Human Data Pretraining](https://arxiv.org/abs/2610.00438)
*Chongyang Xu,Zhao Wu,Jin Chen,Yiming Jiang,Jinhui Ye,Yuming Jiang,Shifeng Zhang,Ziliang Feng,Mu Xu,Yilun Chen,Li Lu,Steven C. H. Hoi*

Main category: cs.RO

TL;DR: 提出HumanVerse-500数据集与λ₀人形全身视觉-语言-动作策略，通过三阶段训练将人类自我中心视频经验迁移到人形机器人全身移动操作，在SIMPLE及4项真实任务上取得SOTA。


<details>
  <summary>Details</summary>
Motivation: 人形全身操作进展迅速，但现有自我中心人类视频监督对全身运动与手-物交互协调的覆盖有限，而通过人形遥操作获取此类监督成本高、难以规模化。因此作者探索如何利用人类经验支撑可扩展的人形移动操作学习。

Method: 构建HumanVerse-500：500小时开放世界人类移动操作行为数据集，用轻量可穿戴系统同步自我中心视频与身体、手部运动。基于该数据开发λ₀——全身人形VLA策略，采用三阶段训练：先利用多样自我中心数据学习交互，再用HumanVerse-500协调身体与手部运动，最后适配下游任务与机器人本体。通过共享表示空间实现人类经验迁移，用领域特定接口处理人与机器人状态/动作差异。

Result: 在SIMPLE基准与4项真实世界移动操作任务上评估λ₀，取得SOTA性能，并分析其缩放行为、泛化能力及各训练阶段的贡献。

Conclusion: 人类经验可为下游人形全身控制提供可扩展支持，验证了数据规模与三阶段训练的有效性；作者将开源代码、模型与数据以促进后续研究。

Abstract: Humanoid whole-body manipulation has advanced rapidly, enabling policies to coordinate locomotion, posture, bimanual interaction, and dexterous hand movements. Meanwhile, egocentric human videos provide diverse examples of everyday interactions across objects and scenes, offering scalable supervision without robot operation. However, existing supervision from these videos provides limited coverage of whole-body movement and coordination with hand-object interaction, while obtaining such supervision through humanoid teleoperation is also costly and difficult to scale. We therefore explore how human experience can support scalable learning of humanoid loco-manipulation. To support this study, we introduce HumanVerse-500, a 500-hour dataset of diverse human loco-manipulation behaviors in open-world environments, collected with a lightweight wearable system that synchronizes egocentric video with body and hand motion. Building on this dataset, we develop $λ_0$, a whole-body humanoid vision-language-action policy, through three-stage training that first learns interaction from diverse egocentric datasets, then coordinates body and hand motion using HumanVerse-500, and finally adapts the policy to downstream tasks and robot embodiments. Across these stages, $λ_0$ learns a shared representation space for human experience transfer, while domain-specific interfaces handle differences between human and robot states and actions. We evaluate $λ_0$ on SIMPLE and 4 real-world loco-manipulation tasks, achieving state-of-the-art performance, and further analyze its scaling behavior, generalization, and training-stage contributions to understand how human data support downstream whole-body humanoid control. We will release our code, models, and data to support further research.

</details>


### [784] [ScaffoldM3C: A Multimodal Sequential Monte Carlo Framework for Generative Stable Construction Planning](https://arxiv.org/abs/2610.00487)
*Gadiel Sznaier Camps,Chengyang He,Guillaume Sartoretti,Eduardo Montijano,Mac Schwager*

Main category: cs.RO

TL;DR: 提出ScaffoldM3C，一种多模态、轻量的自回归模型，将积木式3D结构构建建模为概率式下一块生成任务，引入脚手架令牌并利用序列蒙特卡洛维护多样装配序列，实现高稳定性构建。


<details>
  <summary>Details</summary>
Motivation: 自主构建物理可实现的3D结构面临诸多挑战：组合爆炸的动作空间、可互换零部件、多路径（等效终点）装配序列，以及构建过程中严格的稳定性要求。现有SOTA方法微调大语言模型进行文本驱动的生成式构建，但存在三点不足：(1) 不支持多模态条件（文本、图像、草图）；(2) 忽视脚手架对稳定中间结构的实际作用；(3) 推理速度慢。因此需要一种支持多模态条件、显式考虑脚手架、且推理高效的方法。

Method: 将构建形式化为具有多种潜在装配动作和多种潜在任务条件模态的概率式下一块生成任务；引入辅助脚手架块令牌以显式考虑脚手架的稳定效用；提出ScaffoldM3C——一个多模态、轻量、自回归的积木构建模型，输出一组下一步候选块；基于这些候选，采用序列蒙特卡洛（SMC）维护可能装配序列的种群，从而同时考虑多个、可能不同的装配方向；通过将StableText2Brick数据集扩展为包含图像条件提示与脚手架稳定化的构建序列来训练该多模态架构。

Result: ScaffoldM3C比竞争基线小4倍，推理速度提升5至20倍，同时构建质量与SOTA方法相当，总体稳定性更高。通过仿真和真实机器人装配演示验证了方法的有效性。

Conclusion: ScaffoldM3C通过多模态条件、显式脚手架机制与SMC候选种群搜索，在保证构建质量的同时显著提升推理效率与结构稳定性，并成功迁移至真实机器人装配场景。

Abstract: Autonomously constructing physically realizable 3D structures remains a significant challenge due to combinatorial action spaces, interchangeable components, equifinal assembly sequences, and strict stability requirements during construction. State-of-the-art methods fine-tune large language models for text-based generative construction. However, these approaches do not allow for Multimodal (text, image, sketch) conditioning, overlook the practical role of scaffolding for stabilizing intermediate structures, and suffer from slow inference speeds. Therefore, we formulate construction as a probabilistic next-block generation task with multiple potential assembly actions and multiple potential task conditioning modalities. Concurrently, we explicitly consider the utility of scaffolding by introducing an auxiliary scaffold block token. We present Scaffold Multimodal Monte Carlo (ScaffoldM3C), a multimodal, lightweight, auto-regressive model for stable block-based construction, that proposes a set of next-step candidate blocks. Leveraging these candidates, we utilize Sequential Monte Carlo (SMC) to maintain a population of possible assembly sequences, allowing us to consider multiple, potentially different, assembly directions simultaneously. We train our multimodal architecture by extending the StableText2Brick dataset to contain image conditioning prompts and scaffold-stabilized build sequences. ScaffoldM3C is 4x smaller than competing baselines, yielding a 5x to 20x speedup during inference, while achieving comparable construction quality to state-of-the-art methods and higher overall stability. We demonstrate the effectiveness of our approach through simulations and real-world robot assembly demonstrations.

</details>


### [785] [Same Scene, Different Task: Skill Alignment for Compositional Generalization in VLAs](https://arxiv.org/abs/2610.00524)
*Taegeun Yang,Youngju Na,Yoonki Cho,Sung-Eui Yoon*

Main category: cs.RO

TL;DR: 本文提出CRAFT，通过构造反事实指令对并借助可复用的技能表示转移监督，抑制视觉捷径，提升VLA模型对未演示技能组合的组合泛化能力。


<details>
  <summary>Details</summary>
Motivation: VLA模型难以泛化到微调演示中未出现的技能组合，即使每个组成技能都已单独演示过。作者将"视觉捷径"视为一种失败模式：微调时视觉观测可能成为指令的代理，使策略依据相似观测执行已演示的组合，而非执行指令指定的组合。

Method: 受此启发，用"反事实对"进行训练：固定某条演示观测，将指令改为指定一个未被演示的组合。但这类配对缺少对应的演示动作目标。关键观察是：当前所需技能本身已被演示过，然而这些执行中的动作不能直接作为目标，因为同一技能在不同观测下可能需要不同动作。CRAFT因此利用可跨执行复用的技能表示，将已演示执行中的监督迁移到反事实对上。

Result: 在三个VLA模型和两个仿真基准上，CRAFT提升了未演示组合的成功率，同时保持在已演示组合上的高成功率；在真实机器人上也提升了组合泛化能力。

Conclusion: 通过反事实指令对揭示并缓解视觉捷径，配合可复用技能表示实现监督迁移，是一种有效的VLA组合泛化训练策略，且跨模型、跨基准及真机均验证有效。

Abstract: Vision-language-action (VLA) models often struggle to generalize to skill combinations absent from their fine-tuning demonstrations, even when every constituent skill has been demonstrated. We focus on a vision shortcut as one failure mode: during fine-tuning, visual observations can serve as a proxy for the instruction, so a policy may execute a demonstrated combination associated with similar observations rather than the instructed combination. This motivates training with counterfactual pairs formed by holding a demonstration observation fixed while changing the instruction to specify an undemonstrated combination. These pairs, however, lack corresponding demonstrated action targets. Crucially, the currently required skill has already been demonstrated, but actions from those executions cannot serve as direct targets because the same skill can require different actions across observations. We propose CRAFT, which transfers supervision from demonstrated executions of the required skill to counterfactual pairs using skill representations that can be reused across executions of the same skill. Across three VLA models and two simulation benchmarks, CRAFT improves success on undemonstrated combinations while maintaining high success on demonstrated ones; it also improves compositional generalization on a real robot. Project website: https://taegeunyang.github.io/craft/

</details>


### [786] [Does Continual Imitation Learning Remain Grounded? A Language-Perturbed Benchmark for Robotic Task Retention](https://arxiv.org/abs/2610.00542)
*Siddeshwar Raghavan,Ziqin Yuan,Fengqing Zhu,Byung-Cheol Min*

Main category: cs.RO

TL;DR: 本文提出一个基准协议，用于研究在持续模仿学习过程中，机器人策略的语言引导行为是否随任务累积而发生变化，并区分任务能力与语言敏感性。


<details>
  <summary>Details</summary>
Motivation: 持续模仿学习通常只评估策略是否遗忘旧技能（任务性能保持），但性能不下降并不代表行为仍真正由语言指令驱动——策略可能依赖场景线索、物体关联或记忆化任务结构。因此需要新的诊断方法来检验语言接地的可靠性。

Method: 在 LIBERO 的 Goal、Spatial、Object、Long 四个套件上构建保持语义（paraphrase）与改变语义的指令变体。实验聚焦 LIBERO-Goal，在每个持续学习阶段后分别用原始指令和改写指令评估。在保留各方法原始假设的前提下比较代表性持续模仿学习方法，并将任务胜任度与语言敏感性分离，提出语义鲁棒性、目标适应性和语言敏感性三类诊断指标。

Result: 结果表明，较强的持续学习性能并不总能转化为可靠的语言接地；提出的诊断指标可以判断保留下来的技能是否仍被指令正确引导。

Conclusion: 仅靠学习和遗忘指标不足以评价持续模仿学习，需补充语言敏感性等诊断，以确保策略行为持续受语言指令约束而非依赖捷径或记忆。

Abstract: Continual imitation learning evaluates whether a robot can learn new knowledge without forgetting previously learned skills. However, retaining task performance does not ensure the behavior remains grounded in language because policies may rely on scene cues, object associations, or memorized task structure. We introduce a benchmark protocol to study how language-guided behavior changes as robotic policies learn successive tasks. We construct meaning-preserving and meaning-changing instruction variants for the Goal, Spatial, Object, and Long suites of LIBERO. Policy experiments focus on LIBERO-Goal, evaluating Original and Paraphrase instructions after each continual-learning stage. We compare representative continual imitation learning methods under their original assumptions while separating task competence from language sensitivity. The proposed diagnostics complement standard learning and forgetting metrics by measuring semantic robustness, goal adaptation, and language sensitivity. Results show that strong continual-learning performance does not always translate to reliable language grounding, and our diagnostics help determine whether retained skills remain correctly guided by their instructions. Additional materials are available at https://sites.google.com/view/stillgrounded

</details>


### [787] [Token-World: World Modeling in Vision-Language Model Token Space for Robot Manipulation](https://arxiv.org/abs/2610.00575)
*Chuyao Fu,Xiaowei Chi,Yuhan Rui,Yu-kai Wang,Zezhong Qian,Xiaojie Zhang,Yunfan Lou,Kevin Zhang,Kuangzhi Ge,Chak Wing Mak,Zhiyang Chen,Athena Zhuoming Zhong,Hongyang Chen,Haoran Li,Yike Guo,Sirui Han,Shanghang Zhang*

Main category: cs.RO

TL;DR: Token-World 提出一种动作条件世界模型，将 VLM 视觉 token 压缩为紧凑状态并在该空间预测未来动态，再映射回原策略表征，用于 VLA 世界模型仿真。


<details>
  <summary>Details</summary>
Motivation: 现有 VLA 世界模型仿真通常预测未来 RGB 观测并重新编码为策略输入，仿真与下游策略执行之间存在间接接口；本文探索能否在由 VLM 视觉 token 导出的紧凑、面向策略的状态中建模世界动态。核心难点是原始 VLM 视觉 token 维度高，难以高效准确地进行自回归动态建模。

Method: Token-World 是一个动作条件世界模型：先将 VLM 特征压缩为紧凑 token 状态，在该降维空间学习未来动态，再将预测状态映射回原始的策略面向表征供下游使用。

Result: 在操作类基准上，Token-World 相比近期世界模型仿真器提升了开环特征保真度和策略-动作一致性，且长 rollout 衰减更慢。闭环评估中，其模拟策略性能与参考策略性能的相关性高于 Ctrl-World（r=0.794 vs. 0.583），同时仿真延迟更低。消融显示紧凑表征设计与维度显著影响未来状态预测。

Conclusion: 在紧凑的 VLM token 状态空间建模世界动态，可提升世界模型仿真的保真度、长时程稳定性与闭环策略评估可靠性，并降低仿真延迟。

Abstract: A common approach to world-model simulation for vision-language-action (VLA) systems is to predict future RGB observations and then re-encode them into policy inputs, introducing an indirect interface between simulation and downstream policy execution. We instead investigate whether world dynamics can be modeled in a compact, policy-oriented state derived from VLM visual tokens. A key challenge is that raw VLM visual tokens are high-dimensional, making efficient and accurate autoregressive dynamics modeling challenging. To address this, we introduce Token-World, an action-conditioned world model that compresses VLM features into a compact token state, learns future dynamics in this reduced space, and maps predicted states back to the original policy-facing representation for downstream use. Across manipulation benchmarks, Token-World improves open-loop feature fidelity and policy-action consistency over recent world-model simulators, with slower degradation over long rollout horizons. In closed-loop evaluation, its simulated policy performance correlates more strongly with reference policy performance than Ctrl-World ($r=0.794$ vs.\ $0.583$), while requiring lower simulation latency. Ablations further show that compact-representation design and dimensionality substantially affect future-state prediction. Code will be available at https://chuyaofu.github.io/Token-World/.

</details>


### [788] [When Reasoning Helps Action: Monitoring and Steering Chain-of-Thought in Vision-Language-Action Policies](https://arxiv.org/abs/2610.00601)
*Sathwik Karnik,Joseph JR. Lee,Aryaman Gupta,Somil Bansal*

Main category: cs.RO

TL;DR: 本文提出正确性可修正性(correctability)与行为可执行性(actionability)两个评测维度，并设计TRUST离线价值模型对冻结VLA策略的思维链进行token级监测与选择性引导。在驾驶VLA上，TRUST将推理正确率从75.9%提升至90.0%，碰撞率降低30.4%；但在操作VLA上，尽管推理正确率显著提升，闭环任务性能基本不变，说明推理正确性提升不等于具身性能提升。


<details>
  <summary>Details</summary>
Motivation: 推理增强型VLA策略会输出思维链，看似能解释并指导动作，从而成为运行时安全监控与纠错的潜在接口。但尚不清楚这种接口何时真正能改善具身行为，因此需要明确可评测的维度来判断其有效性。

Method: 定义并操作化两个评测轴：correctability（不可靠推理能否在生成过程中被检测并改善）与actionability（推理纠正能否产生方向正确的行为变化）。为此提出TRUST（Token-level Reward for Utility-Steered Chain-of-Thought），一个离线训练的价值模型，从部分前缀预测最终推理正确性，并据此对冻结VLA策略的推理生成进行监测与选择性引导。

Result: 在Alpamayo 1.5驾驶VLA上，TRUST监测正确性的准确率为88.9%，将推理正确率从75.9%提升到90.0%；在AlpaSim困难子集上，碰撞率相对未引导策略下降30.4%，最大轨迹误差下降11.5%，优于算力匹配的Best-of-4基线。在DeepThinkVLA操作VLA上，抓取状态判断正确率从69.3%提升到90.2%，动作选择判断从68.8%提升到85.9%，但LIBERO-Plus上的闭环任务性能基本不变。分析显示Alpamayo 1.5存在意图一致的行为效应，而DeepThinkVLA效应有限。

Conclusion: 推理正确性的提升并不自动带来具身性能的提升；将思维链作为运行时安全接口时，应同时评测correctability与actionability，而不能仅以推理正确率作为成功标准。

Abstract: Reasoning-enabled VLA policies expose chain-of-thought (CoT) traces that appear to explain and guide their actions, creating a potential interface for runtime safety through reasoning monitoring and correction. In this work, we define and operationalize two evaluation axes for assessing when this interface can improve embodied behavior: correctability, which measures whether unreliable reasoning can be detected and improved during generation, and actionability, which measures whether reasoning corrections produce behaviorally meaningful changes in the intended direction. To enable correctability, we introduce Token-level Reward for Utility-Steered Chain-of-Thought (TRUST), an offline-trained value model that predicts eventual reasoning correctness from partial prefixes and uses these estimates to monitor and selectively steer reasoning generation in frozen VLA policies. On the Alpamayo 1.5 driving VLA, TRUST monitors correctness with 88.9% accuracy and improves reasoning correctness from 75.9% to 90.0%. On a baseline-defined challenging subset in AlpaSim, TRUST reduces collision rate by 30.4% and maximum trajectory error by 11.5% relative to the unsteered policy, outperforming a compute-matched Best-of-4 baseline. On the DeepThinkVLA manipulation VLA, TRUST improves the correctness of grasp-state claims from 69.3% to 90.2% and action-choice claims from 68.8% to 85.9%, yet closed-loop task performance on LIBERO-Plus remains largely unchanged. Empirical analysis reveals intent-consistent behavioral effects in Alpamayo 1.5 but limited effects in DeepThinkVLA, helping interpret these different task-level outcomes. Together, our results show that gains in reasoning correctness do not automatically imply gains in embodied performance, motivating evaluation of correctability and actionability when using CoT as a runtime safety interface.

</details>


### [789] [TacDyn-WAM: Learning Implicit Tactile Dynamics in a Heterogeneous Visuo-Tactile World Action Model](https://arxiv.org/abs/2610.00638)
*Enyi Wang,Mingxin Wang,Quan Shi,Hetian Guo,Hongyu Wang,Xi Wang,Bin Qian,Yupeng Zheng,Wenxuan Song,Houde Liu,Yong Xu,Cheng Chi,Wenchao Ding,Yilun Chen,Yan Wang*

Main category: cs.RO

TL;DR: 提出 TacDyn-WAM 异构视触世界动作模型，用隐式触觉动力学预测替代触觉像素重建，在 UniVTAC 达 81.5% 成功率，真机五任务达 71.0%（预训练后 85.0%）。


<details>
  <summary>Details</summary>
Motivation: 现有触觉世界动作模型多沿用视频生成流程，通过迭代去噪重建未来触觉观测。该范式在部署漂移下不可靠：接触位置或力的微小变化会显著改变触觉像素，即便底层接触演化本身仍可预测。

Method: 构建异构视触世界动作模型，预测隐式触觉动力学而非重建未来触觉观测。学习 TacRep 动力学感知触觉目标空间：在触觉片段上做掩码时空预测训练，并以关系结构蒸馏正则化。视觉专家与隐式触觉动力学专家在各自目标空间预测未来表示，经联合注意力交互；触觉专家单次前向预测多时间尺度的未来表示及其变化，辅以只读触觉记忆提供当前触觉状态。

Result: UniVTAC 上仅用给定示教达平均 81.5% 成功率，达到 SOTA 级别，并与大规模视触轨迹预训练模型具有竞争力；消融验证两条触觉通路及 TacRep 优于像素重建与静态方案。五个真机任务平均成功率 71.0%，小规模预训练提升至 85.0%。

Conclusion: 以隐式动力学表示替代触觉观测重建，可提升世界动作模型在漂移下的鲁棒性与数据效率；双专家异构架构、多尺度表示预测与触觉记忆是性能关键，真机结果进一步验证其有效性。

Abstract: World action models improve robotic manipulation by conditioning actions on predicted futures, yet existing tactile variants largely inherit video-generation pipelines that reconstruct future tactile observations through iterative denoising. Such prediction can become unreliable under deployment drift: small changes in contact position or force may substantially alter tactile pixels even when the underlying contact evolution remains predictable. We introduce TacDyn-WAM, a heterogeneous visuo-tactile world action model that predicts implicit tactile dynamics rather than reconstructing future tactile observations. It learns TacRep, a dynamics-aware tactile target space trained through masked spatio-temporal prediction on tactile clips and regularized by relational structure distillation. A visual expert and an Implicit Tactile Dynamics Expert predict future visual and tactile representations in separate target spaces while interacting through joint attention; the tactile expert predicts future representations and their changes at multiple horizons in a single forward pass, and a read-only tactile memory supplies the current tactile state. On UniVTAC, TacDyn-WAM achieves an average success rate of 81.5% using only the provided demonstrations, reaching state-of-the-art-level performance and remaining competitive with models pretrained on large-scale visuo-tactile trajectories. Ablations confirm the benefits of both tactile pathways and TacRep over pixel-reconstruction and static alternatives. On five real-robot tasks, TacDyn-WAM reaches 71.0% average success, and modest-scale pretraining raises it to 85.0%, further validating our method.

</details>


### [790] [Toward Humanoid Robots in Construction: A Teleoperation Feasibility Study](https://arxiv.org/abs/2610.00718)
*Parastoo Ali Pour,David R. Martin,Chang Min Hur,Bo Zhang,Tommy Zhou,Brandon Thomas Lichter,Shane Stanfield,Pramod Khargonekar,Mohammad Abdullah Al Faruque*

Main category: cs.RO

TL;DR: 本文提出一套面向 Unitree G1 人形机器人的遥操作系统，将基于扩展现实（XR）的上半身控制与脚踏式移动控制结合，使单一操作者能够同时进行操作与行走；在两项建筑施工任务上验证，工具搬运成功率 100%，表面喷漆成功率 80%，但耗时明显高于人工基线。


<details>
  <summary>Details</summary>
Motivation: 受持续存在的劳动力短缺、危险作业环境以及人形机器人自主能力不足等问题驱动，研究遥操作作为一种近期可行的实用方案，既能减轻工人的身体负担，又能采集高质量的演示数据。

Method: 构建面向 Unitree G1 人形机器人的遥操作系统：上半身采用基于 XR 的控制方式，移动采用脚踏式（pedal-based）控制，从而支持单一操作者同时完成操作与移动。从 O*NET 职业数据库中选择两项具有代表性的建筑施工任务，并将遥操作与人工直接操作基线在任务成功率与完成时间上进行对比评估。

Result: 在工具搬运任务上成功率为 100%，在表面喷漆任务上成功率为 80%；与人工直接执行相比，遥操作所需的完成时间显著更长。

Conclusion: 研究表明，单一操作者借助 XR 上半身控制与脚踏移动的遥操作系统，可在人形机器人上以较高成功率完成建筑施工任务，具备作为近期实用方案的可行性，同时可作为高质量演示数据的采集途径；但效率方面仍与人工操作存在明显差距，未来需进一步优化以缩短任务完成时间。

Abstract: We present a teleoperation system that enables a single operator to perform construction tasks on a Unitree G1 humanoid, combining extended reality (XR) based upper body control with pedal-based locomotion to enable simultaneous manipulation and locomotion. Motivated by persistent labor shortages, hazardous working conditions, and challenges in humanoid autonomy, we investigate teleoperation as a practical near-term approach for reducing physical strain on workers while generating high quality demonstration data. We evaluate the system on two representative construction tasks drawn from O*NET occupational database, and report task success and completion time relative to a manual baseline. The system achieved 100% success on tool transport and 80% success on surface painting, with teleoperation requiring substantially more time compared to manual execution.

</details>


### [791] [CF-JEPA: Improving Robustness of JEPA World Models via Controllability Factorization](https://arxiv.org/abs/2610.00727)
*Morgan Byrd,Robert Wright,Sehoon Ha*

Main category: cs.RO

TL;DR: 提出CF-JEPA，将JEPA式世界模型的潜在空间分解为可控与不可控子空间，把干扰信息归入不可控区域，从而在干扰条件下保持控制性能并避免潜在坍缩。


<details>
  <summary>Details</summary>
Motivation: 基于视觉控制智能体需从无关背景中分离有用信息。JEPA式潜在世界模型不做像素级重建，看似天然适合此任务，但实际上仍对干扰信号敏感，并会出现潜在坍缩问题。

Method: 提出Controllability Factorized JEPA（CF-JEPA）：一种JEPA式世界模型，将潜在空间拆分为可控子空间与不可控子空间。干扰信息被捕获进不可控区域，任务则使用与控制相关的潜在信息。

Result: 在2D与3D控制任务中，名义条件下性能与基线相当；在干扰条件下性能更优，且CF-JEPA是唯一未出现潜在坍缩的模型。在模拟机器人任务的干扰条件下也得到验证。

Conclusion: 通过可控性分解潜在空间，CF-JEPA能有效抑制干扰信息并避免潜在坍缩，展现出在真实机器人控制场景中的实用潜力。

Abstract: Controlling an agent with vision requires being able to separate useful information from irrelevant background information. JEPA-style latent world models seem like a natural approach for this, as they do not perform pixel-level reconstruction; however, they are still sensitive to these distractor signals and experience latent collapse. In this work, we introduce Controllability Factorized JEPA (CF-JEPA), a JEPA-style world model which splits the latent space into controllable and uncontrollable subspaces. This factorization allows us to capture all the distractor information into the uncontrollable region, while we use the control-relevant latent information for our task. With this, we show comparable performance across 2D and 3D control tasks under nominal conditions and improved performance under distracted conditions, where CF-JEPA is the only model that does not experience latent collapse. We also validate our model under distracted conditions for a simulated robot task, highlighting the practical application of such a scheme.

</details>


### [792] [Measuring Asset and Scene Reconstruction Effects in Real-to-Sim Robot Evaluation](https://arxiv.org/abs/2610.00731)
*Sanya Verma,Luca Cilio,Velissarios Christodoulou*

Main category: cs.RO

TL;DR: 通过对比自建重建流程与开源默认方案，证明提升视觉保真度、物理参数与度量尺度可显著提高仿真-真实评分一致性，缩小sim-to-real差距。


<details>
  <summary>Details</summary>
Motivation: 仿真评估因成本低、易重复而被广泛用于机器人策略评估，但其价值取决于仿真结果与真实机器人结果的一致程度。作者希望验证：结合度量尺度物体几何、手工设定物理参数与场景重建的流程，能否比开源默认方案更好地降低仿真与真实评分之间的偏差。

Method: 为同一个双臂机器人工作单元构建两种仿真版本：一是"自建重建"，采用估计度量尺度的物体几何、投影纹理、手工设定的物理参数和自研场景splat；二是"默认重建"基线，采用开源配方（生成式单图网格、引擎默认物理、高斯splat场景）。两者使用相同的物体照片与场景视频。两条策略各跑五个任务，共十个"任务-策略"单元（cell），每个单元在两种重建下各运行20次，其他设置完全固定。两种重建均与同一批真实试验对比，由第三方评估者打分。

Result: 十个单元仿真均值与真实均值的Pearson相关系数：自建重建 r=0.90，默认重建 r=0.51。平均得分误差：自建重建6.97个百分点，默认重建17.54个百分点，降低10.56个百分点。

Conclusion: 通过更高视觉保真度、手工物理参数与度量尺度提升环境重建质量，可使仿真更贴近真实世界并缩小sim-to-real差距。作者开源了测试框架、逐次试验得分、所有报告运行的配置以及两种重建的资产与场景。

Abstract: Simulated evaluation is increasingly used alongside real-world evaluation of robot policies because it is cheaper and easier to repeat; however, its value depends on how closely its outcomes track the real robot's. We test whether our reconstruction pipeline, combining metrically scaled object geometry, authored physical parameters and scene reconstruction, reduces disagreement between simulated and real robot scores relative to a default open-source recipe. We constructed two simulated versions of one bimanual robot cell: an authored reconstruction, using object geometry at estimated metric scale, projected textures, authored physics and our own scene splat; and a baseline, referred to as the default reconstruction, using the open-source recipe of a generative single-image mesh, engine-default physics and a Gaussian-splat scene. Both reconstructions use the same object photographs and scene video. Two policies ran five tasks each, giving ten task-policy pairs, which we call cells; each cell was run twenty times in each reconstruction with all other settings held fixed. Both reconstructions were scored against the same real trials, graded by a third-party evaluator. Pearson correlation between the ten simulated and real cell means is r = 0.90 for the authored reconstruction and 0.51 for the default. Mean score error is 6.97 percentage points for the authored reconstruction and 17.54 for the default, a reduction of 10.56 percentage points. These results show that improving the quality of the environment reconstruction through higher visual fidelity, authored physics and metric scale makes the simulation more faithful to the real world and narrows the sim-to-real gap. We release the harness, the per-trial scores, every reported run's configuration, and the assets and scenes of both reconstructions.

</details>


### [793] [DITTO-X: Forward and Reverse Teleoperation for Dexterous Manipulation and Human Intervention](https://arxiv.org/abs/2610.00781)
*Zhanpeng He,Joaquin Palacios,Zhangyu Wang,Chenhao Li,Katelyn Lee,Matei Ciocarlie,C. Karen Liu,Jiajun Wu*

Main category: cs.RO

TL;DR: DITTO-X 是一种手无关的灵巧遥操作接口，利用机器人手自带传感器渲染关节力与指尖接触事件，可驱动三款商用灵巧手，并支持反向遥操作，在数据采集与共享自主干预中提升演示质量与效率。


<details>
  <summary>Details</summary>
Motivation: 现有遥操作系统多以视觉闭环并基于平行夹爪构建，限制了机器人可执行的动作和操作者的表达范围；在共享自主场景中，操作者仅通过被遮挡的摄像头观察，且常需在已抓取物体时中途接管，问题尤为突出。

Method: 提出 DITTO-X 手无关灵巧遥操作接口：从机器人手上已有传感器渲染关节级力反馈与指尖接触事件，无需逐手重新设计即可驱动 Sharpa、Wuji、Inspire 三款商用灵巧手；由于外骨骼具备驱动能力，支持反向遥操作，在下发控制前由机器人将操作者手指反驱至自身构型，使操作者进入回路时即与其所继承的状态匹配。

Result: 实验表明，无论是在常规数据采集还是在策略部署期间对接触丰富操作任务进行人工干预时，DITTO-X 在演示质量和吞吐量上均优于商用动作追踪手套。

Conclusion: DITTO-X 通过力/接触反馈与手无关设计增强了灵巧遥操作的数据采集与共享自主干预能力，并验证了反向遥操作在状态继承匹配上的实用价值。更多信息见 https://tml.stanford.edu/ditto-x/。

Abstract: Teleoperated demonstrations are a primary source of data for robot manipulation, and teleoperated interventions are a primary mechanism for correcting policies at deployment. Yet most teleoperation systems close the loop through vision alone and are built around parallel-jaw grippers, limiting both what the robot can execute and what the operator can express through it. This is most damaging in shared autonomy, where the operator sees the scene only through occluded cameras and must take over a dexterous hand mid-task, often with an object already grasped. We present DITTO-X, a hand-agnostic dexterous teleoperation interface that renders joint-level force and fingertip contact events from sensing already on the robot hand, and drives three commercial dexterous hands (Sharpa, Wuji, and Inspire) without per-hand redesign. Because the exoskeleton is actuated, DITTO-X also supports reverse teleoperation, in which the robot back-drives the operator's fingers into its own configuration before control is transferred, so the human enters the loop already matched to the state they inherit. Our results show that DITTO-X improves demonstration quality and throughput over a commercial hand-tracking glove, both in regular data collection and in human intervention during policy deployment for contact-rich manipulation tasks. More information can be found from our website: https://tml.stanford.edu/ditto-x/.

</details>


### [794] [ECoMEM: Explicit Concept Memory for Memory-Dependent Robot Control](https://arxiv.org/abs/2610.00801)
*Yize Liu,Ke Wang,Mac Schwager,Yiqing Xu,Jiajun Wu*

Main category: cs.RO

TL;DR: 论文提出Explicit Concept Memory (ECoMEM)，将"维护任务相关的可验证历史记忆"与"学习如何基于记忆行动"解耦，用可复用的grounded概念库表示历史，在16个RoboMME任务中15项领先，真实机器人任务成功率达86.1%（无记忆VLA为8.6%）。


<details>
  <summary>Details</summary>
Motivation: 长时程机器人任务中，关键信息（如之前观察到的目标物、人类演示、任务已完成步骤）会从当前观测中消失，而现有VLA策略一旦所需信息不在当前观测中就失败。已有方法多依赖更长历史或从观测-动作轨迹中隐式学习记忆，但动作监督只告诉策略"如何行动"，并不指明"应该记住什么"以及新证据到来时记忆应如何更新，因此记忆机制缺乏对"过去事实"的明确约束。

Method: 将"维护基于证据的过去状态"与"学习如何对其行动"分离，提出ECoMEM：用可复用的grounded概念库表示任务相关历史；由基于证据的Writer负责选择并更新这些记忆记录；由学习得到的Reader将其转为memory tokens，直接作为VLA的条件输入。

Result: 在16个RoboMME任务中，ECoMEM在15个任务上优于所评估的机器人策略；在两个新的真实机器人任务上，同一记忆库可直接迁移，或仅需新增一个概念，实现86.1%成功率，而no-memory VLA仅8.6%。

Conclusion: 显式概念可作为机器人控制中可复用、可扩展的记忆接口，弥补动作监督无法定义"记什么、如何更新"的缺陷，为长时程机器人行为提供有效且可迁移的记忆方案。

Abstract: A robot may lose sight of an object it must later retrieve, need to recall what a person demonstrated earlier, or track which steps of a task it has already completed.
